title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
summary:
Bigg Boss The Common Man is a spin-off and pre-show of the Indian Tamil-language reality television show Bigg Boss. The pre-show involves selecting contestants that are not celebrities for the main show. The format of the show is based on the Telugu-language television show Bigg Boss Agnipariksha.
The show is hosted by former contestant Maya S. Krishnan whilst Oviya, Aari Arujunan and Raju Jeyamohan are the judges. The winners will compete as contestants in the main Bigg Boss house.

title: Bigg Boss Agnipareeksha
summary:
Bigg Boss Agnipareeksha is a spin-off and pre-show of the Indian Malayalam-language reality television show Bigg Boss. The pre-show involves selecting commoner contestants for the main show. The format of the show is based on the Telugu-language television show Bigg Boss Agnipariksha.
The show is hosted by Reneesha Rahiman with  Ranjini Haridas,  Riyas Salim and Akhil Marar as judges. The first season started airing from 15 August 2026 on Asianet and streaming on JioHotstar. The winners will compete as contestants in the main house of Bigg Boss season 8.

Production
articleSections.text: The show was officially unveiled through a promotional teaser released on 21 May 2026, coinciding with Mohanlal's birthday. The contestants are asked to send their introduction video on the official website. Out of this, selected 40 contestants will compete for entry to Main House. title: Bareilly Ke Bacchan
summary: Bareilly Ke Bacchan is an Indian Hindi-language family drama television series that premiered on 8 June 2026 on Colors TV  and streams digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by AORAA Pictures, it stars Pravisht Mishra, Ramneek Kataria, and Kinshuk Mahajan.It is a remake of Star Vijay's Tamil series Ayyanar Thunai.
plot:
The series is set in the town of Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, and revolves around the eccentric, dysfunctional, and all-male Bacchan household. Led by the stubborn family patriarch, Ajab Singh Bacchan (Yashpal Sharma), the household comprises his four unfiltered sons who have lived for years entirely devoid of any female presence or influence. The brothers each represent a unique layer of the chaotic domestic ecosystem: Ganga (Kinshuk Mahajan), the soft-spoken eldest brother who acts as the makeshift mother-figure; Krishna (Pravisht Mishra), a charming taxi driver on a constant quest to find true love; Satluj (Ansh Manuja), an explosive and hot-headed young man; and Mahi (Sachin Jeet Singh), the youngest of the pack.
The narrative kicks off when Krishna crosses paths with Sangam (Ramneek Kataria), an ambitious, clear-headed college topper whose dreams of pursuing her education and career constantly clash with her traditional father’s rigid plans to marry her off. Sangam is initially arranged to marry an arrogant man named Vicky, who dismisses her career ambitions. Krishna, falling in a one-sided love with Sangam, takes up a job as Vicky's driver to stay close to her and protect her interests.
Through a twist of fate and the collapse of her initial arranged alliance, Sangam ends up marrying the carefree Krishna. The core conflict of the show explores the ultimate cultural and domestic clash when Sangam—a strong-willed, goal-oriented modern woman—enters the unkempt, rowdy Bacchan house as the first daughter-in-law. The plot follows Sangam's daily struggles to navigate a household of men completely unaccustomed to living with a woman, as she attempts to bring order to their unruly lives while fighting to keep her own personal ambitions alive.

plotHtml:
The series is set in the town of Bareilly, Uttar Pradesh, and revolves around the eccentric, dysfunctional, and all-male Bacchan household. Led by the stubborn family patriarch, Ajab Singh Bacchan (Yashpal Sharma), the household comprises his four unfiltered sons who have lived for years entirely devoid of any female presence or influence. The brothers each represent a unique layer of the chaotic domestic ecosystem: Ganga (Kinshuk Mahajan), the soft-spoken eldest brother who acts as the makeshift mother-figure; Krishna (Pravisht Mishra), a charming taxi driver on a constant quest to find true love; Satluj (Ansh Manuja), an explosive and hot-headed young man; and Mahi (Sachin Jeet Singh), the youngest of the pack.
The narrative kicks off when Krishna crosses paths with Sangam (Ramneek Kataria), an ambitious, clear-headed college topper whose dreams of pursuing her education and career constantly clash with her traditional father’s rigid plans to marry her off. Sangam is initially arranged to marry an arrogant man named Vicky, who dismisses her career ambitions. Krishna, falling in a one-sided love with Sangam, takes up a job as Vicky's driver to stay close to her and protect her interests.
Through a twist of fate and the collapse of her initial arranged alliance, Sangam ends up marrying the carefree Krishna. The core conflict of the show explores the ultimate cultural and domestic clash when Sangam—a strong-willed, goal-oriented modern woman—enters the unkempt, rowdy Bacchan house as the first daughter-in-law. The plot follows Sangam's daily struggles to navigate a household of men completely unaccustomed to living with a woman, as she attempts to bring order to their unruly lives while fighting to keep her own personal ambitions alive.
tagline: In Bareilly, a charming taxi driver navigates familial chaos and cultural clashes while pursuing love and ambition in a male-dominated household.

title: Brown
summary:
Brown is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language psychological thriller web series directed by Abhinay Deo and produced by Zee Studios. It is based on City of Death, a 2016 novel by Abheek Barua, with the screenplay written by Diggi Sisodia, Sunayana Kumari, and Mayukh Ghosh. It stars Karisma Kapoor as a Kolkata detective, alongside Surya Sharma, Jisshu Sengupta, Soni Razdan and Ajinkya Deo. The series premiered on ZEE5 on 5 June 2026.
Set in Kolkata, the series follows Rita Brown, an Anglo-Indian detective with the Kolkata Police Force who investigates the murder of a teenager from a prominent family while dealing with alcoholism and personal trauma. In 2023, it was selected for Berlinale Series Market Selects, the first Indian web series chosen for that programme.
plot: Rita Brown is a detective with the Kolkata Police Force from the city's Anglo-Indian community. She is a recovering alcoholic assigned to investigate the murder of a teenager from a well-connected Kolkata family. Jisshu Sengupta plays a psychiatrist connected to the investigation.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 2 stars out of 5 and writes that "And in its first couple of episodes, this 7-episode show, which has been hanging fire for a while, does grab our attention." Deepa Gahlot writing for the Rediff.com gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and noted that "Karisma Kapoor makes a powerful return to the screen in Brown, a compelling series." Shreyas Pande writing for The Hindu observes that "Director Abhinay Deo crafts an intriguing world of characters only to later let monotony set in as the screenplay doesn’t take any creative leaps".
Prachi Arya of India Today gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and said that "Brown works best as a psychological crime drama that relies more on its characters and mood than on shock value. Its haunting Kolkata setting, strong performances and well-paced mystery keep you invested throughout, even if the constant emphasis on grief and trauma can feel a little repetitive at times." Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated it 3.5/5 stars and writes that "Watch it if you enjoy atmospheric slow-burn crime thrillers that focus more on complex characters and psychological depth than traditional whodunnit twists."
Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in felt that "Brown follows the beats of crime thrillers to a fault, it benefits from well-written characters with defined arcs and solid scenes. The show is well-produced, appropriately grim-looking and gripping. The dialogue is mostly in Hindi with lashings of Bengali and English." Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India desrcibe it as a "A good-looking but banal crime thriller."
Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost gave 4 stars out of 5 and writes that "Karisma Kapoor’s Brown has the magnetic ability to put you in deep thought. Each episode is long and so immersive that it will not only emotionally drain you out but will also teach you how to deal with grief." Monica Yadav writing for Hindustan Times rated it 3/5 stars and said that "If you love slow-burn, atmospheric noir or want to see a career-redefining performance from Karisma Kapoor, Brown is worth your time." Shreyanka Mazumdar of News 18 gave 3.5 stars out of 5 and priase the performance saying that "Karisma Kapoor delivers one of the finest performances of her career in Brown, a dark and absorbing crime thriller."

articleSections.title: Background
articleSections.text:
Zee Studios developed Brown from Abheek Barua's novel City of Death (2016) over roughly two years before its international debut.
At the Berlinale, Karisma Kapoor told Variety that the character Rita Brown appealed to her precisely because she was far from her earlier work: "flawed, but human," and a role that required dropping the glamour of her film career. The series also features playback singer Shaan in his acting debut.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
Abhinay Deo, known for directing Delhi Belly (2011) and the Indian adaptation of 24, directed Brown. The screenplay was written by Diggi Sisodia, Sunayana Kumari, and Mayukh Ghosh, adapted from Barua's novel. Suri Gopalan created the series in collaboration with Barua; Zee Studios produced it.
The series is set and shot in Kolkata, whose architecture and street atmosphere inform its neo-noir visual tone.

articleSections.title: Release

title: Brothers and Sisters
summary:
Brothers and Sisters is an Indian Tamil-language romantic family comedy drama television series, which is an spiritual successor of the web series Uppu Puli Kaaram (2024).This series is directed by Chidambaram Manivannan for JioHotstar.The story revolves around a close-knit but secret-laden family as a brother and his three sisters embark on a hilarious, emotional mission to manage their father.
The principal characters of the series include Bose Venkat, Gayathri Shastry, Pramodini Pammi, Nikhila Sankar, Luthuf, Shravnitha Srikanth, Kishore, Riyan Joe Jerry, Raj Ayyappa, Siddharth Babu and Namritha MV.It premiered on JioHotstar on 27 May 2026.
plot:
The Ponmalar household, led by the strict textile businessman Shanmuga Sundaram "SS" and his warm-hearted wife Ponmalar, appears happy and tightly knit on the surface. They have four children with distinct personalities: Jayshree (a lawyer), Harini(an IT employee), Jagadeesh "Jaggu" (a DJ), and Meera (an aspiring cricketer).
Their peaceful routines are upended when a shocking revelation emerges: their father has a hidden affair. United by their love for their mother and a desire to protect their family, the siblings band together, taking an oath to expose the affair and shield their family from breaking apart.
reception: Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "On a hot, summer day with overwhelming viewing options, Brothers and Sisters is a safe, convenient choice, tailored for family-friendly viewing. The story is minimal, the atmosphere is light, it deals with relatable characters in a few stock situations and has its target audience entertained without trying too hard".Sree of OTT Release wrote that, "Not a “perfect binge,” but definitely an emotionally messy, sometimes slow, sometimes powerful family drama. If you like stories that feel more real than refined, this one might stick with you longer than expected".

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
In April 2026, JioHotstar announced Brothers and Sisters, a Tamil family drama web series created and directed by Chidambaram Manivannan. The series was developed as a spiritual successor to Uppu Puli Kaaram (2024), with Manivannan returning to explore themes of family relationships, sibling bonds and everyday domestic life through a new story and set of characters and positioning it as a continuation of the long-format family storytelling style popularized by the earlier series.The technical crew included music director Saran Raghavan, cinematographer Manikandan Ramamoorthy and art director Vasu Dhevan.
The series is directed by Chidambaram Manivannan and written by A. C. Karnamurthy. It is produced by Vikatan Televistas, a production company known for producing Tamil television serials such as Siragadikka Aasai, Thamizhum Saraswathiyum and Uppu Puli Kaaram.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: The series stars Bose Venkat and Gayathri Shastry were cast in the lead roles, alongside Raj Ayyappa, Nikhila Sankar, Luthuf, Kishore, Shravnitha Srikanth, Siddharth Babu, Pramodini Pammi and Namritha MV.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The first trailer was released on 25 April 2026, featuring the Ponmalar family as they navigate personal conflicts and unexpected challenges arising from a long-buried family secret.
It was announced that the series would be released in Tamil and other Indian languages and made its streaming debut on 27 May 2026.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: Siddartha Toleti of M9 News wrote that, "On a hot, summer day with overwhelming viewing options, Brothers and Sisters is a safe, convenient choice, tailored for family-friendly viewing. The story is minimal, the atmosphere is light, it deals with relatable characters in a few stock situations and has its target audience entertained without trying too hard".Sree of OTT Release wrote that, "Not a “perfect binge,” but definitely an emotionally messy, sometimes slow, sometimes powerful family drama. If you like stories that feel more real than refined, this one might stick with you longer than expected".

episodesList.title: The House of SS
episodesList.summary: Meet the family of SS and his devoted wife, along with their beautiful children. In Bengaluru, their first daughter Jayshree's live-in boyfriend goes missing.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Second Chance
episodesList.summary: Priyan saves Jayshree after her drastic decision. SS and his family are unable to contact her. Meanwhile, Siddharth opens up to his mother about his feelings for Harini.

episodesList.title: Priyan Guides Jayshree
episodesList.summary: As Jayshree struggles to cope, Priyan makes her face reality and persuades her to return to the warmth of her family. Back at home, Meera gives SS a makeover.

episodesList.title: Harini vs Jayshree's Secret
episodesList.summary: Jayshree returns home and manages to hide her secret. However, Harini begins to sense that something is wrong and suspects that she is hiding a problem.

episodesList.title: Harini Stands by Jayshree
episodesList.summary: SS rejects Ponmalar's brother Azhagar's marriage proposal for Jayshree. Meanwhile, Harini takes Jayshree for counseling to help her feel better.

episodesList.title: Harini Meets Siddharth's Mother
episodesList.summary: SS gets the jewels from Ponmalar to secure funds for Girija's investment in a new house. Meanwhile, Siddharth's mother pays a visit to his office to meet his love interest, Harini.

episodesList.title: New Opportunity for Jayshree
episodesList.summary: When Harini looks for a lawyer's job for Jayshree, Siddharth uses his connections and helps her get a job. His father is surprised and questions him about his unusual behaviour.

episodesList.title: Jaggu and Madhu Grow Closer
episodesList.summary: Jaggu and Madhu find themselves growing closer as new feelings spark between them. Meanwhile, Girija celebrates a fresh start by hosting a grand house-warming function.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Faces Roshini's Love
episodesList.summary: Despite Girija's objections, Madhu visits jail to meet someone. Following his mother's advice, Siddharth asks Roshini to move out of his cabin. But Roshini has different plans.

episodesList.title: Harini Opens Up
episodesList.summary: Ashwin gives Meera a hard time about her siblings' attitude towards him. Meanwhile, Harini shares her budding love interest with Jayshree.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Jayshree unexpectedly meets Priyan and learns of his situation. On the marriage front, things move too fast for Jayshree, but Harini convinces her to agree for now.

episodesList.title: Jaggu's Shocking Discovery
episodesList.summary: Girija asks SS to accompany her to a friend's wedding. At Jaggu's DJ gig, he sees something that shakes his world.

episodesList.title: SS's Secret Shocks the Family
episodesList.summary: Jaggu discovers a startling truth about SS and confides in his sisters. Together, they decide to keep their mother unaware of the situation.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Presents the Proof
episodesList.summary: As his sisters struggle to accept it, Jaggu presents proof of SS's affair. Unaware of the growing tension, SS remains busy preparing for the groom's visit to see Jayshree.

episodesList.title: Humiliation Strikes Jayshree
episodesList.summary: When the groom publicly reveals the truth about Jayshree, Ponmalar collapses from the shock. While Jaggu watches helplessly, Priyan steps in to comfort a devastated Jayshree.

episodesList.title: SS Realises His Love for Ponmalar
episodesList.summary: After regaining consciousness, Ponmalar asks for Jayshree. Watching SS care for Ponmalar, Jaggu and his sisters begin to realise the depth of his feelings for her.

episodesList.title: Jaggu's Outburst
episodesList.summary: Jaggu comes home drunk and has a heated argument with his sisters. He accuses Jayshree of being responsible for their mother's condition, leaving her feeling hurt.

episodesList.title: A Home Filled with Care
episodesList.summary: As Ponmalar gets discharged from the hospital, the girls take charge of the cooking and other chores. Ponmalar talks to SS about getting Jayshree married to her brother, Keerthi.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Fixes Jayshree's Alliance
episodesList.summary: Madhu feels Jaggu is distancing himself from her. Meanwhile, Jayshree is unable to voice her feelings after Ponmalar convinces her brother and finalises her alliance with Keerthi.

episodesList.title: SS Under Scrutiny
episodesList.summary: Girija takes SS to an Ayurvedic clinic for Ponmalar’s medicines. While Ponmalar is happy with his care and concern, Jaggu questions him about his mysterious hospital visit.

episodesList.title: Harini Says No
episodesList.summary: SS agrees to a marriage between Jayshree and Ponmalar's brother, Keerthi. During a car ride, Siddharth insists on taking Harini out for a lunch date, much to Harini's displeasure.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Learns About Madhu's Family
episodesList.summary: Jayshree meets Priyan and tells him about her marriage alliance with her relative and her decision to reveal her secrets. Meanwhile, Jaggu meets Madhu and digs into her family.

episodesList.title: The Children Plot Against SS
episodesList.summary: SS asks Ponmalar to accompany him to secure a loan for the shop. However, Jaggu and his sisters decide to stop them.

episodesList.title: Jayshree Tells the Truth
episodesList.summary: SS vents his frustration to Girija about the business loan issue. When Ponmalar's relatives arrive to finalise the wedding, Jayshree decides to reveal the truth to Keerthi.

episodesList.title: SS Chooses Girija
episodesList.summary: After Keerthy rejects the marriage, SS and Jayshree hide it from Ponmalar. SS plans a trip to Ahmedabad to procure stock for Ponmalar Textiles and asks Girija to accompany him.

episodesList.title: Madhu Convinces Girija!
episodesList.summary: Madhu encourages Girija not to accompany SS on the Ahmedabad trip, accusing the latter of being selfish. Meanwhile, Jaggu strikes up a new friendship with Meena.

episodesList.title: SS's Silent Hurt
episodesList.summary: Jayshree and her sisters plan to reunite their parents by making Ponmalar sleep in their father's room. SS is deeply hurt when they question his business decisions.

episodesList.title: A Twist on Madhu's Birthday
episodesList.summary: After Girija leaves for Ahmedabad with SS, Madhu is left alone on her birthday. She invites Jaggu to her house and feeling sorry for her, he visits her. But a surprise awaits him.

episodesList.title: Meera's Smart Move
episodesList.summary: As SS leaves for Ahmedabad with Girija, Jaggu and the sisters try to disrupt their trip. Meera’s smart move of joining Ponmalar Textiles surprises everyone.

episodesList.title: Harini's Unexpected Demand
episodesList.summary: Harini agrees to accept Siddharth's love with a shocking condition, leaving him torn. Meanwhile, Ponmalar discovers why Keerthi rejected the wedding proposal.

episodesList.title: SS Under Meera's Watch
episodesList.summary: After the family's pleas, SS lets Meera intern at Ponmalar textiles. However, rather than concentrating on her training, Meera remains highly observant of SS's every action.

episodesList.title: Girija Seeks SS's Support
episodesList.summary: Girija opposes Madhu's love interest, leading to a rift between them. She hopes for support from SS. A heated argument between Priyan and Jayshree unexpectedly brings them closer.

episodesList.title: SS Lies to Ponmalar
episodesList.summary: Madhu's hospitalisation forces SS to rush to her and her mother, but Ponmalar has questions. Meanwhile, Siddharth goes to Girija's apartment building in search of a new house.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Alarms Harini with Truth
episodesList.summary: Siddharth agrees to Harini's request to live near Girija's house and reveals that he knows the truth. Girija catches Madhu on a call with Jaggu and questions her.

episodesList.title: Jayshree, Priyan's Special Moment
episodesList.summary: SS rages at Girija for visiting his shop when his daughter is present. Jayshree helps Priyan admit his pregnant sister to the hospital and they share a heartfelt moment together.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Takes Harini Home
episodesList.summary: Priyan is deeply touched as Jayshree gets nutritious postnatal meal for his sister at the hospital. Siddharth introduces Harini to his mother. Velpandi spots them and gets upset.

episodesList.title: Madhu's Love Confession
episodesList.summary: Madhu bares her heart to Jaggu, but his unexpected response leaves her shattered. Meanwhile, Siddharth performs his house-warming ceremony and meets Girija.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Fumble
episodesList.summary: Siddharth plays the good neighbour to Girija when she is away from home. Ponmalar again coaxes Jayshree to consider marrying. To pacify her, Jayshree blurts out a lie.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan
episodesList.summary: SS resists the auditor's pressure to sell his textile business as Jaggu seeks a solution. At the hospital, Ponmalar runs into Priyan and mistakes his and Jayshree's bond for love.

episodesList.title: SS Draws the Line
episodesList.summary: As Thangam and her sons take charge of SS's security, SS asks Jaggu to end the arrangement. When SS confides in Girija, she advises him to sell Ponmalar Textiles.

episodesList.title: Madhu's Heartfelt Confession
episodesList.summary: As SS struggles with a crisis at Ponmalar Textiles, Jayshree offers legal help. Elsewhere, Madhu makes an emotional confession to Jaggu and questions why he cannot love her back.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Meets Priyan's Family
episodesList.summary: Ponmalar decides to visit Priyan and his family to check on them, leaving Jayshree in shock. Meanwhile, Girija changes Madhu's mind and begins searching for a groom for her.

episodesList.title: SS Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: SS mysteriously goes missing, throwing Girija's household into chaos when the groom's family arrives. Ponmalar and her daughters desperately search for SS, fearing for his safety.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Seeks Thangam's Help
episodesList.summary: Jaggu approaches Meenu and asks for Thangam's help in finding his missing father. Meanwhile, Harini asks Siddharth to seek his father's assistance in moving the case forward.

episodesList.title: Girija Avoids SS
episodesList.summary: SS returns home after going missing for a night. Girija is angry with SS and refuses to answer his calls. As the stress builds, she faints, and Siddharth helps her.

episodesList.title: SS Faces Girija's Wrath
episodesList.summary: SS worries about Girija avoiding his calls and goes to her house. Once there, she vents her frustration and disappointment.

episodesList.title: Ponmalar Talks About Priyan
episodesList.summary: Madhu and Girija plan to rent out their house without SS's involvement. Ponmalar has a conversation with Jayshree about Priyan.

episodesList.title: Priyan Plays Reluctant Cupid
episodesList.summary: Baskar approaches Jayshree using Priyan's phone, creating friction between Jayshree and Priyan. Girija realises SS was indeed kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Jaggu Doubts Jayshree-Priyan's Bond
episodesList.summary: Jaggu spots Jayshree having tea with Priyan and suspects they are more than friends. He shares his doubts with Ponmalar, while Meera struggles to convince SS about online sales.

episodesList.title: Jayshree's Feelings Surface
episodesList.summary: Priyan's gift stirs new feelings in Jayshree. While the Ponmalar Textiles staff voice their concerns about online sales to SS, Girija reconciles with him and awaits his visit.

episodesList.title: A Critical Turn for Jaggu
episodesList.summary: Jaggu has been hospitalised following an accident, which has left SS feeling distressed. Meanwhile, Girija is anxiously waiting for SS at home, oblivious to the situation.

episodesList.title: Jaggu's Truth Reaches His Sisters
episodesList.summary: Madhu visits Jaggu in the hospital and lashes out at him for cheating on her. Meera, Harini and Jayshree witness the confrontation and discover the truth about their relationship.

episodesList.title: Jayshree’s Mission to Free Mohan
episodesList.summary: Jayshree meets Mohan in jail and promises to get him out. Since she needs Girija’s signature to appeal in court, she asks Siddharth to help reach out to Mohan’s daughter, Madhu.

episodesList.title: Siddharth Caught in SS’s Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Photographer Vivek makes Meera the model for Ponmalar Textiles’ photoshoot. The security guard mistakenly assumes Siddharth is meeting Girija and Madhu and informs SS about it.

episodesList.title: Madhu's Modelling Break
episodesList.summary: SS is upset with Vivek after seeing Meera as the model, while Vivek approaches Madhu for the next campaign. Elsewhere, Kala's visit to the doctor brings an unexpected twist.

episodesList.title: When Ponmalar Meets Madhu
episodesList.summary: Vivek's request for help with Madhu's saree brings Madhu and Ponmalar together for the first time. Elsewhere, Madhu and Girija seek a loan to kick-start their business.

episodesList.title: Jayshree’s Unexpected Shock

plotHtml:
The Ponmalar household, led by the strict textile businessman Shanmuga Sundaram "SS" and his warm-hearted wife Ponmalar, appears happy and tightly knit on the surface. They have four children with distinct personalities: Jayshree (a lawyer), Harini(an IT employee), Jagadeesh "Jaggu" (a DJ), and Meera (an aspiring cricketer).
Their peaceful routines are upended when a shocking revelation emerges: their father has a hidden affair. United by their love for their mother and a desire to protect their family, the siblings band together, taking an oath to expose the affair and shield their family from breaking apart.
tagline: In a seemingly perfect family, hidden secrets threaten to unravel their bonds, forcing siblings to unite and protect their mother from a devastating truth.

title: Bas Tera Saath Ho
summary: Bas Tera Saath Ho is a 2026 Pakistani romantic drama television series produced by Humayun Saeed, Samina Humayun Saeed, Sana Shahnawaz and Nadeem Baig under the banner Six Sigma Plus Production and Next Level Entertainment. Directed by Qasim Ali Mureed and written by Saira Raza, it aired from 4 May 2026 on ARY Digital. It stars Farhan Saeed and Sana Javed as leads along with Saba Hameed, Salman Shahid, Haris Waheed, Zoya Nasir and Rizwan Ali Jaffri in supporting roles.
reception:
Fizza Abbas of Dawn Images, praised the TV drama for its realistic portrayal of Pakistani family dynamics and grounded characters. She lauded Saira Raza's script and Qasim Ali Mureed's direction for avoiding melodramatic tropes and presenting proactive leads. While noting minor logical flaws in the plot, as well as the supporting veteran cast, for their natural and nuanced portrayals.
Shiraz Aslam of Youlin Magazine, praised the TV series for subverting traditional drama tropes by exploring domestic abuse without gender bias. He commended Farhan Saeed and Sana Javed for their performances as protagonists navigating psychological exploitation and inheritance disputes.
Iqra Ejaz of 24 News HD, praised the series for its strong execution, Asif Khan's cinematography, and Farhan Saeed's compelling portrayal of a male victim of domestic oppression. She commended Sana Javed's bold performance and highlighted the drama's potential to draw attention to men's mental health issues.

title: Bandwaale
summary: Bandwaale is a 2026 Indian Hindi-language musical comedy drama television series directed by 	Akshat Verma and Ankur Tewari it features Swanand Kirkire, Zahan Kapoor and Shalini Pandey in lead roles, alongside a supporting ensemble cast. The series premiered on 13 February 2026 on Prime Video.
plot: Set in Ratlam, the series follows Mariam, a young poet who struggles against the constraints of tradition and limited autonomy in her surroundings. Seeking self-expression and a sense of identity, she begins posting her poetry anonymously online. Her path gradually intersects with Robo, a brass band vocalist, and DJ Psycho, whose companionship and encouragement inspire her to pursue her artistic aspirations.
reception:
Rahul Deasi of The Hollywood Reporter India writes that "The endless 8-episode seeries revolves around a small-town poetess who struggles to break free from societal shackles." Abhishek Srivastava of Times of India gave 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "‘Bandwaale’ comes across as a safe idea stretched into a full series without enough substance to sustain it. It is sincere, but sincerity alone does not create engagement. The themes of ambition, self-expression, and friendship are present, yet they are handled in a way that feels cautious." Deepa Gahlot writing for scroll.in stated that "the series derails into absurd subplots that have no bearing on anything else going on in the family. If there’s a melodramatic misunderstanding over a pregnancy, there’s also a crazy rescue from a charlatan’s clinic."
Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost rated it 2.5 stars out of 5 and said that "There are a lot of boxes that Bandwaale tries to tick. But most of them now feel tried and tested." Divya Nair of Rediff.com gave 3.5 stars out of 4 and said that "Kudos to the makers for attempting to create a meaningful series, Bandwaale, that blends the beauty of music to inspire you to look within, and find your voice." Pritinanda Behera of India Today rated it 2/5 stars and writes that "Bandwaale attempts to tell a heartfelt story about dreams, artistic freedom, and small-town pressures but falters due to scattered storytelling and predictable tropes."

episodesList.title: Mynah
episodesList.summary: When her anonymous poem about a kiss creates a scandal in college, Mariam, a young poetess, is forced to find a way to continue to express herself without causing a stir. Escaping her father David's ire, Mariam turns to the internet to express herself.

episodesList.title: Black Mamba

episodesList.title: Muqabala

Rafi believes this is what will revive the ailing New Modern Band. He invites Psy to join the band. Robo and gang are incensed at this subterfuge. Ismail, to placate flared tempers, calls for a 'Muqabala' between the New Modern Band and DJ Psy.

episodesList.title: Neela Moza
episodesList.summary: Mariam is distraught when her mother is confronted with a medical emergency which lands her in hospital. It doesn't help that things with Psy are awkward. Dark family secrets are revealed. On David's return from Kerala, father and daughter have a bitter showdown. Mariam's words fail her when she needs it the most.

episodesList.title: Bandwaale
episodesList.summary: Mariam has to make it to the influencer conclave organized by Book My Sitara at Jabalpur. However dodging David's ploys of getting her to impress prospective grooms is harder than she thought. Meanwhile Psy struggles to fight his demons. Mariam discovers his secret and takes Robo's help to save him from a dangerous situation.

episodesList.title: Haklaati Haseena
episodesList.summary: At Jabalpur, the band of misfits comes together. It's a whole new world of influencers, social media managers and algorithms. The band is off to a great start but falters when Mariam is faced with her biggest fear. The event is ruined when the band and the audience get into a violent scuffle.

episodesList.title: Knock Knock Knock
episodesList.summary: The Jabalpur debacle makes Mariam famous in a way she least expects. Mariam has to choose between capitalizing on internet fame and being true to her poetry.

title: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery
summary: Bhay: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery (transl. Fear: The Gaurav Tiwari Mystery) is a 2025 Indian paranormal television series directed by Robbie Grewal and written by Arshad Syed. Produced by Prabhleen Sandhu under Almighty Motion Picture, it stars Karan Tacker and Kalki Koechlin.
reception:
Archika Khurana from The Times of India rated the series 3.5 out of 5 stars and said that "A gripping, atmospheric watch—best suited for fans of investigative, psychological, and grounded supernatural storytelling". Arpita Sarkar of OTT Play gave the series 2 stars out of 5 and stated that "The ghosts aren't scary, the cases lack suspense, and the emphasis on paranormal investigation overshadows the potential for deeper explorations into Gaurav's personal life. The real-life footage adds a little interest, but overall, the series struggles to captivate or terrify. " Vinamra Mathur of Firstpost rated 3.5/5 stars and said that "It’s a show that jolts you and forces you to think twice before saying ghosts do not exist."
Bollywood Hungama gave 3 stars out of 5 and said that ""On the whole, BHAY - THE GAURAV TIWARI MYSTERY is an intriguing paranormal thriller powered by an unusual premise, a solid investigative hook and Karan Tacker’s terrific central performance. Sadly, a show with such mass appeal has dropped with limited promotion. Hence, it’ll need a strong word of mouth to catch the attention of its vast target audience."

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The series was announced on Amazon MX Player. It is inspired from Abhirup Dhar's Ghost Hunter Gaurav Tiwari: The Life and Legacy of India's Foremost Paranormal Investigator (2021).
Principal photography of the series commenced in October 2024, and concluded in April 2025. Post-production of the series began in August 2025.

title: Baai Tujhyapayi
summary: Baai Tujhyapayi is a 2025 Indian Marathi language web series directed by Nipun Dharmadhikari and produced for the streaming platform ZEE5. It is a remake of 2023 Tamil web series Ayali. Set in rural Maharashtra in 1990, the period drama follows the story of a young girl who battles superstition and social restrictions in her pursuit of becoming a doctor. The series stars Sajiri Joshi and Kshitee Jog in the lead roles and is scheduled to premiere on 31 October 2025.
plot: The series is set in 1990 in the fictional village of Vesaich Vadgaon, Maharashtra. It centers on Ahilya, a teenage girl who dreams of studying medicine and becoming a doctor. Her ambitions clash with the village’s orthodox customs and gender-based restrictions. When Ahilya attains puberty, she is forced to conceal it to avoid an early marriage, while continuing to challenge the social taboos that attempt to limit her education.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The series is directed by Nipun Dharmadhikari and written by Mukta Bam and Nikhil Khaire.

episodesList.title: Vesai
episodesList.summary: Introduction to the village of Vesaicha Vadgaon and the lore of Goddess Vesai. Ahilya, a brilliant student, learns of the custom requiring girls to marry upon puberty. The episode ends with the terrified realization of her own coming of age.

episodesList.title: Saraswati
episodesList.summary: Ahilya witnesses her friend Saraswati being pulled out of school and married off, reinforcing her fear. She begins her deception, viewing her education as an act of quiet defiance against the inevitable.

episodesList.title: Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: The focus shifts to the domestic sphere. Ahilya’s mother, Lakshmi, grapples with the financial and moral pressures of the household. Ahilya narrowly avoids detection, raising the stakes of her secret.

episodesList.title: Sharada
episodesList.summary: The narrative explores the concept of "Log Kya Kahenge" (What will people say). The social surveillance of the village intensifies, and Ahilya realizes the burden of reputation that women are forced to carry.

episodesList.title: Sharada
episodesList.summary: Faith intersects with policing as the village priestess (Pujarin) and elders suspect that the purity laws are being flouted. The gatekeeping of the temple becomes a central conflict point.

episodesList.title: Mangal
episodesList.summary: The penultimate episode features the highest tension. The village systems mobilize to protect their customs, leading to a near-exposure of Ahilya’s biological reality. The "Taliban-like" monitoring reaches its peak.

episodesList.title: Ahilya
episodesList.summary: The finale. Ahilya faces the consequences of her deception. The confrontation forces the village to choose between their 500-year-old superstition and the humanity of their daughters.

title: Bindiya Ke Bahubali
summary:
Bindiya Ke Bahubali is 2025 Indian Hindi-language OTT series written and directed by Raj Amit Kumar and starring Saurabh Shukla, Ranvir Shorey, Seema Biswas, and Sheeba Chaddha.
Season II of the series was premiered on 21 January 2026. Both seasons can be watched for free on Amazon MX Player.
plot: Bindiya Ke Bahubali explores the aftermath of a mafia don's arrest during an election campaign. Based in fictional town of Bindiya, somewhere in Bihar, India, a volatile battle over legacy and power is ignited when Bada Davan of Davan family (Saurabh Shukla) is detained, and his ambitious son, Chhote Davan (Ranvir Shorey) attempts to seize control. The rest is the huge interplay between various members of this family and the outside world.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text:
The series was released on Amazon MX Player on 8 August 2025.
Season II of the series was premiered on 21 January 2026.

episodesList.title: The Davan Empire
episodesList.summary: Tensions erupt in Bindiya around the land next to Bindiya River, forcing Chhote Davan to negotiate peace through grit. As Chhote dreams of contesting elections, his father Bada Davan publicly snatches the spotlight, triggering emotional turmoil, betrayal that sets off a deadly political chess game.

episodesList.title: The Davan Family
episodesList.summary: Bada Davan is jailed for murder, but his family is torn over whether he's guilty-or being set up. Everyone in the family seems to have their own agenda and are searching for the missing ₹25 crore that could decide the future of Bindiya. Babu risks his career to uncover the truth, while Chacha takes over power.

episodesList.title: Colonel Kaun?
episodesList.summary: With Bada Davan in jail and the family empire splintering, Chhote galvanizes public support while Chacha hunts 25 crores hidden by the dead Accountant, Lala. As both grow in power, Bada shocks them by triggering a ruthless vote within the gang to decide who becomes the next Colonel. What begins as political survival turns into emotional betrayal and a dangerous war within.

episodesList.title: Family Tandoor
episodesList.summary: Sukki forces support for Chacha in the Colonel vote, but chaos breaks loose for Davan Family when his ego collides with mockery. Chhote fends off Murli's blackmail while juggling Ajji's dowry drama and a fractured family. As every Captain picks sides, the coup is officially underway within the family as well as outside the family.

episodesList.title: Poonch Main Lathi
episodesList.summary: As new colonel is chosen, Chhote demands from Chacha to have no more deals with Bhamirs. Meanwhile, Kisna takes his first steps in Davan family business by threatening and bribing Murli. As Chacha schemes with Bhamir Anant Singh, a 25-crore liquor convoy heads to Patna-until on Chhote's tip, Murli's STF ambushes the route.

episodesList.title: War Hoga
episodesList.summary: While Chhote hides 25 Crore election cash in four different portions, Babu finds that love of his life is mistress to his own brother Chhote. Chhote offers Kisna crores to leave Bindiya and Murli plots surveillance on everyone. Chacha is kidnapped by Bhamirs and the episode ends with a call for War.

episodesList.title: Pakka War Hoga
episodesList.summary: As Chhote negotiates a high-stakes deal with Bhamirs betraying his fathers command, hidden family tensions explode. Imli manipulates him for control, while old rivalries resurface through blackmail and sex scandals. A viral exposé turns Bada into a political sensation, triggering vengeance and tragedy that culminates in a devastating fall that can only result in War.

episodesList.title: Shopping
episodesList.summary: Bada defies party orders from prison, sending Chhote to Patna to secure his election ticket. As Chhote’s charm clashes with elitist politics, Imli seduces Baccha, Ajji steals hidden cash, and Babu’s obsession with Sasha spirals into danger. Meanwhile, Murli has a perfect plot to bring next one down in the Davan empire.

episodesList.title: Ek Aur Davan Gaya
episodesList.summary: Chhote’s failed ambush exposes deep family cracks while Kisna’s first kill haunts him. Ajji secretly steals what's not hers, and Murli arrests Sasha to trap Chhote. The episode races toward Roli’s explosive courtroom arrival and a fatal setup in motion.

episodesList.title: Koi Nahi Apna
episodesList.summary: Roli’s testimony sparks chaos as Dharavi shatters the case against Bada, revealing a larger conspiracy. Bhamir's attack Moda Village for revenge and making a way for their Powerplant ambitions, using Police, Raja Babu and Vikram Singh. Babu abducts Roli to find who is actually behind His fathers arrest. Chhote defies Bada, declaring independence and political ambition and father and son finally comes to a break that will last forever.

episodesList.title: Gaanv Chhodab Naahi
episodesList.summary: In this pivotal episode, Chhote orchestrates a deadly trap under the guise of reconciliation—convincing rival Vikram Singh to apologize to Moda Village's resilient residents, only to push him into an enraged crowd where rape victim Soni exacts her fiery revenge. While the village celebrates their defiant stand against displacement, internal family fractures deepen: Ajji steals Chhote's hidden fortune to fund her medical dreams, Kisna siphons money for personal ventures, and Babu's forensic investigation reveals Chacha's betrayal in Bada's arrest.  The episode climaxes in catastrophic violence transforms from a bachelor party venue into a massacre site.

episodesList.title: War
episodesList.summary: Kisna's bachelor party at the Yadav Recreational Club erupts into a bloodbath when Babbal Banna and Raja Babu's militia launch a coordinated siege, transforming celebration into carnage.  Chhote arrives with an LMG-mounted mini truck for a dramatic rescue, but the cost is devastating Myra suffers severe sword wounds from Babbal Banna, As survivors escape through bomb-rigged tunnels to a secret Davan hideout, Chhote calls Anant Singh with a chilling promise—he's abandoning politics for pure gangsterism, vowing vengeance that will reshape Bindiya's power structure forever.

title: Bakaiti
summary: Bakaiti is an Indian Hindi-language comedy-drama web series directed by Ameet Guptha. It stars Sheeba Chaddha and Rajesh Tailang, with Tanya Sharma and Aaditya Shukla playing the lead roles. Set in Ghaziabad, it depicts the everyday struggles of a middle-class family as they navigate financial hardship and interpersonal challenges.
plot:
Set in old Ghaziabad, the story follows the five-member Kataria family during a period of financial difficulty. To earn additional income, the family patriarch, Sanjay (Papaji), decides to rent out a room in their home. This results in Naina, the 21-year-old daughter, being asked to vacate her room and move in with her younger brother Bharat, aged 17.
Naina, ambitious and emotional, is unhappy with the change, while Bharat, a street-smart cricket enthusiast, resents sharing his space. As the siblings struggle to adjust, their parents, Sanjay and Sushma, face pressure from Sanjay’s younger brother to sell the ancestral home following the recent death of their father. With the arrival of a new tenant, tensions rise, relationships are tested, and the family must confront generational differences while rediscovering mutual understanding and care.
reception:
Bakaiti received mixed-to-positive reviews from critics.
Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated the series 3 out of 5 stars, describing it as a modest and heartfelt portrayal of Indian family life that may appeal to viewers seeking comfort and familiarity, though it avoids high‑stakes drama and may feel too safe for some audiences." Shweta Keshri of India Today, also giving a score of 3/5, noted that "noted that while the premise feels familiar, the warmth and genuineness of the storytelling make it an easy and pleasant watch, especially as a short weekend binge."
In a less favourable review, Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express rated it 2/5, calling it "a patchy drama that fails to rise above its noisy family conflicts." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in commented that "A cash-strapped family gets on each other’s nerves – and yours too at times." Lachmi Deb Roy of Firstpost rated the series 3/5, noting that "No out-of-the-box storyline, but it will touch your heart for its simplicity." Nirali Kanabar of Times Now rated 3/5 calling it "a relatable slice‑of‑life drama suited for those seeking a light‑hearted watch."
Anindita Mukherjee of News18 gave the show 3/5 and wrote "Bakaiti has its loopholes, though they’re easy to overlook. At times, certain segments feel stretched. Multiple episodes revolving around the same ‘to rent or not to rent’ storyline come across as repetitive." Arpita Sarkar of OTT Play rated it 3.5/5 describing it as "a warm, lively portrayal of everyday family chaos and relationships, capturing both affection and generational differences." Divya Raje Bhonsale of Mathrubhumi awarded it 3.5/5 praising the performances of Rajesh Tailang and Sheeba Chaddha as parents facing financial struggles while navigating their children’s aspirations."

articleSections.title: Production and release
articleSections.text:
Bakaiti was created and produced by Dice Media, the digital content division of Pocket Aces Pictures. The series is produced by Aditi Shrivastava and written by Gunjan Saxena, Neha Pawar, and Sheetal Kapoor.
It premiered on ZEE5 on 1 August 2025.

plotHtml:
Set in old Ghaziabad, the story follows the five-member Kataria family during a period of financial difficulty. To earn additional income, the family patriarch, Sanjay (Papaji), decides to rent out a room in their home. This results in Naina, the 21-year-old daughter, being asked to vacate her room and move in with her younger brother Bharat, aged 17.
Naina, ambitious and emotional, is unhappy with the change, while Bharat, a street-smart cricket enthusiast, resents sharing his space. As the siblings struggle to adjust, their parents, Sanjay and Sushma, face pressure from Sanjay’s younger brother to sell the ancestral home following the recent death of their father. With the arrival of a new tenant, tensions rise, relationships are tested, and the family must confront generational differences while rediscovering mutual understanding and care.

title: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 4
summary: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 4 is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that aired on Sony TV from 16 June 2025 to 19 September 2025. It is produced by Ekta Kapoor under Balaji Telefilms, it is the fourth installment of the Bade Achhe Lagte Hain franchise. It stars Harshad Chopda and Shivangi Joshi as Rishabh and Bhagya.
plot:
Bhagyashree Iyer is an independent woman who lives in Delhi. She heads Tattvaa and for the last five years has been living away from her parents. She left her home to marry her boyfriend Nikhil after her parents refused to meet him. Nikhil rejected her since he was only after her father's money. The betrayal left her with trust issues and no faith in love.
Rishabh Kapoor is a cheerful and happy-go-lucky man struggling to make ends meet. He was in need of a job and got one at Tattvaa. Bhagyashree learns that her parents, who never learned what happened five years ago, are coming to visit her and her husband. Her friend Nitya advises her to marry before they arrive to portray a happy married life.
She meets Vikram Bhalla, head of Tattvaa's west zone and agrees to marry him. Rishabh exposes him as a fraud and two-timer, thus saving Bhagya from being manipulated. Her parents assume Rishabh is her husband and the two maintain the facade. Bhagya falls in love with Rishabh but he is hiding a truth.
He is a rich businessman and he came into Bhagya's life hoping to earn her trust so he can avenge his father Gautam Kapoor who is in jail because of her false testimony. Despite his mission, Rishabh ends up growing feelings for Bhagya making him feel guilty and conflicted. Naysa, Rishabh's former wife, who remains obsessed with Rishabh, is revealed to be Bhagya's boss. Rishabh discovers that Bhagya believed the victims who were paid by Naysa to speak up against Gautam and gave the testimony. She did not know he was innocent and this was a setup.
Naysa later discovers that the man Bhagya loves is Rishabh and publicly exposes the truth. She reveals that Rishabh is a Kapoor and lies that they are still married. Bhagya is left shattered, heartbroken and asks Rishabh to leave her life. Her pain eclipses the mistake she made of giving a false testimony against an innocent man without checking. She goes to court and corrects her mistake but fails to realise the magnitude of how it destroyed a family.
Bhagya has hardened her heart and refuses to trust anyone. She focuses on work, staying healthy and being with her family. Bhagya left Tattvaa and now works in Kalos, a company whose boss is later revealed to be Rishabh. He also moves next door to Bhagya to regain her trust. Despite many people trying to frame them for wrongdoings in order to separate them, the two remain together and eventually marry.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Harshad Chopda as Rishabh Kapoor: Owner of Kapoor Industries; CEO and managing director of Kalos; Gautam's son; Purab's brother; Bhagya's husband * Shivangi Joshi as Bhagyashree "Bhagya" Iyer Kapoor: Employee at Kalos; former national head of Tattvaa; Padma and Vinayak's daughter; Karthik, Shreyas and Revathi's sister; Rishabh's wife

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The series was announced by Balaji Telefilms for Sony Entertainment Television. The show was initially titled Bahaarein. It was later changed to Bade Achhe Lagte Hain. In August, the show saw a six-month leap.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Harshad Chopda and Shivangi Joshi were cast as Rishabh Kapoor and Bhagyashree Iyer. The show marks their first collaboration. They were the leads of different generations of Yeh Rishta Kya Kehlata Hai but did not get to share screen space. Manoj Kolhatkar, Pyumori Mehta Ghosh and Ashish Kaul joined as Rishabh and Bhagyashree's parents Vinayak Iyer, Padma Iyer and Gautam Kapoor. Nitin Bhatia was cast as Sunny. Next, Saumya Bhandari played Shaina Nath. Aafreen Dabestani was roped in as Mia. In August, Rishika Nag entered as Naysa. Ribbhu Mehra replaced Savant Singh Premi as Nikhil.

articleSections.title: Filming and release
articleSections.text: Principal photography of the show began in March 2025. The first look of the series was released on 26 March 2025 featuring Shivangi Joshi and Harshad Chopda. Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 4 premiered on Sony Entertainment Television on 16 June 2025. It is digitally available to stream on SonyLIV. The first episode was screened on set.

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Fortune Cookie
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree finds a fortune cookie that predicts the return of her first love. As her best friend urges her to attend a party instead of working alone on New Year's Eve, could love be waiting just around the corner?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Ka Akelapan
episodesList.summary: When Bhagyashree's strict father mistakenly believes she's already married, he invites her and her husband to a family wedding. Sensing a rare chance to mend broken ties, Bhagyashree scrambles to turn the lie into a lifeline.

episodesList.title: A Potential Match
episodesList.summary: Rishabh opens up to Sunny, while Bhagyashree meets a potential match. Will he be the one she introduces to her parents?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Past
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree is stunned to learn that the man she went on a date with is actually her boss. Meanwhile, Rishabh discovers the truth about her past. How will she react knowing Rishabh has heard it all?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Gets A Ride Home
episodesList.summary: Rishabh has seven days to vacate his house. Later, Bhagyashree shares a ride home with Vikram. With her parents soon arriving in Mumbai, will she find the right match in time?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Mangetar
episodesList.summary: Rishabh is torn after discovering Vikram is engaged to both Bhagyashree and Shaina. How will he confront Bhagyashree with the truth?

episodesList.title: Vikram Ka Plan
episodesList.summary: Vikram frames Rishabh as a thief, ruining his reputation at work. How will Bhagyashree respond when the truth comes to light?

episodesList.title: Vikram And Bhagyashree's Wedding
episodesList.summary: On the wedding day, Vikram is exposed as a fraud, leading Bhagyashree to call off the marriage. But how will she face her parents now?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Meets Her Family
episodesList.summary: After five long years, Bhagyashree reunites with her family and learns about her father's declining health. Who will step up to pose as her husband in front of her parents?

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ka Natak
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree's relatives bombard Rishabh with questions. Amidst growing tension and tangled lies, will the truth catch up with them both?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Parents Come Home
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree's parents arrive unannounced, putting pressure on her and Rishabh. With tension rising, can they keep their lie hidden?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Gets Accused
episodesList.summary: Mukul Chaddha storms into Bhagyashree's house, accusing her of lying about her marriage and claiming Rishabh isn't her husband. How will Rishabh tackle the confrontation and prove their relationship?

episodesList.title: Society Meeting For Rishabh And Bhagyashree
episodesList.summary: Rishabh and Bhagyashree prepare themselves for the society meeting, knowing Mukul Chaddha is planning to expose them. Will they be able to outsmart him this time?

episodesList.title: Lakho Mein Ek Damaad
episodesList.summary: Rishabh outwits Chaddha, confirming Bhagyashree's marital status. But just as things settle, Somi presents a document that could put Bhagyashree in trouble. How will she handle this twist?

episodesList.title: Nav Vivahit Jode Ke Liye Rasam
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree and Rishabh perform a post-marriage ritual at their mother's request. With her father finally convinced of their relationship, is a new challenge on the horizon?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Gets Followed
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree's father secretly follows Rishabh to uncover his truth, while her brother Shreyas confronts her for lying about their marriage. Will Rishabh's secret come to light?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Father In Jail
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree's father lands in jail as the family tries to secure his release. Will he reveal Rishabh's truth to all, or will Rishabh manage to stay a step ahead?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Vinayak follows Rishabh and catches him at a hotel with a girl, determined to expose him. How will Rishabh explain himself now?

episodesList.title: Mangal Snanam
episodesList.summary: As Bhagyashree begins to feel uneasy seeing Rishabh interact with his girlfriend, the two attend the Mangal Snanam together. But when Rishabh arrives drunk for the ceremony, how will Bhagyashree deal with the situation?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Insecurity
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree grows uneasy with Rishabh's changing behaviour. As her parents prepare to gift them a property, Mukul Chaddha stirs up fresh trouble. How will Bhagyashree and Rishabh handle the mounting pressure?

episodesList.title: Dance Competition In Happy Home Towers
episodesList.summary: Rishabh confronts Bhagyashree about the growing distance between them. After an argument with Mukul Chaddha, Bhagyashree challenges him to a dance competition between the boys and the society girls. Who will win?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Confronts Rishabh
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree learns that Mia is pregnant and decides to confront Rishabh. With Mia's pregnancy and the dance competition both coming up, how will Rishabh and Bhagyashree handle everything?

episodesList.title: Revathi And Rishabh's Connection
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree is shocked to discover the connection between Revathi and Rishabh and questions Mia about it. As Rishabh comes forward to support Revathi, how will Bhagyashree react when she uncovers the truth?

episodesList.title: Revathi's Truth
episodesList.summary: Vinayak is stunned to see his wife performing at the dance competition. Later, Bhagyashree uncovers the truth about the connection between Mia, Rishabh, and Revathi. How will she react after learning everything?

episodesList.title: Mia's Evil Ploy
episodesList.summary: Holding Rishabh at gunpoint, Mia paralyses him and takes him away, while Bhagyashree follows closely behind. Will Bhagyashree be able to save him in time?

episodesList.title: Mini Honeymoon For Rishabh And Bhagyashree
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree's parents surprise her and Rishabh with a trip to Mumbai. While in the city, she receives an invite to her friend's birthday party. Will this trip bring her and Rishabh closer, or will it force her to face her past once again?

episodesList.title: Pyaar Ki Innocent Nishani
episodesList.summary: Rishabh stands up to Bhagyashree's ex and firmly puts him in his place. As Rishabh and Bhagyashree spend time together in Mumbai, she finally expresses her love for him. How will Rishabh respond?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Ki Sachhai
episodesList.summary: As Bhagyashree begins to fall in love with Rishabh, he hides his true intentions. Who is Rishabh really, and what is it that he wants from Bhagyashree?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Growing Closeness
episodesList.summary: Rishabh is troubled by his father's illness, while Bhagyashree senses something is bothering him and tries to understand what it is. As she finds herself falling deeper for him, will Rishabh reveal his true self to her?

episodesList.title: Karthik Is Tortured
episodesList.summary: Purab tortures Karthik to get his hands on his money. Meanwhile, Rishabh and Bhagyashree return from their trip, and Rishabh subtly begins convincing Karthik to get Vinayak to sign the property papers.

episodesList.title: Karthik And Soumya's Disagreement
episodesList.summary: Karthik and Soumya have a disagreement when she suggests he start a business. Later, Shekhar runs away from his own wedding with Rishabh. What are they planning?

episodesList.title: Purab Gets The Papers
episodesList.summary: Meenakshi locks herself in her room. Meanwhile, Karthik hands over the property papers to Purab. Will Rishabh manage to bring Shekhar back to the wedding?

episodesList.title: Shekhar Aur Meenakshi Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ramya attends Shekhar and Meenakshi's wedding as Soumya attempts to expose Rishabh's truth. Later, Purab questions Rishabh about his intentions toward Bhagyashree's family.

episodesList.title: Rishabh Finds Proof
episodesList.summary: The society ladies set up a date for Bhagyashree and Rishabh as he tries to get her fingerprints. Meanwhile, as Vinayak and his family return to Chennai, they are asked to vacate their home. How will the family react to this sudden shock?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Is Blamed
episodesList.summary: While Vinayak and the family are made to leave the house, Bhagyashree models for a brand to help out. Later, things take a turn when she is accused of selling important documents and taken to the police. How will Bhagyashree face this sudden crisis?

episodesList.title: Padma And Vinayak's Suffering
episodesList.summary: Rishabh questions Bhagyashree about the large transaction, while Padma and Vinayak discover that Karthik was behind it as he secretly sold the house. Later, Rishabh rushes his father to the hospital. Will Bhagyashree uncover the truth about him?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Donates Blood
episodesList.summary: As Bhagyashree follows Rishabh to the hospital, he opens up to her about his father. Later, without knowing his identity, Bhagyashree ends up donating blood to Rishabh's father. How will Rishabh respond when he finds out?

episodesList.title: Naysa's Arrival
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree confronts Purab for taking over her parents' house, while Purab begins to suspect that Rishabh has feelings for her. Meanwhile, Naysa arrives in Delhi after learning that some important documents have been stolen.

episodesList.title: Rishabh And Bhagyashree's Feelings
episodesList.summary: Naysa asks Bhagyashree if she has feelings for Rishabh, while Rishabh prepares for his father's upcoming court hearing. Later, he opens up to his father about how he feels for Bhagyashree.

episodesList.title: Ek Dusre Ke Humsafar
episodesList.summary: Naysa and Bhagyashree meet with an accident and are rushed to City Hospital. When Rishabh arrives to check on Bhagyashree, he finally confesses his feelings for her. But what will happen when Bhagyashree finds out about Rishabh and Naysa's past?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Tries To Meet The Witnesses
episodesList.summary: Rishabh talks to his lawyer about his father's case and asks to meet the witnesses. Meanwhile, Soumya goes back to Karthik. Will Rishabh get to meet the eyewitnesses and uncover the truth about Bhagyashree?

episodesList.title: Teej Ka Vrat
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree and the society ladies decide to observe a fast for Teej, while Rishabh tries to uncover her reasons for the court statement. Will he learn the truth?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Finds The Truth
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree and the other women keep a fast. Later, Rishabh learns the truth about her court statement from the victim. Will this change his perception of Bhagyashree?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Ka Sach
episodesList.summary: Rishabh is about to express his feelings to Bhagyashree when Naysa walks in and reveals his truth. How will Bhagyashree respond?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Is Broken
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree feels shattered after learning the truth about Rishabh. Six months later, she begins rebuilding her life with the support of her friends and family. Will love find her this time?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Ki Life Ka Dusra Adhyay
episodesList.summary: As Bhagyashree steps into the new year, Rishabh takes charge of Kalos and returns to her life as her boss. Will he manage to win back her trust?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's New Neighbour
episodesList.summary: Rishabh becomes Bhagyashree's new neighbour to get closer to her, but Bhagyashree plans to move out. Will his efforts truly bring them together?

episodesList.title: Nikhil's Proposal For Bhagyashree
episodesList.summary: Nikhil proposes to Bhagyashree in the office, while Revathi introduces her fiance to the family. How will Rishabh handle this situation?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Ki Koshish
episodesList.summary: After learning that Purab is Revathi's fiance, Vinayak refuses the alliance. Later, Rishabh opens up to Padma about his love for Bhagyashree. Will Padma support him?

episodesList.title: Rishabh And Bhagyashree Get Stuck
episodesList.summary: Sunny announces to everyone that Bhagyashree has agreed to marry Nikhil, while Bhagyashree finds herself stuck in the meter room with Rishabh, where they confront each other. Will this moment bring them closer and help reconcile their issues?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree asks Vinayak to wait before the engagement, but he refuses. Meanwhile, the preparations are in full swing. Will she go ahead and get engaged to Nikhil?

episodesList.title: Revathi Is Pregnant
episodesList.summary: During the engagement, Revathi suddenly faints and the truth comes out that she is pregnant with Purab's child. How will the family handle this shocking revelation?

episodesList.title: Rishabh's Pain
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree openly declares in front of Rishabh and her colleagues that she is engaged. Later, circumstances force Rishabh and Bhagyashree to share the same cabin. Will this situation bring them closer?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree's Care For Rishabh
episodesList.summary: Rishabh and Bhagyashree head out for a client meeting but their car suddenly breaks down. Soon, a group of goons surrounds them. How will they deal with this dangerous situation?

episodesList.title: Nikhil's Plan
episodesList.summary: Nikhil plots to take Bhagyashree away from the hotel. Later, her peanut allergy gets triggered while eating. Will Rishabh step in to save her?

episodesList.title: Complaint Against Rishabh
episodesList.summary: Rishabh shows his care for Bhagyashree while Naysa confronts Purab and the Iyer family. Later, Rishabh faces a shocking accusation of harassing a female employee. How will he prove his innocence?

episodesList.title: Rishabh's Confession
episodesList.summary: The allegation against Rishabh spreads in the media, putting their business deals at risk. Meanwhile, Karthik receives recognition for his efforts. Just as Bhagyashree sets out to prove Rishabh's innocence, Rishabh makes a shocking confession.

episodesList.title: Naysa's Statement
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree questions Nikhil for deliberately putting peanuts in her food. Meanwhile, Naysa holds a press conference to address the allegations against Rishabh. What turn will Rishabh's fate take?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Cares For Rishabh
episodesList.summary: Rishabh gives Naysa the divorce papers, but she refuses to sign. Meanwhile, Karthik tries to uncover the identity of the person sending him money every month. Later, Bhagyashree looks after a sick Rishabh.

episodesList.title: Nikhil Puts Bhagyashree In The Spot
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree slaps Nikhil for his inappropriate remarks. Meanwhile, Karthik questions Purab about Rishabh's investment in his startup. Later, Nikhil stuns Vinayak and the family by claiming that Bhagyashree still loves Rishabh.

episodesList.title: Vinayak's Health
episodesList.summary: Vinayak's health worsens and the doctor is urgently called. Later, Bhagyashree reveals the truth about Nikhil to the family. How will everyone react to her revelation?

episodesList.title: Purab Calls Off The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Purab breaks off his wedding with Revathi after discovering she has been secretly watching him. Soon after, Tanya uploads a video publicly accusing Revathi. How will Revathi handle this blow?

episodesList.title: Karthik Confronts His Family
episodesList.summary: Purab confronts Tanya about the video, only to discover that Naysa was behind it. Meanwhile, Karthik speaks to his family, reminding them of Rishabh's good qualities. Will Revathi and Purab find their way back to each other?

episodesList.title: Purab Ki Condition
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree reaches out to console Revathi, while Rishabh tries to comfort Purab. Later, Purab puts forward a condition that he will only marry Revathi if Bhagyashree and Rishabh tie the knot first. How will the family respond to this?

episodesList.title: Bhagyashree Confronts Naysa
episodesList.summary: While Bhagyashree finally accepts her love for Rishabh, Naysa refuses to sign the divorce papers. Later, Bhagyashree confronts her to get the papers signed. Will Naysa agree, or will she find another way to create trouble?

episodesList.title: Naysa's Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Rishabh meets Naysa to get the divorce papers signed, but she spikes his drink. Later, he discovers that the papers were fake. How will Rishabh deal with this betrayal?

episodesList.title: Naysa's Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: Shreyas receives the good news of a job opportunity in London. Meanwhile, Rishabh goes to confront Naysa, where Gautam pressures him to marry her. How will Rishabh respond?

episodesList.title: Rishabh's Forceful Marriage
episodesList.summary: Vinayak gets hold of Rishabh and Naysa's pictures just as Bhagyashree tries to confront him. Meanwhile, Rishabh is forced into marrying Naysa while in an unconscious state. Will Bhagyashree reach in time to save him?

episodesList.title: Mr And Mrs Kapoor
episodesList.summary: In a surprising turn of events, Bhagyashree and Rishabh tie the knot. Meanwhile, Karthik waits at the hospital for the good news of his baby's arrival.

episodesList.title: Happy Ending For The Kapoors
episodesList.summary: Bhagyashree performs her first Rasoi ritual while Gautam surprises Bhagyashree and Rishabh with tickets to Paris. Meanwhile, Revathi and Purab joyfully decide on the name of their soon-to-be-born child.

plotHtml:
Bhagyashree Iyer is an independent woman who lives in Delhi. She heads Tattvaa and for the last five years has been living away from her parents. She left her home to marry her boyfriend Nikhil after her parents refused to meet him. Nikhil rejected her since he was only after her father's money. The betrayal left her with trust issues and no faith in love.
Rishabh Kapoor is a cheerful and happy-go-lucky man struggling to make ends meet. He was in need of a job and got one at Tattvaa. Bhagyashree learns that her parents, who never learned what happened five years ago, are coming to visit her and her husband. Her friend Nitya advises her to marry before they arrive to portray a happy married life.
She meets Vikram Bhalla, head of Tattvaa's west zone and agrees to marry him. Rishabh exposes him as a fraud and two-timer, thus saving Bhagya from being manipulated. Her parents assume Rishabh is her husband and the two maintain the facade. Bhagya falls in love with Rishabh but he is hiding a truth.
He is a rich businessman and he came into Bhagya's life hoping to earn her trust so he can avenge his father Gautam Kapoor who is in jail because of her false testimony. Despite his mission, Rishabh ends up growing feelings for Bhagya making him feel guilty and conflicted. Naysa, Rishabh's former wife, who remains obsessed with Rishabh, is revealed to be Bhagya's boss. Rishabh discovers that Bhagya believed the victims who were paid by Naysa to speak up against Gautam and gave the testimony. She did not know he was innocent and this was a setup.
Naysa later discovers that the man Bhagya loves is Rishabh and publicly exposes the truth. She reveals that Rishabh is a Kapoor and lies that they are still married. Bhagya is left shattered, heartbroken and asks Rishabh to leave her life. Her pain eclipses the mistake she made of giving a false testimony against an innocent man without checking. She goes to court and corrects her mistake but fails to realise the magnitude of how it destroyed a family.
Bhagya has hardened her heart and refuses to trust anyone. She focuses on work, staying healthy and being with her family. Bhagya left Tattvaa and now works in Kalos, a company whose boss is later revealed to be Rishabh. He also moves next door to Bhagya to regain her trust. Despite many people trying to frame them for wrongdoings in order to separate them, the two remain together and eventually marry.
tagline: Bhagyashree Iyer is an independent woman who lives in Delhi.

title: Black, White & Gray - Love Kills
summary:
Black, White & Gray – Love Kills is a 2025 Hindi-language Indian Mockumentary Crime thriller web series streaming on SonyLIV. It is directed by Pushkar Sunil Mahabal and produced by Swaroop Sampat and Hemal Thakkar.
It stars Mayur More, Palak Jaiswal, Hakkim Shahjahan, Deven Bhojani, Tigmanshu Dhulia and the series is released on 2 May 2025.
plot: In a world where love can be lethal, a string of high-profile murders unravels into a tangled web of forbidden desires and betrayal. As the investigation deepens, it becomes clear — the truth does not come in black or white, but in dangerous shades of grey.
reception:
Shubhra Gupta of The Indian Express gave 3 stars out of 5 and wrote that "Patriarchy, parental opposition, class differences, power structures, are all present in this crime drama, reminding you of several others that have come before." Mayur Sanap of Rediff.com also gave 3 stars out 5 and observed that "Black, White & Gray - Love Kills has a unique take on the standard murder mystery that may not be perfect but is very entertaining nonetheless" Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated 3.5/5 stars and said "With its smart mockumentary format and sociopolitical depth, Black, White & Gray—Love Kills is an engrossing watch that provokes reflection as much as it entertains."
Anisha Rao of India Today said in her review that "'Black, White and Grey - Love Kills' is a mind game. It lures you in with its true-crime coat, then punches you in the gut with emotional depth and masterful storytelling. It's fiction, yes, but it'll haunt you like a cold case you never solved." Arpita Sarkar of OTT Play rated it 2.5/5 stars and said, "The crime thriller series starts well with the gripping plot, however, it loses its thrill in the middle. Meanwhile, Mayur More's acting is praiseworthy." Sonal Pandya of Times Now gave 3 stars out of 5 and commented that "Writer-director Pushkar Mahabal creates a fictional documentary approach to a crime, and viewers watch as it spirals out of control. It is a gripping crime thriller with interesting take on standard mystery.
Rahul Desai of The Hollywood Reporter India writes in his review that "The six-episode series is an inventive subversion of true-crime storytelling. Most docudramas are so preoccupied with showing (rather than suggesting) that they forget to read between the very lines they endorse. They adopt the glamour and distractions of fiction, the politics and insinuations of mythmaking. Everyone seems to be playing a role, including the makers who use creative ambiguity as an excuse for moral ambivalence. But once in a while, an audacious series like Black, White & Gray comes along and breaks the fourth wall." Nandini Ramnath of Scroll.in observed that "Black, White & Gray is intense and involving for the most part, unpeeling its many layers with dexterity. The performances are excellent."
Vinamra Mathur og Firstpost rated 3/5 stars and said "The most nifty aspect of Black White And Gray Love Kills is how it stays true to the essence of the blueprint of a skillful thriller". Troy Ribeiro of Free Press Journal gave 3 stars out of 5 and writes, "Is it perfect? Hardly. But perhaps slickness would have diluted its rage. In an era of algorithm-massaged narratives, this series dares to stay messy, raw, and defiantly uncomfortable—like the truths it seeks to unearth."

episodesList.title: The Girl in the Trunk
episodesList.summary: A two-year-old serial murder case, where four people unrelated to each other were killed in a span of 2 days by a young boy, comes to the forefront when an independent journalist tries to pursue the truth. He interviews the cops and friends, and family to understand what really happened.

episodesList.title: Murder on the Highway
episodesList.summary: An alternate story is uncovered regrading the fateful night of the first murder that conforms to the facts. However, the cops seem to have made up their mind about the story.

episodesList.title: Red Beacon, Black Secret
episodesList.summary: As the alternate theories behind the second murder become fantastical but not wholly believable, a new participant comes into the picture whose existence the cops refused to accept.

episodesList.title: Midnight Raid
episodesList.summary: As the journalist investigates the third murder, he questions whether it was an accident or an intentional kill. Meawhile, the truth behind the fourth murder may be coincidental but not completely realistic.

episodesList.title: Interview Ya Confession?
episodesList.summary: A new theory emerges to join the different versions of the truth - that of love and loss. While the official account stays as it was, the alternate versions now disagree. Which one is the truth?

episodesList.title: Black, White & Gray
episodesList.summary: There is no loss that does not incite the feeling for revenge. But can a mere man hope for support and closure? Can a mere man hope to win against the system?
