episodesList.summary: Mandaar is determined to not let Abhishek meet Gayatri, but even after being very vigilant, Mandaar fails. Abhishek comes in an old man's avatar and asks for help from Gayatri and Mandaar unknowingly lets her help him.

episodesList.title: Mahendra is In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Komila enters Mahendra's life and creates problems for him. Rocky tells Urmila that the clients have liked her pictures and they want her to be the actress in their ad film. When Urmila comes looking for Mahendra, he panics because Komila is still with him.

episodesList.title: Mahendra Seeks Anna's Help
episodesList.summary: Amol spills the beans on Mahendra's secret about Komila. When Urmila gets to know that Komila was hiding in her house she gets angry. Mahendra seeks Anna's help because Urmila is angry with him.

episodesList.title: Mahendra's Crisis
episodesList.summary: Mahendra is seen shivering after coming out from the freezer and Anna helps to cover him with a blanket. Gayatri gives him a concoction to warm up his body while Mahendra is busy cracking jokes with Prabhakar.

episodesList.title: Engagement Announcement
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Anna fight because Anna doesn't let Mahendra tell anyone that they got the place for free because of him. Kalpesh and Prabhakar fight with each other because both of them want to make the announcement of the engagement.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Ring Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Everyone from the two families gets themselves busy for the ring ceremony of Gayatri. In the ceremony itself, Anna forgives his elder daughter and accepts her but not his son-in-law, Jayant.

episodesList.title: Love Letters
episodesList.summary: Vahini discusses her pre-wedding events with Gayatri and makes her aware of how things change after marriage. She also makes her read the letters she had shared with her husband. To know more, watch this episode.

episodesList.title: Anna Gets Angry
episodesList.summary: Bharati comes to Anna's shop, and he gets angry because she comes at the wrong time and is argues with him for no reason. Mahendra offers free umbrellas with his bhakarwadi to his customers. Bharti borrows curd from Urmila.

episodesList.title: Free Umbrella
episodesList.summary: Mahendra sells bhakharwadi with a new scheme of free umbrellas, which makes Anna a little angry but he still manages the same well. Anna scolds a customer and sends him off as he asked for some free item with bhakharwadi.

episodesList.title: Comedy Of Errors
episodesList.summary: Today's episode begins with misunderstandings amongst the womenfolk. Meanwhile, Anna smartly saves Mahendra from a public outburst at his shop. Mahendra peacefully obliges. See what happens in this episode.

episodesList.title: Urmila Thakkar is Dead
episodesList.summary: After receiving a fatal head injury from a constructional dysfunction, Urmila is declared dead by the doctors. Tune in to see what happens.

episodesList.title: Mahendra Becomes Homeless
episodesList.summary: Amol wrongly informs everyone that Urmila is dead. After seeing Urmila alive, Mahendra is content but then he gets to know that they have become homeless. Anna is reluctant to let them stay in his house. Keep watching to know!

episodesList.title: Anna Won't Compromise
episodesList.summary: Anna is afraid of Biscuit and opposes Jyotsna's decision of inviting Mahendra's family to their home. Meanwhile, Mahendra gets trapped in an uncanny place in the hospital. Keep watching to know more.

episodesList.title: Neighbours Become Guests
episodesList.summary: Jyotsna had invited Urmila to her home without Anna's knowledge. Anna, who is initially reluctant, approves their stay after a series of dialogues, when finally Mahendra interferes.

episodesList.title: The Hospitable Maharashtrians
episodesList.summary: Anna and his family welcome Mahendra's family to their house. Anna cordially lets them know the rules of the house, while Urmila takes too long in the one-and-only bathroom of the house. How will Anna react?

episodesList.title: Keshav's Plan
episodesList.summary: Anna is fed up with the guests in his house. Meanwhile, Keshav and Prabhakar plan to scare Mahendra.

episodesList.title: Mahendra is Scared
episodesList.summary: Mahendra's suspicion turns into confirmation when he sees something unnatural in his room. Meanwhile, Abhishek tries to spend some time with his fiancee Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Mahendra and Anna are Worried
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Anna are worried because Kalpesh comes unannounced with his whole family at their doorstep. Abhishek is hiding in a closet, and when Gayatri asks him to come out, he denies her. Keep watching this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Anna is Irritated
episodesList.summary: Seeing the problems, Gujaratis are creating in his house, Anna is both- irritated and furious. Meanwhile, Abhishek and Gayatri are still struggling to spend some time.

episodesList.title: Keshav has an Idea
episodesList.summary: Amid the hustle in Anna's house, Keshav plans to get Mahendra out of the house. He plans to make Abhishek meet Gayatri in a private place. Anna somehow gets to know this.

episodesList.title: The Midnight Party
episodesList.summary: Keshav organizes a party for Abhishek and Gayatri at midnight and on the other hand, he informs Anna and others about it. Now, everybody is trying to look for the couple.

episodesList.title: Mahendra's House is Repaired
episodesList.summary: Amid the clashes of both the families over newspapers, toilets, and everything else, Gayatri gives her parents good news that their house is now repaired. Meanwhile, Anna is still worried.

episodesList.title: Expensive Gifts
episodesList.summary: Urmilla brags about the cost of the sarees in front of a customer. Anna comes to give good news to his family but when everyone makes fun of his behaviour, he gets angry. Gayatri asks Urmilla to not gift such expensive sarees to her in-laws. Tune into this episode.

episodesList.title: Urmila vs Anna
episodesList.summary: Urmila suggests Anna that his image will be ruined if he publishes his business in the way he wants. Anna doesn't like it and he gets involved in an argument with Urmila.

episodesList.title: Anna's Fasting
episodesList.summary: Mahendra convinces Urmila to get ready for the marriage and even promises her that the marriage will be according to her wish. Later, all the members of Anna's family try breaking his fast but fail, whereas Urmila succeeds at once.

episodesList.title: Pre-wedding Drama
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Gayatri invite a group of singers and musicians. They perform both, Gujarati and Marathi folk dance. Urmila gets emotional about her daughter's marriage while Mahendra and Keshav get ready for the celebration.

episodesList.title: Urmila is Angry
episodesList.summary: Urmila gets to know that the designer she had hired is one of her old enemies, Komila. She is furious and warns her to stay away from Mahendra.

episodesList.title: Mahendra's Mischiefs
episodesList.summary: Urmila is worried about the whereabouts of Mahendra while Mahendra is roaming around enacting various characters. Mahendra disguises himself as a milkman and tries to meet Anna.

episodesList.title: Anna Wont Rest
episodesList.summary: Mahendra tells Anna to rest for some time but Anna is continuously working for the upcoming wedding ceremony. Anna tells Mahendra that he has to match with the bridal party's expenses and so he is working hard.

episodesList.title: Anna to Act
episodesList.summary: A director approaches Urmila to act in an ad. He also wants a character in his ad that resembles Anna. Urmila and Mahendra convince Anna to act in the ad. Anna hesitatingly agrees.

episodesList.title: Anna Argues With The Director
episodesList.summary: Anna argues with the director and tells him that if he had to do everything then why did he bother to call them for the acting. Director gets irritated because Anna doesn't understand his directions. Keep watching to see what happens.

episodesList.title: Urmila is Envious
episodesList.summary: Urmila sees Mahendra with Komila and is enraged. Even Anna fails to pacify her. She is constantly blaming Mahendra now.

episodesList.title: Marriage Registration Papers
episodesList.summary: Urmila brings Gayatri along with her to Anna's home for the pre-marriage function, whereas Abhishek plans to get Anna's signature on the marriage registration papers. Abhishek calls Gayatri in the middle of the event and asks her for the same.

episodesList.title: Gokhale Bandhu's New Branch
episodesList.summary: Urmila tells Mahendra that Gokhale Bandhu's new branch is going to open in a mall. Mahendra panics when he gets this news. When Mahendra tells Urmila the truth about the new Gokhale Bandhu branch, Urmila tells him that Anna is going to be really angry because of this. Tune in to see what happens now.

episodesList.title: Anna is Tensed
episodesList.summary: Anna comes to know from a video clip that one of the branches of his business is running in Ahmedabad. He is disturbed amidst the marriage ceremony. Mahendra then convinces Anna that nothing as such has happened. Will Anna find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Wedding Takes a Serious Turn
episodesList.summary: An angry Anna suspects Gayatri and Mahendra's involvement in the establishment of his new branch in Ahmedabad. He questions Gayatri about the same and she confirms her involvement in it.

episodesList.title: Exchange Of House
episodesList.summary: Anna's rude decision leaves everything scattered. Gayatri and Abhishek will exchange their house to find a solution to the problem. Even Mahendra and his wife support Abhishek in fulfilling the cause.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Emotions
episodesList.summary: Anna finds out the truth and now has an even worse impression of Mahendra and Abhishek. In such dire times, Gayatri also doesn't help them out but misses Abhishek. Things get more jovial from then on.

episodesList.title: The Kulfi Story
episodesList.summary: Gayatri prepares Kulfi for everyone in the family. Anna tells Jyotsana that Gayatri has made Kulfi really well. Gayatri suggests to Anna that they should open a Kulfi stall at their shop as it's a traditional Indian food. Keep watching!

episodesList.title: Gayatri Takes a Harsh Decision
episodesList.summary: Abhijeet and his family expect Gayatri to come over to their house for the ceremony of pag phere. This is an occasion everyone is waiting for. However, almost at the last moment, Gayatri takes a rather harsh decision. She decides to get her ceremony done at Bharati bhabhi's house.

episodesList.title: Family's Love Never Gets Lost
episodesList.summary: Gayatri celebrates her pag phera ceremony at Bharati bhabhi's place. Gayatri and Abhijeet missed their own families and vice versa. Bharati bhabhi is very happy about the whole thing. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Game Makes Work Easy
episodesList.summary: Gayatri makes a smart move and brings everyone to compete in a cooking game for the morning food at the shop. Anna comes and tastes the food made by everyone and checks if the tastes are all proper. He is satisfied and has high hopes for Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Abhishek's New Business Plan
episodesList.summary: Abhishek helps Mahendra to have a huge sale and people are starting to prefer his shop to Anna's shop. Abhishek also shares a hopeful business plan with Mahendra. Bharati bhabhi questions herself.

episodesList.title: Tradition Versus Change
episodesList.summary: The wives of the Gokhale family are bonding well. On the other hand, Mahendra's new business plan is slow-paced. It is a battle between Anna's traditions and Mahendra's new-school change.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Starts The Revolt
episodesList.summary: Gayatri wakes up the Gokhale family earlier than usual and treats everyone with tea. After being questioned, she sends a message to revolt against Abhishek's evolutionary visions by sticking to her ritualistic ideas. What plan does she have for Abhishek's vision?

episodesList.title: Intelligent Amol Gokhale
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and his wife are fed up with their feud with the Gokhales and make an effort to end this. They ask Amol Gokhale to provide intel from the opposition. But, this step doesn't go accordingly.

episodesList.title: Abhishek's Plan Goes In Vain
episodesList.summary: Abhishek and Mahendra plan something big for their Dosa Center. Mandar cheekily listens to their conversation and reports back to Anna. Anna has his plans for the opposition. The next day, Police arrive at Gayatri Dosa Center.

episodesList.title: It's Kulfi Time
episodesList.summary: Urmila is still pissed at Mahendra for neglecting the license. Meanwhile, Bharti has a craving for kulfi and she convinces Prabhakar to take her to the Kulfi shop. Prabhakar asks his elder brother to join him so that he'll have a backup in case Anna catches them.

episodesList.title: Anna In a Nutshell
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and her uncles are caught by Anna at the kulfi shop with Abhishek and his in-laws. Mahendra thinks the time has come when Anna will scold Gayatri. But to their surprise, Gayatri was praised for her effort. Mahendra counters Anna for being a hypocrite.

episodesList.title: Vibhu is Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and Abhishek are on their trip. On the other hand, Vibhu comes home with great news. She is expecting a child and is here to stay with her family. Urmila ensures that Vibhu's husband, Jayant is also allowed to stay.

episodesList.title: Urmila Faints
episodesList.summary: Urmila is still sick because of Jayant's ice cream. The same thing is happening with the others as well. As Urmila faints, her dog comes to the Gokhale house and Anna gets scared of him. Will Anna go and check what is wrong at Mahendra's house?

episodesList.title: Bharati's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Bharati and Mahendra decide to bring Abhishek and Gayatri to come closer. They went to buy groceries from a nearby village and thought it would help the cause. But, things didn't work out well for them. Meanwhile, Anna starts to get along with Biscuit pretty well.

episodesList.title: Preparation For Raksha Bandhan
episodesList.summary: Bharati along with her husband decides to gift some golden stuff to his sister on Raksha Bandhan. But later, due to some circumstances, they fail to arrange the same, rather her husband pens down a poem for her. On the other side, Abhishek misses his family and his elder sister. Watch to know what happens next?

episodesList.title: Exchanging Gifts For Raksha Bandhan
episodesList.summary: While the kids exchange gifts amongst themselves on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan, Amol becomes emotional and misses his wife, Supriya. On the other hand, Mahendra is forced by Urmila to get the Rakhi tied by Komila.

episodesList.title: Sister's Right
episodesList.summary: The gifts for the sisters on the occasion of Raksha Bandhan is their right. Urmila asks Anna for something special. On the other hand, Vibhu tries to explain to Abhishek that even if his decision is right, he should try to approach and implement it more subtly.

episodesList.title: Anna Hides His Pain
episodesList.summary: Abhishek and Mahendra are going away so that Abhishek can learn new things and open his baking and confectionery shop. He says goodbye and leaves, but Anna gets triggered. He is angry with him, but also sad that he is going. It is the same with Gayatri, but she doesn't show that she is sad. Gayatri is also taking big orders for the shop.

episodesList.title: Urmila Enjoys The Alone Time
episodesList.summary: After hearing the news about Bangalore floods and the bridge broke down, everyone gets tensed. Anna asks Gayatri to call Abhishek and Mahendra. She learns about their well-being and informs Anna. The next day, Anna sees Yogesh serving food in Mahendra's shop.

episodesList.title: Mahendra In Disguise
episodesList.summary: Abhishek and Mahendra disguise themselves as two Marathi women and enter the town. Urmila spots them, but they trick her into thinking that they have come here to work with Gayatri. Meanwhile, Bharati messes with Anna regarding lunch. Anna makes Bharati pledge about it.

episodesList.title: Cooking is an Art
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Abhishek enter into Anna's house in a different avatar, as lady cooks. Meanwhile, they try to convince the whole house that cooking is correlated to music and dance. Later, they show them how to cook and dance consecutively.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi to The Rescue
episodesList.summary: Bharati's sisters were supposed to come to help Gayatri and Nirmiti with their Mumbai order, but they couldn't come. As an alternative, Anna calls Chandramukhi and her daughter-in-law for the work. Mahendra and Abhishek are in trouble at the hotel, and later, Mahendra might even get caught by Urmila.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi Questioned By Jyotsna
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi and her daughter-in-law come to Anna's house. Anna is very happy to see them, but Jyotsna is there to keep Anna in line. Anna asks them about their wage and then Jyotsna asks them about their family.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Pranks Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Gayatri is spending some time with kids when Abhishek comes disguised as Sulakshana. He succeeds in making Gayatri emotional when he himself cries remembering Raghoba, his imaginary husband. Watch to know!

episodesList.title: Treasure Hunt
episodesList.summary: Sulakshana, Chandramukhi, and Anna fight off the goons at the shop. Anna shares that he has cancelled the Dahi Handi ceremony and given that money to charity. At the Gokhale house, the children get to play a treasure hunt game. Amol and the kids win the challenge. Later, Sulakshana and Gayatri have a heart-to-heart conversation.

episodesList.title: Gayatri is Adamant
episodesList.summary: Gayatri tells Anna that Abhishek should apologize to her and that she is not at all in a mood to talk to him. Anna agrees with her and tells that Abhishek should repent for his deeds.

episodesList.title: Anna Loves Chandramukhi's Cooking
episodesList.summary: As Chandramukhi makes the food, Anna comes to the house, angry at Prabhakar. Bharati plans with Jyotsna to make a face expressing that the food is bad regardless of the taste. However, when Anna tastes the food, he loves it and scolds Bharati.

episodesList.title: The Test
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi and Sulakshana are put to a test by Jyotsna, to check their authenticity. They are taken separately and asked various questions. Both of them are scared, but thankfully, they had prepared themselves. They had practiced all the questions and they both answered the same thing.

episodesList.title: Abhishek and Mahendra Come Home
episodesList.summary: Urmila calls Mahendra for the Ganesh Puja. Parallelly, Anna also asks Bharati to call Abhishek for the Ganesh Puja. They both take a leave from being Chandramukhi and Sulakshana. Both of them reach their homes and are ready for being their true selves once again.

episodesList.title: Maintaining Both Characters
episodesList.summary: Abhishek and Mahendra are busy maintaining both their characters. They are in a tight spot as Gokhale's family is getting closer to them. Urmila also corners Mahendra, but he manages to escape the problem.

episodesList.title: Chandramukhi's Narrow Escape
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi wears the clothes in the wrong manner and people think that she is a ghost. Later, Mahendra goes to his house for the Ganesh Puja. Chandramukhi was almost about to get caught, but she manages to stay out of trouble.

episodesList.title: Ganapati Puja
episodesList.summary: Abhishek arrives for the Ganesh Puja and everyone is happy. Gayatri and Anna wish that everything was fine between them. He leaves and then comes back to talk to Gayatri as Sulakshana. Gayatri bursts out. Later, Urmila almost gets to know the truth about Mahendra and Abhishek.

episodesList.title: Mahendra Stages Gayatri's Kidnapping
episodesList.summary: Urmila gets to know the truth about Mahendra and Abhishek. Parallelly, Anna and Gayatri want to meet Abhishek at his college in Bangalore. To avoid that, Mahendra hires a few people to kidnap Gayatri. They kidnap her and everyone is tensed. The kidnappers call Anna and ask for one crore rupees.

episodesList.title: Finding Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Anna is going to the police to inform them about Gayatri's kidnapping. Mahendra and Abhishek are tensed because of that. However, Amol makes a mistake and Anna comes back. Mahendra is free of tension. Later, Keshav and gang also check the phone recording and find a lead.

episodesList.title: Urmila's Tantrums
episodesList.summary: Urmila gets to know about the staged kidnapping and she overacts in front of Anna. On the other hand, Abhishek's secret is out on the lose. Keshav and gang are on their way to find Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Terrified Mahendra
episodesList.summary: While discussing his plans to get back Gayatri, Mahendra gets scared to see Anna arriving. But to his luck, Anna misses listening to what he said. Later, Anna hugs Abhishek and accepts him.

episodesList.title: Getting Back Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Abhishek come to Anna and speak about the dream that they had. According to their dream, they go to rescue Gayatri. Mahendra pays the kidnappers and they run away. In the end, Gayatri and Abhishek talk and hug each other.

episodesList.title: Keshav Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Anna is happy that both Abhishek and Gayatri are at home. Anna calls Keshav to ask why haven't they arrived yet. Keshav tells Anna that he is bringing Gayatri with her. Anna catches his lie and says that Gayatri is already at home.

episodesList.title: Covering Up The Mistake
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Urmila together try to cover up the mistake that has been made. They are trying to cover the reason why Chandramukhi's phone was in Mahendra's house. Keshav and the others get closer and closer to the truth.

episodesList.title: Amol's Innocence
episodesList.summary: Chandramukhi falls on Anna's lap and Anna tells her not to think negatively. Amol gets a beating in the neighborhood because he wanted to get married. Later, Gayatri and Abhishek play a traditional marriage game. Anna wants to get Amol married to Sulakshana.

episodesList.title: Keshav's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Abhishek is getting into deeper trouble, as Anna and even his mother are fine with getting Amol remarried to Sulakshana. Keshav is growing more and more suspicious about Abhishek and Mahendra.

episodesList.title: Keshav is Onto The Truth
episodesList.summary: Keshav follows Abhishek into the hotel where they live. Keshav then tempts the receptionist with money and finds out all the information he needs. Keshav is almost onto the real truth about Abhishek and Mahendra.

episodesList.title: Abhishek's Gratuity
episodesList.summary: Keshav is still trying to solve the matter that he doubts on. On the other hand, Abhishek thanks and shows his gratitude for whatever Mahendra has done for him. Later, Abhishek falls in a tight spot.

episodesList.title: Keshav's Tricks
episodesList.summary: Keshav tries to get Abhishek exposed but then he is unable to do so. He also uses Amol's emotions for this mission. Keshav is almost confirmed about this fact. He plans something bigger.

episodesList.title: Mahendra In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Keshav is ready with his plan and is gradually executing it. Anna recognizes one of Gayatri's kidnappers and learns that Mahendra had done the entire plot. Keshav calls Shinde to the house and is ready to tell the truth. .

episodesList.title: Mahendra Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: The truth about Abhishek and Mahendra, disguising themselves as Sulakshan and Chandramukhi comes before everyone. Anna tries to understand the matter but he is hurt. Gayatri is also angry with both of them.

episodesList.title: Abhishek and Gayatri's Story Rewind
episodesList.summary: Abhishek makes a call to Gayatri, which she ignores by disconnecting it. But he calls her again. Later, during the conversation, both get nostalgic thinking about their past story. Watch the full episode!

episodesList.title: Abhishek Makes Anna Emotional
episodesList.summary: Anna wakes up late in the morning and reaches the shop late as well. Abhishek stays in line at Anna's store to buy some sweets and also offers some new recipes. Anna later scolds Gayatri for smiling at Abhishek.

episodesList.title: Anna Loses His Patience
episodesList.summary: While going somewhere, Anna gets crosses paths with Bharati, and upon asking her where she was going, she gets Anna all confused and irritated as well. On the other side, Mahendra becomes sad remembering Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Mission Munna
episodesList.summary: Anna and Mahendra join forces to find out who has called Munna to their house. Jyotsna and the others are very happy about Munna's arrival, but Anna is not.

episodesList.title: Jyotsna Controls Anna
episodesList.summary: Anna is furious with his family because they all are happy with Munna's arrival. He still wants to know who has invited Munna. Jyotsna controls Anna from bursting out. On the other hand, Mahendra has other plans for the occasion.

episodesList.title: Komila's Arrival
episodesList.summary: Gayatri comes to take Abhishek back home so that he can help send Munna Kaka back. As a result, they become friends. On the other hand, Urmila's sister Komila arrives, leaving Urmila angry and annoyed with her presence.

episodesList.title: Munna is Here
episodesList.summary: Munna arrives and immediately starts to make people happy. He brings gifts for everyone and even has one for Anna. However, Anna doesn't like him and wants him gone.

episodesList.title: Love Perfume
episodesList.summary: Urmila gets a love perfume which makes a person romantic. They want to use it on Abhishek and Gayatri so that they fall for each other. However, things go sideways and it is also used on Mahendra and Anna.

episodesList.title: Love is In The Air
episodesList.summary: The love perfume starts working and it makes people lovey-dovey. Anna, Mahendra, and Abhishek are all affected by the love perfume.

episodesList.title: The Dressing Contest
episodesList.summary: All the family members along with Anna's friend start a dressing contest, where the dare is to wear kids' dresses and show up. Anna opposes this but fails due to the approval of all.

episodesList.title: Abhishek's Point Of View
episodesList.summary: Anna has a break-in at his shop. As his money is stolen, he regrets not putting the high-tech locks like Mahendra. Suddenly, Abhishek comes and returns the money saying that he had taken it. He did it to show that how easy it is to steal the money from their shop. He makes Anna aware.

episodesList.title: Urmila Sets The Plan
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Komila discuss their plan for Navratri. They plan to bring Abhishek and Gayatri closer on this occasion. The people are happy with Munna Kaka in the house, but Anna is upset about this fact.

episodesList.title: Munna Kaka Helps With Business
episodesList.summary: Munna Kaka, Prabhakar, Keshav, and Anna are at the shop. Munna Kaka comes up with an idea and it works out. On the other hand, he also teaches Keshav a lesson. Later, Anna gets irritated and behaves rude to the customers.

episodesList.title: Anna is Drunk
episodesList.summary: Munna Kaka, Prabhakar, Keshav, and Anna are at the shop. Munna Kaka comes up with an idea and it works out. On the other hand, he also teaches Keshav a lesson. Later, Anna gets irritated and behaves rude to the customers.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Talks to Munna Kaka
episodesList.summary: Abhishek tells Munna Kaka never to do what he did again. He shouldn't try to drop Anna's self-respect. Abhishek tells him just to help in fulfilling the dreams of the family members. Later, Munna Kaka and Komila have a funny session.

episodesList.title: Fancy Dress Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Munna Kaka tells everyone to dress up in various attires and celebrate the Kisaan Divas. Everyone dresses up and is having fun. Anna also takes part in this. Later, Urmila feels jealous of Komila.

episodesList.title: Prabhakar is Rejected
episodesList.summary: Prabhakar goes to the music director but he is rejected. Anna makes fun of it and then Urmila calls to share a problem with them. Abhishek and Gayatri have a photo session of their own.

episodesList.title: Munna Runs Away With Money
episodesList.summary: Munna Kaka takes the money and runs away. The dangerous money lenders come to collect their money. Anna almost gives away his golden Laxmi idol, but Mahendra stops him. They agree upon returning the money by the next morning.

episodesList.title: Anna and Munna
episodesList.summary: Anna is very angry with Mahendra, Urmila, and Abhishek, as they brought Munna Kaka back. Now, Abhishek comes with an issue. The Gokhale land needs to be transferred into Anna's name. However, for this, they need the signature of both Anna and Munna Kaka.

episodesList.title: Anna's Blessings
episodesList.summary: Anna tells that whoever will take his blessings first will also receive money from him. He wants Abhishek to get it and that is exactly what happens. It is Abhishek's birthday as well.

episodesList.title: Abhishek is In a Fix
episodesList.summary: Abhishek tries numerous times to touch Anna's feet. However, he is unsuccessful in his tries and becomes sad. Anna is rude to him and scolds him. At home, everyone is trying to win the competition of remembering Ram in their daily works.

episodesList.title: Mixed Feelings On Diwali
episodesList.summary: Anna scolds Abhishek and tells him to go away. Yogesh is drunk and speaks the truth to Anna. Prabhakar starts crying because of Abhishek. Later Urmila also speaks a few harsh words to Anna. Vibhu is also taken to the hospital.

episodesList.title: The Property Papers
episodesList.summary: Yogesh and Munna get to know about the property papers and they come to make a deal with Anna. Yogesh speaks bad about Anna and gets a beating from the women. Anna is very angry and calls for a family meeting.

episodesList.title: Anna Gives Away His Shop
episodesList.summary: Munna denies that Anna has given him money for his part of the shop. Anna is suggested to partition the shop or sell it. He would never do such a thing so he gives away the entire shop to Munna Kaka.

episodesList.title: New Owner Of The Shop
episodesList.summary: Munna is the new owner of Anna's shop. He is not at all cut for the job and mistreats the customers. His work and ethics are not at all acceptable. Mahendra and Urmila try to help but Anna warns them against pitying him.

episodesList.title: Family First
episodesList.summary: Munna Kaka tried to bring further problems to Anna's family. But when it came to family matters, the women stepped up and gave the men an ultimatum. The men eventually chose family over the deal.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Business Strategy
episodesList.summary: Abhishek is instigating Munna Kaka to be competitive about the business. Gayatri tries to drown his business with her brains. Anna's makeshift shop is running successfully. .

episodesList.title: Munna Confesses The Truth
episodesList.summary: Police come to the shop and want to arrest Munna Kaka for the murder of Mahendra. Out of tension when poked a little, Munna Kaka speaks the truth about receiving the money for the shop from Anna. Mahendra is still alive and the whole thing was a trick to get Munna speaking. .

episodesList.title: Urmila is Daydreaming
episodesList.summary: Urmila is in the shop and is daydreaming. She decides that the best way to get Gayatri and Abhishek together is to ensure that they have a baby as soon as possible. She shares her idea with Mahendra and he is confused about it. .

episodesList.title: Prabhakar Stops Composing Songs
episodesList.summary: Prabhakar decides he will not create any more songs and gives up. The entire family tries to get him to make more music. Bharati expresses her attachment to the songs. .

episodesList.title: Anna's Worries
episodesList.summary: Anna reaches the scene where Bharati is explaining about her dreams where Abhishek and Gayatri are stuck on a lonely island. Later he gets irritated on Prabhakar because of his habit's.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Tries to Make Amends
episodesList.summary: Amol is troubled once again and threatens to jump from the window. Everyone stops him and then later Abhishek speaks to Gayatri and explains to her that he feels her love even through the rough exterior. Abhishek makes efforts to get his relationship back on track. .

episodesList.title: Prabhakar is Sad
episodesList.summary: The Literature Club in the society hears the news about Prabhakar giving up songs and comes over. They make fun of Prabhakar and as a result, Prabhakar is sad. Amol goes with Gayatri and family to the temple. .

episodesList.title: Mahendra and Urmila's Plan
episodesList.summary: Anna is still trying to get Prabhakar back to writing songs. On the other hand, the priest is tried of handling Amol and hence Amol is sent back home. Mahendra and Urmila have their plan on track and want Gayatri and Abhishek to get closer. .

episodesList.title: The Impact Of Sweets
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Mahendra put love potion in the sweets from the puja. They were scared as they mixed those two sweets with the rest of them. However, they ensure that Abhishek and Gayatri get sweets. Anna loses Urmila's dog, Biscuit. .

episodesList.title: Urmila Tells About The Mishap
episodesList.summary: Urmila is shy about what happened between her and Mahendra. She tells the story of how her plan backfired on them to Jyotsna, Bharti and Nirmiti. Later Abhishek and Gayatri speak to each other and have a misunderstanding. .

episodesList.title: Mahendra Solves Prabhakar's Problems
episodesList.summary: Mahendra, Anna and the others try an ultimate attempt to get Prabhakar back to writing songs. They invite the famous literary idol of the locality to their home and each person poses as a popular poet. The eminent personality praises Prabhakar and he agrees to continue his passion for songs. .

episodesList.title: Urmila is Expecting a Baby
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Mahendra go to the doctor and find out that Urmila is pregnant. Urmila reveals the truth to Jyotsna, Bharti and Nirmiti. Later everyone learns of the news and congratulate Mahendra and Urmila. Urmila takes advantage of the situation and asks Anna to bring Gayatri home for a few days. .

episodesList.title: Mahendra Becomes The Gynaecologist
episodesList.summary: Gayatri comes at the wrong time and overhears a little bit of her parents conversation. She suspects the honesty behind Urmila's pregnancy and asks to go to a gynaecologist. Urmila and Mahendra draw out a plan and Mahendra poses and comes as Urmila's gynaecologist, Shishupal Sharma. .

episodesList.title: Urmila Tries to Keep The Secret
episodesList.summary: Urmila wants to keep her secret and hence she makes a plan along with Mahendra. They execute the plan and fool the people for the time being. However, Urmila is still scared that the truth will unfold before the others. .

episodesList.title: Anna Almost Gets to Know The Truth
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Mahendra go to one of their friend who is a gynaecologist for help. Abhishek, Gayatri and Anna get to know about this and reach the doctors office. Somehow, they manage to keep the secret. .

episodesList.title: Keshav Feels Suspicious
episodesList.summary: When confronted by Anna and Gayatri, Dr. Narangi informs them that she had asked Urmila to come to her for Sonography considering they are friends from childhood. Gayatri feels suspicious and sets out to find the truth.

episodesList.title: Abhishek is Curious
episodesList.summary: Everyone is fooled by Urmila and they celebrate the arrival of a new baby. On the other hand, Abhishek becomes suspicious and starts to inquire about a few things. Keshav almost catches Mahendra in the act but his phone rings at the nick of time. .

episodesList.title: Race For a Sonography Report
episodesList.summary: Mahendra is in the race to get a sonography report in time and seeks his friends son Jagdish's help. While he manages to convince him to get a sonography report, he realizes that Jadish is a veterinarian. While Urmila tries to buy him some time by being unconscious, will Mahendra be able to find a way out?

episodesList.title: Anna Learns The Truth
episodesList.summary: Anna is excited to see Urmila's sonograph on the computer screen. However, Mahendra and the doctor are shocked beyond belief when they see the sonograph and see a baby in the womb. Is Urmila indeed pregnant?

episodesList.title: End Of a Tradition
episodesList.summary: Abhishek, Mahendra and Urmila have made a plan to ensure that Gayatri is back with Abhishek. They asked her to divorce Abhishek if she doesn't want to grace the marriage with her presence. Anna is tensed as nobody in the Gokhale family has ever had a divorce. Will it be the end of a Gokhale tradition? .

episodesList.title: Twist In The Tale
episodesList.summary: Anna and Gayatri have the upper hand in the dispute that they have between the families. Urmila and Mahendra are on a hunger strike until they get their daughter back to their home. And they also tell Abhishek to leave their home. Abhishek leaves and is sad. .

episodesList.title: Urmila's Fast is Broken
episodesList.summary: Anna and Gayatri go on to break the hunger strike that Urmila and Mahendra had continued. They go on and tell them to break the fast and Anna forces Urmila to eat an apple. After the fast is broken, Anna and Gayatri return as they are happy and successful in their mission. .

episodesList.title: Jyotsana Shakes Hand With Mahendra
episodesList.summary: Abhishek comes home to handover the divorce papers and leaves. All the family members get worried while his mother shakes hand with Mahendra to prevent the divorce. By making a situation where Late Tauji communicates with Anna trying to make him understand that their family never had any divorce cases and it should never have one.

episodesList.title: Anna is Scared
episodesList.summary: According to the plan, Jyotsna, Mahendra and Urmila are trying to scare Anna. They are trying to bring in a person who looks like Anna's Tauji and scare him. Anna is scared according to the plan but later Amol spoils the thrill. Urmila also puts an ad on the newspapers. .

episodesList.title: Urmila Takes a Chance
episodesList.summary: Urmila comes dressed as Tauji and initially, Mahendra and Jyotsna can't recognize her. She looks great in the costume and she just has to make her voice heavier. Prabhakar gets to know the truth and he is made to listen and understand. The plan is on and Anna has a shock coming at him. .

episodesList.title: Mission to Scare Anna
episodesList.summary: Urmila, Mahendra and Jyotsna are now busy to carry out the mission. They are trying to scare Anna and to ensure that the divorce is not done. Anna is scared but tries not to believe so. The others in the family are also scared and Amol wants to guard the house at night. .

episodesList.title: Execution Of The Plan
episodesList.summary: Mahendra along with wife Urmila as Tauji starts working on their plan but gets caught by Anna's son in the middle. Later Urmila and Mahendra continue into Anna's room to execute the plan and Anna gets scared after seeing Tauji in front of him. How is he going to react? Will Urmila succeed in the plan?

episodesList.title: Tauji's Ghost Busted
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Mahendra's plan to scare Anna pretending to be Tauji's ghost goes berserk and the plan fails. Meanwhile, Bharti freaks out seeing Urmila as Tauji's ghost leaving everyone confused. Later, Gayatri is puzzled to find her dads footwear and suspects him for the foul play. What will Mahendra and Urmila answer to Gayatri?

episodesList.title: Stubborn Anna
episodesList.summary: Anna Faints in the market and Abhishek reaches to help him but Anna insults and sends him away. Later Abhishek comes to Anna's shop for business and pitches his products and leaves. Anna is lost in himself imagining Tauji everywhere and at night Tauji appears and states his consent.

episodesList.title: Anna Searches For a Thief
episodesList.summary: Anna wakes up seeing Tauji in front of him. Tauji says that there should be no divorce in the family. Anna calls everyone to see if it's Tauji or some thief who is trying to fool around. Mahendra and Urmila hide from everyone's notice and escape.

episodesList.title: Abhishek's Present For Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Urmila and Mahendra are both trying to escape all the people chasing them. Abhishek arrives at the house to bring a present for Gayatri. This was the day they first met each other, a year back. Abhishek has a letter along with the gift and Gayatri burst into tears on reading it. .

episodesList.title: Jyotsna Calms The Storm
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Urmila escape from the house with the help of Jyotsna. The next morning Jyotsna had to take care of all the people. She had to cover up the mess that Mahendra and Urmila had made the previous night. .

episodesList.title: Anna's Reaction For Divorce Papers
episodesList.summary: Prabhakar gets caught dressing up as Tauji by Anna but Jyotsna reaches the scene and makes Anna understand and handles the situation. Looking at the mess Anna says, the decision regarding the divorce will be taken soon. Later, Anna gives a reply to Abhishek's divorce papers.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Anna tells Abhishek that he is not angry with him. Rather he wanted to correct him and get him on the right track. Anna brings back Abhishek to his home with open arms. There is a small celebration on Abhishek's homecoming. Later, Gayatri and Abhishek have some alone time.

episodesList.title: The Certification Problem
episodesList.summary: Mahendra and Urmila have made some major mistakes with Gayatri's marriage certificate. That is the reason they are trying to hide the marriage certificate from Anna. Anna is also hyped to check the certificate. Gayatri almost gets to know the truth from Ujwala. .

episodesList.title: Abhijeet Tries Finding Gayatri
episodesList.summary: Anna realises Urmila's mistake in marriage certificate and heads to the registration office and finds mentioned that Gayatri has married Abhijeet. And now Real Abhijeet and his son come finding Gayatri to her house.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Gets Angry
episodesList.summary: The son of Abhijeet urges to play cricket with Gayatri's family and all the kids. Abhijeet, Abhishek, and Gayatri also join in to play. At one instance, Abhijeet holds Gayatri while she slips, but Abhishek gets angry and behaves rudely with Abhijeet. Gayatri makes Abhishek apologise to Abhijeet for behaving rudely.

episodesList.title: Finding Abhijeet
episodesList.summary: Abhijeet comes and plays cricket with the Gokhale family but none of them knows that it is him that they are looking for. They are all searching for the same person somewhere else. Gayatri gets closer and closer to finding out about Urmila's Tauji chapter. .

episodesList.title: Getting The Contact Details
episodesList.summary: Amol has Abhijeet's contact details but he will not share it with the others. Anna tries to be nice and get it but it doesn't make a difference. Later they even go to the court where the mistake had been made in the first place to get Abhijeet's contact information.

episodesList.title: Krishna's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Abhijeet is at Anna's house and everyone clears the confusion among themselves. Abhijeet and Gayatri both want to sign the NOC for each other and declare their marriage null and void on paper. Krishna has his birthday and Anna wants to celebrate it together.

episodesList.title: Ethnic Dress Party
episodesList.summary: Krishna's birthday turns into a much more interesting event at the Gokhale's. At first, there is a competition among Anna, Abhishek and Abhijeet for making the best Bhakharwadi. Thereafter everyone dresses in ethnic attire. There is also a dance programme. .

episodesList.title: Urmila could be In Trouble
episodesList.summary: The party is on with Abhijeet also dressing in an ethnic attire. Everyone is happy celebrating when Krishna falls asleep in Gayatri's lap, and calls her mother in his sleep. Later, Anna feels that he has seen his Tauji in the hospital and Mahendra is tensed about it.

episodesList.title: Abhijeet's Dream
episodesList.summary: Abhishek hides and comes to meet Gayatri when Abhijeet thinks that he is a thief and punches him. Later Abhijeet has a dream that Gayatri denies to give the NOC as she is too attached to Krishna. Later Abhijeet gets Keshav into trouble.

episodesList.title: Gayatri's Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Gayatri gets suspicious about Abhijeet's behaviour about whenever he is on a call he speaks secretly. On the other end, Krishna asks Abhishek and Gayatri to attend his school meeting. Next morning they all go together and Abhijeet arrives as well and slaps a guy who offends Gayatri. Abhishek gets jealous and suspicious.

episodesList.title: The Homework
episodesList.summary: Bharti uses pepper spray on Abhijeet by mistake, as she is trying to learn how to use it. This leads up to a massive confusion between Gayatri and Abhishek. As the teacher meets Aa regarding Ujwala's homework, Mahendra and Ujwala start to panic. Meanwhile, Abhijeet's disappearance creates another series of chaos.

episodesList.title: Abhijeet's Disappearance
episodesList.summary: Abhijeet has disappeared leaving Krishna in Gayathri's house. Everyone gets curious about the disappearance and they enquire the manager about it and he goes speechless. Aa goes to the police station to register a complaint about the missing. Later, Keshav catch holds Ujwala in finding out the facts about Tauji.

episodesList.title: In Search Of Abhijit
episodesList.summary: Tension is rising every second with Abhijit gone for a while, even Aa charges and suspects Mahendra of something fishy. Gayatri tries to squeeze out clues from Krishna about his father but fails. Keshav claims that it was Urmila disguised as someone else in the blanket.

episodesList.title: Everything is Haywire
episodesList.summary: Aa and Mahendra decide to go and find Abhijeet where he was last seen. Keshav is still at his investigation along with Mandar to find out who it was under the blanket. Krishna makes it clear for Gayatri and Abhishek that Abhijit disappears often and its not the first time. Meanwhile, Keshav plans to send Mandar at Urmila's place to retrieve clues, somehow he gets locked in a box.

episodesList.title: Abhijeet Found In Hospital
episodesList.summary: Tau recollects that he has nephew who lives somewhere in Maharashtra . Keshav finds a Santa Claus costume in Urmila's closet, which Keshav finds hard to digest.

episodesList.title: Abhijeet is Found
episodesList.summary: Aa and Mahendra meet Abhijeet and learn that he was looted and beaten at the highway because of which he was unable to contact them.

episodesList.title: Keshav Enquires About Tau
episodesList.summary: Aa makes Urmila, Mahendra, and Jyotsna perform for the play. He is impressed watching them improvise on their own. Keshav disguises as an inspector and enquires with Urmila and Mahendra about Tau's get up.

episodesList.title: Will Aa Know About Mahendra-urmila's Plan?
episodesList.summary: Abhishek informs Aa about Gayatri's groom exchange idea, Aa informs Mahendra about it and Mahendra is more than happy as he now finds it easy to escape Keshavs suspicious nature. Keshav notices Jyotsna burning something and finds a photo that has only Mahendra , Urmila's pic as Tau in it has burnt and Keshav now gets on the quest to solve the mystery as to why did Jyoytsna burn this pic. Mahendra dreams about Aa and Keshav discovering that Urmila was disguised as tau and decides that we need to erase all the cctv footage memory and plan for the same. Urmila calls Jyotsna to explain the plan but Aa picks up the phone and hears everything.

episodesList.title: Mahendra's Fear
episodesList.summary: Aa informs Keshav that Mahendra and Urmila are up to something and are going to come to the house too. Keshav gets going for his trip and makes Aa suspect Mahendra. What is Mahendra & Urmila's fear?

episodesList.title: Urmila-mahendra's Truth Revealed
episodesList.summary: Mahendra thinks that the real Tau is Urmila and flirts with him. Aa sees this and immediately shouts at Mahendra. Keshav finds the hard disk of the CCTV footage. Aa watches the CCTV footage with Keshav and gets to know that he was fooled.

episodesList.title: Faked Tau Revealed
episodesList.summary: Keshav is showing Aa the CCTV footage, where Aa can clearly see Urmila in Tau's costume. Now, what is Aa's decision after the fake Tau's truth is revealed?

episodesList.title: Tau Realises His Mistake Of Misunderstanding Gujratis
episodesList.summary: Keshav asks Jyotsna to leave the house but Aa stops them. Tau realizes that his perspective towards Gujaratis isn't right when he overhears Mahendra-Urmila's conversation.

episodesList.title: Abhishek-gayatri Plan to Take Aa-jyotsna to Dwarka
episodesList.summary: Gayatri- Abhishek go to Mahendras shop, they see the brochure of Dwarka & decide to go to Dwarka for their honeymoon. Keshav informs Aa that Abhishek & Gayatri have changed their honeymoon destination and that they were going to Dwarka. Aa is upset. Gayatri calls & convinces Aa. Mahendra convinces Aa to go for an outing to Mahabaleshwar. Bharti breaks this news to Jyotsna and she gets angry as Aa had not told her about it. Later Aa comes to convince Jyotsna and generally irritates her & tells her that he was going with Mahendra to Mahabaleshwar. Abhishek tells Gayatri that Aa has told Jyotsna that he wasn't taking her to Mahabaleshwar. Theres an emotional conversation between the two where Abhishek tells Gayatri that his mom never went out for any outing. Gayatri asks Abhishek why cant we take Jyotsna and Aa to Dwarka.

episodesList.title: Rasila Wants Her Son Back From Aa
episodesList.summary: Aa is pulling Jyotsna's leg and says that he would meet Rasila. Jyotsna gets angry. We see Rasila searching for Aa's number in an old telephone diary and says it is time to ask Aa to return her son back.

episodesList.title: Aa Gets Rasila's Call
episodesList.summary: Urmila finally manages to convince Jyotsna for Mahabaleshwar trip. Aa receives call from Rasila who asks him for her son. Aa decides to go to Dwarka so that he could avoid Rasila. Keshav tells Prabhakar that he would be going to Dwarka with Aa. Prabhakar says he too want to come but Keshav says that it was a golden opportunity for him to take charge of the shop and that he shouldn't leave it.

episodesList.title: Family Honeymoon Trip
episodesList.summary: Everyone has reached Dwarka. All are excited except Aa who is disturbed and worried as Rasila is constantly calling him & asking him about her son.

episodesList.title: Abhishek is Not Aa's Son
episodesList.summary: Rasila meets all the three ladies. Aa gets to know that Rasila has come to Dharamshala and he leaves from there with everyone. Rasila chases them and she happens to see Keshav and assumes that Keshav is her son. Aa confesses to Mahendra that he wasn't having any affair with Rasila and that her son was with him. Keshav will take Aa's phone and hears Rasila and he misinterprets that he is Rasila's son.

episodesList.title: Aa Can't Part With Abhishek
episodesList.summary: Gayatri and Abhishek want to spend some time together but Jivla is not allowing them and follows them everywhere. Abhishek & Gayatri are irritated. Mahendra is apologetic when he hears the truth & he advises Aa to tell Rasila that he cant part with Abhishek.

episodesList.title: Aa's Extramarital Affair
episodesList.summary: Prabhakar gets robbed. An amount of 5 lakhs is swiped from his account. Jyotsna & Urmila suspect that Aa is having an affair. Aa assures Jyotsna that he would reveal the truth to her.

episodesList.title: Pita Prem
episodesList.summary: Finally, after a long and twisted turn of events, Rasila meets her son, Abhishek at the temple, but Aa is unhappy. He expresses his reluctance to handover his son to Rasila to Mahendra. Fortunately for him, everyone else also shares his opinions. Therefore, they make a run for if, with Rasila and cops after them.

episodesList.title: Aa's Rasila Relationship
episodesList.summary: Mahendra saves Aa and associates his name with Rasila. Rasila brings along an inspector and a chase ensues. Keshav tells everyone that he is an adopted son. Everyone leaves for Sasangir. Aa turns cold when he hears a lion roar while using the washroom.

episodesList.title: Aa Faces His Rasila Past
episodesList.summary: The chase ends when Aa and the family reach Sasangir. Rasila also follows them there. Though Aa starts dancing with the Africans to hide from Rasila, she sees this and becomes a part of the group. While dancing both Aa and Rasila come face to face with each other. How will they react?

episodesList.title: Aa is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Aa, Rasila, and others dance at the resort, disguised as African dancers. Aa and Rasila both are unaware of each others true identity. When Aa recognizes Rasila and tries to escape, Rasila stops him. A cornered Aa finally tells everyone the truth. Aa and family tell Rasila that Abhishek is her son. Rasila asks Aa to handover Abhishek to her at Dwarkadhish temple the following day. Everyone is taken aback.

episodesList.title: Aa Gets a 7 Day Deferment
episodesList.summary: Aa momentarily pacifies Rasila and requests her for a seven days time, before they can come to terms with the parting of his adopted son. The tension doesn't boil down when Rasila returns to Pune since Prabhakar breaks down in front of Nirmiti and Bharti, informing them of his mistake of sharing the OTP. Nirmiti calls Keshav for help.

episodesList.title: Familys Financial Trouble
episodesList.summary: While the family is busy arranging 5 lakhs, Ujwala comes up with the visiting card of a man who had offered a huge amount of money in exchange of Biscuit. Kids, in the hope of cracking a deal with the man, are coed when the man refuses to return their dog. On the other hand, Prabhakar's account is credited with 5 lakhs through an unknown source. Gayatri helps Abhishek bond with his mother and consoles Aa.

episodesList.title: Rasila Returns Biscuit
episodesList.summary: Rasila tells everyone that she hails from New Zealand and will take Abhishek and Gayatri with her. Urmila and Mahendra are sad, but Aa reasons that as Abhishek is Rasila's son, he and his wife must go with his mother. Gayatri informs Urmila and Mahendra that Biscuit is missing. Both call the man who had taken him, but he tells them that someone has already taken Biscuit from him. Rasila finally gets Biscuit and returns her to Urmila and Mahendra. Aa praises Rasila's good deed.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Leaves Aa's House
episodesList.summary: Aa asks Abhishek and Gayatri to leave at the earliest. He thinks that his children have been deprived of love, so he wishes to train them and shower them with affection. Abhishek is overcome with emotions. The next day Abhishek leaves for Rasila's house along with Gayatri. Rasila welcomes them and does a house warming. At night, Aa tries to cheer himself and others. Meanwhile, Rasila gifts a luxury car to Abhishek and Gayatri.

episodesList.title: Abhishek Leaves Rasila's Dinner
episodesList.summary: Abhishek skips Rasila dinner and goes to vaada to help Aa get rid of a rat. Rasila feels betrayed as Aa breaks his promise. Next Day, Keshav visits Rasila's Home. Keshav, Gayatri,  Rasila and Abhishek are going somewhere, when Abhishek notices Aa carrying two heavy bags in his hands.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Helps Aa
episodesList.summary: Abhishek wants to help Aa, but he remembers his promise and stays back. Understanding Abhishek's situation, Gayatri goes and helps Aa. Aa reaches home and sees that Amol is doing something absurd. Aa punishe's Amol but he suddenly remembers Abhishek. Meanwhile, the kids overhear Urmila and Mahendras plan. Urmila and Mahendra plot to do something to Aa's passport, so that it will be difficult for him to leave the country. The kids decide to help Aa and they come up with an idea.

episodesList.title: Kids Steal Abhishek's Passport
episodesList.summary: The kids plan and steal Abhishek's passport from Aa's drawer. Rasila, on the other hand, asks Aa for Abhishek's passport number. When Aa goes to look for it, he finds it missing. He creates a havoc and lifts the entire house on his head. Jyotsana takes a vow that Aa will not drink of eat in the vaada unless the passport is found. The kids get nervous with the situation. However, Urmila and Mahendra make manage to make Aa eat in their house. They assure the kids that they shouldn't worry, as they will keep feeding Aa and the passport will never be found.

episodesList.title: Urmila's Vow
episodesList.summary: Raseela visits Vaada and realises that Aa has lost Abhishek's Passport. She challenges Aa. She tells him that she will get a new passport immediately for Abhishek and after that she take him with her. Aa is upset with his encounter with Raseela. On the other hand, Urmila remembers that her vow is not yet fulfilled. She desires to carry it out before Abhishek and Gayatri leave for New Zealand.  She feels that Abhishek and Gayatri can't live together as a couple unless the vow is fulfilled. Meanwhile, Aa remembers their last years Valentine Celebration.

episodesList.title: The Police Suspect Abhishek
episodesList.summary: Aa has tears in his eyes when recollects Abhishek giving him a Valentine's card the previous year. On the other hand, Urmila and Mahendra reach Raseela's house to perform the vow so that Gayatri and Abhishek can live their life as a happy couple. At the same time, Police enters the house to arrest Abhishek under the suspicion of stealing Jyotsna's jewellery.

episodesList.title: Is Abhishek The Thief?
episodesList.summary: Jyotsna's jewellery is found in Abhishek's Bag. When they take him to Vaada, it is revealed that Abhishek has stolen his passport along with Jyotsnya's jewellery. Raseela is very disappointed with Abhishek. She goes into a suicidal mood. Aa somehow manages to pacify her. Aa makes Abhishek promise that he will listen to his mother. Later, Gayatri visit Mahadevpeth where she learns that Aa is facing problems because of Prabhakar and Amol.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Decides to Stay
episodesList.summary: Gayatri understands Aa, so she decides to stay back with him instead of going to New Zealand with Abhishek. Mahendra is not shocked by this. He supports Gayatri's decision and he tries to convince Urmila to stand by Gayatri. Mahendra feels proud of his daughter Gayatri, for staying back and supporting Aa. On the other hand, Raseela and Abhishek are shocked by Gayatri's decision, they try to change her mind but Gayatri is firm on her decision.

episodesList.title: Aa Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: The family bid a warm farewell to Abhishek. Later, as soon as Abhishek leaves for the airport, Aa meets with an accident and the news of Aa's accident goes viral. Raseela, Abhishek and Keshav on their way to Mumbai airport make a stop to have lunch where Raseela abruptly makes a decision to return to Pune. Abhishek and Keshav are surprised by Raseela's decision. Raseela visits the hospital along with Abhishek and tells everyone that she saw the news of Anaa's accident on the TV.

episodesList.title: Aa Goes Blind
episodesList.summary: Aa has lost his sight due to the accident. Abhishek convinces the kids of the family not to let Aa know that he is back. Later, when Aa returns home, he behaves as if he can see everything. However, Mahendra notices him acting weirdly. He doubts whether Aa can really see. Meanwhile, Jyotsna tells Urmila that she is concerned about her familys financial crisis. Urmila calms her down and says that she has an idea. Later at night, Aa trips over a mousetrap. Anmol shouts and wakes up all. When Abhishek calls out Aa's name, everybody holds their breath. Will Aa realize that Abhishek is back?

episodesList.title: Gayatri Gets Surprised
episodesList.summary: Urmila explains to Aa that Prabhakar is talking to him in Abhishek's voice. Therefore next day, Aa calls a man in womans voice, this causes a ruckus in the shop. Mahadev arrives at the shop to handle the situation. Mahadev and Keshav doubt that something is wrong with Aa.  Meanwhile, Urmila takes Jyotsna with her to a certain location. When they both return, they have two large bags of fresh, good quality vegetables. Gayatri is surprised by the vegetables, as their financial crisis is not yet over.

episodesList.title: What Makes Keshav Suspicious?
episodesList.summary: Kids and Amol force Aa to play with them. Aa is in a fix, but he somehow persuades everyone to play carrom. Meanwhile, Abhishek accidentally drops in front of Aa, but he immediately removes the fuse of the house. Kids warn Aa about the dark, and Aa immediately starts narrating a story. Soon, Gayatri fixes the fuse. On the other hand, Keshav and Prabhakar finds Aa narrating the story to the kids who are fast asleep. Keshav grows suspicious. What will Keshav do?

episodesList.title: Keshav Tricks Aa
episodesList.summary: Mahendra calls Aa to his shop. He then lies to him that he has bought a she-dog as Biscuits companion. Aa asks Mahendra to make the dog bark. Urmila makes sound of barking. Aa then declares that the dog will be a perfect partner for Biscuit. Now Mahendra and Urmila are sure that Aa is unable to see. Mahendra instructs Urmila to keep it a secret. Later, Keshav cheats Aa into getting him sign the power-of-attorney by saying that they are medi-claim paper. He calls someone and discusses the same. However, Mahendra overhears him. What will Mahendra do?

episodesList.title: Anna Plays Blind
episodesList.summary: When Aa hears that Abhishek has not gone to New Zealand, he tells everyone that he is not able to see anything.

episodesList.title: Keshav Sells The Shop
episodesList.summary: Keshav sells the Gokhale Bandhu shop to Diwan for two crore rupees, while someone secretly records the whole deal.

episodesList.title: Aa Calls The Police
episodesList.summary: Aa continues to pretend he's blind, and sees Keshav getting home a bag full of money. Mahendra and Abhishek are after Keshav, trying to snatch the bag from him. Amidst all the confusion, the bag opens and the money falls out. Aa enters the room and sees the money lying on the floor. But, Keshav and gang lie to him, not knowing that he can see it clearly. Later, Aa informs police. What is going on in Aa's mind?

episodesList.title: Bharti Doubts a Blind Anna
episodesList.summary: As Mahendra takes away all the money with him, the Police dont find anything in Keshavs bag. Aa feels disturbed but hides his anxiety. The next day, Bharti witnesses Aa doing a few things, which turns her doubtful about his blindness. Later, she also catches him, while he's taking a newspaper from the table. What will Aa explain to Bharti now?

episodesList.title: Anna Caught Red-handed
episodesList.summary: Bharti catches Aa red-handed while he's secretly reading a newspaper. Aa confesses the truth to Bharti regarding his fake blindness. He also tells Bharti about his actual mission, which is to expose Mahendra and Abhishek. Bharti supports Aa, and joins his team.

episodesList.title: Will Anna Reach On Time?
episodesList.summary: While Aa and Bharti are stuck in the elevator, Deewan reaches to take over Gokhale's shop. Abhishek then calls Mahendra and informs him about the situation. Mahendra immediately rushes. Will Deewan be able to take over Gokhale's shop?

episodesList.title: Gokhale Bandhu Sold?
episodesList.summary: Aa and Bharti reach at the nick of time and expose Deewan. Meanwhile, Mahendra explains all the reasons behind this plan. He shows the proof, sorting out the misunderstandings. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Who is This Mystery Girl?
episodesList.summary: Aa and family celebrate Holi together. There, Abhishek and Gayatri challenge each other with a bhakharwadi competition. Later, Abhishek wins the challenge, as a girl comes and buys all the bhakharwadis. Who is this mystery girl?

episodesList.title: Anna Arrested
episodesList.summary: Aa makes fun of Mahendra and his bhakarwadi. This hurts Mahendra deeply. Suddenly and out of nowhere, the police arrive and arrest Aa. The police claim that a complaint has been lodged against Aa. The complaint states that a few people have been admitted to hospitals due to food poisoning caused after consuming the bhakarwadi from Aa's shop. Mahendra assures the Gokhale family that he would think of a way out.

episodesList.title: Mysterious Sage
episodesList.summary: A sage comes and declares that Aa must face hardships because Sage Khadang Bhushan is upset with him. Bharti starts chanting the sages name in order to save Aa and at the same time, a man named Bhausaheb helps release Aa. Everybody reaches home and the unknown man reveals that he too is a follower of Sage Khadang Bhushan.

episodesList.title: Anna's Never Ending Troubles
episodesList.summary: The follower of Sage Khadang Bhushan asks Bharti to recite the mantras of Khadang Bhushan in order to get Aa out of trouble. Bharti chants the mantra and Bhausaheb gets Aa out of jail on bail. On reaching home, they come to know that Bhausaheb is also a follower of Sage Khadang Bhushan. This is something that Aa dislikes.

episodesList.title: Will Anna Surrender Himself?
episodesList.summary: When it looks like life has returned to normal, the police inspector informs Aa about another death by his Bhakarwadi. He asks Aa to surrender. Meanwhile, accepting the advice of a Khadang Bhushan follower, Bharti decides to dig out a Khadang Bhushan idol. Later, a post-mortem report mistake comes to light, proving Aa's iocence. By then, the idol is dug out.

episodesList.title: Is Anna Being Framed?
episodesList.summary: People confess to Aa that they filed complaints against him because they were asked to do so. Mahendra calls Bhausaheb to find out about Aa's release. Bhausaheb says that he thinks there is some invisible power supporting Aa. When Aa reaches home with the family many people demand that a temple be built in the place where the idol was found. Aa drives them out of the house. But they protest nevertheless.

episodesList.title: Anna's Concern For Protestants
episodesList.summary: Aa feels concerned about the people protesting outside his house. They have been there the whole day. But Keshav asks Aa to ignore them. Later in the night, Urmila, Bharati and Gayatri distribute food to the protestants.

episodesList.title: Bharti's Kindness
episodesList.summary: Aa appreciates Bhartis kindness towards the protesting people. But in the morning the house is in a mess. Bharti is also busy taking care of the people rather than looking after Aa. Meanwhile, Radha tells Abhishek to meet her without Gayatri's knowledge.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Refuses Radha's Offer
episodesList.summary: Bharti is about to prepare lemon water for Aa but when she slices a lemon, the lemon bleeds. And same with other vegetables. Bharti is scared. Nimrit tells Bharti that Bharti is having an illusion and demonstrates cutting a vegetable to prove her statement. Nimrit is stued and confused on seeing the red juice seeping out. On the other hand, the Gokhale family is unable to find a lawyer who can fight Aa's case. Gayatri makes Abhishek call Radha to find out what Radha wants. Abhishek does so and Radha tells him that she wants to meet both Gayatri and Abhishek. Radha meets them and says that she has a way of saving the house but she would like something in return. Gayatri assumes what Radha wants and sends Radha away based on her assumption. Abhishek tells Gayatri that they should have let Radha speak about what she wanted before refusing her offer right away. But Gayatri's assumption is correct and it is later discovered that Radha wants Abhishek in order to save the house.

episodesList.title: Gayatri Signs The Papers
episodesList.summary: Gayatri signs the divorce papers in exchange for the house. In the meanwhile, Bharti and Prabhakar join the protestors. Will Aa be at peace with what is going on?

episodesList.title: Radha and Bhau Set a Trap
episodesList.summary: Gayatri falls into Radhas trap as she signs the papers. It is revealed that Radha is the daughter of Bhau and she has deceived Gayatri and made her sign the papers to sell the house. Next morning, Mahendra receives a call from the insurance company claiming that the insurance amount had to be transferred to Gayatri's bank account. Mahendra gives them the account number. Little does he know that it was Radha who had called. Radha and Bhau succeed in depositing money into Gayatri's account. Gayatri straight falls into a trap with a false evidence. The following morning, Radha and Bhau reach the house and claim that Gayatri has agreed to sell the house. When Mahendra tells them that they are not authorised to do so, Radha and Bhau threaten to charge the family under deception charges. Aa is furious when Mahendra suggests him to disown Gayatri as thats the only way out of the mess.

episodesList.title: The Fight Continues
episodesList.summary: Gokhales and Thakkars, both are living a lie for the sake of Krish, Abhishek and Gayatri's seven-year-old son. However, when Krish is out of the house, both families return to their original self and continue to fight among each other. And one of those fights is about Krish's seventh birthday. Stay tuned to know who wins this fight.

episodesList.title: The Happiest Student
episodesList.summary: Gokhales and Thakkars, both feel proud of Krish for receiving the happiest student award, but even then, they can't keep their differences aside. However, the water goes over the bridge when Thakkars accidentally put their wardrobe in front of Gokhales' house. With Krish returning from school at the same time, how will his family avoid the fight? Let's find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Intention
episodesList.summary: Mahendra visits Anna's room with some hidden intention. Meanwhile not everything is going well at Krish's end. What is Mahendra's secret plan? What is wrong with Krish? This episode will rest all your doubts. Watch now!

episodesList.title: The Cake Chronicle
episodesList.summary: Anna and Keshav discuss a plan for Krish's cake cutting. But there is no grain of truth in it. On the other hand, Mahendra and Anna end up challenging each other. Why is a fake cake cutting being planned? What is the challenge all about? Watch this thrilling episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Many Plans, One Birthday!
episodesList.summary: Finally it's just a day to Krish's birthday. The birthday boy is excited and so are a lot of other people. Different people make different plans for the cake cutting. Whose plan will succeed? This episode will tell you.

episodesList.title: Fake Caller
episodesList.summary: Anna mistakes the caller on the phone and divulges vital information to him. Meanwhile Krishna is nowhere to be found. What does Anna divulge? Where does Krishna go missing? Watch this episode to clear your confusion.

episodesList.title: Hide and Seek
episodesList.summary: In the process of finding the whereabouts of Krishna, different teams search in different places. Ultimately Krishna arrives for the cake cutting. He cuts two separate cakes. But as the cake cutting takes place, something unpleasant happens which leaves a bitter taste in Anna's mouth. What happens to cause Anna distress? Let the cake cutting ceremony in this episode reveal to you.

episodesList.title: Disturbance
episodesList.summary: Anna has full proof plans of ensuring that Urmila and Mahendra get irritated and disturbed. He stages a solid prank with the help of Prabhakar and Mandar. Meanwhile, Sudhakar encounters a significant crisis in his life and seeks Anna's help. What is Anna's disturbance plan? Will Anna lend help to Sudhakar? Watch all this and more, in this episode.

episodesList.title: The S Couple
episodesList.summary: There is a specific reason why Sumeet and Sangeeta decide to visit Anna's house. An important aspect is that their son is a classmate of Krishna and Krishna should be deceived to believe that all is well with his friend's parents. Meanwhile, Bharti's Yoga stunts prove to be too costly for Anna. What is wrong with Sumeet and Sangeeta? What happens when Bharti starts Yoga? Catch the events in this episode.

episodesList.title: Fight No More
episodesList.summary: Anna mocks a fight with his family to give Sumeet and Sangeeta an insight into life after divorce. Mahendra and Urmila agree to support Anna in times of crisis. On the other hand, Gokhale and Thakkar start behaving extra sweetly, which raises suspicion in Sumeet and Sangeeta's minds. Keshav and Urmila soon get into an argument totally unaware of Krishna's presence. Just as Prabhakar arrives they start acting normal, but Krishna tells him about their tiff, and Prabhakar warns both Keshav and Urmila. Will Anna be able to prevent the divorce that he is foreseeing? Will Keshav and Urmila be able to sort out their differences? Watch Anna's next move in this episode.

episodesList.title: Plane Fight
episodesList.summary: Anna and Urmila and Mahendra have sworn not to fight in front of Sumit and Sangita. So, they, and  come up with an idea to fight using paper planes. However, Sumit and Sangita become suspicious of the change between the two families. Later that day, Anna and Mahendra and Urmila are throwing paper planes at each other. Will they make Sumit and Sangita suspicious? What will happen if Sumit and Sangita catch them fighting? Tune in to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: A Misfired Plan
episodesList.summary: Anna and Mahendra are fighting with each other using paper planes. But Amol uses the very same paper planes to make Krish's school project. Parallelly, Sumit and Sangeeta are suspicious about the paper planes. So, to divert their attention, Urmila tells them that she has thrown all the paper planes in the dustbin. But if Amol has used the paper planes for the school project, will Sangita and Sumit find anything in the dustbin? Tune in to find out how the plan unfolds, in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Conniving Couple
episodesList.summary: Sumit and Sangita have a laid a trap for Abhishek and Gayatri. The cunning couple is going to make them both spill the beans and they even take the necessary steps towards actualising their plan. But in the nick of time, the situation is turned around as Anna and Mahendra intervene. What is Sangita and Sumit's plan? How do Anna and Mahendra turn it around? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Secret is Guarded
episodesList.summary: On one hand, everyone is worried that Abhishek and Gayatri might spill the beans due to the truth syrup. And on the other hand, while discussing a solution to this problem, Anna and Urmila get into a heated argument. Not only Sumit and Sangita but even Krish witnesses their spat. How will the families salvage this situation? Will Abhishek and Gayatri reveal the truth to Krish? Watch this and more, only in this episode of Bhakarwadi.

episodesList.title: Troublemakers are Gone
episodesList.summary: Chirag bets that Urmila can make Sumit and Sangita leave the house. After Anna's approval, Urmila talks to the couple and they prepare to leave the house. What did Urmila tell Sumit and Sangita? Have they really left the house? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Supreme Happiness
episodesList.summary: Though Sumit and Sangita planned to leave the house as per Urmila's words, something else is brewing in their minds. They plant a camera in Abhishek and Gayatri's room and plan on showing the footage to the family. However, their plan gets derailed when Krish gets home and the laptop breaks. Does this mean that they will finally exit the house and Urmila will win the bet? Will Urmila convince Krish to stay? See what happens next in this entertaining episode of Bhakharwadi.

episodesList.title: Uncovering The Truth
episodesList.summary: Anna has barricaded Krish from meeting Mahendra and Urmila. A curious Krish, wonders why. Mandar receives the instructions to keep an eye on Krish. But little does Mandar know that Krish can easily get his way. He smartly distracts him, so that he can find things out. What happens when Krish gets his hands on the recording? Will the dispute between the families intensify? Tune in to see how Krish deals with the truth and what lies ahead in the fate of both the families.

episodesList.title: Panic Strikes
episodesList.summary: Another trouble strikes. Krish finds the recordings and discovers the truth which the families were worried about. Disappointed by what he has found, he locks himself up in the room and refuses to come out. When the members break into the door, they are stunned to see that Krish is missing. Worry trickles down their bones and they begin to scout for Krish everywhere. What happened to Krish? Where did he go? Is he safe? Find out what unfolds next in this episode.

episodesList.title: Bridging The Gap
episodesList.summary: Krish had left his house and everyone was extremely concerned about his whereabouts. While some were going helter-skelter looking for him, thoughts of him being kidnapped cropped up as well. But Krish arrives soon and brings along a lawyer with him. He demands separation from both the families. This leaves them speechless. Why did Krish take such a drastic step? What are his intentions behind seeking the separation? Will the families give into his demand? Find out what happens in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Court is In Session
episodesList.summary: Krish wants to reunite the families. He uses reverse psychology saying that he wants to separate from both the families. Owing to which, a court is set up in wada, and the two families are pitted against each other to prove their righteousness. A confession surfaces while the court is in session. Will this bridge the gap between the Thakkars and Gokhales? Or will Krish's plan not bear a reward? Watch this entertaining episode to find out what happens.

episodesList.title: Makeshift Court
episodesList.summary: The bungalow has been converted into a temporary court and two judges have been appointed to proceed with the case at hand. While one of the judges is a Gujarati, his opponent is a Marathi. What happens as the judges take the case ahead and various witnesses are called upon? Watch this episode to view the courtroom scene.

episodesList.title: Lack Of Proof
episodesList.summary: With Urmila backing Anna's innocence, the latter hits a dead end, as he is unable to think of any concrete event, which can be used as a proof against Mahendra. Gayatri further justifies all of Mahendra's deeds, which actually were in Anna's favor. Without any proof, will Mahendra be proven guilty? Watch this episode as Anna struggles to get his points proven.

episodesList.title: Oblivious Mahendra
