episodesList.title: Jr. NTR Welcomes The Contestants
episodesList.summary: Young heart-throb, Jr. NTR welcomes each of fourteen contestants. He then takes the viewers on a tour inside the much-talked about Bigg Boss House.

episodesList.title: New Captain, New Drama
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss nominates a house captain. Later, Bigg Boss asks the housemates to nominate two people out of the show, and gives the inmates a task to make a confession about themselves.

episodesList.title: Aadarsh, Dhanraj's Shocking Prank
episodesList.summary: The contestants get their personal belongings and later, Aadarsh and Dhanraj pull off a shocking prank!

episodesList.title: A Secret Task For Sameer
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks Sameer to secretly prevent some contestants' luggage from reaching them. Meanwhile, Hari Teja, Adarsh and Prince get into an argument.

episodesList.title: Will Mumaith Perform?
episodesList.summary: Sampoornesh is removed from the captaincy and Mumaith is given the responsibility of learning the language. Bigg Boss awaits Mumaith's performance!

episodesList.title: No Smoking!
episodesList.summary: Mumaith Khan and Kalpana compete in a water sport task. Cigarettes are denied to the contestants as the rules of the smoking room were not followed. What will this lead to?

episodesList.title: Elimination Or Celebration?
episodesList.summary: Jr NTR is here again, but unfortunately, to eliminate a contestant! However, an elimination round turns into a celebration in the house.

episodesList.title: First Elimination!
episodesList.summary: After a week's stay in the house among all the craziness and fun, who will be the first one to bid adieu? Will it be Mahesh, Hari Teja or Jyothi?

episodesList.title: A Romantic Task!
episodesList.summary: The contestants give their eviction nominations for the week and perform a romantic task assigned by Bigg Boss!

episodesList.title: Sampoornesh Babu Exits The Show!
episodesList.summary: Hell breaks loose when an insane Sampoornesh Babu threatens the Big Boss team for his release! Why?

episodesList.title: Who Are The Lucky Three?
episodesList.summary: Only three contestants impress Bigg Boss in the assigned task. Later, Shiva Balaji complains about Kalpana's behaviour to Bigg Boss.

episodesList.title: Mumaith Khan Leaves!
episodesList.summary: The other contestants are stunned as Bigg Boss asks Mumaith Khan to leave the house. What is the reason behind her eviction?

episodesList.title: Race Gurram Task!
episodesList.summary: Big Boss assigns a dawdling task for Kalpana, Prince and Shiva Balaji. The contestant who manages to rock the horse till the last minute wins!

episodesList.title: Kalpana, The Villain Of The Show!
episodesList.summary: Jr. NTR unveils a sword throne and asks everyone to nominate the villain in the house. Kalpana gets nominated as the villain many times. Is she in danger?

episodesList.title: Wild Card Entry!
episodesList.summary: Madhu Priya exits the show and shares her experience. Brace yourself as Bigg Boss introduces a wild card entry in the house.

episodesList.title: Safe Zone Nominations
episodesList.summary: The contestants are amused to see Diksha Panth in the house. Bigg Boss asks the contestants to nominate two people to be in the safe zone.

episodesList.title: Mumaith's Never-ending Problems
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns a role-play task to the contestants. Mumaith Khan causes commotion and pulls a fight with Prince and Shiv Balaji, who end up fighting with each other. Why?

episodesList.title: Prince Kisses Diksha
episodesList.summary: Hari Teja is low after a quarrel with her team mates. Prince and his team win the luxury budget task. Later, he surprises a shy Diksha Panth with a kiss.

episodesList.title: Mumaith's Moving Gesture
episodesList.summary: Kalpana and Diksha fight over a past incident. Bigg Boss assigns a task to the contestants. Later, Mumaith does something which moves everyone to tears.

episodesList.title: Shut Up, Mumaith Khan!
episodesList.summary: Big Boss instructs Prince to plaster Mumaith Khan's mouth. Later, there is commotion in the house because of Mumaith.

episodesList.title: Raksha Bandhan Celebration!
episodesList.summary: The housemates celebrate Raksha Bandhan in the house and later, Jr NTR announces the names of the contestants who are saved from eviction!

episodesList.title: Rana Visits The Show
episodesList.summary: Rana visits the Bigg Boss house and unveils the name of the contestant walking out this week. Who will it be?

episodesList.title: Kalpana Under Pressure?
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the house is assigned a funny task and the house captain, Adarsh is asked to monitor them. Later, Bigg Boss asks the members to vote out two contestants with appropriate reasons. Will Kalpana get targetted again?

episodesList.title: Shiva Balaji Insults Adarsh
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams and sets up Simhasanas in the house. Later, Shiva Balaji insults Adarsh till the latter breaks down.

episodesList.title: Who Are The Worst Four?
episodesList.summary: Four contestants are punished for their poor performance in the last few tasks. Who are they and what's the punishment?

episodesList.title: Hello, Who's This?
episodesList.summary: Mahesh Kathi and Adarsh's misunderstanding results in an argument in the house. Later, everyone is excited as they get to speak with their family over the phone.

episodesList.title: Who Is The New Captain?
episodesList.summary: Hari Teja and Adarsh nominate themselves to get a phone call from their family members. Mumaith Khan, Karthika, Hari Teja and Shiva Balaji contest for the house captain post. Who will win the captaincy?

episodesList.title: Another Inmate Evicted
episodesList.summary: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. unveils the contestant's name whose journey comes to an end this week. Who is it?

episodesList.title: One In, One Out
episodesList.summary: Jr NTR announces the name of the evicted contestant and welcomes a new contestant as a wild card entry.

episodesList.title: Navdeep Begins His Stay
episodesList.summary: The newest member of the house, Navdeep begins his stay and the contestants give their eviction nominations for the week.

episodesList.title: Independence Day Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns the contestants to set up a hotel in the house and asks Navdeep and Diksha to be the guests. Later, the Independence Day celebrations begin.

episodesList.title: The Royal Luxury Budget Task
episodesList.summary: In this luxury budget task, the contestants take good care of Navdeep and Diksha. Later, Bigg Boss assigns a secret task to Prince. Meanwhile, Shiva Balaji is mighty annoyed. Why?

episodesList.title: Taapsee Pannu In The House
episodesList.summary: Star actress Taapsee Pannu visits the house to promote her latest movie, Anando Brahma and has some fun with the contestants.

episodesList.title: The Going Gets Tough
episodesList.summary: Mumaith fights for captaincy against Navdeep. Bigg Boss gives the contestants a tough task. While performing it some of the contestants hurt themselves and start bleeding.

episodesList.title: Dhanraj's Hilarious Mimicry
episodesList.summary: NTR Jr plays musical chair with the contestants. Dhanraj imitates the contestant's temperament in the house. Later, the host announces two contestants to be safe. Who are those two?

episodesList.title: Twists And Turns for Mumaith
episodesList.summary: NTR Jr asks Mumaith to pack her luggage and leave the house. Later, Bigg Boss plays a fair game and calls her back to the stage. What's the plan of action now?

episodesList.title: Surprising Evictions
episodesList.summary: The contestants vote out Shiva Balaji and Archana, who don't take it too kindly. Later, Bigg Boss assigns a selfie task to the contestants.

episodesList.title: New Task for Mumaith
episodesList.summary: The contestants are stunned when a few robbers steal almost everything from the house. Bigg Boss has a special task for Mumaith Khan.

episodesList.title: Mumaith Is Back!
episodesList.summary: Mumaith surprises everyone with a dramatic entry. She berates Dhanraj for his double game in front of everyone which drives him to tears.

episodesList.title: Archana Does A Pole Dance!
episodesList.summary: Hari Teja and Mumaith compete for captaincy. Archana performs a pole dance and amazes everyone. Later, 'Arjun Reddy' Vijay enters the house.

episodesList.title: Lord Ganesha In the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks Navdeep to dress up like Lord Ganesha and offer solutions to the contestants' problems. The contestants celebrate Ganesha Chathurthi.

episodesList.title: Double Danger
episodesList.summary: Jr NTR tells the contestants about the elimination twist. Contestants Dhanraj, Kathi Karthika and Archana are in the danger zone. Who gets eliminated?

episodesList.title: Second Eviction of the Week
episodesList.summary: Dhanraj visits the house again. Jr NTR announces the name of the second contestant to get evicted this week. Who will it be?

episodesList.title: Mumaith Turns Rogue
episodesList.summary: Friction builds amid contestants when they have to vote out two contestants. Mumaith's raspy behaviour annoys the housemates. Hari Teja denies safeguarding Mumaith from eliminations.

episodesList.title: Culture Fest in The House
episodesList.summary: In this cultural task, the contestants dress up and dance according to the cities in Andhra Pradesh. The housemates complete the task enthusiastically.

episodesList.title: The Hilarious Hari Katha
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns a task every time the contestants reach a particular destination on the map. Later, Hari Teja steals the show with a self-composed Hari Katha.

episodesList.title: Balloon War for Captaincy
episodesList.summary: The housemates get emotional as Bigg Boss reminds them of their childhood. Everyone is asked to fight for team captaincy with balloons. Will Mumaith crack it this time?

episodesList.title: Mumaith's Birthday Celebrations
episodesList.summary: The contestants compete in the CEAT challenge. Actor Sachin visits the house and plays truth or dare. Mumaith Khan celebrates her birthday!

episodesList.title: Suma Visits the House
episodesList.summary: Popular anchor Suma visits and says that she has come to inspect the Bigg Boss house. Later, Jr NTR announces the names of contestants who are free from eviction!

episodesList.title: Who Will Exit The Show?
episodesList.summary: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. makes the contestants play Dumb Charades in a different way before announcing the name of the exiting housemate. Mumaith, Archana, and Diksha fret when the name is announced!

episodesList.title: Ghost in Bigg Boss House?
episodesList.summary: Diksha wins the captaincy by a majority of votes. Later, the housemates are asked to vote out two people, but soon some paranormal activities take place in the house!

episodesList.title: Adarsh, Prince Lock Horns
episodesList.summary: During the luxury budget task, Adarsh and Prince have a clash. Later, Bigg Boss plays a video clip of the housemates, summing up their journey so far, in the house.

episodesList.title: Let's Get Back to School Life
episodesList.summary: Diksha and Hari Teja are asked to play the role of teachers while other housemates are asked to play the role of primary school students. A group of kids visit Big Boss house and spend quality time with the contestants.

episodesList.title: Allari Naresh Visits the House
episodesList.summary: Allari Naresh visits the show and auditions the contestants. Big Boss assigns numerous tasks to the housemates in order to win the captaincy. Who will win the captaincy for the second time?

episodesList.title: Time for Appraisals
episodesList.summary: Big Boss asks the contestants to do a self-analysis and stand on the ranking podium accordingly. How will the contestants appraise themselves?

episodesList.title: A Tricky Elimination
episodesList.summary: Jr NTR calls the contestants to the confession room and asks them to choose the person they want to eliminate. What will be the result?

episodesList.title: A Surprising Eviction
episodesList.summary: Jr NTR organises a Kabaddi game in the house with some interesting new rules. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who will it be?

episodesList.title: Diksha Is in Trouble
episodesList.summary: All the contestants nominate Diksha to exit the show. Later, Dhanraj, Mahesh Kathi, Karthika and Sampoornesh Babu surprise the contestants.

episodesList.title: A Big Surprise for Adarsh!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss plays the freeze and unfreeze game with the contestants. Shiva gets emotional as his wife visits him. Later, a big surprise awaits Adarsh in the confession room.

episodesList.title: Archana Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss continues the freeze and unfreeze game and gives pleasant surprises to Archana, Hari Teja and Navdeep! Later, someone steals their food.

episodesList.title: Diksha, Archana Lock Horns
episodesList.summary: Shiv Balaji and the housemates enjoy the fight between Diksha and Archana over a petty issue. Celebrity Sunil visits the house and promotes his upcoming movie, Ungarala Rambabu.

episodesList.title: Diksha's Joy is Short-lived
episodesList.summary: Big Boss asks everyone to reveal their favourite spot in the house with reasons. Diksha gets close to Archana until she eavesdrops on her!

episodesList.title: N. T. Rama Rao Jr. in the House
episodesList.summary: The housemates are in for a surprise as NTR Jr. himself visits the house along with Niveth Thomas, Raashi Khanna and his brother, Nandamuri Kalyan Ram to promote his most-awaited movie, Jai Lava Kusa!

episodesList.title: Pretty Stiff Competition
episodesList.summary: NTR Jr. takes leave after whipping up some delicious Mutton Biryani for the contestants. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Will it be Diksha or Archana?

episodesList.title: Last Week in the House
episodesList.summary: As the housemates begin the final week of the season, Bigg Boss asks them to request the audience to vote for them. Will they impress the audience?

episodesList.title: An Unusual Task
episodesList.summary: Every individual pays a visit to the play area as and when Bigg Boss calls out their name. While they are jittery as they enter the play area, as they exit they are all emotional. Why?

episodesList.title: Astrologer in the House
episodesList.summary: Captain Archana becomes the center of attraction as Bigg Boss assigns a task to the male contestants. Later, an astrologer predicts the future of the contestants. How does their future look?

episodesList.title: Time for a Make-over
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks the 5 finalists to take part in the next challenge. Later, they get a make-over from top stylists.

episodesList.title: The Ultimate Face-off
episodesList.summary: The finalists are ecstatic after getting a make-over. Later, they are in for a surprise as one by one the eliminated contestants make a re-entry.

episodesList.title: Last Day in the House
episodesList.summary: All participants take leave after wishing the finalists. The public interacts with the finalists over a video call. Later, each finalist has a surprise in the confession room.

episodesList.title: And The Winner Is
episodesList.summary: Tarak begins the finale episode with a bang. Devi Sri Prasad spices up the entertainment quotient, followed by peppy performances by Prince, Diksha, Madhupriya and others. After a roller coaster 70-days in the house, who will walk out as the winner?

episodesList.title: Nani Kickstarts Bigg Boss 2
episodesList.summary: Natural star Nani kicks off Season 2 with 16 interesting housemates, all set to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss house for the next 106 days. And guess what, Day Zero has already seen a couple of nominations.

episodesList.title: Day 1 in the House
episodesList.summary: Sanjana is mighty disappointed at being forced to stay in the jail. The inmates prefer to get Nutan out of the jail. Deepthi Sunaina, Ganesh and Sanjana get nominated as the inmates gear up for the first elimination. Who will Syamala and Amit nominate?

episodesList.title: Day 2 in the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg boss releases Sanjana from the jail. A luxury budget task 'Cheppandi Prabhu' is assigned to the inmates. Sanjana's team plays the part of the owners. Soon a situation of contention sets in within her team over assigning tasks to the servants' team.

episodesList.title: Day 3 in the House
episodesList.summary: Team Sevakalu put up a unique fashion show and walk the ramp, cross-dressing in style. Bigg Boss takes the teams by surprise by changing the rules of the task. Kireeti gets emotional and sheds tears in solitude. Why?

episodesList.title: Day 4 in the House
episodesList.summary: Just five days into the house, the contestants start having serious disagreements with each other. With a secret mission that promises captaincy, which contestant will take up the task?

episodesList.title: Day 5 in the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss initiates the battle for captaincy and asks the housemates to select four names. They are given a task to entertain the housemates with some quirky props provided. Who will seize the opportunity to become 'captain'?

episodesList.title: Day 6 in the House
episodesList.summary: Nani asks each of the contestants to pick up an envelope and read out the dialogues inside them to the most suitable person in the house. He berates Samrat's captaincy in front of the housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 7 in the House
episodesList.summary: The contestants get emotional, celebrating Father's Day in the house. Nutan and Sanjana are on the brink of getting eliminated while a new contestant is all set to enter the house.

episodesList.title: Day 8 in the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss instructs the contestants to pair up and nominate others for elimination. The new member, Nandini introduces herself and tries to blend in with the housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 9 in the House
episodesList.summary: The contestants gear up to perform the new task announced in the house. Kaushal and Geetha have an ugly argument while the contestants compete with each other in the task.

episodesList.title: Day 10 in the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss warns the captain, Samrat for violating the rules of the house. Hell breaks loose as Geetha and Tanish get into an intense argument. Nutan and Deepthi serve jail time.

episodesList.title: Day 11 in the House
episodesList.summary: Famed comedians, Vennela Kishore and Srinivas Reddy entertain the housemates and promote their upcoming movie, Jamba Lakidi Pamba. However, the joy is short-lived as Bigg Boss ruthlessly punishes the housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 12 in the House
episodesList.summary: From organizing their beds to following food netiquettes, the contestants start getting bugged with each other's mannerisms and decide to voice their concern. With the second captaincy up for grabs, who will seize the opportunity?

episodesList.title: Day 13 in the House
episodesList.summary: Tanish and Deepthi Sunaina are not in host, Nani's good books. One of the inmates vents out his frustration at being targeted. Also, find out which contestants are safe from elimination this week?

episodesList.title: Day 14 in the House
episodesList.summary: The housemates enjoy a fun activity and reveal their buddies in the Bigg Boss house. But will the threat of elimination burst their bubble of assumptions?

episodesList.title: Day 15 in the House
episodesList.summary: After Nutan Naidu's elimination, the contestants start patching their differences, hoping to turn over a new leaf. However, their plans go awry when a mistake leads to an unexpected open elimination.

episodesList.title: Day 16 in the House
episodesList.summary: Rumble arises in the house as Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams to perform a production task. Samrat causes damage to the Bigg Boss property while Bhanu breaks into tears.

episodesList.title: Day 17 in the House
episodesList.summary: Kireeti and Kaushal bribe their workers, while Tejaswi has a game plan to earn extra income. Bigg Boss unveils the winner of the luxury budget task. Who are the winners?

episodesList.title: Day 18 in the House
episodesList.summary: Mayhem breaks out as Tejaswi and Syamala get into an ugly fight. Tears well up in the house as the contestants talk about love and sacrifice.

episodesList.title: Day 19: Ready, Steady, Chomp!
episodesList.summary: With the captaincy on the line, Ganesh, Roll Rida and Kireeti prepare to wolf down huge crates of Biryani to win the challenge. Who will chomp to be the champ?

episodesList.title: Day 20: Excitement Amidst the Tension
episodesList.summary: Nani enquires Tejaswi about her emotional breakdowns and plays a small game of 'Aeyara Dharuvu' with the contestants. With five housemates in the danger zone this week, who will be saved by the audience?

episodesList.title: Day 21: Nani Erupts Tension in the House
episodesList.summary: Nani and the housemates play an interesting 'Yes or No' game before erasing a contestant's name from the roster of the Bigg Boss House. Who bids goodbye tonight?

episodesList.title: Day 22: Mayhem In Bigg Boss House
episodesList.summary: Amit and Tanish take the contestants on an emotional rollercoaster ride by executing a secret task. The housemates pair up and nominate two contestants for the elimination. Who will get blacklisted this week?

episodesList.title: Day 23: In Love And War
episodesList.summary: Love is in the air as the Bigg Boss house turns into a lover's nest. Witness the catfight as the ladies in the house wage a war against each other.

episodesList.title: Day 24: Love And Its Restrictions
episodesList.summary: With the Lovers Hostel task bringing out the inner romantic in everyone, the couples go all out to convey their love to their significant other. Tune in to find out what hilarious antics the housemates pull to achieve their goal.

episodesList.title: Day 25: Sai Dharam Tej in the House
episodesList.summary: Tejaswi is on cloud nine as Sai Dharam Tej and Anupama join the housemates and celebrate her birthday. The guests talk to the housemates about their upcoming movie.

episodesList.title: Day 26: Royal Rumble in the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss penalizes Samrat for his actions after the housemates get into a nasty fight, contesting for captaincy. While Nandini receives a surprise, Deepthi experiences turbulence.

episodesList.title: Day 27: Burying the Rumors
episodesList.summary: The week sees a lot of rumors and fabricated stories flying around the Bigg Boss house. Join Nani, as he confronts the housemates and gets to the end of these baseless rumors.

episodesList.title: Day 28: An Emotional Elimination
episodesList.summary: Nani plays an intriguing game of 'who's the villain' with the contestants. Tune in to witness abrupt emotional outbursts as one among the nominated leaves the house.

episodesList.title: Day 29: Bigg Boss Unmasks the Contestants
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns a dicey telephone booth task to the contestants in order to shed light on their true colours. What repercussions will it have as friendship and bonds start to collapse?

episodesList.title: Day 30: Bhanu Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: The house turns black and white as Bigg Boss selects the angels and demons of the house. The housemates are aghast as Bhanu agonises in pain.

episodesList.title: Day 31: Angels Vs Demons
episodesList.summary: Friendship and love seems to be lost as misunderstandings peak amid the housemates. Roll Rida loses his cool and berates Bhanu and Tejaswi. Why?

episodesList.title: Day 32: Violence in the House
episodesList.summary: Violence explodes in the Bigg Boss house as the arguments between Bhanu, Tejaswi and Kaushal flare-up severely. Bigg Boss gives a special power to captain Kaushal.

episodesList.title: Day 33: The Campaign for Captaincy
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss initiates the new captaincy task where two contenders campaign around the house, hoping to bring a positive change in the contestants. Tune to find out who becomes the next captain.

episodesList.title: Day 34: Happy Birthday Ganesh
episodesList.summary: Nani confronts the housemates and tries to resolve the issues prevailing in the house. Ganesh is in for a surprise on the occasion of his birthday. Tune in to be a part of this celebration.

episodesList.title: Day 35: Nani, the Terminator!
episodesList.summary: The contestants play dumb charades with Nani while they stand on an ice base. Nani decides to break the ice and reveal the name of the eliminated contestant. Who will set their foot out of the house?

episodesList.title: Day 36: Amit Attacks Ganesh!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to pair up and tells Geetha to handcuff them. Amit loses his cool and strikes Ganesh's head for nominating him. Ganesh sheds tears and decides to exit the house.

episodesList.title: Day 37: The Bigg Boss Bioscope
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns the contestants with a task to shoot a blockbuster movie in the house. The excited thespians exercise their theatricals skills to win an oppurtunity to star in the big budget movie.

episodesList.title: Day 38: Lafangirigitta, Coming Soon
episodesList.summary: Deepthi Sunaina and Samrat dance their hearts out on an item song. Amit and his team furnish the scenes and finish shooting their blockbuster movie, Lafangirigitta.

episodesList.title: Day 39: Pradeep Machiraju in the House
episodesList.summary: The housemates are in a good mood as they watch the movie premiere of Lafangirigitta along with special guest, Pradeep Machiraju. Is he the new contender in the Bigg Boss house?

episodesList.title: Day 40: La Tomatina in Bigg Boss House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss initiates the next captaincy task, which involves the contenders juicing tomatoes with their feet. Tune in to see who will crush the most and win the thrilling competition.

episodesList.title: Day 41: Nani's Film Review
episodesList.summary: Nani discusses the Bigg Boss movie task with the excited housemates and recalls their candid experiences. With five housemates nominated for elimination, who will be saved?

episodesList.title: Day 42: Bidding an Emotional Farewell
episodesList.summary: Seeing the contestants tense about the elimination, Lakshmi Manchu enters the house to lighten their mood. With Samrat and Tejaswi in the danger zone, tune in to find out who gets eliminated.

episodesList.title: Day 43: Breaking News in Bigg Boss House
episodesList.summary: The contestants nominate two housemates and break eggs on their heads before breaking their hearts. A newbie sneaks into the house at midnight and makes herself at home. Who's the dame?

episodesList.title: Day 44: Welcome Aboard, Pooja
episodesList.summary: New hopes are revived in the house as a wild card contestant, Pooja embarks her journey. Sentiments flare-up as Bigg Boss connects the housemates to their closest family members through the telephone.

episodesList.title: Day 45: Pooja, the Wonder Woman
episodesList.summary: Pooja actively performs back-breaking tasks to recharge the 'chance to talk' meter. The emotional roller coaster continues as the contestants talk to their loved ones.

episodesList.title: Day 46: Panshop Romeos
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss initiates the 'Panshop' task where the housemates try to woo Pooja, the panshop owner. Later, things turns ugly after Geeta shoots sharps accusations at Babu.

episodesList.title: Day 47: A Flabbergasted Tanish
episodesList.summary: Kaushal, Samrat and Pooja dive into the pool and use their aquatic skills to win the Fogg body spray task. Amidst the tension, an unexpected event relating to Tanish puts a smile on everyone's face.

episodesList.title: Day 48: Nani Interrogates the Housemates
episodesList.summary: Nani tries to resolve the misunderstandings among the contestants and grills each of the housemates, one by one. At midnight, Tanish ignores the cameras and gets romantic with a housemate.

episodesList.title: Day 49: Break the Ice, Burst the Balloons
episodesList.summary: Water Balloons fly in all directions in the house while the nominated contestants get soaked. Nani announces the return of two ex-housemate back into the Bigg Boss house. Who are the special two?

episodesList.title: Day 50: Childhood Memories in the House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss strictly warns Kaushal and Deepthi before announcing the nominations. A tide of emotions ripple and resonate in the house as the contestants watch their childhood photos.

episodesList.title: Day 51: Pooja's Survival Tactics
episodesList.summary: The housemates are impressed as they witness Pooja's exuberant gripping skills while they perform, the Pirates vs Survivors task. Kaushal's notoriety causes problems in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 52: Chota Boss and the Accountant
episodesList.summary: Roll Rida and Pooja win the pirates task and are made the 'Chota Boss and his accountant' respectively. With the captaincy on the line, Bigg Boss gives one of the bottom three performers a chance to redeem themselves. Who will seize this opportunity?

episodesList.title: Day 53: The Surprise Re-Entry
episodesList.summary: Evicted contestants return to the house in an unexpected wild card entry and receive a hearty welcome. Tune in to witness a surprise captaincy task where the house turns into a dance floor.

episodesList.title: Day 54: Festivities with Vishwaroopam 2
episodesList.summary: The housemates can't believe their eyes as the demigod of the film industry, Kamal Haasan enters the house to promote his upcoming movie, Vishwaroopam 2.

episodesList.title: Day 55: Nani Asks Some Tough Questions
episodesList.summary: The housemates struggle to justify some of their actions as Nani poses some tough questions. Later, two nominated housemates move to the safe zone. Who are they?

episodesList.title: Day 56: Friendship Day Special
episodesList.summary: The housemates receive surprising video clips from their close friends on the occasion of Friendship Day. Bigg Boss has to unfriend one contestant from the house. Who will it be?

episodesList.title: Day 57: Mayhem in the House
episodesList.summary: The house descends into total chaos when the contestants are asked to race to the garden area in order to save themselves from the nominations. Deepthi and a few others suffer cuts and bruises during the frenzy.

episodesList.title: Day 58: Ladies Vs Gentlemen
episodesList.summary: Pooja gets into a severe argument with Kaushal after he violates the rules of the task. Battle of the genders begin as Men use their brain while women test their brawn.

episodesList.title: Day 59: Emotional Trip in the House
episodesList.summary: The ladies express sheer joy and celebrate their victory after winning the task while a couple of men have a psychological breakdown. The uproar is noticeable all around as the men and women have a war of words.

episodesList.title: Day 60: The Ladies Play Business
episodesList.summary: After Tanish hosts a quiz for the ladies, their business and management skills are put to test as they are asked to make money with the men.

episodesList.title: Day 61: Having Fun in the Rain
episodesList.summary: It starts raining in the Bigg Boss house and the contestants go wild with excitement and dance to their hearts' content. Tune in to see the housemates lose themselves in an array of emotions and party like there is no tomorrow.

episodesList.title: Day 62: Weekend with Nani
episodesList.summary: Nani interacts with each contestant and reviews their recent activities. The nominated contestants sit at the edge of their seats as Nani reveals the names of the protected housemates of the week.

episodesList.title: Day 63: It's a Pictionary Sunday
episodesList.summary: Nani and the contestants get busy with the board as they play Pictionary together. Later, everyone buckles up as Nani unveils the name of this week's eliminated housemate.

episodesList.title: Day 64: Nominate or Get Nominated
episodesList.summary: Thoughts and decisions flit and flare in the house as Bigg Boss restarts the unnerving task of the week, the nominations round. Find out who gets cornered this week!

episodesList.title: Day 65: Hardships in Bigg Boss House
episodesList.summary: Hearts break and friendships fade as the contestants play a frustrating task. Geetha and Deepthi Sunaina vent out their frustration and break into tears. Why?

episodesList.title: Day 66: Phone’y Business
episodesList.summary: With the 'call centre' task testing the contestants’ patience, the tension between the caller team and the receiver team reaches an all-time high. Tune in to find out what happens when the roles are reversed.

episodesList.title: Day 67: Housemates Celebrate Freedom
episodesList.summary: The contestants let bygones be bygones and celebrate Independence Day in the house together. Everyone jive in joy after performing brilliant skits depicting freedom.

episodesList.title: Day 68: Nutan Naidu Gets Hurt
episodesList.summary: The fight for captainship amid two contestants lead to horror as Nutan Naidu suffers a critical shoulder injury.

episodesList.title: Day 69: Rapid-fire Round with Nani
episodesList.summary: Nani decides to play a fun rapid-fire question game with the contestants. Tune in to be a part of the excitement and also find out who is saved from eliminations this week.

episodesList.title: Day 70: Geetha Govindam Special
episodesList.summary: Sunday's sizzling episode unfolds with Vijay Devarakonda's visit to the show. Deepthi Sunaina plays the puppet while Nani and Vijay steer her actions before the eliminations catch up.

episodesList.title: Day 71: Beware of Nominations
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss sheds light on the four contestants who get nominated this week. Later, the contestants are utterly baffled as they read the letters written by the viewer.

episodesList.title: Day 72: Radhakrishna Weds Madhulatha
episodesList.summary: Happiness and excitement spread through the house as the contestants take up the roles of family members during a wedding themed task. Tune in and be a part of Radhakrishna and Madhulatha's Mehendi ceremony.

episodesList.title: Day 73: A Spectacular Mehendi Function

episodesList.title: Day 87: Priyanka Scores The Least
episodesList.summary: The housemates face two more challenges to earn points for the 'Ticket to Finale'. Priyanka stands low on the score and picks Goutham to share her points, which upsets Amardeep.

episodesList.title: Day 88: The Race Resumes
episodesList.summary: In the Ticket to Finale series, Yawar scores the lowest today and decides to give away his points to Prashanth. With only four left in the race, who will win the finale astra?

episodesList.title: Day 89: Meet the First Finalist
episodesList.summary: Goutham's move reshapes the game, setting Prashanth, Amardeep, and Arjun against each other in an intense showdown. Who will rise above the others and become the first finalist?

episodesList.title: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: Get ready as King Nagarjuna returns in a grand style to unveil the contestants of an electrifying new season, packed with limitless drama and entertainment

episodesList.title: Day 1: A Task for the Third Chief
episodesList.summary: An array of arguments ensues as the contestants enter the house. Later, the housemates' physical strength is put to test to grab the spot of the third chief.

episodesList.title: Day 2: Nomination Sparks Fiery Fights
episodesList.summary: After a midnight altercation, the house meets in the morning to discuss tasks. Later, housemates clash with the chiefs during the season's first nomination.

episodesList.title: Day 3: Confession Room's First Visitor
episodesList.summary: Tension rises as the housemates engage in verbal war to nominate each other. Subsequently, BB summons Manikanta to the confession room.

episodesList.title: Day 4: Chiefs to Select Their Clan
episodesList.summary: Stronger the clan, powerful the chief! The three chiefs must choose a team for themselves, not only by convincing the housemates but also by performing a task.

episodesList.title: Day 5: Clash of Clans
episodesList.summary: Yashmi and Nainika’s clans battle through tasks for the opportunity to steal a member from Nikhil’s team. However, a surprise from BB leaves the winners in awe.

episodesList.title: Day 6: King Meets the Housemates
episodesList.summary: Excitement fills the air as Nagarjuna joins the housemates for Vinayaka Chavithi. Later, things become intense when he dives into individual performance reviews.

episodesList.title: Day 7: First Eviction
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna amps up the fun with new games and a paycheck twist. Later, the atmosphere sours when the housemates bid farewell to the first evictee.

episodesList.title: Day 8: A Colourful Nomination
episodesList.summary: It is that time of the week when the housemates have to take names for eviction. A verbal war begins as they pour the paint on the ones they nominate.

episodesList.title: Day 9: Food Lockdown?
episodesList.summary: Nomination spirals into personal attacks and painful disputes, leaving Nainika in tears. The drama intensifies as BB orders housemates to surrender all their ration.

episodesList.title: Day 10: Find and Run
episodesList.summary: The chiefs get a chance to shop for groceries, while their clans fight to defend the respective provisions. During the task, Sanchalak Yashmi faces pushback over her strict rules.

episodesList.title: Day 11: A Battle for the Budget
episodesList.summary: BB provides a bunch of opportunities for the housemates to win their budget. Each of the clans puts up a tough fight, but the Sanchalak's decision leads to chaos.

episodesList.title: Day 12: Special Gifts for the Housemates
episodesList.summary: After Prerana’s decision on the Socks task, the house engages in an energetic Truth or Dare game. The lively mood shifts to an emotional tone with an unexpected surprise from BB.

episodesList.title: Day 13: Shocks and A Surprise
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna assesses the chiefs and clans with a mix of praise and critique. Further, he brightens Shekar’s day with good news while delivering a shocker to the chiefs.

episodesList.title: Day 14: Elect Chiefs, Evict a Member
episodesList.summary: Sunday Funday begins with electing new chiefs and members, followed by Nagarjuna’s energetic games. The drama heightens as he drops a new twist in this week's eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 15: Dusty Nominations and Drama
episodesList.summary: Clans Kantara and Shakti delegate tasks and discuss last week's robbery. Yet another series of verbal war ensues as the nominations with dust showers begin.

episodesList.title: Day 16: Clans Kantara vs Shakti
episodesList.summary: After going over the nominations, housemates challenge each other for this week’s provisions. Which clan will grab the most points from the three intense tasks?

episodesList.title: Day 17: Prabhavathi Is Back!
episodesList.summary: Disputes arise over Sonia's decision on the balloon task. The next day, the chiefs tackle a new task while Prabhavathi 2.0 returns to the house to present a special assignment.

episodesList.title: Day 18: Procure Eggs to Prevail
episodesList.summary: The housemates compete fiercely to collect the maximum eggs. As the clans face a cooking restriction, the losing team is forced to eliminate one member.

episodesList.title: Day 19: Who Will be the Next Chief?
episodesList.summary: With the red egg, clan Shakti wins the advantage to choose one member for chief contendership. On the other hand, BB shows the main door to clan Kantara for disobeying the rules.

episodesList.title: Day 20: Season's First Red Card
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna confronts the housemates about their misbehaviour. He calls out everyone's faults and, in a dramatic twist, shows a red card to Abhai for his reckless comments.

episodesList.title: Day 21: Playtime with the King
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna ignites a wave of laughter this weekend with quirky games that keep the housemates on edge. As the thrill escalates, one contestant gets ready to exit.

episodesList.title: Day 22: Nomination in Full Swing!
episodesList.summary: As housemates reminisce about their time with the evictee, they gear up for this week’s nominations. With emotions flaring over past disputes, how will the process play out?

episodesList.title: Day 23: Welcome, New Chief
episodesList.summary: With emotions still high from the nominations, Yashmi and Sonia get into a brawl. Later, Nikhil competes with the housemates for a chance to choose clan Kantara's next chief.

episodesList.title: Day 24: A Bigg Twist
episodesList.summary: Seetha takes charge of her new Kantara clan. Soon after, the house descends into chaos when BB reveals the potential arrival of 12 wildcards. What challenges await the housemates?

episodesList.title: Day 25: Clan Shakti in Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Shakti clan wins the thrilling third task of 'Survival of the Fittest', and gains the power to eliminate a Kantara member. Manikanta revolts, sparking arguments within his clan.

episodesList.title: Day 26: Imitation Game
episodesList.summary: BB shares the perks of a golden band, which a member of the Shakti clan puts to work. Later, laughter echoes through the house as everyone engages in mimicry for the next task.

episodesList.title: Day 27: A Crowning Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Past conflicts resurface when Nagarjuna asks the housemates to classify each other as 'heroes' and 'zeroes.' One faces the danger zone, while another is saved from eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 28: Housemates Take a Call
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna hosts an exciting day filled with engaging games that keep the housemates fully entertained. However, he shocks them by granting the power to save or evict a nominee.

episodesList.title: Day 29: Nominations of Fire
episodesList.summary: The housemates present their nominations by throwing the pictures on fire, sparking arguments. Simultaneously, they are asked to vote out one of the chiefs. Who will that be?

episodesList.title: Day 30: Clan Shakti's Winning Streak
episodesList.summary: Survival of the Fittest series continues, and both the clans put up a tough fight in the challenges. As clan Shakti outperforms, clan Kantara is compelled to remove two members.

episodesList.title: Day 31: Pick Your Next Chief
episodesList.summary: Clan Shakti secures victory and selects a chief contender to block the wildcards. Emotional disputes surface when BB allows others to compete for the position.

episodesList.title: Day 32: Midweek Eviction
episodesList.summary: BB dissolves the clans and hosts a task for the contenders to become Mega Chief. As one of them takes charge, an unexpected midweek eviction leaves everyone shell-shocked.

episodesList.title: Day 33: A Token of Love
episodesList.summary: Manikanta’s amusing predictions as an astrologer earn applause in the house. A cloud of tension looms later when they face tough choices and special gifts in the confession room.

episodesList.title: Day 34: A Reality Check
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna highlights this week’s events and some shortcomings of the housemates. While Aditya bids farewell, the house anticipates arrival of the wildcards.

episodesList.title: Day 35: The Grand Reload Event
episodesList.summary: One more housemate bids goodbye. Tables turn as the King welcomes the wildcard entrants and splits all the housemates into two new clans. What surprises are about to be unveiled?

episodesList.title: Day 36: New Housemates, New Drama
episodesList.summary: A wave of excitement fills the house as OG clan welcomes the wildcards aka the Royal clan. However, their happiness is short-lived as nominations from the newbies stun everyone.

episodesList.title: Day 37: Mega Chief's Plea to BB
episodesList.summary: Royal Clan reaps benefits during nominations, putting others in a tough spot. Chaos ensues in the house after mega chief Nabeel slips up during his trip to the supermarket.

episodesList.title: Day 38: Welcome to BB Hotel
episodesList.summary: Avinash takes charge of the ladies, while Rohini coaches the boys in a hilarious challenge. Later, the OG clan excitedly rolls out the red carpet for the Royals to their new Hotel.

episodesList.title: Day 39: Staff vs the Guests
episodesList.summary: Staff swap roles and impress the guests for rewards, but a new physical challenge complicates matters. As time runs out and prize money increases, which clan will claim victory?

episodesList.title: Day 40: Royals Fight for Leadership
episodesList.summary: Six members of Royal clan face off against one member from OG to become the next Mega Chief. However, the tasks go awry as contenders engage in personal conflicts.

episodesList.title: Day 41: A Spotlight on Royal Clan
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna confronts the BB Hotel drama while handing out penalties and advice. As the royals’ gameplay faces intense scrutiny, the stakes for eviction predictions rise.

episodesList.title: Day 42: Dusshera Subhakankshalu
episodesList.summary: King commences the festivities with special games, guests and stunning performances. Amidst this, one housemate is granted a special wish, while another packs their bag to leave.

episodesList.title: Day 43: Killer Girls Get to Choose
episodesList.summary: Amidst the daily tiffs, BB kicks off the nominations for this week. Killer girls Hari Teja and Prerana get to approve the housemates' choices, ensuing intense confrontations.

episodesList.title: Day 44: The Game-Changer
episodesList.summary: Nominations go astray when housemates and nominees engage in hateful verbal wars. Adding to the chaos, BB grants the Royal clan a special power which flips the game.

episodesList.title: Day 45: Brawls Over Battery
episodesList.summary: Nabeel's selfless wish and a hilarious skit brings rewards to the kitchen. Gangavva becomes a contender, while the rest fight for a chance through the Battery task.

episodesList.title: Day 46: High Voltage Drama
episodesList.summary: Royals take out one opponent and desperately try to gain battery in exchange for facilities. Although the OGs resist the temptation, an internal argument throws them into panic.

episodesList.title: Day 47: Final Fight for Mega Chief
episodesList.summary: Royal clan wins the pillow challenge. Avinash and Prithvi get the opportunity to earn additional prize money but at a cost. Finally, who will take over as the Mega Chief?

episodesList.title: Day 48: Its Time for 'BB Times'
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna talks about the past week's happenings and later initiates an intriguing BB Times task. Meanwhile, Prithvi gets an exclusive yet challenging offer. Will he accept it?

episodesList.title: Day 49: Games Galore
episodesList.summary: The atmosphere buzzes with excitement as Nagarjuna entertains the housemates with interesting games. As the fun unfolds, one housemate gets ready to exit the house.

episodesList.title: Day 50: Midway through the Race
episodesList.summary: During the pot-breaking nomination process, tensions flare between Prithvi and Rohini. Later, mega chief Gowtham uses a shield to protect a housemate, leaving Prerana disappointed.

episodesList.title: Day 51: Pot-breaking Nominations
episodesList.summary: Prithvi and Vishnupriya top the list of nominations. Concerned, the OGs urge Prithvi to reconsider his gameplay, while mega chief Gowtham gets the privilege to save a nominee.

episodesList.title: Day 52: Royals' Shenanigans
episodesList.summary: A spontaneous gym session and a spooky prank by the Royals lift everyone's spirits. The next day, housemates gear up to decide who’s in the running to become the mega chief.

episodesList.title: Day 53: OG Clan Turns the Table
episodesList.summary: OG clan wins over the Royals and choose Prithvi and Nikhil as contenders for the Chief. OGs also claim that the title winner of S8 will be one among them.

episodesList.title: Day 54: Meet Your New Mega Chief
episodesList.summary: As BB introduces tougher tasks with clever twists, more contenders enter the race and disagreements arise within the clans. Who will be declared as next week's mega chief?

episodesList.title: Day 55: Funday with Suriya
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna commends Gangavva for her prank and addresses last week’s conflicts with the housemates. Later, the excitement peaks when actor Suriya join him for a lively evening.

episodesList.title: Day 56: Diwali Dhamaka
episodesList.summary: The festivities begin with heartwarming surprises and fun games for the housemates. To add to the excitement, Nagarjuna invites celebrities on stage before eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 57: It's Jail Time for Nominees
episodesList.summary: Avinash's sudden exit shocks all, while BB's decision to let mega chief Vishnupriya imprison five nominees heightens the drama. Hurt by her picks, OGs seek redemption in round two.

episodesList.title: Day 58: The Mega Clan
episodesList.summary: The OG and Royal clans merge and together compete for the Mega Chief contendership. Four teams of three battle to secure at least one top position, leading to chaos.

episodesList.title: Day 59: Team Yellow Lags Behind
episodesList.summary: The water tank task continues and so do the intense fights. Team Green wins and gets to roll the dice, while teams Blue and Red manage to win the next two tasks.

episodesList.title: Day 60: Emotional Outbursts
episodesList.summary: To earn extra cooking time, Rohini and Avinash get a task of turning into toddlers. As the challenges for the Mega Chief gets tougher, who will finally win the title this week?

episodesList.title: Day 61: Happy Diwali!
episodesList.summary: Festive excitement fills the air as housemates enjoy Diwali with a special pooja and lively competitions. Mega chief Avinash makes a request, while BB surprises them all.

episodesList.title: Day 62: Nagarjuna’s Message to the House
episodesList.summary: King applauds Avinash for his fun penalties directed at the midday sleepyheads. He also praises the teams for their task performance while reinforcing the importance of decorum.

episodesList.title: Day 63: Non-Stop Fun with the King
episodesList.summary: The evening turns exhilarating as Nagarjuna engages housemates with quirky guessing games. Later, he hosts a juice mixing challenge ahead of the eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 64: Nomination Frenzy
episodesList.summary: The week kicks off with heightened emotions as housemates face nominations. Past conflicts resurface, and mega chief Avinash steps in to save a nominee.

episodesList.title: Day 65: Contendership Up For Grabs
episodesList.summary: Nabeel, Prithvi and Rohini unexpectedly win the contendership for Mega Chief. Their next challenge is to retain this victory by battling the tough tasks designed for them.

episodesList.title: Day 66: Spill the Tea
episodesList.summary: Contenders Vishnupriya, Prerana and Yashmi confront each other in a strenuous task to grab the spot. Later, BB gives an interesting dare to Prerana and Tasty Teja.

episodesList.title: Day 67: Chaos Over Contendership
episodesList.summary: A prank leaves chief contender Yashmi on edge, while Prithvi's actions make Vishnupriya question their bond. In the final round, housemates jeopardise Nabeel's chance to win.

episodesList.title: Day 68: Eviction Shield
episodesList.summary: Prerana is crowned as the new mega chief, leaving Rohini upset. Later, BB gives housemates a chance to earn an eviction shield by nominating those they deem unworthy.

episodesList.title: Day 69: Nagarjuna's Verdict
episodesList.summary: Rule violation and poor performance land Tasty Teja in trouble, while Nagarjuna gives the contenders a chance to win the shield. Unfortunate results await one of the housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 70: Cosplay Fun and Food Theft
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna looks into the food theft, while the housemates entertain him with a playful cosplay game. Later, Varun Tej joins them ahead of this week's elimination.

episodesList.title: Day 71: Nomination Fall Out
episodesList.summary: Reeling from last week's drama, housemates face nominations where they paint criticisms on each other's portraits. Tasty Teja and Gowtham get defensive, which sparks heated tiffs.

episodesList.title: Day 72: Family Week
episodesList.summary: The most awaited days are finally here! Nabeel and Rohini welcome their dear ones to the house. On the other hand, Tasty Teja makes a tearful plea to BB.

episodesList.title: Day 73: A Sweet Surprise for Avinash
episodesList.summary: Yashmi and Nikhil's happiness knows no bounds as their parents enter the house and join them in various tasks. Avinash reunites with his wife, but faces a very crucial choice.

episodesList.title: Day 74: Happy Reunions
episodesList.summary: Excitement fills the air when Vishnupriya and Prithvi reunite with their loved ones. Adding to it, Gowtham's brother visits him, while Prerana receives a sweet virtual surprise.

episodesList.title: Day 75: Unexpected Arrivals, Unlimited Joy
episodesList.summary: Family week ends on a high note as Prerana and Tasty Teja receive heartwarming surprises. Later, the housemates gear up to choose their next mega chief.

episodesList.title: Day 76: Limitless Fun with the Guests
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna interacts with the housemates and recalls their memorable moments from the week. Later, he welcomes celebrities and family members to join him on stage.

episodesList.title: Day 77: A Game-Changing Choice
episodesList.summary: Housemates' loved ones continue to visit, and Nagarjuna keeps them engaged with games. Tension builds as Nabeel faces the crucial decision of whether to use his eviction shield.

episodesList.title: Day 78: Evictees' Comeback!
episodesList.summary: As part of a nomination twist, Sonia, Shekar, and Bebakka enter to the house to nominate two housemates. During the defense, tempers flare and clashes erupt between them.

episodesList.title: Day 79: Housemates in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Nominations by Aditya, Nainika, Manikanta and Seetha bring hidden issues to light, leaving the housemates bitter and upset. Will these issues tear apart their bonds?

episodesList.title: Day 80: One Last Battle to Become Contender
episodesList.summary: Housemates reflect on the nominations, after which a prank leaves Tasty Teja clueless. Later, chaos ensues as they battle to protect their t-shirts to secure a spot as a contender.

episodesList.title: Day 81: Vishwak Sen Visits the House
episodesList.summary: Nikhil and Rohini compete for a spot, but Gowtham's accusation against the OG clan sparks arguments. After the contenders face a gruelling task, Vishwak Sen makes a surprise entry.

episodesList.title: Day 82: Season's Last Mega Chief
episodesList.summary: The contenders face intense tasks to become the season's final Mega Chief. Amidst this, an argument between Rohini and Vishnupriya adds to the drama. Who will claim the title?

episodesList.title: Day 83: A Stern Warning from the King
episodesList.summary: Rohini and Vishnupriya are reprimanded for their actions, while Gowtham and Prithvi receive a warning. Later, a game of Snakes and Ladders leaves Nikhil and Gowtham with a twist.

episodesList.title: Day 84: Eviction Day
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna enjoys the housemates' fun guessing game and their witty complaints. However, all eyes soon shift to Yashmi and Prithvi, who anxiously await their fate.

episodesList.title: Day 85: Paint it Red!
episodesList.summary: BB asks the housemates to nominate those who don't deserve to be in the grand finale. As each one steps forward for the activity, heated arguments take over the house.

episodesList.title: Day 86: The TTF Race Begins
episodesList.summary: Former contestants Akhil and Harika kickstart the Ticket to Finale battle. They must choose the contenders for the first task and present a black badge to the loser.

episodesList.title: Day 87: Strength, Strategy Put to Test
episodesList.summary: Priyanka and Manas enter the house to plan round two and finalise yet another contender for the TTF race. Who will grab the next spot, and who will get the black star?

episodesList.title: Day 88: May the Strongest One Win
episodesList.summary: The hunt to pick the next contender resumes when Punarnavi and Vithika enter. Nikhil takes the lead, while some housemates raise voices against the unjust decisions.

episodesList.title: Day 89: Ticket To Finale Goes to...
episodesList.summary: Nikhil, Rohini, and Avinash pick Teja as the fourth contender. Later, Sreemukhi enters the house to unfold a few twists. Finally, who will win the Ticket to Finale?

episodesList.title: Day 90: Double Eviction
episodesList.summary: Avinash makes it to the finals, but Nagarjuna’s Ticket game sparks tension. In addition, a shocking double eviction twist leaves the housemates on edge.

episodesList.title: Day 91: One Left, Who's Next?
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna brings in a set of hilarious and entertaining games for the housemates. Tension rises for yet another eviction of this week. Who will bid goodbye?

episodesList.title: Day 92: A Battle for the Second Spot
episodesList.summary: Nominations leave everyone at risk except Avinash. Nikhil and Gowtham lock horns during the task, while Nabeel and Prerana get a golden opportunity, but it comes at a price.

episodesList.title: Day 93: Vote Appeal
episodesList.summary: Housemates get one chance to appeal for votes, leading to a heated argument between Nabeel and Rohini. Shekhar Master's surprise visit brings added excitement with a fun twist.

episodesList.title: Day 94: Task Decision Sparks Unrest
episodesList.summary: Chaos erupts as Prerana contests Nabeel's win for a chance to appeal for votes. Later, the Vah-Chef makes a surprise entry into the house and prepares a delicious feast.

episodesList.title: Day 95: Who Will Secure the Next Spot?
episodesList.summary: Avinash's sacrifice helps Rohini take the lead, while Vishnupriya wins the second round. Now, it's up to the rest of the housemates to pick one of them. Who will that be?

episodesList.title: Day 96: Verbal War
episodesList.summary: Nikhil and Gowtham face off for a chance to appeal, but the former's sharp remarks lead to a major clash. Later, Ohmkar makes a surprise visit to the house.

episodesList.title: Day 97: Eviction Shocker
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna delves into the housemates' regrets from their journey so far. He then shocks everyone with a Double Elimination announcement, leaving the housemates on edge.

episodesList.title: Day 98: Meet the Finalists
episodesList.summary: Housemates discuss their plans for the prize money. After exciting tasks and reveals, Nagarjuna announces the finalists, while the remaining one faces eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 99: Maa vs BB Parivaaram
episodesList.summary: To increase the prize money, the finalists take on quirky tasks. The excitement doubles as Maa stars joins them, bringing chaos, laughter and nonstop entertainment to the house.

episodesList.title: Day 100: Bigg Wins
episodesList.summary: Kavya, Ganga and Gangadhar from Maa Parivaar light up the house with their fun-filled entry. Later, they take on thrilling challenges with the finalists to boost the prize money.

episodesList.title: Day 101: A Fun Banter with BB
episodesList.summary: The housemates prepare some tasty treats for Bigg Boss, and BB returns the favour with delicious delights. Later, Maa Parivaram stars Vaishanavi and Krishna enter the house.

episodesList.title: Day 102: A Trip Down the Memory Lane
episodesList.summary: With just a few days left for the finale, BB prepares some special treats for the finalists. Today, Gautham and Avinash get a chance to relive their incredible journey in S8.

episodesList.title: Day 103: Reliving the Season
episodesList.summary: Nikhil, Nabeel and Prerna get to go through and celebrate their amazing journeys of this season. BB motivates them and wishes goodluck for the finale.

episodesList.title: Day 104: And the Countdown Begins!
episodesList.summary: With just one day for the grand finale, the housemates share the best and worst memories of their life with BB. Later, ever gracious Suma enters to entertain the finalists.

episodesList.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: After 14 weeks of limitless drama and entertainment, Nagarjuna sets the stage for the epic finale. Who will seize the dream trophy and become the winner?

episodesList.title: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: The wait is over! King Nagarjuna returns with a dazzling new season full of glamour, thrills and the twist of double house, double dose! What shocks await the contestants?

episodesList.title: Day 1: Drama Over Duty
episodesList.summary: On the very first day, owners and tenants lock horns over chore duties. Heated food fights, restrictions, and harsh remarks leave the house divided.

episodesList.title: Day 2: First Nomination Sparks Chaos
episodesList.summary: Tempers soar as fights break out during the first nomination process. An unexpected accident shakes the house, turning even the kitchen into a war zone.

episodesList.title: Day 3: Special Power and Scuffles
episodesList.summary: Arguments continue to break out as Srija confronts Sanjana and Thanuja. Harish’s anger brings tears, while Priya and Bharani ignite fierce disputes with rivals.

episodesList.title: Day 4: Battle for Captaincy Begins
episodesList.summary: Captaincy task ignites drama as Manish and Emmanuel clash over fairness. Sanjana’s ban stirs tension, while Rithu and Pavan indulge in cute banter.

episodesList.title: Day 5: Sanjana’s Rule Under Fire
episodesList.summary: Captain Sanjana’s strict reign descends into chaos, earning her the nickname ‘Hitler.’ Tensions flare between Emmanuel and Harish, while Manish backfires during thumbs-up challenge

episodesList.title: Day 6: Weekly Recap with the King
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna settles house fights, questions Sanjana and resolves the theft drama. He wraps up the first weekly recap by smashing the boxes.

episodesList.title: Day 7: First Eviction
episodesList.summary: Owners come under fire for partiality, and the captain learns the extent of her powers. Nagarjuna welcomes Team Mirai on stage just before announcing the first eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 8: Paint to Nominate
episodesList.summary: This week's nominations turns personal, creating a divide in the house. Harish refuses to eat, while Manish calls out two-faced behaviour.

episodesList.title: Day 9: Fiery Verbal Tiffs
episodesList.summary: Priya takes aim at Bharani’s cooking, while Harish picks a fight with Emmanuel. Moreover, Rithu and Ramu push the tension higher during nominations. Who’s in trouble this week?

episodesList.title: Day 10: A Night of No Surrender
episodesList.summary: Housemates burst into laughter with Emmanuel and Thanuja’s romcom skit and Rithu’s cheeky plea. Later, the mood flips when they face a captaincy task that tests their endurance.

episodesList.title: Day 11: The Paint Battle
episodesList.summary: Tenants dismiss Priya due to her mood swings, and other owners which sparks fights over favoritism. Subsequently, the Rangu Padudundi task ignites an array of arguments.

episodesList.title: Day 12: Fair Play or Favouritism?
episodesList.summary: The fight to win yet another permanent membership in the BB house turns physical with Suman’s outburst. Later, Rithu’s emotional gameplay ignites clashes with Emmanuel and Thanuja.

episodesList.title: Day 13: Nagarjuna Grills the Owners
episodesList.summary: Nagarjuna revokes captaincy, forcing contenders to redo tasks with swapped roles. A heartfelt video call moves the house, while praise and scoldings stir tension.

episodesList.title: Day 14: Sunday Fun Turns Tense
episodesList.summary: The king kicks off the day with laughter as he teases Thanuja’s secret crush and leads a fun lyrics game. The mood shifts with a tough captaincy task and tense votes.

episodesList.title: Day 15: Swap a Nominee!

title: Bigg Boss
summary: Bigg Boss is an Indian Tamil-language version of the reality television program of the same name. The program follows the Big Brother format developed by Endemol in the Netherlands. Since its premiere on June 25, 2017, the show has rolled out eight seasons and two spin-off version. The first seven seasons were hosted by Kamal Haasan, followed by Vijay Sethupathi from the eighth season onwards. As of season 9, a total of 183 contestants have participated in Bigg Boss. Bigg Boss has aired a total of 947 episodes.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text: Bigg Boss is a reality show based on the original Dutch Big Brother format developed by John de Mol Jr. Unlike original Big Brother, Bigg Boss features celebrity and commoner contestants. The contestants (known as "housemates") live in a house that is isolated from the world. Following anonymous internal voting by the housemates and external voting by television audiences, one housemate is "evicted" (removed) from the house each week. During the final week, the final four or five housemates vote to determine the show's winner. The eponymous Bigg Boss character serves as an omnipresent authority figure and represents the show's producers. He often interacts with the housemates to assign challenges and ask questions.

articleSections.title: House
articleSections.text: For all of the Bigg Boss seasons the house was located at EVP Film City, Chennai. The house is well-furnished and decorated. It has a variety of modern amenities, but just one or multiple bedrooms and four toilet bath rooms. There is a garden, outdoor seating, pool, activity area, smoking zone, gym, jail and lounge room in the house. There is also a Confession Room, where the housemates may be called in by Bigg Boss for any kind of conversation, and for the nomination process. In season seven, the house was split and there was another added confession room.

articleSections.title: Rules
articleSections.text:
Housemates are bound by various rules. For example, contestants must speak Tamil. Tampering with any electronic equipment or other items in the house is strictly prohibited. They may not leave the premises at any time without permission. Physical violence is completely forbidden. Discussing the nomination process with anyone is also not allowed. Housemates must remain awake until the lights go off.
Occasionally, housemates may be nominated for various reasons, including being chosen by individuals with special privileges obtained through tasks, for breaking rules, or for other unspecified reasons. In serious cases, a contestant may face expulsion from the house.

articleSections.title: Airing
articleSections.text: Daily episodes present the main events of the previous day while weekend episodes focus on discussion of the main problems of the week and interviews with evicted contestants. On the Sunday episode the host announces the evicted contestant.

articleSections.title: Eviction
articleSections.text: Contestants are nominated for eviction each week by their housemates. Viewers cast their votes in favour of the contestants they would like to save from eviction. Each viewer is entitled to cast one vote per day (used to be 50 votes for S1–S4, 10 votes for S5). The contestant with the fewest votes is out. Contestants who break the rules or who leave the house for medical reasons are evicted. During week 14 or 15 (before finale), Contestants get an option to be evicted from the game by their own decision by accepting the cash prize eviction and self evict themselves.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text:
Bigg Boss is aired on Star Vijay and is also available for streaming on JioHotstar (formerly Disney+ Hotstar in India). Everyday episodes contain the main happenings of the previous day. Every Sunday episode mainly focuses on an interview of an evicted contestant by the host. The unseen episode will be available as Bigg Boss Unseen on Vijay Music (sister channel to Star Vijay).
From Season 6 onward, Bigg Boss introduced a 24/7 Live Channel for JioHotstar subscribers.

articleSections.title: ''Bigg Boss Ultimate''
articleSections.text: The series is also set to roll out a digital version of the show called Bigg Boss Ultimate which is also going to be hosted by Kamal Haasan and broadcast by Disney+ Hotstar for 24×6 coverage. The series was eventually hosted by Silambarasan after Haasan had to opt out due to scheduling conflicts with his latest release, Vikram.

articleSections.title: ''Bigg Boss The Common Man''
articleSections.text: It is a digital pre-show of the main Bigg Boss. It will feature contestants from selected commoners to earn their spot in the main house.

articleSections.title: ''Bigg Boss Fun Unlimited''
articleSections.text:
It is a talk show in which the evicted housemates of that season are interviewed about their journey. This show was introduced for Bigg Boss 2 and later discontinued from Bigg Boss 3. The show once again continued from Bigg Boss 8. The show aired on Vijay Super and Disney+ Hotstar.
