episodesList.title: The Boss Is Here
episodesList.summary: Ulaganayagan Kamal Haasan takes us on a tour of the well-equipped Bigg Boss House. Get set to be amazed as he introduces the contestants!

episodesList.title: Day 1: Who's The House Leader
episodesList.summary: The contestants choose their leader on their first day in the Bigg Boss House. Who is it?

episodesList.title: Day 2: Snehan Takes The Lead
episodesList.summary: Things have begun to heat up as the contestants need to nominate 2 vote-outs. Nominating Snehan to lead everybody, Bigg Boss has an exceptional task on hand. What is it?

episodesList.title: Day 3: The Magic Of First Love
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss instructs the contestants to talk about their first love. Vaiyapuri and Namitha feel homesick, while Juliana suspects a cold war rising against her.

episodesList.title: Day 4: The Drama Heats Up
episodesList.summary: The episode opens with another cat fight and Juliana's birthday celebration. The contestants have to tag their soulmates in the primary task of the day.

episodesList.title: Day 5: First Bigg Boss Tamil Awards
episodesList.summary: The contestants are told to get ready for their first Bigg Boss Tamil Awards, based on their performances in the past few days. Will this create unrest?

episodesList.title: Day 6: Week One Review With Bigg Boss
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss reviews the first week with the contestants and mentions of an elimination which is due next week.

episodesList.title: Day 7: First Elimination
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan tells Anuya and Juliana which contestants voted against them and announces the name of the eliminated contestant. Also, watch the contestants enact songs from Kamal Haasan's movies!

episodesList.title: Day 8: A New Leader Is Chosen
episodesList.summary: The contestants choose their new leader and give their elimination nominations for the week. Who is the leader now?

episodesList.title: Day 9: Bigg Boss Says Recite Tamil Anthem
episodesList.summary: The contestants are told to recite the Tamizh Thaai Vaazhthu, which ends in a dispute between Gayathri and Juliana!

episodesList.title: Day 10: New Set Of Challenges
episodesList.summary: The contestants get an interesting task of dedicating proverbs to each other. Who will impress Bigg Boss?

episodesList.title: Day 11: Twists And Turns In The House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns Snehan to give tongue-twisters to each contestant but the real twist comes when Juliana makes a decision!

episodesList.title: Day 12: Big Boss Annual School Festival
episodesList.summary: Will Gayathri’s request to Bigg Boss for chocolate powder be accepted? Meanwhile, Bigg Boss asks Snehan to organise an annual school function with a skit and a singing and dance performance. Who will shine?

episodesList.title: Day 13: Who Is Next
episodesList.summary: Adding to the drama, Kamal Haasan surprises everyone with a no elimination episode. He questions the contestants about the Bigg Boss school and Juliana's fight. The housemates are given a task to shop food items. Who will leave the house this week?

episodesList.title: Day 14: Unexpected Turn Of Events
episodesList.summary: The Bigg Boss contestants are stunned when Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant.

episodesList.title: Day 15: Bharani's Dramatic Escape Attempt
episodesList.summary: A frustrated Bharani tries to escape from the house by jumping over the wall. Will the Bigg Boss evict him?

episodesList.title: Day 16: Virumaandis In The House
episodesList.summary: The contestants dress up as Kamal Haasan's movie character, Virumaandi and dance whenever the songs assigned to them are played. Later, Bigg Boss punishes Aarav and Raisa. Why?

episodesList.title: Day 17: Contestants Become 'Superstars'
episodesList.summary: The contestants become Superstar Rajinikanth's movie character Padaiyappa and rock the house. Bigg Boss asks Ganesh to predict the order in which his fellow contestants are going to get evicted!

episodesList.title: Day 18: Thala - Thalapathy Fever
episodesList.summary: As part of today's task, the contestants dress up like superstars Ajith and Vijay and perform a dance marathon!

episodesList.title: Day 19: Juliana Is The Hot Topic
episodesList.summary: The drama quotient increases exponentially as Juliana becomes the topic of discussion among the housemates. Namita has two days to learn Tamil, while Razia and Snehan quarrel over the food.

episodesList.title: Day 20: Raiza Bears The Brunt
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss punishes Raiza for her frequently speaking in English. Kamal Haasan asks some challenging questions to the contestants. Will it create unrest in the house?

episodesList.title: Day 21: A Dramatic Eviction
episodesList.summary: Amidst tension, Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. What does Bharani say about his escape attempt?

episodesList.title: Day 22: Who Will Rule The House?
episodesList.summary: Shakthi, Oviya and Namitha compete in an endurance challenge to be the new leader. Who will get to rule the house?

episodesList.title: Day 23: A Thief In The House?
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns a character to each contestant and asks them to protect a diamond from being stolen. But, who is the thief?

episodesList.title: Day 24: The Hunt Begins!
episodesList.summary: The contestants learn that the diamond has been stolen and try to find the thief. Will they succeed?

episodesList.title: Day 25: Tamil Thalaivas In The House
episodesList.summary: Tamil Thalaivas, Tamil Nadu's Pro Kabaddi League team visit and play a Kabaddi match with the Bigg Boss housemates. Later, the joy in the house disappears when Juliana falls ill!

episodesList.title: Day 26: Nine Against One?
episodesList.summary: Namita and Gayathri ask the other contestants to stand with them against Oviya. The contestants compete in a fast food challenge.

episodesList.title: Day 27: Kamal Reveals Oviya's Truth
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan makes each contestant understand the issue involving Oviya.

episodesList.title: Day 28: Eviction Creates Confusion
episodesList.summary: As Kamal Haasan prepares to announce the name of the evicted contestant, Gayathri and Juliana rejoice assuming that there is no eviction this week. But is it true?

episodesList.title: Day 29: Who Will Win?
episodesList.summary: Juliana tries convincing Aarav that Oviya is lying. Later, Aarav and Snehan compete in an interesting game to become this week's leader.

episodesList.title: Day 30: Cycling Task Irks Vaiyapuri
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks assigns a cycling task to the contestants but Vaiyapuri isn't happy about it. Why?

episodesList.title: Day 31: Oviya, Gayathri Become Reporters
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks Oviya and Gayathri to become news reporters and interview all the housemates. How will this change things in the house?

episodesList.title: Day 32: Who Is The Jr Bigg Boss?
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants by reducing their luxury budget points and assigns a task to select the Junior Bigg Boss of the house. Who will it be?

episodesList.title: Day 33: Oviya, Juliana Clash
episodesList.summary: As part of a task, Juliana assigns Oviya to put out a red carpet for her. But, it ends in a fight. How?

episodesList.title: Day 34: Kamal Sets Things Right
episodesList.summary: The contestants enact a scene from the movie "Avvai Shanmugi" with a motive. Kamal Hassan sets things right between the contestants.

episodesList.title: Day 35: Welcome The New Contestant
episodesList.summary: Secrets are revealed as everyone gets a chance to talk for each other and answer Kamal Hassan's questions. A new contestant enters the house.

episodesList.title: Day 36: Shock Treatment!
episodesList.summary: Bindu Madhavi has a task for everyone that makes them run. Bigg Boss gives everybody a task of giving someone a shock treatment. Who is the bait?

episodesList.title: Day 39: Oviya Isolates Herself
episodesList.summary: Oviya sleeps outside the living area, doesn't participate in the tasks, and snubs other contestants. Meanwhile, Aarav continues to avoid her. Will someone solve her problems?

episodesList.title: Day 40: Oviya Wants To Leave
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss organises a tug of war in the house. An unstable Oviya says that she wants to leave the house. Will she?

episodesList.title: Day 41: Oviya Exits!
episodesList.summary: The crowd gives a massive reception to their favourite as Oviya leaves the Bigg Boss house.

episodesList.title: Day 42: Another Departure!
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan speaks personally to each contestant about the incidents that led to Oviya's exit and announces the name of the evicted contestant.

episodesList.title: Day 43: A Surprising Decision!
episodesList.summary: After asking the contestants to give their eviction nominations for the week, Bigg Boss stuns everyone with an announcement. What is it?

episodesList.title: Day 44: A Battle On The Cards
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss divides the contestants into two teams with separate luxury budget points, based on their performance. Will it create a conflict?

episodesList.title: Day 45: Unrest In The House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss assigns some contestants with an alternative task as they are unhappy with the laundry task. Someone gets scared after the task is performed. What happened?

episodesList.title: Day 46: Who Is The Lucky One?
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss announces that one of the contestants can be saved from eviction and asks them to cast their votes. Later, there's a rift between Gayathri and Raiza.

episodesList.title: Day 47: Elimination Advantage Challenge
episodesList.summary: A thief and clown gain entry into the house and do their best to disturb everyone. Each contestant has to answer 5 questions to gain advantage in this week's elimination. Who will win this task?

episodesList.title: Day 48: Sathish And Sripriya Visit
episodesList.summary: Actors Sathish Krishnan and Sripriya visit the show with questions for Bigg Boss on his elimination strategy and situation handling with contestants and more.

episodesList.title: Day 49: Whose Turn Is it?
episodesList.summary: The contestants aren't in a mood to celebrate the 50th day in the house as Kamal Haasan announces the name of the eliminated contestant!

episodesList.title: Day 50: Open Nominations
episodesList.summary: The contestants compete in a game to become the leader for the week. Bigg Boss asks each contestant to give their eviction nominations in the presence of others!

episodesList.title: Day 51: Ghost In The House?
episodesList.summary: The contestants give a short speech about India, on the occasion of Independence day. Later, Snehan and Aarav try to scare Bindu. What's their plan?

episodesList.title: Day 52: Another Wild Card Entry
episodesList.summary: Raiza is annoyed with Vaiyapuri's behaviour. Later, a new contestant enters the house as a wild card entry. Who is it?

episodesList.title: Day 53: A Surprising Entry!
episodesList.summary: Snehan and Bindu play a prank on Suja. Gayatri and Aarav are mad at Snehan. Later, the contestants are in for a surprise as a new member joins them.

episodesList.title: Day 54: VJ Kajal In The House
episodesList.summary: Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are unhappy after the rice packing challenge. Later, VJ Kajal makes a dramatic entry. Is she in the house to stay?

episodesList.title: Day 55: Kamal Loses His Cool
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan lashes out at the contestants for disrespecting Bigg Boss and decides to speak only to the newcomers. Later, the contestants answer some controversial questions from the viewers.

episodesList.title: Day 56: Who Leaves This Week?
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan questions the housemates regarding the nominated contestants Raiza and Gayathri and announces the name of the evicted contestant. Later, there are some controversial questions aimed at the evicted one.

episodesList.title: Day 57: Who Is The New Leader?
episodesList.summary: The newcomers compete in an exciting game to become the leader for the week. Later, the contestants give their eviction nominations!

episodesList.title: Day 58: A Nomination Chain!
episodesList.summary: Aarav gets nominated for next week's eviction after pressing a buzzer but has a chance to transfer his nomination. How?

episodesList.title: Day 59: Raiza In Trouble Again!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss punishes the contestants for sleeping during the day and seeks an explanation from Raiza for the same. Meanwhile, Bindu has a tough task ahead.

episodesList.title: Day 60: Killers In The House
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss tells the contestants that there are two killers in the house and assigns Vaiyapuri and Kajal the task to catch them. Who are the killers and what's their modus operandi?

episodesList.title: Day 61: Double Murder Mystery
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss welcomes the housemates to the Bigg Boss Wrestling Federation. Ganesh and Raiza are killed by the mysterious killers. Are the others safe?

episodesList.title: Day 62: The People's Court
episodesList.summary: The killers reveal themselves after two more murders. Some housemates get a chance to confront others, the legal way.

episodesList.title: Day 63: Surprise Or Shock?
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan stuns everyone by introducing a new pattern for conducting the eviction. Does he have more surprises up his sleeve?

episodesList.title: Day 64: Unexpected Visitors!
episodesList.summary: The contestants give their eviction nominations for the week. Later, they are astonished when two guests arrive at the house!

episodesList.title: Day 65: Madurai Team Vs NRI Team
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss divides the housemates into 2 teams and asks them to compete against each other. But, the first task itself creates some problems!

episodesList.title: Day 66: Shift Of Power!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss announces that the Madurai team will gain control of the house and NRI team members should serve them. Later, Julie gets grilled about her equation with Oviya and Aarav.

episodesList.title: Day 67: Wedding Bells in The House
episodesList.summary: Harish and Bindu get married but have to compete with Aarav and Suja to succeed in their marriage. Aarav gets hurt during the task. Will Harish win?

episodesList.title: Day 68: Bindu is Punished!
episodesList.summary: Bindu is punished for delaying in doing a task Bigg Boss assigned to her. Aarthi and Juli argue when Bigg Boss asks them to decide the winning team.

episodesList.title: Day 69: An Attempt to Prank Kamal
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks the contestants to enact some scenes that happened in the house and also asks them to play a prank on Kamal Haasan. Will the housemates succeed?

episodesList.title: Day 70: It's Eviction Time!
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan announces the name of the evicted contestant. Aarav is arrested and taken out by masked men in black, but one masked man stays in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 71: Leader Election
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss introduces a new method to choose the leader for the week. Later, the housemates submit their eviction nominations. Who will get maximum votes?

episodesList.title: Day 72: The Boss Says 'Stop'
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss introduces an interesting task called 'Freeze and Release'. Later, Juliana gets annoyed by something that Aarthi does.

episodesList.title: Day 73: Bigg Boss' Surprise!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss continues the 'Freeze and Release' task and gives heartwarming surprises to Vaiyapuri, Bindu and Harish. Later, an endurance task creates tension in the house!

episodesList.title: Day 74: Loved Ones Visit!
episodesList.summary: Snehan finds it difficult to control his tears when his father comes all the way from his village to see him. Ganesh also receives a delightful surprise!

episodesList.title: Day 75: Sweet Surprise for Aarav and Suja
episodesList.summary: Aarav and Suja are happy when some visitors take them by surprise. Bindu loses a bag of chocolates. Did someone steal it?

episodesList.title: Day 76: Vishnu, Catherine in the House
episodesList.summary: Actors Vishnu Vishal and Catherine Tresa stun everyone with their surprise entry and claim to be the new wild card entries. Are they?

episodesList.title: Day 77: A Surprise for Suja
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan announces that Harish and Bindu are safe. Later, he asks Suja to come out of the house. What's in store for her?

episodesList.title: Day 78: Aarav Leads The Way
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss chooses Aarav as this week's leader. The housemates are surprised to see Suja back in the house. Later, they give their eviction nominations for the week.

episodesList.title: Day 79: Ticket to The Finale!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss gives the housemates an endurance task to win points and secure the ticket to the finale. Looks like the real fight has just begun!

episodesList.title: Day 80: Snehan, Suja Won't Give Up
episodesList.summary: As Snehan and Suja refuse to end the task, Bigg Boss toughens up the rules. After hours of endurance, will the two finally give in to Bigg Boss?

episodesList.title: Day 81: Housemates In Knots
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to form pairs, tie each other and free themselves from a complicated knot, as part of the ticket to finale task. Later, they show their artistic talents!

episodesList.title: Day 82: All for a Ticket to the Finale
episodesList.summary: The men wear Bindu's dress, do a ramp walk and dance around the house. The housemates express themselves to win points and the ticket to the finale.

episodesList.title: Day 83: Steal and Win Points
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss tells the housemates to steal things from other housemates and drop it in a basket for points. Harish, Vaiyapuri, Aarav and Snehan are nominated for eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 84: Kamal In the House
episodesList.summary: Kamal goes inside the house to hand over the Golden Ticket to a surprise winner. Later, he announces the name of the evicted contestant. Who is it?

episodesList.title: Day 85: Fight to Escape Eviction
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss says that everyone, except Snehan is nominated for this week's eviction and gives them a way to escape. Later, a task turns a tad bit violent.

episodesList.title: Day 86: The Egg Challenge
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next Ticket to the Finale?

episodesList.title: Day 87: Angels Vs Demons
episodesList.summary: The contestants divide themselves into teams of angels and demons for the second part of the Ticket To Finale tasks. What are they supposed to do?

episodesList.title: Day 88: Role Reversal
episodesList.summary: As Aarav, Harish and Bindu fail to open the locker, Bigg Boss asks the demons to become angels and vice versa. Will the new demons win?

episodesList.title: Day 89: The Egg Challenge
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss gives each contestant an egg and asks them to protect it at all times. Who will win the next ticket to the finale?

episodesList.title: Day 90: Kamal's Important Announcement
episodesList.summary: The contestants are assigned various tasks with eggs hanging from their necks! Kamal Haasan makes an important announcement regarding the Finale points. What is it?

episodesList.title: Day 91: Who Will Snehan Save?
episodesList.summary: Snehan can save Ganesh or Suja from eviction by giving his points to them. Who will be the lucky one?

episodesList.title: Day 92: Actress Anjali Visits
episodesList.summary: The housemates give a grand welcome to the gorgeous actress Anjali, from the upcoming movie Balloon. What exciting tasks will she come up with?

episodesList.title: Day 93: Dance Marathon is Back!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss asks the housemates to dress up like movie characters and dance whenever the song assigned to them is played. Later, Snehan gets emotional thinking about leaving the house.

episodesList.title: Day 94: Bigg Boss Makes a Tempting Offer
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss offers a huge amount of money to the housemates to leave the house immediately. Will anyone take the bait?

episodesList.title: Day 95: The Last Eviction!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss arranges an award function for the housemates. Find out who among the last 5 contestants get evicted.

episodesList.title: Day 96: Freeze to Get Surprises!
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss brings back the Freeze And Release task to give the housemates some delightful surprises. Snehan writes a brilliant song about their stay in the house!

episodesList.title: Day 97: Aarav or Snehan?
episodesList.summary: After the finalists celebrate with evicted participants, Ganesh Venkatraman and Harish find themselves out of the house. The contest is then between Aarav and Snehan. Who will be the winner of Season 1 of Bigg Boss?

episodesList.title: Kamal Haasan Kickstarts Season 2
episodesList.summary: Superstar, Kamal Haasan kickstarts the show with sixteen interesting housemates eager to begin their journey in the Bigg Boss house. Watch 'The Legend' get the ball rolling, however, with a twist in the tale.

episodesList.title: Day 1 in the House
episodesList.summary: Three candidates, one captain. Who among Janani, Mumtaj and Mahath will take charge as the first captain of Bigg Boss Season 2?

episodesList.title: Day 2 in the House
episodesList.summary: Problems are many and Janani desperately needs to prove her mettle as a captain. Will she succeed amidst all the luxury budget ruckus?

episodesList.title: Day 3 in the House
episodesList.summary: The shackles have come off and the first ever argument breaks out among the contestants. Watch Nithya's adamant demeanor turn her into the villain of the house.

episodesList.title: Day 4 in the House
episodesList.summary: A major rule violation has led to the contestants losing a significant part of their budget. What did they do?

episodesList.title: Day 5 in the House
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya and Janani kiss while Mumtaz and Bhalaji wear diapers and act like kids. All is not well between Mumtaz and Nithya. Janani is asked to name the underperfomers after three housemates are applauded for their efforts.

episodesList.title: Day 6 in the House
episodesList.summary: From the contestants' first-week experiences to Nithya and Mumtaz's onion fiasco, Kamal Haasan is here to peel it all out, layer by layer. Watch the drama unfold.

episodesList.title: Day 7 in the House
episodesList.summary: A happy ride takes a dramatic turn when Kamal Haasan brings the eviction back into focus. Who will pack their bags?

episodesList.title: Day 8 in the House
episodesList.summary: From being dominating personalities to their inability to handle a joke, the seniors are facing backlash, every step of the way. Are they being targeted for elimination?

episodesList.title: Day 9 in the House
episodesList.summary: Mumtaz and Mamathi turning rebellious has created an unrest during the master-servant task. Witness the ruckus in its purest form where solution is just a far fetched idea.

episodesList.title: Day 10 in the House
episodesList.summary: Mumtaz disobeys Bigg Boss's order to wear her mic. Aishwarya and Yashika's raunchy dance has the men at the edge of their seats.

episodesList.title: Day 11 in the House
episodesList.summary: The tides have turned as the roles in the master-servant task have been reversed. From the husband-wife rivalry to Daniel's arrogance, witness the struggle as the house becomes an arena of total chaos.

episodesList.title: Day 12: It's Men Vs Women!
episodesList.summary: A task has the housemates debating over who plays an active role in maintaining a relationship, men or women? What happens when the task ends up in an argument between two people of the same gender?

episodesList.title: Day 13: Fake, Faker, Fakest!
episodesList.summary: On the brink of eliminations, the tensed housemates are in for a nail-biting session as Kamal Haasan exposes their two-faced nature, one by one.

episodesList.title: Day 14: Groove Before You Move!
episodesList.summary: A groovy night comes to a screeching halt as Mamathi, Ananth and Mumtaz face their judgment day. Amidst the symphonious celebration with Kamal Haasan and Shruti Haasan, who's living their final moments in the house?

episodesList.title: Day 15: Misled Path to Captaincy!
episodesList.summary: On their run for captaincy, one amongst Vaishnavi and Senrayan reveals the secret task assigned to them. Will it result in a disqualification?

episodesList.title: Day 16: Injustice In The House?
episodesList.summary: The new luxury budget task is testing Vaishnavi's captaincy as she faces criticism for her unfair evaluation. Is she doing justice to her role?

episodesList.title: Day 17: You Can't Fool Me!
episodesList.summary: In the heat of the luxury budget task the housemates engage in fierce arguments while Bhalajie opts deception as the best tactic to win. However, Mumtaz is unlikely to be fooled.

episodesList.title: Day 18: Mumtaz Proves Herself!
episodesList.summary: Birthday girl Mumtaz shows that she is in it to win. Watch as she finishes the last leg of the luxury budget task with ease where the other contestants are struggling.

episodesList.title: Day 19: A Conjecture of Separation
episodesList.summary: While some of the housemates gang up on each other over trivial issues, Bigg Boss sets the stage for the contestants to pour out their feelings for their loved ones.

episodesList.title: Day 20: Kamal Haasan in Tears
episodesList.summary: The Universal Actor, Kamal Haasan sheds tears on stage, listening to Daniel's heartbreaking story. Amidst the overwhelming emotions, one among the nominated escapes eliminations.

episodesList.title: Day 21: The Evicted Holds Authority!
episodesList.summary: As the door to reality slides open, Ponnambalam and Ananth take their final steps towards eviction. Who amongst the housemates will make an exit and win a chance to sentence a jail term?

episodesList.title: Day 22: United for Ponnambalam
episodesList.summary: Anand's decision to send Ponnambalam to jail has the housemates begging Bigg Boss to rethink the decision. Mahat, Yashika and Aishwarya's friendship is on the line as they are forced to make a tough decision.

episodesList.title: Day 23: Ponnambalam's Unexpected Move
episodesList.summary: As the eager contestants buckle up for the upcoming task, the house decends into total chaos after Ponnambalam does something unexpected.

episodesList.title: Day 24: Taking It Too Far!
episodesList.summary: A major breach of the rules in the task brings out the nasty side of the contestants. From cutthroat arguments to a few housemates quitting the game midway, it's a big confusion in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 25: Everything Has a Price
episodesList.summary: The luxury budget task has the commoners coming up with ingenious ways to make the others cough up money. Catch what happens when Bigg Boss gives the housemates a chance to resolve all their conflicts.

episodesList.title: Day 26: Kadaikutty Singam in the House
episodesList.summary: Karthi, Soori and Director Pandiraj's surprise visit to the house has the contestants in a festive mood. Catch the cast of Kadaikutty Singam as they join the housemates in a fun-filled game of dumb charades.

episodesList.title: Day 27: Through Hunger and Poverty
episodesList.summary: Kamal Hassan questions Ramya regarding her poor judgment as a captain. Catch Senrayan and Kamal Hassan share their heart-wrenching experience with hunger and poverty.

episodesList.title: Day 28: Kamal Haasan Gets Frisky
episodesList.summary: As the clock ticks closer to eviction, Kamal Haasan gets playful before making the big announcement. Will it be Aishwarya's best friend, Yashika or Bhalajie's love, Nithya?

episodesList.title: Day 29: Sneak Peek to Finale?
episodesList.summary: The captaincy task has Mahat, Bhalajie and Shariq choosing their helper who will take the plunge for them. Catch the housemates reveal their thoughts of who might be the finalist.

episodesList.title: Day 30: Recite Your Flaws with Snehan
episodesList.summary: Wearing a school uniform and coming to terms with their flaws through poems with hidden meanings is the only way to win a luxury budget. Who will win the special appreciation from Snehan?

episodesList.title: Day 31: Letter to a Loved One
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya writes a heartfelt letter to her special friend. Tune in to find out why the housemates reveal their emotions and frustrations to Vaishnavi.

episodesList.title: Day 32: Senrayan Faces the Heat
episodesList.summary: Senrayan stands in the line of fire when his repeated questioning leads to a major brawl. Will it be a moment of self-realisation as special guests from various children's homes share their life stories with the contestants?

episodesList.title: Day 33: Daniel Gains Authority
episodesList.summary: The contestants are tasked to introduce their favourite personality from among the housemates. Later, the nominated contestants are given an opportunity to justify themselves. By the powers vested by Bigg Boss, Daniel sends a housemate to jail.

episodesList.title: Day 34: Ponnambalam’s Many Problems
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan gives a social message after Ponnambalam speaks about his childhood. Ponnambalam and Vaishnavi complain about a housemate to Kamal Haasan. All is not well between Ponnambalam and Aishwarya. Why?

episodesList.title: Day 35: Will Ramya's Wish Come True?
episodesList.summary: With the threat of elimination looming over her head, Ramya confesses to Kamal Hassan that she would be much happier away from all the conflicts and drama of the house. Tune in to find out if her wish comes true.

episodesList.title: Day 36: Time for Some Punishment
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss decides to make an example out of Mahat for all the rules that have been broken in the house. Catch what happens when Vaishnavi tries to clear Aishwarya's misconceptions.

episodesList.title: Day 37: Shariq Gets Grilled
episodesList.summary: While the housemates fight during the luxury budget task which is dedicated in honour of the Kargil Heroes, Shariq gets grilled when he tries to bring peace in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 38: Mumtaz and Shariq Lock Horns!
episodesList.summary: Mumtaz's attempt to set foot into the other teams territory turns into an ugly dispute between her and Shariq. With fingers being pointed at one another and ego's hurt, is this an end to the mother-son relationship between the two?

episodesList.title: Day 39: Mumtaz, a Villain?
episodesList.summary: Mumtaz's adamant demeanour topped by her rudeness is testing the contestants' patience, one task at a time. Will Shariq manage to mellow it down as the captain, or will they stand up against her?

episodesList.title: Day 40: Dogfight for Dominance
episodesList.summary: Mahat openly disobeys his team leader's orders. The unique luxury budget task has the housemates engage in a brutal battle for dominance.

episodesList.title: Day 41: Setting the Stage for Vishwaroopam 2
episodesList.summary: The housemates join Andrea Jeremiah, Pooja Kumar and the crew of Vishwaroopam 2 as they launch the latest song from the film. Witness the contestants confess their opinions about their fellow housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 42: Fate of the Nominated
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan kicks off the show in a playful mood with funny bloopers from around the house. Tune in to find out the fate that awaits the nominated housemates in this nail-biting episode.

episodesList.title: Day 43: Bhalajie Faces the Heat!
episodesList.summary: A house meeting turns ugly when Aishwarya lashes out at Bhalajie for using abusive language. Catch all the action and the drama as the contestants are divided into two teams for the Maggi cooking challenge.

episodesList.title: Day 44: All Hail the Queen
episodesList.summary: Some of the contestants are in for a tough time as Aishwarya is made the queen of the house as a part of this week's luxury budget task. A major drama unfolds in the house as Aishwarya dumps garbage on Bhalajie during the task.

episodesList.title: Day 45: Aishwarya, a Tyrant?
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya's rule has the housemates dissatisfied and rebelling against her decisions. Tune in to witness Bhalajie protest against her show of power.

episodesList.title: Day 46: End to Aishwarya's Dictatorship?
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya orders all the housemates to be jailed. Tune in to find out what happens when the housemates decides to put an end to her tyrannical rule.

episodesList.title: Day 47: Ghajinikanth Meets the Housemates
episodesList.summary: Arya and the cast of Ghajinikanth spend a fun-filled evening with the housemates. Tune in to find out what punishment awaits the housemates for breaking the rules of the house.

episodesList.title: Day 48: Kamal Haasan Demands Answers!
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya challenges Mumtaz to prove herself by winning the competition. Join Kamal Haasan as he questions the housemates about their actions during the task.

episodesList.title: Day 49: An Emotional Farewell
episodesList.summary: Tears break out in the house as an unexpected eviction leaves the housemates in shock. Catch all the fun and drama as the contestants celebrate Riythvika's birthday.

episodesList.title: Day 50: Raise Your Complaints
episodesList.summary: It's finally time to address the issues inside the house as each contestant is asked to pen down the injustices faced by them. Watch the drama unfold as some of the housemates accuse Daniel of playing a double game.

episodesList.title: Day 51: Get Into the Character!
episodesList.summary: After an intense court session, the contestants are in for a fun time as they are given a role-playing activity. Things get interesting as one team is given a secret task to trigger certain reactions out of the other team members.

episodesList.title: Day 52: Prayers for M. Karunanidhi
episodesList.summary: Mahat goes an extra mile in his attempt to impersonate Mumtaz. Catch the housemates as they pay their heartfelt last respect to M. Karunanidhi.

episodesList.title: Day 53: Luxury Supplies in Trouble?
episodesList.summary: Janani makes a calculation error that threatens the entire house's luxury supplies. Join the housemates as they speak a few words about M. Karunanidhi.

episodesList.title: Day 54: Love Is in the Air!
episodesList.summary: The housemates are in for a romantic surprise as they meet the cast of Pyaar Prema Kaadhal. Tune in to find out who will be successful in winning the hearts of Raiza and Harish.

episodesList.title: Day 55: Kamal Haasan's Take on Love
episodesList.summary: Housemates reprise their role from the task to answer Kamal Haasan's questions. Also, find out what Kamal Haasan has to say to Yashika and Mahat about their complicated relationship.

episodesList.title: Day 56: Kamal Haasan Enters the House
episodesList.summary: It's a dream come true for the housemates as Kamal Haasan visits them for the promotions of his movie, Vishwaroopam 2. Also in a first-time ever, Kamal Haasan announces the name of the person to be eliminated this week from inside the house.

episodesList.title: Day 57: Smile, Pose and Click!
episodesList.summary: Photography skills of the housemates are put to test in the Vivo task as Janani poses as a model for a photo shoot. Catch all the drama as Daniel and Aishwarya devise a plan of action for the nominations.

episodesList.title: Day 58: Fight and Steal for Luxury
episodesList.summary: Mahat and Daniel struggle to win supplies for their teams in the luxury budget task. Mahat and Mumtaz come up with a sneaky way to secure an advantage over their opponents.

episodesList.title: Day 59: Mahat Strikes Again!
episodesList.summary: Mahat leaves his opponents helpless as he steals their supplies from right under their nose. Will the two teams come up with a plan to play fair?

episodesList.title: Day 60: Yaashika, Aishwarya Take Charge
episodesList.summary: Yaashika and Aishwarya decide to take matters into their own hand in the luxury budget task. Tune in to find out who gets named the best cook in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 61: Mahat against Mumtaz
episodesList.summary: Mahat accuses Mumtaz of being selfish and warns Janani against trusting her. Catch the housemates as they take part in a task that teaches them the importance of the judicious use of water.

episodesList.title: Day 62: A Chance to Quit!
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan watches on as Mahat and Aishwarya accuse Mumtaz of being a backstabber. What will happen when he opens the main door and give a chance for anyone to leave the house?

episodesList.title: Day 63: A Nail-Biting Elimination
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan expresses his heartfelt prayer for the people of Kerala. Tune in to find out how the elimination process has the housemates confused and at the edge of their seats.

episodesList.title: Day 64: House of Drama
episodesList.summary: The housemates have a fun time as they play a game of cricket as a part of the daily task. Catch all the drama as Mahat's behaviour towards Mumtaz raises a few eyebrows in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 65: Yaashika Confronts the Housemates
episodesList.summary: Bigg Boss gives Yaashika a chance to confront the housemates about the issues she has with them. Watch what happens when she confronts Mahat about their complicated relationship.

episodesList.title: Day 66: Supervillains Vs Superheroes
episodesList.summary: Daniel explains the new task to the housemates. Mahat continues to irritate and pester Mumtaj and Daniel. What is it that leaves the housemates shocked and horrified?

episodesList.title: Day 67: Time for Payback!
episodesList.summary: Mumtaz and her team get a chance to have their revenge on Mahat's team as the two teams exchange their roles. Will their plans to stop the superheroes bear fruit?

episodesList.title: Day 68: New Contender in the House!
episodesList.summary: The housemates are woken from their sleep to a surprise, as Vijaylakshmi Feroz becomes the first wild card entrant. The housemates compete to see who is the best cook in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 69: Special Class with Kamal Haasan
episodesList.summary: On public demand, Kamal Haasan lends his ears to the issues faced by the housemates and conducts a special class on good conduct. But, what is it that makes him angry?

episodesList.title: Day 70: A Shocking Turn of Events
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan shocks the housemates as he reveals the first ever red card elimination. Tune in to find out whose anger has caused their place in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 71: Messages From the Loved Ones
episodesList.summary: The contestants earn the angel and devil badges. Senrayan becomes a victim of a prank. Emotions overflow when the housemates receive letters and gifts from home.

episodesList.title: Day 72: Long Awaited Reunion
episodesList.summary: The housemates cannot contain their excitement and tears as they get a chance to meet their loved ones. But, what has caused Bhalajie to breakdown amidst all the celebration?

episodesList.title: Day 73: Aishwarya's Emotional Reunion
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya breaks down in tears as Bigg Boss gives her a chance to finally meet her mother. The housemates get emotional as Aishwarya's mother apologises to Bhalajie and Mumtaz.

episodesList.title: Day 74: A Surprise for Senrayan
episodesList.summary: Senrayan receives the biggest news of his life as his wife informs that he is going to be a father. Join the housemates and Senrayan's family in their celebration of happiness.

episodesList.title: Day 75: Stories of Tears and Smiles
episodesList.summary: Janani and Aishwarya share the heart melting story of their lost love. Join the housemates as they share stories of the best and worst days of their life.

episodesList.title: Day 76: Daniel Feels Manipulated
episodesList.summary: Daniel reports to Kamal Haasan that some of the housemates are playing a double game and using him for their personal gains. But, who is he particularly talking about?

episodesList.title: Day 77: Key to Elimination
episodesList.summary: Janani and Daniel find themselves locked up in the ultimate test that will decide their fate in the house. Tune in to find out who will be evicted from the house.

episodesList.title: Day 78: Yashika Comes to Aishwarya's Aid
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya feels targeted as most of the housemates nominate her for eviction. Yashika promises to use her special powers in the best possible way to save her best friend.

episodesList.title: Day 79: Aishwarya's Ticket to Stay
episodesList.summary: The only way for Aishwarya to escape elimination is by convincing Senrayan to dye his hair red. Things take an ugly turn when Senrayan does something unexpected. What does he do?

episodesList.title: Day 80: Vijayalakshmi Takes a Dirty Dip
episodesList.summary: Vijayalakshmi proves that she is willing to do anything for a friend as she takes a dip in cow dung to help Mumtaz. Join the housemates as their friendship is put through the ultimate test.

episodesList.title: Day 81: Riythvika in the Danger Zone
episodesList.summary: Riythvika finds herself nominated when Mumtaz blatantly refuses to colour her hair as part of the task. Join the housemates as they try to convince Mumtaz to change her mind.

episodesList.title: Day 82: Aishwarya Faces the Heat
episodesList.summary: Tempers flare in the house as Aishwarya's attitude irks some of the housemates. Things turn from bad to worse as Vijayalakshmi calls out Mumtaz for doing something wrong.

episodesList.title: Day 83: Aishwarya to Justify Herself
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan calls out Aishwarya for lying to the housemates during a task and asks for her reason behind it.

episodesList.title: Day 84: Aishwarya Breaks Down
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan admits his shock as he reveals the name of the eliminated housemate. Tune in to find out why Aishwarya is in tears and begging to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Day 85: Old Contestants, New Competition
episodesList.summary: Aishwarya refuses to accept the housemates' decision to nominate her. The former season's contestants return to the house and they are here to stay.

episodesList.title: Day 86: Janani Joins the Guests
episodesList.summary: Snehan and the other guests thank Bigg Boss for the chance. Join them as they team up with Janani and keep the other housemates at the edge of their seats with a smart prank.

episodesList.title: Day 87: Analysing the Old and New
episodesList.summary: The task takes a tragic turn as more than one contestant come out of it injured. The housemates get a learning session on how to handle arguments and issues from the experienced guests.

episodesList.title: Day 88: Ticket to Finale!
episodesList.summary: The housemates are taken aback by the awe-inspiring entry of a mystery guest on a bike. The contestants get a chance to win a spot in the finale with the golden ticket task.

episodesList.title: Day 89: Ticket to Finale Goes to...
episodesList.summary: Yashika and Janani take part in a grueling task that could win them a direct spot in the finale. The housemates come together to help a tired and exhausted Yashika.

episodesList.title: Day 90: Life After Bigg Boss!
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan shares his joy after seeing the contestants from the previous season. Catch Vaiyapuri and the others talk about how their life changed after Bigg Boss.

episodesList.title: Day 91: Reason Behind Eviction
episodesList.summary: The housemates are given a chance to reveal the person they like and dislike the most. Kamal Haasan shows the evicted contestant the reason behind the nomination but keeps a surprise under wraps.

episodesList.title: Day 92: A Test of Willpower
episodesList.summary: Vijayalakshmi proves that she is a no pushover as she takes everything that the other housemates throw at her during the task. How will the others fare in this task of determination and perseverance?

episodesList.title: Day 93: Vijayalakshmi's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Vijayalakshmi comes up with an innovative strategy to make the housemates quit the task. The housemates get a chance to increase their points in a memory test.

episodesList.title: Day 94: Who Will Be Rank One?
episodesList.summary: The housemates are given a tough task of ranking themselves according to their performance. Will they be able to come to an agreement or will their egos and feelings come to clash?

episodesList.title: Day 95: Ladies vs Bhalajie
episodesList.summary: Bhalajie finds himself at a disadvantage as the others team up against him in the task. Join the action as Bhalajie tries to defend against the five ladies in a fun-filled task.

episodesList.title: Day 96: Tied for the Best Cook
episodesList.summary: The latest task has the housemates taking a traditional approach to cooking. Bhalajie and Vijiyalakshmi are tied for the best cook in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 97: Double Eviction Weekend
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan reveals how each housemate has become a role model to many people. He calls out the name of one of the two contestants who will be evicted this weekend.

episodesList.title: Day 98: Steps to Finale
