episodesList.summary: Housemates wrap up the icebreaker task while Aysha sheds tears in silence. The next day, chaos erupts in the house when BB asks them to share reviews about each clubs

episodesList.title: Day 3: A Bigg Kitchen Fight
episodesList.summary: Things turn sour in the house when club captains get a chance to swap their members. Further, Dhanalakshmi's remarks on cooking leads to a heated argument amongst the kitchen team.

episodesList.title: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: Kamal Haasan ignites excitement with the launch of the much-anticipated season, marked by riveting performances from our fresh set of housemates!

episodesList.title: Day 1: Bigg House, Small House
episodesList.summary: Season's first captain Vijay picks six housemates for the Small Boss House. Unexpected twists in nomination leaves everyone in shock. What additional surprises does BB have in store?

episodesList.title: Day 2: A Clash for the household Chores
episodesList.summary: Both houses complete in various tasks for getting away with the household chores. Helping results in punishments, while Pradeep argues with Vijay over today's menu.

episodesList.title: Day 3: A Popularity Showdown
episodesList.summary: Bava's storytime sparks a series of discussions in the house. Later, Maya and Vishnu face each other in the Verified or Blocked task. Who'll emerge victorious

episodesList.title: Season Premiere
episodesList.summary: The stage is set! Join our new boss Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi as he introduces the line up of new contestants of this captivating season.

episodesList.title: Day 1: First Eviction of S8
episodesList.summary: Aatam Pudusu! This season's journey begins with an eviction, followed by another nomination. With no time to relax, the housemates buckle up for their first captaincy.

episodesList.title: Day 2: Swap Your Teammate!
episodesList.summary: In a new twist of the day, BB asks the Men's and Women's teams to swap one member each. As the teams argue to agree, they are presented with the ration list for shopping.

episodesList.title: Day 3: Fiery Fights
episodesList.summary: Muthu crosses the border for water and gets into an argument with the men's team. Another round of verbal war erupts in the house, which gets heated up in the debate task.

episodesList.title: Day 4: Who Is a Better Parent?
episodesList.summary: The housemates are asked to predict the next evictee, while BB assigns a new debate topic. Later, Soundarya gathers everyone to clarify some comments about the morning activity.

episodesList.title: Day 5: The Nomination Free Pass
episodesList.summary: Women's team miss their chance to compete for the pass, while Arun from Men's team gets selected. To everyone's surprise, Sachana re-enters the BB house.

episodesList.title: Day 6: Vijay Sethupathi Meets the House
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan dives into the chaos of provisions and pranks during his first meet. Later, men receive positive feedback while the other team's dynamics sparks curiousity.

episodesList.title: Day 7: Housemates in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi questions Sachana's allegiance and digs into the reasons for the housemates' swap choices. Just as the drama unfolds, the first evictee joins him on stage.

episodesList.title: Day 8: Captaincy and Nominations
episodesList.summary: It's a day of decisions! The teams are asked to pick contenders for captaincy as well as new members to swap. As one battle ends, nomination begins, but with a condition.

episodesList.title: Day 9: No Room for Mistakes
episodesList.summary: Men's team manage to lose their weekly budget, while the Women's team crosses borders without permission. Chaos ensues when these issues are settled alongside the new rules.

episodesList.title: Day 10: King TV vs Queen TV
episodesList.summary: Arnav's actions spark altercations in the Men's team. The King and Queen TV compete fiercely for points, and later, everyone vies for the top spot in the ranking task.

episodesList.title: Day 11: A Neck and Neck Task
episodesList.summary: The housemates pull up their socks to win the "Nomination Free Pass". Later during the dinner preparation, Darsha feels cornered. What happened in the kitchen?

episodesList.title: Day 12: Victory for Women's Team
episodesList.summary: The Award ceremony goes for a toss, while the women's team skillfully win the Nomination Free Pass. Later, the housemates are asked to vote for the best and worst performers.

episodesList.title: Day 13: Applauds from VJS
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates some of the housemates for their good conduct. With a quirky question for Arun and a special task for Muthu, he signs off by advising the Men's team.

episodesList.title: Day 14: VJS Debunks the Accusations
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan leads an open Q and A with the housemates, during which Arnav challenges Dharsha over her accusation. Later, they discuss Sathya's captaincy and this week's eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 15: Team Swap Trouble
episodesList.summary: Ranjith, Tharshika compete for captaincy, while Soudarya fails to convince the women's team for the swap. As candidates are chosen for switching, mixed nominations raise the heat.

episodesList.title: Day 16: First Guests of BB Hotel
episodesList.summary: Arun unintentionally crosses the border to which the women's team put forth a deal. In the hotel task, the men's team complains against the management, leading Pavithra to resign.

episodesList.title: Day 17: Role Reversal in the Hotel
episodesList.summary: The men's team takes charge as staff and the women's team as haughty guests. The ladies succeed in taking revenge, and later everyone gears up for a game of dumb charades.

episodesList.title: Day 18: The Hotel Gets Upgraded
episodesList.summary: After a review session, both teams vote for the best and worst performers. BB announces the results with a twist, and the hotel gets set to welcome their new guests and staff.

episodesList.title: Day 19: Sivakarthikeyan in BB House
episodesList.summary: Women's team win the 'Nomination Free Pass' and have a debate among them to decide who deserves it. Later, all the housemates gather to welcome Sivakarthikeyan to the house.

episodesList.title: Day 20: VJS Reviews the Gameplay
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan recalls last week's events and commends the 'guests' of BB hotel. He probes the fairness of the Killer Coin task and raises issues of inequality among the girls.

episodesList.title: Day 21: Housemates on the Hot Seat
episodesList.summary: VJS commends housemates for their Hotel task and probes for any bias in assignments. He resolves all disputes while assessing team-swapping decisions ahead of eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 22: New Week, New Strategies
episodesList.summary: As the week begins, team swapping and captaincy tasks are in full swing. Nominations raise tension while collecting ration points and shopping add fuel to the fire.

episodesList.title: Day 23: Rolling for Role Play
episodesList.summary: As the women's team lose, they take up all the household tasks. Next, the housemates enact each other's characters as per BB's instructions, raising the bar of entertainment.

episodesList.title: Day 24: Reel Ones Review the Real
episodesList.summary: The housemates get a reality check from their "task characters". After the Showtime, Vishal talks about Muthu's game plan while the women win the float or sink task.

episodesList.title: Day 25: Kavin's Diwali Surprise
episodesList.summary: Decked up in traditional attires, the housemates celebrate Deepavali with fun games, crackers and a special lunch. The merrirment doubles when Kavin enters the house.

episodesList.title: Day 26: Women's Team Wins Again
episodesList.summary: The women’s team earn 'Nomination Free Pass', while Jeffry and Sachana receive penalties for their performance this week. Later, Sathya and Ananthi go head-to-head for captaincy.

episodesList.title: Day 27: Celebrating in Style with VJS
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan spreads festive cheer with his greetings and asks about the outfits he gifted the housemates. He reviews this week's tasks and the women’s team's success streak.

episodesList.title: Day 28: Make Way for the Wildcards
episodesList.summary: VJS asks Muthu about his captaincy review and offers guidance. Moreover, the arrival of new contestants and a Diwali 'bonus' from VJS leaves the housemates feeling bittersweet.

episodesList.title: Day 29: The First Open Nominations
episodesList.summary: Captain Sathya takes charge and assigns duties, while the direct nominations raise tension. Chaos ensues when Tharshika puts forth a condition for the Men's team.

episodesList.title: Day 30: Triumphs and Troubles
episodesList.summary: Men's team won the tasks, yet the border crossing debate remains unresolved. Following the unfair discussions, the women's team declare a hunger strike, leading to a verbal war.

episodesList.title: Day 31: Identify the Manipulator
episodesList.summary: The housemates are asked to vote for the most manipulative ones among them. Men secure their first Nomination Free Pass, while the story task continues without any interruptions.

episodesList.title: Day 32: Letters on the Way
episodesList.summary: Harsh nicknames and anonymous criticisms from each other, leaves the housemates wounded. Later, everyone celebrates Ulaganayagan's birthday before resuming the storytelling task.

episodesList.title: Day 33: Best and Worst Selection
episodesList.summary: The women get a task of styling the men. Additionally, BB asks the housemates to vote for the best and worst performers, while Arun secures the captaincy title this week.

episodesList.title: Day 34: Weekly Review
episodesList.summary: VJS asks housemates and wildcards about their opinions on each other, offering advice to both teams. Moreover, he dives deep into Sathya's leadership and Women's team's new rules.

episodesList.title: Day 35: An Advice from Makkal Selvan
episodesList.summary: VJS revisits the highlights of the weekly task, and emphasises the need to address behavioural challenges. Later, he offered advice to some and resolves ongoing tiffs.

episodesList.title: Day 36: New Rules for the Captain
episodesList.summary: Captain Arun is clad with a powerful cape, while the women's team dominate the shopping task. After nominations, the men panic as they fail to notice their new member Anshida.

episodesList.title: Day 37: Back to School
episodesList.summary: Excitement runs high as housemates become teachers and mischievous students for this week’s BB School task. But with clashes erupting at every corner, can order be restored?

episodesList.title: Day 38: Scuffles and a Secret Task
episodesList.summary: Feedback from students leaves the staff frustrated, while Deepak receives secret task by BB. Later, the teachers struggle to maintain order as fiery arguments erupt in the school.

episodesList.title: Day 39: Chaos at School
episodesList.summary: Students protest against Principal Varshini’s harsh actions. On the other hand, Jacquline is left in tears after Deepak and Arun misinterpret her words.

episodesList.title: Day 40: Captain Arun Faces the Heat
episodesList.summary: After losing stripes from his cape, Captain Arun mediates a dispute within the women's team. The best performers become captaincy contenders, while the worst face a penalty.

episodesList.title: Day 41: VJS Issues a Progress Report
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan receives feedback on the school task and student disruptions. Later, Deepak’s revelation surprises many in the house, while others clarify misunderstandings.

episodesList.title: Day 42: Eviction Drama and a Twist
episodesList.summary: VJS discusses Arun's captaincy and warns the housemates about their refusals and behaviour. After the eviction, he delivers an unexpected surprise to everyone.

episodesList.title: Day 43: A Costly Mistake
episodesList.summary: After a tearful argument with Arun, Manjari takes charge as the captain. Later, a crisis unfolds when the women’s shopping task goes wrong and they lose everything.

episodesList.title: Day 44: Conflict Sparks Mayhem
episodesList.summary: Sachana gets emotional after the women's team confront and advises her. Later, Raanav clashes with Manjari over a rule violation, while Muthu challenges her leadership.

episodesList.title: Day 45: BB Darbar
episodesList.summary: The house splits into two kingdoms - ruled by King Raanav and Queen Sachana. To claim the throne, they must conquer tasks, but what happens when unexpected hurdles arise?

episodesList.title: Day 46: Arimadesam Takes the Lead
episodesList.summary: Teams guess time and weight without gadgets to score points for the throne. The men bag a victory hat-trick, while the women prepare to fight back and take back what's theirs.

episodesList.title: Day 47: The Breaking Point
episodesList.summary: This week’s best performers compete for captaincy, while Soundarya and Shiva face harsh criticism. One is brought to tears, whereas the other attempts to clear the air with Deepak.

episodesList.title: Day 48: VJS Investigates the Issues
episodesList.summary: VJS questions the housemates about changes after the house swap and their task experiences. Later, he probes into concerns over Sachana’s penalty task and Manjari's leadership.

episodesList.title: Day 49: Halfway to Finale
episodesList.summary: The housemates open up about their milestones, the shopping mistake and the challenges in the Darbar task. Later, VJS delivers an announcement that fills everyone with excitement.

episodesList.title: Day 50: One Bigg Team
episodesList.summary: Captain Deepak's proactive efforts win him praises from BB. Though the nomination process causes friction between the housemates, an unified shopping task brings them together.

episodesList.title: Day 51: Doll Task
episodesList.summary: Anandhi and Pavithra's confrontation leaves Anshida emotional. Later, the quirky Doll task spirals out of control when housemates resist placing the dolls.

episodesList.title: Day 52: Traits, Talks and Tasks
episodesList.summary: The housemates make peace with the previous day's results, while an unwashed cup causes a stir. Match the traits activity sets in, and BB resumes the Doll task with fresh rules.

episodesList.title: Day 53: Disputes Over the Dolls
episodesList.summary: Sachana's hasty decision to cut one of the captain's roses leads to an argument. Later, a series of heated tiffs arise after Rayan and Raanav lock horns to secure the dolls.

episodesList.title: Day 54: Special Guests and Squabbles
episodesList.summary: Child artists of the Hotstar Specials show Parachute, visit the house. Later, Manjari raises a food issue with Arun, and the argument intensifies when Captain Deepak gets involved.

episodesList.title: Day 55: From Controversies to Captaincy
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan probes the housemates on this week's issues, from the Arun-Manjari fallout to Sachana’s unacceptable walkout. Later, he applauds captain Deepak.

episodesList.title: Day 56: VJS Reviews the Doll Task
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi discusses about the Doll task in detail. Strategies, gameplays and fights are questioned, while the nominated ones prepare for the eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 57: New Leaders Step In
episodesList.summary: Jeffry and Sachana are appointed captain and vice-captain respectively. The quirky shopping task stirs frustration, while Arun and Manjari resolve their differences.

episodesList.title: Day 58: Ranking Task with a Twist
episodesList.summary: After a morning activity on activeness, the housemates rank each other based on their goodwill. Tables turn when BB declares the top eight as Angels, and the rest as Demons.

episodesList.title: Day 59: Angels vs Devils
episodesList.summary: Intense emotional stress and physical challenges in the task lead the Angels to cry and argue. Meanwhile, the Devils face growing tensions within their ranks.

episodesList.title: Day 60: Role Reversal Round
episodesList.summary: BB asks the Devils to declare the count of hearts collected, and begin the next round by swapping roles. Angels of round one get set to take revenge.

episodesList.title: Day 61: Whom Would You Choose?
episodesList.summary: After intense arguments for the Nomination Free Pass, the housemates choose their friends and foes. The worst performers get punished, while the best compete for captaincy.

episodesList.title: Day 62: Rules or Rebellion?
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi offers a mix of praise and advice on the housemates' roles as Devils and Angels. He questions the fairness of the Goa Gang's rules and their impact on the game.

episodesList.title: Day 63: Double Eviction
episodesList.summary: VJS discusses Jeffry’s leadership, ration concerns and task conflicts. The atmosphere shifts dramatically when he announces the unexpected double eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 64: Stuck with the Label
episodesList.summary: Captain Ranjith faces a housemate's dissatisfaction during his first task. Rayan and Arun engage in a mockery feud, while housemates wear badges with labels from nominations.

episodesList.title: Day 65: Managers vs Labourers
episodesList.summary: Arun and Deepak argue, after which the housemates pick the top and bottom contestants, leading to heated exchanges. Next, the manager vs labourer task creates chaos in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 66: Swap! Swap! Swap!
episodesList.summary: Heated altercations ensue over team swaps between Managers and Labourers. Later, as Muthu's actions lead to a ban, the Managers punish him for his behaviour.

episodesList.title: Day 67: New Rules, New Conflicts
episodesList.summary: 2.0 of the task begins with some twists and changes, making labourers incharge of the household chores. Commotion ensues when the teams clash and rules get violated.

episodesList.title: Day 68: Vidhuthalai 2 Team Pays a Visit
episodesList.summary: Amidst the celebrations and conflicts, Raanav gets nominated while Jeffry wins the Free pass. The best-worst performers are selected, and special guests surprise the housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 69: Mind-bending Questions from VJS
episodesList.summary: A twist in the tale occurs as VJS decides to begin the day with an eviction. He addresses the housemates' concerns and some of his questions make them rethink their decisions.

episodesList.title: Day 70: VJS Checks on the Housemates
episodesList.summary: Ranjith's captaincy is discussed in detail, after which VJS advises him to change his approach. As one more housemate bid goodbye, the rest have a one-on-one discussion with VJS.

episodesList.title: Day 71: Captaincy and Open Nominations
episodesList.summary: Raanav's unexpected move in the captaincy task changes the dynamics, resulting in Vishal's victory. Post-task arguments and open nominations escalate tensions in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 72: Bricks and Bruises
episodesList.summary: Fierce arguments and clashes erupt as housemates fight to secure and steal bricks for the task. Moreover, tension builds when Raanav’s injury triggers strange speculations.

episodesList.title: Day 73: Team Tiffs
episodesList.summary: Raanav’s exit forces a reshuffle, while foul play allegations hit Jeffry’s team. Amid the chaos, Captain Vishal succumbs to the mounting pressure during the task.

episodesList.title: Day 74: Muyal 2.0
episodesList.summary: Three teams battle intensely to catch the most rabbits and claim the NF pass. Problems arisewhen the women engage in physical struggles and sharp exchanges.

episodesList.title: Day 75: BB Revokes Benefits
episodesList.summary: Jacquline receives an audience-assigned task that leaves her in tears. Contender Muthu’s gameplay during the task upsets BB who then makes shocking announcements.

episodesList.title: Day 76: Applauses with a Dose of Advice
episodesList.summary: VJS commends the housemates for their efforts in the weekly task. Later, he interrogates those who questioned Raanav’s injury and highlights the red team's performance issues.

episodesList.title: Day 77: Who Will Join VJS Onstage?
episodesList.summary: The housemates vote for the "Attenion-seeker" while VJS delves into the details of Vishal's captaincy. Muthu gets an earful for his behaviour, and everyone preps for the eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 78: Bigg Buzz Over the New Chef
episodesList.summary: Housemates get emotional as they talk about who they miss. After Soundarya cooks solo, BB announces no kitchen help from now on, sparking lively debates on future cooking duties.

episodesList.title: Day 79: Family Week
episodesList.summary: Emotions overflow as Deepak, Manjari and Rayan reunite with their families. Vishal’s joy doubles when his loved one unexpectedly makes an entrance.

episodesList.title: Day 80: Emotional Surprises
episodesList.summary: Soundarya, Raanav, Pavithra, and Anshida’s families arrive with surprises and reveal their concerns. In the midst of this, Soundarya and Jacqueline resolve their differences.

episodesList.title: Day 81: Happy Reunions
episodesList.summary: Arun’s sadness fades as BB reveals his prank and brings in his parents. Jeffry, Jacquline and Muthu’s families enter shortly after, turning the house into a whirlwind of happiness.

episodesList.title: Day 82: Support and Surprises
episodesList.summary: As tough weeks approach, the housemates' friends bring advice and encouragement. Arun is overjoyed to see Archana, while Erode Mahesh boosts the morale of all the housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 83: Saturday Eviction
episodesList.summary: VJS asks housemates about their family interactions and their thoughts on the contradictions shared. Later, the house is left in shock as he announces an unexpected eviction.

episodesList.title: Day 84: Ticket to Finale
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan prompts housemates to share new year resolutions and call out the least deserving of votes. Following an eviction, he reveals the much-anticipated Ticket to Finale.

episodesList.title: Day 85: And the Games Begins!
episodesList.summary: Open nominations lead to unrest in the house, while Soundarya and Muthu clash over shopping preferences. Later, BB kick-starts TTF week with the first quirky task.

episodesList.title: Day 86: A Tough Fight
episodesList.summary: The TTF challenge heats up with two tough tasks. Muthu and Raanav get into an altercation, while two others score points—who are they?

episodesList.title: Day 87: New Year, New Challenges
episodesList.summary: Muthu, Jacquline and Soundarya find housemates to execute their Phone tasks, but each face failure. Later, BB hosts a special New Year’s dinner with a twist.

episodesList.title: Day 88: Deals and Disputes
episodesList.summary: The scoreboard turns upside down after the Ball task. Manjari strikes a deal with Rayan, while the Points Mandrum task causes chaos in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 89: One Last Call
episodesList.summary: Arun and Rayan compete to pick up the last call from BB, while Soundarya and Raanav engage in a heated argument. Meanwhile, the top TTF scorers battle it out in the final round.

episodesList.title: Day 90: VJS Questions the Strategy
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan asks the house who they believe does not deserve the TTF and why. Further, he analyses the impact of alliances in the game, with Muthu admitting to his errors.

episodesList.title: Day 91: Meet Your First Finalist
episodesList.summary: VJS questions the housemates on who they think deserved to stay in the game. Moments later, the house erupts with excitement as he enters the house to announce the TTF winner.

episodesList.title: Day 92: Wildcard Knockout!
episodesList.summary: Soundarya sobs from the criticism, while the wildcard announcement leaves the house in panic. However, the situation lightens when they get a task to roast the ex-housemates.

episodesList.title: Day 93: It's Time for Feedback!
episodesList.summary: Ex-contestants of S8 re-enter, go through the task comments, and review the rest of the housemates, leading to chaos. Some take it sportingly, while Vishal feels overwhelmed.

episodesList.title: Day 94: Top 8 vs Challengers
episodesList.summary: Dressed as movie characters, housemates battle with the challengers in Aadiya Aatam Enna task. Minor scuffles draw attention, but BB’s strict warning leaves the wildcards in a fix.

episodesList.title: Day 95: Dance Battles
episodesList.summary: Soundarya breaks down after the top 8 and challengers nominate each other for position swaps. Later, the house buzzes with energy during the one-on-one dance showdown.

episodesList.title: Day 96: Clashes and Confrontations
episodesList.summary: Deepak's words hurt Varshini, and besties Soundarya and Jacquline have a heated argument that puts their friendship at stake. The housemates battle in the final round of the task.

episodesList.title: Day 97: A Surprise Eviction
episodesList.summary: VJS appreciates the character performances of the housemates. He also discusses the reactions and reviews of the ex-contestants and reveals the first evictee of this week.

episodesList.title: Day 98: An Unexpected Elimination
episodesList.summary: The housemates share a memory they wish to erase, and VJS discusses the animosity that the ex-contestants came in with. The eviction results sweep everyone off their feet.

episodesList.title: Day 99: Reunions Cause Chaos
episodesList.summary: BB declares that the challengers failed to replace the finalists and applauds the top six. The rest of the ex-contestants step in one by one, creating a stir in the house.

episodesList.title: Day 100: Pongalo Pongal!
episodesList.summary: The housemates happily celebrate Pongal with BBS5 winner Raju and other special guests. The much-anticipated money box has arrived, but with a twist. Will someone claim it today?

episodesList.title: Day 101: Ma Ka Pa in the House!
episodesList.summary: BB brings in the second money box, and Rayan accepts the challenge to retrieve it within a set time. Ma Ka Pa surprises the housemates and hosts an entertaining podcast with them.

episodesList.title: Day 102: Final Race for the Money Box
episodesList.summary: The next four of the top six try their luck with the money box today. The housemates warmly welcome some special guests, including their beloved Manjari, Raanav, and Deepak.

episodesList.title: Day 103: Let's Rewind
episodesList.summary: The housemates are enthralled with the video compilations of their special bonds and bigg fights of this season. Later, the top five finalists get to relive their journey of S8.

episodesList.title: Day 104: The Last Day in BB House
episodesList.summary: All the housemates together have a blast, with BB's farewell speech being a cherry on top. Later, the ex-contestants convey their wishes and bid goodbye to the finalists.

episodesList.title: Day 105: Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: Five contenders, one trophy and an ultimate showdown! Join Vijay Sethupathi as he crowns this season's winner in an evening of captivating entertainment.

episodesList.title: BBTam: Grand Launch
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns with a new season that’s bold, unpredictable, and dripping with drama. Let the chaos begin!

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 1: Water Woes in the House
episodesList.summary: With water running low, in-charges from Normal and Super Deluxe houses come under fire. Later, the season's first nominations begin with a twist.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 2: Rules Broken, Roles Swapped
episodesList.summary: Ramya breaks down after a heated fight, and the housemates face punishment after Kani breaks a kitchen rule. Later, Nandhini, Kemy and Diwakar share their stories.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 3: The Battle for Captaincy Begins
episodesList.summary: The captaincy task Ponguthey Ponguthey kicks off and housemates face early challenges. Tensions flare when Paaru refuses to clean, sparking clashes and emotional moments.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 4: Taps Dry, Tempers High
episodesList.summary: After Kamrudin oversleeps and misses water, BB and housemates confronts the water monitors. Thala Task 2 begins, and Aadhirai, Kalaiyarasan and Praveen Gandhi share their stories.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 5: Fake Fights, Real Tears
episodesList.summary: The Super Deluxe members are left fuming after a prank by the kitchen team. Later, the announcement of the first Thala leaves Aathirai upset, while Nandhini turns to BB for help.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 6: A Reality Check with VJS
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi demands accountability for this week’s water task mess, questions housemates’ roles and addresses Watermelon Star’s comment. Later, he asks them to spot the fake.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 7: Season’s First Eviction
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan puts the spotlight on the housemates’ powers and their fanbase status. After the first eviction, a surprising twist with the water tank cheers up the housemates.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 8: From Noise to Nominations
episodesList.summary: Hungry housemates stir chaos by waking Super Deluxe members with noise and sabotaging their meal. Nadigan Da Nadigan Da task ends with a swap, and so the nominations begin.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 9: Bommai Battles
episodesList.summary: Paaru's act in the kitchen triggers Thala’s warning and a kitchen strike. Later, the first rounds of the weekly task Bommai Bommai end early as Kemy and Paaru get eliminated.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 10: Strong Defenses and Old Scores
episodesList.summary: The Bommai task restarts with a twist, sparking a massive clash between the houses over the game and stolen onions. Later, Ramya shares her emotional life story.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 11: Thala's Downfall
episodesList.summary: After fierce clashes and chaos, the Bommai task ends, granting one housemate immunity. Later, Thala Tushaar and the house face stern warnings for rule violations.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 12: Captaincy Contenders Face-Off
episodesList.summary: Kani and Sabari are picked as the best performers, while Aathirai and Aurora are sent to jail. The Kuthunga Yajaman Kuthunga task sparks a heated argument among the contenders.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 13: Truth or Tactics?
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi appreciates Kani’s captaincy win and questions Kamrudin's performance in the task. Later, he probes the Bommai task strategies and asks about two-faced housemates.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 14: Happy Deepavali
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi starts with festive cheer, teasing Vinoth and Watermelon Star about their fights. He then questions Tushaar’s captaincy and raises food and salt issues.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 15: Festive Vibes in the House
episodesList.summary: Housemates celebrate Diwali with a Tamil-style oil bath, followed by nominations and a house swap. Dhruv Vikram, along with Team Bison, joins them for the festivities.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 16: BB Juice Factory
episodesList.summary: A tea-time clash sparks tension between FJ and Paaru. Super Deluxe faces friction with the other team, while juice task planning stirs fresh conflicts.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 17: House Drama Over Cleaning Duties
episodesList.summary: FJ, Kemy, and Paaru argue over cleaning duties, sparking tensions in the house. Meanwhile, the Juice Factory task intensifies with QC disputes.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 18: Coins Amid the Chaos
episodesList.summary: BB awards factory owners with coins for approved bottles. QC monitors face pressure from workers, while one housemate takes the lead and reaps the rewards.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 19: The Best and the Worst
episodesList.summary: Paaru's emotional breakdown leads to arguments when Watermelon Star intervenes. The best and worst performers are chosen, while FJ and Aathirai lock horns

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 20: Attention, Housemates!
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi slams the housemates for toxic behaviour and serves bitter gourd juice as a reality check. He probes their task performance and issues stern warnings.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 21: Housemates Spill the Tea
episodesList.summary: Housemates discuss problems during Kani’s captaincy. Subiksha, Viyana and Praveen are saved, while VJS asks who is not performing well, before eviction process.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 22: The Day the House Lost Everything
episodesList.summary: A new captain is chosen, and a swap task is held. Tensions rise as Kani and Paaru clash. After nominations, BB drops a massive twist, taking away all belongings for a hard reset.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 23: The Army Rule Rebellion
episodesList.summary: BB takes all food and essentials. Captain Praveen's army rules spark a clash with Paaru. Arguments erupt with Vinoth and Diwakar during the locker task, leaving the house divided.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 24: Non-stop Drama
episodesList.summary: Watermelon Star clashes with housemates over acting lessons. Tensions ease as the team aces the locker challenge before a surprise visit from team Aan Paavam Pollathathu.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 25: Tug of Words
episodesList.summary: An array of arguments unfolds when Watermelon Star shares his grievances. BB housemates secure 1000 points, while the Yaar Antha Paiyan task gets interrupted by intense tiffs.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 26: Lockers Open, Truths Spoken
episodesList.summary: FJ and Sabari share their life stories, and two housemates win a free pass. After a clash between Vikram and Diwakar, the Locker task ends in a twist and BB issues a demand.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 27: VJS Addresses Groupism in House
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi opens the episode with a loudspeaker, scolding housemates for constant shouting. He questions Ramya and Sabari about groupism and warns against team play.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 28: Wild Cards Enter the Game
episodesList.summary: Praveen faced criticism for his captaincy, prompting VJS to guide him on improvements. Later, VJS welcomed wild cards Prajin, Sandra, Divya, and Amit into the house.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 29: One House, One Rule
episodesList.summary: Divya becomes Thala after BB ends house divisions. Open nominations rattle the house, and contestants share their thoughts on the new wildcards.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 30: Aaha Oho Hotel
episodesList.summary: Kamrudin, Prajan and Praveen’s prank ends on an emotional note. The Aaha Oho Hotel task kicks off with Priyanka, Manjari and Deepak’s arrival, bringing fun and drama to the house.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 31: Manager Under Fire
episodesList.summary: Manager Divya calls an urgent assembly, sparking a fight with Tushaar. Later, tensions during a staff meeting lead BB to announce a management change, voted on by the staff.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 32: Hotel in Turmoil
episodesList.summary: Chaos hits the hotel as Sandra’s wild behaviour and secret spills rattle the guests. Overwhelmed by the turmoil, Manager Vikram gives up. Later, singer Mano visits BB house.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 33: Rifts and Realisations
episodesList.summary: Spotlight shines on Paaru as concern turns to tears when she's crowned this week's best performer. While two land in jail, clashes ripple through the house after the selection.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 34: All Eyes on the Wild Cards
episodesList.summary: This week’s conflicts and a controversial prank draw Vijay Sethupathi's scrutiny. He also puts wild cards under the microscope before unveiling this week’s eviction twist.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 35: Weekly Recap
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi clears the air over the Hotel task drama and shocks everyone with Sandra’s secret mission. He confronts idle contestants before proceeding with an eviction.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 36: Nominations and New Alliances
episodesList.summary: Aurora and Paaru’s clash turns emotional, after which a new Thala is elected. Wild cards aim to split Kani’s group and form a new alliance ahead of nominations.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 37: Gana vs Tharbees Samrajyam
episodesList.summary: Thala Sabari steps in after a complaint from Watermelon Star stirs chaos in the Kitchen team. Later, kingdoms Gana and Tharbees ignite the royal task with special showcases.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 38: The Clash of Samrajyams
episodesList.summary: Vikram and Paaru ascend the thrones, with Paaru addressing grievances against Watermelon Star. As tensions ease, the Samrajyams clash in the Kodi Parakuthu task.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 39: Ranking Task Goes Awry!
episodesList.summary: Heated arguments and punishments shake the Royals task. Later, BB selects Kani, Amit and Vikram to rank housemates by maturity, sparking chaos and drama.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 40: Fights and a Fallout
episodesList.summary: Viyana and Subiksha part ways, while BB punishes FJ for rule breaches. The house descends into chaos during the Worst Performer selection before the Captaincy Mathil task begins.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 41: VJS Warns Against Blind Loyalty
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi highlighted mistakes in the task and warned Watermelon Star and Paaru against blind support. He later questioned FJ and Sabari for neglecting others’ injuries.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 42: VJS Probes Task Abandonment
episodesList.summary: During the kingdom-task discussion, VJS questioned Watermelon Star about why he abandoned the task midway. He then asked all housemates about their 'protection shield'.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 43: Special Guests and Selection
episodesList.summary: FJ becomes the new house Thala, while BB hosts a open-nomination that leaves the housemates perplexed. Later, they identify their competitors, and Team Nadu Center visit them.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 44: Soru Soapu Mopu Task Kicks Off
episodesList.summary: BB housemates competed in the 'Soru Soapu Mopu' task across three squads, following their themed rules. FJ, Vinoth, and Amith later insisted the rules shouldn’t affect eating.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 45: From Arguments to Achievements
episodesList.summary: The selection of the Star and Worst Performer leads to chaos, while Ramya and Kemy break down over the remarks. The Mop Mayavis take the lead in Konjam Paatu Konjam Point task.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 46: Only One Team Stands Tall
episodesList.summary: Team clashes and kitchen walkouts spark tension as captains and housemates argue their way through the week. Poornima’s visit brings brief joy before one team emerges victorious.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 47: Kavin Shows Up with a Surprise
episodesList.summary: Sandra and Divya face penalty as the week’s worst performers. Prajin clashes with Vikram over harsh remarks, and Kavin enters the house with a twist - mid-week eviction.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 48: No Mercy for the Wildcards!
episodesList.summary: Delays, comments and team choices put Sandra and Divya under Vijay Sethupathi's scrutiny. Moreover, Prajin faces a hard-hitting reality check post weekly task's analysis.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 49: Half-Century, Full Surprise
episodesList.summary: Marking 50 days, VJS questions the housemates on who surprised them by making it this far. He probes nomination strategies, sparks eviction drama and hints at a mystery surprise.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 50: A Reality Check from Home
episodesList.summary: Viyana and Divya clash over sugar. Following nominations and the Saanja Pochu captaincy task, housemates receive gameplay tips via video messages from friends.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 51: From School Bells to Star Visit
episodesList.summary: Class is in session at BB School! Kani teacher manages her naughty students, while Keerthy Suresh makes a stunning entry. Later, housemates gather for Amit's birthday bash.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 52: Commotion in the Campus
episodesList.summary: Vikram’s haircut prank sparks chatter, Sabari explodes over food, and Amit criticises Viyana. Students share their views on hostel and school before protesting against staff FJ.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 53: Uniforms Lost, Secrets Found
episodesList.summary: Vikram scolds Viyana for tearing the task letter before she’s hit with a humiliating penalty. Paaru’s missing uniform and a troubling letter about her and Amit leave her in tears.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 54: A Day of Lessons and Penalties
episodesList.summary: Students explore the BB Museum while Viyana sits out for mischief. Later, Ramya and Prajin become the best performers, while FJ and Vinoth land in trouble.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 55: VJS Evaluates Task and Attitude
episodesList.summary: VJS praised the housemates’ efforts in the weekly school task with a framed group photo. FJ was criticised for poor leadership, role mishandling, and a remark about Sandra.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 56: Letters Unveiled, Bonds Shake
episodesList.summary: Housemates read their ‘Mottai Kadithasi’ letters, sparking laughter and fun. Later, the ‘Neetippu Thundippu’ task put friendships and rivalries to the test.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 57: Heartfelt Talks to Heated Debates
episodesList.summary: FJ–Aadhirai and Aurora–Paaru resolve their issues, and a new Thala steps up. Post nominations, boys and girls clash in exciting debates. Who’ll emerge victorious?

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 58: Modern vs Retro Cinema Team
episodesList.summary: Paaru, Aurora and Kamrudin discuss their dynamics, while Vikram and Subiksha mend their rift. Later, Modern vs Retro teams challenge each other to protect the prized necklaces.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 59: BB Schools the Housemates
episodesList.summary: Sandra and Subhiksha’s petty fight, along with a 'ghost' lurking in the house stirs unrest. BB blasts everyone for their lack of effort on the task, and a jewel theft follows.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 60: Jodi Task Turns Turbulent
episodesList.summary: Sabari’s theft lands him in jail, Aurora breaks down over Paaru’s words, and FJ is kicked out. In the Jodi task, chaos erupts as teams clash with fights and fierce verbal wars.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 61: Race to Escape
episodesList.summary: BB makes the house name six best performers and sends the others into jail. While arguments explode, the 10 jailed contestants try to save themselves. Who will stay behind?

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 62: Carelessness Exposed by VJS
episodesList.summary: VJS questioned Viyana on the bucket issue but dropped it after her confused answers. He then called out the housemates for ignoring their roles and being careless.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 63: Recap with VJS
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan asks housemates to name who puts others down and digs into task clashes and grievances. Thala Ramya faces a sharp reality check before eviction begins.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 64: New Week, Same Old Drama
episodesList.summary: Kamrudin’s harsh comments backfire when Aurora and Aadhirai confront him. Later, a new Thala is chosen, and the housemates participate in a new nomination process.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 65: Secrets, Rules and Court Drama
episodesList.summary: Paaru and Kamrudin’s secret mic-free talk prompts BB to confiscate all essentials. The Vazhakkaadu Mandram task starts, while the BB court hears the tense Vinoth–Aadhirai case.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 66: Court Dismissed!
episodesList.summary: The house decides on a punishment for Paaru and Kamrudin. Tension peaks as Aadhirai fights with Amit over FJ’s case outcome. The legal drama continues with Paaru taking on FJ.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 67: Funny Trials and Kitchen Fights
episodesList.summary: Vikram pranks Subhiksha for singing and sues her in a funny trial. Aurora fights a case against Paaru, leaving the decision to the Audience. Later, kitchen duties spark a clash.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 68: Chaos at the BB Court
episodesList.summary: The court trial turns chaotic with constant interruptions. FJ fights Kamrudin. Later, the worst performer is named and Divya clashes with Kamrudin.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 69: House in the Hot Seat
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan kicks off by questioning Paaru and Kamrudin’s antics and calls out silent witnesses of his clash withDivya. Later, the house review Amit’s captaincy.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 70: VJS Delivers the Verdict
episodesList.summary: Housemates are schooled by Vijay Sethupathi for poor court decorum as he reviews the cases. After Aurora speaks up against FJ, he earns a warning for his conduct.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 71: New Captain, Colourful Nominations
episodesList.summary: The captaincy task crowns a new leader. Paaru clashes over duties as teams split. Nominations get colourful with paint, ending in tears for Sandra and Kani.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 72: Dance Marathon 2.0
episodesList.summary: Teams battle it out in a dance marathon as BB announces a special prize. Later, fights erupt over eggs, and the teams manage to score points.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 73: Low on Dance, High on Drama
episodesList.summary: A sleepless night ignites arguments and moral debates between Sandra and some housemates. During the Marathon, some shine with swift guesses while others struggle to find the beat.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 74: Tears, Warnings and a Victory
episodesList.summary: Vikram and Subhiksha breakdown after receiving a warning from BB. Yemmadi Aathaadi team shines in the task while Sandra clashes with Kani over personal remarks.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 75: No Apologies, Only Arguments!
episodesList.summary: Kani confronts Sandra while Paaru and Divya clash. The Captaincy task turns aggressive as FJ lashes out. Best and Worst performers are revealed amidst the chaos.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 76: Vijay Sets the Record Straight
episodesList.summary: Vijay Sethupathi grills Sandra on her conduct and resolves Aadhirai and Vinoth’s issue. He reviews the captaincy and asks the housemates who is overshadowing whom.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 77: Truths, Tensions and Two Evictions
episodesList.summary: Housemates cheer as Vijay Sethupathi spreads Christmas vibes along with Santa. Sandra faces questions again. Excitement builds for Family Week before shocking evictions.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 78: Family Week 2.0
episodesList.summary: Kamrudin grabs the spotlight as his argument with Paaru intensifies, and he takes charge of the house. Nominations follow, and Sandra’s special visitors leave her deeply emotional.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 79: Family Bonds and Fun Loops
episodesList.summary: Kani clashes with Amit amid emotional family entries. Vinoth’s wife cuts a birthday apple and advises him on his anger, while Vikram and Paaru enjoy the freeze loop.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 80: Reunions and Reality Checks
episodesList.summary: Vinoth and Amit talk out their cooking conflict! Further, Divya and Amit meet their loved ones in the Family Week. Will reality checks change the gaming equation?

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 81: Friends, Family and Festive Fun
episodesList.summary: Secret Santa surprises the housemates with gifts and chocolates. Later, Paaru’s mother, Aurora’s friends, and Kamrudin’s family arrive, bringing joy and laughter.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 82: A Day of Advice and Conflicts
episodesList.summary: Paaru's mom exits as Vikram and Subiksha’s families enter the house. Tensions flare as Divya clashes with Vinoth and Paaru over the sponsor task.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 83: VJS Reacts to Family Week Fun
episodesList.summary: Housemates shared their views on which visiting family members impressed them most. VJS also reviewed changes after the family’s entry, captaincy, and the vessel-washing issue.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 84: Top 10 Under the Spotlight
episodesList.summary: VJS applauds the Top 10 and asks them to name who might not deserve a finale ticket. Later, a fierce clash between Vikram and Divya shocks the housemates.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 85: Ticket to Finale Begins
episodesList.summary: Housemates expose PR survivors. Kamrudin sparks a huge fight with Paaru over a sensitive issue, while the ultimate battle begins with the first Ticket to Finale task.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 86: Drama Peaks In Ticket to finale task
episodesList.summary: The Ticket to Finale intensifies! Paaru and Kamrudin clash during the game. In the aftermath, Kamrudin apologizes for his outburst, while Vikram makes peace with Divya.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 87: Task Victories Amidst The Drama
episodesList.summary: Paaru and Sandra discuss strategies. As the Ticket to Finale continues, Sabari and Paaru perform exceptionally well. Meanwhile, Divya clashes with Vikram after a tough task exit.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 88: Coins, Chaos and Celebration
episodesList.summary: Sandra breaks down after fighting Kamrudin. Paaru rages against Vikram's Killer Coin task strategy. Later, the house celebrates with a New Year feast.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 89: Secure Your Spot!
episodesList.summary: Aurora wins Task 7, and the final TTF challenge begins. Housemates squeeze into a car where tempers flare between Kamrudin and Sandra, while Paaru’s gameplay leads to an injury.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 90: No More Warnings!
episodesList.summary: Housemates face intense questioning from VJS over the car task chaos, as he grills them on why no one stopped Paaru and Kamrudin. Later, the duo face the harsh reality.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 91: Meet the First Finalist
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan Vijay Sethupathi returns to meet the contestants! Get ready for a rollercoaster of drama, laughter, emotions, and unexpected twists.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 92: Panapetti 2.0
episodesList.summary: BB offers housemates a daring chance to save a nominee. Viyana’s entry and eviction drama triggers panic. Later, the housemates scramble to stack the cash in the money box.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 93: Big Money Temptation Starts
episodesList.summary: Viyana targets Sandra while Praveen & Diwakar join the house. BB warns Diwakar. After tasks add cash to the pot, the Pana Petti opens! Will anyone take the money box and exit?

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 94: Top Six vs Evictees
episodesList.summary: Panapetti 2.0 task intensifies as housemates race to increase the prize money. Ramya and Apsara enter the house, and evictees battle it out to raise the pot.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 95: Can The Final 6 Pull It Off?
episodesList.summary: The finalists must execute a secret mission to hide Kemy inside the house. Can they complete the multiple levels of the task unnoticed? Meanwhile, the LBW team enters the BB House.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 96: Vinoth's Shocking Move
episodesList.summary: Drama brews with clashes between the Top Six and evictees before the Pulambinaa Panam task. Later, as Aurora reaches the money box, Vinoth drops a shocker that stuns the house.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 97: First Encounters, Final Farewells
episodesList.summary: VJS discusses the shift in dynamics between ex-housemates and finalists. A heartfelt farewell for Vinoth follows, as housemates recall their first interactions.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 98: Chinna Kurumpadam, Bigg Twists
episodesList.summary: Makkal Selvan gives ex-housemates a shot to campaign for the finalists, while Kurumpadam uncovers drama. In a jaw-dropping twist, just 4 finalists survive and Sandra waves goodbye.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 99: Finale Week
episodesList.summary: The Top Four light up as Amit, Kalaiyarasan, Prajin and Tushaar arrive. Misunderstandings between Aurora and Tushaar vanish, and the house gears up for the finale with fun tasks.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 100: Celebrating the Bigg Milestone
episodesList.summary: The winning speeches of the finalists take center stage, while Aurora hands a letter to Tushaar. A prank by Kani and Subhiksha upsets Vikram, before housemates celebrate 100 days.

episodesList.title: BB Tam Day 101: Friendship, Fights and Feelings
episodesList.summary: Diwakar fights Divya. Sandra and Vinoth return, resolving issues and consoling Aurora. The house celebrates Bhogi and bonds over friendship memories.

episodesList.title: BBTam Day 102: Pongalo Pongal!
episodesList.summary: The Bigg Boss house is buzzing! New tasks, wild missions, and explosive fights bring real drama and endless entertainment.

episodesList.title: BB Tam Day 103: A Blast from the Past
episodesList.summary: A fight compilation sparks a clash between Prajean and Diwakar. Sandy and Kavin visit for a movie promo and dance! Vikram gets emotional watching his journey video.

episodesList.title: BB Tam Day 104: The Final Night in the House
episodesList.summary: Divya, Sabari & Aurora relive their journeys. The Top four get a makeover for the finale. BB's touching words leave everyone in tears as ex-contestants bid a heavy-hearted goodbye.

episodesList.title: BB Tam Day 105: Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: The wait is over! The 105-day journey ends tonight as Vijay Sethupathi lights up the stage to crown the winner of this season.

title: Bakula Bua Ka Bhoot
summary:
Bakula Bua ka Bhoot is a Hindi comedy drama that started on June 24, 2017 on &TV.
The show is about Bakula's family wanting Bakula to die because everyone in the house wants to do what they please. Mohit is the sensible one in the house. He loves Bakula Bua the most, more than his own mother. One day everyone prays to god that Bakula would die, and it happens. Bakula is now back on earth as a ghost and is going to get back at her family.

references.label: Bakula Bua Ka Bhoot review: The light-hearted comedy show is perfect to entertain you on weekends

She addresses Lord Krishna her husband and also and treats him too. title: Bhaag Bakool Bhaag
summary: Bhaag Bakool Bhaag (transl. Run Bakool Run) is an Indian Hindi-language sitcom. It starred Jay Soni as the titular character with Hiba Nawab and Shruti Rawat.
plot: The sitcom is about Bakool who lives two lives. One in a Rural area and other in an Urban area. What has got him in trouble is that he has two wives in his two lives. Soon, there is a leap of one month and it is shown that both Jigna and Sheena (Bakool's wives) are pregnant with his children. Kokila and Ranjeet are overjoyed. Eventually, everything is revealed in front of everyone and all the characters realize that Bakul was a victim of circumstances and not a fraudster. The show culminates with Bakool feeding both his wives, thereby helping them in completing the rituals of their respective fasts, and both the parties accepting Bakool.

title: Boygiri
summary:
Boygiri is a 2017 Hindi web series, created and produced by Tanveer Bookwala for the video on demand platform ALTBalaji. The web series is about six friends whose lives are filled with adventures and crazy moments.
The series is available for streaming on the ALT Balaji App and its associated websites since its release date.

title: Baahubali: The Lost Legends
summary: Baahubali: The Lost Legends is an Indian television animated series that is a part of the Baahubali franchise, produced by Arka Media Works and Graphic India. The series revolves around the young princes Amarendra Baahubali and Bhallaladeva in the Mahishmati kingdom. The series serves as a prologue to Baahubali: The Beginning and Baahubali 2: The Conclusion. The first season aired on Amazon Prime Video from 19 April to 11 August 2017.
plot:
Baahubali - The Lost Legends is set before the Kalakeya invasion depicted in the movie, when Baahubali and Bhallaladeva are still both young princes of Mahishmati. It chronicles two brothers competing to rule the greatest kingdom of its age and the epic adventures they must endure to prove they are worthy to one day wear the crown. Under the watchful eye of Sivagami, and the slave warrior, Kattappa, one shall rise to be King of the throne, while the other shall become King of the people. The animated series features new, never before revealed stories about the characters from the film including Prince Baahubali, Bhallaladeva, Kattappa and Sivagami, as well as dozens of new characters.
The series follows princes and cousins Amarendra Baahubali and Bhallaladeva, who work to defend the kingdom of Mahishmati from the forces of evil.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text: The animated series was created by S. S. Rajamouli, Sharad Devarajan and Arka Mediaworks, who are all Producers, along with Jeevan J. Kang, Graphic India's EVP Creative and the lead character designer for the animated series, along with Graphic India's senior animation writer, Ashwin Pande.

articleSections.title: Characters
articleSections.text: Amarendra Baahubali – Baahubali is a boisterous young prince of the Mahishmati kingdom and the son of former king Vikramadeva. He is a skilled warrior who cares deeply about the people in his kingdom. * Bhallaldeva – He's the son of Queen Shivagami and Lord Bijjaladeva. He is also a contender for the throne and wants to rule the kingdom with an iron fist. * Sivagami – She is the mother of Bhallaldeva and the wife of Bijjaladeva. She rules over the kingdom since Vikramadeva's death but never occupies the throne herself. * Kattappa – He is an exceptional warrior and a loyal commander of the Mahishmati kingdom's army. He often comes to the rescue of people in trouble, be it Mahishmati subjects or the royal family itself. * Bijjaladeva – He is the father of Bhallaldeva and the husband of Shivagami. Motivated by greed and power, he wants his son to succeed and claim the throne and doesn't fancy Baahubali at all. * Pradhan Guru – He is a mysterious character who shows up to be the royal teacher. He is an extremely skilled fighter and eqaully as cunning and resourcefull. His ulterior motives against Mahishmati ultimately lead to his demise at the hands of Kattappa * Yadhuvanshi – The King of Rudragni and ally of Mahismati who is ultimately killed by his daughter, Princess Yamagni in a plot hatched by his son Prince Varaah. When he first appears, he is an old and sick man. * Varaah – Varaah was the King of the Rudragni Kingdom. He was a vicious and ruthless ruler who only yearned for power and wealth. After having his father, King Yadhuvanshi killed by his sister he quickly usurps the throne. He despises the Mahismati and the royal family, but is jealous of their wealth and power. His hidden family consisting of fisherwoman and son are used by Bhallaldeva as leverage in his bid for the throne. His alliance with Dharmraj ultimately leads to his death when he is stabbed by his sister Yamagani. * Yamagni – Yamagni is the sister of Varaah and the Queen of the Rudragni Kingdom. Unlike her brother, she is a kind-hearted and brave person, and lover of Bahubali. Yamagni is responsible for the death of her father, King Yadhuvanshi. Yamagni also reluctantly struck up a deal with Pradan Guru to help her become the ruler of Rudragni. Rajmata Shivgami learns of her betryal and blackmails her to cut all ties with Bahubali. She later kills her brother Varaah and becomes the Queen. * Aakansh – He is a good friend of both the princes, Bahubali and Bhallaladeva. Bhallaladeva's hatred for him ends with his death in Amaram Kingdom. * Sujata – Sujata is the intelligent inventor of Jwalarajyam Kingdom, a kingdom known for its large library which holds all the knowledge of the world. In the process of defending Jwalarajyam, Bahubali befriends Sujata. She proves to an asset to Mahishmati and Bahubali numerous times. * Dharmraj – Dharmraj is the self-proclaimed son of Jayadeva, the alleged elder brother of King Somadeva; however, his false stories are exposed, and he is overthrown. * Zoravar – Zoravar is the slave-turned-king of Barigaza who faced many hurdles and overcame many opponents to assemble a large army and hold a position of power. He is a compassionate and kind king who is impressed with Bahubali's valor and becomes Mahishmati's ally. He has a wife, Ranaka Devi, and a son, Karan Singh. * Mahabali – Mahabali is the leader of an unnamed tribe in the northern mountains and an old friend of Kattappa. He later retires and places his son Bheemdutt as the leader. * Kalpana Devi – Kalpana Devi is the Queen of Agartha Kingdom. She was a vagabond in her early life until King Shrutsen of Agartha falls in love with her. He teaches Kalpana everything he knows about combat and war strategy. After King Shrutsen is betrayed by his ministers who allied with Bijjaladeva, she vows to never let Mahismati misuse its power again. Her army only consists of warrior women. She wields the Hachiman which belonged to Shrutsen. She has previously massacred many kingdoms, including Amaram, Kalekeyas, and Zoraver's army. She commands Shivagami to crown Bahubali the King so nobody has to suffer like Agartha under the might of Mahismati. Kalpana Devi dies an honorable death at the hands of Shivgami in battle. Her dying wish was that the Hachiman be returned to Nippon. * Paramhans – Paramhans is the king of Amaram Kingdom and commander of the most skilled and disciplined warriors. He is an ally of Mahishmati (by striking a viciou deal with Bhallaladeva) and wants to take revenge on Bahubali who caused his son's death in a fight to save Aakanksh. Paramhans and his kingdom are later destroyed by Kalpana Devi. * Kaalakhanjar – He was the vicious leader of the Sea Pirates and a legend among seamen. After the birth of his daughter Ayesha he changes his way and loots only to support his island community of outcasts. He dies at the hands of his irascible daughter. In his dying breath he proclaims his daughter to be the next Kalakhanjar. * Ayesha – Ayesha the daughter of Kaalakhanjar, succeeds her father as the leader of Sea Pirates after accidentally killing him. She holds Bahubali responble for Kaalakhanjar's death and forms and alliance with Kalpana Devi to destroy Mahishmati and Bahubali. However, after coming to terms with herself and Bahubali's good nature she befriends him again. * Madam Koi – Koi was an opportunistic lady who kidnapped children of the country side to serve her as slaves and to extract ransom from the parents. She took advantage of the lawlessness of the ravaged lands to take over a small castle with her band of goons. Bahubali and Bhalladeva infiltrate her grounds with the help of the villagers and resuce the children. * King Torra – King Torra was one of the two warlords of Nippon, and the enemy of warlord Okami. He used to be a just and kind King until the war with Okami drove him to attack and loot his own subjects. Like Okami he wants to obtain the legendary Hachiman. He even struck his son when he questioned his father's cruel ways. His 20 year long stalemate with Okami has driven Nippon into desolation. He is killed by Okami in a final fight. * King Okami – King Okami was the other warlord of Nippon, and the enemy of Torra. He was a cruel and merciless ruler who used Shinobis for his dirty work. As the other member of the stalemate, he also ravaged the country and wants to acquire the Hachiman. He is killed by Torra in a final fight. * Shinji/Karasu – Shinji is the long-lost son of Torra. The former had left Torra because the latter had attacked him in a rage when he was a child. Shinji later adopts the name Karasu San and becomes the leader of the Tengu tribe of Shinobis. He also befriends Bahubali, and later becomes the King of Nippon, wielding the Hachiman Sword. * Kensai – Kensai was an extremely skilled swordsman who travelled the world to spar with other great warriors. He wielded the legendary Katana Hachiman. Kensai served under Torra as a Samurai while he battled with his soul and external code of honour as he watched his leader become a merciless killer. He eventually leaves Torra when he strikes Shinji and sends the Hachiman to King Shrutsen of Agartha.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text:
The first episode premiered on 19 April 2017 and the other episodes started streaming from 19 May onwards with a new episode releasing every Friday. Season 1 ended on 11 August 2017 with the episode "The Tournament Of Champions Part 2". Season 2 premiered on 16 February 2018 with all 13 episodes released same day, All 13 episodes of Season 3 were released on 28 April 2018 and all 16 episodes of season 4 were released on 10 April 2019.
Colors TV acquired the television rights of the series. The series premiered on Colors on 10 December 2017. In UAE the series premiered on 5 January 2018 on Colors TV ME.

title: Bikele Bhorer Phool
summary: Bikele Bhorer Phool was an Indian Bengali series which airs on Zee Bangla channel. It starred Sudipta Chakraborty and Amitabh Bhattacharjee in the lead roles and Sneha Chatterjee in a pivotal role. The show was written and directed by Snehasish Chakraborty. It premiered on 27 February 2017 and airs at 9:00 pm from Monday to Saturday. Its final episode aired on 1 December 2017. It was replaced by Bokul Kotha.
plot:
It is an unusual love story of a village girl and a city-bred doctor. The show focuses on a young Moina and a middle-aged Dr. Subhankar who get married in a turn of events. Life takes a turn when poor and naughty Moina is introduced to the luxurious lifestyle of Dr. Subhankar and his family members. Moina creates trouble and havoc in the lives of Subhankar's family members and she is disliked by them. However, Nupur, who loves Subhankar, decides to train Moina and make her eligible for Dr. Subhankar. 'Bikele Bhorer Phool' is a unique phrase which describes Moina and Dr. Subhankar's love story. The saying goes - "When two souls are meant for each other, they will find a way to meet, however different they are." Love is indeed the acceptance of difference not the search for similarities and more the difference, steadier the relationship. When Moyna, a high-spirited, fun-loving, mischievous, unruly, pampered village belle meets a city-bred, serious, no-nonsense, middle-aged, mellow Doctor, Subhankar, there is a war of words, thoughts and outlook towards life. Subhankar's disciplined character and thought process is obliterated right away by the simple facts of life as derived by Moyna. They say marriages are made in heaven. On earth, society's set rules of discrimination of age, caste, creed, background take a back seat in 'Bikele Bhorer Phool' where two diametrically opposite persons refuse to give up on each other and embark on a divine journey of marriage.
Dr. Subhankar realizes that Moina needs to be educated to adjust with her family who have all completed their Masters. She is admitted to a school on recommendations. Meanwhile, Konok Kakon plots a dangerous plot to get the ownership of Dr. Subhankar Banerjee Nursing Home from Subhankar. She puts public pressure on him and succeeds in her mission. Marriage of Nupur or according to Moina Bhalo Didi's has been fixed. Shubhankar has decided to take the responsibility.
Moina does not know that her father is alive and her father is none other than Konok Kakon's husband. Konok Kakon will try to kill Moina but Nupur will save her from death. Moina will save the Banerjee family from troubles and danger. Will Nupur die what is awaiting them? Moina saves Nupur from the dangerous plot by Konok Kakon. Later Subhankar signs the property papers and makes the Banerjee house in Dipankar wife Anjali's name. Will Moina save the Banerjee house from selling to someone else? Moyna will finally know that her father is none other than Palash Patra (Konok Kakon's husband). She will run to him to the hospital but Konok Kakon makes a fake Moina to go to Polash before Moina does. Will Moina expose Konok Kakon and the fake Moina? Later, Konok Khakon Makes a conspiracy against Subhankar to make his clinic in her name and make him jailed for a fake death case but her plan succeeded on making the Subhankar"s clinic in her name and she does not succeed in putting Subhankar in jail. Moina Saves him on Time and exposes Konok Khakon in front of everyone and then Anjali tries to create a misunderstanding between Moina and Nupur (Balo didi) and she succeeds in making a rift between Moina and Balo didi and Moina Leaves the Banerjee house because of this and she vows to bring Subhankar Doctor Register Certificate back. After many Twist, Moina Come back to Banerjee house to Give Dr Subhankar Banerjee his doctor register certificate back to his aunt and Subhankar"s aunt accepts Moina as the eldest daughter-in-law of Banerjee house. In the last episode, Nupur marries Aditya and Subhankar meets with an accident (which turned out to be a fake and a plan between Subhankar and Moina just to expose Aditya's true colours in front of everyone), but later forgives Aditya for his misdeeds. The show ends on a happy note with Subhankar and Moina confessing their love for each other and they unite.

She will run to him to the hospital but Konok Kakon makes a fake Moina to go to Polash before Moina does. Will Moina expose Konok Kakon and the fake Moina? Later, Konok Khakon Makes a conspiracy against Subhankar to make his clinic in her name and make him jailed for a fake death case but her plan succeeded on making the Subhankar"s clinic in her name and she does not succeed in putting Subhankar in jail. Moina Saves him on Time and exposes Konok Khakon in front of everyone and then Anjali tries to create a misunderstanding between Moina and Nupur (Balo didi) and she succeeds in making a rift between Moina and Balo didi and Moina Leaves the Banerjee house because of this and she vows to bring Subhankar Doctor Register Certificate back. After many Twist, Moina Come back to Banerjee house to Give Dr Subhankar Banerjee his doctor register certificate back to his aunt and Subhankar"s aunt accepts Moina as the eldest daughter-in-law of Banerjee house. In the last episode, Nupur marries Aditya and Subhankar meets with an accident (which turned out to be a fake and a plan between Subhankar and Moina just to expose Aditya's true colours in front of everyone), but later forgives Aditya for his misdeeds. The show ends on a happy note with Subhankar and Moina confessing their love for each other and they unite.
tagline: It is an unusual love story of a village girl and a city-bred doctor.

title: Bin Kuch Kahe
summary:
Bin Kuch Kahe is an Indian Hindi comedy-drama finite television series, which airs from 6 February 2017 and is broadcast on Zee TV at 6.30 PM (IST). The series is produced by Rajshree Ojha and is set in Jaipur. The series is aired on weekdays' evenings. The show went off air on 18 August 2017 and got by replaced by Zee TV new Horror show Bhootu. The show is broadcasting in South Africa and aired on eBella on Monday 5, March 2018. Shamata Anchan and Sameer Arora are playing the main female and male lead roles respectively.
Bin Kuch Kahe marks the launch of filmmaker Rajshree Ojha as a producer and journalist turned critic Ram Kamal Mukherjee as an associate producer. This finite series is directed by television director Ashish Patil, and Mitesh Chitalia. The casting has been done by casting director Kashyap Chandhock. It has been shot entirely in Jaipur at Zee Studio. The show has been developed and written by Satyam Tripathy who has earlier written the iconic Zee TV shows '12/24 Karol Bagh' and 'Hitler Didi'. The show is about three sisters and their journey in a dysfunctional family, with a troublesome mother, portrayed by television newcomer Archana Mittal.
This 160 episode serial also marks the comeback of Shamata Anchan as main lead after Ashutosh Gwarikar's serial Everest. She is paired opposite model turn actor Sameer Arora. Both Shamata and Sameer has been styled by costume designer from USA, who flew down specially to give them a different look. Noted journalist and former editor of Stardust, Ram Kamal Mukherjee makes his debut as an associate producer. Rajshree Ojha known for her film Aisha with Sonam Kapoor and Abhay Deol, worked almost one year on the subject.
plot:
This is the story of the lives of 3 sisters who live in a dysfunctional family. Abha the eldest runs a canteen called the Kohli Canteen. She has a son called Aryan. Rhea is the second sister who wants to be a rockstar and Myra the youngest wants to be a journalist. This show is completely set in Jaipur.
The soap opera begins with Rhea's engagement to Nikhil. After the engagement, Myra goes to Mumbai after pleading her mom. She goes with her friends for 1 week. There in a bar she meets a charming international journalist named Kabir. They meet almost every day making Myra hate Kabir more. She then has an interview with Zee news for being a journalist. She gets into the job and realizes that Kabir is also a staff of Zee news.
After her interview, she gets a call from Abha saying that Riya has broken the marriage with Nikhil. She gets upset and drinks alcohol. Kabir then helps her and takes her to his house. The next day Myra feels bad about what happened and decides to leave Mumbai without telling anybody. By that time she had got the job. Myra's mom, Sudha Kohli is a very possessive mother and does not allow Myra to go to Mumbai to continue her passion.
Then there is a 1-year jump. It is seen that Myra has got into a local news channel which telecasts insensible news. Rhea sings in the canteen while Abha manages the canteen.
One day Kabir comes to Jaipur for work purpose. There he meets Rhea and becomes good friends with her. She introduces him to the Kohli family which Myra did not like. Myra soon finds out that Kabir is her new boss. Myra hates Kabir and asks Rhea to stay away from Kabir. Kabir helps Rhea with her dreams and she signs into a contract with a famous music company.
