episodesList.summary: Rajiv tells Suman that Shubh wants to give them a surprise. Saanjh gets ready to marry Rajiv. Saanjh and Rajiv exchange garlands in front of all guests. Arjun enters the wedding hall along with Shubh. Rajiv secretly escapes from the hall. Arjun asks Saanjh if Maya is involved in Prem's murder.

episodesList.title: Rajiv Abducts Maya
episodesList.summary: Arjun tells Saanjh's family that he is going out to search Rajiv. Rajiv comes to Maya's house. He tells Janhavi that he is going to marry Maya. Rajiv abducts Maya and brings her near a river. Maya clears it to Rajiv that she does not love her.

episodesList.title: Arjun Rescues Maya From Rajiv
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Saanjh plan to rescue Maya from Rajiv. Rajiv tells Maya that he wants to spend rest of his life with her. Saanjh requests Rajiv to not cause any harm to Maya. Rajiv gets injured when a heavy anchor hits his stomach. Arjun angrily tells Maya that he will not forgive her for her mistakes.

episodesList.title: Arjun Organizes Maya's Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: Arjun prepares a cake and offers it to Saanjh. Later, Arjun comes to a mental asylum to meet his pregnant wife Maya. Maya thanks Arjun for supporting her through thick and thin. Arjun invites his family for Maya's baby shower. A police enters the hall to arrest Maya.

episodesList.title: Ayan And Saanjh Attend Maya's Baby Shower
episodesList.summary: Ayan enters Maya's house to attend her baby shower. Arjun and Maya get shocked to see Saanjh in their house. Maya apologizes to Saanjh for her past mistakes. Ayan reminds Saanjh that Maya was involved in Prem's murder. He advises Saanjh to stay away from Maya. Ayan angrily tells Vandana that Maya has ruined his life.

episodesList.title: Maya Spots Arjun Along With Saanjh
episodesList.summary: Ayan tells Maya that Arjun doesn't love her. He informs Maya that Arjun spent his time with Saanjh in her absence. Ayan takes Maya to Saanjh's house. Arjun meets Saanjh on the terrace of her apartment. Arjun gets shocked to see Maya along with Ayan. Saanjh clears it to Maya that she doesn't love Arjun.

episodesList.title: Maya Hits Ayan With Her Car
episodesList.summary: Maya tells Ayan that though she is mentally ill, she loves Arjun a lot. Ayan records Maya's statement in a camera. Maya requests him to not share the video with Arjun. Later, Maya hits Ayan with her car. She steals his camera and goes back to her house. Saanjh gets shocked to see Ayan in pool of blood.

episodesList.title: Saanjh Blames Maya For Ayans Accident
episodesList.summary: Saanjh calls Arjun and informs him that Ayan has met with an accident. Arjun rushes towards the hospital to see Ayan. Later, Saanjh tells Arjun that Maya wanted to kill Samay. Arjun asks Saanjh to not blame Maya for Ayan's accident. Saanjh advises Vandana to stay away from Maya. Vandana decides to reveal Maya's secret to Arjun.

episodesList.title: Maya Loses Her Child
episodesList.summary: Maya anxiously tells Vandana that she had rammed her car into Ayan. Vandana angrily tells Maya that she is going to inform Arjun about her evil intentions. Maya tries to stop Vandana from leaving her house. Maya falls on her stomach when Vandana tries to hold her hands. Arjun admits Maya in a hospital. He learns that Maya has lost her baby.

episodesList.title: Arjun Loses His Cool
episodesList.summary: Maya gets a miscarriage after falling from the stairs. Arjun is completely shattered and blames his mother for the incident. Police comes to arrest Arjun's mother after Maya filed a case of domestic violence. However, Arjun told the police that Maya is mentally ill and asks them to go back. Find out what happened next.

episodesList.title: Arjun Ends Relationship With Maya
episodesList.summary: Arjun loses his cool and tells Maya that he doesn't care for her anymore and that their relationship was a mere adjustment. He wants everyone to leave him alone. Vandana expresses her guilt to Saanjh and asks her to take care of Arjun. Find out what happened next.

episodesList.title: Ayan Comes Out Of Coma
episodesList.summary: Maya follows Vandana back home to kill her. Maya tells her that Bandar was the bond between her and Arjun and Vandanda was responsible to break it. Meanwhile, Ayan comes out of coma and informs Saanjh that Maya tried to kill him and she should call police before something serious happens. Watch this episode of Beyhadh to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Maya's Killing Streak Continues
episodesList.summary: Saanjh hurries back to Vandana's apartment to save her. Upon reaching the apartment, Saanjh is relieved to find Vandana sleeping in her bed. She immediately calls up Ayan and tells him that Vandana is alright. After cutting the call, Saanjh cuddles near Vandana but to her utter shock, she finds that Vandana has no pulse. Find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Arjun Kills Maya
episodesList.summary: Maya provokes Arjun to kill her. In a fit of rage, Arjun attacks Maya. Maya explains to Arjun that she does not regret killing the one responsible for the death of her unborn child. Then, Arjun loses his cool and pushes Maya. Arjun, too, falls on the ground and loses consciousness. Maya hits her head onto a table and bleeds profusely.

episodesList.title: Arjun Is Arrested
episodesList.summary: The police arrest Arjun for Maya's murder. Ayaan and Saanjh are in disbelief about the entire incident. The police suspect that Arjun murdered Maya for financial gains. Later, in the police station, Ayaan claims that Arjun is being framed. But, Arjun makes a startling claim by stating that he killed Maya.

episodesList.title: Maya's Confession
episodesList.summary: Arjun reveals to Saanjh that Maya threatened to murder her if he did not kill her. He also said that Maya had confessed that she had plotted a fake rape scene to trap Ayaan. Watch this episode of Beyhadh to find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Ayaan Performs Final Rites of His Mother
episodesList.summary: Ayaan performs final rites of his mother and is heart broken that Arjun couldn't be there alongside.ewly assigned investigation officer Ranvir Singh interrogates Arjun and tells him that he has Maya's letter as evidence to prove him guilty. Saanjh however thinks there is a conspiracy behind the chain of events. See this episode of Beyhadh to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Saanjh In Police Custody
episodesList.summary: Saanjh, who believes that Maya has framed Arjun in her murder, sneaks into Maya's apartment to find evidence to prove her point. But, her plan fails as the police also arrive at the scene and arrest her. Later, the police interrogate Saanjh and Arjun. During the interrogation, the police show Maya's diary to Arjun. In the diary, Maya has claimed that Arjun wanted to kill her unborn child.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Trial Begins
episodesList.summary: Ayaan meets Arjun at the prison where they both notice that the media have already given their verdict by deeming Arjun to be Maya's murderer. Meanwhile, Arjun feels that Maya had made the plan to frame him for her murder, long back. He also tells Ayaan that he now hates and despises Maya more than anything else. Later, Arjun and Saanjh are produced before the court where their trial commences. The public prosecutor accuses Arjun of marrying Maya for extorting her wealth and of having an extramarital affair with Saanjh. Arjun denies the accusations levelled against him but his pleas fall on deaf ears.

episodesList.title: Saanjh Appears As A Witness
episodesList.summary: During the courtroom proceedings, Pooja claims in the court that Arjun consipred with Saanjh to kill Maya. Pooja produces key witnesses in the case to prove that Arjun was having an affair with Saanjh. Arjun in a fit of rage, raises his hand on Pooja.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Startling Confession
episodesList.summary: During the courtroom proceedings, Pooja proves that Arjun attacked Maya with an intention to kill her. Arjun's fingerprints are also found on Maya's neck, proving that he attacked her. When Pooja stresses on the point that Arjun conspired with Saanjh, Arjun loses his cool and shouts out in anger that he killed Maya and Saanjh is innocent.

episodesList.title: Maya's New Avatar
episodesList.summary: Saanjh recalls Arjun's words and checks Maya's dead body to determine whether Maya is still alive. Then, she meets Arjun in the prison and informs him about it. Arjun is now absolutely sure that Maya is still alive. Later, Saanjh informs Ayaan that she will get Arjun released from prison at any cost. Meanwhile, Maya takes on a new avatar to come back into Arjun's life with a vengeance. Keep watching Beyhadh to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Revenge
episodesList.summary: Arjun is seething with revenge while serving his sentence, fully aware that Maya is still alive. Maya is patiently waiting for an opportunity to get back into Arjun's life. Arjun's quest for revenge is making him more angrier than ever. His rage is fuelling his desire to get out of prison and find Maya. Meanwhile, Saanjh arrives at the prison to meet Arjun. A few prisoners try to molest her but Arjun arrives to her rescue.

episodesList.title: Arjun Reveals His Plan To Saanjh
episodesList.summary: Maya learns that Arjun is about to be hanged. Meanwhile, Arjun tells Saanjh in a letter that the attack on her in the jail was planned by him. He wanted to be transferred to a solitary prison and that all of this is the part of his plan to escape from the jail. However, Ayaan reads this letter as well and makes a plan of his own.

episodesList.title: Maya Meets A Match
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Maya are headed for a collision course. Both want to destroy each other. Arjun is planning an escape and informs Saanjh about it. Saanjh advises him against it. Then, Ayaan meets the police and informs that Arjun is planning an escape. Will Arjun's great escape materialise? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Great Escape
episodesList.summary: Arjun is preparing himself to break out of prison. He plans an escape with the help of Saanjh. At night, Arjun's plan bears fruit and he escapes from his cell. Unfortunately for him, a constable finds out that he has escaped and alerts the other officers. A surprise in the form of Ayaan awaits Arjun when he gets out of the prison. What follows is a twist Arjun would have never fathomed, even in his dreams.

episodesList.title: Maya's Coffin
episodesList.summary: The tale takes an unexpected turn as Ayaan tricks Arjun and administers an injection to Arjun, which knocks him out. A doctor is called in to check on Arjun. Then, Arjun is taken to the hospital and Saanjh accompanies him. While on the way, the ambulance meets with an accident. As the attention of the police is distracted, Arjun makes an escape.

episodesList.title: Love And Destruction
episodesList.summary: Ayaan conspired with Saanjh to help Arjun escape from prison. Maya tries to escape from the coffin after hearing news about Arjun on the radio. Then, Maya learns that Arjun has escaped from prison. Later, Saanjh arrives at the police station and questions the police officer about the whereabouts of Arjun. Saanjh pretends to be innocent. Meanwhile, Arjun is preparing to himself to exact revenge on Maya.

episodesList.title: The Return Of Samay'
episodesList.summary: The police are forced to release Saanjh, Suman, and Subh. Before leaving the police station, Saanjh reveals to the police that she will get Ayaan out of jail and prove Arjun's innocence and challenges him to stop her from doing so. Meanwhile, Maya is distraught that Arjun has taken away their opportunity to get together after their death. Later, Arjun shares his plan to take his revenge on Maya with Saanjh.

episodesList.title: Saanjh Admitted In Asylum
episodesList.summary: Maya is terrified to see Samay alive again. She runs away from him but Samay catches up and tells her that he is the only person in the world who can truly love her but Maya manages to escape. Meanwhile, Arjun and Saanjh dress up as an old couple and visit the asylum where Maya had stayed. Saanjh, who acts like a patient with multiple personality disorder, plans to visit the room where Maya was kept in order to gain clues about who had helped her in planning all of what she had done.

episodesList.title: Knocking On Deaths Door
episodesList.summary: After cheating death, Samay has come to exact revenge on Maya. Upon being confronted, Maya tries to run away from Samay. But, Samay, like death, follows Maya like a shadow. Meanwhile, Saanjh finds herself in trouble when the inmates at the asylum confront her.evertheless, Saanjh has decides to sneak into Maya's room and find some clues about Maya.

episodesList.title: Maya's Race Against Time
episodesList.summary: Samay reveals to Maya the events that occurred after she had tried to kill him. Meanwhile, Saanjh assures Arjun that she will be safe. Then, she sneaks into Maya's room and searches for any clues. Maya is still facing the barrel of the gun. Samay gives the gun to Maya and asks her to shoot him. Will Maya pull the trigger and end Samay's time on the Earth, once and for all? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Arjun Saves Saanjh
episodesList.summary: The ward boy takes away Saanjh's phone in order to provide information. Arjun waits patiently outside for Saanjh's signal. Meanwhile, Maya finds company in Samay's company and the latter informs her that Arjun and Saanjh are searching for her. He shows her the video footage of the ward boy forcefully administering electric shock treatment to Saanjh. Then, Arjun saves Saanjh and sends a message to Maya.ow, Maya is more determined than ever to kill Saanjh.

episodesList.title: Police Surround Arjun and Saanjh
episodesList.summary: The police surround Arjun and Saanjh and order him to surrender. Arjun comes up with a plan to sneak out of the hospital without being caught by the police. When the police barge into the hospital ward, Arjun and Saanjh have managed to escape. Maya and Samay learn about Arjun and Saanjh's escape through the news channels and waits to meet Arjun and Saanjh.

episodesList.title: Arjun Finds Maya
episodesList.summary: Despite being with Samay', Maya plans to kill both him and Sanjh and get together with Arjun. Meanwhile, the police raids Sanjhs house, and they learn about the location of Sanjh and Arjun from Shubh's laptop. The police stops the bus Arjun and Sanjh were travelling, however, the duo manage to escape. They continue their search for Maya, and Arjun finally sees her in a market. Will he be able to confront him? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Rajeev Traps Saanjh
episodesList.summary: While Arjun chases the clue left behind by Maya, Rajeev torments Saanjh in the jungle. Saanjh steps into a trap set for her and Rajeev reveals himself from the shadows. Despite all the pleading from Saanjh, Rajeev prepares to burn her to death as Rajeev enters a race against time to save her from his hands.

episodesList.title: Arjun Saves Saanjh
episodesList.summary: Arjun manages to trace down the clue left behind by Saanjh and save her from being harmed by Rajeev. A fight ensues between the due and Arjun manages to escape with Saanjh before the police arrives. Arjun tells Saanjh takes he cannot risk her life anymore in order to chase down Maya and that he will surrender to the police. But just before he could do so, Rajeev traces them down and threatens to kill Saanjh.

episodesList.title: Another Betrayal
episodesList.summary: Rajeev calls Maya and then kills Saanjh. Maya is pleased with the fact that, finally, all the biggest obstacle between her and Arjun is dead. Rajeev tells Maya that he is bringing along Arjun with him so that she can kill him with her own hands. However, when Rajeev arrives, he brings along with him two coffins. Maya is shocked to see Arjun in one of those. How will she react? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Samay's Confession
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Samay' tie up Maya on a chair. Samay' goes on to tell Maya how Arjun and Saanjh had convinced him to join them when he had gone to kill the former. Samay' tells Maya that before committing another crime for her, he wanted to test whether she deserves such loyalty. Later, Saanjh collapses and Arjun takes her away to get her some rest while Samay' is left to watch after Maya.

episodesList.title: Maya Turns The Game On Its Head
episodesList.summary: The police surrounds the place where Arjun, Maya, Saanjh, and Rajeev were hiding. They break in to find the dead body of Rajeev with Arjun standing at the stop with a bloody knife in his hands. Just when the police were about to shoot Arjun, Maya runs in to stop them. She explains to them that Arjun had saved him from Rajeev, who had kidnapped him. What is the truth behind Rajeevs death, and where is Saanjh? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Ayaan Learns About Maya's Return
episodesList.summary: Maya shows Saanjh's video to Arjun and tells him that she feels bad for Saanjh, who is under her captivity. Maya's behaviour annoys Arjun but Saanjh's mother and brother prevents him from raising his hand at Maya. Then, Maya looks at Jhanvi and tells her that she has now fulfilled the duties of a daughter, wife and friend. Suddenly, Jhanvi falls unconscious out of shock, prompting Arjun to take her to a hospital.

episodesList.title: How Maya Won The Battle
episodesList.summary: Maya warns Ayaan not to repeat the mistake of hitting her in the future. She also proceeds to tell everyone how she managed to get the better of Samay' by hurting his ego and then went on to execute the kidnapping of Saanjh. Arjun tells Maya that she will never be able to win her love to which she replies that all she needs is his presence. Eventually, Maya reveals to Arjun that she has kept Saanjh in this city.

episodesList.title: Arjun Admitted In Hospital
episodesList.summary: Maya is delighted to have Arjun along her side, and she hopes for a fresh start with him in his life. Later, Arjun goes down with a pain in his stomach, and he is admitted to a hospital. The doctor tells Maya that Arjun will undergo an operation in his appendix. Meanwhile, a nurse in the hospital delivers a note to Suman. What is written in that note? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Arjun Rescues Saanjh
episodesList.summary: Arjun asks Suman to take his place on the operating table while he searches for Saanjh. Meanwhile, Maya is worried and concerned about Arjun's well-being and demands to see him. However, Ayaan manages to calm her down. Later, Arjun reaches the place where Maya had kept Saanjh captive. Will Arjun be able to save her? Will Maya get to know about Arjun's disappearance? Watch to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya Comes To Take Her Revenge
episodesList.summary: Saanjh tries to escape from Arjun and kill herself, but he comes and rescues her. Arjun realises that a time bomb has been placed in Saanjh's body. Maya arrives and threatens to kill Saanjh by pressing the button. Maya asks Arjun to fulfill the vows that he had promised but he refuses to budge.

episodesList.title: Maya Is Behind Bars
episodesList.summary: A shocking revelation comes to the fore. Maya's mother tries to kill her daughter as she is disappointed with her. In the meantime, the police surround the area. Maya is arrested by the police and her game comes to an end. With Maya behind bars, will Arjun and Saanjh's love become eternal? Or will Maya conspire to break their bond of love and friendship? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya's Courtroom Drama
episodesList.summary: Saanjh is sceptical of Arjun's love for her. She believes that Arjun does not love her but merely out of courtesy he is showing her affection. Later, during the courtroom proceedings Maya attacks her lawyer, Pooja. After the situation is brought under control Maya announces that she is fight the case on her own.

episodesList.title: The Murder That Destroyed Arjun's Life
episodesList.summary: Maya's mother appears before the judge to testify against her daughter. She claims that Maya has anger management issues which led to her unlawful behaviour. She makes a startling revelations by claiming that Maya killed her own father. During the courtroom proceedings. Maya's reveals the details behind her conspiracy to frame Arjun.

episodesList.title: Maya In Prison
episodesList.summary: Saanjh argues before the judge that the evidence proves that Maya is guilty. The judge announces a death sentence and Maya is sent to prison. While the police escort Maya to the prison, Arjun hands over the divorce papers to her. Later, Saanjh informs Arjun that they should not turn their friendship into a romantic relationship.

episodesList.title: Maya's Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: Maya is met with hostility from her fellow inmates when she steps inside the prison. The inmates are aware of the crimes committed by Maya. Arjun wants to propose to Saanjh and make her realise that he truly loves her. But, he does not get the opportunity to express his feelings. Meanwhile, Asha, who is pregnant, now shares her cell with Maya. In no time, Maya manipulates Asha to get out of the prison. Will Maya's plan work out? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Arjun Expresses His Feelings to Saanjh
episodesList.summary: While on the way to the hospital, Maya fakes an injury and finds her way out of the hospital. Meanwhile, Jhanvi asks Arjun to make Saanjh realise the feelings he has towards her. Upon much compulsion, Arjun comes up with a plan to propose Saanjh. Find out what happens next!

episodesList.title: Arjun Is Missing
episodesList.summary: Maya is determined to save Arjun at any cost and break out of prison. Ayaan tries to call up Arjun but his phone is not reachable. The family members are worried as Arjun has not reached home yet. Later, Saanjh comes face to face with Maya to find out about Arjun.

episodesList.title: Saanjh Visits the Morgue
episodesList.summary: Saanjh tells Maya that she will go to any length to save Arjun from her dubious plans. As Saanjh leaves the prison, Maya notices that it is already 9 pm and the deadline given by the kidnappers is about to expire. An extremely worried Maya thinks of a plan to save Arjun from the kidnappers while Saanjh heads out to find Arjun's whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Arjun Attempts To Escape
episodesList.summary: Maya comes up with a plan to call the kidnappers before they hurt Arjun. Meanwhile, Saanjh is still in search of Arjun, who has been kidnapped. Finding an opportunity, Maya calls up the kidnappers, but its too late as Arjun is hit on the head by the kidnappers.

episodesList.title: Will Saanjh Find Arjun Before Maya Does?
episodesList.summary: Maya's plan backfires as she attempts to call up the kidnappers from the jailers cabin. The jailer confines Maya in the room, where she has set fire. The kidnappers grow restless and decide to end Arjun's life. Saanjh is worried about Arjun's safety and wants to find Arjun before Maya does. Saanjh wants to think a step ahead of Maya and find Arjun. Will she able to do as planned? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya Is Caught By The Prison Guards
episodesList.summary: The kidnappers fear that the police might barge into their hideout. They hide an unconscious Arjun when the police do arrive. The police leave without conducting a search and Arjun still remains elusive. Later, Maya calls up the kidnappers when they are about to kill Arjun. She asks the kidnappers to spare Arjun's life. But, the kidnappers refuse to listen to her. Maya is caught by the prison guards and brought before the jailer. Meanwhile, Arjun regains consciousness and hides in a freezer to escape an eminent death.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Death
episodesList.summary: Saanjh relies on her intuition to find out where Arjun is. Maya is in a state of despair as she desperately wants to meet Arjun. The jailer fears that Maya might breath her last as she is refusing to eat. Meanwhile, Maya and Ayaan reach the spot where Arjun is located and help him get out of the freezer. Then, the jailer calls up the police inspector who is investigating the case and informs him to get Arjun to the hospital. But, the inspector replies that Arjun is dead.

episodesList.title: Maya Attempts Suicide
episodesList.summary: Devastated on hearing that Arjun is dead, Maya tries to escape from the clutches of the police and locks herself inside a hospital room. Meanwhile, Saanjh and Ayan are elated when they see that Arjun is alive and rush him to the hospital. Maya tries to hang herself from a ceiling fan in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Love Comes Knocking
episodesList.summary: Maya is overjoyed to learn that Arjun is still alive. Arjun assures Saanjh that Maya will never stand between him and his happiness. Arjun tries to impress Saanjh by surprising her. But, their date is cut short thanks to the call from the jailer, who asks Arjun to come to the prison immediately. This upsets Saanjh as she believes that Maya will never them alone.

episodesList.title: Maya's Gift For Saanjh
episodesList.summary: Saanjh's mother is worried about Arjun and Saanjh's future together as Maya is still alive. Saanjh recalls the threatening words Maya had uttered during their last meeting about Arjun's death. Later, Saanjh receives a gift and in it she finds broken bangles. Who has sent this gift? Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Will Maya Stop Arjun and Maya's Wedding?
episodesList.summary: Arjun learns that Maya is in solitary confinement. Saanjh is in a state of fear following the gift from Maya.evertheless, Arjun decides to marry Saanjh. Maya's mother decides to meet Maya and inform her about the wedding. Will the wedding take place as planned? Or will Maya's shadow spoil the future of Arjun and Saanjh? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya's Resurrection
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Saanjh forget about Maya for a brief period and enjoy the ceremonies. While in custody, Maya claims that on the day of Arjun's wedding, she will transform into her previous self. A person sent by Maya makes sure Arjun and Saanjh are reminded about Maya. After learning of his presence, Arjun tries to chase him down.

episodesList.title: Arjun Confronts Maya
episodesList.summary: Arjun has no other choice but to meet Maya in an attempt to persuade her to stop her evil intentions. But, Maya refuses to listen to Arjun. Later, Arjun and Saanjh try to find solace in each others company and forget about Maya. Meanwhile, Maya is busy planning her next move in order to harm Saanjh.

episodesList.title: The Sangeet Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Ayan are left frustrated when the security agencies demand huge sums for offering their services. Then, Ayan tells Arjun that he will arrange a metal detector from his friend. Meanwhile, Arjun asks Ayan and Shubh to bring in all their friends to provide security for the ceremony. On the other hand, Maya has designed another plan to disrupt the ceremony. Will Maya be able to make her plan work? Find out!

episodesList.title: Saanjh Is Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Saanjh forget about Maya and enjoy their wedding forgetting the ominous signs. The hitman sent by Maya is planning to kill Saanjh. Meanwhile, Maya is rejoicing in anticipation of Saanjh's death. Then, tragedy strikes Arjun and Saanjh as the bride to be is stabbed.

episodesList.title: Will Maya Be Hanged?
episodesList.summary: When Saanjh locks herself inside the room, Arjun enters through the window and persuades her. He helps Saanjh get ready for their wedding. Meanwhile, the jailer informs Maya that the time for her hanging is minutes away. Maya asks that jailer that she wants to call Lalvani as her last wish. What final surprises does Maya have up her sleeves and will she be hanged? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Arjun Weds Saanjh
episodesList.summary: Arjun and Saanjh learn that Maya's death sentence has been pardoned. Realising she and Arjun are not safe with Maya still alive, Saanjh decides to call off the wedding. But, Arjun wants to go ahead with the marriage and ties the knot with Saanjh. Maya learns from her informer that Arjun and Saanjh are now married. Even after completing the wedding formalities, the fear of Maya's arrival is still lurking behind the corner for Saanjh.

episodesList.title: Maya's End Or A New Beginning?
episodesList.summary: After witnessing an unpleasant event, Saanjh decides to leave the house. But, Arjun calms her down and assures her of safety. Meanwhile, in the prison, the jailer makes Maya watch Arjun and Saanjh's wedding. Then, Maya's mother meets the jailer and bribes her to kill Maya. The jailer hatches a plan to kill Maya later that night. Is this the end of Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Will Arjun Kill Maya?
episodesList.summary: The jailer's plan to kill Maya backfires on her as Maya turns the tables on her and kills her. After conducting an inquiry, Maya is sent to solitary confinement. Meanwhile, Saanjh learns about this and suffers a brain stroke. Arjun having had enough of Maya's ominous presence in his life, deices to end her life. Will Arjun pull the trigger and kill Maya? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Five Years Later
episodesList.summary: Five years have passed since Arjun last saw Maya. He returns home and finds something eerie in the house. He pulls out a gun in a bid to neutralise the threat. However, Saanjh arrives with her family and friends and congratulates Arjun on his latest achievements. Arjun is ecstatic to see his daughter, Arohi and shares the happiness with his family. But, Maya's last words that she will return one day, still haunt Arjun.

episodesList.title: Maya's New Ploy
episodesList.summary: Arjun is worried that Maya might arrive into their lives at any moment and their happiness will be at stake once she arrives. Meanwhile, Maya is plotting her next move to exact revenge on Saanjh. At Arjun's residence, a journalist makes the mistake of asking him about Maya. Arjun loses his cool and shouts at the journalist and asks her leave. Arohi overhears Maya's name and asks Arjun about her.

episodesList.title: Maya's Death
episodesList.summary: Tulsi meets Maya for the last time before leaving. Maya kills Tulsi in a bid to escape. Then, Maya falls unconscious as per her plan. The doctor arrives at the scene and declares Maya dead. After Maya is shifted to the morgue, she wakes up, ready to escape and exact revenge on Saanjh.

episodesList.title: Maya Returns
episodesList.summary: Maya sets fire to the morgue to wipe out any evidence that could prove that she is still alive. The hospital staff believe that Maya's dead body was charred in the accident. Later, Maya escapes and finds Arjun's house. She stands outside his house and sees him with Saanjh and Arohi. Maya is heartbroken and decides to exact revenge on Saanjh using Arohi.

episodesList.title: Maya Meets Arohi
episodesList.summary: Lalwani finds Maya before Arjun's bodyguards do and helps her escape. The next day, Maya arrives at Arohi's school and creates a distraction to gain Arohi's trust. Maya pretends to be one of the staff and starts working in the school. Meanwhile, Saanjh suspects that something bad is about to happen.

episodesList.title: Arohi's New Friend
episodesList.summary: Maya meets Arohi and tries to befriend her. But, before she can do so, Arjun and Saanjh arrive at the school. Maya gets terrified and wears a mask to hide her identity. Arjun bumps into Maya but does not recognize her. Later, Saanjh arrives at a graveyard to meet a stranger.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Arjun wakes up from a nightmare, in which he saw Saanjh getting killed. Arjun believes that someone has entered the property and orders the guards to conduct a search. Meanwhile, at school, Aarohi sees Maya coming out of the store room. She questions Maya about the need to access the store room, which is out of bounds for the staff. Later, Lalwani arrives at Arjun's factory and mixes a substance in the solution.

episodesList.title: Aarohi is Missing
episodesList.summary: Lalwani does his job and escapes before Arjun can catch hold of him. Aarohi bumps into Maya and finds her secretive. Jhanvi arrives at the school but fails to find Aarohi. Meanwhile, Arjun suspects something to be wrong and orders all the stocks to be recalled. But, the damage has been done as children who have eaten the chocolates being to fall sick.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Death Trap
episodesList.summary: Arjun finds an old tape recorder. When he plays it, he discovers Maya's favourite song and reaises that she has escaped from the morgue. He goes to Maya's psychiatrist to enquire about Maya. Meanwhile Maya tries to get close to Arohi. Later, Arjun decides to make a plan to take his revenge on Maya.

episodesList.title: Maya's Grand Entry
episodesList.summary: Arjun gets ready to kill Maya and loads his gun with bullets. Meanwhile, Saanjh suspects that Arjun is hiding something from her. Arjun reaches the venue for the garba night. While he is searching for Maya, she comes and pats his back. Will Arjun manage to accomplish what he has come for? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya Takes Her Revenge
episodesList.summary: Arjun points a gun at Maya and plans to shoot her. But she tells him that Saanjh's life is in danger. Meanwhile, Saanjh narrowly escapes being hit by a truck while coming to the garba venue. Later, Arjun and Saanjh reach Aarohi's school and find her lying unconscious. They find out that she has been poisoned. Maya disguises herself as a hospital nurse and comes to take her revenge. Will she succeed? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Saanjh Is Separated From Aarohi
episodesList.summary: Maya arrives at the hospital, while Aarohi is being operated upon. She makes sure Aarohi lives and reveals that her intention was never to harm Aarohi. She does want to take revenge but not at the cost of Aarohi's life. After Aarohi is discharged from the hospital, Ayaan decides to take Aarohi along with him for her own safety.

episodesList.title: Maya's New Plan
episodesList.summary: Saanjh breaks down remembering Aarohi. Meanwhile, Maya tells Lalwani that she merely used Aarohi to hurt Arjun. Then, Arjun is informed by his bodyguards about Maya's whereabouts. But, when they reach the spot, Maya is no where to be found. Later, Saanjh is diagnosed with depression. Wanting to help Saanjh, Arjun assures Saanjh that Maya will never be able to take away their happiness.

episodesList.title: The Surrogate Mother
episodesList.summary: Maya calls up Arjun and lets him know that he cannot stop her from meeting him. Later, Arjun and Saanjh arrive at the fertility centre and meet the woman who has been chosen as the surrogate mother for their child. When she is taken inside the operation theatre, Maya plays out her plan and gives money to the woman. Will Arjun and Saanjh find out Maya's plan before its too late? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya Meets Arjun
episodesList.summary: On his way to the hospital, Arjun encounters the surrogate woman who was supposed to carry Saanjh's child. Realising that something is wrong, he rushes to the hospital and notices Maya, who informs him that now she is the surrogate mother. Maya puts forth a condition before Arjun and asks him to take her home. Arjun gets furious at this and tries to choke Maya.

episodesList.title: Maya Arrives In Arjun's House
episodesList.summary: Maya asks Saanjh to take the decision: to either take her home or put her behind bars. Maya then arrives at Arjun's house. Maya's mother is shocked to see her. They are informed that Maya is the surrogate mother to Arjun and Saanjh's child.

episodesList.title: Maya Returns
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets worried after seeing Maya back in the house. Arjun arrives at the police station to file a complaint against Maya but thinks of Sanjh and stops. Meanwhile, Maya makes Sanjh feel guilty for being unable to be a mother. How Arjun and Sanjh face problem after allowing Maya live in their house? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Beginning of Maya's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Maya's obsession blurs into a vengeful quest to destroy Saanjh's life. At midnight, Maya enters her mother's room. Before she can carry out her evil pursuits, her mother turns around, which saves her life. Maya's mother then warns Arjun about the storm that is about to hit their lives.

episodesList.title: Maya's New Strategy
episodesList.summary: Saanjh's mother sees her daughter taking care of Maya. She expresses her displeasure to Saanjh, who informs that Maya is the surrogate to her child. Maya overhears this conversation. After they leave the kitchen, Maya mixes a substance in a glass of milk. What is Maya upto this time? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Seed of Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Maya claims that Suman tried to kill her. While Suman tries to prove her innocence, Maya succeeds in plating the seed of suspicion in Saanjh's mind but fails to do the same with Arjun. Maya can't fathom the thought that Arjun does not trust her anymore.

episodesList.title: Saanjh's Prank On Arjun
episodesList.summary: Maya's words haunt Arjun and he wakes up from a nightmare. He searches for the Saanjh in the house but does not find her. Everyone suspects that Maya has done something to Saanjh. But, to Arjun's relief, he finds Saanjh outside. This turns out to be a prank played on Arjun. Maya and Arjun head to the clinic to determine if Maya is pregnant. Watch and find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Maya's Fast
episodesList.summary: Saanjh is worried that Maya and Arjun are nowhere to be found. She is unaware that they are at the clinic to determine whether Maya is pregnant. Maya is relived to know that she is pregnant but Arjun is not happy about it. Then, Maya informs Saanjh that she is observing fast for Arjun.

episodesList.title: Saanjh's Concern
episodesList.summary: Maya informs Saanjh that she wants to apply Mehendi. Arjun is still thinking about Maya's decision to keep fast for him. When Maya sees Arjun with Saanjh, she gets distressed. Will Arjun feed Maya and end her fast? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya's Rage
episodesList.summary: Arjun makes it clear to Maya that he rejects having loved her. Maya is furious that Arjun thinks about her this way. In anger, Maya takes the car and drives away, forcing Saanjh to follow her. Arjun now has to stop Maya before she hurts herself and his child.

episodesList.title: Maya's Anger
episodesList.summary: Arjun is informed by the doctor that he has to take special care of Maya as any emotional trauma can have adverse effects on the pregnancy. Later, Arjun shouts at Saanjh for not taking care of Maya. Saanjh breaks down but knows that Arjun is taking care of Maya as she is pregnant with her child.

episodesList.title: When Death Comes Knocking
episodesList.summary: Maya's mother claims that Maya tried to kill her, which Maya claims to be an allegation. Maya announces that she will leave the house, unable to bear this humiliation. Will Arjun stop Maya from leaving the house? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maya's Manipulation
episodesList.summary: At the baby shower, Maya and Arjun arrive at their house. Saanjh is disappointed to see Arjun taking care of Maya. Then, Maya informs Saanjh that she wants Arjun in return for giving her the child. Saanjh slaps Maya. Surprisingly, Arjun slaps Saanjh and informs her that she did a mistake by bringing Maya into the house. Then, Maya goes into labor and is rushed to the hospital.

episodesList.title: A New Life is Born
episodesList.summary: The doctor informs Arjun and Saanjh that the delivery has been successful. But, before Arjun and Saanjh can get the time to spend with their daughter, Maya escapes with the newborn. Arjun and Saanjh find Maya and Saanjh decide to speak with her. When Saanjh meets Maya, the latter pulls out a gun on her. Will Arjun save Saanjh at the cost of Maya's life? Watch this episode to find out.

plotHtml:
Maya Mehrotra, the owner of "Fashion and the City" is a young and successful business tycoon, with net worth of around 900 million dollars suffering from dark past and troubled childhood due to her abusive dad, Ashwin. Carefree and cheerful, Arjun Sharma is a photographer in Maya's company. His childhood friend, lawyer Saanjh Mathur, secretly loves him. Initially, Arjun and Maya are at loggerheads as their opposing natures and perspectives often collide and Maya tries to terminate Arjun many times but he gets a chance and returns and annoys Maya even more but with time the two come closer and start to understand each other. As Arjun rescues Maya in an elevator accident and later, from Ashwin, she falls in love with and proposes him.
A series of circumstances including Maya rescuing Ayaan (Arjun's younger brother) from jail, revealing her past to Arjun, helping him realize his past mistakes and uniting him with his step mother Vandana and completing his family in the process leads to Arjun falling for Maya. Thus, he ends up proposing her in Mauritius, much to Saanjh's dismay. As Maya and Arjun plan their wedding, Ashwin (Maya's father) tries to provoke Saanjh and Vandana (Arjun's mother) against Maya to ruin her wedding. Moreover, he tries to get over her company's shares as well but all in vain as he was murdered. Arjun and Maya get married.
Later, Jhanvi (Maya's mother) gets to know about Ashwin's murderer and tries to expose the truth, however, was pushed off a building by the murderer causing her to go in a coma and was blamed for the murder. Meanwhile, Arjun's flirtatious nature and his extreme friendship with Saanjh irks Maya and she fakes a miscarriage and blames Saanjh, leading to a fall out between Arjun and Saanjh. Hurt, Saanjh leaves for London.

title: Bin Roye
summary:
Bin Roye (Urdu: بن روۓ, lit. 'Without Crying') is a 2016 Pakistani romantic-drama television series, which premiered on Hum TV on 2 October 2016. Bin Roye centers on love as it follows the life of Saba Shafiq who, unknown to her cousin Irtaza, deeply loves him but he only thinks of her as a friend. The story follows Saba's obsession with Irtaza, and his marriage with her sister Saman.
Bin Roye was created and produced by Momina Duraid, co-directed by  Shahzad Kashmiri and Haissam Hussain and was written by Farhat Ishtiaq based on her novel of similar name. The series aired on Hum TV as part of a night programming all under Duraid's production company. In 2015, a film adaptation of novel, with the same cast and crew was also released, which went on to become the third-highest-grossing film in Pakistan.
Humayun Saeed, Mahira Khan and Armeena Rana Khan reprised their leading roles from the film adaptation, as Irtaza, Saba Shafiq and Saman Shafiq, respectively. Javed Sheikh, Zeba Bakhtiar, Junaid Khan and Jahanzeb Khan also return to series in recurring roles, while Adnan Malik and Saman Ansari joined for television adaptation.
plot:
Saba (Mahira Khan) is madly in love with her best friend and cousin Irtaza (Humayun Saeed). Saba and Irtaza have grown up together, and Irtaza cares a lot for Saba. Saba is an extrovert, who lives life to the fullest, and expects Irtaza to fulfil all her childish demands. Irtaza happily does everything Saba asks for and feels happy seeing her happy.
Irtaza decides to go to America for his higher studies. Saba is unhappy hearing about this and gets angry at Irtaza. Irtaza reasons with Saba and tells her he will return in two years. Irtaza goes to America and, whilst studying there, develops feelings for his cousin Saman (Armeena Khan).
After completing his studies, he returns to Pakistan, and Saba is delighted to see him. Soon Saman's parents die in a plane crash, and Saman comes to Pakistan along with Irtaza to her extended family for emotional support. Saba and Irtaza take care of Saman. Soon Saba learns that Saman is not her cousin but her elder sister and that Saman was adopted by her uncle when she was a baby. This fact brings Saba and Saman closer to each other. Both Saman and Saba start sharing a very close sisterly bond. One day, Saba realises that Saman and Irtaza have feelings for each other. Despite loving her sister, she cannot help but feel jealousy and anger.
Soon after Saba's realisation, Irtaza proposes marriage to Saman. Saba is heartbroken but tries her best to be happy for her best friend and sister. Saba happily participates in all wedding rituals. However, Saba loses all patience when she finally sees Saman and Irtaza making their wedding vows. In the heat of the moment, Saba curses Saman.
Saman and Irtiza move to America and soon have a son. Saman dies in an accident, and Saba is guilt-ridden for having cursed her. Saba and Irtiza's families get the duo married. Saba feels guilty and is unable to accept Irtiza as her husband. Irtiza meets with an accident, and Saba confesses her guilt and love for Irtiza. Irtiza consoles Saba and makes her realise that her love has been selfless and Saman's death wasn't Saba's fault. Saba and Irtiza discover their love for each other and decide to give their marriage another chance.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
In 2013, it was announced that a drama series was being developed based on Farhat Ishtiaq's novel Bin Roye Ansoo, before the project went into development hell for almost half a year. It was later revealed that Bin Roye will be released as a theatrical film and later on as TV series. Actor Humayun Saeed who played the lead role in film revealed, "Bin Roye is a romantic drama. But it will not just be a film; it will also be turned into a serial to be aired on Hum TV with the same cast."
In July 2015, after the release of film, the drama serial went into production with the same cast and crew, with Haissam Hussain replacing Momina Duraid as a co-director with Shahzad Kashmiri. Farhat Ishtiaq wrote the screenplay for the series, changing several plot details in contrast to the film. In an interview she explained, "Bin Roye the drama has the same cast as in the movie, but things which were not included in the movie from the novel will be seen in drama. The shoot is done and most probably will on air somewhere between April and July of this year." This became Farhat's second consecutive collaboration with Duraid in a year and seventh overall, she recently worked on Diyar-e-Dil (2015) and Udaari (2016), which were the highest-rated and critically acclaimed serials.
In June 2016, it was confirmed that Shiraz Uppal would compose music for the series, who also composed three songs for the film adaptation. In August 2016, Ishtiaq announced that the series would replace, her then-running series Udaari and confirmed earlier saying "the play will air this year as the last edits are in process."

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: All the cast members from the film reprise their roles, with Humayun Saeed returning in role of Irtaza, Mahira Khan as Saba and Armeena Rana Khan reprise her role as Saman. Initially it was circulated that Fawad Khan and Sanam Baloch has replaced Saeed and Rana in lead roles, before being confirmed by Duraid in August 2016 that no changes has been made in cast. Describing his role differences from film, Humayun said, "there's already a lot of difference between film and TV. In 2 and half hours, we already have to show a very large story in a limited time in a film, but when it comes to television, we personally like the way the story is narrated. Thus, the progression is completely different; you will get to see a lot that you weren't able to see before. You will find a lot more depth in a few characters, plus, a lot more answers to those unanswered questions. Of course, in a series of 20 episodes, a lot changes." While Khan expressed, "It's not really different. Well, there's a whole new track in it which wasn't in the original, so that's new (Laughs)! Saba is the same, I mean, the variation you would see is that you will see a lot more shades to her. Of course, Bin Roye was just 1 hour and 58 minutes, so you will get to see a lot more intricacies in this."

articleSections.title: Broadcast and release
articleSections.text: Bin Roye was originally scheduled to release between April–July 2016, The show was also released on the iflix app along with some other shows of Hum TV in 2017 but on terminating the contract with app all the episodes were pulled off. In 2019, it was released on Starzplay app. The show is also available on MX Player app and since mid 2020, the show is also streaming on ZEE5.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text: Bin Roye received positive reviews with most praising Humayun Saeed's performance. Writing for Dawn News, Sheeba Khan wrote, "Bin Royes TV version fills in plot holes the movie couldn't" and expressed "Humayun Saeed was flawless and his chemistry with Mahira Khan was very evident. He easily fit the typical Farhat Ishtiaq character: kind, really good-looking, and successful. The comfort level and the bond that needed to be shown between Saba and Irtaza was easily visualized, thanks to the directors and actors." Saira Khan of HipInPakistan praised Humayun Saeed's performance, saying "He is the undisputed king of romantic plays. No other actor can play a romantic hero as well as him" and also praised Mahira Khan's performance.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text: The rating of Bin Roye (blockbuster) made a huge impact in UK. According to BizAsia, the first episode of the series was watched by 65,200 viewers at 20:00 – peaking at 94,300 viewers. The Sunday night slot on the channel is proving a success for the channel after the departure of ‘Udaari’ last week. The drama gained several other high ratings both in Pakistan and U.K. throughout the 17 weeks it aired.

plotHtml: Saba (Mahira Khan) is madly in love with her best friend and cousin Irtaza (Humayun Saeed). Saba and Irtaza have grown up together, and Irtaza cares a lot for Saba. Saba is an extrovert, who lives life to the fullest, and expects Irtaza to fulfil all her childish demands. Irtaza happily does everything Saba asks for and feels happy seeing her happy. Irtaza decides to go to America for his higher studies. Saba is unhappy hearing about this and gets angry at Irtaza. Irtaza reasons with Saba and tells her he will return in two years. Irtaza goes to America and, whilst studying there, develops feelings for his cousin Saman (Armeena Khan). After completing his studies, he returns to Pakistan, and Saba is delighted to see him. Soon Saman's parents die in a plane crash, and Saman comes to Pakistan along with Irtaza to her extended family for emotional support. Saba and Irtaza take care of Saman. Soon Saba learns that Saman is not her cousin but her elder sister and that Saman was adopted by her uncle when she was a baby. This fact brings Saba and Saman closer to each other. Both Saman and Saba start sharing a very close sisterly bond. One day, Saba realises that Saman and Irtaza have feelings for each other. Despite loving her sister, she cannot help but feel jealousy and anger. Soon after Saba's realisation, Irtaza proposes marriage to Saman. Saba is heartbroken but tries her best to be happy for her best friend and sister. Saba happily participates in all wedding rituals. However, Saba loses all patience when she finally sees Saman and Irtaza making their wedding vows. In the heat of the moment, Saba curses Saman. Saman and Irtiza move to America and soon have a son. Saman dies in an accident, and Saba is guilt-ridden for having cursed her. Saba and Irtiza's families get the duo married. Saba feels guilty and is unable to accept Irtiza as her husband. Irtiza meets with an accident, and Saba confesses her guilt and love for Irtiza. Irtiza consoles Saba and makes her realise that her love has been selfless and Saman's death wasn't Saba's fault. Saba and Irtiza discover their love for each other and decide to give their marriage another chance.
tagline: Saba (Mahira Khan) is madly in love with her best friend and cousin Irtaza (Humayun Saeed).

title: Badho Bahu
summary: Badho Bahu is an Indian Hindi-language romantic drama television series that aired on &TV. Produced by Sunny Side Up and Hum Tum Tele Films, the show premiered on September 12, 2016. It starred Rytasha Rathore and Prince Narula in the lead roles of Komal and Lakhan respectively. The show went off air on 17 May 2018. It has been remade in Kannada as Brahmagantu on Zee Kannada, in Tamil as Oru Oorla Oru Rajakumari on Zee Tamil, in Malayalam as Swathi Nakshatram Chothi on Zee Keralam, in Telugu as Gundamma Katha on Zee Telugu.
plot: It revolves around an overweight girl, Komal, who gets nicknamed Badho because of her physical appearance. Komal is made to do tough manual tasks which need physical strength. She is a sweet, loving, energetic and a simple girl. She has a big heart and helps most people in her town. Lucky Singh Ahlawat is a famous wrestler and is known for his looks. A series of events leads up to Komal and Lucky getting married.

title: Bharatvarsh
summary: Bharatvarsh  is an Indian television historical documentary series, hosted by actor-director Anupam Kher on Hindi news channel ABP News. It started on 20 August 2016. The show presents thoughts and ideologies of personalities in the 5000-year old history of India and showcases journey from ancient India to the 19th century. Season 1 finished on 23 October 2016.
reception: The show was well received. One episode was telecasted in Delhi Public School Ghaziabad for students. The episode on Chanakya was screened in Little Angels Convent H S School, Kohe Fiza, Bhopal. In October 2016, Juggernaut Books and ABP News announced the publication of a book based on Bharatvarsh, which will be published in the first quarter of 2017.

title: Brahmarakshas
summary:
Brahmarakshas is an Indian Hindi-language supernatural thriller television series that aired on Zee TV for two seasons. It is digitally available on ZEE5. It is a franchise produced by Ekta Kapoor under her studio Balaji Telefilms.
The first season titled Brahmarakshas... Jaag Utha Shaitaan, starring Krystle D'Souza and Aham Sharma, aired from 6 August 2016 to 18 February 2017. It was loosely based on the fantasy thriller film Jaani Dushman and the western fairy tale, Beauty and the Beast.
The second season titled Brahmarakshas 2: Phir Jaag Utha Shaitaan, starring Pearl V Puri and Nikki Sharma aired from 22 November 2020 to 4 April 2021.

articleSections.title: Twenty years later
articleSections.text:
In Mumbai, a family decides to conduct a destination wedding for their daughter, Rakhi, at Kamalpura. Rakhi is close to her best friend Raina and easy-go-lucky flirting brother Rishabh. The whole family leaves for Kamalpura.
Learning that Rakhi loves someone else, Raina and Rishabh get them married secretly. Sanjay kills Rakhi, and her husband, Varun. Left shattered, Rishabh and Raina decide to seek revenge from Sanjay. Raina and Rishabh marry in order to bring Brahmarakshas in front of them and kill him.
Aparjita returns to Kamalpura. Raina discovers that Aparajita is Mohini's best friend who is very close to Rishabh. She also discovers that she is not her parents' real daughter. Her parents were the first couple who had been killed by Sanjay. Raina reveals the truth to Rishabh, however he refuses to believe her. As Aparajita's truth is discovered, a dangerous animal kills her and she becomes another Brahmarakshas. Aparajita is murdered by Sanjay, who is under Mohini's control.
Rishabh's brother Yug learns that Mohini is Rishabh's aunt. His wife Naina discovers this but then she is tied and locked in the house basement, where Rishabh's real mother Sudha is found. Mohini takes Sudha to Asursthal to kill her but Raina brings her back. Wanting to awake Narsimha, Mohini takes Raina and Rishabh along with her. They discover her truth.
Mohini loses a Narsimha stone, which breaks. Due to its intense light, the stone captures Rishabh into the stone. Mohini snatches it but is killed by Sanjay. While dying, she reveals to Raina about Narsimha. Rishabh comes out of the stone and notices changes in himself. Narsimha enters into his body. Sanjay gains more powers and kills Naina. Sanjay and Narsimha fight.
As Sanjay takes the gem containing Narsimha's powers, he throws it but Raina finds it. She grabs the sword and stabs Sanjay who finally dies. Raina and Rishabh reunite.

articleSections.title: 16 years later
articleSections.text: All grown up, Kalindi and Minty live with Prithvi bearing taunts from Shalini and her daughters. Kalindi is shown to be a mature woman who feels indebted to Prithvi assuming that he is clearing her father's debts, unbeknownst to his involvement in her parents' death. Prithvi pulls a facade of a loving uncle to Kalindi and Minty in hopes of getting all of Kalindi's property. Angad is now a London-based businessman along with his father and a soccer player, shown to be a casanova. The Mehras return to India on Shakti's insistence to get his sons married to Raghav's daughters which is not well taken by his wife, Damini. Prithvi and Shalini lie to Shakti that Kalindi died not long after her parents' death and that Minty is married. They convince Shakti to get his sons married to the former's daughters while Angad is smitten with Kalindi, assuming her to be one of Prithvi's three daughters. Brahmarakshas possesses Vardhaan Choudary, a well known businessman, and searches for Kalindi. He finds her soon and tries many ways to woo her and later asks her hand in marriage by making her believe that he will help her find the secret of Brahmarakshas to which Kalindi agrees. On learning this Angad is heartbroken and tries many tactics to cancel the wedding but is unsuccessful. Later on the wedding day Prithvi and Shalini tries to kill Kalindi but are unsure as Angad saves her but brahmarakshas renders Angad unconscious and kidnaps Kalindi and tries to wed her when she is unconscious but Angad comes at right time and saves her and informs her of Vardhaan being the Brahmarakshas and she vanquishes brahmaraksas and kills Gehna.

articleSections.title: 2 months later
articleSections.text: Brahmarakshas is revealed to be alive. Angad and Paridhi's haldi ceremony takes place. Madan comes out of the coma. The Brahmarakshas wreaks havoc again. Kalindi and Angad get Madan home. Angad gets jealous seeing Madan and Kalindi getting closer. The inspector learns something suspicious about Madan. Later, Kalindi seeks Madan's help. Angad gets a doubt on Madan. The incident at the mall raises Angad's suspicion on Madan. When the coconut turns black, Shalini thinks that Prithvi is Brahmarakshas. Brahmarakshas kills Inspector Shabana and Angad vows to expose the truth. Mahamaya Ma tells Shalini that Brahmarakshas is in the house. Angad summons Brahmarakshas and inadvertently saves Balan's life. Later, in a trance, Balan conveys Brahmarakshas's message and tries to kill Prithvi. Angad tries to explain to Kalindi that Madan is Brahmarakshas. Angad learns that Uma is his childhood friend Kalindi. Later, Kalindi learns Prithvi's truth and rushes to save Madan. Madan is saved by Kalindi but Brahmarakshas appears. Meanwhile, Damini stops Angad's marriage with Paridhi and shows everyone a video of Paridhi and Sid together, surprising everyone. Angad leaves the wedding and goes to find Kalindi and saves her from the Brahmarakshas. It is then revealed that After the trio return home, Prithvi fakes getting a heart attack and told everyone that Uma is Kalindi and that Kalindi should marry Angad and the preparation for Angad and Kalindi's starts. Meanwhile, Madan tells Kalindi not to marry Angad as Brahmarakshas could take anyone's form and he could take Angad's form and marry her so its not safe for her. Angad, Kalindi, Minty, Robin, Sakshi and Paridhi go for a picnic in the jungle. Where Paridhi learns of Kalindi's plan of leaving her wedding with Angad and marrying Madan. Paridhi agrees to help her by taking her place at the wedding with Angad. Angad realises the truth and goes to stop Madan and Kalindi's wedding. Brahmarakshas appears and wounds Madan but Kalindi manages to kill Brahmarakshas and Madan dies as well. Then Brahmarakshas is shown jumping out of the fire and is revealed to be alive. Prithvi tells Kalindi that Vikram is guilty of Raghav's death. Kalindi's words hurt Minty and she leaves the house for Robin. A revelation about Robin takes place, he is revealed as Brahmarakshas. Vikram dies by burning in front of everyone. Prithvi and Shalini go to a tantric. Kalindi gives consent to Robin and Minty's relationship and their Roka ceremony takes place. Later, Kalindi uses the solution given in the book to identify Brahmarakshas. Brahmarakshas saves Kalindi from the tantric. Kalindi learns that Robin is Brahmarakshas. Later, when the news of Brahamarakshas' death is broadcast on TV, Kalindi does not believe it. Kalindi tries to make everyone aware of Robin's truth. Later, Robin tells Kalindi that he is Brahmarakshas. A revelation about Brahmarakshas takes place while Angad announces his intention to marry Kalindi. Along with the kids, Kalindi makes a plan against Brahmarakshas. Due to Brahmarakshas, Kalindi gets proven wrong before Angad during the sangeet ceremony. Later, Angad sets the ‘granth’ on fire. Kalindi decides to sacrifice herself to save Robin. During Minty's haldi ceremony, Angad suspects that Kalindi has made a plan and asks her to tell the truth. Later, Brahmarakshas accepts Kalindi's condition. Kalindi saves Robin and puts an end to Brahmarakshas. Later, she falls prey to Prithvi's plan. And is later declared dead.

articleSections.title: 2 years later
articleSections.text:
A secret agent is revealed and a new story begins.
In Delhi, a girl named Chandni steals a necklace and reaches Ambala. It is revealed that Chandni is the twin sister of Kalindi, who is also born in Rohini. As she steps on the ash of Brahmarakshas, it becomes alive again and kidnaps Chandni believing she is Kalindi to marry her. Soon, Kalindi is revealed to be alive as well. The Brahmarakshas gains control over Inspector Yug. Posing as her twin Kalindi, Chandni returns with Angad, who discerns that Chandni is not Kalindi. Meanwhile, Prithvi and Shalini try to kill Chandni. Iravat foils Guru Ma's attempt to release Kalindi. He learns Kalindi and Chandni's truth from her and informs Yug. Meanwhile, Chandni's bravery impresses Angad. Later, Yug locates Chandni and attempts to arrest her, only to be stopped by Angad. Chandni prepares for Ishaan and Sona's wedding. Yug gets Kalindi home and Guru Ma vows to save her from Yug and Iravat's clutches. Angad senses that Kalindi is nearby, while Guru Ma helps her escape from the house.
Sona and Ishaan's haldi ceremony begins. Prithvi tells Yug that an impostor is staying at his house. Prithvi then abducts Chandini and hands her over to Yug. On learning about it, Angad rescues Chandini and brings her home. Chandini tries to win Angad's heart but he asks her to leave the house. Robin and Minty give a piece of good news to the family. They tell the family that Minty is pregnant, resulting in Angad stopping Chandni from leaving the house. Later, suspicious of Yug, Angad reaches his house to seek the truth and is attacked by Iravat. Yug lies to Kalindi about her past. At the hospital, Kalindi helps Angad but fails to recognise him. A girl discovers the truth about Yug and Kalindi brings her home. At the hospital, one of the nurses tells Kalindi about a job. At home, Chandini gives a surprise to Angad and proposes to him. Angad doesn't give her an answer but after she risks her life to save his life he changes his mind, post which they get engaged. Posing as Minty's nurse, Kalindi sees her picture in the house. Chandini tries to see Minti's nurse's face. Later, Kalindi's clothes catch fire during Holika Dahan. Yug gets shocked on seeing Kalindi at Angad's house. He puts forth a condition before Prithvi, who plots to get Minty's nurse fired. Angad goes to the hospital to solve a mystery. Kalindi learns that Chandni is her twin. Brahmarakshas tries to kill Angad, but in vain. Later, Kalindi and Chandni join forces and kill Brahmarakshas. Chandni dies sacrificing her life for Kalindi and Angad. Angad and Kalindi unite. After sometime, Angad and Kalindi look at the sky together. They smile and see the broken star and pray.
Meanwhile, the Brahmarakshas becomes alive again and roars, looking out for a powerful body to possess.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Pearl V Puri was selected to play the male lead and Nikki Sharma was cast to play the female lead for the second season of the show.Chetan Hansraj was selected to play the titular role of the second season.

articleSections.title: Critical response (season 1)
articleSections.text: Times Of India stated, "The show definitely has a gripping storyline, and the viewers just don't know what to expect next. It's fast-paced, edgy and doesn't give you time to think".

episodesList.summary: Vardhan strikes a deal with Prithvi. Angad’s misunderstanding about Kalindi clears. Vardhan arrives at Prithvi’s house for Paridhi’s roka and the demon in him struggles to break free at the sight of Kalindi.

episodesList.title: Kalindi’s marriage gets fixed with Sid
episodesList.summary: Prithvi fixes Kalindi's alliance with Vikram’s son, Sid. Gehna apprises Vardhan of the same and tells him to stop the engagement. Vardhan unravels Prithvi, Akshay and Vikram’s past secrets.

episodesList.title: Vardhan invites Kalindi to the Kali temple
episodesList.summary: Under Vardhan’s control, Sid tries to assault Kalindi. Angad tries to cheer up Kalindi. Vardhan arrives to meet Kalindi and invites her to the Kali temple.

episodesList.title: Vardhan’s plan gets foiled
episodesList.summary: Kalindi goes into the jungle to meet Vardhan, but Vardhan’s plan gets foiled. Gehna suggests Vardhan a way to control the demon in him. Prithvi, Akshay and Vikram plot to kill Kalindi.

episodesList.title: Vardhan’s marriage gets fixed with Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Kalindi agrees to marry Vardhan. Guruma meets Raghav at a temple. Vardhan announces that his marriage is in two days. Kalindi asks Angad for help. Madan learns that Vardhan is Brahmarakshas.

episodesList.title: Will Madan be able to expose Vardhan?
episodesList.summary: Madan risks his life and challenges Vardhan to come out in his true form. Brahmarakshas takes Menaka with him. While everyone looks for Menaka in the forest, Kalindi gets hurt.

title: Bharya
summary:
Bharya (transl. Wife) is an Indian Malayalam-language television thriller drama television series that premiered on 16 May 2016 on Asianet. Mridula Vijay, Sajan Surya, Arun G Raghavan, Rajesh Hebbar, Ronson Vincent, Alina Padikkal and Keerthana Podhuval play the lead.
The show aired its climax in a one-hour episode on 26 and 27 April 2019, completing 860 episodes.
plot:
Bharya tells the story of a family residing in Vrindavanam. Nandan and Rohini are the children of Professor, Vishwanatha Menon and Jayaprabha Teacher. They lead a life with little contact to the outside world.
Although Rohini was previously married to a Vrindavanam resident, Sharath, she was later widowed. However, even after more than 4 years, she is unable to acknowledge this. Having moved back to her parents' home with her daughter, Rohini continues to believe that Sharath will return. Nandan - without his parents' permission - marries his love interest, Nayana, and takes her to Vrindavanam. His family does not know that Nayana and her family are a band of antisocials who serve as human parasites.
Nayana's brother Narendran is also their town's rowdy, but people from Vrindavanam seems to have no idea about it. Narendran lusts after Rohini and Nayana starts to work her cruel and devilish activities. Initially shocked, but the family accepts identity of their daughter in law after a long period, but Nandan did not and is blinded by Nayana's feminine charms. Rohini marries Jose for protection from Narendran.
The teledrama is a daily bit for vicarious traumatization of ill family styles and instructive aid on such ways. Rakhi (Rohini and Nadan's younger sister) died by hanging herself because of Jose (that is what they think) but it was actually because of Sharath the villain. Sharath's true nature is exposed to everyone. Meanwhile, Nayana who re-entered the Vrindavan house as she was pregnant, was hated by everyone in the house. She delivers a baby girl, who the Vrindavan family refuses to accept as their own. However, Rohini visits the baby in the hospital. Finally it is revealed that person is there in the name of Sharath is not Rohini's husband, the real Sharath. But he is Suresh aka Vidura Sura. An evil womanizer and wanted criminal. Who is the look alike of Sharath. When Rohini gave birth to her child, Sharath was coming to meet them but he was beaten and thrown to a railway track because he looks identical to the criminal. They thought he was Vidura Sura. In that same time Vidura met Sharath and seeing his resemblance to him. He took Sharath's identity and pretended to be Sharath to everyone. Finally, the real Sharath came back and Vidura Sura was killed by Rohini. Now Sharath is being hunted by people mistaking his identity as the deceased criminal. Naran marries Mochitha and she became pregnant. Naran knows about Sharath shares Momochitha.
Now the main lead characters changes to Sharath (Arun G Raghavan) and Rohini (Mridula Vijay). It has now come to knowledge that Rohini's original husband Sharath is alive. Jose (Rajesh Hebbar) compels Naran to disturb Sharath in any way so as to make Rohini his own. In the end, Jose gives Rohini to Sharath.

title: Bhootu
summary:
Bhootu is an Indian Bengali language children's comedy-drama television series that aired on Zee Bangla. The series revolves around a friendly girl ghost named Bhootu, who always tries to help others, often causing light mischief and mayhem in the process. The show was rebooted in Hindi with same name as Bhutu for Zee TV and premiered on 21 August 2017.
Zee Bangla brought back Bhootu but in an animated version for every Sunday from 12 November 2017 to 29 May 2022.

title: Bahu Hamari Rajni Kant
summary: Bahu Hamari Rajni Kant (transl. Our Daughter-in-Law Rajni Kant) is an Indian science fiction sitcom television series, which aired from 15 February 2016 to 13 February 2017 on Life OK.
plot:
Shantanu Kant, a scientist creates a super humanoid robot with the help of his best friend Devendra Bangdu.The robot is named RAJNI, short for "Randomly Accessible Jobs Network Interface", a robot with 10X the power of hulk, a human's body, a pretty face and a brain faster than 100 computers.
The robot was made for saving humans' life. After a few episodes, Shaan made Rajni his wife as he did not want to take burden of wedding along with his dreams and aspirations of becoming a renowned scientist. The Kant's women do not like Rajni as her daughter-in-law due to Rajni's weird behaviour, and also because Surili (Shaan's mom) wanted a classy Bengali girl as her 'bahu' - so, Surili never accepts Rajni as her daughter-in-law by heart. But, the Kant's men always favour Rajni and like her nature.
Many problems arise in the Kant family-some of them come by themselves and some are unintentionally created by Rajni as she does not understand humans accurately. But, Rajni always saves the Kants from all these troubles-sometimes with the help of Shaan and Dev. Later Rajni misinterpreted Shaan's command and changed his face by plastic surgery which creates some problems but later all confusions are cleared by Shaan. In the middle of all this, other confusions arises which made Shaan to dismantle Rajni. Kants have gone bankrupt post. Shaan been in USA, returns with his fiancée Ria. The Kant fix the marriage to get their wealth by Ria's rich family.
It is then revealed that Rajni saved herself from the factory 5 years ago where she had found an infant on the streets and had decided to adopt him but Rajni was not updated with latest technologies. Rajni's adoptive son named as R.A.M, incidentally help Kant's family who were then invited to Kant Nivaas where Ria finds out about Rajni and broke up the alliance. Shaan then decides to divorce Rajni. Meanwhile, the court gives Shaan and Rajni 6 months' time to their marriage.
In these 6 months, Rajni wins everyone's, including Shaan's trust back, but later she was proven to be a human by Surili. Soon it gets revealed that the girl was Rajjo, the duplicate of Rajni.
Soon Shaan and Rajjo start developing mutual feelings for each other. Amrish learns about Rajni's truth, he accepts her, but this reunion is stopped by a robot from other planet who looks exactly as Shaan, and asks Rajini to come with him. She is about to leave when Shaan, R.A.M and Amrish try to stop her, but being given command to leave with Shaan-like robot, she turns away. The robots fly away, leaving the three (Shaan, Amrish, R.A.M) in tears when Shaan finds a small machine on the ground, presumably belonging to the robot from other planet and he believes to bring back Rajni with the device.
