An upset Vibhuti and Angoori decide to start a catering business. Vibhuti tells Angoori to seek INR 10000 from Manmohan. Angoori is able to get the money from Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Angoori's Business Takes Off
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Angoori advertise their business and hire Saxena as a delivery boy. Manmohan asks Angoori for food, but she is busy with Vibhuti in her business. As Vibhuti talks on the phone, Anita reminds him of the house chores, but he refuses to do them. Angoori is busy talking to Vibhuti and asks Manmohan to take the food himself. Manmohan wants to romance Angoori, but she keeps getting calls from Vibhuti. An annoyed Manmohan tells him to call in the morning. Vibhuti gets a gold ring for Anita.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: As Anita thinks about Vibhuti, Manmohan arrives, and they discuss how busy their partners are. Manmohan adds loose-motion medicine to the tiffin meant for Happu to disrupt the catering business. Angoori replaces Happu's tiffin with Manmohan's by mistake, and he ends up eating Happu's food. Manmohan falls sick. Manmohan feels bad and decides to be supportive. Even Anita decides to be so and informs it to Manmohan. Angoori feels bad about not spending time with Manmohan and stops her business.

episodesList.title: Angoori Suspects Manmohan Of Having an Affair
episodesList.summary: Angoori assumes that Manmohan sings for her in his sleep, but later finds out that it is for someone else. Angoori tells Vibhuti about Manmohan singing for someone else, and they plan to record it and query him. Manmohan receives a call from a man, Sweety, who is a fan of his business and adores him. Angoori overhears the conversation and assumes that Sweety is Manmohan's lover. Angoori calls Vibhuti and tells him about Sweety. Anita overhears and assumes that Vibhuti has an affair with Sweety.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Plans to Find Out About Manmohan's Girlfriend
episodesList.summary: Manmohan wants to romance Angoori, but she refuses to do so. Anita tries to be romantic with Vibhuti, but he is uninterested. Manmohan starts singing. Angoori calls Vibhuti and Anita assumes that it is Sweety. Vibhuti and Angoori try to record and find out who Manmohan is singing for. Angoori informs Amma Ji about Manmohan's affair, and she decides to come home. Vibhuti tells Manmohan that he has a girlfriend to find out about Manmohan's girlfriend, but Manmohan denies having one.

episodesList.title: Sweety Visits Manmohan and Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan informs Anita about Vibhuti's lover. Vibhuti suggests to Angoori that she pretend to have an affair on the phone. Angoori calls Vibhuti and pretends to have an affair with some Raj. Anita overhears Vibhuti pretending to be Raj and removes him from the house. Manmohan is sad about Angoori's affair. Amma Ji beats Manmohan and removes him from the house. Vibhuti and Manmohan discuss why they were removed. Sweety comes to meet Manmohan and Angoori. Anita and Angoori realise the confusion.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Dramatic Performance
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori apologise to their spouses. As Anita watches Vibhuti's old drama videos, Manmohan asks what she likes about it. Anita tells him that Vibhuti is an artist, and Manmohan lacks drama-based knowledge. Manmohan decides to prove her wrong. As Saxena discusses a TV show revolving around a bad husband with Malkhan, Manmohan asks Saxena to lend him the script. Manmohan asks Angoori to enact the script with him at night. The Mishras overhear and assume that Manmohan is torturing Angoori.

episodesList.title: The Mishras Call Happu to Help Angoori
episodesList.summary: When Vibhuti asks Angoori what happened the previous night, she tells him that she was studying. Manmohan tells Anita that he and Angoori played chess then. Manmohan asks Vibhuti to teach him angry expressions, which angers Vibhuti. Manmohan assumes that Vibhuti is teaching him. As the Tiwaris enact the script, Angoori shrieks on seeing a mouse. Manmohan picks a stick to hit the mouse. Assuming that Manmohan is hitting Angoori, the Mishras call Happu, who finds the Tiwari house's state alright.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Act is Exposed
episodesList.summary: Angoori buys costly okra for Manmohan. Vibhuti tells Angoori not to love an abusive husband so much, but she says that Manmohan is good. Manmohan asks Anita to lend Vibhuti's leather belt, but she refuses to do so. The Mishras feel that Manmohan will use the belt to hit Angoori and decide to save her. As Manmohan ties up Angoori and starts enacting, Amma Ji, the Mishras and Happu barge in. Amma Ji beats up Manmohan. The Tiwaris clarify that they were just acting. Anita lauds Manmohan's acting.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Incites Anita to Divorce Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita trips over Vibhuti's slippers and shouts at him for being careless. They shout at each other. Anita removes Vibhuti from the home. As Manmohan and Angoori behave playfully with each other, Vibhuti seeks shelter. Manmohan decides to mediate, but instead instigates Anita by saying that Vibhuti wants a divorce. Anita decides to divorce him first and asks Manmohan to get a lawyer. Manmohan finds out that Saxena is a lawyer. Manmohan informs Vibhuti that Anita wants a divorce.

episodesList.title: Anita Gives Divorce Notice to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena discusses the divorce with Anita and gives its notice to Vibhuti. Vibhuti gets nightmares, because of which Laddoo asks him to leave his room. Vibhuti goes to Angoori, and they exchange places. Manmohan tries to hug Vibhuti, assuming that he is Angoori. Manju calls Anita to talk to Vibhuti, but Anita does not inform her about the divorce. Manmohan wants to use the loo, but Vibhuti is occupying it. Anita is on call with her friend when she mentions her birthday. Manmohan overhears it.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Tries to Break Anita and Vibhuti's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti buys roses for Anita, but is scared to give them to her. Manmohan offers to give them on Vibhuti's behalf. Manmohan takes the roses, but wishes Anita himself and says that Vibhuti has forgotten her birthday. He tells her to have a party to make Vibhuti feel bad. Manmohan tells Vibhuti that Anita tore his card and asks him to attend the party to make her feel bad. Manmohan throws a party where Vibhuti sings a betrayal song. Anita runs out, and Manmohan consoles her. Anita returns dancing.

episodesList.title: The Mishras' and Tiwaris' Plan For Monsoon
episodesList.summary: Angoori cries because of the separation involving the Mishras. Manmohan decides to patch them up and calls Anita and informs that Vibhuti has consumed poison and vice versa. The Mishras end up getting back together. It is thundering, and Vibhuti wants to get wet in the rain with Angoori. Angoori refuses at first as Manmohan hates rains, but then agrees. Anita shares her desire to have home-made onion fritters with Manmohan as Vibhuti does not cook it well. Manmohan promises to cook for her.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Makes Fritters For Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita agrees to eat fritters only when it rains. Manmohan sends Angoori to rest and makes fritter batter under the pretext of helping her. Vibhuti tells Anita that he is practising to dance with her. When it starts raining, Vibhuti runs towards Angoori while Manmohan runs towards Anita with fritter batter. Angoori prays and tells Vibhuti to wait. By the time that Angoori is done, and Manmohan starts frying fritters, the rain stops. Vibhuti and Manmohan catch each other leaving the other's house.

episodesList.title: The Rain Spoils Manmohan and Vibhuti's Plan
episodesList.summary: Angoori sends Manmohan to bathe. Anita books movie tickets to go with Vibhuti, but he refuses to go with her, and runs out when it starts raining. Vibhuti takes Angoori out to dance and locks Manmohan up in the room. Just when Angoori steps out, it stops raining. Manmohan hears the rain and wants to rush to Anita in a soapy state, but is locked up. Angoori calls Amma Ji and informs about Manmohan's sudden love for rains. Anita and Angoori are not at home when it rains unexpectedly.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Millionaire
episodesList.summary: Angoori dances in the rain but Vibhuti is unable to see or join her as he is suffering from high fever. Manmohan gets some fritters for Anita but she declines due to her diet. Angoori informs Vibhuti and Saxena that Manmohan is buying a car. Saxena goes on a vacation to England. Anita receives calls from Vibhuti's creditors and she rebuked him. A lawyer arrives and informs that Vibhuti's late uncle has left him property worth INR 25 crores. The Tiwaris find out that Vibhuti is a millionaire.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Anita Show-off Their Wealth
episodesList.summary: Anita makes calls to buy cars and homes. Vibhuti plans to buy a kabaddi team but Anita tells him to wait till the money is received. He gifts Anita a diamond ring. Manju informs Anita about her dream where Vibhuti had become rich. Anita decides not to tell Manju that her dream has come true. The Mishras distribute clothes to the poor when Happu arrives and offers security to them. Manmohan calls his rich relatives to find out if anyone is dead. Vibhuti interviews the neighbours to hire servants.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Servants Mistreat Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti brings an expensive saree for Angoori which she decides to gift to Ammaji. Tillu asks for his pending salary from Manmohan, while Vibhuti pays him more than his salary and hires him as his secretary. Vibhuti continues to purchase things on credit, making Anita scared. A money lender lends Vibhuti INR 10 Lac and Anita is stressed. Vibhuti invites the Tiwaris for dinner. When the Tiwaris go to the Mishras house for dinner, all the servants along with Vibhuti mistreat Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Offers to Pay Off Vibhuti's Debts
episodesList.summary: Manmohan has a dying rich step-uncle and he waits for him to die. According to Vibhuti's uncle's will, Vibhuti is left with a debt of INR 2.5 lakhs and no property. Vibhuti falls in a huge debt and Manmohan offers to pay his debt as he is going to be rich. Angoori cures Manmohan's uncle and Manmohan gets nothing. Anita's friend brings her dog, Ravi, for her to keep for five days. Vibhuti hates dogs. Vibhuti tells Angoori to stop Manmohan's food for him to develop his muscles.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets a Dog
episodesList.summary: Angoori is allergic to dogs. Anita is feeding Ravi when Vibhuti arrives so she hides Ravi. The Mishras are fast asleep when Ravi enters their bed and Vibhuti finds out that Ravi is at home. Vibhuti sleeps in the veranda and Angoori asks him the reason. When Vibhuti informs her about Ravi, she tells him to stay away. Manmohan comes to meet Anita and Ravi smells his feet. Ravi ends up biting Manmohan. Happu comes to warn Anita about the chain snatchers when Ravi scares him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Plan to Get Rid Of Ravi
episodesList.summary: Ravi bites Happu and Manmohan. Doctor Gupta informs Manmohan that he has to behave like a dog to befriend a dog. When Manmohan practices to behave like a dog Angoori assumes he is becoming one and decides to cure him. Manmohan tries to befriend Ravi but gets bitten. On Ammaji's recommendation, Angoori gives Manmohan an iron rod burn to cure him. Angoori throws Manmohan out of the house because of the dog smell. Vibhuti and Manmohan kidnap Ravi and give him to Saxena. Anita looks for Ravi.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Creates a Chatbook Account
episodesList.summary: Anita threatens to leave if Ravi is not found. Vibhuti and Manmohan ask Saxena to return Ravi but he is lost. They confess about their deed to Anita. Saxena arrives with Ravi and informs that he was hiding in his home. Anita asks Vibhuti to start a chatbook account. Vibhuti creates Angoori's account on chatbook to chat with her. Anita wants to create an advertisement for her classes. Vibhuti refuses to act in the advertisement but Manmohan agrees to do it. Angoori takes Ladoo's help to chat.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Misleads Angoori
episodesList.summary: Ladoo sends rude replies to Vibhuti's messages and Vibhuti is confused why Angoori is being rude. Saxena explains to Teeka and Malkhan about copywriting and Manmohan asks Saxena to teach him modelling. Angoori asks Vibhuti to come online at night. Ladoo continues to post rude replies to Vibhuti and compliments Manmohan. Vibhuti pretends to be Angelina and chats with Angoori. He informs Angoori that he is Manmohan's girlfriend. Manmohan dresses differently and Angoori assumes it is for Angelina.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Incites Angoori Against Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Manmohan to add a cap to complete his look. Angoori stops going online and Vibhuti tells her not to be scared of Angelina. While chatting as Angelina, Vibhuti informs Angoori that she has gifted Manmohan a cap. Manmohan walks in wearing the cap. Angoori questions Manmohan about the cap and he lies to her. Vibhuti keeps flowers in Tiwari's lawn with a card with Angelina's name to make Angoori angry. Angelina is invited by Anita to play the lead in the advertisement.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Health Report
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Angelina sit on a bike as a part of their shoot. Angoori stops them but Anita explains the situation. They wonder who has falsely defamed Manmohan. Manmohan approaches Anita with a backache and she makes Vibhuti kick him as a therapy. The doctor comes with Manmohan's bad health reports while Vibhuti's reports are perfect. Manmohan bribes the doctor to inform the Mishras that Vibhuti has diabetes. As a religious ritual, Angoori plans to laugh the entire day at anything said to her.

episodesList.title: Anita Stops Vibhuti From Eating Sweets
episodesList.summary: Teeka and Malkhan bring sweets for Vibhuti. Manmohan eats all the sweets. Vibhuti tries to steal the pastries from the fridge but Anita gives away the pastries to Manmohan who eats them in front of Vibhuti. Vibhuti goes to Angoori and requests her for some sweets when Manmohan arrives and eats the piece that Angoori was offering Vibhuti. Vibhuti and Manmohan fight and Happu decides to arrest Vibhuti. Anita stops Happu. Anita locks Vibhuti to stop him from eating sweets. Manju arrives.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Gets Diabetes
episodesList.summary: Anita lies to Manju that Vibhuti is not at home. Manmohan informs Manju that Vibhuti is upstairs and she is angry with Anita for lying. Anita informs Manju about Vibhuti's diabetes. Vibhuti tricks Anita into opening the door and runs away with the sweets. Saxena stops Vibhuti from eating the sweets and they fight while Manmohan polishes off the sweets. Manmohan faints and the doctor informs that he has diabetes. Anita finds Vibhuti's original reports that state that Vibhuti is healthy.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Invests Money In Prem's Buisness
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's friend Prem, a rich investor, decides to meet him. As the Tiwaris and Manmohan talk about his income, Prem arrives. Prem makes fun of Vibhuti. Vibhuti decides to invest and become rich and asks Angoori to choose a company to invest in as he feels that she is lucky for him. Vibhuti earns a good profit. Manmohan assumes that Anita is lucky for Vibhuti and decides to invest in a company Anita selects. Vibhuti informs Anita about the profit and his further plans. Anita is sceptical.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sells Anita's Necklace
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti steals Anita's necklace and uses it as a collateral to buy more shares. Vibhuti warns Manmohan that the company he is investing in is not profitable. Manmohan has second thoughts, but his inner voice tells him to go ahead. Vibhuti suffers a loss and decides to kill himself, but stops for Angoori. Manmohan profits and takes sweets for Anita and informs her about Vibhuti's loss. Vibhuti denies investing any money. Vibhuti is shocked to see that Manmohan has gifted Angoori Anita's necklace.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tries to Steal Anita's Necklace
episodesList.summary: Anita loves Angoori's necklace and asks Vibhuti to show Angoori the same one she has. Vibhuti diverts them. Vibhuti decides to borrow money from Saxena. As Vibhuti tells Saxena everything, Manmohan overhears them. Manmohan tells Vibhuti to steal the necklace. Angoori sees Vibhuti stealing and shouts. Pelu catches Vibhuti. Vibhuti comes clean to Anita, who tells that the necklace was a cheap fake. Angoori and Vibhuti read news about a vigilante, who bests men who torture their wives.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Gets Vibhuti Thrashed By The Vigilante
episodesList.summary: Anita wants to meet the vigilante. Manmohan tells her to write a letter to the vigilante about Vibhuti and use it to meet him. Anita agrees. Manmohan imagines being the vigilante and winning Anita's heart. Manmohan brings holy seeds for Anita and Angoori and asks Angoori to call Anita over alone. The Tiwaris gift the seeds to Anita. Manmohan leaves the women alone and locks them in. Manmohan calls Vibhuti outside. Vibhuti gets beaten by the vigilante. Anita loses a chance to meet the vigilante.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Writes a Letter to Get Back At Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Manju is shocked to see Vibhuti wounded. Anita accepts that she wrote the letter on Manmohan's suggestion. As Teeka and Malkhan talk about girls, the vigilante arrives and beats them. The vigilante is Saxena. Manmohan asks Angoori to not write a letter about him if Vibhuti insists. Vibhuti tries to instigate Angoori vainly. Saxena sees Vibhuti writing a letter against Manmohan. Vibhuti brings a gift for Angoori and asks Anita to call her over alone. Vibhuti leaves the women alone.

episodesList.title: Anita Meets The Vigilante
episodesList.summary: As Vibhuti and Manmohan talk, the vigilante comes and batters Vibhuti. All are confused as to why Vibhuti was beaten up again. When Anita and Angoori talk about the vigilante, Manmohan overhears that Anita wants to hug the vigilante. When Manmohan calls up Vibhuti as the vigilante, Anita snatches the phone from him. Manmohan vows to meet Anita at night. Saxena overhears Manmohan's conversation. Manmohan comes as the vigilante. Anita asks for selfies with the vigilante, and he offers to hug her.

episodesList.title: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain - Episode 121 - August 17, 2015 - Full Episode
episodesList.summary: Bhabi Ji Ghar Par Hain! will take you to the lively lanes of Kanpur and introduce two distinctly different neighbouring couples. Produced by Edit II,the sitcom promises rib-tickling comedy while bringing forth human tendencies.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrests Manmohan For Making Fun Of Him
episodesList.summary: Anita feels that her sense of humour is bad. Manmohan cracks a joke about spouses to prove her wrong but ends up enraging her. Manmohan runs away. As Saxena prepares for a lecture on sense of humour, Manmohan approaches and asks for help. He makes fun of Manmohan and upsets him. Anita tells a joke to Vibhuti and gets a lukewarm response, which makes her upset. Manmohan approaches Saxena and thinks that sense of humour is in making fun of others. He starts making fun of Happu and gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori's Bad Jokes
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori decide to exchange their jokes to make their husbands laugh. Anita shares Angoori's joke with Vibhuti but he doesn't laugh. Angoori informs Ammaji about Manmohan not liking her jokes. Ammaji asks Angoori to put her on hold and share a joke with Manmohan. When Manmohan doesn't laugh, Ammji reprimands him. Vibhuti and Manmohan make a deal. They go to their respective wives and insist on hearing their jokes. The wives are happy to hear them laugh on their jokes.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets X-ray Sunglasses
episodesList.summary: Angoori cooks wearing sunglasses and informs Vibhuti that Manmohan has got conjunctivitis. Prem gifts Vibhuti x-ray sunglasses which can make you see through the clothes. Vibhuti decides to see Angoori through the sunglasses but his inner voice stops him. Ammaji gives the home remedy of applying cow dung on Manmohan's eye to Angoori. Anita visits the Tiwaris and Manmohan hides his conjunctivitis. Vibhuti is about to throw away the x-ray sunglasses when he bangs into Saxena and loses them.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tells Anita About The X-ray Sunglasses
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti stops Anita from going to the market as he is scared that someone will look at her using the x-ray sunglasses. Presuming that they are the x-ray sunglasses, Vibhuti drops his basket when he sees the vegetable vendor wearing sunglasses and talking to Angoori. Vibhuti snatches Happu's sunglasses and runs away. Vibhuti sees Teeka and Malkhan wearing sunglasses and staring at Anita from the balcony and beats them. Vibhuti reveals the truth to an angry Anita. Manmohan overhears them.

episodesList.title: Prem Reveals The Truth About The X-ray Sunglasses
episodesList.summary: Manmohan tells Angoori about Vibhuti's x-ray sunglasses which makes her avoid Vibhuti. Vibhuti dreams that men wearing x-ray sunglasses are chasing him. Manmohan finds the x-ray sunglasses and using them, decides to see Anita but his inner voice stops him. Angoori overhears Manmohan talking to himself about possessing the x-ray sunglasses and informs the Tiwaris. Both the women rebuke their husbands. Prem arrives and informs them that the x-ray sunglasses were fake.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Uses The Lie-detector
episodesList.summary: Happu keeps a lie-detector at Manmohan's house until the police station gets painted and teaches Manmohan how to use it. Pelu drops Anita and asks a high fare for the ride. Anita tells him that he is lying when Manmohan intervenes and offers to test with his lie-detector. Pelu proves to be truthful. Vibhuti dreams about the lie-detector and Angoori. Anita refuses to give the clothes to the laundryman as he uses a sub-standard detergent but he denies the allegation.

episodesList.title: Anita Tests Vibhuti With The Lie-detector
episodesList.summary: The Mishras and the Tiwaris test the laundryman's honesty with the lie-detector and find out that he is using a sub-standard detergent. Next, the wives decide to test the lie-detector on their husbands and Manmohan goes in first. Angoori asks him simple questions so he passes the test. Anita asks Vibhuti twisted questions but he also passes. When she finally asks if she is the only woman Vibhuti loves, he pretends to get an epileptic attack making Anita decide to test him once he is well.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Kick Their Husbands Out
episodesList.summary: Manmohan finds the way to tweak the lie detector's result from Happu. Vibhuti bribes Happu to take the machine away but Happu gets called by his boss so he is unable to help Vibhuti. Anita asks Vibhuti if he only loves her and his answer is detected as a lie. Anita throws Vibhuti from the house which makes Manmohan happy. Angoori also decides to test Manmohan with the same question and Manmohan fails the test and Angoori too throws him out of the house.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Buy Rakhis
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti decide to take Happu's help to win their wives back. They bribe Happu to tell their wives that the machine is faulty. Happu informs Anita and Angoori that the machine is faulty and even provides a demonstration. Anita and Angoori repent. Vibhuti dedicates a love song for Angoori on the radio but accidentally a brotherly song is played. Saxena sells 'rakhis' and Anita and Angoori decide to tie 'rakhis' to the men in the area who look like their brothers.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan's Attempts to Avoid Rakhi
episodesList.summary: To avoid 'Raksha Bandhan' celebrations with Anita, Manmohan plans to leave for Aligarh. To ensure his escape, Manmohan rushes towards the door but falls and sprains his right leg. Vibhuti jumps off his balcony in the middle of the night and runs away in Pelu's rickshaw. But Pelu drops him back home. Meanwhile, Manmohan convinces Saxena to crash his bicycle into him, but Angoori saves him. Manmohan and Vibhuti carry out all kinds of shenanigans to avoid being tied a 'rakhi' by Anita and Angoori.

episodesList.title: The Mishras Visit Tiwaris For Raksha Bandhan
episodesList.summary: Manmohan dreams that Anita forcibly ties a rakhi around his wrist. So, Manmohan fakes an epileptic attack, and a doctor is called. Manmohan gives up his act when the doctor pulls out an injection. Vibhuti hides in his house, and Happu tries to help Anita find him. Happu finds him hiding in his fridge, but Vibhuti bribes him to shut him up. Yet, Happu tells Anita where he is hiding. Anita and Vibhuti visit Angoori's house for 'Raksha Bandhan'. What happens next surprises both of them.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Arranges a Job For Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti that she is fasting for 'Karva Chauth'. Anita wants Vibhuti to work as a peon, but Vibhuti disagrees. Manmohan finds a job for Vibhuti in Dubai as a sheikh's accountant-cum-personal assistant for INR one lakh a month. Angoori can't break her fast as she is unable to see the moon in the sky. Vibhuti climbs up a tree to show Angoori a lunar image and break her fast. Saxena sees Vibhuti in the tree and stones his ear. Vibhuti's hearing ability is affected.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loses His Hearing Ability
episodesList.summary: Manmohan brings the sheikh to Vibhuti's house. The sheikh interviews Vibhuti, but Vibhuti mishears all the queries due to his poor hearing. Anita and Manmohan discover Vibhuti's poor hearing, and she calls a doctor. The doctor gives eardrops to Vibhuti that deafen him. Happu seeks Vibhuti's advice, but he misunderstands and shoots Happu's gun in the air. When Vibhuti visits Angoori's house, she tries to talk to him using sign language. But Vibhuti misunderstands her actions as flirty gestures.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be Deaf
episodesList.summary: Angoori applies medicine on Vibhuti's ears, which leads to the recovery of his hearing. Vibhuti pretends to be deaf to find out what people talk behind his back. The sheikh offers to take Vibhuti to Dubai. Vibhuti plans revenge with his pal Leone, an actress. Leone falsely accuses Manmohan of eve teasing. Happu, Anita, and Angoori find out about the incident and ask Vibhuti about it, but he pretends to be deaf. But Vibhuti reveals his plan when Angoori threatens to leave the neighbourhood.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Cheat to Get Krishna's Part
episodesList.summary: Angoori wants Manmohan to play the role of Krishna in Janmashtami celebrations, but he disagrees. Anita wants Vibhuti to portray Krishna, and he disagrees too. Manmohan and Vibhuti find out that Anita and Angoori will portray Rukmini and Radha. Vibhuti and Manmohan want to portray Krishna. But the role of Krishna is assigned to Saxena. Later, Happu, Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Pelu also want to play Krishna. Anita decides to pick chits to select their Krishna. Manmohan and Vibhuti cheat in the game.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Lips Get Burnt
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori find out that Vibhuti and Manmohan cheated in the game. Vibhuti pretends to play a flute with Saxena's help to impress Angoori. Manmohan sabotages his act and gives him an electric shock that burns Vibhuti's lips. Happu injures his left leg while breaking the pot. Manmohan bribes Happu to play the role of Kansa. While Angoori makes butter, a lizard enters her vessel, and Manmohan eats that butter. Anita notices Vibhuti's burnt lips, but he lies about the reason behind it.

episodesList.title: Angoori Dreams About Vibhuti's Death
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti spills oil in front of Manmohan's home to stop him from being Krishna. Manmohan and Vibhuti slip due to the oil and hurt themselves. Laddoo plays Krishna in the 'Janmashtami' procession. Later, Angoori has a nightmare that Vibhuti is dead. Angoori is worried about Vibhuti's life. Anita is excited as her uncle will be visiting and wants to surprise Vibhuti. Vibhuti finds out about Angoori's nightmare when she is praying. Vibhuti lies to Angoori that he will die soon to get closer to her.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Learns About Vibhuti's 'disease'
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Manmohan about Vibhuti's disease. Manmohan feels sympathy for Vibhuti. Vibhuti requests Manmohan to hide the news from Anita. Manmohan overhears Anita's phone conversation with a DJ and thinks that she is planning to celebrate Vibhuti's death. Vibhuti tries to flirt with Angoori by taking advantage of his 'health excuse', but fails miserably. Manmohan tells Happu, Teeka Ram and Malkhan that Vibhuti will die soon. Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu visit Anita's house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Lie Gets Exposed
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Saxena, and Anita prepare for a party. 'Yaadram Ka Launda' plays music, and Anita and Saxena dance to his tunes. Manmohan and Angoori stop them and tell Anita about Vibhuti's health. Vibhuti's drama gets exposed. Anita tells everyone about her uncle's visit. However, Anita's uncle cancels his plan to visit her. Manmohan brings 'jalebis' for Anita, but Vibhuti throws them away. Manmohan gets angry and plans his revenge on Vibhuti after watching a Bollywood movie.

episodesList.title: Jagmohan's Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manmohan robs Vibhuti and forces him to slap himself at knifepoint. When Vibhuti complains about the incident to Angoori, Manmohan lies that he has an evil identical twin, Jagmohan, who did it. Jagmohan enters Vibhuti's house and forces him to slap himself at knifepoint. Anita and Vibhuti visit Angoori's house and threaten to file an FIR. But Manmohan convinces Vibhuti that he doesn't need to file a report. Jagmohan strikes again, and he forces Teeka and Malkhan to beat up Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Amma Ji Thrashes Manmohan For Lying
episodesList.summary: Jagmohan enters Vibhuti's house to abuse him, but Anita catches him and batters him. Manmohan goes home, but Angoori thinks that he is Jagmohan and hits him with a pole. Vibhuti calls Amma Ji to complain about Jagmohan. However, Amma Ji denies the existence of Jagmohan. Jagmohan attacks Vibhuti again, but Amma Ji catches him and beats him up with a leather belt. Manmohan reveals that he was lying all along about Jagmohan. Manmohan tries to justify his actions. Amma Ji hits Manmohan again.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti finds out that there are kidnappers in his neighbourhood and contemplates disappearing for a few days. Vibhuti pays Teeka and Malkhan to kidnap him. While sitting in his verandah with Anita and Angoori, Vibhuti patiently waits to be kidnapped. Vibhuti gets kidnapped in front of Anita and Angoori. Anita files a kidnapping complaint with Happu's help. Manmohan, Angoori, and Anita decide to wait for the kidnapper's phone call. Vibhuti finds out that he has been actually kidnapped.

episodesList.title: Angoori Pays Ransom to Vibhuti's Kidnappers
episodesList.summary: Anita is worried about Vibhuti and waits for the kidnapper's phone call. Teeka and Malkhan reach Anita's house to kidnap Vibhuti, but they find out that he has already been kidnapped. Teeka and Malkhan try to find Vibhuti. The kidnappers call Anita and seek a ransom of INR 50,000. Angoori is asked to carry the money to a specific location. Vibhuti finds out that Saxena has also been kidnapped with him. Angoori pays ransom to the kidnappers. Vibhuti escapes from the kidnappers with Saxena's help.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Sudden Affinity For 'chinese'
episodesList.summary: Manmohan overhears Anita's phone conversation, where she finds out that her great-grandmother was Chinese, and that she likes Chinese men. Manmohan plans to start a Chinese food business with Angoori to impress Anita. Angoori calls Amma Ji and tells her that she finds it difficult to cook Chinese food. Vibhuti suggests to Angoori that he will buy Chinese food from a restaurant and she can serve it to Manmohan. Manmohan lies to Anita that he has a deep relationship with China and knows Chinese.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Sells Chinese Food
episodesList.summary: Manmohan dresses up in Chinese attire to sell Chinese food outside his home. Manmohan saves the last two plates for Anita. Anita likes his Chinese food. Manmohan pretends to do kung fu to impress Anita. Manmohan lauds Angoori's cooking and asks her to cook more Chinese food. Vibhuti brings Chinese food for Angoori since she can't cook. Happu objects to Manmohan's business as he doesn't have the license to sell food, but Manmohan bribes him. Anita asks Manmohan about his connection with China.

episodesList.title: Anita and Manmohan Plan to Watch a Chinese Film
episodesList.summary: Manmohan practises fake kung fu again. Vibhuti sabotages his practice, which hurts Manmohan. Anita asks Manmohan to break a tube light using kung fu, and they plan to watch a Chinese film together. Vibhuti brings only a few packs of Chinese food as he runs out of money. Manmohan and Anita discuss their movie plan, and Anita's mother calls to tell her that she is not Chinese. Anita rejects Manmohan's offer to watch the Chinese movie. Angoori cooks Chinese food, and Vibhuti praises her cooking.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Insults Vibhuti For Being Unemployed
episodesList.summary: Manmohan gifts a vase to Anita, but Vibhuti breaks it accidentally. Manmohan gets angry and insults Vibhuti based on his unemployment. Anita and Angoori are unhappy with Manmohan. Vibhuti tries to borrow money from Prem, Saxena and Happu. However, he fails to persuade them. Angoori calls Amma Ji to complain about Manmohan's behaviour. Amma Ji tells her how to hurt Manmohan. Angoori fakes mood swings to hurt Manmohan. Vibhuti pretends to be a poor labourer to gain Anita's and Angoori's sympathy.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be a Labourer
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is concerned as Anita is angry with him. Angoori seduces Manmohan and kicks him out of the bedroom to torment him. Vibhuti continues his drama of being a labourer. Anita is worried about Vibhuti. Manmohan tries to apologise to Anita. Anita and Angoori see Vibhuti sleeping on his bassinet outside his home. Vibhuti pretends to eat lunch like a labourer, and Anita and Angoori offer him well-cooked food, which Vibhuti doesn't eat. Manmohan vows to Anita that he will bring Vibhuti back home.

episodesList.title: Angoori Suspects That Manmohan Likes Pammi
episodesList.summary: Manmohan apologises to Vibhuti. Vibhuti's drama gets revealed. Manmohan buys perfume for Anita and places it on her doorstep, but Vibhuti takes credit for buying the perfume. Manmohan feels cheated. A new lady, Pammi, moves into the locality. Teeka, Malkhan and Pelu are attracted to her. Angoori grows suspicious of Manmohan as she thinks that Manmohan is attracted to Pammi. Pammi visits Manmohan's house, and he tries to set her up with Vibhuti. Angoori is jealous of Pammi.

episodesList.title: Pammi Confesses Her Feelings For Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Anita and Vibhuti that she is suspicious about Manmohan and Pammi. Vibhuti tries to manipulate Angoori into thinking that she is right about Manmohan. Vibhuti meets Pammi and tries to set her up with Manmohan. Pammi calls Anita's house, which infuriates her. Vibhuti talks to Pammi, and she calls him over. Teeka, Malkhan and Happu vainly try to approach Pammi. Manmohan tells Anita that Vibhuti is at Pammi's house. Pammi tells Vibhuti that she is in love with Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Pammi Traps Vibhuti and Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Manmohan that she fully trusts Vibhuti. Pammi calls Manmohan and asks him to come over to her place. Pammi reveals that she is in love with Vibhuti. Vibhuti rushes to Angoori's house to tell her that Manmohan is at Pammi's house. Manmohan tries to deny the allegation. Pammi texts Vibhuti and Manmohan and calls them over urgently. Pammi blackmails Vibhuti and Manmohan using the video footage of their interaction. She demands a ransom of INR 10 lakhs within eight hours from both.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Come to Their Husbands' Rescue
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan try to convince Anita and Angoori to vacation with them for a few days, but they disagree. Vibhuti tells Anita about the video and the blackmailing attempt. Anita and Angoori are angry with Vibhuti and Manmohan. Anita and Angoori visit Pammi's house and manipulate her into retrieving the videos. They successfully retrieve the videos from Pammi. Happu enters Pammi's house and arrests her. Vibhuti and Manmohan try to leave their house, but Anita and Angoori stop them.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Electric Shocks
episodesList.summary: Anita reads some article in a magazine. Vibhuti criticises the article. Manmohan sees Vibhuti and Anita kissing and interrupts them. Saxena tells Manmohan about a chip that gives electric shocks. Manmohan installs the chip in Vibhuti's watch when he is sleeping. Vibhuti accidentally gives electric shocks to Laddoo, Manmohan and Angoori. Vibhuti realises that his body transmits electric currents. Anita reads another article. Vibhuti gives an electric shock to Anita purposely.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Installs a Chip In Manmohan's Glasses
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gives an electric shock to Saxena. Saxena realises that Vibhuti has his chip. The electricity supply to Angoori's house gets disrupted. Vibhuti uses his powers to start Angoori's mixer grinder. Anita constantly pushes Vibhuti away due to his electric shocks. Vibhuti realises that his watch is culpable for the electricity. Vibhuti finds the chip in his watch. Vibhuti climbs into Manmohan's bedroom and installs the chip in his glasses. Manmohan gives an electric shock to Angoori and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Punish Their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Manmohan tries to find the chip but fails. Angoori kicks Manmohan out of the bedroom due to the electric shocks. Manmohan tells Anita and Vibhuti about his problem, and Anita asks him to leave as she thinks that his condition is contagious. Angoori hits Manmohan with a stick to get rid of his problem. Manmohan begs Vibhuti to tell him where he hid the chip. Anita and Angoori give electric shocks to Vibhuti and Manmohan. Anita and Angoori reveal that they used the chips to teach them a lesson.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Lures Vibhuti Into Gambling
episodesList.summary: Anita expresses disgust after watching the Mahabharata scene, where Yudhishthira gambles away Draupadi. She tells Manmohan that she doesn't allow Vibhuti to gamble. Manmohan sees Malkhan and Saxena playing cards and intervenes. Saxena invites Manmohan over for a game that night. Anita and Vibhuti have an argument about his unemployment. Manmohan manipulates Vibhuti into gambling and calls him over to play with Saxena. Vibhuti goes to Saxena's game, and Manmohan offers him money for gambling.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loses His Independence In Gambling
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti buys onions for Angoori and gives the greengrocer extra cash in case Anita and Angoori want to buy vegetables in the future. Vibhuti returns to gamble with Saxena, Manmohan, Teeka Ram and Malkhan. Manmohan fixes the game. Vibhuti starts with a big bet. Manmohan increases the bet to INR 1,80,000. As Vibhuti falls short of cash, Manmohan convinces him to bet himself. Vibhuti loses, and Manmohan makes him his servant. Manmohan renames Vibhuti to Hetram and makes him clean his house.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Mistreats His New Servant
episodesList.summary: Angoori insults Vibhuti and forces him to work. Vibhuti tells Happu about his loss. Manmohan kicks Vibhuti and makes him work all day. Anita sees Vibhuti carrying a heavy sack to Angoori's home. Manmohan calls Vibhuti at night and orders him to feed stale flatbread to dogs. Anita sees Vibhuti trying to call dogs by barking. Saxena attacks Vibhuti and offers to eat stale flatbread. Angoori finds Vibhuti lying on the road while watering her plants and calls Anita. Vibhuti tells them the full tale.

episodesList.title: Chhuttan Seeks Shelter At Manmohan's House
episodesList.summary: Laddoo goes on a school trip. Angoori and Manmohan invite Vibhuti and Anita for dinner as Angoori plans to cook a special dish from Bihar. While watching the news, Anita finds out that a criminal has escaped from Happu's custody with his gun. As Manmohan waits for the arrival of Anita, suddenly, the criminal Chhuttan enters his house. Chhuttan threatens Manmohan and Angoori with a gun and hides at their house. Happu searches for Chhuttan and fears that he might lose his job.

episodesList.title: Chhuttan Holds The Mishras and Tiwaris Hostage
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tries to convince Anita that they should go to Manmohan's house. Happu visits Anita's house to warn her and Vibhuti about the escaped criminal, but Anita insults him for his incompetence. Anita and Vibhuti visit Manmohan's house again for dinner. Manmohan stops them from entering his house. Vibhuti insists on visiting Manmohan's house for dinner. Vibhuti and Anita forcibly enter Manmohan's house and find out that Chuttan is hiding there. They are held hostage by Chhuttan at gunpoint.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Look For a Burqa For Chhuttan
episodesList.summary: Anita plans to help Chhuttan flee by making him wear a burka. Manmohan and Vibhuti try to find a burka, and they spot Saxena in it. They request Saxena to give them his burka, but he disagrees. Anita and Angoori call them back to discuss a new idea for Chhuttan's escape. Anita gives Chhuttan a makeover to make him look like a woman, but their plan fails. They dress up Chhuttan in a burka and sneak him out of the house. Vibhuti and Angoori request Saxena to drop Chhuttan at the Kanpur bus stop.

episodesList.title: Anita Organises a Blood Donation Camp
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti has a nightmare, in which Anita turns into a dracula. Anita organises a blood donation camp, and she wishes that Vibhuti participates in it. Happu and the others announce a blood donation camp in their neighbourhood and they laud Anita for her noble deed. Vibhuti lies to Angoori about his past blood donation experience and becomes almost unconscious after getting a small cut. Vibhuti hides at Manmohan's house to escape the camp. Manmohan is excited to donate blood.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Hides From The Blood Donation Camp
episodesList.summary: Happu tells Manmohan that he donated blood. Saxena wishes to donate blood, but the doctor and Anita don't let him do so. Anita is concerned as only a few people showed up for blood donation. Vibhuti hides under Angoori's bed. Vibhuti dreams about romancing Angoori. Manmohan comes home after donating blood and asks Angoori to bring him sweet lemon juice. Vibhuti distracts Angoori and dilutes the juice with water. Manmohan changes his look and calls himself Romeo D'souza to donate blood again.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Loses Consciousness
episodesList.summary: Manmohan faints on the street after donating blood. Angoori wakes him up and gets a glass of milk for him. Vibhuti hides at Manmohan's house. Anita calls Vibhuti to ask him where he is, but he lies that his mother is sick and that he is taking care of her. When Vibhuti's mother visits his house, his lie gets exposed. Manmohan dresses up as a woman to donate blood again, but he faints at Anita's house. The doctor says that Manmohan has lost a lot of blood. Vibhuti volunteers to save Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Anita Prepares For a Night-long Prayer Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Angoori prepares for a night vigil prayer. Manmohan visits Anita's house to invite them for the prayer and tells them that he can't find a singer for the ceremony. Vibhuti tells Angoori that he sings so well for prayers that a tiger blesses the ceremony. Vibhuti teams up with Saxena and the others for a fake performance. Pandit Ji tells Anita and Manmohan that couples, who attend the prayer jointly, stay together for seven reincarnations. Manmohan plots to keep Vibhuti away from the prayer.

episodesList.title: A Tiger Appears At The Prayer Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti hosts the night vigil prayer and starts a fake performance with the help of Saxena. Manmohan puts a drug in Anita's sherbet to induce sleep. Everyone starts praying and dancing in the ceremony. Angoori asks Vibhuti about the tiger's appearance at the prayer. Teeka Ram dresses up as a tiger, but some stray dogs chase him. A real tiger comes for the prayer, which shocks all. Happu gets a call saying that a tiger has escaped from a zoo. Angoori and Anita pray to the tiger, and it goes away.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Compare Their Husbands to Demons
episodesList.summary: Anita invites Angoori for tea. They go to Anita's home and see that Vibhuti has messed up the living room. Anita and Angoori compare their husbands to Kumbhakarna and Ravana. Manmohan and Vibhuti plan to alter their opinions. Manmohan tries to address Angoori like Lord Ram and tells her that he wants to feed poor people. Manmohan looks for beggars to feed. He offers food to Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Pelu, but they refuse it. Vibhuti hires Teeka Ram and Malkhan to misbehave with florist Sreedevi.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Decide to Donate Their Organs
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti hits the florist's husband, and the florist beats him up. Vibhuti pretends to meditate and ignores Anita. Manmohan ignores Angoori and focuses on his work. Anita and Angoori try to seduce their husbands, but they fail. Vibhuti offers sweets to Laddoo and Angoori and ignores her. Saxena dresses up as an old man and appreciates Manmohan as Manmohan promises to donate his kidneys to the old man. Vibhuti calls the doctor over and tells that he wishes to donate his organs after his death.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Pretend to be Saints
episodesList.summary: Manmohan pretends to care about the world and its sorrows. Vibhuti dreams of romancing Angoori. Angoori complains to Amma Ji about Manmohan's behaviour, and she gives her an idea. Anita and Angoori discuss their husbands' weird behaviour. Anita and Angoori pretend to be saints and tell their husbands that they will adopt asceticism. Manmohan and Vibhuti reveal the truth and apologise. Vibhuti and Angoori meet two new people, Rahul and Malti, on the street. Rahul tells them that he is a rockstar.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Demand a Car From Their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Angoori wishes to drive a car, and Vibhuti tells her to demand a car from Manmohan. Vibhuti says that he will teach Angoori how to drive. Vibhuti dreams to go on a long drive with Angoori. Angoori tells Manmohan that she wants a car, but he refuses to buy one. Manmohan sees Anita wait for a rickshaw and decides to buy a car to drop her at her grooming class. Manmohan enquires about a second-hand car. Manmohan tells Angoori that he has bought a car. Anita demands a car from Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Angoori Hits Happu While Driving a Car
episodesList.summary: Manmohan drops Anita to her grooming class in his new car. Vibhuti plans to teach Angoori how to drive. Angoori and Vibhuti sneak out of their houses at night. Vibhuti teaches Angoori to drive. Happu hides in a trash can to catch a criminal. Anita sees Manmohan's car speeding on the road. Angoori drives for the first time and crashes into the trash can that Happu is using for hiding. Angoori and Vibhuti return home silently. Happu has multiple injuries and starts looking for the driver.

episodesList.title: The Mishras and Tiwaris Observe 'karva Chauth' Fast
episodesList.summary: Happu accuses Manmohan of drunk-driving and crashing into him. Happu tells Angoori about the whole incident, and she reveals that it was her fault. Happu tries to arrest Angoori, but a man interrupts them with a complaint about his stolen car. They all find out that Happu had sold Manmohan a stolen car, and Angoori is not arrested. Vibhuti buys an ice-cream cone for Angoori, but she tells him that she can't eat as she is fasting for 'Karva Chauth'. Vibhuti and Manmohan also fast for their wives.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Struggle With Their Fast
episodesList.summary: Manmohan applies 'mehendi' on Anita's hand and makes a brinjal design. Vibhuti cleans Manmohan's house to help Angoori during her fast. Angoori tells a hungry Manmohan a story to make him forget about hunger. Vibhuti also experiences hunger, and Saxena eats a 'samosa' in front of him. An angry Vibhuti slaps Saxena. Vibhuti gives a prank call to Manmohan and tells him that his shop is on fire. Anita calls Vibhuti to tell him that she sprained her leg. Manmohan returns home as Laddoo is lunching.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Wait to Break Their Fast
episodesList.summary: As Vibhuti tries to eat food from his fridge, Anita catches him. Vibhuti buys sarees for Angoori and Anita. When Manmohan and Angoori leave their house, Vibhuti climbs into their bedroom with her saree using a ladder. Saxena takes his ladder. As Vibhuti tries to escape from another door, Manmohan and Angoori come back home. Vibhuti veils himself using the saree and pretends to be a woman to escape. Manmohan and Vibhuti wait for the moon to rise. Vibhuti plans with Saxena to show a lunar image.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loses His Memory
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram and Malkhan sell a lottery ticket to Vibhuti. Angoori attaches a nail to a wall with a hammer. The head of the hammer falls on Vibhuti's head, making him unconscious. Dr Gupta helps restore his consciousness, but Vibhuti loses his memory and can't recognise anyone. Anita meets Vibhuti, and he fails to recognise her. Manmohan tells Anita about the incident, but Vibhuti interrupts and tells them that he is fine. Angoori tells Anita about the incident. Vibhuti loses his memory again.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Regains His Memory
episodesList.summary: To take advantage of Vibhuti's memory loss, Manmohan tells him that he stays in Shikarpur. Anita tries to find Vibhuti and asks Happu to search for him. After Pelu drops a banana peel on the street, Vibhuti slips and bangs his head against a pillar. Happu finds Vibhuti and vainly tries to send him to Shikarpur as Vibhuti regains his memory. Angoori calls Amma Ji, and Vibhuti overhears their conversation about his memory. Vibhuti pretends to have memory loss to gain sympathy from Angoori.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Oppose The Flyover's Construction
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori are concerned for Vibhuti. Teeka Ram and Malkhan tell Vibhuti that he has won INR 1 crore in a lottery. Vibhuti's excitement exposes his drama. The lottery inspector informs Teeka Ram that Vibhuti hasn't won the lottery. Vibhuti and Manmohan check out Angoori and Anita from their balconies. Manmohan and Vibhuti find out that a flyover will be constructed in front of their houses. They are angry as the flyover will not let them see Angoori and Anita from their balconies.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Goes On a Hunger Strike
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti wishes to stop the flyover construction, and Manmohan tries to manipulate him into protesting. Manmohan and Vibhuti bribe civil engineer Gupta, but he disagrees with their terms. Vibhuti has a nightmare about the constructed flyover. Manmohan and Vibhuti motivate each other to stop the project. They hold a meeting in their locality to manipulate everyone, but they fail miserably. Vibhuti flips a coin to decide who will protest against the construction. Manmohan starts a hunger strike.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Secretly Eats Biryani
episodesList.summary: Angoori calls Amma Ji to complain about Manmohan's hunger strike. Angoori brings food for Manmohan, but he doesn't eat it. Saxena invites everyone except Manmohan for a party to celebrate the day he was declared insane. Everyone celebrates and eats 'biryani' at Saxena's party. Manmohan bribes Happu for the 'biryani'. Manmohan eats 'biryani' in the middle of the night. Amma Ji arrives and forcibly feeds Manmohan with Angoori's help. Dr Gupta is called, and he diagnoses Manmohan with overeating.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Takes Credit For Saxena's Work
episodesList.summary: Manmohan finds out via the media that a writer is returning his award as a protest. Saxena goes to Manmohan's house and asks Manmohan to keep his literature award with him for two days. Manmohan lies to Anita that he had won an award and takes credit for Saxena's work to impress her. Vibhuti lies to Angoori that he has got hired as a secret agent, who reports writers that return their awards. Manmohan tells that he will return his award to back other writers to impress Anita and her pal Jassi.

episodesList.title: Anita Organises a Press Conference For Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Angoori tries to hide Manmohan's award when he is sleeping. Happu visits Manmohan's house in the middle of the night and asks him to recite stories for his kids. Angoori complains to Amma Ji about the whole incident. Happu comes back and tells Manmohan and Angoori that Manmohan's stories sickened his kids. Anita interviews Manmohan about his literary career choices and prepares for a press conference. Vibhuti tries to force Angoori to go for a candlelight dinner with him to save Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Manmonhan and Vibhuti's Lies Get Revealed
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti convinces Angoori for a candlelight dinner with him. Manmohan tells Anita that he was lying. A secret agent interrupts Vibhuti and Angoori. He asks for Vibhuti's ID, which exposes Vibhuti's act. Saxena returns to Manmohan's home for his award, and his lie gets revealed to Angoori. Vibhuti overhears Manmohan's conversation about Angoori visiting her native place for Diwali as she is scared of fireworks. Vibhuti breaks Manmohan's phone. Angoori dreams about interacting with Goddess Laxmi.

episodesList.title: Angoori Turns Into a Kid
episodesList.summary: Manmohan complains to Anita that Vibhuti broke his phone. Anita tells Manmohan that she loves fireworks. Vibhuti tries to convince everyone in the locality against using fireworks. Manmohan accidentally burns Tillu's face while lighting fireworks. As Vibhuti tries to convince Angoori to stay, suddenly, Teeka Ram and Malkhan burst firecrackers to scare him. Angoori faints due to the sound of fireworks. Angoori mentally turns into a six-year-old kid and fails to recognise Vibhuti and Manmohan.

episodesList.title: The Tiwaris and Mishras Celebrate Diwali
episodesList.summary: Angoori constantly cries and annoys Manmohan. Angoori's condition saddens Vibhuti and Manmohan. Teeka Ram and Malkhan try to ask for money from Vibhuti and Manmohan, but they beat up Teeka Ram and Malkhan. Angoori, Saxena and Pelu team up to prank Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Happu, and Anita. Amma Ji visits Manmohan's house as she is worried about Angoori. Manmohan is concerned about Angoori. Vibhuti, Anita, Amma Ji and Laddoo celebrate Diwali. Amma Ji helps Angoori recover using a medicine.

episodesList.title: Bhoory Lal Comes to Visit Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan repairs his radio. Manmohan and Angoori play the radio and dance. Angoori's father Bhoorey Lal comes to meet her but refuses to enter Manmohan's house and expresses hatred for him due to his commercial choices. Angoori takes Bhoorey Lal to Vibhuti's house. Vibhuti wishes to take advantage of his hatred for Manmohan. Vibhuti offers to let Bhoorey Lal stay at his place. Angoori tells Manmohan about her father's visit, which intimidates him. Vibhuti tries to bond with Bhoorey Lal.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey Lal Bonds With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti bonds with Bhoorey Lal with alcohol. Manmohan is jealous of the bonding between Vibhuti and Bhoorey Lal. Angoori and Manmohan meet and try to communicate with Bhoorey Lal, but he insults and dismisses Manmohan and Angoori. Bhoorey Lal interrupts Anita and Vibhuti when they are sleeping and wishes to sleep between them on their bed. Vibhuti guides him to the living room and makes him sleep on the couch. Vibhuti breaks a mirror of Bhoorey Lal's scooter and puts the blame on Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Bhoorey Lal Files an Fir Against Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti lies to Bhoorey Lal that Manmohan tortures his daughter and manipulates him into filing an FIR against him. Happu goes to Manmohan to tell him about the arrest warrant and gives a deadline to Angoori of two hours to convince Bhoorey Lal to scrap his FIR. Angoori and Manmohan request Bhoorey Lal to cancel his FIR, but he disagrees and dismisses Manmohan. Angoori requests Happu to extend the deadline by 30 minutes. Anita tries to convince Bhoorey Lal, and he reveals what Vibhuti had said.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Invents Sundari to Frame Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Bhoorey Lal cancels his FIR and saves Manmohan. Anita wishes to go on a trip to Simla with Vibhuti. Manmohan overhears that during Vibhuti and Anita's fourth honeymoon, he had fallen into a river, disappeared for ten days, and couldn't remember what happened. Manmohan keeps a letter, faking it to be from Sundari, outside Vibhuti's home, and Anita reads it. The letter states that Vibhuti was with Sundari during his disappearance. Anita gets mad at Vibhuti and kicks him out of the house.

episodesList.title: Two Sundaris Show Up
episodesList.summary: Anita receives another letter from Sundari and she threatens to leave the house. Manmohan offers Anita his place to stay. Manmohan asks Tillu to find a girl and a child to impersonate Sundari and her child. Vibhuti asks Saxena to pretend that he is Sundari. Saxena shows up as Sundari at Manmohan's home and Tillu also pretends to be Sundari confirming that they had been together. Phulwa, the lady who had saved Vibhuti shows up and proves that he is innocent.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Job As Angoori's Tutor
episodesList.summary: Angoori receives Manmohan's client, Gupta's, call. Due to Angoori's poor English, she miscommunicates to him that Manmohan has had an accident. Angoori's faux pas could have led to Manmohan losing money in his business. Manmohan gets mad at Angoori and tells her to learn English before speaking the language. Anita finds out that Minal's husband has got a promotion and wishes Vibhuti had a job too. An angry Anta asks Vibhuti to find a job. Vibhuti gets a job as Angoori's English tutor.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Ignore Their Spouses
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti dresses as a professor to teach Angoori English but, Manmohan criticises him. Vibhuti faces multiple difficulties due to Angoori's poor command over the English language. Vibhuti goes home and Anita asks him to cook special food to celebrate. However, Vibhuti refuses as he wants to work. Angoori and Vibhuti ignore Manmohan and Anita because of the English lessons. Angoori calls Vibhuti to recite a poem. Anita and Manmohan discuss the issues they are facing due to these English lessons.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti does Not Wish to Help Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan challenges Angoori that if she recites a poem well, then he will become her servant. Angoori seeks Vibhuti's help. Vibhuti tries to teach her the correct pronunciation but fails. Angoori comes to Vibhuti's house for her English lesson. Vibhuti requests Anita to lie to Angoori that he's not at home. Angoori tells Anita about Manmohan's challenge. Anita decides to help her and tells her that Vibhuti is in his room. Vibhuti escapes from his balcony. Anita and Angoori look for Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Go For a Ritual
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti admits that he is unable to teach English to Angoori but Happu forces him to teach her at gunpoint. Angoori tries to narrate an essay but messes up several words. Everyone appreciates her English anyway. Saxena reads Manmohan's palm and tells him and Angoori that he might be interested in other women. Anita gets a call from the editor of her favourite magazine inviting her for a ritual that helps women control their husbands. Anita and Angoori go for the ritual together.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Hide Gulfam Kali
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti spend time at Vibhuti's home. Gulfam Kali, a local dancer, visits Vibhuti's home. Anita and Angoori return as the ritual gets cancelled. Manmohan hides Gulfam Kali in the bathroom. Anita tries to go to the bathroom but she hears a woman's scream. Manmohan comes out and lies that it was his scream. Vibhuti asks Gulfam Kali to leave. Angoori comes to Vibhuti's house looking for Manmohan and they hear a woman's scream again. Anita and Angoori get suspicious.

episodesList.title: December 15th's Importance For Anita
episodesList.summary: Manmohan brings flowers for Anita and dreams about romancing with her. Anita asks Manmohan about the reason behind getting flowers and Manmohan lies that he remembers a special day in his relationship with Angoori. Anita asks Vibhuti about the importance of December 15th but he fails to answer. Anita gets mad and kicks him out of the house until he finds the reason. Vibhuti requests Angoori to ask Anita about the reason. Anita tells her the reason but asks her not to disclose it.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Assumes That Anita is Pregnant
episodesList.summary: Anita prepares for her uncle's birthday on December 15, but Vibhuti thinks that it is her grandfather's death anniversary and plans to surprise her. When Dr Gupta tells Anita that he will have his fifth child soon, she lectures him about overpopulation. Manmohan sees Dr Gupta leaving Anita's house. Dr Gupta gives him the news, but Manmohan misunderstands that Anita is pregnant and becomes sad. Vibhuti invites Saxena, Malkhan and others to mourn on December 15, which angers Anita.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Test Their Husband's Fidelity
episodesList.summary: Manmohan gets a call from the woman, who had rejected his engagement offer, and they decide to meet. Angoori overhears Manmohan's conversation and becomes suspicious. Angoori tells Anita about the whole incident. Anita also develops suspicion about Vibhuti. Anita asks many queries to Vibhuti, but he realises that she is suspicious. Angoori asks Manmohan about the woman after he returns, but he assures her that he is loyal. Anita and Angoori take their spouses' phones and message female contacts.

episodesList.title: Saxena Flirts With Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Anita checks Vibhuti's phone and continues to message his female friend. Anita invites his female friend over, but she refuses to come as her husband is home. Angoori tells Vibhuti that Manmohan is cheating on her. Angoori gets Manmohan's phone again and tells Laddoo to message Manmohan's female friend, who is actually Saxena. Laddoo sends a flirty text, and Saxena flirts back. Angoori tells Laddoo to invite Saxena to her home the next morning. Manmohan opens his door to find Saxena bathing.

episodesList.title: Shiela and Prem Prank Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita forcibly invites Vibhuti's friend Shiela to her house. Angoori behaves rudely with Manmohan and messages Saxena, thinking that it is Manmohan's girlfriend, to come over within an hour. Saxena comes over, and Angoori beats him up with a wooden pole. Manmohan witnesses the whole incident, and Angoori's plot gets revealed. Shiela comes to Vibhuti's home and pretends to be his girlfriend. Shiela reveals that she knew Anita had messaged her all along, and she and Prem decided to prank her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tries to Invoke His Grandfather's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti dreams about his grandfather asking him to find his grandmother's box of jewellery. Saxena visits Angoori's home and tells her that he has read a book about spirits. Vibhuti tells Saxena to summon his grandfather's spirit as he wants to ask about the location of his grandmother's jewellery box. Saxena, Manmohan, Vibhuti, Anita, and Angoori sit for the ritual, but Saxena fails to deliver. Vibhuti gets up in the middle of the night and follows a witch, who is singing on the street.

episodesList.title: Jhumma Possesses Manmohan's Body
episodesList.summary: Anita and Manmohan catch Vibhuti as he follows the witch. Vibhuti tells Saxena and everyone else about his experience. Vibhuti follows the witch again and everyone witnesses the incident. The witch, Jhumma, tells them that she was a local dancer, and Vibhuti's grandfather was attracted to her. Saxena scares Jhumma away. Bhoorey Lal visits Angoori's home, and she convinces him to forgive Manmohan. Jhumma possesses Manmohan's body. Manmohan behaves rudely with Bhoorey Lal, and they argue.

episodesList.title: Jhumma Plays With Mishras' and Tiwaris' Psyche
episodesList.summary: Jhumma changes herself into Angoori and flirts with Vibhuti. Jhumma regains her natural form and scares Vibhuti. Jhumma transforms into Anita to flirt with Manmohan. Anita and Vibhuti see the witch flirting with Manmohan and tell him about it. Jhumma scares Manmohan. Angoori calls Bhoorey Lal and tells him to give Manmohan another chance. Jhumma possesses Manmohan's body again, and he behaves rudely with Bhoorey Lal. Angoori is angry with Manmohan. Saxena performs a ritual to summon the witch.

episodesList.title: Jhumma Possesses Saxena's Body
episodesList.summary: Saxena tries to stop Jhumma, and she attacks Happu. Saxena tells everyone that Jhumma wants to marry and then kill Vibhuti. Anita is concerned after receiving this information. Jhumma possesses Angoori and Anita to haunt Manmohan and Vibhuti, and they all run to each other's houses. Saxena comes to the rescue and performs a ritual to scare Jhumma away. Vibhuti, Anita, Manmohan and Angoori ask Saxena to stay with them for security. Jhumma possesses Saxena's body and haunts everyone.

episodesList.title: Saxena Banishes Jhumma
episodesList.summary: Jhumma possesses Amma Ji, who dances to music playing through Pelu's radio and faints subsequently. Vibhuti gets possessed by Jhumma and tied to a bed. Saxena manipulates a possessed Vibhuti into drinking holy water, and Jhumma's spirit leaves his body. Bhoorey Lal visits Angoori's home and insults Manmohan. Angoori and Anita plan to go to a religious place. Vibhuti, Manmohan and Prem plan to spend time together. Prem sends Gulfam Kali over to Vibhuti's house. Anita returns to see them together.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Diamond Ring For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Vibhuti that she loves diamond rings. Vibhuti plans to get a diamond ring for Angoori. Saxena shows his diamond rings to Vibhuti, and he asks Saxena to lend him one. Vibhuti manipulates Saxena by saying that the ring is for Anita and tells Saxena that he will pay for it later. Saxena visits Anita's home and tells her about the whole incident. Angoori loses her ring. Saxena tells Vibhuti that Anita knows about the ring. Angoori calls Vibhuti to tell that she has lost the ring.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Buys a Diamond Ring For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti calls Angoori to tell her how he got the ring and ask her to find it. Angoori tells Vibhuti that might have dropped the ring in the sink. A happy Anita seduces Vibhuti. Angoori tries to steal money to pay Vibhuti while Manmohan is sleeping, but he wakes up. Vibhuti vainly tries to find the ring. Manmohan buys a diamond ring from Saxena and places it on the dressing table to surprise Angoori. Angoori thinks that she has found Vibhuti's ring and returns it. Vibhuti gives the ring to Anita.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Dress As Thieves
episodesList.summary: Manmohan thinks that Vibhuti has stolen the ring he had got for Angoori and has gifted it to Anita. Angoori soon realises that she has given Manmohan's ring to Vibhuti. Angoori wishes to get her ring back from Vibhuti. Manmohan and Vibhuti dress up as thieves to steal the ring from Anita, and Angoori finds the ring. Anita and Angoori beat up the thieves. Vibhuti buys multiple soaps that have gift coupons in them. The Mishras open the soap packets to win a bungalow. Manmohan and Vibhuti are sad.

episodesList.title: Ranveer Singh Dances With Angoori and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena pretends to be Vibhuti's client from London, who wants to purchase insurance worth INR 5 crore. Vibhuti plans to go to London for the client, but stubs his toe on the staircase. Manmohan prays to God that Anita doesn't move into their new bungalow. Vibhuti dreams that Anita forcibly takes him to the bungalow and Angoori doesn't want him to leave. Actor Ranveer Singh visits Angoori's home and interacts with her and Vibhuti. Ranveer dances with Angoori and Vibhuti and promotes his film.

episodesList.title: Anita Falls Prey to a Scam
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan pretend to be best friends to manipulate Anita and Angoori. Manmohan pretends to have fever and tells Angoori that he is sick because Vibhuti will leave soon. Vibhuti fakes a suicide attempt and leaves a note that says that he has taken sleeping pills as he is sad about leaving Manmohan. Anita, who has already paid INR 5 lacs to the soap company Rampat, is unable to contact them. Happu reaches Anita's home with Rampat's representative and tells everyone that he is a scammer.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Buys a Perfume to Attract Anita
episodesList.summary: A salesman sells Manmohan perfume, which will make him attractive to women. Manmohan sprays the perfume on his body. Angoori smells the perfume, and she instantly feels attracted to him. Manmohan dreams about romancing Anita but attracts Gulfam Kali instead. Vibhuti talks to Angoori as she cooks, but she dismisses Vibhuti after smelling Manmohan's perfume. Manmohan sprays the perfume again and runs to Anita's house, only to find out that Anita has a blocked nose due to cold.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Replaces Manmohan's Perfume
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti buys a perfume that repels women from the salesman. Vibhuti replaces the perfume in Manmohan's pocket with the one that repels women. Vibhuti applies the perfume and goes to Angoori's house. Vibhuti dreams about romancing Angoori but romances Gulfam Kali instead. Anita sees Vibhuti and Gulfam Kali together. Manmohan repels Anita due to the perfume's smell. Vibhuti tells Anita about the perfume, and she throws it away. Manmohan finds it and realises that someone had replaced his perfume.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Dress Up As Santa Claus
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti decorate a Christmas tree. Anita invites Angoori and Manmohan for Christmas celebration. Angoori and Anita tell their husbands to dress up as Santa Claus and give gifts to them and in exchange, they will kiss them. Vibhuti decides to give gifts to Angoori and Manmohan plans to give presents to Anita. Happu overhears their conversation and plans to give gifts to Anita. Vibhuti dresses up as Santa Claus and climbs into Anita's bedroom. Vibhuti dreams of romancing Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get a Kiss From Their Respective Wives
episodesList.summary: Anita talks to Angoori, while Vibhuti waits for her to leave. Anita takes Angoori with her and Vibhuti gets disappointed. Manmohan waits for Anita at her house. Anita returns to Angoori's home and sees Vibhuti dressed up as Santa Claus. Angoori goes to Anita's home to find Manmohan dressed as Santa Claus. Vibhuti and Manmohan give gifts to Anita and Angoori and they kiss their husbands. Angoori plans to go for a ten-day trip to Shimla and Vibhuti tries to manipulate a Shimla trip for Anita too.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Arranges Snowfall In Kanpur
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti wears warm clothes and tells Angoori that there is going to be a snowfall in Kanpur. Vibhuti organises a fake snowfall with the help of Saxena. Angoori wears warm clothes. Vibhuti throws fake snow outside Angoori's window. Vibhuti convinces Manmohan about the cold weather in Kanpur with the help of Teeka Ram, Malkhan, and Saxena. Manmohan wears warm clothes and dreams about romancing Anita. Anita sees Vibhuti and Saxena throwing fake snow at Angoori and Manmohan and their act is exposed.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Spies On The Tiwaris
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tries to eat pastries but Anita sees him on a CCTV camera and stops him. To keep a watch on her all day, Vibhuti hides a camera in a bouquet and gives it to Angoori. Vibhuti sees Manmohan sneakily get his phone and kiss someone's picture, which makes him suspicious. Vibhuti sees Angoori hurt her foot and rushes to help her. Vibhuti accuses Manmohan of being interested in other women and demands to check his phone. While snatching his phone, Vibhuti tears Manmohan's shirt pocket.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sees Angoori 'killing' a Woman
episodesList.summary: Amma Ji calls Angoori to tell her that there are some issues in her horoscope and suggests a solution for them. Vibhuti watches Angoori stab a woman and Manmohan support her actions on his camera. Vibhuti gets scared of Angoori. Happu shows a picture of a missing woman to Vibhuti and Angoori and asks whether they have seen her. Manmohan invites Anita and Vibhuti over for dinner. Vibhuti sees Teeka Ram and Malkhan carry a mannequin to Angoori's home and thinks it's a dead body.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Shows Bhoorey Lal Footage Of Angoori's Crime
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti watches Angoori stab another woman on his camera and gets scared. Vibhuti sees Manmohan and Angoori carry the dead body for disposal. Vibhuti notices that Anita is sick. Angoori calls Amma Ji to appreciate her solution and Amma Ji suggests stabbing another mannequin. Bhoorey Lal visits Angoori's home to meet her but Vibhuti stops him. Vibhuti tells Bhoorey Lal about the whole incident and shows him the video evidence. Bhoorey Lal tries to tell Angoori to leave Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Amma Ji Comes to Angoori's Rescue
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Bhoorey Lal think that Manmohan and Angoori are going to kill Anita. Vibhuti and Happu rush to Angoori's home and beat Manmohan. Amma Ji arrives and explains to everyone that Angoori had stabbed some mannequins to resolve the issues in her horoscope. Angoori plans to visit Amma Ji's home for a religious ritual. Vibhuti invites Angoori and Manmohan for the New Year Eve celebrations and finds out that Angoori cannot come. Anita wants Vibhuti to roleplay a thug for the celebrations.

episodesList.title: Angoori Beats Vibhuti For Holding Manmohan Hostage
episodesList.summary: Manmohan sees Vibhuti dressed as a thug, Kallu, enter Anita's home. Manmohan sees Anita and Kallu dancing and romancing. Manmohan intervenes but Anita and Vibhuti bully him. Angoori and Amma Ji return as Angoori is worried about Manmohan but they find their home locked. They go to Anita's home and Vibhuti hides Manmohan in the kitchen at knifepoint. Angoori enters the kitchen and sees Manmohan held hostage. Angoori and others beat Vibhuti but he escapes.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Decides to Become a Tailor
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti decides to become a ladies tailor. Manmohan gifts Angoori a dress but she hates it. Vibhuti finds out that Saxena has started a ladies tailoring business and asks him for a job. Vibhuti takes Saxena's phone for business reasons. Angoori complains to Vibhuti about Manmohan's gift and he suggests to her a tailor, Gulkand. Vibhuti pretends to be Gulkand and tells Angoori that he will stitch her clothes. Vibhuti, disguised as Gulkand, visits Angoori's home to get her measurements.

episodesList.title: Gulkand Takes Anita's Measurements
episodesList.summary: Manmohan overhears Anita having some troubles with her tailor and suggests going to Gulkand. Anita asks Vibhuti whether he knows Gulkand. Pretending to be Gulkand, Vibhuti insults Anita. Vibhuti, disguised as Gulkand, gives Anita her dress. Angoori introduces Anita to Gulkand and Anita takes him home for her measurements. Manmohan sees Gulkand taking Anita's measurements and gets jealous. Manmohan interrupts and accuses Gulkand of touching Anita inappropriately but Anita dismisses him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Hypnotises Angoori
episodesList.summary: Saxena tells Anita that he has stitched Angoori's dress and accuses Gulkand of fraud. Manmohan exposes Vibhuti's act but he gives a false explanation. Manmohan notices that Anita orders Vibhuti to do household chores and tells him that he is his wife's servant. Vibhuti sees Saxena hypnotising Teeka Ram and Malkhan and making them slap each other. Vibhuti learns hypnotism from Saxena. Manmohan shows his authority over Angoori by making her do unnecessary tasks. Vibhuti hypnotises Angoori.

episodesList.title: A Hypnotised Angoori Beats Manmohan Black and Blue
episodesList.summary: A hypnotised Angoori kicks Manmohan out of the house. Anita sees Manmohan sleeping outside his house. Manmohan tells Anita about the incident but Angoori says that she had been worried about Manmohan as he hadn't returned home. Vibhuti hypnotises Angoori again and tells her to hit Manmohan. A hypnotised Angoori beats up Manmohan with a belt. Manmohan visits Anita's home, cries, and tells her about the entire incident. Anita and Manmohan go to his house and on seeing him, Angoori cries.

episodesList.title: Anita Hypnotises Vibhuti to Learn The Truth
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti dreams that Angoori flirts with him and Anita catching him in the act, stabs him. Anita finds out that Vibhuti has learnt hypnotism from Saxena. Anita asks Saxena to teach her hypnotism techniques. Anita hypnotises Vibhuti and asks him the reason behind learning hypnotism from Saxena. Vibhuti's entire plan gets exposed in front of Anita and she punishes him by locking him in the bathroom. Manmohan finds out that Vibhuti had learnt hypnotism to manipulate Angoori against him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Works Tirelessly All Day
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Anita argue and he complains about his poor health. Vibhuti tells the priest about his poor health and he checks Vibhuti's horoscope. He tells Vibhuti that he might go insane unless he keeps working all day and tells him to work continuously for five days. Vibhuti cleans the tea seller's utensils. Vibhuti goes home and starts cleaning the house and washes Angoori's utensils. Anita's friend offers Vibhuti a good job in the US. Vibhuti tells Anita that he has been working all day.

episodesList.title: The Priest Teaches Vibhuti and Manmohan a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti cleans Teeka Ram and Malkhan's bathroom and offers to wash the tea seller's utensils. The priest tells Manmohan the same problem and the solution that he had given Vibhuti. Manmohan washes Anita's utensils and she kicks him out of the house. Vibhuti washes Angoori's utensils but Manmohan kicks him out and starts cleaning them himself. Angoori and Anita wish to romance their husbands but they continue working. The priest reveals that he had lied to teach Manmohan and Vibhuti a lesson.

episodesList.title: Puttan Visits Angoori
episodesList.summary: Puttan, Angoori's brother, enters Manmohan's home while everyone is asleep and pulls him out of the bed.
