episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori are pleased that Vibhuti and Manmohanâ€™s snack business is doing good. Anita praises Vibhuti for starting a new business with Manmohan despite their differences. Tillu, who witnessed the gambling, spills the beans in front of Anita and Angoori. Angoori and Anita are devastated on learning the truth. They confront Vibhuti and Manmohan, who then apologize. They promise to stop gambling. As Anita falls asleep, Vibhuti tries to sneak out of the house but finds the door to be locked.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Join Their Husbands In Gambling
episodesList.summary: Addicted to gambling, Vibhuti and Manmohan climb down from their houses using sari but are caught by Saxena. Saxena is beaten by Manmohan and Vibhuti. Meanwhile, Anita and Angoori wake up, only to realise that Vibhuti and Manmohan are missing in the middle of the night. Manmohan tries justifying his gambling to Angoori, whereas Anita also fails to make Vibhuti understand. Anita is afraid that her husbandâ€™s gambling can be dangerous. Anita and Angoori start gambling with Vibhuti and Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Lose Their Husbands to Gambling
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan, en route to gambling, are shocked to see Anita and Angoori gambling with Prem. Vibhuti is irritated as Anita arrives home late from gambling. Manmohan is also annoyed by Angoori's gambling. Anita and Angoori continue to gamble late in the night. Vibhuti and Manmohan are disappointed by their wives gambling and blame Prem for it. Angoori shocks Manmohan by informing that she lost money in gambling. Anita, too, informs Vibhuti that she has lost him to Saxena in gambling.

episodesList.title: Vibuti and Manmohan Plan to Go For Movies
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita lose their husbands to Tillu and Saxena in the game of cards. Happu Singh arrests Anita and Angoori, embarrassing Vibhuti and Manmohan. Vibhuti and Manmohan promise never to gamble. Anita and Angoori then reveal that Happu Singh was helping to teach them a lesson. Vibhuti and Manmohan get to know about a movie, which is similar to their life story. Vibhuti plans to take Angoori, and Manmohan tries to bring Anita alone to the theatre, but they all meet eventually.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes a Cop
episodesList.summary: Anita and Manmohan learn about the escape of a criminal named Birju from the hands of Happu Singh. The commissioner wants to find the culprit behind the escape of Birju. Vibhuti is restless because of upset stomach and mistakenly helps Happu Singh in catching Birju. The commissioner praises Vibhuti in front of everyone and makes him 'daroga' and demotes Happu Singh to 'havaldar'. Anita and Angoori are proud of Vibhutiâ€™s new reputation in the society. Anita tells Vibhuti to do good as a cop.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Arrests Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Anita that he is inspired to be an honest cop. Vibhuti handcuffs Manmohan for making fun of him. A woman comes running at Vibhuti and complains about a few men eve-teasing her regularly. Vibhuti beats Malkhan and Teeka after mistaking them as the eve-teasers. Happu Singh explains about being treated as a servant to Manmohan, who is still handcuffed. Vibhuti releases Manmohan on the request of Angoori. Vibhuti informs Angoori that Manmohan is actually a drug peddler.

episodesList.title: Tillu Seeks Vibhuti's Help to Get His Pending Salary
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti searches Manmohanâ€™s house and finds drugs. He asks Manmohan to stop drug peddling. Happu Singh informs Anita that Vibhuti has sent a basket of fresh fruits to Angoori which makes Anita mad at Vibhuti. Manmohan complains to Anita about Vibhuti barging into his house at night to arrest him. Tillu arrives and requests Vibhuti to help him in getting his long-pending salary from Manmohan. On Tilluâ€™s complaint, Vibhuti handcuffs Manmohan and frisks him for the money.

episodesList.title: Sarju Vows Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gives Tillu his salary and orders Manmohan to pay Tillu daily. Vibhuti sends Gulfam Kali to flirt with Manmohan and complains to Angoori about Manmohanâ€™s cheap behaviour. Anita confronts Vibhuti for troubling Manmohan. Manmohanâ€™s smile returns after learning that Birjuâ€™s brother, Sarju has vowed to take revenge from Vibhuti. Manmohan sends a man to Vibhuti who conveys Sarjuâ€™s threatening message to him. Manmohan, disguised as Sarju, calls and threatens Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Fired From His Job
episodesList.summary: Manmohan, posing as Sarju, threatens Vibhuti to resign. While talking to Angoori, two men fire at Vibhuti but later, realise that the gun and bullets were fake. Manmohan threatens a scared Vibhuti to resign. Commissioner Resham Pal refuses to accept Vibhuti's resignation. Happu Singh advises Vibhuti to insult Commissioner Resham Pal but it doesn't work. Vibhuti admits that he had lied about catching Birju. To Vibhuti's relief, Commissioner Resham Pal fires him from the post of an Inspector.

episodesList.title: When Manmohan's Dreams Came True...
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is horrified after dreaming about Anita dancing in the middle of the road with Vibhutiâ€™s pyjama in her hands. The next morning, his dream comes true as Anita jumps while picking up Vibhuti's pyjama from the street upon seeing a rat. Angoori and Manmohan watch in shock. Manmohanâ€™s other dream about Vibhuti, with shaving cream on his face getting beaten by some people also comes true. Angoori and Manmohan inform Vibhuti and Anita respectively about Manmohanâ€™s dreams coming true.

episodesList.title: Anita Jumps Into Manmohan's Lap
episodesList.summary: Manmohan informs Anita that he dreamt of her being in his lap. Vibhuti is shocked to see Anita jumping into Manmohanâ€™s lap after seeing a rat. Manmohanâ€™s next dream is about Vibhuti slapping Anita and he alerts her. As Vibhuti is about to surprise Anita with a ring, Anita shouts and runs away. Vibhuti slaps Anita on seeing a mosquito on her cheek. Manmohan informs Happu Singh that he dreamt about him getting suspended and Happu Singh gets suspended for a week by Commissioner Resham Pal.

episodesList.title: Anita, Angoori, and Vibhuti Fail to Keep Manmohan Awake
episodesList.summary: Angoori falls off to sleep while trying to keep Manmoman awake so that he cannot dream. Manmohan sees himself getting beaten by Anita with a chappal. Anita who is chasing a thief mistakes Manmohan for the thief and beats him with her chappal. Anita decides that Vibhuti will stay with Manmohan to keep him awake. Happu Singh is again suspended and this time for a longer duration by Commissioner Resham Pal making Manmohan's dream come true. Manmohan gets sick and falls asleep in the bathroom.

episodesList.title: Anita Runs Away With Chedi
episodesList.summary: Manmohan dreams that Angoori approaches Vibhuti to kiss him. Anita locks Vibhuti inside the room to keep him away from Angoori. Vibhuti is bitten by a snake on his cheek and asks Angoori to suck the poison out of him. Instead of Angoori, Vibhuti is kissed one by one by Malkhan, Teeka, Pelu, Saxena, and Happu Singh. Manmohan informs Vibhuti, Anita and Angoori that in his dream, Vibhuti slaps him and Anita runs away with Chedi. Anita runs away with Chedi leaving a mourning Vibhuti behind.

episodesList.title: Brett Lee Arrives In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Anita returns home with Chedi, the next morning. Upon being questioned Anita reveals that she had gone to help Chedi's pregnant wife which clears everyone's doubt. Manmohan sees many dreams, however, this time Manmohan's dreams have a reverse effect. The Australian fast bowler, Brett Lee arrives along with Tannishtha Chatterjee to promote his film 'Unindian' and meets Angoori, Vibhuti, Anita and Manmohan. Brett Lee enjoys a game of cricket with everyone and teaches bowling to Angoori and Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be Mentally Unstable
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti promises to bring green bangles for Angoori. Manmohan refuses to go for a 'havan' with Angoori and asks her to go without him. Vibhuti enters Angoori's bedroom with green bangles. Gulfam Kali enters Manmohan's bedroom. Anita sees her and informs Angoori. Upon getting caught, Vibhuti acts like a mentally unstable person. Dr Gupta checks Vibhuti and says that he is normal but Vibhuti denies being well. Prem advises Vibhuti to continue with his act.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Incites Anita to Kick Vibhuti Out
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti acts abnormally in front of Happu Singh and Teeka. Saxena is brought to prove if Vibhuti is unstable. Saxena concludes that Vibhuti is normal which makes Anita furious. Manmohan agrees to help Vibhuti by stopping Anita from divorcing Vibhuti. But Manmohan instigates Anita against Vibhuti and advises her to throw Vibhuti out of the house. Angoori sees a taxi outside Anitaâ€™s house. Manmohan is happy and informs Angoori that Anita might have thrown Vibhuti out of the house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Instigates Angoori Against Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Much to Manmohanâ€™s disappointment, Anita is the one leaving the house. To stop Anita from leaving, Manmohan takes the blame on himself. Anita rejoices and Angoori is devastated after Manmohanâ€™s confession. To return the favour Vibhuti assures a crushed Manmohan that he will try to calm Angoori. Vibhuti instigates Angoori and asks her to divorce Manmohan. Angoori decides to leave the house to stay with Ammaji. Vibhuti is upset on learning that Angoori is leaving instead of Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Visit Gulfam Kali
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti lies down in front of the cab to stop Angoori from leaving. He asks Anita to take her inside the house. While consoling Angoori, Anita thinks that the truth is something else. Anita asks Happu Singh to take them to Gulfam Kali. Manmohan and Vibhuti ask Prem to set the meeting with Gulfam Kali to clear the confusion. Anita and Angoori arrive with Happu Singh and see their husbands with Gulfam Kali. Anita and Angoori complain to their husbands for not being romantic lately.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Follow Prem's Advice
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori share the lack of romance in their lives. Prem informs Manmohan and Vibhuti about a formula to charm any woman. Vibhuti and Manmohan romance with their wives in front of each other. Vibhuti and Manmohan take Anita and Angoori respectively to the market and romance in the middle of the street making Anita and Angoori uncomfortable. Happu Singh interrupts them and arrests Vibhuti and Manmohan. After getting arrested, Vibhuti and Manmohan find Prem, too, locked up.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Twin Brother Appears
episodesList.summary: Anita confronts Vibhuti for not taking up a job. Manmohan insults Vibhuti in front of Angoori. Prem offers Vibhuti a job of a garbage collector which he hesitantly accepts. Anita, unaware of Vibhuti's job profile, feels happy that he has started working. Vibhuti arrives at Angoori's house to collect garbage and introduces himself as his twin brother, Darling. Manmohan informs Anita about Darling, Vibhuti's brother which surprises her. Anita questions Vibhuti about his new job and his brother.

episodesList.title: Amgoori Sells Things to Darling
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti lies to Anita that Darling is his twin brother. Anita demands to meet Darling despite Vibhuti's objection. Manmohan scolds Angoori for selling the new laptop to Darling. Vibhuti tells Angoori to take care of Darling whenever he comes. Manmohan complaints to Anita about Darling making Angoori sell the laptop. Manmohan sees his laptop with Teeka and takes it back. Vibhuti again comes as Darling to Angoori and makes her sell the TV which infuriates Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Anita Finds Darling's Truth
episodesList.summary: Anita continues to ask Vibhuti about his job but he refuses to bend. Manmohan complains to Vibhuti that his brother has taken away his TV. Happu Singh is irritated as someone keeps stealing his lungi. Anita gets to meet Darling and invites him home. Teeka and Malkhan sell Manmohan's TV back to him. Anita learns that Vibhuti is Darling after she finds his bag filled with used things. Gulfam flirts with Manmohan but he doesn't respond. Vibhuti tricks Angoori into selling her sofa.

episodesList.title: Anita Romances Darling
episodesList.summary: Manmohan drives Darling away who is trying to buy his sofa. Anita flirts with Vibhuti aka Darling and asks him to meet her later. Ladoo dresses as Lord Krishna and leaves for the school's Janmashtmi play. Angoori, while following Ladoo, slips and is caught by Ladoo dressed as Lord Krishna. Vibhuti aka Darling arrives and Anita dances around him while Manmohan watches. A heartbroken Manmohan visits Gulfam Kali's place. Vibhuti tries to express his sadness to Anita who continues to torture him.

episodesList.title: Anita Plans to Elope With Darling
episodesList.summary: Manmohan informs Angoori that Anita is having an affair with Darling and informs the same to Vibhuti, the next day. Manmohan offers Malkhan and Teeka money to beat Darling. Anita asks Darling to elope with her to Agra and asks him to meet her at eleven at the street corner. Teeka and Malkhan thrash Darling. As planned Anita and Darling meet at night. Unable to bear the trauma, Darling informs Anita that he is Vibhuti. Anita tells him that she knew this secret from the very beginning.

episodesList.title: Pandit Ramphal's Advice to Manmohan
episodesList.summary: A frightened Manmohan narrates to Angoori how he escaped death while returning home. Angoori calls Ammaji and informs her about the incident. Ammaji advises Angoori to meet Pandit Ramphal. Anita finds a job for Vibhuti but they end up arguing. Pandit Ramphal informs Manmohan and Angoori that Manmohan will die in five days. To avert his death, he must stay away from Angoori and spend the next five days in the company of another woman. They ask Anita to be Manmohanâ€™s wife for the next five days.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Manmohan's Wife
episodesList.summary: On Anitaâ€™s advice, Vibhuti agrees to spend the next five days as a woman to save Manmohanâ€™s life. Manmohan cries and is scared for his life. He sees an actor dressed as Yamraj and believes him to be the real one. Saxena rehearses his role of Yamraj for an act in the International Mad Day event to be held at Agraâ€™s mental hospital. Vibhuti is unhappy to live as Manmohanâ€™s wife. Manmohan sees Saxena dressed as Yamraj and gets scared. A frightened Manmohan kisses Vibhuti on his cheeks.

episodesList.title: David Falls For The 'woman' Living With Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Upon being forcefully kissed the night before, Vibhuti informs Angoori and Anita that he canâ€™t continue being Manmohanâ€™s wife. However, on Angooriâ€™s request, he agrees to continue with the act. David returns from London and falls in love with Vibhuti, who is disguised as a woman. At night, he enters Manmohanâ€™s house to check on Vibhuti. Manmohan again sees Saxena as Yamraj and he again kisses Vibhuti out of fear. David beats Manmohan and takes Vibhuti away from him.

episodesList.title: David Learns About Vibhuti's Disguise
episodesList.summary: Smitten by Vibhutiâ€™s beauty David spends time alone with him. Anita spends time with Manmohan on Davidâ€™s request. David flirts with Vibhuti making him uncomfortable. Ammaji pays a visit to Manmohan. She mistakes Anita for Angoori and sleeps with her. David comes to know the truth about Vibhutiâ€™s disguise. Ammaji catches Anita sleeping in Manmohanâ€™s bed and gets angry with the confusing situation. She learns about Pandit Ramphalâ€™s solution to keep Manmohan alive.

episodesList.title: Anita's Necklace Gets Stolen
episodesList.summary: Manmohan hides his cash as instances of robberies have risen in the neighbourhood. A burglar robs a house in the locality, at night. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori. Anita screams and Manmohan, VIbhuti, and Angoori rush to see her. Anitaâ€™s necklace worth INR 2.5 lakhs gets stolen and Happu Singh investigates the case. Manmohan and Angoori invite Vibhuti and Anita for dinner. After returning home, Anita finds the stolen necklace at her doorstep.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Sponsors Anita's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Anita fights with Vibhuti as he forgets her birthday which is in a couple of days. She asks him to throw her a party and invite the entire colony. Vibhuti can't afford to throw a birthday party as he doesnâ€™t have the money. However, he changes his mind when Angoori tells him that she was expecting to dance at a DJ party. Manmohan tells Vibhuti that he will sponsor Anitaâ€™s birthday party and will keep it a secret. The entire colony comes to know about the birthday party.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Happy to be Stuck In Angoori's House
episodesList.summary: Manmohan arrives at Anitaâ€™s birthday party and is smitten by her beauty. Vibhuti goes to Angooriâ€™s house and asks her to get ready quickly. A mob attacks Teeka and Malkhan in the alley. On hearing the noise outside, Vibhuti opens the door but the mob throws stones on him too. Vibhuti learns that the government has imposed a curfew in Kanpur due to such instances. Vibhuti is happy as now he can spend time with Angoori.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Stuck With Prem Due to The Curfew
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti are happy to spend the night in the company of each otherâ€™s wives. Anita asks Vibhuti to return home and bring Angoori along with him The four of them meet in the middle of the street. The mob attacks them and Anita is left alone at Angooriâ€™s house. Anita mistakes Prem for an intruder and beats him. She gets bored of listening to Prem. Vibhuti and Manmohan start drinking before the party begins. Anita is stuck with Prem as the curfew is not called off.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Escape to Saxena's House
episodesList.summary: Angoori catches Manmohan and Vibhuti having a drink. The curfew is still on and Anita is stuck with Prem. Vibhuti ties a rope from Manmohanâ€™s house to his house to reach home. Manmohan joins him and the rope breaks under their weight. They fall in the middle of the road and enter Saxenaâ€™s house to escape from the mob. Itâ€™s almost morning and the two are still stuck at Saxenaâ€™s house. Anita arranges for Happu Singh to get Vibhuti out of Saxenaâ€™s house.

episodesList.title: Anita's Birthday is Celebrated
episodesList.summary: As there is a curfew on the streets, Happu asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to come out of hiding to celebrate Anita's birthday. The goons beat up Happu. Anita and Angoori get stuck in one house with Prem, Vibhuti's friend. In the meantime, Vibhuti and Manmohan get stuck in another house. Anita asks all to come in the balcony. Vibhuti cuts the cake on Anita's behalf and throws the pieces of cake in Anita and Angoori's mouth. Anita gets angry when Manmohan says that Vibhuti took money from him.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Decide to Test Their Husbands' Love
episodesList.summary: Anita is upset that Vibhuti's been talking to Prem since a long time. She wants him to talk to her, but he falls asleep. Angoori dresses up for Manmohan, but he too falls asleep. Angoori asks Ammaji for help. Anita and Angoori share their problems with each other. Vibhuti and Manmohan also tell each other that they have nothing to talk about to their wives. Anita tells Angoori that they need to test if their husbands love them. Angoori pretends to be injured and asks Manmohan to carry her.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Spy On Their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Manmohan asks Malkhan and Teeka Ram to carry Angoori inside. Vibhuti scolds Anita for pouring cold water on him at midnight. Prem asks Manmohan and Vibhuti to meet Gulfam Kali. On the magazine editor Kalawati Sharma's advice, Angoori and Anita follow their husbands everywhere. This irritates Vibhuti and Manmohan. Angoori accuses Manmohan of having an affair with Gulfam Kali and says that she will go to Anita's house. When Vibhuti gets angry at Anita, she asks him to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Apologise to Their Wives
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Vibhuti meet while going to each other's houses. Angoori cries and tells Anita that Manmohan doesn't love her. But Anita asks her to be strong. Vibhuti and Manmohan laugh aloud so their wives think they are happy. Anita tells Angoori to pretend to be happy. Prem and Happu ask Vibhuti and Manmohan to visit the brothel to meet Gulfam Kali, but they refuse. Kalawati tells Anita that she will send two men to her house. Manmohan and Vibhuti go to Anita's house to apologise to their wives.

episodesList.title: Two Men Take Anita and Angoori For a Long Drive
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti watch as two men on bikes take their wives for a long ride. Distraught, they go to Gulfam Kali's brothel. But Vibhuti and Manmohan imagine their wives dancing instead of Gulfam and they cry. While returning, they talk ill about Angoori and Anita, so Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Anokhelal beat them up badly. The wives are very happy. Vibhuti and Manmohan apologise to Anita and Angoori saying they are incomplete without them, but they ask them to shut up and leave the house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Get an Upset Stomach
episodesList.summary: Resham raids and arrests Happu, Prem, Vibhuti and Manmohan. Vibhuti and Manmohan get bailed out. Anita and Angoori tell Vibhuti and Manmohan that they were not having an affair and that the men were sent by Kalawati to teach them a lesson. The husbands confess their love for their wives. Later, the husbands fall asleep as before, while their wives wish to talk. Vibhuti and Manmohan get upset stomach after eating 'chole bhature' at a tea stall. As their wives are not home, they go to Ammaji.

episodesList.title: Ladoo Gives a Tip to Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti scolds a man, who calls him useless. He and Anita fight. Manmohan fights with Angoori as she gives him 'samosas'. Vibhuti, Manmohan and Happu beat up Teeka Ram and Malkhan to vent out their anger. Anita sees that Laddoo is always happy. Laddoo says he listens to music. Angoori plays songs, but Vibhuti scolds her. Anita says that all are stressed so they should add music to their life. Saxena says that he sings well, being a classical singer. Vibhuti praises Angoori's voice.

episodesList.title: Anita Fixes Vibhuti's Marriage With Bittan
episodesList.summary: Everyone starts talking in a musical tone to each other. Teeka Ram scolds Malkhan when he asks him to buy some biscuits. Happu complains by singing that his wallet was stolen. A girl named Bittan asks Vibhuti for directions. When he does so singing, she tells him she loves him, but he runs away. Anita's aunt tells her that the girl's family will come to meet her for Rajesh's wedding. Bittan and her brother, Chuttan, think Vibhuti is Anita's brother. Anita fixes her marriage with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Balushankar Sends Flowers For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Chuttan threatens to kill Vibhuti if he doesn't marry Bittan. He asks Anita to divorce Vibhuti when he learns that she is his wife. Balushankar sends a bouquet of flowers to Angoori with a letter, in which he praises her voice, but insults Manmohan. Teeka Ram and Malkhan tease a girl by singing. She beats them up. Anita calls Happu. Happu says that Chuttan is a minister's sycophant, so Resham asked Vibhuti and Anita to get divorced. Manmohan gets angry when Angoori says Balushankar fed her.

episodesList.title: Anita Shows Vibhuti's Mms to Chuttan
episodesList.summary: Chuttan asks Anita to sign the divorce papers. Manmohan spits the 'kheer', thinking Balushankar gave it. Saxena tells everyone that Balushankar is married and got caught in an MMS scandal. Anita makes a plan. Manmohan calls Balushankar home, and Anita calls Gulfam. Teeka Ram has an MMS of Vibhuti and Gulfam. Balushankar thinks he's talking to Angoori, but it's his wife hiding under the sheets, who beats him up. Anita shows Chuttan the MMS. He recognises Gulfam as he made 17 MMS videos with her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loses His Voice
episodesList.summary: Anita is relieved when Bittan says she won't marry Vibhuti after seeing the MMS. Vibhuti and Anita hug each other but soon learn that Teeka Ram sent the MMS to many people. After dinner, Angoori insults Manmohan, who gets angry and scolds her for calling him a bull. Vibhuti downs a glassful of ice with liquor and loses his voice. Ammaji asks Angoori to tie a rope from the ceiling around her neck and chant a 'mantra' 108 times. Vibhuti thinks she is going to kill herself and saves her life.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Gives Advice to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan surprises Anita by bringing a certain brand of handkerchiefs. Angoori feels that Laddoo and Manmohan don't love her. Anita reads an article that says ignoring your partner is the biggest kind of torture. So Anita uses it on Vibhuti and he uses it on Angoori. Vibhuti gives Angoori's 'kheer' to Teeka Ram then takes it back from him. Angoori tries to woo Manmohan, but he sleeps. Ammaji asks Angoori to pretend that she will die in a few days to get attention. Angoori bribes a doctor to lie.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Cry Over Angoori's Diagnosis
episodesList.summary: Manmohan asks Angoori to make food in spite of knowing that she is sick. Vibhuti learns from the doctor that Anita is sick. Manmohan tells Anita that he is feeling lonely as Angoori is sick. Manmohan and Vibhuti argue and beat up Teeka Ram and Malkhan. They become hysterical when they learn that Angoori will die in a few days. They hide from Angoori and cry. Vibhuti prays for Angoori. A priest asks Vibhuti to perform a ritual for Angoori's health. Anita speaks to a doctor in Mumbai.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Walks On Hot Coals For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets worried when Anita says she'll take her to Mumbai for treatment. Laddoo reads Angoori's thoughts and tells Anita. Angoori says she made a false report as everyone was avoiding her. They plan to continue the drama. Vibhuti spits 'paan' on Manmohan and mentions the ritual. Anita takes Angoori for shopping. The priest asks Vibhuti to walk on hot coal pieces so that Angoori is healed completely. Vibhuti walks on the coals for Angoori. Saxena asks Manmohan to be with Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Learns About Angoori's Lie
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Saxena and Happu perform acts to make Angoori happy. Vibhuti tells Angoori a story about himself, Angoori and Manmohan by giving examples of animals. Angoori tells Ammaji that she feels guilty for lying about her health. Vibhuti hears Angoori and gets upset with her. Vibhuti takes Manmohan to the priest who cheated him. The priest shows him a knife and takes Manmohan's watch and bracelet. Vibhuti plans to expose Angoori and talks to Anita about Manmohan's remarriage.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Stops Manmohan's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Angoori about Manmohan's plan to marry again. Angoori is distraught. So she dances to prove to him that she is fine. But Manmohan tells her that people start behaving that way before dying. Anita scolds Vibhuti for planning Manmohan's wedding. Angoori is shocked to see that Manmohan has decided to marry Gulfam. Anita and Angoori tell Gulfam about Manmohan's flaws, but she says she loves him anyway. Ammaji stops the engagement and beats Manmohan. Angoori says she's fine.

episodesList.title: Sunny Leone Casts Vibhuti In Her Film
episodesList.summary: Anita scolds Vibhuti for breaking a plate and calls him jobless. Manmohan learns that Sunny Leone will visit Kanpur for a shoot. He is very excited. Tillu asks Manmohan for his salary. Angoori and Manmohan call Vibhuti jobless. As Vibhuti cries and complains outside, Sunny plans to cast him in her next film as the lead. She says she's impressed with his acting and gives him a cheque of INR 11 lakhs. Vibhuti's photo appears in the newspaper. Anita is forced to do the household chores.

episodesList.title: Sunny Praises Anita and Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti complies with their requests and gives Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu his autograph on their faces. Vibhuti makes Saxena his secretary. Vibhuti eats 'badam Ka halwa' made by Angoori and insults Manmohan. Anita works hard to make for Vibhuti's favourite dish. But he says he had dinner with Sunny. During a shoot, Vibhuti praises Angoori and tells the news reporters that Anita is his wife. Vibhuti cooks Thai food for Sunny. Sunny praises Angoori and Anita's beauty. Manmohan meets Sunny.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Plans Vibhuti's Abduction
episodesList.summary: Sunny discusses a scene with Vibhuti in which she cuts her finger in the kitchen and he tears his shirt and bandages her finger. Anita refuses to let him do the scene. Sunny lets Happu come in. He pleads with her to make him her cook. Teeka Ram starts crying, seeing Sunny in person. Malkhan asks Sunny to give him her used soap. Angoori cooks food for Vibhuti and asks Manmohan to eat outside. Manmohan suggests kidnapping Vibhuti. He agrees to pay Teeka Ram and Malkhan to kidnap Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Fears Vibhuti Getting Close to Sunny Leone
episodesList.summary: Manmohan sends Saxena away and asks Vibhuti to wear a burkha and meet Sunny at a location. Tillu sends Lallu, a gangster, to kill Vibhuti. So Manmohan wears a burkha to escape him. Teeka Ram and Malkhan abduct Manmohan, thinking he's Vibhuti. Vibhuti scolds them. Anita is shocked to see Vibhuti home. She scolds Manmohan for failing to get Vibhuti kidnapped. Anita dreams that Sunny and Vibhuti get close during a dance. Vibhuti tells her that she always doubts him. A news reporter questions Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Quits His Job For Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita wears a burkha to hide from the reporters. Meanwhile, Manmohan sends Saxena away and tells Vibhuti that Sunny is in trouble. Vibhuti also wears a burkha. Teeka Ram and Malkhan kidnap Anita, mistaking her for Vibhuti. Anita scolds them and Manmohan as well. Manmohan promises to hire professional kidnappers. Anita apologises to Vibhuti and says she won't bother him. Vibhuti does the household chores and tells Angoori that he quit his job as Anita doesn't like him working with Sunny.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Sees Ahuti Romancing Anita
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is chased by a wrestler, whom he owes money. He hides at Angoori's house. Angoori lies to the wrestler and sends him away. Vibhuti asks Anita to give him INR 50 thousand to pay the wrestler, as he had borrowed and lost in gambling. Saxena gives Vibhuti an idea to dress up like an old man. Vibhuti pretends to be Ahuti. He insults Manmohan and flirts with Angoori. Manmohan is shocked to see Anita dance with Ahuti. Angoori is in the mood for romance, but Manmohan scolds her.

episodesList.title: Ahuti Takes Anita and Angoori Out For a Treat
episodesList.summary: Manmohan calls Vibhuti, and he says he knows that Anita is dancing with Ahuti while he is dancing with his mother. Manmohan rebukes Anita for her behaviour, but she says that his mind is dirty. Teeka Ram and Malkhan gamble at the tea stall, and Ahuti scolds them. They make fun of Vibhuti. Ahuti slaps them and scolds Happu when he asks him the same question. Ahuti irritates Manmohan by calling Angoori 'Bhabhiji'. Ahuti drives the rickshaw and takes Angoori and Anita for a 'pani puri' treat.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Vibhuti Start Laundry Business
episodesList.summary: Manmohan makes Ahuti drink and begs of him to leave Kanpur. When Ahuti refuses, Manmohan plans to pay him. Ahuti takes the INR 50 thousand from Manmohan and gives it to the wrestler. Angoori wants a diamond necklace worth INR 1.5 lakhs, but Manmohan lies that his business is going through heavy losses. Anita accuses Vibhuti of being jobless. Angoori wants to help Manmohan and she starts a laundry business with Vibhuti. Manmohan and Anita are embarrassed by their spouses' work.

episodesList.title: Anita Wants Vibhuti to Close His Shop
episodesList.summary: Manmohan's in the mood for romance, but Angoori is washing clothes at night. Anita asks Vibhuti to wear a 'lungi' then changes her mind and scolds him. Anita asks Vibhuti to close his shop as Mr Gupta, a financer, will come home the next day. But he refuses, saying it's his livelihood. Manmohan makes Anita drink tea at his regular tea stall. Manmohan gets furious when Teeka Ram and Malkhan give Angoori their dirty clothes to wash. Anita complains to Happu, but Resham refuses to close the shop.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Buys The Necklace For Angoori
episodesList.summary: Manmohan expresses his grief to Anita about Angoori washing other people's clothes. Manmohan beats up Teeka Ram and Malkhan when they ask him to give their clothes to Angoori. Mr Gupta invests in Vibhuti's business rather than Anita's boutique. Ammaji arrives and is shocked to find Angoori washing loads of clothes. Ammaji beats Manmohan. He then tells Angoori the truth and buys her the necklace. Anita tells Vibhuti that she will be his partner but makes him do all the work. Vibhuti runs away.

episodesList.title: Saxena Plans Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: While Vibhuti is busy talking to Angoori, Saxena disturbs him and asks him to slap him. So, to send him away, Vibhuti lies that there are live wires at a distance. Saxena learns that there are no wires and vows revenge. He mixes something in Vibhuti's tea. Vibhuti wakes up at Gulfam's house 10 hours later and lies to Anita that he saved a girl from some dangerous goons. Saxena calls Vibhuti and threatens him, asking him to tease Angoori if he doesn't want Anita to see his video with Gulfam.

episodesList.title: Saxena Forces Vibhuti to do His Bidding
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti teases Angoori on Saxena's orders. Teeka Ram and Malkhan beat Vibhuti up, as Angoori cries. Saxena asks Vibhuti to put a chewing gum in Anita's hair. Anita had just curled her hair and scolds Vibhuti. She is forced to cut her hair. Saxena asks Vibhuti to slap him. He says two mosquitoes were sitting on his cheeks. He slaps him a third time. He lies to Anita and Angoori that a priest asked him to do those things. Saxena asks him to do the things again. Anita tells Manmohan everything.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Last Task For Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: On Saxena's orders, Vibhuti applies mud from Angoori's plant on Manmohan's face. Kalu complains to Happu that a boy teases her. Saxena again asks Vibhuti to slap Happu. Vibhuti slaps him and walks away. Vibhuti cries, and Saxena says he will not trouble him. He asks Vibhuti to apologise to all and say that he had gone insane. He does so. Manmohan forgives Vibhuti, hugs him and asks him to eat food with him. Vibhuti apologises to Anita and Happu. Vibhuti again applies mud on Manmohan's face.

episodesList.title: Angoori Shelters Tillu, Teeka Ram, and Malkhan
episodesList.summary: Anita gets a lawyer and asks Vibhuti to divorce her. Saxena asks Anita not to get divorced. He says he asked Vibhuti to do those things to teach him a lesson. Anita apologises. Vibhuti boasts to Angoori of being a helpful person. Tillu, Teeka Ram and Malkhan lose their homes and ask Vibhuti to keep them in his house. Angoori keeps them at her house. Teeka Ram kisses Manmohan. Manmohan scolds Angoori and complains to Anita. She scolds Manmohan for planning to remove the trio from his house.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Joins Saxena's Movement
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets furious with the three and mixes spices in their food. Saxena says that they should start a movement. Manmohan plans to join the movement. Vibhuti enters Angoori's bedroom to look at her. He hides, but Teeka Ram sees a shadow and the three beat Vibhuti up. He lies that he climbed her room to check if a robber was there. Manmohan shouts slogans, but Happu beats him up. Happu leaves when Anita says he's siding with the builders. Gulfam says that she will make an MMS of the builder.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Angoori a Piece Of 'moon'
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti calls the trio a nuisance. Happu says he spoke to the builder, who has agreed to return the houses. Vibhuti says he's lying as Gulfam did the work. Malkhan refuses to go, but Vibhuti and Manmohan throw the trio out. Manmohan sees Anita sleepwalking, and she sleeps on his sofa. She asks him not to tell Vibhuti. Angoori reads an article and gets angry on Manmohan as he doesn't gift her anything. Vibhuti gives Angoori a stone, saying it's a piece of moon, and lies that he is an astronaut.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Venture Into Space
episodesList.summary: Manmohan waits outside for Angoori to sleepwalk, but she jogs elsewhere. Vibhuti wears a spacesuit and asks Angoori to feed him curd and sugar. She asks him to get her some mud from Mars. Manmohan tells a sleeping Anita that he loves her. Vibhuti sees Anita sleepwalk. Vibhuti asks Angoori to sprinkle the mud on Manmohan's food, as it's healthy. Manmohan gets a doctor, who asks Anita to drink four pegs of liquor before sleeping. Vibhuti lies to Angoori about his spaceship being stuck in traffic.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Instigates Happu to Arrest Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manmohan scolds Angoori for returning home late, and she says she was with Vibhuti, the astronaut. Happu is searching for a criminal, who roams in a spacesuit. Manmohan tells him that the guy is Vibhuti. Vibhuti asks Saxena to dress up and pretend to be a Martian, an extraterrestrial being from Mars. Angoori is happy to meet the Martian. Happu tells Anita that Vibhuti is a secret agent of the enemy. Vibhuti tells Happu that he was fooling around with Angoori and is not a secret agent.

episodesList.title: Dr Abhay Ashiana's Novel 'martha'
episodesList.summary: Anita is reading a novel of a famous novelist Dr Abhay Ashiana. Manmohan arrives and reveals the name of the murderer in the novel. Anita becomes furious and scolds him for spoiling the suspense. Saxena brings Abhay home and asks Anita to keep him at her house as there are loose wires in his. Anita is the writer's big fan. He begins writing his novel Martha. As he narrates the novel, it sounds very similar to the lives of the people he is staying with. A lady, Martha, beats up Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Martha Thrashes Modern Colony's Residents
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram and Malkhan tell Anita and Angoori that an old lady beat them up. The Mishras have dinner at Manmohan's house along with Abhay, who continues narrating his novel. Like the story, Vibhuti gets a call. He goes outside and gets beaten up by Martha. Martha appears near Vibhuti's bedroom and scares him and Anita. Anita learns that it's the same Martha who is in Abhay's novel. Teeka Ram and Malkhan get scared seeing Saxena dressed like Martha, but he says he's playing Hilda's role in a play.

episodesList.title: Dr Abhay's Martha Appears In Reality
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti try to leave the house, but Abhay forces them to stay and listen to his story. As he narrates his story, Martha beats up Manmohan and Happu. They return and narrate their story to everyone. Anita says that Abhay said that Martha beats up the men who eye other women. Vibhuti and Manmohan hear Abhay tell Mayor Ghungroo that the main characters will die. So they tell Abhay to change the climax, but he refuses. Later, as Abhay reads the climax, Martha appears before everyone.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Grandmother Gets Impressed By Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Happu arrives and removes Martha's wig. The man dressed as Martha is Abhay's cook. To make his book famous, Abhay had asked his cook to become Martha. Happu says that Abhay will be sent back to the mental hospital. Angoori's father tells her that her granny has come out of coma and wants to get Angoori married. Angoori tells about this to Manmohan. Angoori's grandmother asks him some questions about maths and science. Manmohan fails to answer them, but Vibhuti answers them and impresses granny.

episodesList.title: Anita Becomes Vibhuti's Cousin
episodesList.summary: When Anita arrives, Vibhuti tells granny that she is his cousin. Ammaji scolds Manmohan for losing Angoori. Angoori's father praises Vibhuti while he's drinking with Vibhuti and Manmohan. Manmohan is upset so Vibhuti makes a plan to change his place and put Manmohan instead for the 'pheras'. Vibhuti informs Tillu, Teeka Ram, Malkhan and Happu about Anita's wedding. Tillu plans to take his salary from Manmohan. Angoori's father asks Anita to dance at the sangeet as she is Vibhuti's sister.

episodesList.title: Angoori's Wedding Ceremony With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita dances at Angoori's sangeet. Teeka Ram, Malkhan, Happu, Vibhuti and Angoori also dance. Granny then asks Vibhuti and Angoori to feed each other sweets. Granny says that the bridegroom will ride the devil. Angoori's father asks Manmohan to be the devil. Vibhuti sits on Manmohan and gives Angoori a rose. Anita worries about the wedding and gets furious at Vibhuti smiling continuously. The 'baraat' arrives. Vibhuti is carried by two people, and Anita puts the garlands on VIbhuti and Angoori.

episodesList.title: Anita Asks Govinda to Teach Her to Dance
episodesList.summary: Anita plans to ask Govinda to teach her dance for her grooming class. Govinda comes to buy Anita's house. Govinda asks Vibhuti to show him around the house. Teeka Ram and Malkhan ask him tips to woo girls. Vibhuti tells Saxena that he joked about selling the house. Govinda dances with everyone. Anita praises Govinda's dance. Anita asks Vibhuti to return home. But he refuses, saying he gets to eat Angoori's food. Anita tells Manmohan that she's missing Vibhuti and asks him to do the housework.

episodesList.title: Malluka's Threat Makes The Men Dress Up As Women
episodesList.summary: Anita scolds Vibhuti for not washing her clothes properly. Angoori tells Manmohan that she wants to work at his shop, but he refuses. Happu tells everyone that a goon named Malluka wants men to dress like women and do the housework, otherwise he will kill them. While the women do men's work, Vibhuti, Manmohan, Resham and Happu dress up like women. The doctor says that Malluka tried to kill him but missed and hurt his butt. Angoori is happy to learn that now she will get to run Manmohan's shop.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Dress Up As Men
episodesList.summary: Teeka Ram and Malkhan get kidnapped by goons, who think they are girls. When the goons learn that they are boys, they beat them up. Vibhuti is surprised to see Anita dressed up like a handsome man. Angoori also dresses up like a man and says she's going to the shop. They ask their husbands to cook food for them. Teeka Ram and Malkhan complain to Happu, and he files an FIR. Manmohan and Vibhuti cook food. Saxena asks Vibhuti and Manmohan to slap him. Malkhan says he's fed up with being a woman.

episodesList.title: Angoori Takes Over Manmohan's Business
episodesList.summary: The men say they won't dress up like girls anymore and take off their wigs. Malluka throws a letter, which says that the knife will be in their butts the next time. Vibhuti and Manmohan get intimate with Anita and Angoori respectively. Tillu tells Angoori it's a pleasure to work with her. Laddoo's Teacher beats up Tillu when he insults him. Teeka Ram and Malkhan complain that the goons stripped them and beat them. Vibhuti and Manmohan make food for their wives. Angoori's business is doing well.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Locks Up Malluka
episodesList.summary: The men decide to catch Malluka and plan to send a prey to him. They make chits and Vibhuti's name comes up first. Angoori says she has made a sale of INR five thousand. Anita and Angoori trouble Manmohan. Happu says in the news that the criminal is Vibhuti. Malluka makes a cop unconscious and tries to kill Vibhuti. But he escapes and locks Malluka in the prison. Manmohan is happy to be a free man. Vibhuti refuses to do the housework, but is forced to do it. Happu boasts of catching Malluka.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Tells Angoori to Donate to Charity
episodesList.summary: Ammaji brings a priest sent by Pandit Ramphal who says that Angoori should do charity as a very auspicious time will arrive for her. Angoori donates her chain to Vibhuti. As their gas is over, Anita asks Manmohan if she and Vibhuti can eat dinner at his place. Angoori cooks lot of food, but Manmohan takes it all inside. An insulted Anita leaves with Vibhuti. Manmohan gives lots of things in charity to people. But Ammaji says Pandit Ramphal made a mistake and they had to act miserly instead.

episodesList.title: The Snakes' Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets intimate with Anita. Manmohan sees and plans to teach him a lesson. Vibhuti by mistake pours water on two snakes who were mating. A snake charmer tells Vibhuti that the snakes will take revenge. Manmohan enters Vibhuti's room while he and Anita are romancing and tells him that he caught a snake entering his room. Anita reads that a snake bit three people. Manmohan keeps a fake snake on Vibhuti's leg. Angoori sees Manmohan placing a snake in his shirt. Ammaji tells Angoori something.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Turns Into a Snake
episodesList.summary: When Teeka Ram and Malkhan search for rats at Anita's house, she asks them to look elsewhere as the snakes ate the rats. Angoori and Vibhuti watch as Manmohan drinks milk like a snake. Vibhuti puts a snake in Manmohan's pants and catches it later. Angoori tells Ammaji that Manmohan is turning into a snake. Teeka Ram and Malkhan sell the rats to Manmohan. So Happu beats them. Manmohan pretends to eat a rat. Vibhuti sees it and tells Anita that Manmohan is a snake. But she doesn't believe him.

episodesList.title: Manmohan's Snake Dance
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells Angoori that he saw Manmohan eat a rat. Angoori tells Ammaji that Manmohan is turning into a snake. Ammaji tells her she will speak to Pandit Ramphal. Manmohan invites the Mishras for dinner, but Vibhuti refuses and Anita says they will come. Teeka Ram and Malkhan ask Happu to give them INR one crore for a rat as the gem that Happu is looking for is worth crores. Manmohan puts a snake under the sofa and scares Vibhuti. Manmohan dances like a snake while all are shocked.

episodesList.title: Angoori Dresses As a Nagin to Woo Nagraj
episodesList.summary: Angoori is convinced that Manmohan is a Nagaraj. Happu Singh, Teeka and Malkhan try to get the nagmani from Manmohan but they fail. Anita tries to convince Angoori that Manmohan is acting as Nagaraj but in vain. Manmohan continues to scare Vibhuti. Manmohan asks Vibhuti to consider Anita as his sister. Happu Singh is bitten by a real snake while trying to capture Manmohan. A shaken Vibhuti refers to Anita as his sister in a state of panic. Angoori dresses as a Nagin and tries woo Manmohan.

episodesList.title: Malkhan and Teeka Try to Extract Nagmani From Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Anita visits Manmohan to tell him that she believes that he is a Nagaraj. Anita tells Manmohan that she will reveal her secret if he comes to her house dressed as Nagaraj. Anita comes in front of Manmohan dressed as a Naagin and scares him. A scared Manmohan admits about his act. Vibhuti and Angoori overhear Manmohanâ€™s confession which makes Angoori sad. Happu Singh, Malkhan and Teeka pull Manmohanâ€™s teeth out while retrieving the nagmani. Ramkali arrives and beats Manmohan with a stick.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Affected By Demonitization
episodesList.summary: Tillu begs Manmohan to pay his salary but Manmohan drives him out. Manmohan displays hidden loads of cash to Angoori. Manmohan faints after hearing the news about the ban of INR 500 and INR 1000 notes. Vibhuti feels happy about the news. Prem informs Vibhuti that he is doomed and tries to lend him some money. Happu Singh arranges a marriage for money. The commissioner shares news with Happu Singh which makes him cry. Angoori tries to cheer a sad Vibhuti. Manmohan asks Anita for help.

episodesList.title: Who was Troubled By Demonetisation?
episodesList.summary: Anita finds pleasure in engaging in playful role-playing as Rocky's fictional girlfriend, Charulata, much to Vibhuti's frustration, as he is tired of these antics. Anita becomes aware that people are mocking Vibhuti due to their ongoing foolish role-playing, leading to a realization of the consequences.

episodesList.title: Anita Refuses to Help Happu With His Black Money
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is shocked that Manmohan has earned so much money. Prem informs Vibhuti about an agent who exchanges the old notes with the new ones. Vibhuti informs a worried Manmohan about the agent. Manmohan hesitates after knowing about the huge commission he will have to pay. Happu Singh reaches out to Anita to exchange his black money. A furious Anita refuses and threatens to complain to the commissioner. Manmohan informs Happu Singh about the contact who can exchange the old notes.

episodesList.title: Anita Saves Vibhuti, Manmohan, and Happu
episodesList.summary: Anita confronts an adamant Vibhuti for indulging in illegal exchange of the old notes with the new ones. Prem tells Vibhuti that he will come to his home with new notes and warns him not to tell anyone. Manmohan and Happu Singh go to exchange the old notes with the new ones. To everyoneâ€™s shock, the agent turns out to be an Income Tax officer. Anita replaces the old notes with clothes before the inspection, thus saves Vibhuti, Manmohan, Happu Singh. Everyone thanks Anita.

episodesList.title: David Learns The Truth About Vibhuti's Marriage
episodesList.summary: David arrives unannounced. He is shocked to see Vibhuti dancing with Anita since Angoori is his real wife. Upon questioning, a scared Vibhuti and Anita make an excuse that Vibhuti was teaching her dancing and Angoori is learning English from Manmohan. David learns from Anokhelal about their truth and catches Vibhuti, Anita, Manmohan and Angoori sneaking out at night. They tell him the truth and ask for his forgiveness. David forgives everyone and tells them to go home.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to be a Doctor
episodesList.summary: Vibhutiâ€™s uncle, Mamulal, informs him that he is on his way to visit him. Mamulal believes that Vibhuti is a doctor. Anita assures a clueless Vibhuti that she has a plan. Vibhuti borrows a doctorâ€™s instruments from Dr Gupta and brags about his achievements as a doctor which makes Mamulal extremely happy. Vibhuti is shocked to know that Mamulal plans to stay with him longer than expected. Anita asks Manmohan to use his house as a hospital and Angoori agrees to act as a nurse.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Takes Mamulal to His 'hospital'
episodesList.summary: A drunk Mamulal requests Vibhuti to examine his piles. Manmohan, Angoori, Teeka and Malkhan set up a hospital. Mamulal is confused to see Vibhutiâ€™s hospital board which was not there earlier. Anita and Vibhuti make an excuse about the board. Mamulal takes a tour of the hospital. Manmohan, Teeka and Malkhan act as patients. Mamulal is overwhelmed after visiting the hospital. Vibhuti introduces the patients and his nurse. Vibhuti treats the patients which makes Mamulal proud of him.

episodesList.title: Resham Pal Arrests Dr Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Commissioner Resham Pal orders Happu Singh to uncover a kidney racket. Mamulal asks Vibhuti for INR 5 lakhs that he has lent him for his medical studies. Vibhuti asks help from Manmohan but he refuses. Happu Singh informs everyone about the kidney racket. Anita devises a plan to fake Vibhuti's arrest by Happu Singh to avoid giving money to Mamulal. Commissioner Resham Pal arrives and arrests them for real. They explain their plan to the commissioner who sets them free.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Commits Robbery to Get Arrested
episodesList.summary: Angoori dreams about Manmohan being arrested for the murder by Happu Singh and narrates her dream to Manmohan. Ramkali explains to Manmohan that Angoori's dream will come true and can be avoided only if Manmohan spends a few days in jail for a petty crime. Manmohan slaps Happu Singh to get arrested for a few days but Vibhuti spoils his plan. Manmohan deliberately gets himself caught during the act of robbing Anitaâ€™s house. To Anitaâ€™s amusement Manmohan requests to get arrested.

episodesList.title: Angoori Presses Charges Of Domestic Violence On Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Manmohan, who is eager to go to jail, applies black paint on the commissioner's face who is busy flirting with Gulfam Kali. Tillu asks for his salary but Manmohan refuses. He asks him to report to the police. On Angooriâ€™s advise, Manmohan passes lewd comments at Anita. Vibhuti stops Anita from calling the police. On Vibhutiâ€™s advice Angoori reports against Manmohan for domestic violence. Happu Singh arrests Manmohan. Ramkali informs that the pandit was wrong about Manmohanâ€™s destiny.

episodesList.title: Malkhan Gets a 'family'
episodesList.summary: Malkhan informs Anita and Angoori that he has got a job offer in Dubai. The condition to get the job is that his boss, Fakirchand wants to meet Malkhan's family as he doesnâ€™t have one of his own. Anita and Angoori agree to act as his family. The fight between Manmohan and Vibhuti continues. Anita and Angoori try to convince their husbands to act as brothers for Malkhanâ€™s future. To impress Fakirchand, Malkhan informs him that his mother will welcome him. Anokhelal poses as Malkhanâ€™s mother.

episodesList.title: Fakirchand Falls For Malkhan's Mother
episodesList.summary: Fakirchand comes to meet Malkhanâ€™s family. Vibhuti and Manmohan are introduced as twins. Fakirchand is attracted to Anokhelal as Malkhanâ€™s mother, Indumati. Teeka warns Fakirchand about Malkhanâ€™s lies but he disbelieves him. Fakirchand decides to stay longer with Malkhanâ€™s family. A drunk Teeka warns Malkhan that Fakirchand is a fraud. Fakirchand flirts with Indumati. During the conversation on the dinner table, Fakirchand agrees to give the job to Malkhan in exchange of Indumati's hand.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Try to Reason With Fakirchand
episodesList.summary: Anokhelal as Malkhanâ€™s mother agrees to marry Fakirchand. Anita makes Anokhelal realise that he cannot marry Fakirchand. Teeka asks Malkhan to take him also to Dubai. Vibhuti, Malkhan and Manmohan support Anokhelalâ€™s decision. Fakirchand comes to get Indumati but he is asked to take permission from Indumatiâ€™s husband. Happu Singh is asked to act as Indumatiâ€™s husband and he agrees. Anita and Angoori explain to Fakirchand that it is not right to marry a married woman.

episodesList.title: Shaan Arrives At Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Everyone is shocked to watch Fakirchandâ€™s fraud being exposed in the news. Teeka mourns for his friend and cries. Malkhan, who is unaware of Fakirchandâ€™s fraud returns as he couldnâ€™t leave Teeka alone. Commissioner Resham Pal arrests Fakirchand and saves Anokhelal. Manmohan shares about his business going down with Angoori. Singer Shaan arrives to promote Voice India Season 2 and meets Vibhuti, Manmohan, Anita, Angoori and Anokhelal. Ramkali and Tillu appreciate Angooriâ€™s soulful voice.

episodesList.title: Angoori Provides Food to Vibhuti, Teeka, and Malkhan
episodesList.summary: Ramkali informs Angoori that for Manmohan's business to flourish she will have to serve food to three poor people for a year and a half and give money to them. Manmohan informs Anita that he saw Vibhuti eating at a 'langar' organised by her students. A disgusted Anita throws Vibhuti out of the house. Teeka and Malkhan cry as they are thrown out by their landlord. Angoori feeds the homeless Teeka, Malkhan and Vibhuti. Anita asks the homeless Vibhuti to return but he refuses.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Tired Of Coaxing Vibhuti to Return Home
episodesList.summary: Angoori wakes Vibhuti, Malkhan and Teeka who sleep on the street for breakfast. An angry Anita blames Manmohan and admits to missing Vibhuti. Manmohan does Anitaâ€™s household chores. Anita is tired of Vibhutiâ€™s tantrums and he refuses to return to the house. Manmohan asks Angoori not to provide food to Malkhan, Teeka and Vibhuti. Tillu taunts Manmohan for working at Anitaâ€™s house. Happu Singh offers to help Anita in removing Vibhuti, Teeka and Malkhan from the streets.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Throws a Party
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is angry after seeing Vibhuti eating at his house. Determined to teach him a lesson Anita reminds Happu Singh to take action against Vibhuti. Gulfam Kali sees the poor trio on the street and asks Vibhuti to come with her. Happu Singh asks them to leave the street but Gulfam Kali sends him away. Manmohan suggests that Anita fakes an affair with him to make Vibhuti jealous. While the poor trio is busy eating, Manmohan invites them to a party. The three of them arrive at the party.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Exposes Anita's Act
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's cheap gift angers Anita as she receives expensive ones from the others at the party. Manmohan and Happu insult Vibhuti. Anita tries to make Vibhuti jealous by announcing that Prem Chaudhary is her new prince charming. Vibhuti learns about Anita's drama, exposes her, and doesn't return to her. Manmohan tries various means to get rid of Vibhuti, Teeka and Malkhan as Angoori continues feeding them for free. Finally, Saxena agrees to scare the trio by appearing as a bear.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Returns to Anita
episodesList.summary: Anita gets angry on seeing Vibhuti play cards on the road with Teeka and Malkhan. Saxena appears as a bear to scare the trio off but simultaneously a real bear arrives and kidnaps Saxena. As per Ammaji's new idea, Angoori lashes Vibhuti, Teeka Ram and Malkhan 50 times after serving them food. Vibhuti apologises to Anita and returns to her. Vibhuti confronts Angoori and she reveals that it was Ammaji's idea so that Manmohan's business would flourish.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Wish to Go to Nainital
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori are excited to go to Nainital but Manmohan and Vibhuti make dumb excuses to avoid the trip. Malkhan and Teeka start a travel agency and offer an attractive trip to Nainital at cheap rates. Malkhan and Teeka convince Vibhuti and Manmohan to take the trip to Nainital. Happu Singh and Saxena book for the Nainital trip. Vibhuti and Manmohan flirt with Angoori and Anita respectively. Vibhuti makes a plan so that Manmohan doesn't come to Nainital and he can spend time with Angoori.

episodesList.title: Manmohan and Vibhuti Fall Prey to Each Other's Plan
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti sabotage each other's plan as they both suffer from diarrhoea because of the other. Anita and Angoori get irritated as Vibhuti and Manmohan spoil their Nainital plan. Vibhuti and Manmohan visit the toilet frequently and dislike Gulfam Kali coming to Nainital with them. Anita and Angoori get stresses as everybody boards the train except Vibhuti and Manmohan. Vibhuti and Manmohan somehow reach the station as the train starts picking up speed.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Miss The Train to Nainital
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan run on the platform to catch the moving train but eventually miss it. A newly married couple boards the train and sits in the same compartment where the entire Modern colony does. Everybody else on the train play 'antakshari'. Vibhuti and Manmohan take a cab to the next station but get late as they keep running to the toilet in between. Gulfam Kali flirts with Happu Singh. Anita and Angoori worry as they don't see Vibhuti and Manmohan at the next station also.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Fight to Use The Toilet
episodesList.summary: Finally, Vibhuti and Manmohan catch the train. Anita and Angoori confront Vibhuti and Manmohan as they believe that their husbands don't want to go to Nainital. The ticket checker, Nempal Singh gives separate seats to all and Anita asks Happu Singh to convince him not to do so. Vibhuti and Manmohan fight about using the toilet and Dr Gupta gives them a wrong medicine. Happu Singh thrashes Malkhan for not providing free food during the journey but Dr Gupta appreciates Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Get Mugged In The Train
episodesList.summary: The train halts because of the fog and everyone gets down at the station. On Happu Singh's request, Gulfam Kali entertains everyone with her dance. A married couple distributes drugged sweets and everyone drowns in deep sleep. The next morning, Modern colony residents realise that they have been mugged. Nempal refuses everyone to board the train without tickets and they return to Kanpur. Everyone berates Teeka and Malkhan for the disappointing trip. Happu Singh thrashes Teeka and Malkhan.

episodesList.title: Anita is Assigned With Night Patrolling
episodesList.summary: The police commissioner of Kanpur gives Anita the duty of night patrolling. Vibhuti shudders because of the cold weather. Manmohan gets medicine from a 'Babaji' to brace the cold weather and feels energetic and youthful after having the medicine. Manmohan mocks Vibhuti and tries to impress Anita. Happu Singh gets worried about his night patrolling in the cold weather. Angoori seduces Manmohan but he avoids her because of the cold. At night, Anita gets ready for night patrolling with Saxena.

episodesList.title: Anita Decides to Take Manmohan's Interview
episodesList.summary: Anita reports about the poor people sleeping on the streets of Kanpur and exposes Happu Singh's sleeping on duty. Vibhuti flirts with Angoori and discusses on how to dry the wet clothes in the winter season. Manmohan takes the medicine and impresses Anita with his strength to brace the cold. Anita decides to take Manmohan's interview during her night patrolling. Teeka and Malkhan tease Happu Singh for sleeping on duty. Happu Singh bribes Teeka and Malkhan to patrol for him at night.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Slips Into The Bed With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Failing to get the medicine from 'Babaji', Manmohan tries to postpone his interview but in vain. Vibhuti guides Angoori on how to dry the wet clothes. In spite of not taking the medicine, a trembling Manmohan gives the interview wearing minimal clothes and dances. Masterji complains about his blanket being robbed. Manmohan rushes to Anita's house and slips into the bed with Vibhuti as Angoori doesn't open the door. Anita is shocked seeing Manmohan sharing the bed with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Takes a Bath In Chilled Water
episodesList.summary: Anita confronts Manmohan for sharing the bed with Vibhuti. Vibhuti gives Angoori ideas to keep herself warm. Manmohan takes the medicine from the 'Babaji' again and mocks Vibhuti for shivering. Manmohan takes up the brave challenge of bathing in chilled water at night. Angoori tries to stop Manmohan from doing the stunt. The 'Babaji' gives incorrect medicine to Manmohan but he bathes in chilled water to impress Anita. Later, when Manmohan asks for a blanket, Angoori gets him an ice-cream.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Agrees to Sleep On Ice
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets the same medicine from the 'Babaji' that Manmohan had got to keep himself warm. Manmohan gets upset on learning that Vibhuti has taken the medicine. Vibhuti announces that he will sleep on ice to prove himself but Anita laughs it off. Manmohan exchanges Vibhuti's medicine and Vibhuti fails to perform the challenge. Manmohan too fails to perform the challenge as he mistakenly takes an incorrect medicine. Manmohan and Vibhuti catch pneumonia and land in the hospital.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Masakali
episodesList.summary: Due to Prem, Gulfam Kali injures her leg and is unable to perform for Prem's client. Vibhuti gets mesmerised with Angoori's dance and asks her to divorce Manmohan. Anita pressurises Vibhuti to earn money by lying to him that her grooming classes are not doing well. Vibhuti decides to earn money and performs as a lady called Masakali. Prem's client gets happy on seeing Masakali's dance and seals the business deal. Gulfam Kali learns that Vibhuti is Masakali and they both become business partners.

episodesList.title: Masakali Performs a Dance For Her Clients
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti hands over a bundle of cash to Anita and she suspects that Vibhuti is into gambling. Malkhan and Teeka overhear Happu Singh praise Masakali's dance and wish to see her dance. Vibhuti and Manmohan criticise Happu Singh for being a womaniser. Vibhuti asks Angoori to teach him how to dance and lies to Anita about his work. Manmohan sees Vibhuti leave with a lady at midnight. Masakali performs for Happu, Malkhan, Teeka and Prem. A drunk Happu Singh asks Masakali to dance on strewn beads.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Spies On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita wonders about Vibhuti's source of income and Manmohan instigates Anita against him. Vibhuti avoids Anita's questions after she sees him limping. Gulfam Kali threatens Vibhuti to continue performing as Masakali when he wishes to retire. Angoori teaches Vibhuti how to enhance his expressions while dancing. Anita asks Manmohan to spy on Vibhuti. Vibhuti unwillingly performs as Masakali. A drunk Happu Singh demands Masakali for a night. Manmohan learns that Vibhuti is Masakali.

episodesList.title: Anita Tells Vibhuti to Quit Dancing
episodesList.summary: Manmohan invites Anita to his house where he vows to expose Vibhuti's truth. Vibhuti fears of getting exposed when Gulfam Kali asks him to perform at Manmohan's house. Unwillingly, Vibhuti agrees to perform. Happu Singh is sad as Masakali is upset with him. Later, Anita and Angoori see Masakali perform at Manmohan's house and learn that Vibhuti is Masakali. An enraged Anita asks Vibhuti to stop performing as Masakali but he reveals that he is trapped. David wishes to see Masakali's dance.

episodesList.title: Anita Rescues Masakali From Gulfam's Clutches
episodesList.summary: Anita gets furious upon hearing David's wish to see Masakali's dance. Angoori is upset with Vibhuti for not doing the correct dance steps. Vibhuti pleads with Anita to allow him to perform as Masakali for one last time. Anita berates Happu Singh for going crazy over Masakali in spite of being married. Happu Singh and David go crazy about Masakali and Happu Singh takes Masakali with him. Happu Singh is shocked to learn Masakali's truth. A courageous Anita rescues Vibhuti from Gulfam Kali.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan's Courteous Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori worry as Vibhuti and Manmohan bicker and abuse each other. Anita and Angoori get angry seeing the men of Modern colony abusing others and complain to the commissioner. Vibhuti and Manmohan don't pay heed to their wives when they ask them to behave decently. A TV anchor announces a reward of INR 5 lakhs to the 'Most well-behaved man' in the Modern colony. The next day, Happu Singh, Vibhuti and Manmohan start talking respectfully with everyone around.

episodesList.title: Most Well-behaved Man' In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti display etiquettes to win the INR 5 lakhs reward for being the 'Most well-behaved man'. Malkhan and Teeka take Masterji's help in learning etiquettes. Anita berates Vibhuti as he refuses to enter the kitchen saying that his etiquettes do not allow him to do so. Tillu insults Manmohan and the latter accepts it with respect. Anita chides her washerman, Cheddi for spoiling her clothes but Vibhuti rewards him for being honest. Saxena taunts Happu Singh for faking etiquettes.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Malkhan Harass Masterji to Learn Manners
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti visit Manmohan's house for dinner and the men compete in displaying courtesy. Vibhuti and Manmohan fight about who would open the dish's lid and a furious Anita leaves without eating. Teeka and Malkhan harass Masterji to teach them etiquettes. Angoori chides Manmohan for his stubbornness. Vibhuti rewards Cheddi for being honest enough to accept that he has ruined Anita's clothes. Ammaji apprises Angoori about the auspiciousness of the night for conceiving a child.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Manmohan Bicker With Each Other
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets in a romantic mood but Manmohan avoids her in the name of etiquettes. Vibhuti invites Angoori and Manmohan for lunch where Vibhuti and Manmohan start competing again. Teeka and Malkhan kidnap Masterji to learn etiquettes from him. Saxena claims that Vibhuti and Manmohan are faking etiquettes. A lady smashes cake on Happu Singh's face for harassing her. Vibhuti and Manmohan begin abusing again when they learn that the competition of 'the Most well-behaved man' stands cancelled.

episodesList.title: Baba Premanand's Advice to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Prem complains to Vibhuti about his wife, hearing which Vibhuti starts deriding Anita. Anita overhears her insult and whacks Vibhuti in front of Modern colony residents. To teach Manmohan a lesson, Vibhuti disguises as Baba Premanand and asks Angoori to smash Manmohan 50 times for his long life. An innocent Angoori smashes Manmohan. Later, Angoori apologises and reveals the truth to Manmohan. Anita overhears Vibhuti telling Manmohan that it was his trick to take revenge.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Ploughs His Garden to Impress Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita's uncle gets a job for Vibhuti in Meerut but he refuses. This enrages Anita. Vibhuti learns that Angoori has high regards for farmers and makes up a story that he is also from a farmer's family. To impress Angoori, Vibhuti starts ploughing his garden. Vibhuti gives an offer to Teeka and Malkhan to join him as farmers. Angoori gets impressed seeing Vibhuti work hard as a farmer. But Anita gets furious on seeing her garden ploughed and confronts Vibhuti about his desire to become a farmer.

episodesList.title: Anita and Manmohan Suspect Vibhuti's Act
episodesList.summary: Manmohan insults Vibhuti for pretending to be a farmer and asks him to work in the real fields instead. Angoori supports Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan decide to join Vibhuti. Manmohan and Anita believe that Vibhuti is playing a drama just to avoid going to Meerut. Manmohan asks Anita to leave Vibhuti hungry to bring him back on track. But Angoori gets food for Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan work hard in the garden to sow the seeds. Teeka gives a massage to Malkhan and Saxena.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Grows 10kgs Of Tomatoes Overnight
episodesList.summary: Anita claims that Vibhuti is a fraud farmer and is avoiding going Meerut. At night, Vibhuti buys ten kgs of tomatoes and places them in the garden. Angoori gets astonished seeing the grown tomatoes and wonders how the seeds bore the fruits in just a day. Vibhuti reveals that he has a secret formula for growing the tomatoes overnight. Manmohan and Anita ask Happu Singh to report against Vibhuti for farming in a residential area. Tillu insults Manmohan. Angoori vows to make Manmohan a farmer.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Refuses to Reveal His Secret Formula
episodesList.summary: Anita throws Vibhuti out of the house for fooling everyone. Happu Singh accuses Vibhuti of troubling the residents because of his farming activity but the commissioner supports him. Manmohan gets furious with Vibhuti for ploughing inside his house but the commissioner supports Vibhuti. The media questions Vibhuti about his secret formula which he refuses to reveal. Anita is angry with Vibhuti for ploughing inside their house. A Chinese national spies on Vibhuti to learn about his secret formula.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Kidnapped By Chinese Men
episodesList.summary: Anita gets excited seeing Vibhuti's interview and calls him a scientist. Manmohan calls Vibhuti a fraud and accuses him of fooling everyone. Vibhuti gets kidnapped and thrashed by the Chinese for his secret formula. A worried Anita reports about Vibhuti's kidnapping to Happu Singh. A vegetable vendor exposes Vibhuti by revealing that Vibhuti has been buying tomatoes on credit from him. Meanwhile, Saxena rescues Vibhuti from the Chinese. Vibhuti reveals the truth to Malkhan and Teeka.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Gets Constipated
episodesList.summary: Manmohan is stressed because he is constipated and tries hard to get some relief. He lies to Anita about his constipation but Angoori blurts out the truth. A cunning Vibhuti gives a defective suggestion to Angoori to cure Manmohan's constipation. Vibhuti mocks Manmohan's state. Anita gets upset with Manmohan as he constantly blabbers about constipation. Ammaji suggests to Angoori to seduce Manmohan as a cure for his constipation. Angoori seduces Manmohan, which baffles him.

episodesList.title: Dr. Gupta's Medicines Fail to Cure Manmohan
episodesList.summary: Angoori seduces Manmohan but he gets irritated and avoids her. Angoori cries about Manmohan's actions which worries Anita and Vibhuti. Teeka and Malkhan mock Manmohan about his constipation. Manmohan overhears everyone making fun of him and lies that his constipation is cured. Dr Gupta gives medicine to Manmohan which bears no results. Anita gets annoyed as Vibhuti keeps talking about constipation. Manmohan slaps Saxena as the latter asks him to enjoy his current state.

episodesList.title: Manmohan Blocks His Colony's Water Supply
episodesList.summary: Manmohan whacks Teeka as he along with Malkhan constantly tease him about his constipation. Vibhuti instigates Teeka and he files an FIR against Manmohan with Happu Singh. Meanwhile, Angoori tries varied home remedies to cure Manmohan's constipation but fails. Manmohan hits Happu Singh as he irritates him by constantly repeating the word constipation. Anita uses meditation therapy on Manmohan, but that too fails. A frustrated Manmohan blocks the colony's water line to teach everyone a lesson.

episodesList.title: Manmohan is Finally Relieved Of Constipation
episodesList.summary: Manmohan refuses to unblock the water line for everyone to suffer what he is going through. Saxena reveals another working water line which disappoints Manmohan. Vibhuti and Angoori speak to a specialist but learn that he is a victim of constipation. Vibhuti hits on a new idea. Vibhuti, Angoori, Teeka, Malkhan and Happu Singh scare Manmohan by disguising scarily. The idea works and Manmohan is finally relieved of constipation. Angoori throws a party.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Pretends to Commit Suicide
episodesList.summary: After a quarrel with Vibhuti, Manmohan lies to him that Prem has met with an accident, and asks him to take Happu Singh's new car. Vibhuti gets upset as Happu Singh's car gets stolen because of him which Manmohan and Happu Singh take discreetly. Manmohan makes Vibhuti his servant until he pays back for the car. Vibhuti learns about Manmohan's plan and pretends to have committed suicide which makes Happu and Manmohan confess their misdeeds in front of the commissioner.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Prank Their Husbands
episodesList.summary: Manmohan and Vibhuti thank Prem for showing them a film and laud the actress in that film. Anita and Angoori get irritated as their husbands compare them with the vivacious film actress. A worried Anita and Angoori pick a solution from a magazine and play pranks on Manmohan and Vibhuti which infuriates them. Teeka and Malkhan mock Vibhuti and Manmohan as the latter discuss the pranks of their wives. An excited Anita decides to play a prank on Happu Singh.

episodesList.title: Angoori Lands Vibhuti In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Anita makes Happu Singh sit on a chair where she has spread adhesive because of which Happu Singh gets stuck to the chair. The Commissioner gets angry on seeing an irresponsible Happu Singh. To harass Vibhuti, Angoori lies to him that Masterji has teased her. A furious Vibhuti confronts Masterji for teasing Angoori and drags him to her. Meanwhile, Anita plays a prank on Manmohan. Angoori cunningly flips in front of Masterji and states that she has not said anything to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Happu Singh's Sudden 'death'
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti insults Dr Gupta as he advises him to start working. Angoori and Anita make their husbands do sit-ups and play pranks on them. Vibhuti and Manmohan decide to take revenge from Anita and Angoori with the help of Happu Singh. But instead of pretending, Happu Singh faints when Anita plays a prank on him. To take revenge from Vibhuti, Dr Gupta lies that Happu Singh is dead. Vibhuti and Manmohan get frightened and blame each other for the situation.

episodesList.title: Manmohan-vibhuti Try to Hide Happu's 'dead' Body
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan try to handle Happu Singh's dead body. They meet the commissioner on their way. Vibhuti and Manmohan deceive the commissioner and get Happu's dead body home. Anita and Angoori learn that it was Manmohan and Vibhuti's plan to harass them. Happu Singh shows some movements but nobody notices him as they are busy arguing. Cheddi, who mistakenly takes Happu Singh's dead body brings him back to Vibhuti. Vibhuti dresses Happu Singh as a lady in a veil and David asks him about her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Head Gets Stuck In a Vessel
episodesList.summary: David flirts with the lady in the veil and is later, informed that the lady is Happu Singh. Vibhuti, Manmohan and David place Happu Singh's dead body in a rickshaw. The commissioner identifies the lady in the veil as Happu Singh by his shoes. As Anita and Angoori are confessing, Happu Singh regains consciousness and all are saved. Later, as Vibhuti flirts with Angoori his head gets stuck in a vessel. With great difficulty, Vibhuti is freed but Manmohan's head gets stuck in that vessel.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Become Enemies
episodesList.summary: While consuming alcohol Vibhuti and Manmohan start quarrelling. Anita and Angoori ask their husbands to behave civilly with their neighbours but in vain. Anita and Angoori decide to teach their husbands a lesson. Vibhuti and Manmohan vow not to fight anymore. Anita and Angoori pretend to be enemies, and hurl insults on each other, witnessing which Manmohan and Vibhuti get stressed. Moreover, Vibhuti and Manmohan are asked by their wives not to cross the line drawn between their houses.

episodesList.title: Boredom Gang' Beats Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Manmohan mock the line drawn by Anita and Angoori. Anita and Angoori are glad to see Vibhuti and Manmohan being civil with each other but continue with their plan. Manmohan and Vibhuti get worried as Anita and Angoori insult each other. Dragging the drama, Anita and Angoori call each other their enemies and ask their husbands to stay away from each other. Vibhuti gets beaten by Saxena and Malkhan, who are a part of the 'Boredom gang', representing Angoori.

episodesList.title: Boredom Gang' and 'gori Gang's Enmity
episodesList.summary: Witnessing Anita and Angoori's enmity, Tillu and Teeka form a 'Gori gang' and Saxena, Prem and Malkhan form a 'Boredom gang' representing Anita and Angoori respectively.
