episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita return home after watching the movie and ignore their husbands. Anita deliberately harasses Vibhuti and he gets upset. Tiwari complains about Angoori to Ammaji.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Beaten Up Due to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori regrets torturing Tiwari. At a conference, Angoori accuses Tiwari of being a corrupt official, and people beat him up. Some goons attack Vibhuti, and he goes to the hospital along with Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Make a Decision
episodesList.summary: Angoori slaps Tiwari. Vibhuti and Tiwari decide to divorce their wives. While they spend time with Teeka and Tillu, who are disguised as nurses, Saxena shoots them and shows the video to their wives.

episodesList.title: Angoori Saves Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari decide to end their lives. Angoori finds them hanging on a cliff and reveals the truth. She saves Vibhuti and Tiwari with Saxena's help. Tiwari gets into trouble due to Ammaji.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets an Idea
episodesList.summary: Ammaji suggests Tiwari to indulge in debauchery. Anita taunts Vibhuti of being unemployed. Vibhuti decides to open a club with the help of Teeka, Tilloo, and David.

episodesList.title: Naughty Girls Come to Tiwari's House
episodesList.summary: David tells Tiwari about the naughty girls. Teeka, Tilu, Saxena and Vibhuti dress up as naughty girls and come to Tiwari’s house which breaks Angoori’s heart. Masterji punishes Tiwari at his behest.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Calls The Naughty Girls Once Again
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti informs David about Tiwari's deeds. Angoori tells Anita about Tiwari having fun with the ladies. Despite promising Anita, Tiwari again calls the naughty girls. Vibhuti gives Angoori advice.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Angoori's Romance
episodesList.summary: Anita complains to Happu about Tiwari. At Angoori's behest, Vibhuti pretends to flirt with her and Tiwari sees them. Happu finds the commissioner with the naughty girls in a hotel.

episodesList.title: The Naughty Girls are Exposed
episodesList.summary: Anita visits Tiwari's house and scolds him for having fun with the girls. The cops arrive, and the naughty girls are exposed. Ammaji reveals the truth to Tiwari and asks him to have fun with the men.

episodesList.title: Chameli is Angoori's Doppelganger
episodesList.summary: The Commissioner, Happu, and Manohar see that the underworld don Malik's lover, Chameli, a look alike of Angoori. Vibhuti vows to teach Angoori English. Tikka and Tillu are delighted to get a car.

episodesList.title: Happu's Advice to Use Angoori to Catch Malik
episodesList.summary: Happu advises the commissioner to disguise Angoori as Chameli to catch Malik. Vibhuti helps Angoori in speaking English using Bluetooth. Tikka and Tillu get scared on seeing a dead body in the car.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Blackens Vibhuti's Face
episodesList.summary: Tiwari blackens Vibhuti's face, and the two get into an argument. The commissioner makes Angoori a part of his mission. Tiwari and Vibhuti are distressed when Angoori goes missing.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Sees Angoori Dancing At The Club
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti are surprised to see Angoori dancing at the club. They meet Angoori, who introduces herself as Chameli. When Tikka and Tillu try to dispose of a dead body, Masterji arrives there.

episodesList.title: Malik is Apprehended Due to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Don Malik mistakes Angoori for Chameli and takes her with him. With Angoori's help, the Commissioner, Happu and Manohar manage to catch Malik. Tiwari and Vibhuti learn about Angoori's mission.

episodesList.title: Will Tiwari Romance Maryada?
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti discovers that his cousin Maryada will be staying with him for a few days. At Vibhuti's behest, Angoori asks Tiwari to be romantic with Maryada. Vibhuti also makes a request to Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Maryada Falls In Love With Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari agrees to romance Maryada, who falls in love with him at first sight. Saxena suggests to Masterji that he should harass women as part of the treatment.

episodesList.title: Maryada's Demand Scares Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori feels upset when she sees Maryada kissing Tiwari. Maryada takes Tiwari to the bedroom and demands that he apply vermillion to her forehead. The doctor assures Vibhuti that Maryada is fine.

episodesList.title: The Family Tells The Truth to Maryada
episodesList.summary: The family informs Maryada that Tiwari is married. The Commissioner's wife accuses Masterji of harassment. Tikka and Tillu reveal Maryada's true identity to Vibhuti and Angoori.

episodesList.title: Maryada Threatens to Kill Angoori
episodesList.summary: Maryada ties Vibhuti to her two-wheeler and drags him around the colony. Moreover, she threatens to kill Angoori and shares a plan with Saxena. Later, she gets caught and her mental state improves.

episodesList.title: A Solution For The Modern Colony's Boredom
episodesList.summary: As the modern colony is bored, Saxena's friend Nicholas suggests having a celebration. Everyone plans to get someone married. Tiwari asks the commissioner's consent for Teeka and Tillu to marry Rusa.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Rejects Teeka and Tillu
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti ask questions to Teeka and Tillu. They take Teeka and Tillu's proposal to the commissioner's daughter, but the commissioner rejects them. Tiwari and Vibhuti try to convince him.

episodesList.title: The Marriage Of Tiwari and Vibhuti's Plants
episodesList.summary: Teeka and Tillu jump off the roof in an attempt to commit suicide, injuring their hands and legs. Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to get the plants in their respective houses married and preparations begin.

episodesList.title: Wedding Preparations In Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: The modern colony residents prepare for the wedding, and the celebration begins. Everyone asks amusing questions while playing Truth or Dare. David makes fun of Bhure for drinking alcohol.

episodesList.title: Everyone Argues Due to Ammaji
episodesList.summary: Bhure informs Tiwari about his humiliation. The groom's family arrives at Vibhuti's house. Due to Ammaji's mistake, the groom's and bride's families start arguing. Later, Ammaji's secret is revealed.

episodesList.title: Bad News For The Modern Colony Residents
episodesList.summary: The Modern Colony residents plan to celebrate Independence Day. Saxena informs them that the builder Kuljeet Kulta intends to demolish the Modern Colony. Tiwari and Vibhuti go to talk to Kulta.

episodesList.title: A Mall to be Built On The Modern Colony Land
episodesList.summary: Kulta insults Vibhuti and refuses to change his decision. Tiwari and Vibhuti urge everyone to confront Kulta. Kulta's engineer visits the Modern Colony to design a map for the mall's construction.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Plan to Send Angoori to Kulta
episodesList.summary: The people of Modern Colony try to delight the colony's owners, Sir Kuda and Kulta. Tiwari tells Vibhuti about the plan to send Angoori to Kulta. Angoori dances in front of Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Kulta Shoots Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori coaxes Kulta into revelating about the place where he has kept the colony's documents. Vibhuti and Tiwari steal the documents. Later, Vibhuti confronts Kulta, and the latter shoots him.

episodesList.title: Kulta Shoots Tiwari As Well
episodesList.summary: Kulta shoots Tiwari after Vibhuti. Angoori makes a request to everyone to protect them. Dr Gupta does the surgery on Tiwari and Vibhuti. The commissioner felicitates Tiwari, Vibhuti and Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Decision to Invest In The Stock Market
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti informs Anita about the profits Prem gained from the stock market. At Angoori's behest, Tiwari calls Bhure home to seek advice about the stock market. The colony residents buy shares.

episodesList.title: Anita Abandons Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Bhure helps Tiwari in selecting shares. Vibhuti also buys some shares. Ammaji advises Anita to stay away from Vibhuti for Vibhuti's well-being. Later, Anita leaves the city.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes The King Of The Stock Market
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gives an interview on Saxena's news channel. Tiwari discovers Vibhuti's strategy for choosing shares. After talking to Anita, Vibhuti incurs losses. Later, Bhure and David argue.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Suffers Losses In The Stock Market
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti benefits from the stock market, while Tiwari faces losses. He tells the landlord that he wishes to buy the house. After being evicted from his home, Vibhuti seeks shelter in Tiwari's house.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Throws a Splendid Party
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets his house back and throws a splendid party for everyone. Later, he stops Anita from leaving him. The Modern Colony residents suffer significant losses due to the stock market.

episodesList.title: David Tells About Maharaja Khalbali
episodesList.summary: David tells Vibhuti that his ancestors were servants of Maharaja Khalbali Tiwari, and Tiwari overhears this. Tiwari steals a photo of Khalbali from David's wallet and makes a large poster of it.

episodesList.title: David and Vibhuti Become Slaves to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: David learns that Tiwari is a descendant of Khalbali. He and Vibhuti become slaves to Tiwari and Vibhuti takes Angoori to the market. Teeka and Tillu steal Prem's belongings and sell them to Saxena.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Hits Vibhuti With a Hunter
episodesList.summary: Tiwari invites everyone to his house for a feast. Vibhuti makes a mistake and Tiwari hits him with a hunter. David informs Vibhuti about Khalibali's treasure. Vibhuti takes Angoori to the market.

episodesList.title: David Learns About Tiwari's Plan
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti teaches a lesson to the thugs. David learns the truth about Tiwari not being the descendant of Khalibali. David and Vibhuti get their revenge on Tiwari by making him eat spicy Gulab Jamuns.

episodesList.title: David and Vibhuti Plan to Harm Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori serves spicy gulab jamuns to Tiwari. Vibhuti hits Tiwari with a hunter as a demonstration of strength. David and Vibhuti plan to harm Tiwari, but Tiwari reveals his plan to them.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Makes a Group Of 'qawwali' Singers
episodesList.summary: Anita rejoices on getting an admission in Dhaba Acting School. Angoori tells Vibhuti that she loves ‘Qawwali’. Vibhuti, along with Teeka, Tillu and Saksena, makes a group of ‘qawwali’ singers.

episodesList.title: Anita's Words Hurt Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Ammaji asks Tiwari and Angoori to celebrate their anniversary with great enthusiasm. Anita's words hurt Tiwari. Later, Vibhuti and his group practice singing Qawwali songs.

episodesList.title: Anita Throws Vibhuti and His Gang Out
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Anita if she is having an affair with someone in front of Happu. Anita throws Vibhuti and his gang out of the house. Vibhuti asks Tiwari to provide space for him to practice Qawali.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Bitten By a Snake
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets bitten by a snake. Tiwari allows Vibhuti and his group to practice at his home. He prepares for his birthday celebration. Vibhuti talks to Angoori about organising a Qawwali program.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Betrays Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari instructs Vibhuti and his group to work as waiters. Vibhuti presents the bill to Tiwari, but he refuses to pay. Vibhuti seeks help from Happu. Later, a man offers a job to Vibhuti's group.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Becomes a Special Collector
episodesList.summary: The Commissioner elects Tiwari as the collector of the Modern Colony. Tiwari gets angry with Vibhuti over his words. Masterji hits Teeka and Teelu. Later, Anita invites Tiwari for food.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Slaps Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti adds chillies to Tiwari's sweets and later slaps him for his words. Tiwari asks Vibhuti to come to the gathering to face the punishment. Anita asks Saxena to fight Vibhuti's case.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Ousts Vibhuti From The Colony
episodesList.summary: Tiwari ousts Vibhuti from the colony for slapping him. Vibhuti then seeks shelter at Teeka and Tillu's place. Tiwari comes to Anita's house, where David spills tea on him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Becomes Jaswinder
episodesList.summary: On Anita's suggestion, Vibhuti dons a disguise and returns to the colony. He introduces himself to Tiwari as Jaswinder. Anita and Jaswinder's proximity shocks Tiwari. Later, Jaswinder greets Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Calls Vibhuti Back to The Colony
episodesList.summary: Seeing Jaswinder and Anita getting close to each other, Tiwari calls Vibhuti back. Tiwari learns about Vibhuti and Anita’s ploy. Manohar reveals the news of Vibhuti becoming the special collector.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Decides to Become a Journalist
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti gets emotional as he remembers his father. David informs him that his father was a revolutionary journalist. Vibhuti decides to become an honest journalist and later, seeks help from Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Opens His Printing Press
episodesList.summary: Tiwari makes a deal with a merchant Kediya. Vibhuti inaugurates his printing press. Later, he asks Angoori some questions. Teeka and Teelu are shocked reading the news printed about Masterji.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Publishes a News Story Against Anita
episodesList.summary: Masterji confronts Vibhuti for writing against him. Tiwari slaps Kedia for betraying him. Vibhuti publishes a news story against Anita, making her angry. Vibhuti receives new information.

episodesList.title: Gp Shoots Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Kedia's goon GP tries to kill Vibhuti, but Saxena saves him. Vibhuti reveals the truth to Anita. Later, everyone arrives at Vibhuti's funeral after GP shoots him.

episodesList.title: Kediya Gets Arrested
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti overhears as everyone badmouths him at his condolence meet. Later, Vibhuti comes in front of Tiwari, who rejoices on seeing him alive. The commissioner arrests Kediya with Angoori’s help.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Faces Job Rejection
episodesList.summary: As per Anita's advice, Vibhuti sets out to ask for a job but gets turned away. Due to Angoori's poor English, Tiwari's client cancels the deal. Vibhuti returns home at night.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Starts a Begging Business
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti inaugurates ‘Beggars and Beggars Private Limited’ and starts begging. Saxena ties up Teeka and Teelu to stop them from begging. Tiwari taunts Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Suggests Angoori to Beg
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Anita about Vibhuti being a beggar. Vibhuti asks Angoori to beg with him and further interviews Teeka and Teelu. Later, Vibhuti explains Angoori how to beg.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Observes Angoori Begging For Alms
episodesList.summary: Due to Angoori's poor English, Vibhuti is beaten up. Tiwari observes Angoori begging and informs Anita about it. Later, Saxena binds Teeka, Tillu, and David. Angoori receives some good alms.

episodesList.title: Anita and Tiwari Turn Into Beggars
episodesList.summary: Anita complains to Happu about Vibhuti. Angoori and Vibhuti are surprised to see Anita and Tiwari begging. Angoori takes a promise from Tiwari that he won't beg. Vibhuti also makes a promise to Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti has a Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti has a nightmare wherein he hangs Angoori to death. Later, he goes to help Angoori, who prepares food for Tiwari’s client. Upset over this, Anita gives Vibhuti an order.

episodesList.title: Angoori Kills Singhania
episodesList.summary: Tiwari's client, Singhania misbehaves with Angoori, and she kills him. Singhania dies, and Tiwari informs Vibhuti of the incident. Happu, Manohar, and the Commissioner arrive at Tiwari's house.

episodesList.title: An Attempt to Dispose Of Singhania's Corpse
episodesList.summary: The commissioner runs the police station from Tiwari’s house. Angoori, Vibhuti and Tiwari try to dispose of the Singhania's corpse. Later, they call Teeka and Teelu and ask them to courier the body.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives an Idea to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Teeka and Teelu bring the corpse back to Tiwari’s house. Vibhuti asks Angoori to fight with Tiwari and leave the house. Happu picks up the bag to help Angoori. At that moment, Angoori’s uncle arrives.

episodesList.title: Singhania Apologises to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Tiwari reveals the truth to Fufaji and involves him in his plan. Anita also decides to leave the house with Angoori. Later, Singhania comes out of his suitcase and apologises to Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti to Play Dandiya With Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita dreams of her grooming class, while Tiwari envisions selling his shop. On hearing the announcement of the Dandiya competition, Vibhuti decides to participate in it with Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Consumes The Unlucky Laddoo
episodesList.summary: The priest performs a puja and captures Angoori's bad luck in a laddoo. Vibhuti accidentally eats that laddu, and Angoori's bad luck affects him. Later, Tillu deceives Teeka.

episodesList.title: Anita Asks Tiwari to Kidnap Someone
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti comes to Angoori’s house and the fan falls on his head. Anita asks Tiwari to kidnap the nurse of the judge, Dr Gupta. Later, Teeka exacts his revenge on Teelu.

episodesList.title: Tiwari is Arrested
episodesList.summary: Tiwari is arrested on charges of attempting a kidnapping, and Anita gives a false statement in front of Happu. Vibhuti gets injured once again. Anita instructs Tiwari to kidnap Dr Gupta and Masterji.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Learns The Secret Of The Laddoo
episodesList.summary: Tiwari is once again arrested for attempting to blackmail Masterji. Ammaji reveals the secret of the laddoo to Vibhuti. Although the Dandiya competition gets cancelled, everyone still plays Dandiya.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Finds a Magical Cave
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti finds a secret cave which doubles everything. He tells Anita about it and she goes to use the cave as well. Later, Saxena explains to people about the share market.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Learns About The Secret Cave
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti tells David about the secret cave, and Tiwari overhears it. Tiwari, driven by greed, sells his house and invests money in the cave. Saxena teaches Teeka and Tillu about the stock market.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Angoori Become Homeless
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Tiwari become paupers and the new owner of the house ousts them. Vibhuti gives them shelter in his house. Anita and Vibhuti learn about the cave. Anita asks the commissioner for a job.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Accused Of Stealing
episodesList.summary: Angoori sends roti with Vibhuti for Ammaji. Urmila, the new owner of the house, accuses Vibhuti of theft in front of the police. Someone sends food for Vibhuti's family. David and Ammaji beg for alms.

episodesList.title: The Cave Gang is Caught
episodesList.summary: Shivpratap tries to molest Angoori. Anita resigns from her job at the police department. Tiwari's mental state worsens. To everyone's joy, Manohar tells them that the cave gang is caught.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Engages In Online Fraud
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti engages in online fraud with his old friend, and a man witnesses it. Anita advises Tiwari on managing his finances. The man creates an incriminating video of Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: A Man Blackmails Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: A man blackmails Vibhuti to work for him. Tiwari informs Anita about transferring money to Angoori's account. Later, Teeka and Tillu decide to work for Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Swindles Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti swindles Angoori of INR 5 lakhs, causing her distress. Tiwari informs Anita about Angoori's situation. Meanwhile, Tillu calls Happu and cons him.

episodesList.title: Teeka Dupes The Commissioner
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Anita go to the police station and lodge a complaint about Angoori being cheated. Teeka dupes the commissioner. Angoori curses the person who cheated her. The commissioner reassures Anita.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Apprehended
episodesList.summary: Anita, Tiwari and Angoori devise a plan to capture the impostor. Vibhuti is apprehended, and he informs the commissioner about Jamtareshwar. With his assistance, the commissioner arrests Jamtareshwar.

episodesList.title: Aaramfal Advises Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Ammaji, along with Pandit Ramfal's Guru Aaramfal, visits Tiwari's house. Aaramfal advises Tiwari to sweep and clean the city. Later, the residents of Modern Colony plan for Diwali celebrations.

episodesList.title: Angoori to have an Affair With Her Neighbour
episodesList.summary: Aaramfal advises Angoori to have an affair with a neighbour. Anita is shocked to see Tiwari sweeping. Angoori attempts to attract Vibhuti. Later, David wins money in gambling.

episodesList.title: Angoori Tries to Impress Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Aaramfal advises Anita to stay away from Vibhuti and focus on her housework. Angoori tries to impress Vibhuti, and Saxena observes this. Teeka and Tillu decorate the Modern Colony.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Anita's Argument
episodesList.summary: Tiwari argues with Anita about littering on the road. On seeing Angoori getting close to Vibhuti, Saxena threatens Tiwari. In an attempt to avoid Angoori, Vibhuti gets into trouble.

episodesList.title: The Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Diwali
episodesList.summary: At Amma's behest, Angoori beats up Vibhuti, and he faints. Amma reveals to everyone that the real Aaramfal is someone else. David loses all his money, and the modern colony celebrates Diwali together.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Takes a Position As a Traffic Cop
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Anita set up a transport company. Happu and the commissioner control the traffic. Later, Tiwari and Anita hire Tillu. Vibhuti accepts a job with the traffic police.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Fines Tillu
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti, in a traffic police uniform, approaches Angoori. Later, he fines Tillu, who is driving Anita and Tiwari's truck. Anita gets enraged with Vibhuti for issuing a fine for their truck.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Fines a Minister's Son
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fines a minister's son. Happu scolds Vibhuti, but the minister is pleased with Vibhuti's honesty. Later, Vibhuti stops the commissioner's wife's car and asks her to pay the fine.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Refuses to Take a Bribe
episodesList.summary: Anita asks David to convince Vibhuti to take a bribe. David talks to Vibhuti, but he leaves the house and goes with Saxena. At Tiwari's behest, Angoori slaps Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Arrests Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti arrests Angoori. Later, he brings food for Angoori, who is imprisoned. Vibhuti resigns from his position, securing Angoori's release. Tiwari's business suffers financial losses.

episodesList.title: Saxena Makes a Unique Bicycle
episodesList.summary: Teeka and Tillu are surprised to see Anita going to the graveyard. Tiwari, saddened by Anita's behaviour, instigates Vibhuti against her. Saxena makes a unique bicycle. Ammaji advises Angoori.

episodesList.title: The Spirits Of Michael and His Bicycle
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is saddened to see Anita talking to Michael. Michael's father tells Teeka and Tillu about the spirits of Michael and his bicycle. Vibhuti gets into trouble because of Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Sees Anita With Michael
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti see Anita talking to Michael. Later, they both discover that it is Michael's skeleton. Angoori tries a way to become a sorceress. Tiwari and Vibhuti meet Michael's father.

episodesList.title: Occultist Angoori Gives Vibhuti a Solution
episodesList.summary: Tiwari likes his neighbour, Vibhuti's ultramodern wife, Anita, and Vibhuti likes Tiwari's simple wife, Angoori. Their quest to impress each other’s wives often leads to hilarious situations.

episodesList.title: Anita Reveals The Truth to Everyone
episodesList.summary: At Vibhuti’s behest, Anita kicks David. Tiwari and Vibhuti mistake Saxena’s cycle to be Michael’s cycle and take it to Angoori. Later, Anita reveals to everyone that she was filming a documentary.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Notices Vibhuti Being Stressed
episodesList.summary: Tiwari mentions that Vibhuti is under stress. Anita completes her anger management course. Everyone gathers at Tiwari's birthday party. Vibhuti mischievously interacts with Tiwari over the phone.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Troubles Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti continues to trouble Tiwari by repeatedly calling him. Happu's leave gets cancelled, and he vents his anger in front of the commissioner. Later, he learns about Anita's anger management class.

episodesList.title: Anita's Anger Management Class is Inaugurated
episodesList.summary: The Modern Colony residents attend the inauguration of Anita's anger management class. Vibhuti frequently harasses Tiwari. Happu meets Anita at her office. Tiwari tells her problems to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Slaps Himself
episodesList.summary: Amma confronts Tiwari for scolding Angoori, and Tiwari slaps himself. He asks Happu to write a complaint against the one troubling him. Anita asks some questions to Tiwari in the class.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Reveals The Truth to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Anita gets enraged with Tiwari after learning that he likes another woman. Unaware of the commissioner's presence, Happu speaks ill of him. Vibhuti informs Tiwari that he was the one troubling him.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Locket From Vidhnyanchand
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Angoori leave their home. While escaping from the goons, Professor Vidhnyanchand reveals a secret to Vibhuti. Vibhuti gets a locket from Vidhnyanchand, which makes him invisible when worn.

episodesList.title: An Invisible Vibhuti Beats Up Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari brings Angoori home, and an invisible Vibhuti beats him up. Saxena asks Vibhuti to promise him that he will keep his secret hidden. Vibhuti's actions lead to Angoori being revered as a goddess.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Punishes Prem For His Deeds
episodesList.summary: Everyone mistakes Angoori for a goddess and worships her. Tiwari informs Anita about it. Vibhuti saves Saxena from being thrashed and later punishes Prem. Two goons watch this and inform their boss.

episodesList.title: Ammaji Asks For Money to Seek Angoori's Blessings
episodesList.summary: Tiwari bows before Angoori, and the fan falls on his head. Ammaji asks for money from the people of the modern colony to seek Angoori's blessings. Angoori denies being a goddess.

episodesList.title: Rambo Kidnaps Angoori
episodesList.summary: When Rambo kidnaps Angoori, Tiwari, Vibhuti and Anita arrive to save Angoori. They give Rambo a fake locket, and he is unable to disappear. Later, Happu arrests Rambo.

episodesList.title: Saxena Creates a Clone Of Angoori
episodesList.summary: Saxena creates a clone of Angoori through an experiment. Angoori becomes fed up with household chores. Saxena shows Angoori her clone and names her A One. Teeka and Tillu talksabout the two doctors.

episodesList.title: A One Arrives At Tiwari's House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti makes fun of Anita for having lost her inner romance. Angoori's clone, A One, meets Tiwari and dances in front of him. Teeka and Tillu deceive people by posing as fake doctors.

episodesList.title: Anita is Surprised to See Angoori's Romance
episodesList.summary: A One insults Vibhuti. Anita introduces Tiwari to Teeka and Tillu, who are disguised as doctors. She is surprised to see Angoori and Tiwari's romance and prepares to romance Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Asks Romance Tips From Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita seeks tips from Angoori to romance with Vibhuti but gets into a trouble. A One gets close to Vibhuti, leaving him scared. Tiwari meets the doctors, while Angoori asks A One about Saxena.

episodesList.title: Saxena Tells The Truth About The Clone to Everyone
episodesList.summary: Dr Gupta informs Vibhuti about Angoori's death. Happu arrives to arrest Saxena for creating Angoori's clone. Tiwari is saddened by Angoori's death. Saxena tells everyone about A One.

episodesList.title: Anita Asks Tiwari to Become Her Guarantor
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Tiwari to become her guarantor for a loan. Prem informs Vibhuti about the gambling happening in the city. Saxena starts seeing the future. Vibhuti borrows money from Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Loses Money In Gambling
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti loses the money given by Tiwari in gambling. On Ammaji's suggestion, Tiwari invites the Mishra family for dinner, but Vibhuti refuses to go. Tiwari stops Anita and David from eating.

episodesList.title: Angoori Takes a Promise From Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari starts following Vibhuti. Tiwari and Angoori once again invite the Mishra family for a meal. Angoori takes a promise from Vibhuti to join them for dinner. Saxena predicts someone's death.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Goes Missing From Home
episodesList.summary: Tiwari stops David from starting his meal without Vibhuti. Anita and Tiwari ask Happu to find Vibhuti, who is missing. Happu searches for Vibhuti, and Vibhuti is disheartened by his humiliation.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Feeds Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tillu throws a net at Vibhuti, and he gets caught. Tiwari feeds Vibhuti and forgives his debt. Anita is displeased with the land going away from her hands. Teeka gets exposed.

episodesList.title: Anita Disrespects Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: A Christmas party is organised at Anita's house. Anita tells Vibhuti that people respect him because of her. Vibhuti makes an announcement in Modern Colony. Ammaji suggests a solution to Angoori.

episodesList.title: The People Insult Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and others insult Vibhuti. Following Saxena's advice, Vibhuti decides to become an IAS officer. Angoori comes up with the idea of hindering his studies. Vibhuti asks Prem for money.

episodesList.title: Angoori Distracts Vibhuti From Studying
episodesList.summary: Anita assigns household chores to Tiwari, and he gets baffled. Angoori tries to stop Vibhuti from studying. Vibhuti and Anita argue over Anita's actions. Later, Angoori dances in front of Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Saxena Becomes Vibhuti's Teacher
episodesList.summary: Angoori is shocked to see Tiwari cleaning Anita's living room. Saxena starts tutoring Vibhuti for the IAS exams. Angoori goes to meet Vibhuti, but Saxena stops her.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Passes Ias Exam
episodesList.summary: On Ammaji's insistence, Angoori hits Vibhuti with her scooter and then drops him off at the examination centre. Vibhuti passes the exam and becomes a collector. Later, everyone learns the truth.

episodesList.title: The Modern Colony Residents' Mobile Phone Addiction
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Angoori to romance him to fix the plant. Everyone is busy using their mobile phones. A thief steals from Tiwari's house. The doctor explains the drawbacks of using mobile phones.

episodesList.title: A Theft Takes Place At Anita's House
episodesList.summary: A theft takes place at Anita and Vibhuti's house while she is busy with her phone. Later, both of them lodge a complaint with Happu. Tiwari fears as his mobile gets damaged and he argues with a man.

episodesList.title: Saxena Confiscates Everyone's Mobiles
episodesList.summary: Saxena comes to the New Year party of Modern Colony and gets angry after seeing everyone using mobile phones. He confiscates the phones for a week. Without phones, everyone's life becomes miserable.

episodesList.title: David Steals a Man's Mobile
episodesList.summary: David steals a man's mobile, and Saxena gets upset over it. Teeka and Tillu deliver everyone's messages to each other. Later, Tiwari and Angoori go to Anita's house for a meal.

episodesList.title: Saxena Returns Everyone Their Mobile Phones
episodesList.summary: Tiwari, who arrives at Anita's house for a meal, argues with Vibhuti. Saxena asks everyone some questions and tells the benefits of not using a mobile phone. He returns everyone their mobile phones.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Addicted to Stealing 'rotis'
episodesList.summary: Saxena begins shooting a film with Teeka and Tillu. Meanwhile, Vibhuti gets addicted to stealing 'rotis' from people's hands. Later, he meets Tiwari's client, Mr Khanna.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Snatches The Rotis Of Tiwari's Client
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti snatches the rotis of Tiwari's client. Ammaji tells Tiwari the remedy to feed rotis to a few people. Vibhuti stops Tiwari from giving rotis to the poor. Anita ties Vibhuti's hands.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Complains About Vibhuti to Happu
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti fools Teeka to get himself untied and then snatches the rotis from Tiwari, who complains to Happu about him. Anita lashes out at Happu, who looks for Vibhuti. Tiwari taunts Happu.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Dons Disguises to Steal 'rotis'
episodesList.summary: Disguised as a woman, Vibhuti gives a slip to Happu and steals 'rotis' from Tiwari's house. Later, Vibhuti tells Dr Poori about his childhood trauma related to the 'rotis' and dons a disguise again.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Plan Cures Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita stop the residents of Modern Colony from punishing Vibhuti. Anita tells them about Vibhuti's mental state. Saxena's plan cures Vibhuti's habit of stealing Rotis.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Receives The Title Of a Wrestler
episodesList.summary: Tiwari experiences weakness in his body, and Angoori plans to feed him dry fruits. Vibhuti decides to open a dry fruit store. Later, a renowned wrestler chooses Tiwari as his successor.

episodesList.title: Wrestler Likhkhu Bestows His Title Upon Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's shop items are delivered to his home. Tiwari tells everyone about the wrestler's mattress he received. Likhkhu, the wrestler, honours Tiwari and bestows upon him his title.

episodesList.title: Angoori Gets Upset With Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori disapproves of people offering money to Tiwari as gifts. Vibhuti suggests Tiwari promote his dry fruits brand. Meanwhile, Teeka, Tillu, and Saxena practice in Tiwari's arena.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Eats Vibhuti's Dry Fruits
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori come to Vibhuti's house for a meal, and Tiwari eats dried fruits from Vibhuti's shop. In exchange for promoting Vibhuti's shop, Tiwari asks Vibhuti to serve him dry fruits 'kheer'.

episodesList.title: Likkhu Expels Tiwari From His Position
episodesList.summary: At Anita's behest, Tiwari promotes Vibhuti's dry fruits brand. While shooting the advertisement, Vibhuti gets irked with Tiwari. Enraged at Tiwari, wrestler Likkhu expels him from his position.

episodesList.title: An Upset Angoori Leaves The House
episodesList.summary: Angoori gets upset with Tiwari’s behaviour and leaves the house. Vibhuti takes Angoori to his house, but Anita doesn’t like it. Later, Prem sees Teeka and Tillu fighting and offers them jobs.

episodesList.title: Anita Asks Tiwari to Apologise to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Tiwari to apologise to Angoori and take her home. Vibhuti comes to Tiwari's house to take Angoori's clothes. Anita considers Angoori lucky for herself. Ammaji scolds Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Plan Against Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari takes Angoori back to his home. At Anita's insistence, Vibhuti goes to take Angoori, but Tiwari refuses to send her. Vibhuti shows Tiwari's edited video to Angoori, who soon leaves the house.

episodesList.title: Angoori Returns Home After Happu's Intervention
episodesList.summary: Tiwari complains to Happu that Vibhuti has forced Angoori to stay at his house. Happu looks into the matter and Angoori returns home. Later, Vibhuti lies to Angoori and takes her to his house again.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Anita Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks a man to kidnap Angoori and bring her to his house, but the man mistakenly abducts Anita instead. Later, Tiwari again gets Anita kidnapped and blackmails Vibhooti to send Angoori home.

episodesList.title: Bhoore Gives Angoori a Cheque Of Inr 50 Lakhs
episodesList.summary: Tiwari refuses to give money to Angoori for shopping, and she gets upset. She overhears Teeka and Tillu calling her a fool. Bhoore gives Angoori a cheque of INR 50 lakhs and seeks a promise from her.

episodesList.title: Angoori Changes Her Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti make fun of Angoori. Upon Saxena's advice, Angoori changes her behaviour and insults Vibhuti. Later, she refuses to cook breakfast for Tiwari, which annoys him.

episodesList.title: Angoori Hosts a Kitty Party At Home
episodesList.summary: Angoori hosts a kitty party with her friends and repeatedly humiliates Tiwari and Vibhuti. David encourages Tiwari. A drunk Tiwari narrates the entire incident to Ammaji.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Pretend to be Drunk
episodesList.summary: Ammaji's makeover in Angoori's party surprises everyone. Tiwari asks Bhoore to take back the money given to Angoori and scolds him. Angoori and Anita pretend to get drunk in front of everyone.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Decide to Leave The House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is shocked to see a drunk Anita. Saxena teaches a lesson to those protesting against Anita and Angoori. Tiwari and Vibhuti decide to leave the house, so Anita and Angoori tell them the truth.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Argument
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti argue, and David suggests they go to the jungle to fight. Saxena demonstrates his magic to everyone. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti prepare to go to the jungle.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Fall In Love With Each Other
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti go into the jungle and get possessed by the spirits of two lovers, Bhola and Bhooli. They both share romantic moments. Tiwari teaches a lesson to Prem, who insults Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti's Romantic Video
episodesList.summary: Bhure is enraged at Tiwari and Vibhuti threatens him. Teeka and Tillu spy on Vibhuti and Tiwari and make a video of their romance. Later, Anita and Angoori are shocked when they watch the video.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Make Their Husbands Wear Amulets
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori are disturbed by Tiwari and Vibhuti's romance. Saxena's Guru Maa gives Anita and Angoori an amulet, which they then give to their husbands. The next day, Tiwari and Vibhuti recover.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Guru Maa Captures The Spirits
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti take off their amulets and again fall in love with each other. Anita and Angoori seek help from Saxena's Guru Maa. Later, Guru Maa captures the souls of Bholi and Bhola in a bottle.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Challenge to Anita
episodesList.summary: Angoori reveals her Valentine's Day plans to Vibhuti. Tiwari challenges Anita that Vibhuti won't remember Valentine's Day. Teeka and Tillu get the commissioner's credit card.

episodesList.title: Saxena Falls In Love With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari presents Anita with a gift, and she believes that it's from Vibhuti. Saxena tells Anita that he has fallen in love with Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti and Tiwari plot against each other.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Discover Each Other's Plot
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti discover that they have conspired against each other. Tiwari informs Anita about a Tarot card reader. Teeka and Tillu take Rusa for shopping using a credit card.

episodesList.title: A Disguised Tiwari Gives Anita Some Advice
episodesList.summary: Tiwari, disguised as a tarot card reader, advises Anita to celebrate Valentine's Day with her neighbour. Angoori also asks Vibhuti to celebrate Valentine's Day with her. Saxena organises a procession.

episodesList.title: Pradeep's Men Beat Up Vibhuti and Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti plays gambling with Pradeep Seth and loses. Tiwari poses as Vibhuti, and Pradeep's men beat him, mistaking him for Vibhuti. Later, they beat Vibhuti as well, and Anita mocks their condition.

episodesList.title: Saxena Announces The Saxena Winter Games
episodesList.summary: On the occasion of his uncle's 125th birthday, Saxena announces the Saxena Winter Games. Anita teams up with Tiwari, and Angoori with Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu fight over making Rusa their partner.

episodesList.title: Saxena Winter Games' Begin
episodesList.summary: The people of Modern Colony begin preparations for the 'Saxena Winter Games' and the program commences. Vibhuti reads a poem for Saxena's uncle. Later, everyone introduces their teams.

episodesList.title: The Modern Colony Residents have a Competition
episodesList.summary: Saxena Winter Games' first innings begin and the teams compete fiercely. In the final innings, Angoori and Tiwari lock horns and Tiwari loses the game. This leaves Anita furious.

episodesList.title: Everyone Plays a Game Of Sitting On The Ice Bed
episodesList.summary: In the second innings of the Saxena Winter Games, Saxena introduces a new game where he sits on an ice bed. Anita wins the first round, and Angoori wins the second. Later, Tiwari and Vibhuti face off.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Tillu Win The Game
episodesList.summary: While playing the game, Teeka, Tillu and Rusa sprinkle itching powder on everyone. As a result, Teeka and Tillu win the game. However, Saxena's uncle does not give them the prize money.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Furious At Vibhuti For Eating Paan
episodesList.summary: Anita gets irked when she sees Tiwari eating Paan. Teeka and Tillu open a paan shop. To take revenge on Anita, Tiwari feeds Paan to Vibhuti. Anita gets furious at Vibhuti for eating Paan.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Offers 'paan' to Angoori
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti feels delighted after eating 'Paan' from Teeka and Tillu's shop and offers it to Angoori. Soon, he gets 'Paan' for Anita, leaving her irked. Anita asks Teeka and Tillu to shut down their shop.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Asks Angoori to Promise Not to Eat 'paan'
episodesList.summary: Tiwari makes a deal with Teeka and Tillu and asks them to not shut their shop. He asks Angoori to promise him not to eat 'Paan', but Vibhuti makes her consume it. Tiwari complains about it to Anita.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Tries to Stop Angoori From Eating 'paan'
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to stop Angoori from eating 'paan'. David and Vibhuti stroll around, carrying a spittoon in hand. The commissioner visits Teeka's shop. Anita's client accuses Vibhuti of being dishonest.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Angoori Promise to Not Eat 'paan'
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti accidentally spits 'Paan' on Anita's client. Vibhuti and Angoori promise Anita and Tiwari that they will not eat 'Paan'. Later, the commissioner shuts down Teeka and Tillu's 'Paan' shop.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets The Curse Of Dancing Everywhere
episodesList.summary: Angoori has a dream that comes true. Tiwari mocks a woman, Chhichhorbai, who then curses him. Due to the curse, Tiwari starts dancing everywhere. Later, Bhure approaches Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Dances In Front Of Bhure
episodesList.summary: Tiwari consoles an upset Bhure and suddenly starts dancing in front of him. Bhure tells Angoori about it and goes to sleep at Vibhuti's house. Saxena tells Teeka and Tillu about becoming an occultist.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Curse Affects Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena informs Tiwari about the curse he received and encapsulates it in a laddoo. Angoori then feeds that laddoo to Vibhuti. Later, David and Bhure are surprised to see Vibhuti dancing.

episodesList.title: The Curse Rebounds and Affects Tiwari Again
episodesList.summary: Anita gets annoyed seeing Vibhuti dance repeatedly. Vibhuti gives God's offerings to Angoori, and Angoori feeds them to Tiwari. Tiwari starts dancing again and later, meets Saxena.

episodesList.title: The Modern Colony Starts Dancing
episodesList.summary: Tiwari traps his curse in the sweets and gives it to Vibhuti. Vibhuti performs lewd actions in front of Bhure. Everyone consumes the consecrated offerings at a mourning assembly organised by Bhure.

episodesList.title: Astrologer Dr Ganguly Comes to Anita's House
episodesList.summary: Tiwari snatches Teeka and Tillu's kachoris. Ammaji tells Angoori a remedy to help Tiwari gain weight. Astrologer Dr Ganguly visits Anita and makes revelations after reading everyone's birth charts.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Life is In Vibhuti's Hands
episodesList.summary: Dr. Ganguly predicts that Vibhuti and Tiwari will die within a 10-minute interval. Vibhuti prevents Tiwari from eating 'kachori'. Furthermore, he stops Tiwari from going for a business deal.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Panics As Tiwari's Health Deteriorates
episodesList.summary: Angoori prepares rabdi for Tiwari, but Anita finishes it. Vibhuti disguises himself as a gorilla to prevent Tiwari from eating kheer-puri. Tiwari's health deteriorates, and Vibhuti panics.

episodesList.title: Anita Plans to Kidnap Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori complains to Happu about a gorilla entering her house. Vibhuti disguises himself as a gorilla again, and Happu comes to catch him. Later, Anita asks David to kidnap Angoori.

episodesList.title: Anita's Action Shocks Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori is shocked to see that Anita has abducted her. Vibhuti forces Tiwari to eat salad to keep him healthy. Later, Ammaji comes home and tells Vibhuti that Tiwari has a long life.

episodesList.title: The Views Of The People Of The Modern Colony On Holi
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori oppose the rowdy Holi celebration. Journalist Barkha Dutt asks the Modern colony people about their preferred style of Holi celebration. Ammaji asks Angoori to play Holi disorderly.

episodesList.title: Angoori Enjoys The Festivity Of Holi
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Tiwari that she will play Holi. Then, Angoori, with Teeka and Tillu, messes up Vibhuti's appearance. She also spoils Anita and Tiwari's faces. Later, the reason for this is revealed.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Tillu Smear Mud On Happu
episodesList.summary: Angoori, Teeka and Tillu get Tiwari drenched in mud while playing Holi. Angoori gifts a box filled with cow dung to Bhure and again applies colour to Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu smear mud on Happu.

episodesList.title: David Decides to Save Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti once again falls prey to Angoori, Teeka and Tillu's plan. Later, they colour Masterji, Roosa, Doctor and Prem. Anita complains to Tiwari about Angoori. David decides to save Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Celebrate Holi
episodesList.summary: Tiwari comes to Vibhuti’s house, but Anita calls him a coward and doesn’t let him in. Ammaji asks Angoori to stop the ill-mannered Holi. Later, the Modern Colony residents celebrate Holi.

episodesList.title: A Beautiful Lady Comes to The Modern Colony
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari quiz each other about Anita and Angoori's likes-dislikes. However, this creates trouble for them. Later, a pretty lady's arrival in the Modern Colony attracts everyone's attention.

episodesList.title: Chandni Attends The Party At Anita's House
episodesList.summary: Anita invites Chandni, who has come to live in the neighbourhood, to a party. Chandni attends it and recites a few poetries. Meanwhile, Tiwari argues with Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu fall for Chandni.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Chandni Fall In Love
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti misbehaves with Angoori and kisses Chandni, but Saxena sees him doing so. Chandni throws a letter for Vibhuti, but Anita finds it. Later, Tiwari instigates Anita against Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Anita Suspects Vibhuti and Chandani
episodesList.summary: Anita asks David if Vibhuti and Chandani are having an affair. Tiwari organises a party at his house and invites Chandani. Anita's suspicions are confirmed after seeing Vibhuti and Chandani's actions.

episodesList.title: Saxena Exposes Chandani
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti decides to leave the house for Chandani. Anita complains to Happu about Vibhuti. At Tiwari's party, Saxena reveals that Chandani is a hypnotist. Saxena cures Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Saxena does Not Find a Single Friend
episodesList.summary: Tiwari befriends Vibhuti at Anita and Angoori's insistence. The Modern Colony residents refuse to befriend Saxena. He impersonates Vibhuti with the help of artificial intelligence and calls Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Saxena Impersonates Tiwari to Threaten Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena instigates a fight between Teeka and Tillu and impersonates Tiwari to threaten Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti throws a cake at Tiwari. Anita requests Vibhuti, while Angoori urges Tiwari to make a vow.

episodesList.title: Anita Complains About Tiwari to Happu
episodesList.summary: Saxena impersonates Tiwari and insults Vibhuti. As a result, Anita complains about Tiwari to Happu and Happu interrogates Tiwari. Saxena talks to Anita in Tiwari's voice, and she misunderstands him.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Become Homeless Due to Saxena
episodesList.summary: Saxena creates a rift between Tiwari and Angoori, as well as Vibhuti and Anita, leading the wives to oust their husbands. He turns Bhojraj against Tiwari and Vibhuti, so Bhojraj complaints to Happu.

episodesList.title: Saxena Tells Everyone About His Deeds
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti ask Tillu and Teeka to tell their wives a false story, but their deception is caught. Happu arrests Tiwari and Vibhuti. On Anita's insistence, Saxena tells everyone the truth.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Opens His Hospital
episodesList.summary: The Modern Colony residents get their check-ups done and everyone is astonished by the reports made by Dr Gupta. Ammaji instructs Angoori to lock herself in the bedroom. Vibhuti opens his hospital.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets His Treatment Done By Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: On Anita's suggestion, Tiwari comes to Vibhuti for treatment. Saxena suggests strange remedies as a treatment for the residents of the Modern Colony. Later, Vibhuti treats Tiwari's neck.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Threatens Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Saxena treats Teeka and Tillu in strange ways. Tiwari threatens Vibhuti to fix his twisted neck. Vibhuti and David share a plan with Tiwari, and Tiwari gets enraged.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Complains About Vibhuti to Happu
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to fix his stiff neck. Later, when he experiences stiffness in his legs, he seeks help from Teeka and Tillu. When Tiwari complains about Vibhuti to Happu, Anita goes to meet Happu.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Tends to Tiwari's Neck
episodesList.summary: When Anita's inquires, Vibhuti tells her that he doesn't possess a degree in physiotherapy. Vibhuti tends to Tiwari's neck, but Tiwari encounters trouble. He suggests twisting Tiwari's neck again.

episodesList.title: Anita Faints After Spotting a Thief
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti shoot a reel with Anita and Angoori. Anita faints after spotting a thief. Teeka and Tillu start a 'Dhaba'. Anita and Vibhuti come over to Tiwari's house for dinner.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Addicted to Stealing Items
episodesList.summary: Anita steals some items from Tiwari's house. She even steals Tiwari's bracelet. Ammaji scolds Tiwari for losing his bracelet. Later, Anita steals spoons from Teeka and Tillu's Dhaba.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Discovers That Anita is a Thief
episodesList.summary: When Vibhuti finds some objects hidden under the bed, he discovers Anita's theft and informs Tiwari about it. Anita steals the necklace from the commissioner's wife's bag and Angoori notices her.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Locks Angoori In The Bathroom
episodesList.summary: Happu informs Tiwari and Vibhuti that either Angoori or Anita have committed the theft. Anita cries in front of Vibhuti. To stop Angoori from complaining about Anita, Tiwari locks her in the bathroom.

episodesList.title: The Residents Of Modern Colony Stage an Act
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti helps Angoori out of the bathroom but locks her again after realising her intention. To cure Anita, everyone performs a drama connected to her past and she gives up stealing.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets a Job In America
episodesList.summary: Anita's paternal aunt Kusum calls her from America for Vibhuti's job. Vibhuti refuses to go there when Anita informs him. To avoid going to America, Vibhuti thinks of an idea after seeing Tiwari.

episodesList.title: David Tells Vibhuti a Trick to Avoid Going to America
episodesList.summary: David suggests Vibhuti a trick to avoid going to America. Tiwari overhears them and goes to Happu to foil their plan. Later, Vibhuti, Teeka and Tillu pull off a pretence in front of Happu.

episodesList.title: Dr Gupta Replaces Vibhuti's Reports
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asserts that he cannot leave his country. At Vibhuti's behest, Dr Gupta presents Vibhuti's fake reports to Anita. Tiwari arrives with a doctor and exposes Vibhuti's deceit.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Flirts With The Commissioner's Wife
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti makes a plan with Teeka and Tillu to get himself arrested. Tiwari hosts a party at home to celebrate Vibhuti getting a job in America. Vibhuti flirts with the Commissioner's wife there.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Leaves For America
episodesList.summary: The modern colony residents celebrate as they bid farewell to Vibhuti and he leaves for America. Anita learns the plan of her aunt, who stays in America. Vibhuti returns home after missing the flight.

episodesList.title: Prem Goes to Stay At Vibhuti's House
episodesList.summary: Ammaji tells Angoori and Anita to try to become mothers. Prem's wife ousts him from the house, and he goes to stay at Vibhuti's house. Later, Amma scolds Tiwari for drinking alcohol.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gives Alcohol to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Prem to leave Vibhuti alone. Angoori shares her wish to become a mother with Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu seek accommodation from Saxena. Vibhuti deceitfully gives alcohol to Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Falls From The Balcony
episodesList.summary: Tiwari advances towards Angoori for romance and accidentally falls from the balcony. Anita tries to romance with Vibhuti but Prem interferes. Teeka and Tillu search for a place to stay.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Shocked By Prem's Behaviour
episodesList.summary: After being ousted from Anita's house, Vibhuti goes to Prem's house. Prem refuses to let Vibhuti stay, leaving him and Anita shocked. Tiwari also gets scared of Vibhuti's behaviour.

episodesList.title: Anita Lashes Out At Prem
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tells Happu that Vibhuti has kidnapped Angoori. Anita lashes out at Prem for not helping Vibhuti. Later, Vibhuti attacks Happu. Furthermore, Anita is delighted as Vibhuti gets cured.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Decide Not to Get Angry
episodesList.summary: Saxena advises Anita and Angoori not to get angry with their husbands. Tiwari and Vibhuti are worried about their wives' behaviour and Prem advises both of them to make their wives angry.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari's Plan Fails
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Tiwari's plan to make Anita and Angoori angry fails. Teeka and Tillu start selling Langoor Soap. Prem tells Vibhuti and Tiwari the story of their friend, Grover.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Get Angry
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries to make Anita angry by instigating her against Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu encounter a trouble. Later, Anita and Angoori finally get angry on hearing Tiwari and Vibhuti’s words.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori Grow Furious With Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori is furious with Vibhuti while Anita is irked with Tiwari. Teeka and Tillu fail to sell Langoor Soap. Later, Anita and Angoori grow furious with Tiwari after hearing his poem about women.

episodesList.title: Anita Slaps Happu
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti try to pacify their angry wives. Anita slaps Happu when he asks her to divorce Vibhuti. Later, everyone puts on an act to save Happu’s job.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Plan to Get a Big Order For Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari considers making some changes in his business. Vibhuti informs Tiwari about a foreign businessman, Baniyano Underwearo. The commissioner loses his job, and Happu gives him some advice.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Inspects Tiwari's Factory
episodesList.summary: Angoori gives a unique gift to Vibhuti when he helps Tiwari get a big order. Tiwari employs the Modern Colony residents for work. Vibhuti inspects Tiwari's factory and considers cancelling the order.

episodesList.title: The Workers Protest Against Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Anita to manage his factory. Tiwari prohibits giving alcohol to the workers during work, but they rebel against him. David also breaks his relationship with Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: The News Given By Vibhuti Shocks Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Workers at Tiwari's factory toil day and night to complete Tiwari's order. Prem tells Vibhuti that Baniyano Underwearo's company is fake. This shocks Tiwari, while the workers are also disappointed.

episodesList.title: Baniyano Underwearo is Taught a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Tiwari is shocked to face a loss in business. Angoori and Ammaji beat up Vibhuti. The workers demand for wages from Tiwari. Vibhuti, Angoori and Anita teach Baniyano Underwearo aka Dubey a lesson.

episodesList.title: Happu Moves Into The Modern Colony As Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Happu disguises himself as Kalindi and moves into the Modern Colony to catch a terrorist. Teeka takes sleeping pills, so Tillu takes him to the hospital. Angoori asks Teeka about his distress.

episodesList.title: Teeka Falls In Love With Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Anita asks Tiwari and Vibhuti to find a girl for Teeka. Tiwari and Vibhuti choose Kalindi as Teeka's partner. Teeka also accidentally bumps into Kalindi in the market and he falls in love with her.

episodesList.title: Teeka Dances With Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita go to meet Kalindi. Tiwari throws a party at his house and invites Kalindi to introduce her to Teeka. Later, Teeka dances with Kalindi at the party.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Kalindi's Marriage is Not Fixed
episodesList.summary: Kalindi introduces everyone to her family. They discuss her wedding with Teeka. Happu tells the commissioner about Chef Besura. Teeka threatens to kill himself if his wedding with Kalindi isn't fixed.

episodesList.title: Happu Tells Everyone Why He Became Kalindi
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti stops Teeka from committing suicide. Tiwari and Vibhuti abduct Kalindi, while Happu reveals his true identity to everyone. They help Happu in arresting the terrorist by putting on an act.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti is Possessed By Santiram's Spirit
episodesList.summary: Masterji remembers his teacher Santiram on his death anniversary. Vibhuti hides from Chhote Pehelwan in Santiram’s room and gets possessed by Santiram’s spirit. Later, Vibhuti thrashes Anita.

episodesList.title: Masterji Introduces Santiram to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Angoori finds Vibhuti's behaviour extremely strange. Saxena receives a boon. Later, Vibhuti disguises himself as Santiram and comes before Masterji and Prem. Masterji takes him to Tiwari's house.

episodesList.title: Everyone Gathers In Santiram's Classroom
episodesList.summary: Anita refuses to believe that Santiram has possessed Vibhuti and is scared by an incident. The people of Modern Colony receive Santiram's letter. Later, everyone gathers in Santiram's classroom.

episodesList.title: Santiram Fixes Anita and Tiwari's Alliance
episodesList.summary: Santiram punishes the students for giving wrong answers to his questions. Later, he fixes Anita’s alliance with Tiwari against her will. Tiwari informs about it to Angoori, leaving her shocked.

episodesList.title: Santiram's Spirit Leaves Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori agrees for Anita and Tiwari's marriage. Anita meets Saxena. The rituals of Tiwari and Anita's wedding begin. Saxena brings Madhumati, and Santiram's spirit leaves Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Modern Colony Residents Suffer Due to The Heat
episodesList.summary: The residents of Modern Colony suffer due to the scorching heat. Anita asks David to take her important file, but he refuses. Meanwhile, Tiwari faints due to extreme heat.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Condition Deteriorates Due to The Heat
episodesList.summary: Ammaji asks Angoori to bury a bag in the mountain temple, but Vibhuti goes in the scorching sun instead. Tiwari is stunned by Anita's statement. Vibhuti's condition deteriorates due to the heat.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Slaps Prem
episodesList.summary: Anita tries to convince an irate Vibhuti. Vibhuti slaps Prem, and Dr Gupta brings home a sunburned Vibhuti. Later, Dr Gupta collapses due to heat exhaustion.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Beats Up Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Tiwari and Angoori about Vibhuti's changed behaviour. Vibhuti beats up Tiwari when he comes to talk to him. Angoori takes food for Vibhuti. Tiwari invites everyone to the party.

episodesList.title: Angoori Pacifies Vibhuti's Anger
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti arrives at Tiwari's party and beats up everyone. At David's behest, Angoori spends a night with Vibhuti to pacify him. But Vibhuti's anger shifts onto Angoori and she starts beating people.

episodesList.title: A Woman Slaps Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari gets irked with Vibhuti for wasting his time by talking to Angoori. Anita asks Vibhuti for some money. A woman slaps Tiwari. Later, Ammaji suggest an unusual solution to Angoori’s problem.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Asks Vibhuti to Tease Angoori
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti to tease Angoori. The commissioner tells Happu about a group of women beating the city's brothers-in-law. Anita tells Vibhuti to take money in return for teasing Angoori.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Harasses Angoori
episodesList.summary: Anita demands that Tiwari give INR 100 per minute to Vibhuti to harass Angoori. Vibhuti harasses Angoori, and Masterji beats him up. Anita demands extra money because Vibhuti got beaten up.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Gets Beaten Up For Harassing a Woman
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti harasses a woman mistaking her for Angoori, and her husband beats him up. The women set out to teach all the brothers-in-law a lesson. Vibhuti teases Angoori and the women beat him up.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Anita and Tiwari tell Happu about Vibhuti's kidnapping. Vibhuti returns home and tells everyone about his ordeal. Later, Angoori teases Vibhuti and he falls off the balcony.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Sees Vibhuti and Anita Fighting
episodesList.summary: Tiwari is shocked to see Vibhuti and Anita fighting. Saxena roams around Modern Colony disguised as Lelo Jaan, a courtesan. Masterji tells everyone about the domestic violence he had to endure.

episodesList.title: Angoori Assigns Teeka and Tillu a Task
episodesList.summary: Angoori tells Ammaji about Anita and Vibhuti's fight. Vibhuti ousts Anita from the house, and Anita gets enraged when Tiwari intervenes. Angoori assigns Teeka and Tillu to keep an eye on Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Stops Vibhuti From Drinking Alcohol
episodesList.summary: Tiwari stops Vibhuti from drinking alcohol. At night, David records a video of Vibhuti and Anita arguing, and Tiwari intervenes by visiting their house. Later, Tiwari complains to Happu about Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Vibhuti Arrested
episodesList.summary: Tiwari conspires with Happu to have Vibhuti arrested. Later, he falsely assures Anita that he will secure Vibhuti's bail. Angoori slaps Happu and gets arrested.

episodesList.title: Anita Reveals The Truth to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari arranges for Vibhuti's bail. Vibhuti slaps Happu and goes back to jail to stay with Angoori. Anita clears Tiwari's misunderstanding by revealing the truth about shooting the video.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Tries to Win Anita's Heart
episodesList.summary: Angoori and Anita talk about the kinds of people they like, which Vibhuti and Tiwari overhear. Tiwari insults a beggar in front of Anita. Angoori informs Ammaji about this.

episodesList.title: Angoori is Impressed By Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti impresses Angoori by treating a beggar kindly. Tiwari belittles Teeka and Tillu, which impresses Anita. Later, Anita arrives at Tiwari's house for the party.

episodesList.title: A Beggar Sneaks Into Vibhuti's House
episodesList.summary: Anita gets enraged at Vibhuti for bringing Teeka and Tillu to Tiwari's party. A beggar sneaks into Vibhuti's house at night and Anita is shocked. Saxena reassures Teeka and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Tiwari's Act Lands Him In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tiwari lashes out at a man in front of Anita, but later, he learns that he is the Income Tax Officer. Later, to fulfill a beggar’s wish, Vibhuti asks Angoori to feed the beggar.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Help Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Vibhuti inform Angoori and Anita that they are being blackmailed. Anita teaches a lesson to the income tax officer and Angoori scolds the beggar. Tiwari and Vibhuti beat up Teeka and Tillu.

episodesList.title: Angoori Plans to Express Her Love to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Minal that she likes a man who gets drenched in the rain and Tiwari hears this. Angoori plans to express her love to Vibhuti as advised by Ammaji. Tiwari decides to become Saxena's model.

episodesList.title: A Mark On David's Body Causes Vibhuti to Faint
episodesList.summary: Saxena draws a picture of Tiwari getting drenched in the rain, which impresses Anita. Vibhuti faints upon seeing a mark on David's body. Angoori forgets that she needs to confess her love to Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Angoori Tries to Confess Her Love to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Angoori tries to confess her love to Vibhuti, but he flees when thunder strikes. Tiwari gets drenched in the rain and impresses Anita. Teeka and Tillu trick people by dressing as women.

episodesList.title: A Scared Vibhuti Runs Away From Angoori
episodesList.summary: Angoori warns Tiwari that she will complain about him to Ammaji. Angoori fails to complete the remedy due to Vibhuti's fear. Anita tells her doctor friend about Vibhuti's condition.

episodesList.title: Saxena Threatens Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Saxena aims a gun at Tiwari and draws his picture while he stands in the rain. Ammaji asks Angoori to make a change in her plan. Teeka and Tillu shock everyone by revealing their true identities.

episodesList.title: Anita Dies In a Bus Accident
episodesList.summary: Tiwari stops Anita from going to Lucknow. Agent Vinod entices Teeka and Tillu with dreams of sending them to Singapore for INR 50 lakhs. Later, Happu informs Vibhuti that Anita died in a bus accident.

episodesList.title: A Condolence Meeting For Anita
episodesList.summary: At Anita's condolence meeting, the people of Modern Colony say a few words about her. Teeka and Tillu decide to ask Saxena for money. Anita regains consciousness at Vaidya Ghanteshwar's house.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Sees Anita Everywhere
episodesList.summary: Tiwari keeps seeing Anita everywhere. Heartbroken by Anita's departure, Vibhuti turns into an alcoholic. Later, Ammaji, Angoori, and others ask Vibhuti to remarry, but he refuses.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Second Marriage is Arranged
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti's marriage is arranged with Prem's sister-in-law, Dimple. Anita regains her memory and returns during Vibhuti and Dimple's engagement. Happu sneaks into Anita's house at night to meet her.

episodesList.title: Dimple Demands Inr 1 Crore From Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: After the engagement breaks off, Dimple and her mother demand INR 1 crore from Vibhuti. Soon, Vibhuti, along with, David, Tiwari and Anita, puts on an act to scare Dimple and her mother.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Receives a Threat
episodesList.summary: Angoori wakes up from a bad dream and informs Tiwari about it. A threatening letter is stuck outside Tiwari's house warning about an unseen threat. Tiwari requests Happu to take action against it.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Responds to an Anonymous Threat
episodesList.summary: At Vibhuti's provocation, Tiwari responds to the threat from an unknown person. Teeka tells Tillu about the plan to raid Tiwari's shop. The unknown person threatens Tiwari to disappear Angoori.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Decides to Go to Bhind Morena
episodesList.summary: Tiwari decides to go to Bhind Morena. Vibhuti too makes plans to settle there but in vain. Later, Vibhuti insults the Indian judiciary, and Resham Pal asks Manohar to arrest him.

episodesList.title: A Ceremony to Bid Farewell to Tiwari and Angoori
episodesList.summary: Tiwari tries a trick to avoid going to Bhind Morena, but it fails. Teeka and Tillu ask Tiwari to give them his shop. Modern Colony residents perform a ceremony to bid farewell to Tiwari and Angoori.

episodesList.title: Manohar Gives Good News to Tiwari and Angoori
episodesList.summary: Everyone gets sad during Tiwari and Angoori's farewell. Angoori and Tiwari pack their bags to leave the city. Later, Manohar tells them that the anonymous person threatening them has been caught.

episodesList.title: Anita and Angoori's Husbands Discourage Them
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti motivates Angoori to try Western dance. Tiwari praises Anita's singing, but Vibhuti disagrees and calls it poor. Tiwari also criticises Angoori's dance, which discourages her.

episodesList.title: Angoori and Anita Prepare to Learn Dance and Music
episodesList.summary: On seeing Vibhuti and Tiwari fighting, Teeka and Tillu bet on them. Angoori introduces Tiwari to her dance teacher, Bobby. Meanwhile, Anita introduces Vibhuti to her music teacher, Sunny Darbari.

episodesList.title: Bobby and Sunny Add to Tiwari and Vibhuti's Worries
episodesList.summary: While Vibhuti gets upset to see Bobby massaging Angoori's head, Tiwari is displeased to see Anita with Sunny. Later, Vibhuti and Tiwari watch Anita and Angoori go to the market with Sunny and Bobby.

episodesList.title: Saxena Gives Shock Therapy to Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti sees Bobby feeding ice cream to Angoori. Tiwari also sees Sunny proposing to Anita. Saxena gives shock therapy to Tiwari and Vibhuti. Tiwari and Vibhuti then put their plans into action.

episodesList.title: Teeka and Tillu Beat Up Happu and Manohar
episodesList.summary: Happu and Manohar stay at Sunny and Bobby’s house to catch a criminal. Teeka and Tillu beat them, thinking they’re Sunny and Bobby. Anita and Angoori say Sunny and Bobby are like brothers to them.

episodesList.title: Ammaji's Lookalike Arrives At Tiwari's House
episodesList.summary: Tiwari worries about Aamaji’s arrival. Ammaji's lookalike knocks Ammaji unconscious and goes to Tiwari's house in her place. Vibhuti finds Aamaji's behaviour strange. Saxena predicts the future.

episodesList.title: Ammaji's Lookalike Likes Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Angoori go to Tiwari's house. Vibhuti flirts with Ammaji's lookalike, mistaking her for Anita, and she gets attracted to him. Angoori is surprised to learn that Ammaji likes Vibhuti.

episodesList.title: Ammaji's Lookalike Confesses Her Love to Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Ammaji's lookalike plays cards with Teeka and Tillu. Later, she confesses her love to Vibhuti, leaving Tiwari shocked. Tiwari beats up Vibhuti. Teeka and Tillu face an accident.

episodesList.title: Angoori Asks Vibhuti to Marry Ammaji
episodesList.summary: Ammaji's lookalike tricks Angoori and instructs her to persuade Vibhuti to marry Ammaji. She then challenges Anita to a gambling game and imposes a condition on her.

episodesList.title: Ammaji and Vibhuti's Wedding Preparation
episodesList.summary: Ammaji's lookalike Anita loses in a gambling game, leaving Vibhuti shocked. As the people of Modern Colony gather for Ammaji and Vibhuti's wedding, the real Ammaji arrives and reveals the imposter.

episodesList.title: Life Of The Modern Colony Residents In Kheeramandi
episodesList.summary: Saxena takes Tiwari and Vibhuti to his uncle, who is a scientist. Using a special telescope, Vibhuti sees a parallel world where the Modern Colony residents are living a different life in Kheeramandi.

episodesList.title: Anita is a Courtesan In The Parallel World
episodesList.summary: Tiwari protects the honour of Anita, a courtesan in the parallel world. Tiwari and Vibhuti tell Angoori and Anita about Kheeramandi. Later, Angoori and Anita also see it through binoculars.

episodesList.title: Anjuman Hatches a Ploy
episodesList.summary: Anara and Anjuman share their grief with each other. Anjuman and the cucumber seller hatch a ploy. Saxena's uncle scolds Tiwari and Vibhuti. Anita gets angry when Tiwari addresses her as Anjuman.

episodesList.title: Saxena's Uncle Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: The British officer, Happu, arrives in Kheeramandi. The cucumber seller asks Anara, to buy his cucumbers. When Vibhuti calls Anita a courtesan, Tiwari gets angry. Saxena's uncle goes missing.

episodesList.title: Anjuman and Anara’s Plan is Revealed
episodesList.summary: Saxena’s uncle sends his telescope to Tiwari’s house via courier. The cucumber seller kills Beluddin. Anjuman and Anara’s plan is revealed. Vibhuti is upset with Anita’s deception.

episodesList.title: Anita's Decision to Go to London With Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita praises foreign cuisine, and Tiwari and Vibhuti oppose her. Later, Anita informs Vibhuti that they are moving to London. Tiwari is upset by this news.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Invites Anita For Dinner
episodesList.summary: Tiwari invites Anita for dinner. Teeka and Tillu decide to learn English from Saxena. Vibhuti tells Angoori that Anita is forcefully taking him to London, but later, he changes his mind.

episodesList.title: Anderson Tells Anita About His Plan to Visit India
episodesList.summary: Anita and Vibhuti joke about Tiwari. Saxena teaches English to the people of Modern Colony. Anderson tells Anita over call that he wants to come to India and meet his neighbours.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Gets Enraged With Anita
episodesList.summary: A drunk Tiwari loses his temper with Anita and gets into a scuffle with Vibhuti. Saxena teaches his students how to talk to girls. Anita makes a request to Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Anita Cancels Her Plans to Go to London
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Angoori to put on an act. Anderson explains to Anita the importance of her country, and she cancels her plans to go to London. Later, the Modern Colony residents hoist the flag together.

episodesList.title: Pandit Ramphal's Unique Solution
episodesList.summary: Pandit Ramphal finds a flaw in Tiwari's horoscope and recommends feeding 11 kilograms of sugar to a special person. Vibhuti’s blood sugar goes up. Pandit Ramphal goes to check Vibhuti's horoscope.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Agrees to Eat Sugar
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti eats the sugar and promises to help Angoori. Angoori makes halwa for him. Happu asks Teeka and Tillu for help in catching a gang. Anita is shocked when Vibhuti’s sugar levels rise.

episodesList.title: Tiwari is Thrashed Due to a Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Happu, Teeka and Tillu thrash Tiwari due to a misunderstanding. Angoori gets Vibhuti to drink sugar water which increases his sugar level. Later, Angoori prepares to feed him laddus.

episodesList.title: Anita Gets Tiwari Arrested
episodesList.summary: Anita repeatedly sees Tiwari feeding sweets to Vibhuti and has him arrested by Happu. Later, Anita goes to Angoori’s house to steal sugar, and Angoori catches her in the act.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Health Worsens After Eating The Sugar
episodesList.summary: Angoori frees Vibhuti from the locked room and feeds him sugar. Vibhuti's condition worsens, and Saxena treats him by giving Ayurvedic medicines. Later, everyone celebrates Janmashtami.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Aunt Bulbul Arrives In The City
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti sends Teeka to the station to bring his aunt, Bulbul. Later, Bulbul praises Teeka, which makes him happy. Meanwhile, Saxena shares his sorrowful story with Angoori.

episodesList.title: Teeka Falls In Love With Bulbul
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti is happy with Bulbul's arrival. Anita and Bulbul have an argument. Teeka informs Angoori about his love for Bulbul, and Angoori decides to fix Teeka and Bulbul's marriage.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Asks Vibhuti For Bulbul's Hand
episodesList.summary: Tiwari asks Vibhuti for Bulbul's hand for Teeka, and Vibhuti beats him up. Tiwari complains about Vibhuti to Happu and later sets a condition before Vibhuti. Bulbul tells Vibhuti that she loves Teeka.

episodesList.title: Teeka Consumes Poison
episodesList.summary: Tiwari threatens to get Vibhuti arrested after Bulbul and Teeka’s marriage alliance fails. Shattered by Vibhuti’s words, Teeka consumes poison. Later, Teeka and Bulbul get engaged.

episodesList.title: Teeka Asks Vibhuti For Dowry
episodesList.summary: Anita tells Tiwari that Bulbul and Teeka's marriage may shock Vibhuti. At Tiwari's insistence, Teeka asks Vibhuti for dowry and the marriage is cancelled. Later, Angoori tells Vibhuti the truth.

episodesList.title: The Commissioner Tells Happu About 'khujali Gang'
episodesList.summary: Prem sks Vibhuti for his money and Anita makes a decision. Tiwari calls Angoori's food distasteful. The commissioner informs Happu about the 'Khujali Gang'. Saxena helps Teeka regain consciousness.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Decides to Form His Khujali Gang
episodesList.summary: Angoori asks Tiwari to cook his own food. Happu tells Vibhuti about the Khujali Gang, and Vibhuti decides to form his own Khujali Gang. Later, he asks Saxena for the itching powder.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti's Khujali Gang Commits Theft
episodesList.summary: Tiwari sees Anita eating samosas and asks her a question. Vibhuti puts itching powder on Tiwari and then steals from his house. The residents of the colony complain to Happu about the Khujali Gang.

episodesList.title: Happu Arrests David, Teeka and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari catches Vibhuti red-handed stealing in his house. Happu arrests David, Teeka, and Vibhuti, presenting them as the Khujali Gang in front of the media. Later, Happu makes a request to Anita.
