episodesList.summary: Angoori turns down Tiwari’s romantic gestures, while Vibhuti avoids Anita by pretending to be busy, leaving her upset. Amidst it all, the ‘Chidiya Udd’ contest enters its next thrilling round.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Burns Angoori’s Saree
episodesList.summary: Power gets cut due to Vibhuti’s unpaid bill, triggering a clash with Anita. While Angoori fumes at Tiwari for burning her saree, David drops by their house to use the toilet.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Arrive At The Airport
episodesList.summary: Anita and Angoori gift fake Thailand tickets to their upset husbands. At the airport, Tiwari and Vibhuti realise the prank, while the wives enjoy their mischief.

episodesList.title: Prem Urges Vibhuti to Step Into The Betting Market
episodesList.summary: Prem lures Vibhuti to invest in betting. Tiwari tells Angoori of business losses, while Manish tempts Vibhuti with a daring scheme to profit from cricket wagers.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti and Tiwari Invest In The Betting Market
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Anita for money to enter the betting market and convinces Tiwari to join. Soon, wagers are placed on Manish’s brother’s cricket team, as Pappu outlines the betting terms.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Lose Their Money In The Betting Market
episodesList.summary: Manish’s brother’s cricket team is defeated, and the betting market swallows all the money. Desperate to repay Pappu, Tiwari and Vibhuti become pickpockets, stealing their wives’ purses in shame.

episodesList.title: Manohar Punishes Tiwari and Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Manohar whips Tiwari and Vibhuti for the theft. Angoori dances publicly to earn money, and Vibhuti informs Tiwari, who ends up selling his house to Pappu to clear the debt.

episodesList.title: Anita Takes Charge As Pappu’s Personal Secretary
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Angoori vacate their house. Anita becomes Pappu’s secretary, shocking Tiwari and Vibhuti as they witness her romance, until Anita and Angoori reveal the truth.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Face Off In a Carrom Match
episodesList.summary: Tiwari defeats Vibhuti in a carrom match, while Saxena invents a device to control human hands. Anita treats Vibhuti coldly and showers praise on Tiwari.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Asks Saxena For His Special Device
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti asks Saxena for his hand‑control device. Tillu begs Tiwari to meet his future in‑laws as his brother. Later, Anita cleverly feeds Tiwari Saxena’s special laddoo.

episodesList.title: Vibhuti Takes Control Of Tiwari's Hand
episodesList.summary: Tillu’s future in-laws visit Tiwari’s home. Vibhuti seizes control of Tiwari’s hand, making him act bizarrely before them. Later, Anita complains to Happu that Tiwari misbehaved with a girl.

episodesList.title: Tillu’s Alliance Breaks Due to Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Tiwari embraces Tillu’s future mother‑in‑law, breaking Tillu's alliance. As a result, Tillu and Teeka rush to inform Anita about it. Prem tells Tiwari that his hands are being controlled by Saxena.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Takes Revenge On Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Tiwari goes to Saxena, and together they gain control over Vibhuti’s legs. As a result, Vibhuti crushes the foot of Tillu’s would-be father-in-law and is then shocked to see Tiwari with Saxena.

episodesList.title: Amma’s Memories Tied to Her Favourite Quilt
episodesList.summary: Amma recalls old memories of her favourite quilt to the children. Later, she angers Rajesh by refusing her earrings, prompting her to take a vow. Meanwhile, at college, Ranbir finds a new love!

episodesList.title: Angoori’s Strike Spells Trouble For Tiwari
episodesList.summary: Teeka and friends support Angoori’s strike against Tiwari. Later, Angoori refuses to cook, while Tiwari, desperate to win her back, tries to charm her with romance.

episodesList.title: Angoori Enters Politics
episodesList.summary: During the strike, Anita demands a hefty sum from the 'Mukt Mahila Party' leader to join Angoori’s cause, while the 'Swatantra Mahila Party' chief also asks Tiwari about her.

episodesList.title: Anita is Envious Of Angoori’s Growing Popularity
episodesList.summary: Tiwari urges Angoori to join the 'Swatantra Mahila Party', but she declines. Anita, stung by Angoori’s rising fame, schemes a twist, while the chairman erupts at Tiwari’s words!

episodesList.title: Angoori's Insistence Causes Tiwari's Abduction
episodesList.summary: Angoori refuses the Swatantra Mahila Party, triggering Tiwari’s abduction by its chief. Anita and Angoori mount a daring rescue before stealing the spotlight on Saxena’s podcast.

episodesList.title: Birthday Bash Chaos and Herb Smoke Twist
episodesList.summary: Modern Colony unites for David’s birthday bash! Sparks fly as Vibhuti clashes with Tiwari over Angoori, wrecking the party. Later, he inhales Saxena’s rare herb smoke, igniting unexpected chaos.

episodesList.title: Everyone is Shocked By Vibhuti's Changed Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti suddenly behaves lovingly with everyone, leaving the colony stunned. Dr Kimaka suggests a remedy to Anita, who then seeks Tiwari’s help and he quickly comes up with a plan.

episodesList.title: Anita Puts On an Act to Cure Vibhuti
episodesList.summary: Anita’s teasing romance act with Tiwari leaves Vibhuti unfazed. Later, she also pretends to romance Prem, and on seeing them together, Tiwari suffers a heart attack.

episodesList.title: Prem's Wedding Procession Comes to Anita's House
episodesList.summary: Vibhuti and Saxena trick Tiwari into inhaling herbal smoke, causing a sudden change in his behaviour. Later, they arrive with Prem’s wedding procession to marry him off to Anita, and Anita helps Prem.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Vibhuti Get Their Own Houses Robbed
episodesList.summary: Intoxicated, Tiwari and Vibhuti unknowingly let Teeka and his gang rob their houses. David and Anita report the theft to Manohar and once the herbal haze fades, Tiwari and Vibhuti return to normal.

episodesList.title: Tiwari and Anita’s Plot to Make a Fortune
episodesList.summary: Tiwari and Anita dream of a windfall. Later, they visit Minister P.P. Srivastav’s office, who advises them to acquire land near the airport to make a fortune.

episodesList.title: Anita’s Scheme to Use Prem’s Money
episodesList.summary: Fearing the tax department, Prem entrusts his money to Vibhuti, and Anita persuades Vibhuti to invest it. Later, Tiwari and Anita unveil a grand plan to make the colony rich.

episodesList.title: The Residents Of The Colony are Deceived
episodesList.summary: The airport site is shifted, leaving Modern Colony residents cheated out of their money. Prem confronts Vibhuti for repayment, while Tiwari reports the fraud to the Commissioner.

episodesList.title: Tiwari Asks Anita to Pose As His Wife
episodesList.summary: Tiwari schemes to gain his aunt’s property by making Anita pose as his modern wife. When Prem abducts Vibhuti, Anita agrees to act as Tiwari’s wife to save him.

episodesList.title: Let’s Set Out For Ghoonghatganj!
episodesList.summary: Angoori decides to go to Ghoonghatganj with Tiwari and Anita, while Vibhuti insists on joining. Tiwari and Anita also rope in Teeka and his gang, taking them along as servants.

cast.name: Aasif Sheikh
cast.role: Vibhuti "Vibhu" Narayan Mishra, an unsuccessful insurance agent, Anita's husband, David's nephew, and Helen's son. Often called "Nalla" for being unemployed, he has fallen for the simple-minded Angoori Tiwari, Manmohan’s wife. He is known to be highly educated but refuses to take a regular job due to his ego and laziness. His plans to woo Angoori usually fail due to her naivety, putting him in dire situations. He despises Manmohan Tiwari, believing that Manmohan doesn't deserve a wife like Angoori. Vibhuti has tried numerous times to ruin Manmohan's reputation in front of Angoori, but these attempts have led to negative results. Although he claims to be the "Chhapra University Topper," his Uncle David Mishra revealed that he bought the degree for him during his college years. (2015–2026)

cast.name: Rohitashv Gour
cast.role: Manmohan Tiwari, a successful undergarments businessman. Often called ‘Kaccha-Baniyaan’ for selling undergarments, he is attracted to the modern and elegant Anita Mishra, Vibhuti's wife. He is Ramkali's elder son, Laddu's elder brother, and Angoori's husband. He’s often depicted being short tempered and greedy, as he keeps all money to himself and refuses to give it to others. Throughout the series, it is frequently hinted, though never confirmed, that Manmohan may not be Ramkali's biological son from her husband Jummanlal Tiwari but rather from Pandit Ramphal, a priest from whom Ramkali regularly seeks remedies and spiritual advice. (2015–2026)

cast.name: Shilpa Shinde
cast.role: Angoori Tiwari. Shinde left the series after a dispute with the series' producer, Binaifer Kohli and former channel head Vikas Gupta. Later in December 2025, she returned, reprising her role as Angoori Tiwari. (2015–2016, 2025-2026) Ghunghat Wali Bhabhiji (2025–2026)

cast.name: Shubhangi Atre
cast.role: Angoori Tiwari (2016–2025) Angoori Tiwari, a traditional Indian housewife who wears a lehenga-style saree, sindoor and mangalasutra and speaks with a Bhojpuri accent. She is gullible, kind-hearted, and innocent, regarded as one of the most kindhearted women in her neighbourhood. She is Manmohan's wife, Bhoorey Lal's daughter, and Puttan's elder sister. Angoori performs various superstitious rituals, often suggested by her loving mother-in-law, Ramkali, leading to humorous outcomes. She occasionally mispronounces English words, prompting others to correct her in certain situations, to which she replies with her signature catchphrase "Sahi Pakde Hai!" (You Got It Right!).

cast.name: Saumya Tandon
cast.role: Anita "Annu" Mishra, Vibhuti's wife, a modern, elegant woman who leads grooming classes in Kanpur. She holds a black belt in Karate, which she uses for self-defense. She despises her husband's laziness and often makes him do the household chores, to fulfill her romantic fantasies, she frequently persuades Vibhuti to adopt various characters, such as a thief, robber, college stud, painter, dacoit, electrician, and cop, often leaving him frustrated. She shares a good friendship with Angoori. On 21 August 2020, Tandon revealed via her social media accounts that she has opted to not renew her contract and has quit the show. (2015–2020) Neha Pendse replaced Tandon in February 2021. Pendse quit the show a year later, in February 2022. (2021–2022) Vidisha Srivastava replaced Pendse in 2022. (2022–2026)

cast.name: Saanand Verma
cast.role: Anokhelal Saxena, commonly known as Saxena Ji. He is eccentric and mentally unstable. He often electrocutes himself and consumes bizarre or unhealthy items like lizard soup and cockroach tea, followed by his trademark exclamation, "I like it!". Saxena is depicted with various occupations, including lawyer, artist, actor, writer, tailor and singer. (2015-2026)

cast.name: Soma Rathod
cast.role: Ramkali Tiwari (Ammaji), Jummanlal's wife, Manmohan and Ladoos's mother who loves her daughter-in law, Angoori and younger son, Ladoo. Ramkali is a devoted follower of the renowned astrologer and priest, Pundit Ramphal, who suggests various rituals that she makes Angoori perform to attain health and wealth. The nature of Ramkali's relationship with Pundit Ramphal insinuates that he may be Manmohan Tiwari's biological father. (2015-2026)

cast.name: Vaibhav Mathur
cast.role: Tika Ram, an unemployed dimwit who often accompanies his friends Tillu and Malkhan. The trio lives together in a rented place. Tika frequently flirts with girls alongside Malkhan. At times, he is depicted as a diploma holder, while at other times he is shown as illiterate. One of Tika's amusing quirks is his miscommunication; he often says, "I can't toilet," when he actually means, "I can't tolerate. (2015-2026)

plotHtml:
The show is set in the fictional "Modern Colony" in Kanpur and revolves around two neighbouring couples. The husbands, Vibhuti Narayan Mishra and Manmohan Tiwari, have been married for seven years and are bored with their marriages, while being smitten with each other's wives, unbeknownst to one another.
Manmohan Tiwari is a successful undergarment businessman. Often referred to as "Kaccha Baniyaan" (a slang term for someone who sells undergarments), he spends most of his time managing his business. In contrast, his wife, Angoori Tiwari, is a simple and naïve housewife.
Their neighbour, Vibhuti Narayan Mishra, was once an unsuccessful insurance agent and is now unemployed. Often referred to as "Nalla" (a slang term for being unemployed), he spends most of his time doing household chores. In contrast, his wife, Anita Mishra, is a headstrong, intelligent, and modern woman who runs grooming classes. She is the breadwinner of the family and disapproves of her husband's unemployment and laziness.
Their houses are located opposite each other, with the Tiwaris residing in House No. 6 and the Mishras in House No. 9. The Tiwaris own their house, while the Mishras live in a rented property that belonged to Anita's uncle. Much of the plot unfolds in their respective homes, and the characters often visit a nearby tea stall, "Gupta Tea Center", where they discuss their lives and daily affairs.
As both men devise schemes to impress each other's wives—Angoori and Anita—they frequently undermine one another and create further complications for everyone involved.
tagline: The show is set in the fictional "Modern Colony" in Kanpur and revolves around two neighbouring couples.

title: Bhagyalakshmi
summary:
Bhagyalakshmi (International Title: Lady Luck) is a daily soap opera that airs  on Zee Network's Hindi entertainment channel &TV. It premiered on 2 March 2015 and ran till 1 January 2016.
A second season of the show, post a generation leap, was aired on the same channel and time slot of 8pm from 4 January 2016 and was titled Saubhagyalakshmi.
plot:
Bhoomi Agrawal is a bubbly young woman, who wants to be independent in life. She is forced to choose between her personal or professional life after marrying Anshuman Prajapati, the son of a rich traditional family. Through a twist of events, Bhoomi is assumed dead, but in fact alive, she hires a woman, Divya Nair, to take her responsibilities in Prajapati household, as she doesn't want them to know about her death. Divya and Maan pretend to the family that Divya is in fact Bhoomi as Bhoomi's death was likely to destroy the entire family. However, as Maan and Divya start falling in love though unable to forget Bhoomi, Maan accepts his feelings for Divya later they consummate their relationship. Divya's former husband Yuvraj used to abuse her, and threatens to destroy their happy family to get Divya back who has now built a relationship with Maan. Meanwhile, the real Bhoomi who is shown to be in a coma in a critical condition, and gives birth to her and Maan's daughter Muskaan but Yuvraj kills Bhoomi.
Maan and Divya continue keeping her secret from the Prajapati family. Divya becomes pregnant with Maan's child but Yuvraj returns and vows to destroy the Prajapati Family. The show ends with Yuvraj murdering all the members of the Prajapati family except Badi Maa who survived at the shootout. Badi Maa is shocked when Yuvraj exposes Divya's true identity of not being the real Bhoomi. After Yuvraj shoots Maan and Divya, Badi Maa manages to kill him. A dying Divya gives birth to a daughter. Badi Maa, despite her hate for Divya and that her past life brought a disaster for her family, decides to leave with Muskaan and her other granddaughter (Divya's daughter) who she sees as Maan's blood.

title: Begusarai
summary:
Begusarai is a soap opera that aired on &TV. The show aired from 2 March 2015 to 24 June 2016. The show was produced by Swastik Pictures. It starred Shivangi Joshi, Vishal Aditya Singh, Shweta Tiwari, and Sartaj Gill in lead roles. 
The show is set in Begusarai, Bihar which shows the story of a High Respected goon-based Thakur family in Begusarai, turns the love of family into hate and violence when their sons Priyom and Lakhan falls for their Shy neighbour servants daughter Poonam.
plot:
The intelligent Poonam Kumari dreams of higher studies. Her childhood best friend Priyom is the son of Begusarai's Bahubali Phulan Thakur, whose nephew Lakhan has loved Poonam since childhood. Phulan marries Lakhan who starts to torture Poonam. Breaking the alliance, Phulan plans a fixed wedding for Poonam and Priyom and they fall in love. Lakhan wreaks havoc on the Begusarai and Thakur families. Poonam decides to marry him, so he will leave Thakur's family alone.
Bindiya, a dancer enters Begusarai to make money by dancing in events. She wants to ruin the Thakurs as her father was the former king of Begusarai whom Phulan killed, bringing Bindiya and her mother on the road, and thus becoming the king himself. Once Lakhan and Poonam marry, he again tortures her. Poonam learns about Lakhan's love for her and how he never hurt anyone when trying to woo her; she starts to like and turns him into a soft person, and they become closer.
Priyom is constantly angered by Bindiya's antics and tries to change her. Guddi is pregnant with the child of Poonam's brother, who dies in an accident. Poonam blames Lakhan for this, and they are separated. Bindiya and Priyom fall in love; he becomes the Bahubali of Begusarai. Priyom tries to stop Mithilesh from killing a cheating business partner, but ends up being collateral and dies by his hands. Bindiya swears vengeance on Mithilesh. The entire family opposes her, except for Poonam and Lakhan. She decides to file a case against Mithilesh but loses when Badi Amma locks Poonam in the supply closet. Datta Ji leaves jail and returns to the Thakur Haveli. He strips Bindiya in front of the entire Begusarai and drowns her. Lakhan and Poonam unsuccessfully try to save her. He also tries to kill Guddi and her child, but Poonam and Lakhan save her.
Poonam and Lakhan finally reveal their mutual feelings and start a new relationship. Bindiya is revealed to be alive and returns for vengeance against the entire Thakur family for not saving her. She gives mercy to Lakhan and Poonam but tortures the rest of the family members and even kills Datta Ji. Choti Amma's granddaughter, Komal, comes to visit her while Bindiya becomes the Bahubali of Begusarai. Komal falls in love with Lakhan and financially assists Bindiya by bringing her a Sarkar business partner. Sarkar demands much from Bindiya, costing Guddi to lose her child and Lakhan and Poonam to almost divorce. The Thakur family oppose Bindiya and Komal and try to discover who Sarkar is. Sarkar is revealed to be Choti Amma, who wants revenge on the Thakur family and brought Komal to the Thakur family. In a chase between Komal and Choti Amma and Lakhan and Mithilesh, Komal's car falls off a cliff, and Choti Amma and Komal die. Bindiya is revealed to be pregnant with Priyom's child.
A couple of months later, Poonam and Mithilesh's wife, Maya, are pregnant. When the three daughters-in-law celebrate their baby shower and do puja by the river, Guddi is pulled into the water. Her cadaver is found. It is revealed that Komal is alive and killed Guddi. Komal then kidnaps Mithilesh and Poonam's father, demanding that Poonam leave Lakhan. Mithilesh and Poonam's father flee, but Poonam's father dies in the ensuing chase. Poonam decides to surrender herself for the safety of the Thakur family. Lakhan finds Poonam and Komal and shoots Komal in the chest. Poonam falls unconscious, and Lakhan takes her to the hospital. At the hospital, goons kidnap Poonam, and it is revealed that Komal was saved after she had been shot. Komal shoots Mithilesh and Lakhan, and Poonam dies during childbirth. Bindiya takes the baby and decides to raise him as her own.

articleSections.title: 20 years later
articleSections.text:
Twenty years later, Bindiya has become Ma Thakurain and cares for Mithilesh and Maya's children, Soni, Adarsh, Amar, and Samar, her and Priyom's son, Garv, and Poonam and Lakhan's son, Shakti, who resembles Lakhan. Bindiya hates women because of what Komal did to the family. The entire family is scared of her and never do anything she does not like. All of the boys are like goons and do everything for Bindiya. Everyone calls her mom, and Maya is jealous because her children do not consider her their real mother. Ananya Mishra, the daughter of Ramakant Mishra, a constable who is transferred to Begusarai, arrives. Ananya has an older good-for-nothing brother named Mayank (Mithil Jain), who chats with Soni online.
Ananya and Shakti first meet when Shakthi saves Ramakant from goons. He asks for money, but since she has none, he takes her late mother's necklace. She retrieves it and learns he fears his mother. They have funny interactions. Mayank and Soni meet secretly, but someone sees them and tells Ma Thakurain. She plans to have Soni marry within three days. When Mayank hears of this, he attempts suicide. When Ananya discovers the reason for the attempt, she decides to let Soni and Mayank meet for a final time. But Mayank cheats Ananya and flees with Soni. When the five brothers learn Ananya helped Soni escape, they kidnap her and torture them to learns where Soni and Mayank are.
When Ananya is freed, helped by police, the police arrest Ma Thakurain and the brothers seek revenge. Ma Thakurain leaves jail, and Soni and Mayank return to Badi Haveli. Ma Thakurain decides to allow Soni and Mayank's marriage, but they live in their house on Mayank's condition. She asks Shakti to make Ananya fall in love with him, and then she will marry all of her sons. Ananya falls in love with Shakti, and Bindiya has her marry all of the sons without interference. When Ananya learns the truth of her sham marriage, she seeks vengeance on the Thakur family. She refuses any relations with the brothers and learns the oldest, Adarsh, is secretly married and is about to have his child.
She gets Adarsh's wife her rights in the house, and Shakthi falls in love with Ananya. Bindiya reverts to her former self when Badi Amma tells her she acted precisely like Datta Ji. Ananya talks to Bindiya and then asks if she can leave. Shakthi asks her to stay, but she says her trust was broken, and she cannot. A few months later, Ananya is shown to be a teacher at a school, and Shakti arrives. He asks her to forgive him and marry him for real, and she finally forgives him. The show ends with Ananya forgiving Shakti.

title: Baked
summary:
Baked is an Indian comedy web series created by Pechkas Pictures and ScoopWhoop Talkies. It chronicles the misadventures of three university flatmates who start a midnight food delivery service. The series is written and produced by Vishwajoy Mukherjee and Akash Mehta and directed by Mukherjee. The show's primary cast includes Pranay Manchanda, Shantanu Anam, Manik Papneja, and Kriti Vij.
The first two seasons were shot in Hindu College and University of Delhi. It was one of the early web series in India and gained immense popularity and became one of the most-watched shows by students in India.
The third part of the series was made into a film. Principal photography began in October 2018 and was wrapped up in February 2019. However, the third part was released as a five-episode series as the third season titled Baked – The Bad Trip. It premiered on 2 May 2022 on Voot.
plot:
The first two seasons revolve around the lives of three friends and roommates—Haris (Pranay Manchanda), Oni (Shantanu Anam), and Body (Manik Papneja)—students at Delhi University who find it hard to make ends meet and start a midnight food delivery service to earn some extra money.
In the third season, Haris, Oni, and Body—now three former college friends—reunite for a road trip to the hills, each with a secret agenda. From getting lost in rural India to being mistaken for drug smugglers and getting arrested, nothing goes according to plan for the boys.

articleSections.text:
The first and second seasons were released on ScoopWhoop's website and YouTube channel. The first two episodes of the first season premiered on May 20, 2015, with the remaining five episodes released weekly. The second season premiered on December 9, 2016, with all the episodes.
The third season premiered on May 2, 2022, on Voot.
After the shutdown of Voot in August 2023, all three seasons became available for streaming on JioHotstar.

title: Byomkesh
summary: Byomkesh was a 2014 Indian Bengali crime fiction television series based on the Bengali sleuth Byomkesh Bakshi created by Sharadindu Bandyopadhyay. The series starred Gaurav Chakrabarty, Saugata Bandyopadhyay and Ridhima Ghosh as Byomkesh Bakshi, Ajit and Satyabati respectively. The series premiered on 20 November 2014 on Colors Bangla channel and is due to end on 14 November 2015. This series was re-run on 4 March 2024. The first episode was narrated by Sabyasachi Chakrabarty.

title: Bandhan – Saari Umar Humein Sang Rehna Hai
wikiTitle: Bandhan – Saari Umar Humein Sang Rehna Hai
summary: Bandhan – Saari Umar Humein Sang Rehna Hai is an Indian television drama show, which premiered on 16 September 2014 and aired on Zee TV until 17 April 2015. It replaced Ek Mutthi Aasmaan in its timeslot. The story of the film is about the bond between a little girl named Darpan, and her adopted brother, Ganesh the elephant. The show took a 10-year leap in the episode of 27 January 2015.
plot:
Darpan Karnik is a school-going aged girl who lives with her parents Mahesh and Prabha and is happy in her life. She also has an adopted brother, Ganesh, who is an elephant. Mahesh is a forest ranger and is determined to expose Vishwasrao Patil, a politician, for his illegal activities regarding elephants. Vishwasrao befriends Darpan and gets successful in getting information about Mahesh's plan to expose him. He abducts Prabha so that he can reach Mahesh. When Mahesh comes to save Prabha, Vishwasrao kills both of them and Mahesh is termed a thief by everyone. Vishwasrao takes Darpan to his house as he is still doubtful about Mahesh's death as his dead body wasn't found, and hopes that Mahesh can return for Darpan. In his house, there is his arrogant and egoistic wife named Meethi, his younger brother Suryapratap and his wife Sheetal and their children Sanju and Pinky, his younger brother Devpratap who is stammer and is about to marry Payal, his evil sister Shakuntala and an orphan kid named Raghavendra "Raghav".
Darpan is harassed regularly in that house by Meethi, Shakuntala and Devpratap. Devpratap attempts to molest a dancer named Kajri and Vishwasrao gets him married to her as punishment. Darpan also gets bullied by Raghav, Sanju and Pinky who also turn to be her bullies at school, but later Raghav reforms and befriends Darpan. Narayani Deshpande, an animal activist, saves Ganesh and unites Darpan with him. Later, it's revealed that Narayani is actually Vishwasrao's ex-girlfriend and Raghav is their biological son. Darpan soon learns that Vishwasrao had murdered her parents and determines to seek justice for them. Vishwasrao kills Narayani when she threatens to expose him while Darpan is blamed for the murder.
Kajri encourages Darpan to escape to save her from Vishwasrao's family who attempt to harm her. She escapes but falls into a sea and is presumed dead by the family. A childless couple finds Darpan and decides to raise her as their own daughter.
10 years later
Darpan has lost her memory and has grown into a lovely young woman. She is now known as Riya Khare. She meets Ganesh but fails to recognize him. She is arranged to marry Raghav who gets to know that Riya is Darpan. Darpan regains her memory and gets determined to punish Vishwasrao who murdered her biological parents. Raghav promises to make Darpan's life hell and torture her to death as he still believes that she killed Narayani. Darpan gets to know that Vishwasrao has killed Kajri and kidnapped Devpratap and Kajri's daughter. Soon, Darpan reveals her true identity, proves her innocence and exposes Vishwasrao in front of the Patil family. Darpan saves Kajri and Devpratap's daughter and brings her back. A fire breaks out in the house and everyone manage to leave, except Vishwasrao and Darpan. Raghav saves Darpan and leaves Vishwasrao to die. Darpan and Raghav start living happily with the Patil family and Ganesh, and the show ends on a happy note.

articleSections.title: Abuse of elephant
articleSections.text:
The makers of the show have been facing opposition from Animal Welfare Board of India (AWBI) and animal rights organization, PETA India for abusing baby elephant, Suman, who is a central character in the show. According to media reports, AWBI and PETA conducted an inspection and found out that elephant, Suman, was treated poorly on the sets. Suman had developed skin infection and exhibited abnormal behaviour. Handlers also reportedly threatened her with sticks in front of the inspectors and she was not provided with adequate access to drinking water, appropriate housing or necessary veterinary care. Suman, the baby elephant, is three years old and separating her from her mother has been called 'unethical' by PETA.
According to a news published in Times of India, AWBI has canceled the permission to use the animal after which makers of the show went to Bombay High Court. The case is under sub-judice.

title: Badi Doooor Se Aaye Hai
summary: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hain (transl. We've Come From Far Away) is an Indian television sitcom created by Vipul D. Shah and Jamnadas Majethia or Aatish Kapadia that aired on Sony SAB from 9 June 2014 to 14 November 2016.
plot:
Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai is a story of an extraterrestrial family who come to Earth with an aim to find their eldest and lost son, named 2015, whom they have been searching for on many planets.
The spaceship of Alien family crashes in a jungle as they land on Earth. After landing, they are shocked to see human civilization and its form. Later they realize that if they move around in their alien form they will be treated differently or may be taken captive for research and analysis, thus risking their existence. But since they get very strong clues of their lost son 2015 to be living on Earth, they forcefully take the form of humans and secure their lives. The alien family consists of Vasant, his wife Varsha, his younger brother Sharad and two sons, Hemant and Shishir. The residents of Sunshine Colony are unique and funny in their own different ways. At first, they found it difficult to accept the Ghotalas because they are weird but slowly they treated them as their own seeing their kind and selfless nature. Sharad falls for Anna. Ghotala's tries to search for 2015 but fail various time. Due to their weirdness towards human customs, they get targeted by Sunshine Colony members. Later, the family learn that God has created their destiny for various special mission more than their hunt for their son 2015.
Firstly, they save Liza and Ronnie's daughter's life with Hemant's newly discovered superpower of healing. They later save Shishir's real human form from Bureau of Alien Investigation and Research (BAIR) who learns about Ghotala's real alien form but mistake them the real human form. Later, BAIR agents, Pritesh, and the scientist Rajender create hurdles and the alien family almost escapes from revealing their true form. Later, Lord asks the family to visit Runnotsav of Kutch where they rescue Murlidhar Ojha's long lost son Manav Ojha who was presumed to be dead. Manav now helps Ghotala whenever Sunshine colony members blame them for various situations. When Manav reveals his feelings for Anna, this starts a love triangle between Sharad, Anna and Manav.
During their stay on Earth, Dada 420 as Bharavi's grandfather's doppelgänger, Dadi 90 as Bharavi's grandmother's doppelgänger, Nani 555 as Urvashi Dholakia's doppelgänger, their daughter 333 visit the family on Hemant's invitation which also creates problems for the family.
On a trip, Pritesh fake's his illness and Ghotala's in an attempt to save his life, expose their superpowers. Due to this, the colony hates the family. Pritesh has a change of heart and convinces the colony to save Ghotala family for good.
Through much trouble the Ghotala family finds out their son 2015 has been held captive at an evil Alien's (1313) chamber, because he wanted him to repair Weather Controlling Machine, which is capable of destroying the Earth. Ghotala family defeats 1313 and got back their son and named him Samar. Now the Ghotalas decides to leave for their planet. As they are midway, they got the news of 2015's wife and son, on Earth. Due to this the Ghotala family crash-land on Earth one more time.
When Ghotalas meet Daulatram's (Samar's Father-in-law) he falls in love with Varsha at first sight and Varsha is smitten by him but he starts suspecting them. Anna and Sharad finally get married. Ghotala's now tires to convince Daulatram for the sake of Sonachandi and Maakhan. Sunshine colony members help the family in the process.After a series of events Sonachandi announces that she and 2015 are expecting another child. Vasant accidentally showcases his superpowers and Daulatram finds out that the Ghotala's are aliens. Afraid that Daulatram will expose their secret to the BAIR, Ghotalas decide to leave Earth immediately and move to their home planet, along with Daulatram's family. After some time they realize that they forgot Shishir and Maakhan at the Earth itself. Thus they decide to return to Earth, and crash lands on Earth for the third time. In the last scene of the show, Maakhan is shown thinking that now since the Ghotalas have been exposed to Daulatram, it would be more interesting to watch the Vasant-Daulatram clash.

episodesList.title: Aliens Laal Dravya
episodesList.summary: The residents of Sunshine colony wake up to a huge explosion in the middle of the night and the entire colony assembles downstairs out of curiosity and discuss their theories, Meanwhile, the real reason behind the explosion seems to be the crash landing of an alien space ship, where an alien family comes out of the ship, dazed and confused. They seems eons ahead of us in terms of technology and quickly adapt to human ways. How and why did they get here? Let's go on a journey with our visitors.

episodesList.title: 426 Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: The residents of the sunshine colony fail to understand the reason behind the explosion. They reach the location but see no sign of an explosion. But in this mix-up; they end up taking one of the alien family members with them. This creates some hilarious scannarios. Watch as humans and aliens interact with each other for the very first time. Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Rajinder's Radar
episodesList.summary: Rajindar, who is a scientist, detects the entry of a spaceship on his radar. He relays this information to his seniors, but nobody trusts him. So he sets out on the search for the Spaceship himself. The alien family, on the other hand, reaches Sunshine colony to look for their family member. This leads to some interrogation, which makes the alien family uncomfortable and they ask if accommodation was possible in Sunshine colony. Will they be the newest residents?

episodesList.title: Alien Family In Search Of a House
episodesList.summary: The detector blinks when they enter Sunshine colony but the stops shortly after which is disappoints the entire family. However, the family meets an estate agent and try their best to look like humans, they all dress up like they're from different parts of the country which confuses the Estate agent and he asks them their family name. The family comes up with 'Ghotala'. Watch as the newest residents try to get themselves a place in the society.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Move In
episodesList.summary: The Estate agent shows a house to Ghotala family in Sunshine colony but something there upsets Ronny. The family stands next to the pool and Vasant thinks it would be appropriate to drink water from the swimming pool. The whole family follows his actions and starts drinking from the pool, this surprises the other residents. Watch as Ghotala family adapts to this hole in ground with water in it. Apparently humans did something called 'Swimming' here.

episodesList.title: Rajinder Radars New Discovery
episodesList.summary: Ghotala family gets saved by life guards. The residents of the colony are impressed at the family's bravery and decide to give permission to stay there in the colony. Ghotala family however catches flu and Ojha advises them to go to the doctor. The family agrees but have no clue what or who a doctor is. Meanwhile, Rajinder experiments with the red liquid on a mouse and the mouse becomes a human being.

episodesList.title: Chase Between Thief and Vasant Ghotala
episodesList.summary: Ghotala family returns from the doctor after their treatment. While on the way to home they see a thief snatching a bag away from an old man. Vasant uses his supernatural powers and catches the thief. They return the old man's bag and in return the old man provides them with the address of a man who forges documents required to get a house. Watch as the family slowly inches towards complete assimilation.

episodesList.title: Vasant Immensely Misses His Son
episodesList.summary: With no knowledge about what food is The Ghotala family can only guess what food could do to humans. On the second morning their energy reduces abnd they look to the sun for a refill. Mitesh and Pritesh who are are keeping eye on them, see this and get curious. Sharad and Vasant go to agent's office with their documents to finalize the house. Meanwhile, Varsha who is trying her best to seem normal offers dinner but fails to understand the chronology. Watch their struggles on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Pritesh and Miteshs Secret Research
episodesList.summary: Rajinder catches cockroach man and plans on doing a DNA test. Meanwhile, as Vasant is trying to contact on his planet a vegetable seller interrupts him. Varsha and Vasant goes out to get some vegetables. This gives Mitesh and Pritesh the oppurtunity to enter the house and collect the proof against the Ghotala family. Watch as Mitesh and Pritesh inch closer on their doubts.

episodesList.title: Grand Welcome Of Ojha, Shah D'souza
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala family is cooking as per instructions. Howver they have no clue what to do with a pressure cooker. Shishir, seems to be the only one with some knowledge about humans. Meanwhile, the residents come to meet the Ghotala family and offer them cake. Cake, which is alien to the aliens confuses the Ghotala family as they struggle with it. Watch The family's culinary journey on earth only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Cocki In Rajinder Radars Lab
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala family invites everyone over for dinner and serves them with an array of food items which don't go well with each other. This shocks their neighbours and they leave the dinner after insulting the family. The Ghotala family struggles to understand the reasoning behind this dismissal. Just as their guests leave, the indicator blinks. Their family member must be around. Watch as the family inches closer on their lost family member.

episodesList.title: Optimus Prime In Ojha's Colony
episodesList.summary: Optimus Prime comes to Sunshine colony to meet the Ghotala family. Does this gives away their family's secret and everyone in the colony comes to know that they are aliens. Shishir, who seems to be the only sane one, is busy making samosas with the residents of Sunshine colony. How does this affect the resident's behavior towards the family? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Special Gift For Ojha, Shah & D'souza
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Sharad try bribing the Estate agent into complying. The Ghotala family visits to Ojha's house with samosa to please them where they come to know about their surprise plan for Ronnie and Lisa on their anniversary. Ghotala family doesn't really understand the concept of surprise. Here it's again Shishsir who clears the air .With the secret now as public knowledge, how do the residents behave with the Ghotala Family?

episodesList.title: Varsha's Surprise Practice Session
episodesList.summary: After learning about concept of surprise the Ghotala family decides to give the residents of Sunsine Colony a surprise party. They get information that Ojha's son Manav, 'Bhagwanko Pyara ho gaya'. Not knowing the meaning of the phrase, the family takes it in a positive manner and decide to throw a party. Watch how the Residents react to this odd party only on Sony Liv.

episodesList.title: New Drama In Ghotala House
episodesList.summary: Ronnie and Lisa are contemplating on going out for their anniversary, which doesn't fit well with the residents. They make up ridiculous excuses and fake medical emergencies to stop Ronnie and Lisa from stepping out.With practice, the Ghotala family on the other hand, is slowly getting better at this alien concept of partying. Celebrate Lisa and Ronnie's birthday only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Bhavna is Admitted to The Hospital
episodesList.summary: The entire society is dealing with fake medical emergencies and confusion, the residents of the sunshine colony struggle to cover their lies. Sharad tells Vasant that they have to somehow deceive Ronnieand Lisa. But Vasant takes it a little too literally. Vasant soon realizes the truth behind Bhavna's heart attack. Watch this hilarious episode only on Sony Liv.

episodesList.title: Ana and Sharad's Romantic Dance
episodesList.summary: With Ronnie and Lisa's surprise party failing, the society decides to make it up to them. The Ghotala family gets invited, but under one condition that they will not create any nuisance. The family gets in charge of food and clothes, but as they finish their part of the duty, the alien detector starts to blink. Vasant and family can't control their feelings. Do they find their family member? Watch now on Sony Liv.

episodesList.title: Planning Of Roni and Lisa's Party
episodesList.summary: Residents of Sunshine colony are upset with the Ghotala family. Ronnie and Lisa, discontent at not getting their clothes, make do with old ones. The party continues, but the Ghotala family comes to know about something that could ruin the party. The catering company will be unavailable to serve. Hence they start cooking to make up for the loss. Let's watch what's cooking in the colony.

episodesList.title: Roni and Lisa's Surprise Party
episodesList.summary: The colony is in a state of chaos with the preparations. With the gas getting over at Bhavna's and Ghotala family starts using extraterrestrial powers to cook, the entire family doing whatever they can to help out. As the party progresses, Ronnie and Lisa start dancing to Bollywood tunes. Watch the residents of Sunshine Colony celebrate Ronnie and Lisa's anniversary in style.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Unique Way Of Apologizing
episodesList.summary: With the party on at full blow, a Police inspector comes in party with his nephew, who happens to be Rajinder the scientist. The inspector introduces Rajinder to the residents and tells that he is researching on Aliens. How does this make the colony people feel?Meanwhile, the Ghotala family is seeing all these things with their extraterrestrial powers.

episodesList.summary: Vasant gets the mistake corrected and learns that Mr. Bansidhar Ojha is going to be congratulated by the community, Vasant mistakes Bansi for Murali and announces it to Bhavna. Ojha overhears and gets extremely excited, he throws his weight around waiting to get felicitated. How does the entire ceremony and confusion pan out? Watch now on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Ojha is Angry
episodesList.summary: At the function, Ojha realizes that the prize was for some other Ojha and he walks out. He thinks he has been pranked twice and goes in front of the temple again. How do the family members go and make peace with Ojha? Will the be able to win him back? Watch the entire episode only on Sony Liv.

episodesList.title: Makar Sankranti Celebration
episodesList.summary: Ojha finally forgives everyone and returns.He celebrates Makar Sankranti Festival with all the other residents of the Sunshine Colony. Anna comes in the night and invites the Ghotala family to play a game with the other families of the colony. Do they know this game? Or will they be confused like always? Watch the entire episode exclusively on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Get The House
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala's are playing Hide and Seek with the other society members when they purposely call them inside their row house and gives it back to them. They are very happy with their house. Meanwhile, Vasant is looking for a job for himself. Will he get one?

episodesList.title: No One Wants to Go to School
episodesList.summary: Hemant and Shishir do not go to school, Mitesh and Pritesh too want to follow the same pattern and want to study at home. Bhavna confronts the Ghotala's for the same while Mitesh tries to have Ronnie on his side and asks him to imagine if all the elders went to the same lame school that Mitesh Pritesh attend. Will Mitesh and Pritesh be excused from school?

episodesList.title: Mugging Helps No One
episodesList.summary: Ronnie imagines himself and other members of the colony attending the same school and creating havoc.  Ronnie, Ojha and Bhadresh agree to what Pritesh says that mugging up helps no one to achieve a bright future. Pritesh sees no hope in Ronnie hence he thinks of some other way to convince the kids to go to school. Will the kids succeed? Find out in this episode only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Children Protest
episodesList.summary: Children protest against all the elders and want to boycott the school. Bhavna blames this all on the Ghotala family and decides that Mitesh and Pritesh should no longer be in the company of Hemant and Shishir. Will Bhavna break their friendship? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Angel's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Hemant and Shishir are invited to Angel's birthday party but Mitesh and Pritesh have been ignored. Bhavna tells the kids in the colony to stay away from Shishir and Hemant as they are a bad influence on them. Shishir is disturbed with this and tells Vasant who then decides to talk to Ronnie about it. Will Hemant and Shishir go to the birthday party? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Invitation For Angel's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Bhavna and Bhairavi decide to talk to Ronnie but when they reach there, they find Ghotala's talking to Ronnie about inviting Mitesh and Pritesh to Angel's birthday party and ignoring Hemant and Shishir. Bhavna feels sorry for her deeds and apologies to Vasant? Will this bring back the kids together?

episodesList.title: Bhavna Apologizes
episodesList.summary: Bhavna apologizes to Ghotala's for what she has done and Ronnie finds a good school where all the children can go together to study. The children are happy and so are the members of the Sunshine colony. Watch this episode to know more only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: The Preparation For Interview
episodesList.summary: All the parents start preparing themselves for the interview, Anna tries to train the Ghotala's while Bhairavi gets an expensive Churan from a fake saint to gain knowledge. Bhavna gets mad at her for this and scolds her. Watch the drama unfold in this episode only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Mock Session
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's are doing a mock session for the school admission interview when Pritesh explains Vasant that Bhairavi does not have the needed grasping capacity and Vasant comes up with the idea of having a guardian couple for Mitesh and Pritesh for the interview. Ronnie on knowing about the idea laughs over the situation which Bhairvi overhears. How will Bhairavi react? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Bhavna Prepares Bhairavi
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi tries to commit suicide but is saved at the right time. Bhavna on knowing the truth is in a fit of rage. Bhavna decides that she will herself prepare Bhairavi for the interview and starts doing the same. Will Bhavna succeed in her mission of educating Bhairavi? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Vasant & Varsha Go For The Interview
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Varsha go for the interview and impress the Principal with their wit and humour. Now it's Ronnie and Lisa's turn to attend the same. Will, they also succeed like the Ghotala's? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Interviews
episodesList.summary: Ronnie makes blunders while delivering his answers in the interview session but Lisa manages to manipulate his flaws. The next is Bhairavi and Bhadresh's turn where Pritesh overhears his mother praying to god and blaming herself for being unable to be a perfect mother in spite of her trying hard. In the morning all panic as Pritesh is missing and Vasant reveals that he saw him going out of the colony gate at 11 pm in the night.

episodesList.title: Pritesh's Confession
episodesList.summary: Pritesh confesses to Vasant about him missing. Bhairavi and Bhadresh give their interview and Pritesh speaks his heart out in front of the school board and requests them to please convey to his parents that it's his disability and not his mothers that they have not been admitted to the school. The authorities are floored with Pritesh's mental level and both the kids get admission in the school on a special scholarship basis. It's a celebration for the Sunshine colony.

episodesList.title: The Unknown Car
episodesList.summary: A car comes and parks itself in front of Ojha's house in a very odd manner and all are disturbed and are eager to find who has parked the car in such a funny manner.  After looking for the driver they encounter a new neighbour in the colony who calls herself as Kumkum Balakukreti and the residents give her a nickname Kukku. Ojha, Bhadresh and Ronnie are flattered seeing her but she is flattered seeing Vasant. Watch this episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Kuku Becomes Famous
episodesList.summary: Kukku is the talk of the society and even Hemant gets infatuated towards her. Meanwhile. Varsha gets a secret message from the High command which she is not supposed to share with Vasant. When Vasant enquires about the same Varsha tells him that High command will give Vasant a superpower. What power is Vasant going to get? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Kuku Hides a Transmitter
episodesList.summary: Kuku tries to hide a transmitter at the Ghotala house but is unable to do so. Lisa shouts and is baffled as her diamond necklace is missing. Inspector Sweety Singh is called to investigate and upon seeing Kukku, he feels that he knows her.

episodesList.title: Varsha Receives a Secret Message
episodesList.summary: Sweety Singh is unable to recollect as to where has he met Kuku before. Ojha Ronnie and Bhadresh try to be extra nice to Kuku and go to her place with goodies which is not appreciated by their wives but Kuku's special attention is grabbed by Vasant and is not accepted by the 3 men. Meanwhile, Varsha gets another message from the high command.

episodesList.title: Plan to Poison Varsha's Ears
episodesList.summary: Ojha, Bhadresh and Ronnie are disturbed with Kuku's attention towards Vasant and scheme up a plan to poison Varsha's ears against Vasant and make her extra watchful over her husband. Will Varsha trust them? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Varsha Falls Into The Trap
episodesList.summary: Ronnie, Ojha and Bhadresh work on their plan and Varsha falls into their trap. Varsha starts suspecting an affair between Vasant and Kukku and also imagines both of them dancing and singing. Agitated Varsha confronts Vasant as he returns home after helping Kukku settle down at her new home. Will Vasant save himself from an angry Varsha?

episodesList.title: Kuku Visits Ojha's House
episodesList.summary: Vasant tries to justify himself but Varsha is not convinced. Meanwhile, Ojha is waiting for an explosion of anger at the Ghotala house as the plan they have schemed have worked well but Lajjo comes in and all his dreams are diffused. Kuku visits Ojha's residence and tries to hide a transmitter in the drawer when it slips from her hand. What happens next? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Kuku Goes Away
episodesList.summary: The fight between Vasant and Varsha turns ugly and becomes the talk of society. Ronnie thinks that now his line is clear with Kuku and starts imagining himself singing songs with her and Ojha and Bhadresh are also in their sweet dream with Kukku but Kukku had some other plans? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Varsha Apologizes
episodesList.summary: Ronnie takes Kukku to buy vegetables and Varsha sees this. She understands Ronnie's plans and apologizes to Vasant by singing a song. Finally, Ghotala's are again a united and a happy family. What is Kuku's next step? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ojha Sells Vegetables
episodesList.summary: Ronnie washes Kukku's sarees and Kukku's party is cancelled so she tells Ojha to sell all her vegetables. She is devising a plan with a girl named Pinky on the phone.  Meanwhile, Vasant tells this to Lajjo who is angry on Ojha. How will Lajjo react?

episodesList.title: Wives Discover The Truth
episodesList.summary: Wives of Ojha, Bhadresh and Ronnie discover the truth about their husbands and throw all of them out their house, All 3 men land up at Ghotala's where Vasant advises them to pay extra attention towards their wives but all three deny. Will they be allowed to enter their house? Watch this episode to find out only on Sony Liv App.

episodesList.title: Kuku Leaves For Delhi
episodesList.summary: Kukku leaves for Delhi with Pinky and all 3 men convince their wives singing a song. They start preparing for Valentine's day party. Meanwhile, Lisa has Kukku's diary. What is in it? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Valentines Day
episodesList.summary: Residents of the Sunshine colony are celebrating Valentine's day and Sharad accompanies Anna to youngsters Valentine bash where Anna tells Sharad to sing a song. Sharad calls for Vasant's help who is playing games at the colony party. On getting Sharad's call, Vasant immediately leaves to help Sharad but as he leaves Dolly aunty sees him disappearing in a hurricane.

episodesList.title: Anna & Sharad have a Showdown
episodesList.summary: Vasant reaches the spot and sings for Sharad. Anna finds this out and Anna and Sharad have a major showdown. Both return to their home heartbroken. Will they get back together? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Anna Returns The Ring
episodesList.summary: Anna returns the ring to Sharad that he had gifted her and also wishes to put an end to their friendship. Vasant gets a dream of a godly child who tells him that the second mission of their journey lies in Kutch. Bhavna receives a letter that her application for a stall at Rann Utsav has been approved. She gets excited and moves ahead when she slips and breaks her leg. How will Bhavna go to Kutch? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Vasant Receives His Super Power
episodesList.summary: Due to the broken leg, Bhavna is in no shape to prepare goods for her stall but Ronnie assures her that he will make fantastic objects and get a prize for her stall. Ojha, Ronnie and Bhadresh amongst themselves decide not to take Ghotalas along with them to the Rann Utsav and in the meanwhile, Vasant receives his special superpower.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's In Kutch
episodesList.summary: Aliens are determined to go to Kutch and all transform themselves into clay dolls with the help of Vasant's superpower. Shishir goes and gives the dolls to Bhadresh by telling him that it's a contribution for the stall from the Ghotala family. Bhadresh carries the dolls along with him and with others, Ghotala family also reaches to the Rann of Kutch.

episodesList.title: Bhairavi Only Couriers The List Of The Items to Ran Utsav
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh, Ronnie, Ojha and Anna discover that Bhairavi has sent only the list instead of things mentioned in the list whereas the Ghotala's take the form of humans from dolls and are about to trespass the tent city when they come across Nanjee Cheda who misunderstands them to be the singing party for the festival. How will the Ghotala's deal with it? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Idols are Missing In Ran Utsav
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh, Ronnie and Ojha encounter the Ghotala family at the cultural programme. Vasant performs and sings very well and Anna approaches Sharad and both get back on friendly terms and asks Sharad to give her the finger ring back Sharad is about to make anna wear the ring when she gets a text message. Who is the sender? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ojha's Son Manav Returns
episodesList.summary: Anna receives an SMS from some Mansoor Aved who has sent a message to Ruksana asking for help. Ghotala's prepare goods for the stall, Manav calls up Anna and tells her that his life is in danger and sends his whereabouts to her and asks her to save him. Will Anna save him? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Sharad Reveals a Shocking Truth to Ana
episodesList.summary: Anna and Sharad begin their journey towards the border to find Manav. Manav is being interrogated by the Pakistani army. Vasant realises that they had been sent to Rann of Kutch to save Manav. Ghotala's inform Ojha that his son is alive Ojha has a breakdown. Will Anna and Sharad find Manav?

episodesList.title: Search For Manav Begins
episodesList.summary: Sharad and Anna have entered the country across the border and are caught by the BFS officer of the other country. BSF officers realise that they are Indians and interrogate them. Will Anna and Sharad escape or will they be held captive?

episodesList.title: Ana Meets Manav
episodesList.summary: Anna and Sharad see Manav in the custody of neighbouring country. Anna is upset as she is not able to meet Manav. Sharad morphs himself as a neighbouring country soldier and tactfully gets Manav and Anna meet each other. Vasant and Varsha try to locate the way to go to Pakistan and learn that the only person who can help them is Gullubha. Will Gullubha help them? Find out in this episode only on Sony Liv app.

episodesList.title: Manav Salutes His Motherland
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Ronnie dance in front of Gullubha. Ojha is dressed up as Gullubha and all the colony members get into a tempo and try to trespass the border of the country and enter the neighbouring country but are halted by the BSF officer of the neighbouring country on the way. Will they escape or will they get caught?

episodesList.title: Iqbal Decides to Kill Ana, Sharad and Manav
episodesList.summary: Gullubha manages to escape from the BSF officer and on the way, he is stopped by Captain Iqbal who tells him about Anna and Manav with him. Ojha gets emotional on seeing Manav and gets caught as his beard comes off. The entire team of Sunshine Colony is caught by the Captain. What will Ojha do now?

episodesList.title: Manav Meets Ojha
episodesList.summary: Vasant fights against the captain of the neighboring country and gets them all out of the trouble. Sharad faces a tough time as he sees Manav and Anna unite in front of his eyes and he suffers a major heartbreak. Will Sharad come out of it?

episodesList.title: Manav Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Manav enters the colony and everyone welcomes him in a unique manner by celebrating all the festivals with him. Sharad is majorly depressed and Hemant has called for a spaceship as Sharad wants to go back to his planet. Vasant consoles Sharad and in the meanwhile Pritesh comes to visit the Alien family leaving all in a panic.

episodesList.title: Pritesh Becomes Prahlad
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the colony is excited as Manav is back in the colony and they are preparing to celebrate Holi with great pomp and posh. The Ghotala's are confused as they do not know what is holi and wish if Anna could come and help them but Varsha says that Anna will not come now as she is busy in her life. Who will teach the Ghotala's about Holi?

episodesList.title: Vasant Celebrates Holi In Sunshine Society
episodesList.summary: Manav and Ojha visit Ghotala's and thank them for helping Manav. Anna comes there and tells Gotala's about the festival of Holi. Everyone gathers to celebrate Holi where Manav tells Anna to speak her heart out before she gets misunderstood. Anna and Sharad are quiet when Lisa engages everyone in a game.

episodesList.title: Manav Gets Injured While Performing
episodesList.summary: Danceantakshari begins and everyone is enjoying along with their dance partners when Manav gets hurt as glass pierces through his feet. Lajjo starts blaming someone to have done this deliberately but Manav says that this has happened because of his carelessness and he asks Sharad to dance with Anna.

episodesList.title: Members Indulge In Bhaang
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh and Ronnie make the Ghotala's drink bhaang and all 4 of them get high. They start calling each other by their original names and all the colony members feel odd as they are clueless about the names with which they are referring to each other.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Show Their Superpowers
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's are high after having bhaang and Sharad morphs himself to Anna. Vasant and Sharad together go to meet all the colony members all are happy to see 2 Anna's in front of them. Shishir also faces a tough time as Pritesh reaches his home when Varsha and Hemant are high and playing with their superpowers.  Sharad morphs himself back in front of everyone and all are stunned to see Anna convert to Sharad. Will the colony members catch the Ghotalas this time?

episodesList.title: Effect Of Bhaang On Bhairavi and Bhadresh
episodesList.summary: All the colony members are back to their senses and wonder if whatever happened with them happened for real. Anna is still in shock to see a duplicate of hers standing in front of her and changing herself into Sharad. Vasant asks Sharad if he really loves Anna and tells him about an opportunity where he can showcase this.

episodesList.title: Perfect Jodi Competition In Sunshine
episodesList.summary: The posters of the best couple competition are put up in the colony and all the colony members are excited about the idea. Anjali comes and challenges the Sunshine Colony for this competition. How will the residents react?

episodesList.title: Ana, Sharad & Manav Submit Their Entry
episodesList.summary: Sharad accompanies Anna and Manav and says that he wishes to be Anna's partner in the couple competition. Together all 3 go to the administration office of the couple competition organisation and Sharad there tells Manav that it should be his name in the form with Anna's name instead of Manav. Both Anna and Manav are shocked to hear this. Has Sharad overstepped the boundary?

episodesList.title: Competition Between Manav & Sharad
episodesList.summary: Manav comes up with the idea of internal competition and competition between Sharad and Manav takes place where colony members play the role of judges and Manav takes the cake of the first round that is based on personality and then begins the second round Pehchaniye Apne Pyaar ko. Will Sharad outnumber Manav this time?

episodesList.title: Pehechano Apne Pyar Ko Round Begins
episodesList.summary: A tough competition takes place as Sharad beats Manav in the second round, Pehchaniye Apne Pyaar ko. The third round is the endurance round. Ronnie goes to collect the clothes from the laundry instead of Manav and gets hit by someone and is lying on the road unconscious. Who hit Ronnie and why?

episodesList.title: Sharad's Plan to Win Final Dance Round
episodesList.summary: Manav dances very well and Vasant apologizes to Sharad for slapping him. Lisa tries to contact Ronnie but Ronnie gives no response. There is a tie between Sharad and Manav and everyone is waiting for Ronnie to vote for them.  Ronnie returns with a broken leg and Lajjo insults the Ghotala's.

episodesList.title: Tie Between Manav & Sharad
episodesList.summary: Manav apologizes to Ghotala's as his mother behaved in a very rude manner with them. Bhadresh calls for a doctor to check Ronnie while Bhairavi gives Bhavna the vote that has been cast by Ronnie. Who will win the competition?

episodesList.title: Vasant & Varsha In Personality Round
episodesList.summary: Ronnie votes for Sharad and Vasant comes to know that Manav had advised Ronnie to vote for Sharad. Sharad, Anna and Manav opt themselves out of the competition. The doctor informs Ronnie that he is suffering from a hairline fracture. Meanwhile.the perfect couple competition begins.

episodesList.title: Roni & Lisa's Heart-stealing Dance Performance
episodesList.summary: The competition continues and Ronnie, Lisa dance on one leg giving Anjali and Rahul a tough competition. Anjali burns Vasant and Varsha's dance costumes but Anna. Manav and Sharad think of an alternative until their item begins. Will Vasant and Varsha perform?

episodesList.title: Final Winner Of Perfect Couple Competition
episodesList.summary: Sharad accidentally breaks the property that is to be used by Vasant and Varsha and Vasant then tells him to morph himself into an owl. Vasant, Varsha, Ronnie, Lisa are declared as winners of the competition while Rahul and Anjali get confiscated. Bhairavi gets fascinated by the owl and Vasant is tensed as to how will he get Sharad back. Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Vasant Gets Caught In Bhavna's House
episodesList.summary: Vasant sneaks into the Gujarati house in the night where Bhavna is sleeping while Hemant and Varsha try to keep Bhairavi and Pritesh occupied in their talks downstairs. Will Vasant get Sharad back?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Transmitter Plan
episodesList.summary: Vasant manages to flee from Bhavna's house with the help of Pritesh and gets Sharad back with the Ghotala family in the human form. The Ghotala's discover that Kukku had hidden transmitters in their house. How will they tackle this?

episodesList.title: Sharad Finds a Transmitter Under The Table
episodesList.summary: CBI officers come looking for Ojha thinking that he is an actual refugee and have now come to arrest him. Meanwhile, we see D'Souza family leaving for some wedding and Varsha sneaks into their house by shrinking in size but gets caught by Dolly.

episodesList.title: Cbi Questions Vasant, Ojha, Hemant & Sharad
episodesList.summary: Ojha is arrested by the police. Meanwhile, Lisa and Anna meet Varsha when she is quietly sneaking back from their house. Ronnie too feels that he saw Varsha inside the house and Dolly adds fuel to the fire by complaining about Varsha entering their house. Varsha shows them the transmitter and Dolly gives them the news of Ojha being arrested by the police. Ojha along with Hemant, Sharad and Vasant are taken to the police station.

episodesList.title: Vasant,ojha,hemant and Sharad are Put Into Lockup
episodesList.summary: Senior Police inspector punishes  Ojha and the Ghotala's by showing them episodes of "Bahu meri beti nahi samdhan dahej deti nahi" Varsha explains them Kuku's deeds but is unable to understand why Ojha is in the prison. Anna explains to her how big a crime it is to cross the border in the disguise of someone else. Vasant morphs himself into a tea seller and escapes from the prison and all the policemen are surprised as real Gullubha enters the police station.

episodesList.title: Ghotala Family's Search For Guluba
episodesList.summary: Vasant morphs himself as Gullubha and gets Ojha, Hemant and Sharad free from the custody of the police. Meanwhile, Varsha calls up Rasila and gets Gullubha's whereabouts. Vasant morphs himself as a senior inspector and escapes from the prison.

episodesList.title: Ojha's Gorgeous Look
episodesList.summary: Vasant, Varsha, Sharad and Hemant go to find Gullubha and instead of reaching a wedding, they end up at an obituary of a young woman. Ojha is disguised as Bhavna's mother-in-law to misguide the police but all are tensed and play hard to convince Bhairavi to believe that Ojha is actually Bhavna's mother-in-law.

episodesList.title: Dadi Saass Special Demand
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala family runs away from the obituary but gets caught by the police. Police arrest Ojha from Bhavna's house and warn the Ghotala's and Ojha that they will be presented at the fast track court and will be given the punishment. Will Ojha and the Ghotala's escape from the court?

episodesList.title: First Hearing Of Ghotalas In The Court
episodesList.summary: Ghotalas and Ojha are presented in the court where they come across a weird husband and a wife who are fighting the case along with an equally weird judge Mr Desai. Meanwhile, the colony members find out the exact location of Gullubha and go to find him to save Ojha and the Ghotala's.

episodesList.title: Captain Iqbal In Witness Box
episodesList.summary: The case in the court continues and in the meanwhile, the colony people reach the venue where the wedding is to take place but they find that the wedding is over and everyone has left.  They are about to leave the place disheartened when Bhairavi spots Gullubha. Meanwhile, in the court Nilima brings ahead Captain Iqbal as a witness to prove that Ojha is Gullubha, Ghotala's are perplexed.

episodesList.title: A Shocking Clip Of Gullubha
episodesList.summary: Manav is admitted in the hospital and all are praying for his well being. Bhadresh asks Ghotala's to donate blood for Manav and the Aliens are now in dilemma. How will the Ghotala's get out of this?

episodesList.title: Manav's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Manav is out of danger and is back home. Everything looks normal in Sunshine Colony when suddenly milk starts disappearing from their houses and they suspect a thief. Will they find the thief?

episodesList.title: Pritesh's Unique Way Of Finding The Truth About Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: Pritesh goes to ask for milk at the Ghotala house and Vasant then realizes that he has to prove that they regularly buy milk and they behave as if they buy milk regularly. They also invite Bhavna to have breakfast with them. Will this help them coverup their identity?

episodesList.title: Ghotalas New Game
episodesList.summary: Bhavna has a tough time and runs away from the Ghotala house without having breakfast. Vasant invites all the colony members for dinner at his place and distributes them a  menu card of the dishes that will be made.

episodesList.title: Vasant is Scared Of Bhadresh's Son Pritesh
episodesList.summary: Bhavna thinks of offering a helping hand to the Ghotala family and goes to their house to prepare the dinner for the party. Meanwhile, Ronnie Ojha and Bhadresh decide to confront the Ghotala's regarding the theft of milk at the Dinner party.

episodesList.title: Search For Milk Thief Begins
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's are hurt as Bhadresh alleges them as thieves for stealing milk but Bhavna shouts at them and apologizes to Vasant Ghotala for the same. Pritesh says that whoever is doing the theft is very needy and innocent. Will they find the thief?

episodesList.title: Hemant & Bhairavi's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Pritesh assigns work to all of the colony members and Manav finds out that theft is done by the poor kids of some workers working on a construction site. How will the members of the Sunshine colony react? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Manav Gets to Know About Poor Kids
episodesList.summary: The father of the kids is made aware of the truth and Sunshine colony members promise them to bring them milk and biscuits every morning. The next morning a new car arrives and all forget about their promise except the Ghotala's.

episodesList.title: Bhavna Wants to Celeberate Pritesh's Janaew Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Hemant borrows Vasant's shoes and runs like a hurricane in the colony compound and disappears. Vasant panics and goes searching for Hemant when he learns that Dolly aunty has seen a hurricane in the society.

episodesList.title: What is Thread Ceremony Jenavu?
episodesList.summary: Bhavna declares that she wants to get Pritesh's janeu ceremony done Anna goes to Ghotala house and asks the Aliens if they know what janeu ceremony is. Ghotala's are as usual left speechless and start fumbling with weird answers as they are unaware of the said ceremony.

episodesList.title: Ghotala Family Goes Shopping
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's give the shopkeepers a tough time while Bhavna also faces an obscure situation by solving the blunder with Ojha created by Bhairavi where she asked Lajjo to come and lend a helping hand in doing household chores instead of the janeu ceremony.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Confusion
episodesList.summary: Bhavna decides that Hemant will perform the ritual of Pritesh's thread ceremony as his mama instead of Bhairavi's real brother or cousin as both are unable to attend the function. How will Hemant react to this?

episodesList.title: Hemant's Training
episodesList.summary: Sharad takes the form of Pritesh and gives Hemant a practice.  Anna and Bhavna enter Ghotala house to help Hemant know the janeu ceremony only to find the Aliens in a  very confusing situation but somehow with their regular tricks they get out of it. Pritesh wants an automatic remote control car as his janeu gift and Aliens misunderstand it to be an actual automatic car and are busy to select one for Pritesh when Anna and Manav happen to visit them.

episodesList.title: Pritesh's Thread Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The janeu ceremony begins and everyone is waiting for Hemant but Hemant and Sharad are caught in the broken lift of a mall where they had gone to buy a gift for Pritesh. Vasant manages to borrow the transforming power from Sharad through telepathy and tries to convert himself to Hemant when he accidentally converts himself to Anna and real Anna comes there to ask for Hemant.

episodesList.title: Varsha's Confusion
episodesList.summary: Sharad and Hemant are out of the jammed broken lift Meanwhile, Vasant has transformed himself into Hemant and is performing the rituals of the janeu ceremony. Hemant comes to know about it and gets furious and runs towards the colony as he wants to perform the ritual himself. Sharad warns Vasant about it that actual Hemant is coming to the colony and Vasant panics.

episodesList.title: The Mysterious Box
episodesList.summary: The janeu ceremony is done with pomp and posh and all are happy. In the midnight Hemant is sneaking from the colony with a big box and does not reveal about the contents of the box to anyone. The entire colony is woken up by the watchman and Bhairavi comes and discloses their secret that she and Hemant were donating things for Nepal disaster relief group. Vasant gets orders from the high command to immediately report to their planet.

episodesList.title: Bapuji's Illness
episodesList.summary: Vasant leaves in his spaceship with a huge bang which creates a freight in the colony. Bhavna and Bhairavi get into a big tiff due to Bhairavi's absurd behaviour and Bhairavi in front of all the colony members swear that henceforth she will not make any blunders and if she does she will leave the Bhatt family forever. All are dumbfounded at her taking this step.

episodesList.title: Pritesh's Confusion
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi is proving herself in front of the colony members. Bhavan is getting irritated with her attitude and decides that she will give Bhairavi 3 tasks that she has to perform and if Bhairavi succeeds then Bhavna will become her slave. Watch this tiff between Bhavna and Bhairavi in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Challenge
episodesList.summary: The first task given to Bhairavi is to throw a party for the entire colony with Chinese cuisine.  Aliens help her and prepare chhole puri instead of Chinese food. Anna comes and informs Varsha that Bhairavi is supposed to prepare Chinese food and not Punjabi food.  Varsha panics as she does not know how to cook Chinese food.

episodesList.title: Bhairavi's Game
episodesList.summary: The dinner party at Bhairavi's house is a major success and everyone is surprised as Bhairavi had cooked a scrumptious dinner. Ojha imagines Bhavna as a slave and also talks about his wishes to get his chores done by her. Bhairavi finds a bill from a hotel in her house. Her kids wave off the fact but Bhadresh gets a doubt that there is someone who is helping Bhairavi to complete her tasks perfectly.

episodesList.title: Vasant Returns
episodesList.summary: Vasant returns from his planet with 3 gadgets, multiplier capsules, remote control and special glasses to help them identify and read the mind of the person in an instant. How will Vasant use these gadgets?

episodesList.title: The Triplets
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi gets her second challenge to make Ojha a model while Ghotala family begin their new business of Advertising cum detective agency. How far will their business go? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Advertising Firm
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's approach ad maker, Sonal Shah with the hope that she might cast Ojha in one of her ads but Sonal refuses to launch him. Ghotala's try to convince Ojha to pose for a simple banner ad but Ojha is adamant to be a model in a television ad and it needs to be fulfilled only then will Bhairavi complete her second task.

episodesList.title: The Audition
episodesList.summary: Sonal Shah visits Bhairavi and calls Ojha for a look test. Vasant and family are discussing the same when Vasant suspects Sharad who must have transformed himself into Sonal. Vasant transforms himself into Ojha and goes to Bhavna's house and meanwhile, Ojha leaves his house for the audition and both Ojha's come face to face in the colony garden.

episodesList.title: The Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: Everyone in the colony are shocked to see two Ojha stand face to face with each other. Sharad uses the new gadget of remote control and rewinds the time till Vasant transforms himself but it comes with its own repercussions.  Bhavna and Bhairavi enter and Bhairavi overhears Vasant talking about someone helping Bhairavi and Bhairavi breaks down. Ghotala's now got on the mission and find out the good soul who was helping Bhairavi to complete her tasks.

episodesList.title: The Helper
episodesList.summary: Vasant tells the society residents that the one who helped Bhairavi is none other than Bhavna aunty and then begins a machchar bhagao andolan in the colony. How will the society react to this?

episodesList.title: Ghotala's First Client
episodesList.summary: Anna takes Vasant to her friend Monika's cafe to help Ghotala's get their first client but Vasant feels giddy and falls on the ground. Anna and Monika along with Sharad take him to hospital. What happened to Vasant?

episodesList.title: Mishaps In Sunshine
episodesList.summary: Ojha is not well and is running at a high temperature. The doctor is called and the entire colony is gathered at his residence for his well being.
