Sharad informs Varsha through telepathic talk that Vasant is admitted in the hospital. Why is everyone at the Sunshine colony getting sick?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Blood Test
episodesList.summary: The doctor advises Vasant to get a blood test done but Vasant is reluctant because if his blood is kept under any test, his secret of being an Alien will be revealed. Hence Sharad and Vasant try to escape from the room and morph themselves into Dr Anatani and a teddy bear respectively.

episodesList.title: Hemant and His Clone
episodesList.summary: Hemant consumes the multiplier capsules and clones himself as two more and creates a major confusion amongst the colony members. Varsha faces a very tough time handling all of them at a single time and creates doubt in Lisa's mind. How will Varsha handle this?

episodesList.title: Vasant The Teddy Bear
episodesList.summary: Varsha and Hemant reach the hospital to get Vasant back. Sharad morphs himself as a nurse to ease their task to find Antani's cabin where Vasant who has morphed himself as a teddy bear is kept. Will they get to Vasant? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Return to Sunshine
episodesList.summary: Ronnie and Bhadresh enter Ghotala house in the night as they find something is fishy amongst the Ghotala's but are confronted by Shishir, Pritesh and Manav. Varsha and Sharad enter the colony with Vasant as a teddy bear and quietly sneak into their house.

episodesList.title: Ailing Vasant
episodesList.summary: Anna informs everyone that Vasant is on the last stage of blood cancer.  The society members go to the Ghotala house to console the ailing family. How will the residents react to this news?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Grandparents
episodesList.summary: Pritesh questions the Ghotala's about their relatives. The aliens are in a dilemma as to where to get relatives.  Hemant informs them that he has already asked Vasant's grandparents to visit them in the human form of Bhairavi's grandparent's. Aliens are all aghast on hearing this. Has Hemant invited new trouble for the Ghotala's?

episodesList.title: New Circle Of Problems
episodesList.summary: Vasant's grandparents arrive and with their arrival begins a new circle of problems. Ghotala family is caught in blunders with a blackout in the sunshine colony which makes all the colony members inquisitive to meet the grandparents of the Ghotala's and they reach Ghotala house to meet the grandparents.

episodesList.title: Source Of Light
episodesList.summary: The entire Sunshine colony is at the Ghotala house to know about the light that was coming out from their house. Dada and Dadi transform themselves into a dog and modern lady in front of colony people giving Vasant a tough time and being suspected in front of colony members.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's Facing a Tough Time
episodesList.summary: Dada and Dadi give a tough time to the Ghotala family. They are hidden by the Ghotala's so that they don't face the colony members. Hemant has invited Bhairavi in the morning with ice cream and has promised her that he will surely make him meet his grandparents. Vasant has a tough time and is irritated by Hemant.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Vasant shouts at Dadi but Bhairavi misunderstands and complains to Bhavna that Ghotala shouted at her and asks her never to visit them. Bhavna is unable to understand and wishes to find the reason that made Ghotala say so. Hence along with Ronnie and Ojha Bhavna goes to Ghotala house for confrontation.

episodesList.title: Dada Dadi At Bhairavi's House
episodesList.summary: Ronnie fights with Vasant for insulting Bhairavi but Vasant tends to insult him more on knowing that dada- dadi have vanished from their home. Bhavna too is hurt now by this behaviour of Ghotala's. Meanwhile, dada and dadi enter Bhavna's house. Will Bhavna find out?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Missing Shoe
episodesList.summary: Vasant finds out that dada and dadi have gone to the Bhatt house and he too sneaks into the house and takes them from there.  While moving out, one of his shoes slips and Bhavna finds it.  A conference takes place at Bhavna's house to find out the owner of the shoe that is found at Bhavna's house.

episodesList.title: Dada and Dadi At The Poolhouse
episodesList.summary: Vasant is irritated with dada and dadi as to why did they go to Bhavna's house. He is scared about Bhavna finding out about his missing shoe. In all this haphazard Sharad is called by Anna at the society club poolhouse. Sharad is unaware that dada and dadi have followed him.

episodesList.title: Unconscious Bhairavi
episodesList.summary: Sharad meets Anna at the pool. He tries his best to not let Anna notice them. Vasant and Varsha with the help of Shishir's vision superpower find out that dada and dadi are at the pool. Varsha gets Anna and everything seems to be calm when Bhairavi arrives at the pool and notices dada and dadi at the pool and falls unconscious.

episodesList.title: Cctv Footage
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi comes home where she tells other colony members that she saw her dada and dadi. Ronnie gets the CCTV footage of the pool but the vision is blurred. Lisa and Bhavna go to the Ghotala house to enquire about Sharad and Hemant and Sharad replaces the photos. Will the colony members find out about Bhairavi's grandparents.

episodesList.title: Bhairavi's Wish
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi tells Bhavna that she misses her dada and dadi a lot and how they have brought her up since she was six months old. Her wish is only to thank them for all they have done for her. Ghotala family have been watching all this and dada and dadi wish to fulfil Bhairavi's wish.

episodesList.title: Dadi Dadi Back to Their Planet
episodesList.summary: Dada and Dadi visit Bhairavi and she fulfils her wish of thanking them. They return to the Ghotala house and Vasant with his family bids goodbye to them with a heavy heart in a spaceship and dada dadi return to their planet.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's Out Of Sunshine
episodesList.summary: Ronnie informs all the colony members that he has driven the Ghotala's out of the colony for their weird behaviour. Lisa sends Ronnie, Ojha and Bhadresh on the lookout for Ghotala's. Will they find the Ghotala's?

episodesList.title: Ghotala's At The Bhelawala House
episodesList.summary: Manav finds out that Ghotala's have taken shelter at the Bhelwala's house and all the colony members go there to get the aliens back to the Sunshine Colony. Will Ghotala's agree to go with them? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's House Warming
episodesList.summary: The members of the colony go to the Ghotala's and apologise for their mistakes and ask them to come back to the Sunshine Colony. Bhavna and Bhairavi plan for a proper house warming to welcome the Ghotala's back to the colony. Ronnie gets a call from Bhairavi's grandmother and he is shocked to hear this. Was it really Bhairavi's dead grandmother?

episodesList.title: Multiplier Capsule
episodesList.summary: The Alien detector starts blinking and the Ghotala's get excited as its an indication that their missing son 2015 is somewhere around. They start looking for him where they come across Bhadresh, Ronnie and Manav. Sharad hides the multiplier capsule in the Bhatt house and next day goes to look for it only to realise that it is with Ojha.

episodesList.title: Bhavna and Bhairavi In a Tiff
episodesList.summary: Vasant calls Ojha to complete Pritesh's projections and Sharad leaves the Alien house and morphs himself as Ojha to collect the multiplier capsules from the Ojha house. Bhavna is busy asking all the colony members to make Bharavi understand as she has packed Bhavna's bag and is planning to send her away from their home.

episodesList.title: Angry Ronnie
episodesList.summary: Society members decide to give a party to Ojha. Ronnie and Anna go and tell this to  Ghotala's where Ronnie discovers that  Ojha has prepared a project about different culture of India and has not mentioned the Goan community. Ronnie is hurt and confronts Ojha about it and also complains to Lisa.

episodesList.title: Hindi Speaking Colony
episodesList.summary: Lisa initially tells Ronnie that it's a minor issue and he should not think much about it but Ronnie is still adamant and hence, Lisa comes up with the idea of sending Ronnie to Hindi Speaking Classes. Will Ronnie cope up with the Hindi classes?

episodesList.title: Hemant and Ronnie In The Same Boat
episodesList.summary: Lisa takes Ronnie to Hindi speaking classes and finds out that Hemant too is admitted in the same class since both of them are sailing in the same boat. Will they learn Hindi? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Elongated Varsha
episodesList.summary: The teacher has a tough time handling all the students on the first day meanwhile Bhavna, Anna and Bhairavi enter Ghotala house to collect the contribution from the Ghotala's to buy a gift for Ojha when Varsha is stuck after elongating herself and the three ladies are about to face the truth of Ghotala's being Aliens.

episodesList.title: Hemant and Ronnie's Class Test
episodesList.summary: Varsha somehow manages to get normal and the three ladies miss out on the aliens. The teacher at the Hindi classes is taking a test and both Hemant and Ronnie perform badly. Hemant scores 13 marks whereas Ronnie scores just 1. The Ghotala's are making fun of Ronnie when he comes to their house. How will Ronnie react to this?

episodesList.title: Disheartened Ronnie
episodesList.summary: Hemant scores the highest in the test with 13 marks while Ronnie gets 1. Ronnie goes and apologizes to Ojha as he feels he is unable to fulfil the challenge. Ojha immediately goes to Bhavna and asks her to encourage Ronnie to fulfil his challenge. Will Ronnie complete his challenge or will he leave it midway?

episodesList.title: Ronnie's Speech
episodesList.summary: Lisa shouts at Ronnie for acting like a loser and Ronnie is motivated to learn Hindi. He prepares a speech with Lisa's help for Ojha's party. Will Ronnie be successful this time or will he fumble as usual? Watch this episode to find out on Sony Liv App.

episodesList.title: Ojha's Goan Party
episodesList.summary: Ronnie recites an original speech at Ojha's party and impresses everyone without stopping. Ojha too gets emotional and takes Ronnie and other colony members for a surprise by taking everyone to a Goan setup party.

episodesList.title: Three Vasant
episodesList.summary: Society residents are enjoying at Ojha's Goan party. He discovers that the shiny stones that he had found is missing and decides to talk to all the other colony members about it. Meanwhile, the Ghotala's are playing dumb charades where Vasant consumes the multiplier pills and turns into 3 followed by Hemant.

episodesList.title: Missing Stones
episodesList.summary: Hemant runs out of the house where Bhairavi notices him. Vasant comes up with a reply that convinces Bhairavi for the time being. She goes home and confronts Mitesh and Pritesh about witnessing 3 Hemants. Pritesh's mind gets active on hearing this and calls out loud for Hemant. Meanwhile,  the residents suspect Ghotala's to have taken the stones from Ojha's house and start to think of a plan on how to nab them.

episodesList.title: Alert Ghotala's
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh, Bhavna and Bhairavi visit the aliens at midnight when Bhairavi unknowingly spills the beans of the missing shining stone from Ojha's house and aliens are warned that the colony members can visit them to know about shining stones. Will the Ghotala's get caught?

episodesList.title: Alien Bag Of High Command
episodesList.summary: Pritesh cracks the truth of the shining through his research and tells Mitesh that soon he will bring the truth out from Vasant's mouth. Ronnie, Bhadresh and Ojha visit the Ghotala's and start looking for the shining stones and find the alien bag of High command. How will the Ghotala's react to this?

episodesList.title: Pritesh and The Shining Stones
episodesList.summary: Hemant has secured the alien bag and he then tells Vasant that he has given the box of the multiplier to Pritesh as he felt that was a secured place. Will the Ghotala again pay for Hemant's stupidity? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Sunshine Colony Picnic
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala's get a riddle to solve from the shining stone and the Ghotala's are in a fix. Meanwhile, Bhavna feels unconscious and Lisa tells Anna that she has a soft corner for Sharad. The residents of the Sunshine colony are going for a picnic when Pritesh tells them about a surprise that he is going to give to the Ghotala's.

episodesList.title: Pritesh Meets With an Accident
episodesList.summary: Everyone is enjoying the picnic when Vasant asks Pritesh to give him the shining stones but Pritesh takes the box and starts running not aware of a truck coming from the opposite direction and Pritesh meets with a serious accident where the doctor declares that Pritesh is serious and it seems difficult to save him. Will Pritesh survive?

episodesList.title: Hemant is Serious
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala's truth is about to get revealed when Bhavna, Anna and Bhairavi force Varsha to open the bag but Vasant rewinds the time and instead of Pritesh, it is now Hemant that faces a mishap against the truck and is serious he is immediately rushed to the hospital. Will Hemant survive this mishap?

episodesList.title: Hemant's Last Few Hours
episodesList.summary: The doctor declares that Hemant has got only a few hours to survive. Everyone is in for a shock and they all pray to god for some miracle to work for Hemant. Will Hemant survive the attack with everyone's prayers?

episodesList.title: Yamraj's Entry
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala's are heartbroken and everyone is giving them strength and sympathy. Bhairavi gives Ghotala's the book of Vad Savitri and gives him the idea of talking to Yamraj for Hemant's long life. Yamraj arrives to take Hemant along with him. Will the Ghotala's convince Yamraj?

episodesList.title: Helpless Yamraj
episodesList.summary: Yam is mentally tortured by Hemant and Yam's head starts aching badly. Yam requests Vasant to stop Hemant, but even Vasant is helpless. Seeing this, Shishir reminds Vasant about the Savitri Satyavaan idea and Vasant asks everyone to be ready. There on the other side, Hemant continues to torture and irritate Yam mentally. Yam requests Vasant to suggest a way out of this predicament and how to handle Hemant. What will Vasant do now? Watch the episode to know more.

episodesList.title: Jab They Met
episodesList.summary: Mitesh Pritesh and Shishir get a project from their school to write about how their parents met each other and all the children are confused as each of them have a weird set of parents and have no clue as to how will they complete their project. Who will help the children of the Sunshine colony?

episodesList.title: Ghotala's and The Concept Of Marriage
episodesList.summary: Bhavna tells Mitesh Pritesh that she will narrate the story of Bhairavi and Bhadresh's meeting to them while Ghotala's are confused with the concept of marriage. How will Shishir get his story?

episodesList.title: Misunderstood Ghotala's
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's decide to attend a wedding that is taking place in the nearby hall to understand the concept of marriage. They are again misunderstood as a performing band but this time they are saved by Ronnie and Lisa. Will this wedding help the Ghotala's understand the concept of marriage?

episodesList.title: Wedding Photograph
episodesList.summary: Ronnie asks Ghotala's to give him their wedding photographs and Ghotala's find themselves in a trap as they do not have any wedding photographs. Hemant asks Bhairavi if she knows any wedding taking place nearby.

episodesList.title: Sunshine Colony At a Wedding
episodesList.summary: Bhavna narrates Mitesh and Pritesh the entire story of how Bhairavi and Bhadresh's marriage was fixed. Meanwhile, Vasant and Varsha get dressed as bride and bridegroom while other family members get dressed as baraati's to attend a nearby wedding. They enter the wedding hall and begin clicking pictures with the ceremony of Bidaai. Will the residents fall in trouble?

episodesList.title: The Ghotalas At The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Aliens tell Bhavna that the groom party is fraud and the wedding is halted. Bhavna questions the aliens about their presence in the wedding and aliens find themselves in a fix. They tell Bhavna that Ronnie has asked them for wedding picture and the album is spoilt. Bhairavi comes up with the idea of remarriage of Vasant and Varsha.

episodesList.title: Bhadresh Spies On The Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: The residents of the Sunshine colony begin preparataions for the wedding of Vasant and Varsha. Anna divides everyone into two teams and Sharad happens to be in her team as the bride's family. Ojha, Bhadresh and Ronnie get suspicious about the Ghotala's and place a camera in their home to so that they can keep an eye on them 24x7.

episodesList.title: Sharad Hurts Manav
episodesList.summary: The preparations for the wedding is on and it's decided that the wedding will take place in Gujrati style, Mehndi in Arabian manner, the sangeet will be Marwari while the bachelors will enjoy the Victorian atmosphere. Men are eager to know the venue of the mehndi ceremony while women bribe Hemant to know the venue of bachelors party

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ki Tyaari
episodesList.summary: The three musketeers are busy keeping an eye on the Ghotala's. They hear Vasant talking to Sharad about changing his avatar. Everyone thinks that they have hit the bullseye and barge into Ghotala house. Will the Ghotala's be caught?

episodesList.title: Pritesh Ka Request
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala's outsmart Ronnie, Bhadresh and Ojha as they already knew about the hidden camera. Hemant uses his power to make a sherwani for Vasant which will disappear after 1 hour of its making. Meanwhile, Vasant goes to the Bhatt house to ask for their opinion about his sherwani but is saved by Sharad in the nick of time.

episodesList.title: Arabian Nights
episodesList.summary: The Mehndi party begins and the Men dress up in Arabic attire and somehow manage to enter the venue The ladies are playing games but after a period of time start missing their spouses. Sharad offers his hand to Anna but Anna prefers to dance with Mitesh instead of Sharad. He is hurt which is observed by Bhairavi and Hemant.

episodesList.title: Mehandi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The men now plan to have a bachelors party and Ojha informs all the ladies that the organiser has not at all arranged for the waiters and they are now going to have a tough time at the party, Bhavna gets an idea. Will Bhavna's idea work? What is the idea? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Anna is Convinced
episodesList.summary: Anna is praying to God and asking him for help so that she can choose between Manav and Sharad and on the other end Sharad is also praying to God and asking him to make Anna fall in love with him. Meanwhile, the men are dressed in Victorian attire and begin their bachelors' party where Ronnie is dressed up as a lady and performs in front of all the other men. The ladies get an idea to be a part of the bachelor's party that the men will be a part of. What is this idea?

episodesList.title: Spaceship On Earth
episodesList.summary: As the 'all men's party' goes on, it is time for the challenge to be put up. The challenge deals with making every attempt to get Mitesh laughing. One by one, all the members including members of Ghotala family try to get Mitesh laughing but fail. Finally, Hemanth gets on the stage and Sharad is worried that he will soon reveal their hidden identity. Meanwhile, a spaceship makes its way to the earth and crashes near the neighbourhood. Who has arrived in this spaceship? Find out here.

episodesList.title: The Uninvited Guest
episodesList.summary: Varsha's mother has come down to earth from the alien planet in the disguise of Urvashi Dholakia, a tv actress. The Ghotala family is not aware of the arrival of their granny and big circle of errors begins in the colony. How will the Ghotala's save themselves?

episodesList.title: Alien On Earth
episodesList.summary: The sangeet ceremony begins and the Ghotala family are still trying to get in touch with the Alien who has arrived on earth. Meanwhile, Urvashi is finding her way to the Sunshine colony and gets in a tiff with a few goons on the street. Pritesh is informed by his scientist friend that a spaceship has landed on earth and Pritesh gets him to work for the same. Will Pritesh find out the truth of the Ghotala family?

episodesList.title: Mana'sik Taraang
episodesList.summary: Hemant reveals that it is his Nani who has come to earth. Vasant is upset with this while Varsha is extremely happy. Urvashi is showing her superpowers to humans on the street and everyone is mistaking her for actress Urvashi. Sharad contacts her and gets her home.

episodesList.title: Mother Trouble
episodesList.summary: Urvashi is giving a hard time to Vasant when Bhairavi steps in. They are trying to hide her from Bhairavi but she reveals herself and with her powers learn the Gujarati language. Meanwhile, Anna comes to talk to Manav but instead of Manav, Sharad is sleeping. The Sunshine colony witnesses 2 new guests. Who are they? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Unexpected Guests
episodesList.summary: Abhishek Bachchan and Rishi Kapoor come to the Ghotala house to use the restroom. Meanwhile, Ratna Pathak Shah reaches the Bhatt house. Urvashi puts chutney on her face thinking it's Haldi. She reaches Ronnie's house and with her powers learns his way of talking while Vasant is busy looking for her.

episodesList.title: Mother In Laws Reality
episodesList.summary: Bhavna confronts Vasant saying that she is Urvashi Dholakia but Vasant declines. As things go in progression Vasant's mother-in-law descents in the living room. Urvashi challenges Vasant that she will never let her daughter Varsha get married to Vasant again and Vasant challenges her back saying that he will mary Varsha come what may. Who will win this challenge? Urvashi or Vasant? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Vasant & Varsha's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi and Hemant are dancing on the eve of Vasant and Varsha's marriage as their dance show gets the momentum. Bhavna calls Bhairavi to enquire about the lost nose ring of Bhavna for which she asked Bhairavi to organize a search. Meanwhile, Vasant is preparing for his wedding and his neighbours are helping him in the same. Can Bhairavi find her mother-in-law's nose ring? How this wedding of Vasant and Varsha will turn out?

episodesList.title: Mystery Of Varsha's Disappearance
episodesList.summary: Vasant enquires about Varsha when the wedding ceremony is going on. Urvashi has devised a plan along with Pritesh to stop Varsha and Vasant's marriage. Lajjo comes looking for Varsha but Varsha is missing. Where is Varsha? Is this a new plan by Urvashi?

episodesList.title: Truth Behind Varsha's Disappearance
episodesList.summary: Vasant Hemant and Sharad find out that Varsha is been in the dustbin and is unable to get back to her original size due to lack of sunlight absorption. Everyone at the venue is waiting for Varsha and Vasant. Will she get back to her original form?

episodesList.title: Shaadi Ka Drama
episodesList.summary: Varsha and her mother are engaged in a fight and Varsha wants her to leave and go back home. Vasant then interferes and calms them down so that they can go back and perform the marriage rituals. Can Varsha forgive her mother? Will Vasant and Varsha finally get married?

episodesList.title: Bhairavi Ka Dukh
episodesList.summary: Urvashi goes back to her planet and Vasant and Varsha celebrate the post-wedding ceremony. Bhavna and Bhairavi get into their regular tiff where Bhavna shouts at Bhairavi and in return depressed Bhairavi takes shelter at Ghotala house.

episodesList.title: Bhavna Ka Mangalsutra
episodesList.summary: Bhavna and  Bhairavi go out for some shopping to the market. Petty thieves strike and manage to snatch Bhairavi's mangalsutra. They are distraught by the event but just then Vasant uses his supernatural powers and gets the mangalsutra back. Unfortunately for them the goons find out about his supernatural powers.

episodesList.title: Bhairavi Ka Apaharan
episodesList.summary: The goons rush back to their boss and inform him about the supernatural powers. They are convinced that Bhairavi has these powers which they can use to their own advantage and amass wealth.The boss orders his goons to kidnap Bhairavi. Bhairavi is kidnapped and she is taken to the boss's house.

episodesList.title: Ghotala Family's Secrets
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi is abducted by the goons and their boss forces Bhairavi to showcase the super power which they think she has. A baffled Bhairavi is totatlly unaware of what is being asked from her. Meanwhile,the colony members have called for police for finding out Bhairavi's whereabouts and police suspects its Ghotala's as they were very nervous during the interrogation.

episodesList.title: Ransom Accepted
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's go to Rameshbhai and deonstrate to him their superpowers. Rameshbhai tells Ghotala's that  Bhairavi would be set free if they would get him the jewels from Babulal jewellers. Ghotala's are ready to abide by the offer placed by Rameshbhai and agree to get them the booty from the jewellery shop.

episodesList.title: Transformation Troubles
episodesList.summary: A comic confusion unfolds. Sharad has transformed himself as Bhairavi and is facing a tough time as Bhadresh is in a romantic mood!  Meanwhile Bhairavi gives a tough time to Ramesh and his wife. On the other hand Vasant, Varsha and Hemant have to quickly think of an idea to save Sharad.

episodesList.title: Aliens' Ransom Plans
episodesList.summary: Aliens are now thinking and plotting of various ideas to break into  the jewellery shop. Just then Sharad returns back to their house. However, Vasant sends him back so that he can transform himself into Bhairavi and figure out a plan to avoid Bhadresh.

episodesList.title: The Robbery
episodesList.summary: In this episode Sharad comes up with an excuse to avoid Bhadresh. Meanwhile Bhairavi manages to give everybody the slip and flees from Ramesh house the next morning. In the meanwhile Vasant, Varsha and Hemant leave the colony to rob the jewellery shop.

episodesList.title: Bhairavi Returns Home
episodesList.summary: In this episode a very unfortunate coincidence happens. Ghotala's are at the jewellery shop and in a very naive manner ask for all the jewels of the shop. Meanwhie Bhadresh and Murli too reach the jewellery shop following Ghotala. At this very moment it so happens that actual robbers land up  at the jewellery shop!!

episodesList.title: Sharad Finally Gets Freedom
episodesList.summary: Bhavna is completely confused and is having a tough time in understanding what is happening at her home because of two Bhairavi's . She starts suspecting that something fishy is happening and begins asking Bhairavi a lot of questions about her activities so that she can arrive at the truth.

episodesList.title: Police Released Ghotala Family
episodesList.summary: In this episode everyone confuses the other with their activity. The police too is competely baffled. Ghotala along with Murli, Bhadresh, Ramesh, Mrudula are all summoned to the police station. Very soon Bhairavi too is called for interrogation.

episodesList.title: Hemant's Search For Baal Krishna
episodesList.summary: The police station beomes the venue of all confusion where questions, counter questions and clarifications all get muddled up. Bhairavi along with Bhavna and Ila too arrive at the Police station and after much ado Ghotala's are finally declared innocent,  They use the victory as an opportunity to celebrate a belated Rakshabandhan.

episodesList.title: Nakli Railway Station
episodesList.summary: In this episode Hemant swears that he will get the blessings of Lord BalKrishna for his sister Bhairavi as a gift of rakshabandhan. He starts implementing on it immediately and uses all the means he has at his disposal. Needless to add, he gets the Ghotala family and all the colony members in a perplexed situation.

episodesList.title: Hemant's Desire to Meet Krishna
episodesList.summary: Hemant reaches the railway station and Ghotala family too land up there looking for him A big confusion is created between Hemant and the Ghotala family. Finally the manager of the studio advises Hemant to go to Mumbai Central to catch a train for Ahmedabad.

episodesList.title: Hemant Gets Krishna's Blessings
episodesList.summary: In this episode, after a lot of confusion Hemant is united back with Ghotala family. Everybody is in a happy frame of mind. Festivities and celebrations start and all begin to observe janmashtami in the form of performance of Dashavataar of Vishnu.

episodesList.title: Murli's Birthday Gift
episodesList.summary: As the Janmashtami celebrations are on every one joins in for performing Dashavataar of Vishnu. To add fun to the proceedings, all the colony members frighten Ojha by scaring him as goons and give him a wonderful birthday surprise at midnight.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Search For Painting Shop
episodesList.summary: As Ojha's birthday celebrations are on he declares that he will give a "sone ka gift"  to the one who gifts him a wonderful thing on his birthday. Expecting a gold item, all  colony members get into the hunt for best gift for Ojha.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Gift For Murli
episodesList.summary: As everyone is busy trying to impress Ojha and try to get the best gift, the Ghotala's  somehow manage to get a wonderful painting as a birthday gift for Ojha after creating a few blunders. Ojha comically upstages everyone by announcing that he has a pillow as "sone ki gift " !!

episodesList.title: Vasant Forgets Lord Ganesha's Idol
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see a very hilarious and unique situation evolving. All the ladies of the group want to impress their husbands and go to a beauty parlour and return with new hair cuts and beauty treatments. However, their efforts go waste as it goes completely unnoticed by their husbands, especially Vasant!!

episodesList.title: Vasant Eager to Meet Barkha
episodesList.summary: Varsha, disappointed by the way her husband Vasant has behaved tells her sorrow to the women of the colony and Anna comes up with an idea. Vasant recieves a flirtatious call from an unknown lady Barkha. She desires to meet him and Vasant agrees for the same!

episodesList.title: Vasant Mistook Varsha For Barkha
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Varsha comes to meet Vasant as Barkha as all the ladies have given her a makeover. Vasant starts flirting with Barkha unknowingly and Varsha gives him back. Finally, Vasant patches up with her.

episodesList.title: Tussle For Ganesha's Idol
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see Sharad select a Ganapati idol that  Anna had liked. They are unaware of the fact that it had already been shortlisted by Vidya Mandodre. All colony members are scared of the consequences as they are fully aware that Vidya is very stubborn and will react adversely.

episodesList.title: Ganesh Murti Laane Ki Zidd
episodesList.summary: As expected, the showdown happens in this episode. Vidya gives a threatning call to the colony members. Despite attempts to reconcile, both Sharad and Vidya remain adamant that they will not change their selection. The water supply to the colony is cut and all the  members face a tough time.

episodesList.title: Vidya Tortures Sunshine Residents
episodesList.summary: In this episode too the showdown continues and in fact becomes worse. The water and even the gas supply in the colony is cut off.  All the colony members try to convince Sharad but Manav finds that whatever Sharad is standing for is right. The entire colony decides to stand by Sharad

episodesList.title: Protest Against Vidya Mandodari
episodesList.summary: In this episode the Aliens family comes to rescue and diffuse the crisis. They arrange water and food for the colony members all participate to have some fun and light a camp fire. While everyone is having dinner,  Manav comes up with an idea to give Vidya a hard time.

episodesList.title: End Of Women Protest
episodesList.summary: All the males of sunshine colony sneak into Vidya's house for a bath while the ladies  order food for entire colony and bill it on Vidya. On learning this Vidya takes a vow to not let the colony people take the Ganesh idol to their colony. The next day all are shocked to see their ouses being locked by hired goons of Vidya.

episodesList.title: Sunshine Colony Celebrates Ganesha Chaturthi
episodesList.summary: A mega showdown unfolds between a stubborn Vidya and the members of the colony. Even as she and her goons prevent the Ganesha idol being taken Vidya suffers from an asthama attack. The good samaritans of the colony take her to the doctor and save her life. Vidya realizes her folly and reaches an amicable settlement with the Sunshine Colony.

episodesList.title: Kaam Wali Bai
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh,Ronnie and Ojha feel that their life has no excitement. They come to the conclusion that the only way to add spice in their life is to take a break  from their regular boring lifestyle. They decide that fun can come back only if they manage to get back to their bachelor phase of life. They start planning it.

episodesList.title: Bhavna Left Her Home
episodesList.summary: In this episode the three musketeers - Bhadresh, Ronnie and Ojha elaborate their plans. They start convincing all the ladies of their family to switch family members to maximise the fun. The ladies too agree to the hilarious idea and the fun unfolds.

episodesList.title: Bhavna In Ghotala Residence
episodesList.summary: Bhavna gives a tough time to the Ghotala's family. Lajo meanwhile faces a tough time with Bhairavi. On the other hand the "The three musketeers" are lost in the dream world of their fantasies as they have now hired a maid for the seven days as domestic help.

episodesList.title: Housekeeping Staff Ramya
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see Bhavna making Varsha and Vasant work very hard on the daily chores. She however is all praise for Hemant for his perfect work. Hemant gets excited and eats three multiplier pills and turns himself into a nine year old.

episodesList.title: Old & Weak Ramya
episodesList.summary: In this episode we are taken through all the difficulties that the family members go through to get  Hemant back to normal which finally happens to the relief of everybody. The three musketeers too come back from their fantasy land and get rid of the  maid bringing back a sense of normalcy.

episodesList.title: Eight Avatars Of Hemant
episodesList.summary: Sharad is disturbed due to the good chemistry that develops between Manav and  Anna. He tries his level best to disturb them and also succeeds in his task. We also see that the experiment of switching families has had a adverse effect on colony members and all are sitting in the colony compound in distress.

episodesList.title: Bhadresh's Smart Plan
episodesList.summary: In this episode we finally see the realization seep in that the entire idea of switching families was a wrong one and does not lead to happiness at all. The colony members unite with their families and agree on the old  saying that "Home is where the heart is"

episodesList.title: Reunion Of Bhavna and Bhairavi
episodesList.summary: There is a suspicious creature moving about in the colony. All happen to notice the strange movements but are unable to conclude as to what exactly it is. The rumours gather speed and very soon the news spreads around that an alien has been sighted. All colony members now start to panick.

episodesList.title: Alien On Earth
episodesList.summary: The news of an Alien being sighted has spread a panick in the colony. Pritesh and his scientist friend come up with special kind of glasses which when worn can enable one to spot the Alien. Pritesh convinces the males of the colony to experiment with the glasses in the presence of Ghotala family.

episodesList.title: Alien Creates Chaos
episodesList.summary: All the males along with the kids go to Ghotala house and obviously the aliens are apprehensive that people should wear glasses in their presence. Others however are slightly surprised with their strange behaviour. Vasant is in a fix . Meanwhile we see Urvashi entering the Ghotala house but others are unaware of this.

episodesList.title: Alien Recognizing Sunglasses
episodesList.summary: There is a mix-up of glasses because of Bhairavi. Ghotala's  are now in a panic  and are sure that Bhairavi has identified Hemant as an alien after wearing the glasses. Sharad and Vasant proceed towards them when Bhavna enters the colony along Bhairavi and Hemant.

episodesList.title: Return Of 555
episodesList.summary: In this episode the women folk of the entire colony are excited and beaming with happiness at the thought of celbrating navratri. But typically the males of the colony are engrossed with the cricket matches. The women however begin their preparations in all earnestness for the navratri event.

episodesList.title: Family Navaratri Competition
episodesList.summary: The ladies cut the connection of TV of their homes to prevent the men from watching cricket. This forces Ojha,Bhadresh and Ronnie to go to Ghotala's house to watch the match. Here they find Vasant, wearing a ghaghra teaching Urvashi how to play garba. Urvashi embarasses Vasant in front of all the males of the colony.

episodesList.title: Navaratri Celebration
episodesList.summary: The barrier between cricket lovers and Garba dancers is broken when Manav declares a  prize of Rs 50,000/- for the best dancer. Ronnie, Ojha and Bhadresh  start practicing garba with the women of their family. Navratri competition takes place and all families participate in the fun and frolic.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Grumpy Mother In Law
episodesList.summary: Nani had promised that she would leave after navratri but does not do so and comes up with an excuse. This irritates others. Meanwhile, Sharad talks about his pain to Manav and Anna consoles him. This extra attention which Sharad gets disturbs Manav and he gets into a complaining mode.

episodesList.title: Vasant Gets Tortured
episodesList.summary: In this episode we find everyone giving others a bad time. Lajo is seen comparing Ojha's temper with a typical mother-in-law which hurts his ego. Nani on the other hand is giving Vasant a tough time and portrays Vasant as a culprit in front of Varsha.

episodesList.title: Bhavna's Juice Corner
episodesList.summary: All the menfolk and especially Ojha, Vasant and Bhadresh are now tired with daily nagging of women of their families. They want to emerge out of this vicious circle of allegations, counter allegations and misunderstandings. Ronnie and Lisa come up with  an idea and convince them that it is going to work.

episodesList.title: Bhadresh Employs Murli & Vasant
episodesList.summary: Murli and Vasant  decide to start a bussiness venture. They hit upon the idea of selling juice at a joggers park. Here they come accross a customer who claims to be an expert in face reading. He tells Murli that very soon he will find love in his life.

episodesList.title: Murli's Love Horoscope
episodesList.summary: Vasant, Bhadresh and Uncle Ojha visit Ronnie after a hard day's work. Ojha had been very quiet since he enters the hour. On pressurizing, Ojha finally reveals that he was told by a fortuneteller that he will find new love in his life and he is very excited about it. The rest of the family are practicing for Diwali's fashion show and are completely determined to win the event.

episodesList.title: Love At First Sight
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Ojha find out that there is a shoot set up near their juice shop for the day and are happy that the sales would be good today. Soon after, the beautiful actress, Toffee, comes to the shop for some juice and begins a series of back and forth flirting. Bhadresh tries to prove Mr. Yadav wrong, by helping him sell mattresses while using his best selling strategy.

episodesList.title: Murli's Love Story
episodesList.summary: Uncle Ojha's flirting continues with the actress, Toffee, as she calls him to have lunch with her. At the same time, Lajo sends some lunch for Murlidhar. Ojha finds out about the actress' diet and their story progresses.

episodesList.title: Oh Just Fantasy
episodesList.summary: In this episode we find Ojha fantasizing about his love life with Toffee along with Lajo and Manav. He even dreams about Lajo and Toffe both celeberating karwa chauth together. Ojha is convinced that there is a full on romance happening between him and Toffee.

episodesList.title: Nani The Prankster
episodesList.summary: In this episode Ojha's fantasies and dream world get a further boost whenToffee asks him for a night out at Panvel . Meanwhile, Nani gives Vasant a tough time by playing pranks on him. Ojha on the other hand is in his dream world and is super excited by the thought of spending a night at Panvel with Toffee.

episodesList.title: Ojha Caught
episodesList.summary: Manav is now made aware of his father's new found fantasy. He is deeply shocked to learn that his father has fallen in love at this age. He insists on hearing the same from Toffe also. Ojha asks Urvashi to inform Lajo about the same.

episodesList.title: Toffee's Story
episodesList.summary: Toffee confesses to Ojha that he resembles her late father a lot and that was the only reason why she was attracted towards him. Ojha becomes a laughing stock in front of his friends but Manav understands his fathers emotions and handles the situation very well keeping Lajo unaware of the entire incident.

episodesList.title: Bhadresh Apologizes to Bhavna
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see Manav continue to behave in a very matured way and manages to re-kindle romance amongst his parents. However, his personal love life takes an adverse turn as Anna gets upset over a minor issue and is bugged with Manav and Sharad.

episodesList.title: Planning For Liza's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Lisa and Ronnie declare that its Lisa's 40th birthday party.  Anna decides to make it a grand event. The theme of the party is traditional wear and all the guests are supposed to dress up in traditional outfits. The members of Sunshine colony begin their dress reherasal for the grand party.

episodesList.title: Alien Roop
episodesList.summary: Nani is busy asking everyone as to what she should wear for the party. All advise her to wear the traditional dress of the place she has come from. Varsha manages to get Nani home when the alien detector starts blinking. Hemant, Varsha and Nani run outside in the dark in search of their lost son much to the surprise of the colony members.

episodesList.title: A Competition
episodesList.summary: Hemant returns late night alone when all the colony members question him. The next morning Bhadresh suspects the Ghotala family and to prove their innoocence Nani performs alien tricks in front of the Sunshine colony and then covers it up by saying she was a trapeze artist in Suryanagar. The Ghotala family is hence proved innocent.

episodesList.title: Venue For Liza's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: In this episode Nani takes Anna and Sharad to an empty bungalow in the pretext of taking a look at the venue of the party. Ronnie, Lisa and all others are worried as Anna is not in the colony and cannot be traced. Sharad informs Anna that they have been deliberately locked up in the empty bungalow.

episodesList.title: Anna Stuck With Sharad
episodesList.summary: Anna is worried as its dark and she is lockd in the bunglow with Sharad. The entire colony is worried as Anna is missing and its getting dark. Sharad on the other hand recollects the tactic taught by Nani and Hemant to get closer to Anna. Vasant is tensed and asks Nani about Sharad and Anna but Nani is adamant and remains mum.

episodesList.title: Anna Impressed By Sharad
episodesList.summary: Sharad gets some eatables for Anna and hurts himself. Anna masagges his leg and falls asleep. Ronnie goes and gets Anna and Sharad back and Anna says that Sharad is a gem of a person. Nani explains Sharad that after all he is an alien and he and Anna would not be a good match. Sharad agrees and says that he will have a talk with Anna accordingly.

episodesList.title: Anna Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Ojha gets Manav's alliance for Anna but she tries to postpone things and says that she needs some time to think. Bhairavi informs about it to Sharad who understands the real reason behind it. He asks Anna to go ahead and have a happy life with Manav. He breaks up with Anna and kills the feelings he had nurtured for her.

episodesList.title: Friends Again
episodesList.summary: Manav tells Anna that she will have to change her religion if she wishes to marry him. Anna rejects his proposal at that very instant only later to learn that Manav was only trying to help Anna to get a clear vision on who she would choose as a partner him or Sharad. Meanwhile, Jacky a new tenant comes to the Colony. The alien detector app blinks brightly on his arrival but goes unnoticed by the Ghotala's.

episodesList.title: Jackie The Alien
episodesList.summary: Jacky is introduced to all the colony members by Anna and she invites him to Lisa's party. Jacky visits the Ghotala's when they are dressed in tribal clothes. Varsha develops a special liking towards him. Jacky leaves the party abruptly as he starts feeling his superpower going out of control.

episodesList.title: Suryanagar Ki Recipe
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see that because of fluctuation of power the aliens are forced to leave Lisa's birthday party abruptly. They give lame excuses for leaving so soon. This provokes Bhadresh to ponder over their behaviour which looks quite abnormal.

episodesList.title: Galat Doctor
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh, the good samaritan that he is, takes a doctor along with him to check the Ghotala's. They had all developed high fever immediately after the party which again does not seem to be a normal thing to the colony members. Nani thinks of an idea to stop being suspected.

episodesList.title: Bhuse Ki Roti
episodesList.summary: Nani and Hemant spike the drinks of colony members which makes the normal humans display super powers. Except the Ghotala's, all are now behaving in a different way and the entire situation is a bizzare as nobody has a clue as to what is the reason behind this.

episodesList.title: Formula 070
episodesList.summary: In this episode Vasant comes to know that Nani and Hemant had spiked the drinks hence this bizarre behaviour by everyone. He decides that as soon as possible he should go ahead in search of their lost son. He calls for a special time machine for this purpose.

episodesList.title: Time Machine
episodesList.summary: Pritesh suspects Hemant to have spiked the drink of the colony members. They all get together and discuss about the matter. Meanwhile the Ghotala family is about to leave in search of their son leaving Nani behind as the machine can carry only five people.

episodesList.title: Paanch Saal Pehle
episodesList.summary: A huge goof up is committed by Hemant. The Time machine, that was scheduled to leave for 2010, takes them 5200 years behind as Hemant presses the wrong buttons. To make matters even more complicated, Vasant discovers that Bhairavi has accompanied them in the time machine by mistake and panicks for the same.

episodesList.title: Time Travel
episodesList.summary: The time machine now dutifully goes back by 5200 years and the Ghotala's are transported to very strange surroundings. As they alight from time machine they discover that they have landed in Gokulnagari in the era when Lord Krishna was alive in human form.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas In Gokulnagari
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see that Lord Krishna meets the Ghotala's. He finds them pure at heart and grows fond of them. Meanwhile there is panic in the Sunshine colony as Bhairavi is missing and nobody has a clue as to why she has gone missing.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Mistaken For Demons
episodesList.summary: Vasant finally tells Lord Krishna that they are in the midst of a huge confusion and need his help urgently. Lord Krishna in return tells them that he will help them provided they agree to participate in his leela. The Ghotala's have no option but be part of the Krishna leela.

episodesList.title: Kanha's Lesson For Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: In this hilarious episode Vasant and Hemant help Krishna to steal makhan from a house. Yashoda catches them red handed and Kanha puts the entire blame on Vasant. They move from there in search of the pigment to charge the Time machine where Brahma appears!!

episodesList.title: Divine Play Of Krishna
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see Lord Krishna helping out the Ghotala's. He shows his viraat swaroop to the aliens. Finally, they find the pigment to charge the time machine. However, it starts raining heavily posing further hurdles.

episodesList.title: Time to Leave Gokulnagari
episodesList.summary: With the help of Lord Krishna they surmount all their problems. Govardhan parvat leela is performed and the Ghotala's  manage to get into the time machine. After a lot of twists and turns they return to their actual time.

episodesList.title: Reality Of Jackie
episodesList.summary: Meanwhile back in the colony everyone is now deeply worried. People in general, start suspecting Jacky to be the real culprit behind the disappearance of Bhairavi.  However, very soon the confusion is over as the aliens reach to their current time zone along with Bhairavi.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Return to 2015
episodesList.summary: All reach in their real time and not only that God, it seems, has adjusted the time zone to previous night. Oblivious of everything, all are enjoying Lisa's birthday party. Vasant expresses his gratitude to paththarwale bhagwan.

episodesList.title: Whereabouts Of 2015
episodesList.summary: In this episode finally the Ghotala's notice that the alien detector machine shines on the entry of Jacky. They are now sure that he too is an alien. On interrogating him they realise that their son was a friend of Jacky. They once again begin their search for their lost son in right earnest.

episodesList.title: Reality Of Manav
episodesList.summary: Jacky shows the pic of his friend to Ghotala family. They become emotional as they see a ray of hope of finding their lost son. They start asking more questions about him to Jacky and learn that their lost son now works as a supervisor in a sports shop.

episodesList.title: Search For Mysterious Shop Boy
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's visit the sports shop where they think they would get to know the wehereabouts of their lost son. To their disaappointment they find a female working there as the store supervisor. Vasant gets hit by a big ball and falls unconcious. Meanwhile, back in the colony a big quarrel between Bhavna and Bhairavi breaks out.

episodesList.title: Vasant In Trouble
episodesList.summary: With great difficulty Varsha and Hemant  manage to take Vasant back home. Vasant has been speaking in alien language!  Bhavna and Bhairavi continue with their quarrel with no end in sight. Bhavna thinks only Vasant has a solution to their problem.  But Varsha discovers that Vasant has lost his memory.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Memory Loss
episodesList.summary: By mistake Hemant downloads Bhojpuri language into Vasant's system.  Vasant starts speaking in Bhojpuri. Varsha tries to help Vasant to recollect everything by showcasing their super power.  Finally Varsha tries to hit him with a ball which accidently hits Bhavna and she falls unconcious.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Language Changed
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Ronnie takes Vasant with him to Bhavna's house with the intention of helping him to find back his memory. Pritesh now finds an oppurtunity in it and starts interrogating Vasant in a peculiar manner which creates a matter of worry for Varsha and Shishir.

episodesList.title: Alien or Human Being
episodesList.summary: Varsha and Shishir get Vasant back to their house and look for a solution. They decide to send Vasant back to their planet which Vasant overhears and misinteprets. Vasant and Hemant flee from their house only to find shelter with Pritesh and Padmavati in a secluded place. Pritesh calls up his scientist friend as he now thinks that he has caught the aliens red handed.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Khaas Video
episodesList.summary: Pritesh records Vasant and Hemant showcasing their super powers. Just then Bhavna Bhairavi and Anna come looking for them. Accidently the ceiling falls on Vasant and Pritesh's mobile crashes. Vasant regains his memory  in the process!!

episodesList.title: Alien Detector
episodesList.summary: Vasant has a doubt that Manav is their lost son and he takes the alien detector with him to check. He is unaware of the fact that Hemant has exchanged their working detector with Jacky's broken one. Obviously the detector does not blink. A hilarious situation develops where Vasant is forced to become tiny and hide in a fruit bowl. But matters get worse for him as Hemant puts the bowl inside a fridge.

episodesList.title: Rony's Formula 44
episodesList.summary: Varsha tries all the best medicines for Vasant to get cured but overdose of medicines creates a reaction in Vasants body and he turns 105 years old. Sweety Singh comes looking for Vasant as he has a video of Vasant stealing from an ATM machine. Pritesh smells a rat and renews his mission to reveal the secret of Ghotala's being aliens.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Involvement In Atm Robbery
episodesList.summary: Varsha complains to high command of the hapenings and he sends a formula to help Vasant get back to his normal self. Vasant's progress is slow and he turns 75 years old from 105. Meanwhile Sweety Singh comes and takes the 75 year old Vasant along with him to the police station as a proxy of Vasant. Bhavna sends Ronny, Bhadresh and Ojha to free 75 year old Vasant from the police station.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Guarantor
episodesList.summary: Ojha , Ronny and Bhadresh go to the police station to get Hiralal back. Sweety sends all of them back empty handed and Hiralal is put in the lock up. Varsha and Shishir decide to take food for him in the lock up.

episodesList.title: Third Dose
episodesList.summary: The problems with Vasant cntinue . He now turns into a small baby!! It is with great efforts that Varsha succeeds in getting Vasant back home. Unaware of the reality, the  colony members come to play with him. Sweety Singh arrives there in a very suspicious manner.

episodesList.title: Nayi Musibat
episodesList.summary: Sweety Singh shows the cctv coverage of Vasant helping the robbers to put the ATM machine in the truck . Vasant comes back to his actual form and swears never to help anyone without being asked for. The colony members start preparing for 31st party and ladies go out to buy fruits. Jacky  informs that by consuming contaminated fruits the effect of 070 vanishes and Aliens come back to their original form.

episodesList.title: Do Sir Wala Alien
episodesList.summary: Unaware of the danger,Varsha consumes fruits and is horrified to see herself convert into her original form.  The colony ladies have a glimpse of the alien and fear a lot. Pritesh informs the Ghotala's that colony ladies have seen an alien on the road.

episodesList.title: Pritesh Blackmails Vasant
episodesList.summary: Vasant panicks when he comes to know that Varsha is stranded on the road as an alien after eating the fruit. Meanwhile, Varsha takes shelter in a truck full of toys while Vasant and family leave the colony and come out in search of Varsha.

episodesList.title: Varsha's Medical Report
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see that the sighting of an alien has created a panic. As the search heats up agents enter Sunshine colony and spot alien footprints that lead towards the backyard window of the Ghotala house.

episodesList.title: Aliens Super
episodesList.summary: Agents enter the Ghoatla house and confirm that alien footprints are going upstairs. Just then Shishir comes wearing an alien costume and saves the situation. He says that he was wanting to keep it as a surprise and hence he entered the house from the backyard window. Unconvinced with the explanation Pritesh takes everybody upstairs to meet Varsha.

episodesList.title: Alien Theme Stall
episodesList.summary: All the colony members find the alien theme best for the 31st party and decide to wear Alien costumes. Vasant decides that they would keep an alien game counter in the party so Varsha could easily hide amongst the dolls. Ronnie gets some holy oil to apply on Varsha's forhead and just then both Sharad and Jacky come running downstairs to inform Vasant that Varsha's health is deteriorating.

episodesList.title: Alien Ki Saazish
episodesList.summary: In this episode Varsha is saved by Hemant as he lends her a few years from his age. Bhavna is bugged with Bhairavi and sets up a tent in the colony compound and starts living there. Meanwhile Pritesh has called for the agents again to look for hidden aliens in the Ghotala house.

episodesList.title: Manav's Changed Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Manav talks to someone in a suspicious manner and leaves the colony. Anna and Sharad follow him while Pritesh leaves smokesticks in Ghotala house but falls uncocncious inside the house. Vasant finds Pritesh and tells Jacky to convert himself into Varsha. All wonder why? But Vasant tells all to follow what he says.

episodesList.title: Pritesh's Failed Plan
episodesList.summary: Vasant gets the unconcious Pritesh out. However, once he comes to his senses he insists that there are aliens in the Ghotala house. On the other hand Manav discovers that Anna and Sharad are following him. He misguides them into an isolated jungle. Manav and Anna come across a fierce looking man there.

episodesList.title: Ana Proposes Sharad
episodesList.summary: The agents are cross checked by colony people. They want to know why they had been using Pritesh to enter the house with smoke sticks. All the members now enter Ghotala house only to find that no one is inisde. Later, Vasant shows his family members the tunnel where he has hidden Varsha .

episodesList.title: Alien Theme Party
episodesList.summary: Alien dolls are ready and Vasant is also ready to face Pritesh at the 31st event. Manav gets his uncle and aunt to the colony and all are introduced to the weird couple. Ojha declares that as there is painting work going on in his house  and he has decided to stay with his guests at Ghotala house.

episodesList.title: Manav's Friendship
episodesList.summary: The event of 31st kicks off with Ronnie, Bhairavi, Anna and Ila dancing popular tunes. Chandrabhan and Ramdulari are the judges of the competition. All colony members insist that Varsha should grace the occasion and this puts Vasant in a tough spot.

episodesList.title: Pritesh Gets a Shock
episodesList.summary: Varsha wins the competition and all return home feeling happy and relaxed.  Bhavna discovers that she has been robbed.  Meanwhile Hemant, who was practicing his super powers, has gone invisble with only his hands and face visble. He is unable to come back to his original self.  Ojha comes to Ghotala house with his guests .

episodesList.title: Jewellery Theft
episodesList.summary: A big hue and cry is made about the robbery at Bhatt's residence. Sweety Singh is called to investigate. A sequence of events lead to the discovery of the hidden tunnel and Vasant covers the invisible part of Hemants body with a blanket.

episodesList.title: Theft In Ana's House
episodesList.summary: The discovery of the tunnel surprises every one. All men enter the Ghotala house through the tunnel. Allegations are levelled against the Ghotala's who are suspected to have robbed the colony members. Sharad now counters them and levels allegations against Lisa.

episodesList.title: Truth Behind Robbery
episodesList.summary: Sharad informs everybody that Varsha's jewellery is missing which is later on found at Ronny's house. Sharad then tells them that he had given it to Lisa to get it polished. A tiff between Anna and Sharad takes place.  The next day Varsha notices that Hemant with his half invisible body is there in the balcony of Ojha.

episodesList.title: Dance Varsha Dance
episodesList.summary: Sharad and Varsha dance to divert the attaention of their guests while Vasant flees from Ojha's house covering Hemant with a table cloth which is witnessed by Ronny. Ronny informs Ojha that Vasant was at his house and Hemant was wrapped in a table cloth.

episodesList.title: Hemanth Wrapped In a Tablecloth
episodesList.summary: Ladies of the colony confront Varsha as to why she lied to Murli that Vasant had gone to the doctor along with Hemant when actually he was at the Ojha House. Sharad looses his cool and a big fight takes place between Bhavna and Ghotala's where Bhavna swears to break all her ties with the Ghotala family.

episodesList.title: Pritesh Locked Hemanth
episodesList.summary: It is time for a showdown when Pritesh takes Hemant along with him to his home. He locks Hemant in his room and dramatically asks all the men gathered in his house to see what is hidden behind the table cloth. All begin to move towards the room.

episodesList.title: Hemanth Ka Adrishya Hona
episodesList.summary: Vasant comes and forbids all from opening the room where Hemant is locked but fails in stopping them. They open the door but find no one there except the table cloth. Hemant informs his family members that he finally has learnt to become fully invisible. Manav comes and tells Vasant that he has an answer for the colony members .

episodesList.title: Tablecloth Ke Ander Ka Raaz
episodesList.summary: All the colony members are called at Vasant's house where Hemant reveals his bare body. They all get emotional as they see that Hemant has tatooed the names of the colony members all over his body and was reluctant to show them as he was nervous they might not like it. Ramdulari now tells Sharad that he shouldnt apologize to Anna instead he should ignore her.

episodesList.title: Sharad Ignores Ana
episodesList.summary: Sharad follows Ramdulari's advice and ignores Anna big time. Anna is upset about the same and talks about it to Manav and asks him to get gifts for Sharad. Anna tells Ronny about it too  and Ronny tells that friends do forgive.

episodesList.title: Sharad's Anger
episodesList.summary: Ronny explains Anna that its easy to make a friend smile and recollects how he and Bhadresh had made Ojha smile by dancing like females!  Manav tells Anna that he has plans to revive their friendship but Sharad comes there and returns all the gifts that were exchanged between him and Anna. This leaves her more disturbed.

episodesList.title: Manav and Ana's Romantic Dinner
episodesList.summary: While arranging a candle light dinner Anna realizes that she has a liking for Manav. Meanwhile Vasant starts thinking of some way out to help Anna and decides to convert himself into a beautiful girl. He asks Anna to come at the club house pool. Vasant and Sharad head towards the venue and Anna and Manav also leave for the pool.

episodesList.title: Sharad's New Girlfriend
episodesList.summary: Vasant morphs as kanishka and goes to the pool with Sharad to kindle a feeling of jealousy in Anna's heart. They are mobbed by the media as the image of the girl that Vasant has used to morph himself is actually a missing girlfriend of  a Don named Jalandhar. Jalandhar's men come and take Kanishka and Sharad with them.

episodesList.title: Vasant In Trouble
episodesList.summary: In this episode we find that Vasant as Kanishka and Sharad are now in the custody of the Don. Back home in the Sunshine colony everyone has got the news about Sharad's involvement with the girlfriend of a notorious Don. Afterall they were seen together at the swimming pool. They are all are in a dilemma as to what is actually going on?

episodesList.title: Kanishka's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Don wants to marry Kanishka but Kanishka who is actually Vasant comes up with an excuse that she is in love with Don's younger brother who is in U.S.A. To everybody's surprise the Don agrees and  announces the wedding of kanishka with his younger brother.

episodesList.title: Rescue Plan For Vasant
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see that the Don starts the preparations for Kanishka and his brother Rahul's wedding. Seeing all this Vasant is deeply worried and asks Varsha to help them get out of the sticky situation. Varsha in turn asks Manav to help them and together they plan to bail out Vasant.

episodesList.title: Ghotala Family In Don's Home
episodesList.summary: The colony members reach the Don's bungalow and present themselves as marriage co- ordinators. They even perform during the sangeet sandhya at the Don's place. Bhavna asks Vasant to run away from there and Manav gets busy in hunting for the real kanishka. He talks to someone and informs them to look for the real kanishka and not to believe in the news.

episodesList.title: Don's New Wedding Style
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Varsha get caught by the Don while they were attempting to run away from the venue in a car. Vasant converts himself into Kanishka and tells Don that she wishes to marry Varsha. The Don announces the change in the wedding plans while all colony members are aghast after hearing the new announcement.

episodesList.title: Ana's Confusion
episodesList.summary: After a lot of hilarious twists and turns finally the real Kanishka ties the knot with the Don.  Vasant is united back with his family. Anna asks for an explanation for all the confusion but Vasant tries to manipulate and somehow gets rid of Anna's confusion. Sharad patches up with Anna and a new day begins in Sunshine colony with the arrival of a salesman.

episodesList.title: Couple Game In Sunshine Colony
episodesList.summary: A salesgirl enters the colony and organises a couple game where Bhairavi wins gold. Ronny was not there at the time of the game so Lisa decides to play the game with him. Ronnie however fails to give the correct answers. Varsha too is upset with Vasant as he has failed in the 'know your wife' game.

episodesList.title: Rony's Valentines Day Memories
episodesList.summary: Vasant tries to woo Varsha by singing but Varsha is still angry. Lisa complains to Ronnie that he dosent pamper her the way he used to and makes him recollect how they had met. Both of them revive memories of the day they had met when Ronnie was going around with Nisha and it was a Valentine party at Ronny's residence.

episodesList.title: Rony and Vasant is Hurt
episodesList.summary: Ronny and Lisa remember their younger days when they used to have a lot of fun. Lisa comments on Ronny that he has grown old. Next day Vasant tells Ronnie that Varsha had commented on him about growing old. Ronnie shares his sadness with Ghotala too. Bhavna sends Bhairavi with a box of sweets for Varsha.

episodesList.title: Varsha's Challenge to Vasant
episodesList.summary: In their eagerness to look young Vasant and Varsha do a blunder.  While going to the club Vasant wears the fashy clothes of a groom while Varsha applies kajal all over her face instead of a tikka. Ojha makes both of them understand the reality. Finally Vasant puts on some decent clothes and all the men folk go to the club to enjoy.

episodesList.title: A Challenge to Rony
episodesList.summary: Ronnie gets into a tiff with two girls Sunny and Sanju at the club and they challenge Ronnie to play chess with them. Meanwhile, at Sunshine colony Ramdulari teaches all the wives on how to keep their husbands interested in them romantically. She shares her experience on how she woos Chandrabhan.

episodesList.title: Chess Competition
episodesList.summary: Ronnie looses against Sanju and Sunny and as per the bet removes all his clothes. He comes across his ex-girlfriend Nisha, who asks him to call her. Ramdulari meanwhile tells Lisa to create a fake profile on funbook and send Ronnie a friend request and see what reaction she gets.

episodesList.title: Ram Dulari's Innovative Idea
episodesList.summary: Ronnie gets a friend request from Nisha he is not aware that Lisa has sent him the request faking herself as Nisha. Ghotala's reach home and begin to learn all sorts of board games so that next time whe they visit a club they dont have to face a showdown regarding board games.

episodesList.title: Ronni's Chatting Strategy
episodesList.summary: Ronny goes to Vasant's house at midnight and chats with Lisa thinking its Nisha. Ojha also makes friendship with someone called Shakuntala. Ronny fixes up a date with Nisha for the next day at 5 pm at Lover garden restaurant. Sharad fixes up a date for Ojha with Shakuntala too at the same time and same place.

episodesList.title: Ronnie's New Affair
episodesList.summary: Sharad arranges a date for Ojha with his online friend shakuntala on the same day time and place as Ronny. Vasat explains Varsha a wrong meaning of nikal padi which is then corrected by Bhavna. Ronny is getting ready for his date and Lisa eyes him as he gets dressed.

episodesList.title: Cheating Husbands Caught
episodesList.summary: Ronny and Ojha with Bhadresh go to the venue of their date. Ronny, to his embarassment finds out that it was actually Lisa and Anna who were chatting with them. Ojha on the other hand had been chatting with an 80 year old lady. Lajo also comes to know about Ojha and his activities.

episodesList.title: Varsha's Truth
episodesList.summary: Ronny tries to woo Lisa but she is bugged and is not talking. The ladies of the colony go for shopping to surprise Varsha with a godbharayi function. Manav  advises Ghotala's to tell the truth to colony members about Varsha's fake pregnancy. The next day all the ladies begin the ceremony while Vasant and his family are in a dilemma.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Nightmare
episodesList.summary: Manav arrives at Ghotala's residence and again asks them to tell the truth to the colony members. Alien family follows his advice and tell the truth but they avoid giving them the reason as to why they had lied about Varsha's preganancy. Colony members now have a topic to ponder. Why did the Ghotala's lie?

episodesList.title: Pritesh's Brilliant Idea
episodesList.summary: Tthe colony members are discussing as to why Ghotala's must have lied to them. Pritesh tells that everyone has a problem in life which they do not like to share with others. We should simply accept this without any fuss. Pritesh further suggests that they should all take the Ghotala family out for a vacation as they seem to be stressed and unhappy.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Take On Diabetics
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see that Bhavna is diagonised with heavy diabetes. Lisa, Ramdulari and Bhavna decide to stay back in the colony for her wellbeing. Sharad meanwhile calls Anna for a candlelight dinner. He wants to revive their relationship and requests her to accept his friendship.

episodesList.title: Sharad Confessing His Love
episodesList.summary: Sharad and Anna have a romantic candle light dinner and Manav sees that. The next day Anna tries to talk to Manav but he avoids her. Meanwhile, everybody gets geared up for the holidays and enter the flight. The Ghotala's  make a blunder and Vasant has doubts about Pritesh's attitude.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Journey On a Flight
episodesList.summary: All are getting settled in the flight. Ramdulari tells Lisa and Bhavna that she had dreamt a very scary dream and she pleads them to call all the colony members back as she feels that a mishap awaits for them ahead. Manav notices two suspicious passengers and feels that something is out of place.

episodesList.title: Plane Hijack
episodesList.summary: Ramdulari's apprehensions turn out to be true as the two men hijack the flight. As the news breaks out all the colony members are in distress. In fact it is learnt that one of the hijackers has, in a scuffle, injured the co-pilot and made him unconcious.

episodesList.title: Emergency Landing
episodesList.summary: Manav rises to the ocassion and uses his skills to overpower the hi-jackers. However the  aircraft is forced to make an emergency landing on an isolated island. Pritesh becomes seriously ill and to save his life the Ghotala family reveals their identity to the members of Sunshine colony. Vasant declares that he and his family are Aliens!

episodesList.title: The Superpowers Of Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: All the colony members are shocked to hear the truth about Ghotala's. It's very hard for all to digest the fact that they have been living with an alien family all along in the colony. After a lot of arguments the colony members decide to go back home. The Ghotala family returns home alone.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's Decision
episodesList.summary: Bhavna is furious on hearing the truth. Every house in the Sunshine colony is discussing about Ghotala family and everyone is of the opinion that Ghotala family should leave the colony. Manav tries to convince them but its all in vain. Ghotala family start packing.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's Humiliated
episodesList.summary: All the colony members come to the Ghotala house and humiliate them. When they return back to their homes Pritesh feels some remorse. Bhavna too gives a thought to what Pritesh has said. Ghotala's are recollecting the good times they had in the Sunshine colony.

episodesList.title: Ghotala's Bid Farewell
episodesList.summary: Ghotala family visits every family of Sunshine colony to say final goodbye. They are ill treated by all of them once again. It is only Pritesh who apologizes to them for his rude behaviour. Meanwhile, Bhavna finds out that Bhairavi has shifted their God from the temple in their house.

episodesList.title: Pritesh Attempts Suicide
episodesList.summary: Ghotala's are about to leave when Pritesh announces that he will commit suicide if Ghotala family leave, Bhavna feels guilty for having being rude towards Ghotala family after learning the truth that they have come on earth in search of their missing son.. in short there is a change of hearts and Ghotala's are once again welcomed.

episodesList.title: Alien vs Human
episodesList.summary: In this episode we see the Ghotala's entering  their home again after an emotional reunion with all the colony members. They thank pattharwale bhagwan and Manav for convincing the colony people to accept them. Manav meanwhile takes Sharad to Anna to get both of them on talking terms again.

episodesList.title: Love Between Alien and Human
episodesList.summary: A dilemma begins in Anna's heart. Though she has developed a soft corner for Sharad, Manav too is in the fray making it a classic love triangle. Meanwhile at theGhotala house all colony memebers meet  and tell them that now as they have accepted Aliens living in their neighbourhood they too should share their super powers with the colony members!!

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Super Powers
episodesList.summary: Vasant, Varsha, Hemant and Shishir share their super powers with the colony menmbers and a laugh riot is created as all of them start trying the superpowers. Vasant thinks of reading the colony members mind to confirm if they have accepted the aliens whole heartedly or not.

episodesList.title: Padosi Dharam
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh schemes a plan to present Ojha as a mind reader antaryami baba who will read peoples mind and tell them what they are thinking without them speaking about it. Ojha and Chandrabhan too think that it's a fantastic idea and easiest way to mint money. Vasant is confused as he thinks using the super power to earn money is wrong.

episodesList.title: Satsang Of Lalan Baba
episodesList.summary: Bhadresh Chandrabhan and Ojha get on working with their idea and held a large gathering where Ojha is introduced as Antaryami baba. But Ojha is unable to read anyones mind as Sharad had locked Ojha's super power after hypnotizing him. A chaos is created at the Antaryami baba's gathering.

episodesList.title: Fake Lallan Baba Behind Bars
episodesList.summary: Confusion reins supreme as Bhadresh tries to handle the situation at Antaryami baba's gathering. Vasant gets a yes man who says yes to all that Ojha says. Sweety Singh comes there and arrests Vasant for playing a fraud as Ojha, Chandrabhan and Bhadresh flee from the place.

episodesList.title: Returning Superpowers to Ghotala
episodesList.summary: Ojha uses his super power of reading minds and gets Vasant out of the police station. In the evening as they sit and read Rambha's mind they realise with horror that she is planning to kill her aunt. Vasant, just to confirm, goes to meet her and Rambha opens the door carrying a sharp huge knife

episodesList.title: Rambha's Murderous Plan
episodesList.summary: Colony members are now convinced that Rambha is about to kill her aunt. They approach Sweety Singh and request him to save Rambha's aunt. There is a huge anti-climax as they learn the truth that Rambha was planning to kill all the mates of her aunt in the game of chess. A big fiasco is created and Vasant finds himself again behind the bars.

episodesList.title: Hemanth Advertising His Superpowers
episodesList.summary: Bhavna and Bhairavi get into a  huge tiff and are seen shouting at each other. Hemant gives Bhairavi the multiplier capsule and Bhairavi gets cloned into three. Bhairavi meets Chandrabhan and a big chaos is created but Anna and Ronnie somehow try to manage the situation but are not able to convince Rastogi.

episodesList.title: Ek Se Bhale Teen
episodesList.summary: Hemant and Bhairavi convince Manav and Chandrabhan also to have the multiplier capsule and both get cloned into 2 others of themselves. A major commotion erupts. Rastogi and Vasant can think of no other way out except to rewind the time. Vasant and Sharad enter the  house after the rewind session only to realise that time has gone 3 days back.

episodesList.title: Time Rewinding Machine
episodesList.summary: Sharad rewinds the time but all go 3 days backwards as the rewind machine is faulty.Manav also gets cloned into 3 . One of the clone tells Lajo that Manav is not her son. Even after the rewind session Lajo remembers everything that has happened and tells Ojha about it. Ojha confronts Manav about it.

episodesList.title: Bhavna Criticises Ghotala Family's Party
episodesList.summary: In this episode Ojha challenges Vasant to arrange for a dinner party for the entire Sunshine colony. Bhavna takes Varsha along to teach her some manners and be more humans. Ghotala boys are now in a dilemma as they are left alone to prepare for the dinner party with Punjabi cuisine.

episodesList.title: Chakori Teaching Ghotala Family About Punjabi Foods
episodesList.summary: The hilarious mix up continues in this episode. Ghotala men make blunders and to add to their misery Bhairavi teaches them different styles of Punjabi dances instead of food items.
