Ghotala's try to shop for vegetables but drive the sabjiwali crazy. Bhairavi tells Hemant that Punjabi cusisne should have maa ki daal leading to more confusion!

episodesList.title: New Guest In Ghotala Family
episodesList.summary: Hemant calls his aunt from their planet as he has misunderstood the concept of maa ki daal. Bhavna takes aunt to her house along with Varsha. The Ghotala menfolk go to masala shop for shopping of ingredients for the party where again they drive the masala shop man crazy due to their absurdity.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: In this episode, Ghotala men are busy preparing for the dinner party when Manav informs them that Varsha is admitted in the hospital. Ghotala men rush to the hospital and get a pleasant surprise of Vasant's birthday bash planned by Manav. Chachi is sent back and Vasant and Varsha patch up.

episodesList.title: Bhasant Gets Kicked Out
episodesList.summary: Varsha gets bugged with Vasant due to some stupidity of him and Vasant is now in dilemma on how to win her back. Chandrabhan gives him an idea to woo Varsha with a song. Vasant now starts hunting for some nice lines and wins over Varsha. Bhairavi seeds in the idea of creating a world record by writing maximum number of original songs in Chandrabhan's mind.

episodesList.title: Chandrabhan Ka Mushayra
episodesList.summary: Chandrabhan begins with his mission to create a world record and drives all the colony members crazy by reciting his ming boggling verses. They hold Vasant responsibe for their plight as he had given the crazy idea. Sharad and Hemant manage to leave Chandrabhan and Ramdulari deep into the forest. Vasant informs the colony members that they no longer will be pestered  as he has put them at their right place.

episodesList.title: Chandrabhan & Ram Dulari Punished
episodesList.summary: Sharad and Hemant take Ramdulari and Chandrabhan deep into a dense forest and run away, abandonding them over there all by themselves. TO make things worse, while leaving, both Hemant and Sharad erase each others' memories. Ramdulari and Chandrabhan are unable to find their way back to the city and realise that the forest they have been abandoned in is filled to the brim with dangerous animals. Will this be it for them, or will they be able to find their way back, by some miracle of god? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Search Begins For Chandrabhan
episodesList.summary: All the colony members try very hard to help Sharad regain his memory, but fail to do so. Meanwhile, back in the forest, Ramdulari and Chandrabhan find a hut and enter it for shelter, unaware that there is a skeleton inside it. Meanwhile, Manav helps the aliens recollect their memory, and find out that Sharad and Hemant left the colony with the two missing people Manav in a private taxi. Will this clue be enough to help them find the two missing members? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Suraag Ki Talaash
episodesList.summary: Sharad recollects that the name of the dirver of the private taxi they left in was similar to the name of a Rajesh Khanna movie. So, all of Sunshine Colony now gets to work hunting for the names of every film Rajesh Khanna starred in, that can be the name of a sardarji taxi driver. Will they be succesful in this pursuit and find their missing friends? Or will they have to search harder still? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Missing Kavi
episodesList.summary: Finally, Ramdulari and Chandrabhan are found by the residents of the Sunshine Colony and all seems to end well. But in the night, Varsha goes missing. Meanwhile, Anna, Sharad, and Hemant begin to have some doubts about Manav, begining to consider the possibility that he may also be an alien. Could he really be one? And what of Varsha- what happened to her, and will they find her? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Missing Varsha
episodesList.summary: After having disappeared, Varsha is found sleeping, quite peculiarly, on a book. The next day, a 5 day event begins at the Sunshine Colony where the residents must enact a scene of the Mahabharata as a part of a festival. As usual, the aliens misunderstand what needs to be done, unaware of the concept of the Mahabharata- and end up prepearing to perform a scene from the movie 'Pandu Hawaldar' instead. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Draupadi Ka Role
episodesList.summary: All the residents of the Sunshine Colony begin preparing for their performances. But when the residential colony members realise that the Ghotalas' performane is not a scene from Mahabharata, but from the movie 'Pandu Hawaldar', all hell breaks loose. Manav is still happy that the family made an attempt. But how do the others react? Do they get offended, or forgive the family for yet another misunderstanding? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Role Selection
episodesList.summary: Ojha and Vasant both are eager to perform the role of Draupadi. To solve this problem, Manav comes up with the idea to tell both of them to disguise themselves in front of the colony members to test their acting abilities. Ojha comes dressed as a sabjiwala. Meanwhile, Vasant comes up with the idea to disguise himself as a beggar. Who will win this challenge and be known as the superior actor? Will Vasant be succesful in his pursuit of the role of Draupadi?

episodesList.title: Draupadi is Missing
episodesList.summary: Several residents of the Sunshine Colony perform the 'Draupadi Vastra Haran' scene from the Mahabharata in their own ways in front of the other colony members. But as usual, things go wrong, and the performance is ruined by mistakes and several things going-most notably when the actor playing Draupadi goes missing. Will the audience still be entertained despite all the mistakes? And will they find Draupadi? Or will this performance go down as a failure? Watch this episode to find out now?

episodesList.title: Cancellation Of House Agreement
episodesList.summary: Vasant and the rest of the family receive a legal notice from their landlord. To their horror, the notice informs them that they will soon be evicted after failing to pay the rent for their house for 3 entire months. Vasant rushes to find the money worth the 3 months of unpaid rent in cash from somewhere. Will he be able to save the day? Or will mistakes once again get in the way, and this time lead to the family losing their home?

episodesList.title: Missing Vasant
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the colony is very worried, because Vasant is yet to return home after leaving to find the rent money. It is now late into the night, and they are yet to see or even hear from Vasant? What could have happened? Did something go wrong, and did the usual blunders and mishappenings land him in a sticky situation? Where is Vasant? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Missing Vasant
episodesList.summary: Ronnie arrives at the colony and informs everyone that the money has been paid to the landlord, but that he too has not seen Vasant. Meanwhile, Manav informs everyone that BAIR agents have caught an alien at Borivali. He and Varsha head to the BAIR bureau to confirm whether the caught alien is Vasant or not. Is this alien Vasant? And if it is not, who is this other alien? And will the family finally find Vasant, or is he still lost? Watch this espidoe tot find out now.

episodesList.title: Varsha In Bair Office
episodesList.summary: Varsha is glad to learn that the alien caught by the BAIR is not Vasant. But she also discovers that there was a two-headed alien caught by the agents very recently, which has now died. She panics and presumes that the body belongs to her lost son, '2015'. Meanwhile, the BAIR agents warn the residents fo the Sunshine Colony, saying that if the BAIR agency finds any evidence that suggests that the residents have been helping aliens, they will be in big trouble. Who is the lost alien, then?

episodesList.title: Vasant Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: The Sunshine Colony residents are worried about having to safeguard themselves from the BAIR agents after they receive a warning from them for helping aliens. Meanwhile, Varsha decides to flee from the colony, but leaves behind a message in a chit for Vasant, which tells him to reach a temple, where the rest of his alien family will be waiting for him. Will Vasant be reunited with Varsha and his family? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Hemanth's Letter For Vasant
episodesList.summary: All the residents of the Sunshine Colony arrive at the temple to find Varsha and her family after they discover the chit she left behind for Vasant. Meanwhile, Padmavati Devi and Mitesh get the BAIR agents arrested by the police. And in a third plot, Vasant reaches the Sunshine Colony, where he meets Bhadresh and Ramdulari. Will the family finally be reunited with Vasant with the help of the Sunshine Colony? And what will happen to the BAIR agents? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Jhoot
episodesList.summary: Varsha reaches the Sunshine Colony and is finally reunited with Vasant, her loving husband. Everyone asks Vasant where he was, since he had disappeared for a long time, but Vasant gives them a strange answer, listing all the possible reasons he could have gone missing, making all the residents of the Sunshine Colony confused, as they begin to get angry with Vasant for not giving them any clarity on where was he last night. Will they get to the bottom of this mystery?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Second Marriage
episodesList.summary: Vasant is behaving very secretively, and Hemant is very curious as to why. He begins to investigate and finally finds out the reason behind Vasant's behaviour. As it turns out, Vasant has married someone else and now has a second wife! All the Sunshine Colony members now go and ask Vasant for the truth about where he was when he went missing, when a lady who calls herself Premlata, or 'Premi' arrives at the colony and asks for Vasant. Is she Vasant's second wife? And why did he marry her?

episodesList.title: Vasant Ki Dusri Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Premi arrives at the Ghotala household, and Vasant finally admits in public that he has married her. Varsha is furious and is not ready to listen a single word in Vasant's defence. She gets very mad at Premlata and asks her to leave the house immediately. Why would Vasant marry for a second time? And why would his second wife be so eager to meet his other family? Could there be more to the story? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ki Uljhan
episodesList.summary: All the colony members want an answer from Vasant, about who this Premlata is. They demand to know if he has married, and if so, why? Vasant tells Varsha how he came across Premlata and her father, and how he signed for them what he thought were papers of rent, but which turned out to be the papers of court marriage. How will Varsha and the others react to this mistake? Will this be the last straw, or will they get Vasant out of this hole too? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ki Gharwali
episodesList.summary: Ojha, Chandrabhan, and Bhadresh decide to befriend Premi and take her to Ojha's house, where all of them ask her about how she came across Vasant. Varsha, Sharad, and Hemant ask Vasant where was, to which he replies saying that he had gone where the High Command had sent him. They ask the High Command for more information, but High Command denies having sent Vasant anywhere. Where was he, then? And will Ojha and the others find out more about Premi?

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Love Letter
episodesList.summary: A meeting takes place at Ronny's house amongst all the Sunshine Colony members and the Ghotala family. Premi states in front of all the residents that she and Vasant have been married to each other for a long time and that Vasant even has written love letters to her. Varsha is shocked to hear this, but so is Vasant, as he is completely unaware of having done the things Premi is saying he did. Is she lying? And if so, why?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Birth Mark
episodesList.summary: Premi shows everyone the love letters she received, and the handwriting on them matches that of Vasant. She even talks of a birth mark on Vasant's body, which truly does exist. Still, Vasant denies having met Premi before. It is decided in the meeting that until Vasant's claims are proven or disproven, Premi gets to stay at the Ghotalas' house. Bhavna warns Varsha that now she has to take extra care of Vasant. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Biwiyo Ki Paheli
episodesList.summary: The ladies of the colony come up with a plan to find out the truth about Premlata. Meanwhile, in an attempt to put this situation to rest, Manav comes up with a theory of 'doppelgangers', two strangers who look identical to each other, have the same birth marks and even similar tastes, but who but have never crossed paths. Could this be the answer, did Vasant's doppelganger cause this?

episodesList.title: Searching Vasant's Duplicate
episodesList.summary: The residents of the Sunshine Colony are rushing to figure out the truth behind Premi and working hard to put this debacle to rest. But while they are doing so, Vasant grows fond of Premi, and has a dream about him living a happy life with both Varsha and Premi as his wives, living together peacefully. Will this get in the way of the residents' plans? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant As Professor Premi
episodesList.summary: The ladies of the Sunshine Colony warn Varsha to watch out for Vasant, as Premi might make him attracted to her, with his naive attitude. Meanwhile, Manav, Sharad and Anna begin their mission to find Vasant's lookalikes- and they soon meet the first one, a fashion designer by the name of Asit Baliwala. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Emraan Hashmi In Sunshine Colony
episodesList.summary: The women of the Sunshine Colony decide to try and test Premlata. They ask her to 'get modern' and wear an outfit with heels, and Premi turns out to seem very comfortable, and not out of place in ths outfit. She claims she is so comfortable wearing heels because she is used to balancing 3 pots of water on her head in her village, but the ladies are reluctant to believe her. Is Premlata is not a fraud, and is Vasant lying to them?

episodesList.title: Searching Premlata's Husband In Chunkypur
episodesList.summary: Manav and the rest of his team finally meet the marathi farmer, and it turns out that he is not Premlata's fradulent husband. Meanwhile back in the Sunshine Colony, big things are about to happen, as Premlata has foudn out that Vasant and his family are aliens, and is about to go and tell Bhadresh, Ojha and Chandrabhan. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Humshakal
episodesList.summary: Manav, Anna, and Sharad meet a conman, but he too turns out to not be Premlata's husband. Bhairavi suggests to Vasant to hunt for his lost son, '2015' by using their time machine. The Ghotalas use their time machine to go back to the moment 2015 landed on Earth, but they reach 30 minutes late and come across a group policemen looking for aliens, after having discovered a spaceship. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Searches
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Varsha, after having travelled time back in the time, find 2015's belongings in a bag, along with pictures of all the residents of the Sunshine Colony.  Vasant is now certain that one of the colony members is their son. Meanwhile, Manav, Anna and Sharad finally meet the Tamil hero who refers them to a man named 'Basant' who might be Premlata's husband, since he is also Vasant's look alike. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Statue Of Galti
episodesList.summary: With the residents of the Sunshine Colony eager to end this debacle and find out the truth behind Premlata's story, Manav, Anna and Sharad finally find Basant, the man who they have heard is Vasant's lookalike. As it turns out, this is the right lead after all, as he is actually the true husband of Premlata. Will Premlata be united with her husband and sent home? Will this nightmare finally end for the Ghotalas and the residents of the Sunshine Colony?

episodesList.title: Manav Ki Sachai
episodesList.summary: While everyone tries to get rid of Sweety Singh, Anna finds out the fact that Manav too is an alien. However, Manav tells her not to tell anyone, as his motive now is only to protect Lajo and Ojha. Meanwhile, the Ghotalas are still in search of their lost son. Vasant and Sharad make Anna wear the special glasses and confirm that she is not an alien. But Vasant then asks Manav to try them. Will Manav's secret finally be revealed?

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Searching For 2015
episodesList.summary: The Ghotalas look into their lost son, 2015's bag, and find out that there are three possible supects at the colony who could be 2015 in his human form, and start searching for them. All the ladies call Sweety Singh and share the photographs of the three suspects with him, and ask him to get their whereabouts. Manav, Sharad, and Hemant visit a club where one of the suspects was believed to have worked. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Ana Questions Manav
episodesList.summary: The family doubt that someone in the colony is actually the lost son, 2015, but still don't rule it out as a possibility. The search begins for the alien in disguise, with the help of a special pair glasses Vasant owns, that reveal any alien's true form. They begin questioning all the Sunshine Colony members to deduce who really is 2015. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Manav's Truth Revealed Before Ana
episodesList.summary: It is revealed that 1313 has 2015 held as his captive, and wants him to repair a weather control machine, with which he can conquer the whole world. But it turns out that the machine can be mended only by the union of the superpowers of 2015, 9211 and -426. Meanwhile, in the Sunshine Colony there has been fluctuation of super powers, prompting BAIR agents to arrive with legal warrants to check everyone's homes. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Super Powers Of 2015
episodesList.summary: BAIR agents discover an alien in Chandrabhan's house and see him transform into Sweety Singh. Unable to catch the alien, the BAIR agents rush to Sweety Singh's house, as Vasant informs them that he is actually 1313 and has landed on earth to destroy it. He tells the agents that they must catch 1313. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Sudden Snowfall In Sunshine Colony
episodesList.summary: Sweety Singh finds the whereabouts of all three suspects, when suddenly, a strange snowfall begins to happen where he is, followed by acidic rainfall. Vasant says that these sudden changes in the atmosphere is because of a villainous alien, 1313. Meanwhile, Manav gets more information on the boy who worked at the club- he has been missing for 2 years, and people have been talking about him being kidnapped. But he was also seen with Jacky, a.k.a. Alien 1947. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Weather Control Machine
episodesList.summary: It is revealed that 1313 has 2015 held as his captive, and wants him to repair a weather control machine, with which he can conquer the whole world. But it turns out that the machine can be mended only by the union of the superpowers of 2015, 9211 and -426. Meanwhile, in the Sunshine Colony there has been fluctuation of super powers, prompting BAIR agents to arrive with legal warrants to check everyone's homes. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Searching Aliens In Ghotalas House
episodesList.summary: BAIR agents discover an alien in Chandrabhan's house and see him transform into Sweety Singh. Unable to catch the alien, the BAIR agents rush to Sweety Singh's house, as Vasant informs them that he is actually 1313 and has landed on earth to destroy it. He tells the agents that they must catch 1313. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Son 2015 In Sunshine Colony
episodesList.summary: 2015 and 212 enter the Sunshine Colony disguised as Rastogi and a client. Nobody notices them, and meanwhile, the Ghotala family leaves for Shivhari Yadav's house in search of 2015. Will anyone discover that Rastogi and his client aren't who they seem like they are? And will the Ghotalas finally be reunited with their son? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Khatarnak Aliens
episodesList.summary: 2015 and 212, disguised as Rastogi and his client, are interogated by Bhavna when she begins to suspect something is off about them. Meanwhile, the Ghotalas face failure in meeting Shivhari Yadav. Bhavna thinks that 2015 and 212 are actually 1313 and someone he works with, and calls the BAIR agents to catch him. Will 2015 and 212 finally be revealed, and will their reunion with the Ghotalas be stopped?

episodesList.title: Bhavna Saves Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: The Ghotala family arrives back at the Sunshine Colony. There, Bhavna informs them about what has happened, but they tell her that 1313 does not have the power to morph, and that only 2015 has the power to fly. But the reunion must be postponed when the electricity supply of the colony is cut off after Vasant tries to charge his spaceship there, making the colony receive a 2 lakh rupee bill. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Conspiracy Of 313
episodesList.summary: Vasant, Varsha, and Sharad reach the fort, where a clash takes place between the aliens and the stooges of 1313. They soon return to the colony with a long face, without 2015. Meanwhile, Ronny and Anna question Bhavna and Mitesh, close to realizing that they are actually 2015 and 212. But just then, 1313 along with his stooges arrives at the Sunshine Colony. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Khatarnak Alien 313
episodesList.summary: Varsha and Vasant give 2015's pictures to Sweety Singh to get his wereabouts. Meanwhile, Bhavna accidentally reveals to 1313 that she is not an alien, but covers up her blunder with a story of Bhadresh being a producer, Ronny being a director and Bhairavi an actress. 1313 sends his stooges to the Sunshine Colony to confirm if what information Bhavna has said is true- saying that if it is false he will kill her. What happens next?

episodesList.title: 2015 Contacts Vasant Ghotala
episodesList.summary: 2015 finally has verbal communication with Vasant through their satellite call. Meanwhile, -102 and 1600+ arrive at the Sunshine Colony to take Bhairavi, Ronny and Bhadresh along with them. Vasant and the Ghotala family leave for the 'Nana-Nani' park to fetch 2015, when Varsha gives him the idea to save Bhavna and Mitesh from the clutches of 1313. Will he be able to to? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant In Nana Nani Park
episodesList.summary: The residents of the Sunshine Colony reach the den of 1313. 1313 asks them to prepare to perform a scene in front of him to prove that they are actors and directors as they claim, making everyone tense. Meanwhile, 2015 comes across an actor by the name of M.Chadrakant who gives Basant's address. 2015 and 212 are leave for Basant's house. Will they finally be reunited with the Ghotalas?

episodesList.title: 2015 In Sunshine Colony
episodesList.summary: 2015 reaches Basant's house but finds a lock on the door. He realizes that he has reached the wrong location. Meanwhile, all the Sunshine Colony residents escape from the custody of 1313, and Manav gets the Ghotala family back home. They are all waiting for 2015 to return home, when a distressed 1313 sets out to ruin the occasion. Will the reunion be ruined? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Is This Guy Really Manav?
episodesList.summary: 1313 is causing extreme heat using his powers to try and ruin the day, and as a result, the airplanes in the sky begin to glow, infrared, due to the immense hot weather. The Ghotala family finds out that Manav too is an alien as he starts glowing along with them due to the heat. What will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Manav Reveals His Truth
episodesList.summary: The electricity officer arrives at the Sunshine Colony to investigate the reason behind the huge bill, and sees a glowing light coming from Ghotala house. He suspects there to be some small scale industry inside and wants to inspect the house, but all the colony members try to stop him. Meanwhile, Anna explains to the Ghotalas why Manav had been hiding the truth from all of them- Manav is the son of high command who has come to Earth to protect them. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Hemanth's Healing Super Powers
episodesList.summary: 2015 reaches the den of 1313 and surrenders to him. The heatwave stops and Hemant heals Vasant, who finally comes back to his senses. The electricity officer leaves after realising there is no industry in the Sunshine Colony. Meanwhile, Sweety Singh informs the Ghotalas that the photo they had asked him to investigate belongs to the nephew of a conman who the police is looking for. Will this unfortunate disguise sabotage 2015's plans of reuniting with his family?

episodesList.title: Vasant Decides to Return Back
episodesList.summary: 1313 calls for X and Q and informs them that he can help them catch the aliens on Earth. He introduces himself as scientist Dixit. Agent X and Q arrest the Ghotala family by showing them a video of 2015 being tortured by 1313. Meanwhile, back at the colony Lajo falls unconscious and Manav rushes her to the hospital using his super powers. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Murlidhar Knows Manav's Truth
episodesList.summary: 1313 reaches the BAIR office to capture the Ghotala family, but there, a clash takes place between the aliens. 1313 tells the Ghotala to surrender if they want to meet their lost son 2015, and the Ghotala family agree. Ojha reveals his displeasure upon learning that Manav is an alien. Will Ojha stay angry or forgive him? What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: 313 Holds 2015 Captive
episodesList.summary: For the first time in years, the Ghotala family and their lost son, 2015, come face to face with each other- in the custody of 1313. 1313 does not allow Vasant to reuinite with his son unless he repairs the weather machine and creates a wall of electric current to prevent the father and son from doing so. Meanwhile, Sharad contacts Manav and asks for his help. Will Manav be able to help the family?

episodesList.title: Vasant Agrees to Repair Supernatural Device
episodesList.summary: A fight takes place between the aliens and the Ghotalas and Manav win, defeating 1313 and his cronies. The long wait finally ends and 2015 is reunited with his family. But suddenly, Manav begins to feel dizzy and as if he has lost something, which puts all the aliens in another dilemma. What is happening to Manav? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: 313 Ki Nayi Saazish
episodesList.summary: Lajo is admitted into a hospital. All the residents of the Sunshine Colony try to keep talking to her constantly to distract her and keep her mind off Manav. Meanwhile, the aliens discover that 1313 has robbed some of them of their memory of certain points in time, when all of them fail to recognise Ronny, Bhairavi, Anna and Mitesh. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: 313 Threatens Bhairavi
episodesList.summary: 1313 kidnaps Ronny, Bhairavi, Mitesh, and Anna, and as a ransom, tells Vasant to repair and return the weather control machine. If he does not, 1313 says that he will throw the residents of the Sunshine Colony who he has held hostage out into space, killing them. Will Vasant be forced to succumb? Or will 1313 be stopped? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Bhavna's Concern
episodesList.summary: Vasant agrees to do as 1313 says and commits to fixinf the weather control machine. But slyly, he transforms himself into Ila and goes to try and free all the residents of the Sunshine Colony who have been kidnapped from the clutches of 1313. Will 1313 find out and stop him, or will Vasant be able to save the day? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Advice to 2015
episodesList.summary: Vasant, disguised as Ila, lures 1313 away by dancing in front of him. But 1313 is hard to fool, and he catches Vasant. He warns him not to try and outsmart him again, and to repair the machine. Vasant tries to contact Sharad for help, but Sharad is unable to answer the call, as Sweety Singh has arrived at the colony o arrest 2015, whom he thinks is the nephew of a fraudulent conman the police is after. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Vasant As Ila Mehta
episodesList.summary: Sharad finally recieves Vasant's message, and Varsha, Hemant and Sharad leave in the spaceship with the repaired weather control machine to free the members of Sunshine Colony. Will they be forced to succumb and hand it over to 1313, or will they be able to come up with a plan to outsmart him? And more importantly, will they save the residents who have been kidnapped?

episodesList.title: Sweety Singh Comes Looking For Vasant
episodesList.summary: Varsha and the rest of the team reach Vasant's location, and 1313 takes charge of the weather control machine. But things go wrong even further, when Hemant accidentally spills the beans of Vasant having created a new season that the machine can simulate. 1313 asks Vasant about it and Vasant is compelled to answer against his will, confirming it. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: The End is Near
episodesList.summary: Back at the colony, Bhavna and Bhadresh try to convince Ojha to accept Manav as he is, but it seems to be in vain, as he refuses to. Meanwhile, 1313 finds out about the new 'power season' that the machine can simulate when Hemant accidentally reveals it to him. He presses the button to activate the season and witness its effect on the humans he has held hostage. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Hemanth Disclosure to 313
episodesList.summary: The new 'power season' simulated by the weather machine created by Vasant works its wonders on 1313. It turns out the power season is actually one of human emotions. 1313 turns a new leaf and begins to feel sorrow. He begs for Vasant to forgive him, as he feels sorry for everything he has done, and begs to be taken back to make up for everything he regrets doing. Could this saga be coming to a close?

episodesList.title: Multiple Characters Of 313
episodesList.summary: The Ghotalas return back to Earth with 1313 who lets himself be arrested by Sweety Singh. Manav is all set to leave and Ojha does not even try to ask him to stay back. Ronny rushes to Ojha and takes his case, bugged with him. Ronny tells him that he has broken all ties with him by behaving like this. Ojha is in distress, but Manav leaves with his luggage. What happens next? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Sharad Wants to Marry Ana
episodesList.summary: Samar and Vasant propose the alliance of Sharad and Anna to Ronny and other members of the Sunshine Colony. Meanwhile, Hemant overhears Samar talking to someone a woman, and telling her that even if he goes back to his home planet he would return back to Earth for her. Who is this woman Samar is speaking to? And what will happen next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Sharad Proposes Ana For Marriage
episodesList.summary: Manav is about to leave the Sunshine Colony forever. He goes to Bhavna's house to bid her goodbye, forever, when Ojha arrives there and accepts him back as his son. He tells him not to go anywhere, and the father and son reunite again. It seems that all is well and back on track. Anna informs the Ghotalas that all the Sunshine Colony members are planing a farewell party for all of them, but that she still needs some time to answer the proposal of Sharad. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Ghotala Dance
episodesList.summary: The residents of the Sunshine Colony throw a farewell party for the Ghotala family. They organise a kafiya mehfil for them, and everyone begins to enjoy themselves, talking to each other about different things, laughing, and dancing.  But as their departure edges closer, the Ghotalas and their neighbours all begin to get emotional. Will this really be it? Will they really leave after staying here for so long? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Farewell Gifts For Ghotalas
episodesList.summary: The Ghotalas leave for their planet and the Sunshine Colony is left with sorrow in their hearts at the thought of bidding their friends farewell. But the Ghotalas, once in their spaceship, discover that Sharad has constantly been texting Anna. Samar too seems to be busy texting someone. Vasant and Varsha ask Samar what he is upto which makes him nervous. What is going on with Anna and Samar?

episodesList.title: 2015 is Married
episodesList.summary: Samar informs his parents that he has already married Sonachandi, the daughter of a business tycoon named Daulatram. Vasant is now tensed as the girl is aware that Samar is an alien but her father is not. The family decide to return to take the daughter in law along with them. Meanwhile in the Sunshine Colony, Manav explains that he is completely fine with Anna being with Sharad. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Decides to Return Back On Earth
episodesList.summary: The Ghotalas return to Earth as their spaceship lands back where it took off from.  All the residents of the Sunshine Colony are sure it is them, and are confused about why they are back. Just then, Sharad calls up Anna and Anna proposes to him on the phone. Will he say yes? What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Ghotalas Arrives On Earth
episodesList.summary: The Ghotalas drive Rastogi and his client away as they take back custody of their house. Sonachandi tells her father, Daulatram that Samar had asked her to get her father to come along to meet his family that evening. Vasant and the family are very excited as they will get to meet their grandson Makhan. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Sweety Singh Comes to Daulat Ram Home
episodesList.summary: Vasant and the rest of the Ghotala family are doing all the preparations to welcome Samar's in-laws. Meanwhile Daulatram and his family are also getting ready to meet the Ghotalas, when Sweety Singh happens to arrive at Daulatram's house and tells him that he knows Vasant Ghotala- and that he is a huge nuisance and not to be socialised with. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Samar & Sona's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Sonachandi discovers for the first time that Makhan has the super power of reading other people's minds, as they are getting ready to leave for the Ghotalas' house. Meanwhile at the Ghotalas' house Ojha and Ronny act as though they are ladies to give the family a example of how to behave when Daulatram arrives with his family. Soon, Sharad officially proposes to Anna. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Ana Accepts Sharad's Marriage Proposal
episodesList.summary: With the proposal now officially accepted, Sharad and Anna begin to dream about a romantic song with each other. Meanwhile, Daulatram arrives with his family at the Ghotalas' house. Will Sweety Singh's meddling get in the way of Sharad and Anna's happiness, or will Daulatram look past it and accept Vasant and his family? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Sona
episodesList.summary: Varsha gives a warm welcome to Daulatram and his family. Meanwhile at Bhavna's house, Bhavna complains to Bhairavi about feeling 'giddy'. Unfortunately, Bhairavi interpets this incorrectly, thinking that Bhavna is expecting a baby. But soon, Bhavna leaves for the Ghotalas' house, as a war of words seems to have broken out between Vasant and Daulatram. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Sona Chandi's Father Questions Vasant
episodesList.summary: Daulkatram starts interrogating Vasant with all the possible questions he can think of based off Sweety Singh's allegations. Vasant lies to him to try and cover up his tracks and keep his child's engagement from falling apart, but one lie just leads to more, until Vasant is left blurting out a series of lies, that he has to justify using some very weird logic. Daulatram is suspicious whether to believe Vasant or not. What happens next? Will the engagement fall apart?

episodesList.title: Vasant's Self
episodesList.summary: Daulatram, bugged with Vasant, leaves Ghotalas' house along with his daughters, furious. Vasant too is adamant as he does not want to agree with Daulatram about letting Samar stay with his in-laws' family after the marriage. Daulatram comes up with a compromise on one condition- if all the things Vasant has told them are true, he will let Sona and Makahan stay with the Ghotalas. But if even a single lie is discovered, then Samar has to stay with Daulatram's family. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Vasant Ki Nayi Mushibat
episodesList.summary: Sonachandi informs Varsha about Daulat's condition. Varsha passes on the message to Vasant, who now becomes tense, since he will now have to prove all the lies that he had said in a flurry to cover up his tracks. And to top it all off, Varsha says that she too has lied to Daulat about their family staying in Suryanagar. What will happen next? Will Samar have to stay with Daulatram's family?

episodesList.title: Bhairavi As Doctor
episodesList.summary: Hemant tells Bhairavi that he has fallen for Heeramoti, and that if Vasant's talks are not proven to be the truth, he will never be united with his love. Bhairavi tells her brother not to worry, and goes to Daulatram's house in the disguise of the doctor who treated Samar when he was in a coma. Daulatram is convinced that Bhairavi is the doctor, but Vasant is worried about how to cover up the lie about Suryanagar. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Ronny Ki Nayi Musibat
episodesList.summary: Daulatram visits the place that Vasant had told him was a hospital, but finds an agarbatti shop in its place. Bhairavi reaches there, disguised as doctor, and tells him that the hospital was there, but it burnt down, and the agarbatti shop was built in its place. Vasant, disguised as Laxmi, also comes to meet Daulatram- but suprisingly, Daulatram falls in love with Laxmi at first glance. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Chakkudi Ka Naya Plan
episodesList.summary: Anna, Manav, Sharad, and Ronny rehearse the Christian wedding, to make Sharad more aware of what a christian marriage is like. Just then, Lajo arrives there and insults Anna for having ditched Manav. Vasant returns disguised as Laxmi and informs Varsha that Daulataram has fallen in love with him whilst disguised as Laxmi. With all of this new trouble on its way, what will happen next?

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Naya Plan
episodesList.summary: Daulatram visits the Ghotalas' house to ask for Laxmi's hand in marriage. Meanwhile, Bhavna discovers that there is another love story cooking up in the Sunshine Colony, this time between Hemant and Heeramoti. She cannot help but wonder what will happen next, with so many odd couples beginning to form in the Sunshine Colony. Will this season of love continue? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Ana Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Ronny and Ojha visit the Ghotalas while Daulatram is at their home. Daulat fails to recognize Ronny, but he does notice a resemblance between Ojha and Vasant's father. Vasant is now baffelled and pleads to Ojha and Ronny to not attend the wedding to avoid further troubles with Daulatram. But both Ronny and Ojha insist on attending the wedding. How will Vasant solve this problem?

episodesList.title: Vasant is In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Manav convinces Vasant that killing the father is not a good idea, and insists that they will be able to  think of some other way out of this situation. Daulatram promises Anna a 'hen party' by his pool atnhis home. Meanwhile, all the boys get ready to attend Sharad's exciting bachelor's party at a fancy resort. What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Lakshmi Roop
episodesList.summary: Vasant, disguised as Laxmi, also decideds to attend the Anna's hen party at Daulatram's farm house. There, Daulatram gifts Laxmi a khandani necklace and asks her to be her "Ghar ki Laxmi". Vasant, not very eager to find out the actual meaning of the phrase "Ghar ki Laxmi', tries to get out of the situation. Will this escalate, or end here? What happens next? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ki Pool Party
episodesList.summary: Bhavna makes the Ghotalas realize that nothing has been sorted out with Daulatram, and that Vasant has actually invited even trouble to his home by accepting Daulatram's proposal. Everyone asks Sonachandi to make her father deny the proposal, but when Daulat asks his daughters' permission for a re-marriage, they feel so moved that they agree with their fathers wishes. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Lakshmi Ka Asli Chehera
episodesList.summary: Sharad and Anna's wedding day arrives and it now becomes Vasant's task to sort out the sitation with Daulatram, as he keeps on asking to meet Laxmi and Vasant's father. Meamwhile, Manav is struggling with his own demons, as he realises how hard it is for him to watch the love of his life, Anna, get married to somebody else. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Daulatram Plans to Marry Lakshmi
episodesList.summary: Inspite of all the introspection and guilt he is facing, Manav assures Sharad that he can handle himself, and that Sharad is the only person Anna should get married to. On the Daulatram front, Samar transforms himself into Laxmi and manages to try and keep Daulatram occupied. What will happen next? Will Anna and Sharad be happily married? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Sharad's Best Man
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Vasant that according to his guest list, he expects at least 2,000 attendees at the wedding of Samar and his daughter Sonachandi. Vasant once again finds himself under pressure- 2,000 people at one wedding? How is he supposed to handle that many guests? Will he be able to? What happens next? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Sharad Ki Shadi
episodesList.summary: Bhavna assures Vasant that the long guest list is not something to worry about, because she will teach Vasant how to behave like he is a part of the groom's family. Ramdulari comes up with the idea of making Laxmi dance with goons to sabotage her image in front of Daulatram. But Sonachandi comes up with an even better idea- to have Samar disguise himself as her deceased mother and tell Daulatram to not marry Laxmi. Will the plan work?

episodesList.title: Sharad Missing Ana
episodesList.summary: Samar transforms into Narangi, Sonachandi's mother, and tells Daulatram that he should not marry Laxmi. But noticing how Laxmi and Narangi behave similary, Daulatram thinks that Narangi has given him a hidden message that he should in fact marry Laxmi. With Sonachandi and Samar's entire idea going wrong, will the wedding face yet another obstacle? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Gussa
episodesList.summary: Hemant arranges a plan for the relatives, making all of them disappear one by one, while Varsha and Sharad keep Daulatram distracted with the help of Vasant, disguised as Laxmi of course. What is their plan to stop this madness? How will they be able to stop Daulatram from marrying a person who does not exist, without letting it interfere in their own son's marriage? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ki Wife Ka Bhoot
episodesList.summary: Varsha takes Laxmi back home along with her and Sonachandi, when the staff complains to Daultaram about her. Daulatram refuses to believe them, completely in love with Laxmi. But then, Manav calls over Daulatram tells him to visit a bungalow to find his answers. When he reaches there, he is shocked to find Laxmi dancing inside the bungalow- with the goons from earlier. Will this finally be the end of this saga?

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ki Dusari Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Surpisingly, Daulat assumes that the saga at the bungalow was all just a gimmick. Meanwhile, Vasant gets a dream about their secret being revealed in front of Daulatram. In the dream, Daulatram becomes infuriated and kills all the Sunshine Colony members. Still, Vasant and Varsha decide to take a chance and reveal the truth to Daulatram, to finally put this story to bed. But what will happen next?

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Game Plan
episodesList.summary: Ronny, Bhadresh, Ojha and Manav face a tough task- training Jyotsna, Lakshmi's lookalike, to act like Lakshmi. Meanwhile Vasant and group of Sunshine Colony members face a tough task of themselves, having to decide who will tell the truth to Daulatram. What will happen next? Will both groups succeed? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ki Chinta
episodesList.summary: Vasant comes up with the idea of performing a play in front of Daulatram. During the play, Varsha grows extremely tall in front of the audience, who have come to attend the mehendi function at the wedding. But thankfully, Ronny arrvies with some good news- informing Vasant that they have found the real Lakshmi and that they need not worry anymore. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Vasant Threatens Daulatram
episodesList.summary: Sonachandi helps the Ghotala family by coming out walking on stilts, and tellind everyone that Varsha had grown tall with the help of those same stilts. Vasant and the rest of family are delighted to meet Jyostna. But meanwhile, Daulat informs Sonachandi that he has planned to get married to Lakshmi on that day itself and intends throw a surprise wedding. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ki Dusri Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Daulatram informs Vasant that Samar has already signed papers where he has mentioned that he gives the responsibility of bringing up Makahan to Daulat but Daulat tears all the pages in front Vasant's eyes and declares a competition on proving who is more capable of to look after Makhan Vasant accepts the challnege.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Secret
episodesList.summary: Daulatram makes Vasant understand that Samar and Sonachandi need to go with him at his place but Vasant is ready to accpet the challenge and prove that he is more capable than anyone else tyo give the best upbringing to Makhan

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Drama
episodesList.summary: The Nana-Dada comprition begins and Daulat pulls out a doll along with diaper Vasant takes an excuse and runs upstairs followed by Varsha n Sharad.

episodesList.title: Jyotsna Ki Entry
episodesList.summary: The competition begins where Vasant accepts his defeat and lets Daulatram take Makahn along with him Bhavna shouts at Vasant that why did he accept his defeat and asks him to ask Daulatram for another competition the very next day .

episodesList.title: Daulatram Aur Lakshmi Ki Shaadi
episodesList.summary: Competition 2 begins and Vasant defeats Daulatram in the first two rounds, the third round is the competition where both the parties are asked to go to park and protect Makhan, Hemant and Hiramoti are to take Makahn for an outing in the park.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Lakshmi Roop
episodesList.summary: Bhavna sends Ojha,Bhadresh and Ronnie dressed as ladies to kidnap Makahan and also sends Samara and Sonachandi in the disguise of police officers but somehow there creates a havoc in the park and all find that Makahn is missing.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ka Toota Sapna
episodesList.summary: All rush to police station where Sweety Singh tries to solve the matter but all his efforts go in vain when Samar has a look at the letter given by Heeramoti and learns that the writing on it are of Bhavna's Bhavna is suspected and called at police station where Bhavna grees to have written the date on it but she says that the writing does not belong to me.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Wants Maakhan's Custody
episodesList.summary: Samar keeps on getting ransom calls from the kidnapper and all are now on a quest to find the owner of the number that has been used but they find out that the numbers from which the calls are made belong to Ojha and Bhadresh and to top the confusing Sweety finds out that Heeramoti was playing on his cell phone and had also called the kidnapper .

episodesList.title: The Competition For Makhan
episodesList.summary: All find out that Hemant had taken Makahan away to prove that he is capable to look after Makhan single handed he also says that he will not show his face to his family untill and unless he is not capable enough o buy a house of his own and leaves from there .

episodesList.title: Daulatram Wins Maakhan's Custody
episodesList.summary: Daulat suspects that sometjing is wrong with Makhan and wishes to get him check by one his doctors which scares Sonachandi and Bhavna and Bhairavi are woken up at 2 am in the morning with a bang on their door Hemant has returned with the papers of a house. Bhavna is surprised to see the papers.

episodesList.title: Daulatram's Fatherly Duties
episodesList.summary: Hemant returns and informs all that he has asked money from his planet and has counted nearly 3 crore rupess entire night working hard and bought the house that is Row no. 2 in his name, Daulat is insistent on taking Makahn along with him to the doctor hence, Vasant schems up a plan and asks Daulat to first visit Sunshine colony as he wants Daulat to shoot the first Jaykara of ganesh festival.

episodesList.title: Manav Ka Idea
episodesList.summary: Makahn tries to save the Ganapti idol from falling and ends up holding it in air Daulatram notices this and Vasant understands that he will be questioned about it he flees from there giving a stupid reason and Daulat questions the sunshine colony members about it and all are confused as to what to answer.

episodesList.title: Maakhan Ho Gaya Kidnap
episodesList.summary: The entire colony members now cook up a story of Ganeshji giving darshan to all by showing a ganesh idol in air at Ojha and Bhavna house but Daulat is not convinced with the same,he tells Jhumroo that he shall be shifting to Sunshine colony the other day to fulfill his desire which only he is aware of.

episodesList.title: Maakhan's Kidnapper Demands Ransom
episodesList.summary: Lord Ganesh gives blessings to Vasant and Varsha in their dreams. Daulatram comes to Vasant's house. Varsha informs Daulatram that Hiramoti has gone to the market along with Bhavna.where Ketan and Girish misbehave with the ladies and on hearing this Daulatram gets a fit of rage.

episodesList.title: Maakhan Ka Kidnapper
episodesList.summary: Manav informs Bhadresh that Vasant is going to teach a lesson to the goons who teased Sonachandi. On the other hand, Vasant and Daulatram come to Madhusudan's house where Daulatram learns that Madhusudan is actually Daulatram's follower

episodesList.title: Hemant Ki Pratigya
episodesList.summary: Madhusudan apologizes to Daulatram for his past mistakes. Daulatram requests Vasant to prove his worth as Maakhan's guardian and tells Vasant that my follower has hurt you so now as punishment you need to challenge me on anything and if you loose than i shall take Makhan along with me.

episodesList.title: Hemant Buys a Home
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Jhumroo that Vasant may soon prove his worth as Maakhan's guardian and so I will have to make him challenge him soon but then begins a journey on what should they challenge each other, Colony members end on boxing and all begin to teach Vasant the tactics of boxing.

episodesList.title: Vasant's Family Celebrate Ganesha Festival
episodesList.summary: Ronny and Manav teach tricks and tactics of boxing to Vasant. Samar informs his family that Vasant has fallen unconscious while learning the game of boxing.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Demands Explanation
episodesList.summary: Vasant is knocked badly on head which makes the hindi language erased from his brain function to download it again he neds to be brought in his alien form Sharad and Varsha help him get to his alien form whe Daulat notices him and all are shocked.

episodesList.title: Lord Ganesh Blesses Vasant
episodesList.summary: Daulatram notices Vasant in his original avatar. Hemant tells Daulatram that the alien standing before him is none other than his father.Sharad rewinds the entire events and Daulatram enters the house where he sees Vasant in his original avataar but Vasant is forbidden from speaking.

episodesList.title: Vasant Meets The Goons
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Sonachandi that he is going to give a new challenge to Vasant to prove his worth as Maakhan's guardian. Manav tells Bhairavi that they must teach wrestling to Vasant.Daulat says that this time I shall play the dice in such a manner that I would look like a loser but the game will be won by me.

episodesList.title: Vasant Challenges Daulatram
episodesList.summary: Sonachandi fails to find Daulatram's wrestling certificate in the cupboard and thinks that kushti is the only game that Daulatram is not a champion at.Daultarm plays a fool and pleads to Vasant that he is weak in kushti and wants himn to challenge in some other game Vasant gets adamant and challenges in kushti Daulat now reveals that he actually is a champion in kushti and thanks Vasant as Daulat is confident to win over him, Vasant is devastated.

episodesList.title: Vasant Wants to Learn Boxing
episodesList.summary: Sonachandi and Samar come to Daulatram's house. Sonachandi requests Daulatram to not hurt Vasant in the wrestling competition. Daulatram thrashes their request.

episodesList.title: Vasant Learns Boxing
episodesList.summary: Vasant Ghotala and Daulatram come face to face to play the game of wrestling. Manav tells Samar that Vasant will surely lose the game against Daulatram.All pray for Vasant while Vasant gets charged to face Daulat in the ring.

episodesList.title: Vasant Forgets Hindi
episodesList.summary: Vasant and Daulat Ram get into a fight in wrestling ring for who will take care of their grandson Maakhan. Ghotala family and Sunshine colony members suggest innovative ideas to Vasant to beat Daulatram. Will Vasant be able to win the challenge? The match is a draw..

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Asli Roop
episodesList.summary: Ojha tells Daulatram that he is celebrating the result of the wrestling match in Bhadresh's house. Sonachandi tells her in-laws that Daulatram is emotionally attached to Maakhan.

episodesList.title: Daulatram's New Challenge
episodesList.summary: Vasant has invited Daulatram to his house for lunch on instigation of Samar. Later, Vasant and his son go to a shop to bring ingredients for the bash where a hilarious situation is created because of their alien beings.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Challenges Vasant
episodesList.summary: Ronny tells Sonachandi that he is pleased to know that Vasant could impress Daulatram with his cooking skills. Bhairavi and Ramdulari enter Varsha's house. Daulatram tells Ronny that he wishes to give a surprise to Vasant.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Prepares For Wrestling Match
episodesList.summary: Ramdulari tells Bhadresh that Daulatram is planning to gift a camera to Vasant. Bhairavi and Ramdulari meet Daulatram. Daulatram requests Bhairavi to complete his task at the earliest.Bhairavi with Ramdulari goes for shopping but both are in a dilemma that why has Daulatram asked them to buy the best of saree and bangles in the size of Vasant when it should be bought in varsha's size.

episodesList.title: Vasant Aur Daulatram Ka Face Off
episodesList.summary: Daulatram brings bangles for Vasant. Ronny asks Daulatram to not humiliate Vasant. Daulatram clears it to Ronny that he is not insulting Vasant instead he wishes Vasant to get a job like Samar Hemant and Sharad.

episodesList.title: Wrestling Competition
episodesList.summary: Hemant, Bhairavi and Hiramoti plan to set up a vegetable shop. Daulatram comes to Vasant's house. Girish and Ketan bring a bull in his Vasant's colony and daulatram than as promised to Sonachandi offers work to Vasant and asks him to milk the bull.

episodesList.title: Ojha Celebrates Daulatram's Defeat
episodesList.summary: Hemant, Bhairavi and Hiramoti start selling vegetables in a market. Ronny tells Vasant that he has found a job for him.

episodesList.title: Vasant Visits Sweets Shop
episodesList.summary: Ronny brings Vasant to a restaurant. Ronny's friend, Svetalna the owner of the restaurant interviews Vasant for the post of assistant manager. Will Vasant be able to impress his interviewer?

episodesList.title: Vasant Impresses Daulatram
episodesList.summary: Bhairavi starts selling vegetables at discounted rates. Sunil, the manager at the restaurant tells Vasant that he must demonstrate his skills to his boss to secure his new job and vasant now begins to showcase his skills.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ka Gift
episodesList.summary: Svetlana appoints Vasant as the manager of her hotel as his honesty makes her earn a good reputation. Meanwhile there takes place a tiff between Daulatram and Sunshine colony members where, Samar asks Bhadresh to not interfere in his family matters.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Insults Vasant
episodesList.summary: Sharad calls Vasant and tells him that he is not able to use his superpowers and asks for Vasant's superpowers as they wish to travel in the past to visit Durga maa's time to get a few facts about her, Vasant agrees to it. Sharad tells his family that they must travel into the past using a time machine to take the blessings of God.

episodesList.title: Hemant Ki Dukaan
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells the police that Vasant has kidnapped Girish and Ketan. While Ghotala family along with Bhavna ramdulari chandrabhan Girish and ketan meet Lord Shiva in Himalayas.

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Naya Job
episodesList.summary: Bhavna,Ramdulari,Chandrbhan, Ketan Girish and Ghotala family meet Goddess Durga.The goddess tells them that she is going to kill a demon called Mahishasur. She suggests them to help her achieve her goal

episodesList.title: Vasant Ka Interview
episodesList.summary: Daulatram enters into Vasant's colony in the disguise of a greengrocer. Vasant tells Ronny that his family may never be able to return back to the future with the help of the time machine as the machine in which they have gone does not have the return button in it and the group of people that have gone in past will not be able to rerun back to present.

episodesList.title: Sabji Ka Sale
episodesList.summary: All the ladies get into a thinking proces as to what is the mesaage behind the riddle that maa has asked them to solve,Bhairavi cracks the riddle and tells Varsha that she should appear before Daulatram in the disguise of 'Maa Durga'. Vasant receives a gift from his boss,Svetalana.

episodesList.title: Vasant Gets a New Job
episodesList.summary: Ronny tells his uncle that women of his family should observe 'karva chouth' festival in the house. Ronny explains the importance of 'karva chouth' to Vasant.

episodesList.title: Sharad Ka Plan
episodesList.summary: Manav tells his father that a spaceshift would soon appear on earth. He further tells his family that they should make sure that the spaceshift doesn't appear before Daulatram. On the other hand, Daulatram meets Bhavna and Varsha and schemes up a plan against Vasant whom Varsha thinks is behaving in a an odd manner and Daulatram poisons her ears regarding the same stating that Vasant has been cheating upon her.

episodesList.title: Bhavna & Team Reach Himalayas
episodesList.summary: Ramdulari tells Bhavna that soon she would face troubles in her life which Bhavna miffs off in anger as she is irriatted with Bhairavi's absurdity. Bhavna along with other women of colony gather to celebrate 'Karva Chauth'.

episodesList.title: Bhavna & Team Meet Goddess Durga
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Varsha that Vasant is involved in an extra-marital affair and the proof is that the chalni has gone balck during the karwa chauth pooja. Vasant tells his wife that his boss has gifted him a bracelet.

episodesList.title: Time Machine Ka Problem
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Varsha that her husband Vasant is planning to go to Manali along with Swetlana. Varsha assures Daulatram that Vasant is not involved in extramarital affair.

episodesList.title: Varsha Ka Naya Avatar
episodesList.summary: Vasant comes home in a good manner and meets Daulatram. Vasant tells Varsha and Daulatram that he is highly impressed by Swetlana. Sharad tells Manav that they should reveal Vasant's secret to Daulatram..

episodesList.title: Karva Chouth
episodesList.summary: Daulatram advices varsha to pay less attention to Vasant instead try and make him jealous to focus his attention on someone else and Varsha thus starts randomly calling a person who is complete stranger to her and starts acting mushy with him on the phone in front of Vasant.

episodesList.title: Manav Ki Chinta
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Varsha that Vasant is involved in an extra-marital affair and the proof is that the chalni has gone balck during the karwa chauth pooja. Vasant tells his wife that his boss has gifted him a bracelet.

episodesList.title: Karva Chauth Celebrations
episodesList.summary: Vasant tells Swetlana that his wife might have an extramarital affair. Sonachandi tells Daulatram that she has decided to leave his house. Will Daulatram be able to stop his daughter from moving out of his life?

episodesList.title: Vasant In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Varsha asks Vasant to not interfere in her personal life. Raju plumber comes to Varsha's house. Vasant tells Swetlana that Varsha is involved in an extramarital affair

episodesList.title: Daulatram Reveals Vasant's Secret
episodesList.summary: Vasant tells Ronny that his wife Varsha has an affair with a plumber. Swetlana informs Varsha that the award function has been cancelled

episodesList.title: Vasant Plans to Go to Manali
episodesList.summary: Hiramoti consumes a multiplier tablet given by Hemant. Hiramoti's two identical twins appear in her house. Bhairavi's family decide to hide this truth from Daulatram.

episodesList.title: Varsha Plans to Teach Vasant a Lesson
episodesList.summary: Vasant yells at Hemant for giving multiplier tablet to Hiramoti. Daulatram's family admits him to a hospital. Vasant calls Ramdulari and asks her to inform Daulatram that Ojha has passed away

episodesList.title: Varsha Ka Secret Plan
episodesList.summary: Daulatram assumes that Ojha has passed away. Vasant comes to Ojha's house in the guise of a spiritual master. He claims that he can wake Ojha up from death.

episodesList.title: Vasant Shares His Fear With Swetlana
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Jhumroo that he suspects the presence of an alien in Vasant's colony. Vasant's high-command informs him that an alien would soon land on earth

episodesList.title: Raju Plumber Meets Varsha
episodesList.summary: Ronny requests Manav to not allow the space shift to land on earth. Daulatram tells Vasant that he wishes to see his space shift. Vasant and his family stop Daulatram from moving out of the house

episodesList.title: Varsha Ka Affair
episodesList.summary: Daulatram learns that Vasant and his family members are aliens. Daulatram enters into the spaceshift.

episodesList.title: Teen Hiramoti
episodesList.summary: Daulatram requests Vasant to take him back to the earth. He further tells Vasant's family that he wishes to stay along with Maakhan

episodesList.title: Daulatram Hospitalized
episodesList.summary: Daulatram has a panic attack and faints when he sees the three Hiramotis, and gets hospitalized. When he awakens, he is certain that Vasant is behind everything. Samar and Sonachandi begin to wonder if it is time to tell Daulatram that the Ghotalas are aliens. They wonder if this could finally sort out all of their problems, but are not sure. Will this be it? Will Daulatram finally find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Vasant Plans to Fool Daulatram
episodesList.summary: Vasant is a 100% certain that Daulatram has begun to suspect that he and his family have some sort of super powers- and so the family must now figure out a plan to make him believe otherwise- and Vasant has an idea for what they can do. Will Vasant's plan work? Or will Daulatram realise that the family are in fact aliens? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Suspects Presence Of Alien
episodesList.summary: Daulatram tells Jhumroo that he suspects the presence of an alien in the Sunshine Colony. Meanwhile, Vasant's high-command informs him that an alien will soon land on Earth. Who is this alien, and what will happen on the Daulatram front? Watch this episode to find out now.

episodesList.title: Daulatram Plans to See The Space Shift
episodesList.summary: Ronny requests Manav to not allow the spaceship to land on Earth. Daulatram tells Vasant that he wishes to see the spaceship. Meanwhile, Vasant and his family stop Daulatram from moving out of the house. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Daulatram Enters Spaceshift
episodesList.summary: Daulatram learns that Vasant and his family members are aliens. Then, Daulatram enters into the spaceship. What will happen next? Will this be the end of the relationship betweem Daultram and the Ghotala family? Or will he accept them as they are?

episodesList.title: Daulatram Ki Iccha
episodesList.summary: Daulatram requests Vasant to take him back to Earth. He then tells Vasant and the rest of the Ghotala family that he wishes to stay there, along with Makhan. Will this be the end of this saga? Watch this episode to find out now.

plotHtml: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai is a story of an extraterrestrial family who come to Earth with an aim to find their eldest and lost son, named 2015, whom they have been searching for on many planets. The spaceship of Alien family crashes in a jungle as they land on Earth. After landing, they are shocked to see human civilization and its form. Later they realize that if they move around in their alien form they will be treated differently or may be taken captive for research and analysis, thus risking their existence. But since they get very strong clues of their lost son 2015 to be living on Earth, they forcefully take the form of humans and secure their lives. The alien family consists of Vasant, his wife Varsha, his younger brother Sharad and two sons, Hemant and Shishir. The residents of Sunshine Colony are unique and funny in their own different ways. At first, they found it difficult to accept the Ghotalas because they are weird but slowly they treated them as their own seeing their kind and selfless nature. Sharad falls for Anna. Ghotala's tries to search for 2015 but fail various time. Due to their weirdness towards human customs, they get targeted by Sunshine Colony members. Later, the family learn that God has created their destiny for various special mission more than their hunt for their son 2015. Firstly, they save Liza and Ronnie's daughter's life with Hemant's newly discovered superpower of healing. They later save Shishir's real human form from Bureau of Alien Investigation and Research (BAIR) who learns about Ghotala's real alien form but mistake them the real human form. Later, BAIR agents, Pritesh, and the scientist Rajender create hurdles and the alien family almost escapes from revealing their true form. Later, Lord asks the family to visit Runnotsav of Kutch where they rescue Murlidhar Ojha's long lost son Manav Ojha who was presumed to be dead. Manav now helps Ghotala whenever Sunshine colony members blame them for various situations. When Manav reveals his feelings for Anna, this starts a love triangle between Sharad, Anna and Manav. During their stay on Earth, Dada 420 as Bharavi's grandfather's doppelgänger, Dadi 90 as Bharavi's grandmother's doppelgänger, Nani 555 as Urvashi Dholakia's doppelgänger, their daughter 333 visit the family on Hemant's invitation which also creates problems for the family. On a trip, Pritesh fake's his illness and Ghotala's in an attempt to save his life, expose their superpowers. Due to this, the colony hates the family. Pritesh has a change of heart and convinces the colony to save Ghotala family for good. Through much trouble the Ghotala family finds out their son 2015 has been held captive at an evil Alien's (1313) chamber, because he wanted him to repair Weather Controlling Machine, which is capable of destroying the Earth. Ghotala family defeats 1313 and got back their son and named him Samar. Now the Ghotalas decides to leave for their planet. As they are midway, they got the news of 2015's wife and son, on Earth. Due to this the Ghotala family crash-land on Earth one more time. When Ghotalas meet Daulatram's (Samar's Father-in-law) he falls in love with Varsha at first sight and Varsha is smitten by him but he starts suspecting them. Anna and Sharad finally get married. Ghotala's now tires to convince Daulatram for the sake of Sonachandi and Maakhan. Sunshine colony members help the family in the process.After a series of events Sonachandi announces that she and 2015 are expecting another child. Vasant accidentally showcases his superpowers and Daulatram finds out that the Ghotala's are aliens. Afraid that Daulatram will expose their secret to the BAIR, Ghotalas decide to leave Earth immediately and move to their home planet, along with Daulatram's family. After some time they realize that they forgot Shishir and Maakhan at the Earth itself. Thus they decide to return to Earth, and crash lands on Earth for the third time. In the last scene of the show, Maakhan is shown thinking that now since the Ghotalas have been exposed to Daulatram, it would be more interesting to watch the Vasant-Daulatram clash.
tagline: Badi Dooooor Se Aaye Hai is a story of an extraterrestrial family who come to Earth with an aim to find their eldest and lost son, named 2015, whom they have been searching for on many planets.

title: Baawre
summary: Baawre is an Indian television drama that aired on Life OK. It first began broadcasting on 2 June 2014 and went off air on 5 September 2014.  The show stars Abhishek Rawat and Vinita Joshi Thakkar as two individuals who at first hate each other but eventually fall in love. The show was scripted by Neelesh Misra and produced by Sudhir Sharma for Sunshine Productions.
plot:
Nikumbh, a theatre director, a successful playwright who puts life in his plays and believes in his innate talent, aims to touch the skies with his hard work. He has a dedicated outlook towards life and love. Nikumbh does not believe in love and goes ahead to bump into his future love Yamini accidentally. The cupid struck them but with arguments. Yamini, a famous singer, whose life is only lined by her father Raghavendra Singh. She wants to live her life as her dad moulds it, no matter she gets happiness in it or not. He wants her to get him many civil contracts by using her singing talent and making good terms with the city bigwigs. Raghavendra is very ambitious and uses Yamini to make contacts.
Yamini feels upset seeing her dad not supporting her at times, but his love keeps her going. Yamini's family is very loving and caring which makes her tough life simple. Her Maa and Dadi always take her side to counter Raghavendra when anything goes against Yamini's wish. Raghavendra wants the best for Yamini and himself too. He loves Yamini but his dreams are more important to him than her. Nikumbh and his best friend Azam hangout together, where Nikumbh passes most of the time bitching about Yamini. Azam is in love with Shaheen and finds ways to stick around her. Nikumbh helps him get Shaheen's mobile number and Azam is thankful to him.
Nikumbh loses the rehearsal hall to Yamini, and is annoyed with her. Yamini feels bad for him as she did not know Raghavendra has taken Nikumbh’s hall for her rehearsals. She goes at a Boutique’s inauguration, where she is given a western revealing dress by Neha. Yamini does not want to wear the dress at MLA Tripathi's daughter Neha's party, and suddenly Nikumbh passes by and slips, making the ink fall on the dress. Yamini is thankful to him for saving her from wearing the dress. She wears the other dress which Raghavendra gifted her on her birthday and Tripathi and Neha are annoyed. Yamini manages to tell them the fate of the ruined dress. Tripathi is eyeing Yamini knowing what Raghavendra wants from him.
Neelesh Misra is the Sutradhar of the show, who tells us about how the leads are feeling and links their stories together. It presents a unique style of storytelling which was never seen before. In the upcoming episodes, the track goes like this..... Nikumbh is annoyed when he learns that he lost his play slot to Yamini, already knowing he lost the rehearsal hall to her before. Yamini has nothing to do in this and all this is done by Raghavendra. There begins a misunderstanding between them. Yamini apologizes to Nikumbh knowing his loss because of her. Later on, Yamini comes to Nikumbh’s theatre group to do a role, knowing he needs someone. Nikumbh feels she is a singer and won’t have any acting talent. He dismisses her and Yamini asks him to decide after taking her audition. Let’s see how Yamini and Nikumbh’s love story starts. Yamini gives the audition and gets Nikumbh’s approval. She ends up as the heroine of his play and slowly likes his ideas and talent. She eventually falls in love with him. Baawre looks a good novel concept which will be shaping up its storyline with each episode.

title: Bibi Chowdhurani
summary: Bibi Chowdhurani is a Bengali television serial telecast by Zee Bangla.
plot: The show was about a girl named Bibi who was a liar but ultimately the lies turned out to be beneficial for others. She is a compulsive liar. Her father is a politician. Her elder sister is to be married with a guy, so in order to rescue her elder sister she lies to her father about her sister, but she finds herself trapped in her own lies. Her father decides to get her married with the same guy. In order to avoid the marriage she lies to the guy that she is an alcohol addict, chain smoker, etc. but the guy falls in love with her as he feels that she is a pure girl.

title: Balaganapathy
summary: Balaganapathy is a Malayalam soap opera that launched on Asianet. The first episode aired on 31 March 2014. It was relaunched in Asianet Plus from late 2016. The show was also remade into Tamil under the same title on Star Vijay from 14 September 2015 to 18 December 2015 for 65 episodes.
plot: Balaganapathy tele serial tells the story of Ram, a ten-year-old child and his devotion to Lord Ganesha. Ram believes blindly in the powers of almighty and he learned about Lord Ganesha through the stories told by grandmother. Pooja is his best friend, who stays with him throughout his failures and gives him confidence. Their class teacher Sunitha is compassionate to Ram and wants to see him succeed in life. However, he fails to succeed in many of the tasks presented to him. In the story's turning point, Lord Ganesh himself takes the avatar of Balagnapathy to accompany Ram and his friends to overcome all difficulties in his life.

plotHtml: Balaganapathy tele serial tells the story of Ram, a ten-year-old child and his devotion to Lord Ganesha. Ram believes blindly in the powers of almighty and he learned about Lord Ganesha through the stories told by grandmother. Pooja is his best friend, who stays with him throughout his failures and gives him confidence. Their class teacher Sunitha is compassionate to Ram and wants to see him succeed in life. However, he fails to succeed in many of the tasks presented to him. In the story's turning point, Lord Ganesh himself takes the avatar of Balagnapathy to accompany Ram and his friends to overcome all difficulties in his life.
