title: Baalveer
summary:
Baalveer is an Indian fantasy television series and the longest-running speculative fiction television series in India. The franchise stars Dev Joshi in the titular role. 
Its first season aired from 8 October 2012 to 4 November 2016. 
The second season, titled Baalveer Returns, aired from 10 September 2019 to 30 June 2021. It is a direct sequel to the first season. 
The third season, titled Baalveer 3, aired from 18 March 2023 to 9 September 2023. It is a spiritual sequel to Baalveer Returns. 
The fourth season, titled Baalveer 4, ran from 6 May 2024 to 23 July 2024 on SonyLIV. It is a direct sequel to Baalveer 3.
A fifth season titled Baalveer 5 aired from 7 April 2025 to 10 May 2025 on SonyLIV. It is a direct sequel to Baalveer 4.
reception: The first episode of Baalveer Returns has over 45 million views on YouTube. Baalveer Returns episode 233 has over 72 million views on YouTube. Its 170 episode has over 60 million views.

articleSections.title: ''Baalveer''
articleSections.text:
The story revolves around Pari Lok (the Fairy Realm), where good fairies reside, each possessing unique abilities. Rani Pari is the queen of the fairies, while Bhayankar Pari, an evil fairy, plots to create terror on Earth. She seeks revenge as she wasn't given the throne by Maa Pari, when she was a good fairy. Rani Pari assigns different fairies to protect specific locations on Earth from Bhayankar Pari's evil plans, but in vain.
Consequently, Rani Pari decides to give powers to Baalveer to fight with the evil. Years ago, he was born in Rajasthan with Pari-Tara's powers. Bhayankar Pari tried to abduct him, but Rani Pari stopped her. In a series of events, Baalveer was saved and carried to Pari Lok by Baalpari. Ranipari identified him and permitted Baalpari to raise him in Parilok. In the present, Rani Pari grants him the power of seven fairies, known as Saptapari, along with her own powers to aid him in his mission. An upright man named Mahesh Dagli adopts Baalveer, when he's sent to Earth. Baalveer becomes known as Ballu and is embraced by Mahesh's family -the Saat Sachhon ka Parivar (Family of seven who never lies), who are unaware of his true identity.
The series features multiple confrontations between Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari, who attempts to spread evil in Pari Lok and Earth. Despite various challenges, Baalveer emerges victorious with the help of fairies. Later, Chhal Pari tries to kill Baalveer, but ends up killing Rani Pari. A new Rani Pari emerges to guide Baalveer and fairies.
Bhayankar Pari is eventually killed by Baalveer and new evil fairies are introduced throughout the show. Numerous battles take place to uphold peace and righteousness. The story concludes with the triumph of good over evil, restoring peace and harmony in both Pari Lok and Earth, as Baalveer returns to Pari Lok from Earth.

articleSections.title: ''Baalveer Returns''
articleSections.text:
Timnasa, an evil enchantress and the queen of Kaal Lok, begins a quest to rule the whole universe and become the most powerful and evil entity. She attacks and destroys the Pari Lok. Baalveer and the surviving fairies take refuge in Pari Lok's sister-planet Veer Lok, whose leader is a white lion, Shaurya. Baalveer becomes weaker due to his injuries in the attack. On Shaurya's instructions, Baalveer goes to Earth as Dev, with the fairies as his sisters, to find his successor, as he needs help to fight Timnasa.
Baalveer's successor is a very mischievous 10-year-old boy named Vivaan. Initially, Baalveer and Vivaan dislike each other, but soon, Baalveer finds out that Vivaan is his successor and discloses his reality to him and takes him to Veer Lok. Timnasa turns Baal Pari into evil Kaal Pari to stop Vivaan's Veer-Tilak. Baalveer manages to get Baal Pari's wand and instates Vivaan as his successor. The duo heroically spoils all of Timnasa's evil plans. Soon, Baalveer and Vivaan start loving and taking care of each other.
Baalveer finds Sarvakaal's prison and Timnasa's past, about how she was banished from Pari Lok years ago by Baal Pari, because of her evil and egoistic intentions. Baalveer fakes losing his memories and lives as Vivaan's brother Debu with him, as instructed by Shaurya. He acquires a new avatar, Naqabposh and befriends Ananya, a girl who is threatened by Timnasa, and also receives help from Sarvakaal. They together go to Earth to find the hidden power which is destined to kill Timnasa. Consequently, it is revealed that Vivaan is Ananya's long-lost brother, and their biological mother is Devaki, the former queen of Shwet Lok, which was destroyed by Timnasa and was made Kaal Lok by her. The trio forms 'Team Shadow' and Vivaan, being the hidden power destined to kill Timnasa, gains Sarvakaal's infinite energy. By this new power, he puts an end to Timnasa's trinity except for Tauba Tauba. During the battle, Masti Pari is killed by Bhaymar, and Vayu Pari and Jwala Pari sacrifice themselves as Timnasa's weapons hit them, to protect the Earth.
Later, when Debu opens the secret message of Timnasa, which she had handed over to him before her death, Timnasa's spirit tells Debu that his biological parents were killed by Shaurya and the fairies. Baalveer cures Baal Pari from Timnasa's magic, but Shaurya persuades her to refrain from revealing the truth.
The series unveils the underwater kingdom of Shinkai, which is ruled by Jalraj Kaikos. The commander-in-chief Bambaal plots to rule over the whole universe, along with his sidekick Milsa. Baalveer captures Milsa, but Bambaal secretly kills her to hide his identity from Debu and Vivaan. Ray's full powers are unleashed by Debu's blood after he threatens Vivaan's life. It is revealed that Baalveer is Jaikaas' son and Ray's twin-brother, born in 2000. Jaikaas was a lunatic scientist of Veer Lok, who planned to destroy Earth by 2020, but was deceptively killed by Shaurya while escaping and Baalveer fell to Rajasthan, where a couple adopted him and later Bhayankar Pari tried to abduct him prompting Rani Pari's interruption. Eventually, Baal Pari carried him to Pari Lok, while Shaurya managed to justify himself. Bambaal, using Baalveer's troubled past, tries to turn him against Shaurya, but enraged, he captures Bambaal and kills him. Ray kills Baalveer out of anger. Later, Baalveer comes back to life as he and Vivaan went through a test of destiny. Ray creates problems for the duo and revives Bhaymar, Timnasa, and Akroor to revenge Bambaal and Milsa's deaths.
Timnasa plots to destroy the earth by attaining the ultimate power, a red diamond. Baalveer, Vivaan and the fairies battle against Timnasa to get the diamond to protect Earth. However, Timnasa deceitfully manages to obtain it. Baalveer manages to find the white magical diamond and sacrifices himself by joining the two diamonds, leading to a terrifying explosion leading to his and Timnasa's death, leaving their souls destroyed.
A new character, Happy, is introduced, who is a lookalike of Baalveer. Kaal, another lookalike of Baalveer with evil intentions who was imprisoned by Swarna Shaurya centuries ago and kept frozen as a statue in Drak Lok gets freed from prison. Baalveers's energy star divides into 6 pieces and entres the body of the 6 lookalikes of Baalveer, which helps Kaal to escape from prison. He decides to kill other lookalikes of himself. Happy tries to administer his newfound powers. Kaal manages to kill a lookalike and gets his powers.
Later, Happy and his family visit Bharat Nagar to conduct wedding of Diwali's relative. The residents of Bharat Nagar are shocked to see Happy, lookalike of Debu, and get emotional assuming him as Debu. However, it is revealed to them that Happy is just a lookalike of Debu. Ray and Bhaymar doubt Happy to be Baalveer and plan to disclose the same. In Drak Lok, the seven Shauryas manage to safeguard remaining three lookalikes of Baalveer at a secret place, but Kaal finds them and manages to kill another lookalike of Baalveer and gain his powers. Happy tries to control his mind and powers. The fairies and Vivaan try to collect energies of seven Shauryas from seven universes to defeat Kaal and try to save the remaining lookalikes.

articleSections.title: ''Baalveer 3''
articleSections.text:
A spiritual sequel to the previous seasons, this season unravels the story of another universe. The plot is central to the Baalveer of this universe, who is preparing for his mother, Adishi's arrival in Udaka Lok after her two months' journey. He goes to Earth to buy a gift for her and saves a girl named Kaashvi from an accident. In Udaka-Lok, Baalveer passes a test set by Uttan, the ruler of Shaashvan-Lok, and is declared worthy. However, Aageel plans to kill Baalveer using her Mahajadoo.
Kaashvi’s mother is revealed to be Tuyeer, a trusted ally of Aageel. When Aageel attacks Kaashvi, her Mahajadoo is absorbed inside her (as she is the offspring of two different species). Aageel captures Kaashvi and takes her to Himbaash to extract her Mahajadoo, but she is eventually saved by her parents who then safely sends her to Earth. In a series of events, Baalveer is charged guilty for Babel and Tuyeer’s death and thereby is stripped off his memories and powers until the investigation to the matter is completed. Until then, he is sent to Earth via Bardol, a secret agent of Shaashvaan Lok, to lead a new life.
Bardol entrusts Bhaskar Bhardwaj, a magician, to take care of Baalveer until the matter is sorted. Thus, Baalveer begins to live a new life as "Veer Bhardwaj", befriends Kaashvi, after certain bickerings, and furthermore vows to bring an end to the financial problems of his new family.
Veer's memories and powers temporarily return unknowingly via Kaashvi’s help, and under the guidance of "Benaam", Veer regains his superhero identity and soughts to find clues to prove his innocence to Uttan, but in vain. Meanwhile, Shashmaag releases the soul of a devilish witch named "Kurja" and transmits her into Adishi’s body with the objective of escaping from Uttan’s suspicion and to kill Baalveer. Meanwhile, Aageel’s futile attempts of killing Baalveer by manipulating Kaashvi triggers the negative traits of the latter frequently. Simultaneously, Veer and Kaashvi’s bond continues to develop.
Adishi (controlled by Kurja) meets Baalveer and commands him to surrender, to which he refuses. In a set of dramatic twists, she is apparently killed and the blame of the same is put on Baalveer by Shashmaag to instigate Uttan. Although Benaam catches hold of Kurja’s soul, Shashmaag kills the latter in the nick of time.
An angered Uttan soughts to destroy "B", the power source of Baalveer to put an end to his life. However, Baalveer manages to overpower him and preserves "B" safely with himself. In a set of thrilling twists and turns, Baalveer ultimately finds out about Shashmaag’s duality and finally proves his innocence to Mahamahim, who then remorsefully captures and kills Shashmaag with the help of his twin brother, Nehmaag. However, Shashmaag exchanged places with Nehmaag in the nick of time and took his guise, without gaining anyone’s suspicion.
Meanwhile, Aageel poses as "Agni", a righteous protector who then instigates Kaashvi against Baalveer and provokes her into believing that the latter is responsible for her parents’ death. Thus, Kaashvi vows revenge by killing off Baalveer with the help of her newly found powers. She is devastated and hurt to know that Veer is Baalveer, and consequently attacks him in a rough battle at the solar eclipse (when her powers are at par). However, both of them effectively solve the misunderstandings and a regretful Kaashvi eventually reconciles with Veer, only to realise that the Mahajadoo inside her is steadily weakening her survival like a poison.
With the help of Benaam and Kaashvi, Baalveer subsequently manages to extract Mahajadoo from the former’s body, thus making her safe. While Shashmaag joins hands with Aageel to seek revenge, Baalveer eventually finds out that Benaam is his real biological mother, and on being tricked by Aageel, he soughts to free his father, Bhasma, from Krinkaal Lok. He successfully frees his father after overcoming various problems. But, Bhasma, starts destroying the world which angers Uttan. Baalveer promises to return, after realising his mistakes, with greater powers, to save the world.

articleSections.title: ''Baalveer 4''
articleSections.text: Baalveer successfully frees his father, Bhasma, from Krinkaal Lok, unaware that he is a villain. Bhasma starts destroying the world. Then, Baalveer makes Bhasma faint. Benam tells Baalveer about his past: Bhasma was initially a soldier of Shashwan Lok, but he wanted to rule the world. So, he pretended to be in love with Benam and married her. Then Baalveer kills his father with Bhasm trident at last, but a new enemy named Param, who has already killed 49 different Baalveers of the universe, is trying to kill this last Baalveer. But to complete the Baliduar Vidhy and fill his powers, he first kills Baalveer's mother Benam and then Mahamahim Uttan.

articleSections.title: ''Baalveer 5''
articleSections.text: Baalveer is confronted by a powerful new enemy named Param, who has a mysterious connection to him and has already eliminated Baalveers across multiple universes. Param's sole mission is to destroy the current Baalveer. Adding to Baalveer's struggles, he is dealing with the emotional fallout of a difficult confrontation with his father, leaving him feeling powerless. While, on the other hand Kaashvi and Vivaal set out to kill Ageel but got failed when Ageel regains her powers and vows to kill Vivaal. On the other hand, Tauba Tauba decides to burn Dada Ji's body but gets failed. While, Shashmaag who is pretending to be Nehmaag joins hands with Param. Later, Shashmaag shows his real identity to Baalveer's friends. Baalveer's friends' souls get captured by Param. Baalveer decides to save them. Ageel shows her power parts to Andher and Timira. She tells both that if one of them kill Vivaal she will give them powers. Later, Andher, Timira and Tauba Tauba set out to kill Vivaal. After continuous fights, Baalveer along with the help of other 49 Baalveers' powers finally defeats and kills Param. Then Baalveer and his mother Benaam come to Himbash lok and together they defeat and kill Ageel resulting in the destruction of Ageel's powers and her palace. Then Baalveer and Kashvi finally reunite indirectly confessing their love for each other, concluding the series.

articleSections.title: Crossover
articleSections.text: Baalveer Returns had a crossover with Aladdin – Naam Toh Suna Hoga from 27 January 2020 to 31 January 2020.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The commencement of the show, a sequel to the children's fantasy series Baalveer, was announced in early August 2019 by Optimystix Entertainment and Sony SAB. The first promo was released in August 2019. The new series cast Dev Joshi as Senior Baalveer, and introduced Vansh Sayani in a lead role as Baalveer's successor. Pavitra Punia was cast as the evil fairy, Timnasa.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is being taped on sets at Film City, in Mumbai, Maharashtra, India After the Indian government announced the COVID-19 lockdown, the show ceased airing new episodes, along with other shows throughout the Indian entertainment industry. Four months later, after the government relaxed restrictions, the series resumed airing of new episodes, continuing with the storyline that had been interrupted.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
In 2020, Pavitra Punia announced that she would exit the series to participate in Season 14 of Bigg Boss. Subsequently, Krutika Desai, Amika Shail and Khushi Mukherjee also quit the show.
The storyline ended and producers announced a new arc, introducing the underwater kingdom of Shinkai, which would be populated by new villains, Bambaal, Milsa and Ray, played by Vimarsh Roshan, Shweta Khanduri and Shoaib Ali, respectively. In mid-December 2020, makers announced that Vimarsh Roshan was leaving the series and Aditya Ranvijay would return as Bhaymaar. In early January 2021, makers announced the return of Pavitra Punia as Timnasa also, following her eviction from Bigg Boss.
Later Dev Joshi played six different characters.

episodesList.title: Montu Harasses Manav And Meher
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is blessed with the power of fairies and fights evil on earth saving the innocents. Manav and Meher who are always bullied by Montu are running away from him when a dog accidentally saves them. Disturbed by this, their grandmother tells them a story of PariLok.

episodesList.title: The Pari's Share A Horrific Incident With Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: Baal Veer is taken to a fairyland where he is blessed with special powers by six fairies, each having her own unique traits. He uses these powers to help his friends, including Manav and Meher.

episodesList.title: Bhayanak Pari Decides To Conquer Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: Fairies are frightened by seeing Bhayankar Pari who is in search of Baalveer. Baal Pari inquires about the motive of Bhayankar Pari and why she was looking for her son Baalveer. Rani Pari answers all her questions.

episodesList.title: An Unforgettable Fight
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari tells Baal Pari all about Baalveer's past and Baal Pari remembers how she saved Baalveer from the accident and was allowed by all the fairies and Rani Pari to keep the child. That is how he got his name 'Baalveer'.

episodesList.title: Rani Pari To Give Super Powers To Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari decides that it is time Baalveer goes on earth to help innocent people. Baalveer is super excited hearing this, but his mother Baal Pari is terrified because owing to the dangers on earth. Meanwhile, in Bhayank Lok, Tauba informs Bhayank Pari that something big is going to happen in Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Gets Superpowers From All The Paris
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is given the powers of all the seven fairies to prepare him for Prithvi Lok and fight the evil there. There is a celebration going on in Pari Lok, but meanwhile, in Bhayank Lok, Tabua Tauba tries to figure out the big thing happening in Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Rani Pari Sends Baalveer On A Mission
episodesList.summary: It is time for Baalveer to finally leave for Prithvi Lok, Rani Pari explains the reason for Baalveer to be on earth to Baal Pari. Baal Pari is sad knowing that soon she will not have Baalveer alongside her, she already misses him and revisits old memories.

episodesList.title: Bapuji's Illness
episodesList.summary: Baalveer finally starts his journey for Prithvi Lok. Rani Pari tells him that he has to take care of the "Sath Saccho ka Parivar" and explains to him his mission. Baalveer gets his first sign about here to start on earth. He seeks Natkhat Pari's help adjusting to Prithvi Lok. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari comes to know the whereabouts of Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Fights Against Evil Powers
episodesList.summary: Baalveer starts his work on the tea stall and also his mission to help kids who are controlled by Bhayankar Pari, his first attempt goes successful but Tauba Tauba warns Bhayankar Pari. Meanwhile, Baalveer fails to deliver the tea order properly and his boss is not happy with it, but Baalveer finds a very generous and good-hearted man to his rescue.

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher Are Introduced To Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Mahesh takes Baalveer home with him. Whereas in Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari turns Tauba Tauba into Dooba Dooba 1 and sends him on a mission to Pari Lok to get information on Baalveer. In Dagli's house, everyone welcomes Ballu (Baalveer) except for Manav and Meher, they have a huge problem of their own. Baalveer makes a promise to Manav & Meher.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Gets Caught In Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: Tauba gets caught in the Pari Lok, but somehow he manages to escape but not with much information on Baalveer. On the other side in Prithvi Lok, Manav and Meher don't like the attention Ballu is getting and leaves for school. Ballu denies helping Manav and Meher when he sees Montu bullying them. Will Balveer come to their rescue?

episodesList.title: Montu Gets Electrocuted
episodesList.summary: Baalveer comes to rescue Manav and Meher. With the help of fairies, he teaches Montu and his friends a lesson that they will never forget. In Bhayank Lok Tauba finds something on Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari reaches one step closer to finding him. Will this lead to Bhayankar Pari and Baalveer coming face to face?

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher Are Punished
episodesList.summary: When Montu's father (one of the school's trustees) complains about Manav & Meher bullying Montu with the help of Baalveer, the principle has to punish them. But Baalveer comes on time to help. Bhayankar Pari is still in Prithvi Lok in search of Baalveer but in Pari Lok, Rani Pari has an intuition about something bad.

episodesList.title: Tea Owner Spills The Beans To Bhayankar Pari
episodesList.summary: Dari & Bhari Pari are sent to make sure that Bhayankar Pari does not find Baalveer. Bhayankar Pari interrogates chacha about Baalveer. In the school, Baalveer again warns Montu and asks him to leave Manav and Meher alone. Will Montu learn his lesson and apologize to Manav & Meher? Will Bhayankar Pari find Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Rocky Lands In Deep Trouble
episodesList.summary: Tauba finds a crucial object which will help him find Baalveer. In Pari Lok Baal Pari gets worried about Baalveer, but Rani Pari assures her about Baalveer's safety. In Dangli house the kids narrate what Baalveer did for them. Will Rani Pari be able to protect Baalveer or will Bhayankar Pari catch him?

episodesList.title: A Lottery
episodesList.summary: Baalveer saves a member of Dangli House and Dada Ji tries to get Ballu into Manav and Meher's school. In Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari has laid a trap for Baalveer and visits Pari Lok. Watch this episode to find out Bhayankar Pari's evil plan.

episodesList.title: Principal And Teachers Are Impressed With Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Ballu asks Meher to teach him for his admission test, but Meher tries to avoid it. Finally, he seeks the help of Natkhat Pari in studying. In Pari Lok, Rani Pari reveals the secret of Baalveer's safety. Meanwhile, in Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari is waiting for Baalveer to take his next move. Will Ballu pass the admission test? Will Baalveer fall into Bhayankar Pari's trap? Watch this episode to find out.

Meher wins the competition and is very happy to finally have gotten a mobile. Will this evil mobile bring trouble for Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Importance Of Education
episodesList.summary: All the fairies are trying to find Vijdhar Pari's magical wand, Rani Pari helps them and find it, but Natkhat Pari has doubt and she believes that this was done by Bhayankar Pari. In Prithvi Lok, Baalveer is trying to help poor kids by telling them about the importance of education. Will Rani Pari come to know about Bhayankar Pari's Plan?

episodesList.title: Pari Tara
episodesList.summary: Pari Lok is getting ready for Pari Utsav and all the fairies are excited and looking forward to it. Bhayankar Pari finds Pari Utsav as a perfect opportunity to steal the Pari Tara. Will Bhayankar Pari achieve her goal this time? Will Pari Tara give her all the powers?

episodesList.title: Meher Challanges Montu
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari makes her alibi strong by asking Rani Pari to put her in a cage during Pari Utsav. All the other fairies are excited to get superpowers from Pari tara during the Utsav. In Prithvi Lok, Meher challenges Montu. Watch this episode to find out who wins the challenge and whether Bhayankar Pari's master plan will work or not.

episodesList.title: Montu Finds Out About The Magical Shoes
episodesList.summary: Meher gets angry at Manav for not dancing properly. Montu finds out the secret about magical dancing shoes and tries to exchange them. In Pari Lok, Natkhat Pari is keeping eyes on Bhayankar Pari who is very close to getting what she wants 'Pari Tara'. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: The Grand Finale of the dance competition has arrived and all the kids are gearing up to give their best, everyone wants to win it. Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba are digging the tunnel which will lead them to Pari Tara. Who wins the competition? Will Pari Tara fall in Bhayankar Pari's hand?

episodesList.title: Winner Is Announced
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba are still searching for the path that will lead them to Pari Tara, all the other fairies are very excited about the Pari Utsav. Manav gets to know about the dancing shoes and is shocked, meanwhile, the results of the dance competition are announced.

episodesList.title: Manav Gives Away The Award
episodesList.summary: Manav gives his trophy to Montu and calls himself a cheater and then Montu reveals the truth to the judges. Bhayankar Pari is running against time and she must find her way to Pari Maidan soon if she wants to steal the Pari Tara. What will the judges decide after knowing the truth? Will Bhayankar Pari reach on time? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher Want To Meet Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari reveals to Rani Pari about her plan and announces that she rules the Pari Lok as the Pari Tara is hers. Meanwhile, in Prithvi Lok Manav and Meher asks Baalveer to let her meet Rani Pari. How will Rani Pari save Pari Lok from Bhayankar Pari?

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Steals Powers
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari steals all the powers of all the fairies, Rani Pari decides a way to punish Bhayankar Pari but Bhayankar Pari ends up punishing her. Baalveer found a way to make Manav and Meher meet Rani Pari. Baalveer must come to the rescue of Rani Pari and the whole Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Exits Blocked
episodesList.summary: All the fairies escape from the Pari Maiden making Bhayankar Pari angry. She blocks the exits of Pari Lok and traps everyone. The only person who can save them is Baalveer, but he himself is stuck with Mahesh, Manav, and Meher. Will Baalveer come on time to save the Pari Lok?

episodesList.title: Searching
episodesList.summary: All the fairies are hiding, Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba are searching for them in the entire Pari Lok. Baalveer tries to meet all the fairies, but will he be able to help them? Meanwhile, in Prithvi Lok, everyone in the school makes fun of Montu.

episodesList.title: Montu's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari tricks Baalveer and disguises herself as Baal Pari. Baalveer realizes he did a mistake by trusting Bhayankar Pari earlier. In Prithvi Lok, Montu makes a plan to bully Manav but it backfires. Watch this exciting episode to find out if Baalveer will save the Pari Lok?

episodesList.title: Natkhat Pari Leaves Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Montu is making plans to bully Manav and Meher again, this time they are locked in a cupboard. Baalveer is very sad seeing Baal Pari being punished by Bhayankar Pari. He goes to Prithvi Lok and Bhayankar Pari comes to find him. Meanwhile, Natkhat Pari has decided to leave Baalveer forever.

episodesList.title: Captive
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is sad after Natkhat Pari leaves him. He finds out that Manav and Meher are missing. Manav and Meher are in Pari Lok and think that Baalveer has fulfilled his promise. Bhayankar Pari has kept all the fairies captive and announces that tonight she will be crowned as queen of Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari's Test
episodesList.summary: Baalveer finds out Manav and Meher's location and he must save them before Bhayankar Pari finds them. Baalveer changes Vijdhar Pari, Firang Pari, and Dooba Dooba into Manav, Meher, and Ballu and safely hide the Pari Tara in plain sight.

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher Are Still Missing
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari tells her next plan to Naraz and Taraz Pari and devises a plan to find Pari Tara. Mahesh's family gets scared of Jimmy, but Manav and Meher are still missing. Will Bhayankar Pri find them before Baalveer? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Suraksha Kavach
episodesList.summary: All the fairies in Pari Lok are made to follow Bhayankar Pari's orders. Bhayankar Pari has come up with a 'new plan involving Suraksha Kavach' and tells it to Tauba Tauba. Baalveer has reached Pari Lok, but this might just be Bhayankar Pari's another trap.

episodesList.title: Slave
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher are surprised to see Bhayankar Pari as Rani Pari. Bhayankar Pari has made Natkhat Pari her slave and has given her a task to complete. Baalveer has to find Manav and Meher and save them from getting caught by Bhayankar Pari. Watch now to find out if Baalveer succeeds or not.

episodesList.title: Mahesh Catches The Thief
episodesList.summary: Baalveer listens to Bhayankar Pari's conversation with Natkhat Pari and Tauba Tauba about getting him to Pari Lok to capture him. Manav and Meher are missing their family and decide they want to go back to their home where Mahesh has caught a thief.

episodesList.title: Punishment
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is shocked to see that Natkhat Pari is on Bhayankar Pari's side. He confronts her and they get into a fight. Natkhat Pari wins it and punishes Baalveer. Bhayankar Pari's plan seems to be working. What was Natkhat Pari's punishment? Will Baalveer save himself and Pari Lok? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Montu Gets A Shock
episodesList.summary: Tabua Tabua still has his doubts on Natkhat Pari, so he follows her when she, along with Baalveer goes in search of Mayavi Parvat. Montu while troubling Manav and Meher gets a shock and cannot understand what just happened. Watch now to find out if Natkhat Pari has switched sides or is this just a new plan of hers.

episodesList.title: Invisible Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and Natkhat Pari find a way to help Manav and Meher. Baalveer makes himself invisible. Tauba Tauba doubts Baalveer's intentions and keeps an eys on him. What is Baalveer's master plan to save Manav and Meher?

episodesList.title: Magical Kada
episodesList.summary: Baalveer reveals about Magical Kada, Bhayankar Pari, and Rani Pari to Manav and Meher and they are scared, but he assures them that he will save them at any cost. Baalveer gets to know about Jaadui Pare and decides to find them.

episodesList.title: Sajnikant
episodesList.summary: Baalveer finds that Jaadui Pare is kept across a pond. Mitto Ram comes to help Baalveer and tells him he cannot go into the water. Baal Pari goes missing. Sajnikant tells a funny story to Dadaji. How will Baalveer cross the pond and get to Mayavi Pare? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mayavi Pare
episodesList.summary: Baalveer gets the Mayavi Pare after several attempts. Natkhat Pari tries to find about Bhayankar Pari's plan to help Baalveer but fails. In Prithvi Lok, Vijdhar Pari, Firang Pari, and Dooba Dooba who are hiding as Manav, Meher, and Ballu try to find Gaal Pari.

episodesList.title: Magical Mirror
episodesList.summary: Mahesh's Boss has brought a gift for his wife, but everyone is excited to find out what it is, Mahesh tries to avoid going near it and keeps it in a safer place. Manav and Meher get trapped inside a magical mirror. Will Natkhat Pari help Baalver in saving Manav and Meher from Bhayankar Pari's trap?

episodesList.title: Magical Mirror Gets Broken
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari is angry with Baalveer as he went back on his words and punishes him. Baalveer tries to save Manav and Meher from Bhayankar Pari's trap and breaks the magical mirror. But will he have to get into another face-off with Bhayankar Pari? What will Ballveer do next? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Gives Good News
episodesList.summary: Baalveer gives good news to all the fairies in Pari Lok, he also finds out how to get Manav and Meher out of the magical mirror. In Prithvi Lok, Dadaji has gotten himself in trouble again. Bhayankar Pari's next plan is more dangerous than ever. Watch this episode to find out what will happen next.

episodesList.title: Burned Kurta
episodesList.summary: Baalveer saves Manav and Meher and escapes Bhayankar Pari's trap. Natkhat Pari tries to distract Bhayankar Pari. Dadaji is very angry because his favourite kurta got burned. Will Bhayankar Pari catch Manav, Meher, and Baalveer again?

episodesList.title: Udan Khatola
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari finds Baalveer, Manav, and Meher and destroys the Udan Khatola. But to her surprise, they managed to escape again. Dr Jhatkanand visits Mahesh and his family and Firang Pari who is living as Meher asks Dr Jhatkanand to fix the electricity problem.

episodesList.title: Montu Knows The Secret
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari gets hold of Manav and Meher and punishes them, she has also closed all the exits of Pari Lok. Baalveer has to accept Bhayankar Pari's offer and agrees to the terms set by her. Montu gets to know the truth about Vijdhar Pari and Dooba Dooba Ek. Will Montu keep this secret or tell it to everyone? What will Baalveer do next? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: The Cat Is Out Of The Box
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari gets to know about Baalveer plan to steal the other half of Pari Tara and escape with Manav and Meher, but Natkhat Pari smartly comes to Baalveer's help. In Ptihtvi Lok, no one believes in Montu's stories. Natkhat Pari brings good news to Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Where Is The Remote?
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari takes all the fairies back to Pari Lok. School's principal does not believe in Montu and suggests he take a rest. In Dagli house no one can find the remote to their TV. Baal Pari meets Baalveer and gives him the advice to be safe.

episodesList.title: Natkhat Pari Knows Everything
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari takes Manav and Meher to Prithvi Lok, she also protects the lie played by Vijdhar Pari, Firang Pari, and Dooba Dooba Ek. Bhayankar Pari tries to find Baalveer and cannot understand what his next move is. Natkhat Pari tells Baal Pari and Gaal Pari about everything that has happened.

episodesList.title: Where Is The Remote?
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari takes all the Paris back to Pari Lok. School's principal does not believe in Montu and suggests he take a rest. In Dagli house no one can find the remote to their TV. Baal Pari meets Baalveer and gives him the advice to be safe.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Must Be Stopped
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari now has both the halves of the Pari Tara and she is going to use it, but Baalveer is on his way to stop her. There is drama going on in Dagli house and Rocky is enjoying it. Baalveer is not able to find his way and seeks Baal Pari's help. Will Baalveer reach on time to stop Bhayankar Pari? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Loses Everything
episodesList.summary: Baal finds a different way to enter the stadium, but he has no way to save the Pari Lok now. Bhayankar Pari wins against him. Baalveer request Baal Pari and Natkhat Pari to accept Bhayankar Pari as Rani Pari and let her rule the Pari Lok. Has Baalveer lost everything? Will he be able o find a way to fight back? Watch this exciting episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Last Spark
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is in tears and down on his knees. But he has one last spark left in him. He confronts Bhayankar Pari and manages to grab half of the Pari Tara. There is a massive fight between Bhayankar Pari and Baalveer. Baal Pari and Natkhat Pari runs away with half Pari Tara. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Mayavi Macchali
episodesList.summary: Baal Pari and Natkhat Pari are hiding from Bhayankar Pari. They are in the sea and Mayavi Macchali has become an obstacle for Bhayankar Pari. In Prithvi Lok, Montu is still trying to convince everyone about Ballu being Dooba Dooba Ek. Will Baalveer get to Baal Pari and Natkhat Pari before Bhayankar Pari finds them?

episodesList.title: Faliure To Prove
episodesList.summary: All the fairies are happy and relaxed now that Baalveer has achieved the Pari Tara. In the school, Montu and his friends fail to prove that Ballu is Dooba Dooba Ek. Bhayankar Pari is out of options for now. But will she come up with a new plan or will she give up? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Powers Return
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Pari Lok is worried because Rani Pari has gone missing, Baalveer figures out it must be Bhayankar Pari who has captured Rani Pari. Baal Pari with the help of Pari Tara gives all the fairies their powers back. Montu and friends try to prank Manav and Meher but the plan backfires. Baalveer finds out something really bad happening with poor kids. Will he be able to help them?

episodesList.title: Keeping The Hopes Up
episodesList.summary: Baalveer does not like what the goons are doing with the kids and decides to teach them a lesson. Bhayankar Pari tells Tauba Tauba about her plan to kill Baalveer once and for all. All the fairies in Pari Lok are keeping their hopes up. Will Bhayankar Pari succeed in her plan and kill Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Ballu Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Ballu goes missing and the whole Dagli family is looking for him. Baalveer meets with the goons and they get into a fight. He teaches the kids an inspirational lesson, but the goons have weapons and shoots at Baalveer. In Bhayanak Lok, Bhayankar Pari is making plans to kill Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Ballu Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: All the fairies decide that they will not play Holi, because Rani Pari is in captivity of Bhayankar Pari. Dooba Dooba Ek gets to know about Bhayankar Pari's plan and goes in search of magical colors. Montu and his friends have made a plan on Holi for Manav and Meher. Watch this episode to find out if Dooba Dooba will save Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Holi!
episodesList.summary: Baalveer joins the kids to play Holi and they are really happy except for Meher. Tauba Tauba comes with the magical colors to put on Baalveer. In Pari Lok, other fairies are in a faceoff with Bhayankar Pari and try to find out about Rani Pari.

episodesList.title: Bad Colors
episodesList.summary: Baalveer gets stuck in Bhayanak Lok and gets to know about Bhayankar Pari's plan with colors. Baal Pari gets to know about the encounter with Bhayankar Pari. Natkhat Pari visits Dagli house only to find out that Baalveer is missing. Who will come to save Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Will The Truth Come Out?
episodesList.summary: Dagli house is getting worries as Ballu has still not shown up. Mahesh, Dadaji, and Meher have searched all the town. Meanwhile in Pari Lok also, the search for Baalveer is going on. Baal Pari is getting worried now. Mahesh and his family might get to know the truth about Baalveer. Watch this exciting episode of Baalveer to find out what will happen.

episodesList.title: Dal Dal
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is stuck in Bhayankar Lok, and in Prithvi, Lok goons try to harras Mahesh and his father, Meher tries to call Baalveer for help but Baalveer is not available. Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba try to kill Baalveer who is stuck in a magical dal dal in Bhayankar Lok.

episodesList.title: They Need Help
episodesList.summary: Baalveer attempts to escape but fails. In Prithvi Lok media covers the news of missing Baalveer and more and more kids are calling for his help. Montu finds this as a perfect opportunity to bully kids who used to take Baalveer's help.

episodesList.title: Where Is Baalveer?
episodesList.summary: Montu bullies Meher into pouring ink over a school mate. Meher is disturbed and seeks for Baalveer's help, but he is nowhere to be seen. In Pari Lok, all the fairies are looking for Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari all over the planet. What will be Baalveer's next move? Will he come to help Meher? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: Evil VS Good
episodesList.summary: Kids in school make fun of Manav, even a teacher is angry with Manav and Ballu in school. The fairies decide to follow Tauba Tauba secretly in the hope that he will lead them to Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari. Will Bhayankar Pari's evilness win over Baalveer's goodness?

episodesList.title: Kala Baalveer
episodesList.summary: All the fairies get to know about Baalveer's location and decide to attack Bhayankar Pari. Bhayankar Pari has made a Kala Baalveer who will help her in her plans. Will Baal Pari and other fairies get to know about Kala Baalveer? Will Kala Baalveer's actions make kids hate the real Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Notice The Change
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari notices the change in Baalveer's behavior. Montu again bullies Manav and Meher. Manav and Meher are in deep trouble and are looking for Baalveer's help. Watch this episode to find out if Natkhat Pari will get to know about Kala Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Tommy's Chase
episodesList.summary: Tommy is chasing Manav and Meher who are scared and running away for him. Baalveer takes Montu's side and humiliates Manav and Meher in front of everyone. Natkhat Pari comes to save Baalveer but Bhayankar Pari catches her. Will Natkhat Pari become an ice statue? Will Manav and Meher know about Kala Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Meher Is Not Talking To Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is acting weird and hurting everyone, this comes as a shock. Meher has decided that she will not talk to Baalveer. Manav and Meher reveal a secret to their family. On the other hand, the real Baalveer tries to help Natkhat Pari.

episodesList.title: Jeevan Chakra
episodesList.summary: Meher is very upset and is not eating, neither talking to anyone. Bhayankar Pari reveals to Bura Baalveer about the Jeevan Chakra and how all the fairies have it but it was taken from her when she left Pari Lok, he promises her that he will destroy the Jeevan Chakra.

episodesList.title: Meher Cheer Up!
episodesList.summary: Dooba Dooba Ek tries to cheer Meher up by showing magic. Baalveer along with Baal Pari and Gaal Pari goes to find the Jeevan Chakra, but to find it he must solve all the puzzles. Will Baalveer get to the Jeevan Chakra before Bura Baalveer destroys it? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Operation
episodesList.summary: Manav goes through an ear operation and it was successful, everyone in Dagli house is happy. Bura Baalveer tries to find Jeevan Chakra but is unable to solve the puzzle. Baalveer comes to save Meher from a big accident, but Meher is still angry at him. Will Baalveer tell Meher about Bura Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Meher, The Chosen One!
episodesList.summary: Bura Baalveer needs someone honest to reach Jeevan Chakra and he chooses Meher for the task. Manav is looking for Meher. Montu on the other hand becomes a trouble for Manav. Will Meher realize that she is not with real Baalveer or will she lead bura Baalveer to Jeevan Chakra? Watch now to find out.

episodesList.title: It Is About Survival
episodesList.summary: When all the fairies come to know that Baalveer has gone to stop the Jeevan Chakra, panic sets in Pari Lok. If Jeevan Chakra stops, the survival of all the fairies will become difficult. A gorilla chases Montu. Will Meher stop the Jeevan Chakra without realizing that she is helping bura Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari? Watch this exciting episode of Baalveer to find out.

episodesList.title: It's Going To End
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari had refused to help Naraz Pari. Bura Baalveer finally reveals his real identity to Meher and also tells her that he has killed the real Baalveer and she has just helped him in destroying the Pari Lok. Meher is shocked and scared. Will Accha Baalveer come to Meher's rescue and save her and the Pari Lok?

episodesList.title: Habit To Fail
episodesList.summary: When all the fairies in Pari Lok start getting their powers back, Bhayankar Pari realizes that real Baalveer is still alive and she has lost to him once again. Her plans are failing every time and she feels dejected. What do you think, will Bhayankar Pari come back with another idea to take her revenge? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer VS Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Bura Baalveer reveals himself in front of everyone. There is a huge face-off between bura Baalveer and accha Baalveer. When Manav goes home without Meher, dadaji questions him. But everyone in the Dagli house is shocked when they watch Meher on news stuck in between the fight of bura and accha Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Must Die
episodesList.summary: Baalveer visits Pari Lok and makes a promise to never return until he has destroyed Bhayankar Pari. Baalveer wins aginst Bura Baalveer. Meher comes up with an idea to reveal the truth to her family. Dagli's house is just happy to see Meher safe as she comes back home.

episodesList.title: Cheel Ki Chaal
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari takes the help of an Eagle to save herself from Baalveer. Montu and his friends get into a heated argument but get united to bully Manav and Meher. When their plan does not work, punishment from their teacher is sets them straight. Watch this episode to find out if Baalveer destroys Bhayankar Pari?

episodesList.title: Scholarship Test
episodesList.summary: All the students are preparing hard for a scholarship test, which will be given to the top scorers. In Bhayankar Lok, Baalveer is looking for Bhayankar Pari and is going to destroy her once and for all for trying to destroy Jeevan Chakra, but he finds out that her life does not exist in her physical form.

episodesList.title: Mahapari Shastra
episodesList.summary: Baalveer uses the most powerful weapon Mahapari Shastra on Bhayankar Pari, but she is still alive, Baalveer does not understand how. Tauba Tauba listens to Baalveer's conversation and tries to save Bhayankar Pari. In Prithvi Lok, Montu comes up with a new idea to bully Manav and Meher.

episodesList.title: No Way To Study
episodesList.summary: Mahesh doe not like how his kids are studying and stop them from giving the exam. In Bhayankar Lok, Baalveer has killed Bhayankar Pari and decides to visit Pari Lok and tell the good news to all the fairies. Tauba Tauba is pretending to be sad. Watch now to find out why Tauba Tauba is pretending? Will Manav and Meher give their exams?

episodesList.title: Footprints
episodesList.summary: Before leaving Bhayankar Lok, Baalveer sees Bhayankar Pari's footprints and is shocked to know that she is still alive. He must destroy her before leaving. Baalveer gets to know what Bhayankar Pari is planning. Montu is trying to get famous in school.

episodesList.title: Disappearing Words
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher are shocked and dumbfounded to see that whatever they wrote in the exam has disappeared. Bhayankar Pari distracts Baalveer from killing the Eagle and not let Baalveer get aware of the truth, that her life is connected to it.

episodesList.title: Spirit In The Bottle
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher are sad as Montu pranked them, but this time it was bad, it can cost them their scholarship. Finally, Baalveer kills Bhayankar Pari and captures her spirit in a bottle. Meher calls Baalveer for help. Baalveer travels in time and set things straight.

episodesList.title: Results
episodesList.summary: Baalveer gives the good news to all the fairies. Baal Pari tells Baalveer and all the other fairies that Bhayankar Pari's spirit should be kept in Sarvata Qaidkhana. In Prithvi Lok, the results are about to come and all the students are eagerly waiting, as their scholarship depends on it.

episodesList.title: Sarvata Qaidkhana
episodesList.summary: Montu and his friends are going to teach Manav a lesson, but because of Montu's friends, things get problematic for Montu. Bhayankar Pari's spirits are sent to Sarvata Qaidkhana, but something bad happens over there. Will Baal Pari come out safe? What has happened in Sarvata Qaidkhana? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Bawandar Pari
episodesList.summary: Montu and his friends decide to break Manav's cycle, but Montu himself gets into trouble. Bawandar Pari was released from her bottle in Sarvata Qaidkhana. She and Bhayankar Pari get in an argument and Bhayankar Pari offers her to help in escaping from the Qaidkhana, but Bawander Pari refuses. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Manav's Cycle
episodesList.summary: After getting so many chances from the Pari Lok, Naraz, and Taraz Pari are still supporting Bhayankar Pari. Naraz Pari decides to take Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand. Baalveer helps Dooba Dooba Ek in his task. Manav's cycle goes missing and the cycle race is just around the corner.

episodesList.title: Naraz Pari Tells Taraz Pari About Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Naraz Pari tells Taraz Pari about her plan of getting Bhayankar Pari's Jaadui Rajdand. Bhayankar Pari and Bawandar Pari are still into the argument, and Bhayankar Pari warns Bawandar Pari that she will destroy her. Tauba Tauba goes to release Bhayankar Pari from Sarvata Qaidkhana. Will Tauba Tauba and Naraz Pari succeed in their individual goals?

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Tries To Save Bhayankar Pari
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba tries to save Bhayankar Pari. Naraz Pari and Taraz Pari are waiting outside to ask Bhayankar Pari for her Rajdand. In Prithvi Lok, everyone is getting ready for the cycle race. But Meher with the help of Baalveer finds out that Montu is cheating. Find out if Bhayankar Pari comes out of Qaidkhana. Who will win the race?

episodesList.title: The Cycle Championship
episodesList.summary: The cycle championship is about to begin. Meher outs Montu's secret and he is disqualified. Jadui Rajdand and the winning price of the cycling championship both go missing. Montu accidentally gets hold of Jadui Rajdand. What will Montu do with the Rajdand? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Naraz, Taraz Pari, And Tauba Tauba Are Scared
episodesList.summary: Naraz, Taraz Pari, and Tauba Tauba are scared and looking for Rajdand. Manav is currently on 3rd position in the race. Montu decides to use the Jadui Dand to his advantage and make trouble for Manav. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Montu Enters The Race Again
episodesList.summary: Montu enters the race again and is leading now. He uses the Jadui Dand to make a big barrier for Manav, Baalveer rushes to save Manav. Tauba Tauba comes to Prithvi Lok to find Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand but gets into trouble. Montu is shocked to see Manav again in the race.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Calls All The Fairies On Prithvi Lok
episodesList.summary: Baalveer calls all the fairies on Prithvi Lok and tries to figure out which evil power is troubling the kids. Montu uses Jadui Dand to his advantage and leads the race. He is creating many troubles for Manav, but Manav is safe for now. How will Manav cross the stone wall right in the middle of the road? Will Baalveer come to help? Find out now in this episode.

episodesList.title: Manav Is Safe
episodesList.summary: Manav is still safe with some good superpowers helping him. The race continues and Manav and Montu are in the final round. It's a very close race, they both are inching towards the finish line. All the other fairies are finding the evil power that is troubling the kids. Watch this episode to find out who wins the cycling championship.

episodesList.title: Manav Wins The Race
episodesList.summary: Manav wins the race and Manav and Meher return home with the cycle they won. The whole family is very happy for them. Bawandar Pari tries to escape the Sarvata Qaidkhana. All the fairies and Ballveer gets to know about Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand. Will Tauba Tauba find it before Baalveer destroys it?

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher Spend Time In Their Home
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher spend time in their home. There is drama going on in Dagli house. Baalveer decides to open Sarvata Qaidkhana's gates to find out the evil power that is troubling the kids. Montu uses Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand on Manav and Meher to humiliate them in front of everyone. Will Bawandar Pari escape when Baalveer opens the door?

episodesList.title: Bawandar Pari Escapes
episodesList.summary: As Baalveer opens the door of Qaidkhana, Bawandar Pari escapes. Bhayankar Pari gets angry at Baalveer for making such a huge mistake. Montu in Prithvi Lok uses Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand. Now Baalveer has another powerful villain to fight and save the earth from. Will he succeed?

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher Get A Notice From School
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher get a notice from school. Tauba Tauba is still looking for Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Rajdand. Bawandar Pari is free and makes her first move to destroy everything. There is a huge hurricane and Baalveer must save the kids trapped in it.

episodesList.title: Baalveer In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Baalveer tries to stop the hurricane but Bawandar Pari sees this and does not like it. She increases the power of the hurricane making things difficult for Baalveer. Bawandar Pari visits Pari Lok and decides to steal Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Rajdand. Will Bawandar Pari succeed in her mission?

episodesList.title: Summer Trip
episodesList.summary: All the students are excited about the summer trip and are enjoying it. Bawandar Pari meets Naraz and Taraz Pari in Pari Lok and involves them in her plan. She explains how she plans to destroy Baalveer. Tauba Tauba is still on earth, trying to find the Jadui Dand.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Follows The School Bus
episodesList.summary: The kids are enjoying their trip and having a great time. Tauba Tauba follows the school bus in search of Jadui Dand. Dooba Dooba Ek listens to Bawandar Pari's plan and goes to reveal it to Baal Pari, but Bawandar Pari stops him with her superpowers. Naraz and Taraz Pari are scared that Dooba Dooba will out them.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Is Still Searching
episodesList.summary: Manav, Meher, and Ballu try to solve puzzles on their trip. Montu with his friends plans to harass Manav and Meher by using the Jadui Dand. Tauba Tauba is still searching. Will Tauba Tauba find the Jadui Dand with Montu? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Jadui Dand
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba finds out that Montu has the Jadui Dand and follows him to the resort. Manav is severely punished and Meher is upset because she believes Manav did nothing wrong. Will Baalveer come to know about Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Rajdand and that Montu has it? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Calls Bawandar Pari
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba calls Bawandar Pari and tells her about Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Rajdand. Bawandar Pari comes up with an idea to get it back from Montu. Montu plays a dangerous prank on his teacher and who is stuck in the pool and is struggling. Can Baalveer save the school teacher on time?

episodesList.title: Montu Teaches Ballu A Lesson
episodesList.summary: Montu decides that it's time he teaches Ballu a lesson for always coming in between his plans and save Manav and Meher. There is a musical night going on in summer camp. Ballu gets to perform a task which his teacher does not like. Ballu spots Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand in Montu's hand. What will Ballu do next, will he come as Baalveer and take the Jadui Dand away from Montu?

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Runs Away With Rajdand
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba runs away with Rajdand but struggles to reach Bawandar Lok. Naraz and Taraz Pari visits Bawandar Pari and asks her about her next plan. Meanwhile, the Jadui Rajdand falls back into Montu's hand. Will Baalveer take away Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand from Montu?

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Rajdand
episodesList.summary: Baalveer asks Montu about Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Rajdand. Meher becomes a hen and Tauba Tauba's search for Rajdand begins again. Baalveer tells Meher all about the Rajdand. Naraz and Taraz pari releases Magical Deemak in Pari Lok .

episodesList.title: Baalveer Makes A Plan To Get The Rajdand
episodesList.summary: Baalveer makes a plan to get the Rajdand. He reveals his plan to Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba Ek, Natkhat Pari offers to help. Baalveer and Natkhat Pari disguised as Bunty and Chuimui go to Montu and his friends to take Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand back.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Is Planning Something
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher try to steal the Jadui Rajdand from Montu whereas Tauba Tauba is making his plans. Bunty, Chuimui, and Professor Anokhe execute their plan to trick Montu's friend. Will Baalveer get the Jadui Rajdand? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Meher and Manav Are Stuck!
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher are stuck in mangoes, they call Baalveer for help. Professor Anokhe spots to Bunty in his lab and gets confused. Montu still has Bhayankar Pari's Jadui Dand. Will Tauba Tauba find out about Baalveer's plan?

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Plan
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba holds Dooba Dooba Ek captive and converts into Professor Anokhe. Tauba Tauba gets involved in Baalveer's plan. Baalveer is secretly looking at Professor Anokhe using the magical machine. Dooba Dooba Ek tries to stop all this, but he is tied. Will he be able to help?

episodesList.title: Bawandar Pari Captures Meher
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba successfully takes away Bhayankar Pari's Rajdand. Montu apologizes to Baalveer after Baalveer tells him his plans. Bawandar Pari captures Meher, on seeing this Natkhar Pari is shocked. Will Baalveer save Meher this time? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Gets To Know About Bawandar Pari
episodesList.summary: Bawandar Pari explains to Tauba Tauba that no one can defeat her in Bawandar Lok. Baal Pari tells Baalveer everything about Bawandar Pari and Bawandar Lok. In Manav, Meher's school there is a problem with water shortage.

episodesList.title: Bawandar Pari's Plans
episodesList.summary: The whole city is suffering from water shortage. There is no water in schools or hospitals. Baalveer is called upon to help the people, but he explains how this is against the laws of nature and he cannot do anything. Baalveer talks to Baadal Ji and asks him to make rain happen. Bawandar Pari is making her plans to destroy Baalveer. Watch this episode to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Manav's Birthday
episodesList.summary: Meher makes invitation cards for Manav's birthday, but Montu destroys all of them. Manav and Meher are sad. Baalveer talks to Pradushan and asks it to make way for Baadal, but Pradushan teaches Baalver an important lesson. Naraz and Taraz Pari visit Bawandar Pari with the news.

episodesList.title: Badal Yantra
episodesList.summary: Baalveer tries to convince all the fairies to invent clouds for rain, but all the fairies refuse unanimously because they don't want to go against the laws of nature. Baalveer asks Dooba Dooba Ek to keep an eye on Montu. Natkhat Pari tells all the fairies about her new invention Badal Yantra.

episodesList.title: Manav And Montu Switched?
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari tests her Yantra on Dooba Dooba 4. Manav gets a piece of sad news for his birthday. Dooba Dooba Ek switches Manav's and Montu's bodies. Naraz and Taraz Pari visits Bawandar Pari with new information. All the fairies in Pari Lok are impressed with Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Bawandar Pari's Fight
episodesList.summary: Montu in Manav's body tries to convince his friends that he is the real Montu, but no one believes him. Bawandar Pari comes up with multiple cyclones to fight with the new baadal that fairies from Pari Lok have sent. What will happen to Baalveer and the people on Prithvi Lok? Watch this exciting episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Pariyaa Are Disturbed
episodesList.summary: Manav's family is confused with his behaviour, but he tries to explain to them that he is Montu trapped in Manav's body. Bawandar Pari steals all the clouds sent by Pari Lok with the help of her cyclones. All the fairies in Pari Lok seem disturbed.

episodesList.title: Dooba Dooba Makes A Mistake
episodesList.summary: Baalveer fights Bawandar Pari but nothing happens to her. Baal Pari and Gaal Pari explains to Baalveer how it is impossible to defeat Bawandar Pari in Bawandar Lok. Dooba Dooba Ek realises that he made a mistake. People in dry areas are excepting Baalveer to help them. Will Baalveer live up to their expectations and solve their problem?

episodesList.title: Baalveer To Fight Bawandar Pari?
episodesList.summary: Manav and Montu who are still living in each other's body fight before Manav's birthday and Montu tries to spoils Manav's birthday cake. Baalveer tells everyone in Pari Lok that he is going to fight Bawandar Pari. Everyone wishes a happy birthday to Montu instead of Manav which makes him sad. When will this confusion end and who will end it?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Enters Bawandar Lok
episodesList.summary: Everyone is excited to celebrate Manav's Birthday. Manav takes Ballu's help to teach Montu a lesson. Baalveer enters Bawandar Lok to find out where are the clouds that Bawandar Pari stole and tries to release them.

episodesList.title: The Confusion Continues
episodesList.summary: Manav and Montu's confusion continues. Manav does not like that Montu is getting all the attention oh his birthday. Baalveer is in Bawandar Lok looking for clouds. Baalveer finds the clouds but it is not easy to set them free.

episodesList.title: Is Baalveer Safe ?
episodesList.summary: Montu's friend bullies him unkowlingly. Dooba Dooba Ek who is disguised as Baalveer tells about his mistake to Natkhat Pari. Baalveer is in Bawandar Lok planning to fight Bawandar Pari, but he has to be safe as it is impossible to beat her in Bawandar Lok.

episodesList.title: Manav's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Kids are having a blast in Manav's Birthday who has become Montu. Bawandar Pari chases Baalveer as he was escaping with Black Clouds that she had captured. Bawandar Pari tries to kill Baalveer. Will Baalveer succeed in defeating Bawandar Pari?

episodesList.title: The Rains
episodesList.summary: Kids are having a blast at Manav's Birthday, who has become Montu. Bawandar Pari is chasing Baalveer as he flees the Black Clouds. Meher informs the family that Manav is Montu but nobody believes that. On the other hand, the children and villagers are happy because the rains have arrived.

episodesList.title: Montu's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Montu is angry and he feels he's going to get revenge from Manav, Manav listens and gets scared of him. All the Paris celebrates the Maha Mangal Parv in Pari Lok, where Naraz and Taraz Pari listen to them. After many alerts, Montu decides to teach Manav an unforgettable lesson.

episodesList.title: Manav Gets Trapped
episodesList.summary: Manav gets trapped by Montu and his gang, Manav makes a fool of him and manages to escape, Bhayankar Pari returns and Mahesh reveals good news to all his family members. The Paris of Pari Lok manage to cure Rani Pari, who was heavily punished by Bhayankar Pari.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Succeeds In Finding Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari finally finds Baalveer but is unable to kidnap him because he is protected by Rani Pari's shield. In Pari Lok, Naraz and Taraz Pari request Rani Pani to give them their power back, but Rani Pari disagrees. Will Baalveer be safe? Will Rani Pari know about what Naraz and Taraz did?

episodesList.title: Montu Becomes A Honeybee
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari sends Nara and Taraz Pari as her informant to Pari Lok in exchange of protection from Rani Pari. Meanwhile, Montu is scared after what he dreamt. Tauba Tauba comes with new information on what kids like and reveals them to Bhayankar Pari. Will the kids become friends? What will Bhayankar Pari do with this new knowledge?

episodesList.title: Meher Demands An Unique Gift
episodesList.summary: Meher asks her father for a mobile phone on her birthday, but he refuses. Meher requests Baalveer to convince her father, but he also refuses, but Baalveer with the help of Natkhat Pari gets her a gift. The Dangli's decide that they will celebrate Ballu's birthday on the same day as Meher's. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari is coming up with her new plan.

episodesList.title: Meher Is Mesmerized
episodesList.summary: On the morning of Meher's birthday she gets a gift from Baalveer and likes it, but still demands a mobile phone from him. Baalveer accidentally reveals his secret in front of the whole family. And Bhayankar Pari has found her way to Baalveer's school.

episodesList.title: Manav's Dadaji Lands In Deep Trouble
episodesList.summary: Dagli house is busy in the preparations of Meher and Ballu's birthday later, Dadaji lands himself in trouble, but Baalveer saves him. On the other side, Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba organize an event in the school and are distributing their Mobile phones. Meher wins the competition and is very happy to finally have gotten a mobile. Will this evil mobile bring trouble for Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Preparation Of Giant Cake In Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: All the fairies are preparing to celebrate Baalver's birthday in Pari Lok for the first time, Baalveer is happy to join them and help. Meanwhile, Bhayankar Pari starts her evil plan of capturing kids through a phone call and keeping them in Bhayank Lok. Her next target is Meher. Will Meher pick up her phone from an unknown caller?

episodesList.title: Kesari Accepts Balwaan's Challenge
episodesList.summary: Mahesh's family is super excited to celebrate Meher's and Ballu's birthday. Montu and his friends make fun of the cake made by Meher's mother, seeing this Ballu comes as Baalveer and teaches them a nice lesson in front of everyone. Celebrations are going on in Pari Lok also, but in Bhayanak Lok, Bhayankar Pari captures more kids.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Kidnaps Meher
episodesList.summary: Baalveer goes to Pari Lok to celebrate his birthday, everyone is very happy. Meher gets a call from Tauba Tauba on her mobile, despite Baalveer's attempts Meher picks up the phone and is trapped in Bhayanak Lok. She is scared and helpless. Can Baalveer save her? Will Meher tell Bhayankar Pari about Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Tortures Meher
episodesList.summary: News breaks out that kids are disappearing. Meher's family is in shock. Manav figures out something about disappearing kids. In Bhayank Lok, Bhayankar Pari persuades Meher to call Baalveer to Bhayanak Lok. Will Meher call Baalveer to Bhayanak Lok? How will Baalveer save all of them and Meher?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Enters Bhayankar Lok
episodesList.summary: Meher's family is really worried about her, meanwhile, Baal Pari gets the news that Baalveer has gone somewhere and she also gets worried. Baalveer visits Bhayanak Lok to save Meher and other kids and comes across Tauba Tauba and Bhayankar Pari. Watch this episode to find out, what will happen when Bhayankar Pari and Baalveer come face to face?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Is Trapped In Bhayanak Lok
episodesList.summary: Baalveer fights Bhayankar Pari. Everyone in Pari Lok comes to know that Baalveer is missing with other kids. Baal Pari is praying that Baalveer is safe and misses him. Bhayankar Pari makes Baalveer her captive. How will Baalveer free himself? Or will Rani Pari come to save everyone? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Manav and Meher Grown Up
episodesList.summary: Mahesh and Smita are surprised to see Manav and Meher growing up all of a sudden. Meher becomes a Teacher, and Manav becomes an honest Lawyer. All the family members are surprised to see Meher and Manav's tranformation. Montu enters the school, who has also grown old.

episodesList.title: Builder Montu Lakhani
episodesList.summary: With Manav and Meher, Mahesh goes to school. Mahesh gets surprised to see children, and he thinks there must be a fancy dress competition in the school. Builder Montu Lakhani warns Meher, not only is Mahesh upset with Manav and Meher's behaviour, but the city's parents are also upset as children have suddenly grown up.

episodesList.title: Meher's School To Get Demolished
episodesList.summary: Montu decides to demolish Meher 's School, Meher tells builder Montu Lakhani that she will take strict measures against him if he breaks the school. RaniPari reveals to Paris that Bhayankar Pari has used black evil air on children to make them older, Natkhat Pari shares the incident with Rani Pari.

episodesList.title: Smita And Mahesh Are Worried
episodesList.summary: Mahesh is upset because of the change in children. Manav and Meher run to meet Mahesh on the road to which he gets mad at them. Smita and Mahesh are worried for their children as they have grown up before age. Rani Pari reveals to Baalveer that he's going to find a solution in Brahm Lok, but he's trapped in the solution. Just then Mahamaai comes and warns him to leave the Brahm Lok.

episodesList.title: Pavitra Hawa
episodesList.summary: Mahamaai comes there and warns him to leave from Brahm Lok. The Woman who trapped Baalveer gets impressed by him and tells him about Pavitra Hawa. The parents are worried about kids. Montu Lakhani becomes a Baba as all the kids grow old.

episodesList.title: Ghamnadi Parvat
episodesList.summary: Baalveer gets acquainted with Ghamnadi Parvat and also succeeds in solving the problem of the mountains. At Brahmlok, Ghamandi Parvat breaks down and now he's going to have to pass a second test. Here in school, the children started a hunger strike against Montu to save the school.

episodesList.title: The Sunhera Moti
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has reached the 2nd Sunehra Moti of Khatru Pakshi. Mahamaai tells him he's got to acquire the 3rd Sunehra Moti and he's got a lot of time for that. He's got to defeat the Danav to get the 3rd and the last Moti.

episodesList.title: Baalveer VS Danav
episodesList.summary: Baalveer asks Danav for 3rd Sunehra Moti and a fight takes place between Baalveer and Danav. Montu gets ill while Mahamaai succeeds in identifying the real Sunehra Moti which was twinkling on the Mountain.

episodesList.title: Bharti's Magic Show
episodesList.summary: Comedian Bharti and Jhumroo show their magic skills and show the viewers a magic show like never seen before. Bhayankar Pari is asking Naraz and Taraz to steal her dand from Pari Lok. A big box lands in theMsahesh's house. They're all surprised, two kids are in troble because of their mom, Baalveer comes to their rescue.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Manav And Meher
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher are surprised to meet Bharti Masi, who assures them she will teach them new magic tricks. Bhatri Masi teases Mahesh, Bhart becomes Lalli and sits on Mahesh. Tauba Tauba is coming back to Bhayankar lok, Bhayankar Pari is shocked to see him again.

episodesList.title: Bharti Teaches Magic
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba become kids as they want to find out the truth in Manav's House. Mahesh tries to escape from there just then Bharti catches him, Naraz and Taraz Pari try to get to know about Bhayankar Pari's dand. Bhayankar Pari gets to know that Ballu is Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Master Plan
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari kidnaps Bharti Maasi. Baalveer reveals his master plan as he doesn't want to return the Jaadui Dand.

episodesList.title: A Special Gift
episodesList.summary: Bharti Maasi talks about Mahesh and Smita's marriage. Rani Pari punishes both of them and makes them birds. Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba are coming to earth, and Baalveer sees them doing so . Bharti is going to be Lalli again.

episodesList.title: Bharti And Meher Goes Missing
episodesList.summary: Bharti Maasi and Meher are abducted by Bhayankar Pari. When Bharti reaches Bhayanak Lok she suffers a loss of memory but she suddenly gets her memory back. Meher is trying to handle the show as they were all eagerly waiting for Bharti 's arrival. Baalveer is trying to find out the truth.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Reveals His Plan
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari transforms Dooba Dooba into Meher, Meher comes out of the box, Bharti becomes Lalli again and troubles Tauba Tauba as he screams. Mahesh is going to find Ballu and Bharti, Mahesh is going to find Ballu. Rani Pari is planning to fight with Bhayankar Pari.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Escapes From Rani Pari's Trap
episodesList.summary: Baalveer comes to Bhayankar Lok and meets Bhayankar Pari to get her jadui dand. Rocky Chachu informs all the members, they all come to the room and found Ballu and Meher there. Just when Bhayankar Pari was about to get Jaadui Raj Dand, she is trapped by Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Revealed Identity
episodesList.summary: Bharti Masi and Meher are coming home with Baalveer, just then Rocky Chachu comes into the room and sees two Ballu and two Meher, Bharti Maasi is coming to know that Ballu is Baalveer. Bhayankar Pari uses her jadui dand and scares Tauba Tauba, and says she's going to spread chaos now.

episodesList.title: Asal Shakal Chitra Yantran
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba is trying to convince Bhayankar Pari that Ballu is only Baalveer. Natkhat Pari shows Asal Shakal Chitra Yantran to Dooba Dooba 1 and Bhayankar Pari. Tauba Tauba gets to know about Naraz and Taraz Pari in Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Begins His Investigation
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba has entered Manav's house to click Ballu's photo with Asal Shakal Chitra Yantra. He transforms himself into a raddiwala. Rani Pari announces that Naraz and Taraz Pari will soon regain their powers. Tauba has the proof that Ballu is Baalveer only.

episodesList.title: Meher Fights With Montu
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba becomes raddiwala and comes to the Dagli family and clicks a photo of the Baalveer with the asal shakal khichu yantra that he stole from the Dooba Dooba 1. Montu steals Meher 's special Rakhi, but apparently this doesn't go too well with Meher. Bhayankar Pari transforms Tauba Tauba into a woman, and then clicks Tauba Taubah 's photo.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Confronts Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: Manav and Ballu teach Montu a lesson as he was about to destroy Meher's Rakhi. Natkhat Pari reveals Rani Pari's chitra yantra. Tauba Tauba turns into a child and goes to the dagli family to see if Ballu is Balveer. All Pari get frightened that if Bhayankar Pari had known about Baalveer then it was risky for Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Baalveer To Leave Earth
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari says that Baalveer must leave saat sacho ka parivaar for their safety. Ballu's Chacha in Pari Lok. Baalveer trains the Chacha. Baal Pari reveals to Baalveer that the time has come for him to leave Manav's family. The children are calling for Baalveer. Ballu has transformed into Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Meher's Plea To Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: Manav, Meher and other children are saved by Baalveer. Ballu's Chacha reveals to Mahesh and his family that he wants to take Ballu to Dubai forever. Meher's special request to Rani Pari- Bhayankar Pari is to speak with Tauba Tauba once atleast.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Traps Ballu
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari grants Baalveer one more day to spend some time with Manav and Meher 's family. Baalveer gets trapped in the evil circle. On the occasion of rakhi, Santa Clause comes to Pari lok. Everyone is told by Baalveer's chacha that ballu will not go until rakhi.

episodesList.title: Rakshabandhan Brings Ballu Home
episodesList.summary: Meher ties Rakhi to Ballu. Manav and Baalveer save Dooba Dooba Ek from the trap of Bhayankar Pari. Meher is going to be emotional and celebrate Rakshabandhan Day with Ballu. Suddenly, she sees the rakhi that she tied to the balloon and was shocked.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Punishes Ballu's Uncle
episodesList.summary: Montu and his friends are listening to Manav and Meher who say that Ballu is Baalveer. Tauba Tauba also listens to them, and informs Bhayankar Pari. Santa Claus is trying to cheer up Baalveer and reveals his Christmas plan as well.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Reveals Ballu's Secret
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari traps Montu, Rohit and Keval-Manav. Meher, Montu, Rohit and Keval are severely punished by Bhayankar Pari. Mahesh and smita and rocky go to meet ballu, just then ballu's chacha comes there and tells them that his hut has flown away, and all the kids were inside. Bhayankar Pari starts fire in the huts, kids get frightened, all the kids are calling Baalveer to save them.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Vs Baalveer
