episodesList.title: Ronnie To Sabotage Manav's Performance
episodesList.summary: Ronnie disturbs Manav during his performance in the dance round of the middle school captain competition, Ronnie wins the round, furthermore he plans to cheat in the quiz round as well, Meher comes to know about Ronnie's intensions and tries to call Baalveer for help.

episodesList.title: Quiz Competition In School
episodesList.summary: Meher tries calling Baalveer to complain about Ronnie but Baalveer doesn't respond. There is a tie breaker in the quiz round between Ronnie and Manav. Tauba Tauba arrives at Rani Mahal and addresses Rani Pari as Bhayankar Pari. Will all the angels come to know that Bhayankar Pari is disguised as Rani Pari? Who will win the quiz round?

episodesList.title: Jaiveer Gets Special Powers
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari convinces Baal Pari to give Baalveer's magical stick to Jaiveer. Baalveer's and Jaiveer's sticks get interchanged. Ronnie and Manav prepare themselves for the last round of the competition. Who will win? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Race Day In School
episodesList.summary: All the angels are shocked when they come to know that Bhayankar Pari is disguised as Rani Pari and they try attacking her but they are stopped by Jaiveer. Ronnie applies chipku gum at Manav's starting line. The race begins, everyone starts running but Manav is stuck at the starting line. Who will win the last round of the competition? Will it be Manav or Ronnie?

episodesList.title: Winner Announcement
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari captures all the angels and brings them to Rani Mahal, she orders all the angels to obey her orders. Sir announces that there is going to be a voting round between Manav and Ronnie to decide the winner, Ronnie tries bribing the children. Who will be the middle school captain? Keep watching to find out!

episodesList.title: Voting For Captain
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari suggests all the angels to steal Bhayankar Pari's magical stick. Ronnie falls off the stage, he tries to hit Ballu. Who will win the middle school captain competition? Will the angels succeed in stealing the magical stick?

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Attacks Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: Baal Pari manages to steal Bhayankar Pari's magical stick and goes to the Pawan River to unbound Rani Pari. Jaiveer and Bhayankar Pari follow Baal Pari. Ronnie replaces the actual box of the voting results with a fake one. Will Ronnie win the competition? Watch the episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Teacher Declares The Captain
episodesList.summary: Meher checks the voting box and finds out that Ronnie had given money to the peon to change the ballot box. To get rid of all the sufferings caused by Bhayankar Pari, Baal pari calls the Golden Chariot and orders it to take all the angels to Divya lok. Will all the angels succeed in escaping?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Returns
episodesList.summary: All the angels are distressed by the sufferings caused by Bhayankar Pari, Naraz Pari leaves all the angels and goes with Bhayankar Pari. A fishermen finds a boy on the seashore and they find that he is alive. Watch the episode to witness the disclosure of all the events!

episodesList.title: Jaiveer's Wicked Mission
episodesList.summary: Everyone at the Dagli house is in despair with the news of Baalveer's demise. Jaiveer tries to explain Bhayankar Pari why he saved Manav's life. Shanta thinks that the boy they found on the seashore is her son.

episodesList.title: Jaiveer's Evil Side
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has forgotten everything and is in a confused state of mind. All the children decide to go for Baalveer's peace march but Ronnie tries stopping them. Baal Pari hopes that Baalveer comes back and saves them from their misery. Will Baalveer get back his memory? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: Dev's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Ronnie befriends Jaiveer. Ballu, Manav and all the children come for Baalveer's peace march. Jaiveer tries to stop all the children from participating in the peace march. Deva is a bit perplexed to hear the name Manav.

episodesList.title: Happy Singh's New Project
episodesList.summary: Deva runs to find Manav on hearing his name, Deva is also a bit confused about how does he have these powers? With the intensions to disrupt the peace march Jaiveer pretends to help the children. Will Jaiveer succeed in disrupting the peach march? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Hit And Miss Situation Of Baalveer And Manav
episodesList.summary: On seeing Manav, Deva recollects that he's seen him before. All the angels are in despair because of Bhayankar Pari. Baal Pari informs all the angels there are many secret ways to go out of Pari Lok. Bapuji informs everyone that the house is mortgaged.

episodesList.title: Naraz Pari's Escape Plan
episodesList.summary: Naraz Pari assures all the angels that she will help them. All the angels think of an idea to get their magical sticks back. Happy Singh arrives to take the possession of the house. The Dagli family has only 2 days to save their home. How will the family come out of this tensed situation?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Gets Kidnapped
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari instructs Naraz Pari to hurt all the angels. Kidnappers kidnap Deva, Ballu hides in the trunk of the car secretly. Bapuji talks to the manager of the bank to help him save his house. Will Bapuji able to save his house somehow? Keep watching to witness the story unfold!

episodesList.title: Return Of Montu
episodesList.summary: All the angels prepare a strategy to escape Pari Lok. Ballu tells Manav that he saw Baalveer. Montu comes back and asks Jaiveer to punish Manav, Jaiveer throws Manav and he starts to fall crying for help. Will Manav fall down and get injured or someone will help him?

episodesList.title: Spiderman Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Manav calls Rani Pari and asks her for help. Mahesh realizes that the door of his house is locked from outside, Bapuji calls the police. Bhayankar Pari sends Jaiveer to trouble Manav and his family and decides to acquire all the powers from Shastra Ghar into her magical stick.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Tries To Recollect
episodesList.summary: The police rejects Bapuji's complain to arrest Happy Singh. Naraz Pari and Natkhat Pari go to the Shastra ghar to collect all magical sticks but while exiting they see Bhayankar Pari. Happy Singh forces Mahesh and Bapuji out of the house. Ballu goes on searching for Baalveer

episodesList.title: Happy Singh's Final Warning
episodesList.summary: All the angels are tensed and waiting for Naraz Pari and Natkhat Pari to return from the Shastra Ghar. While playing cricket Deva hits the ball so hard that it reaches Pari Lok. Baal Pari is pleased to realise that Baalveer might be still alive.

episodesList.title: Naraz Pari Finds The Jaadui Dand
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba informs Bhayankari Pari about the plans of all the angels. Bapuji and Mahesh are tensed to know that the Bank is closed. How will they save their house? Will Bhayankar Pari disrupt the escape plan made by the angels?

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari To Kill Natkhat Pari
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari attacks all the angels, Natkhat Pari escapes and comes to Prithvi Lok. Deva's father convinces him that he's their son. Happy Singh arrives to take the house. Will the Dagli family have to give up their house?

episodesList.title: Happy Singh Raids Manav's House
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari orders all the angels to accept her as their Rani Pari. Natkhat Pari meets Dooba Dooba 1 and they decide to save Dagli family's house. Dooba Dooba 1 disguises himself as a lawyer. Will Natkhat Pari and Dooba Dooba 1 succeed in saving the Dagli house?

episodesList.title: Rani Pari Returns
episodesList.summary: Jaiveer tells Bhayankar Pari that all the angel's strength is their unity and it should be broken. Baalveer gets his memory back. Bhayankar Pari is furious to know that Baalveer is alive. Will Baalveer save the angels? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Rony Gets Badly Beaten Up
episodesList.summary: Ronnie, Rohit and Keval make a plan to trouble Manav. New Rani Pari arrives. Rani Pari and Baalveer decide to go to Bhayank Lok to kill Bhayankar Pari. Will Baalveer and the new Rani Pari able to defeat Bhayankar Pari?

episodesList.title: Montu Challenges Rony
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and Rani Pari attack Jaiveer and Bhayankar Pari, an intense battle commences between them. Montu warns Ronnie to stop harassing the school children. PT teacher suggests a boxing match between Ronnie and Montu. Who will win the boxing match?

episodesList.title: School Bus Goes Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: Ronnie and Montu start practising for the boxing match. Bhayankar Pari damages the breaks of a school bus. Will Baalveer be able to save the children in the bus? Will Ronnie cheat to win the boxing match? Stay tuned to find out!

episodesList.title: The Boxing Match
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari goes to Pari Lok and starts destroying everything. Ronnie plans to cheat in the boxing match by using gloves that are controlled by his trainer. Montu faints in the match, what happened to Montu?

episodesList.title: Montu Fights A Losing Battle
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari leaves Rani Mahal on the verge of destruction and plans to poison all the angels with a special poison. Montu is about to give up, but Manav and all the children encourage him. Manav and Vaani call Baalveer for help. Will Montu loose the match?

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Shares Her Plan
episodesList.summary: Baalveer stops the fight and tells everyone about Ronnie's cheating. Rohit and Keval ask for Montu's forgiveness. Bhayankar Pari meets Zehreeli Maya asks her for a transparent poison. Rani Pari thinks of an idea to protect Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Rani Pari Trapped In Satrangi Jungle
episodesList.summary: Montu harasses Manav and Vaani, they call Baalveer for help. Rani Pari decides to give Maha Ghajni the responsibility to protect Pari Lok. Maha Ghajni traps all the angels. Keep watching to witness the story unfold!

episodesList.title: Mahagajhini's Final Decision
episodesList.summary: All the angels unbound each other and they ask Maha Ghajni to protect them. Mahesh brings Girpade to find a home for Gajanand. Zehreeli Maya makes the transparent poison and gives it to Bhayankar Pari.

episodesList.title: Mighty Raju Meets Manav
episodesList.summary: Montu comes and stops everyone from playing, Mighty Raju comes there and stops Montu. Gajanand calls and informs that he is coming tomorrow. Bhayankar Pari checks the tansparent poison. Will Bhayankar Pari succeed in her cruel intensions?

episodesList.title: Dhoke Ka Vaar
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari goes to pour poison in the river. Mahesh shows his house to Gajanand and his family. Shubhangee and Smita pour daal on Bapuji's head, Shubhangee gives chipku gum instead of a shampoo to clean Bapuji's head. Watch the episode to join the laughter and madness!

episodesList.title: Pari Lok's Protector
episodesList.summary: Bapuji is furious to know that he was given a chipku gum instead of a shampoo to clean his hair, everyone decides to boil Bapuji's hair. Rani Pari announces that Maha Ghajni is the new Suraksha Karmi of Pari Lok. Bhayakar Pari instructs Tauba Tauba to find Maha Ghajni's weakness.

episodesList.title: Mahagajhini Plays Football
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba informs Bhayankar Pari that Gajju is Maha Ghajni's weakness, Bhayankar Pari decides to kidnap Gajju. Mahesh finds a solution to help Bapuji. Will Mahesh be able to help Bapuji come out of his misery?

episodesList.title: Babuji's Hair Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Bapuji is tired of his pointed hair, All the children suggest an idea to help Bapuji. Bhayankar Pari makes a plan to kidnap Gajju and put the blame on Rani Pari. Bhayankar Pari and Tauba Tauba arrive at the border of Pari Lok to gauge Maha Ghajni's security.

episodesList.title: A New Member In Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: Montu, Rohit and Keval trouble Saloni and push her in the mud. All the angels alert Maha Ghajni from Bhayankar Pari. Maha Ghajni and Baalveer don't recognize each other and attack each other. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari Monitors Gajju's Progress
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari gives a box to Tauba Tauba and sends him to Pari Lok. All the angels are shocked seeing black clouds and smoke in Pari Lok, Gajju runs away and the black clouds follow him. What is Bhayankar Pari's strategy to kidnap Gajju? Will she succeed?

episodesList.title: Gajju Is Missing
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari kidnaps Gajju, all the angels call Baalveer for help. Montu threatens Manav that he should stop Sachin from troubling him or else Manav will suffer, Manav tries calling Baalveer. Sir introduces Gajanand Sir to the all the students.

episodesList.title: Kidnapped Gajju
episodesList.summary: Montu tells Rohit and Keval about his plan to create a rift between Manav and Sachin. All the angels inform Maha Ghajni about Gajju's disappearance. Rani Pari assures Maha Ghajni that they will bring Gajju back to her. Will Rani Pari succeed in keeping her promise?

episodesList.title: Gajju Is Trapped In Bhayanak Lok
episodesList.summary: Montu's plan works and Manav and Sachin begin competing and fighting for everything. Tauba Tauba and Bhayankar Pari make a plan to disguise themselves as Gajju and Rani Pari and go to Maha Ghajni. What is Bhayankar Pari's new strategy?

episodesList.title: Mahagajhini's Attack
episodesList.summary: Kuku is tensed to find out that someone has added extra chilli powder in his food. Montu decides to break Manav and Sachin's project. Maha Ghajni is informed that Rani Pari has hidden Gajju. What would be Maha Ghajni's reaction when she is informed about this?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Protects Parilok
episodesList.summary: Maha Ghajni attacks Baalveer and all the angels and decides to come to Prithvi Lok to hurt the children. Montu tricks Manav and Sachin and breaks their project. Maha Ghajni comes to Prithvi Lok and starts destroying everything.

episodesList.title: Mahagajhini's Attack On Planet Earth
episodesList.summary: All the children are frightened of Maha Ghajni and are running to save their lives. A few children fall in a hole, Manav helps Sachin to come out of the hole. Everyone at the Dagli house is shocked to see this news. What will happen now? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Baalveer Vs Mahagajhini
episodesList.summary: Manav and Sachin become friends again. Baalveer tries to stop and calm Maha Ghajni but instead she hits Baalveer and he falls on the ground unconscious. The Police start firing bullets on Maha Ghajni. Will they succeed in stoping Maha Ghajni without Baalveer?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Has A Plan
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and and all the angels find out that Gajju is jailed in Pari Lok. Baalveer disguised as Tauba Tauba goes to Bhayankar Pari. Bhayankar Pari informs all the angels that as soon as Baalveer touches the jail there will be a huge fire in the cave that will burn Baalveer and Gajju.

episodesList.title: Gajju Trapped In Fire
episodesList.summary: Baalveer tries to free Gajju from the cage but instead it leads to a huge fire around Gajju. Gajju tells Baalveer to go to the coulourful jungle and get his ball. Maha Ghajni arrives at Pari Lok and assures Gajju that she will save him. Will Baalveer and Maha Ghajni succeed in getting Gajju out of the fire alive?

episodesList.title: Sachin Lands In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Baalveer asks Maha Ghajni to put off the fire using the water from her trunk. Sachin spills food on P.T sir by mistake, Montu applies Maha chipku gum on the pipe and Sachin's hand gets stuck. Watch this episode to laugh your heart out!

episodesList.title: Mr. Iyer's Unique Invention
episodesList.summary: Montu scares all the children. Gajanand meets his friend Chatur, he gives his a gadget and tells him to take care of it. The children decide to teach Montu a lesson using the gadget. What is this new gadget? Watch the episode to find out!

episodesList.title: Brahmhan Pari's Revenge
episodesList.summary: Sachin becomes invisible after wearing the gadget and hits Montu and asks him to stop harassing the children. Brahman Pari disguised as Dooba Dobba 1 comes to Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Brahmhan Pari's Plan
episodesList.summary: Shubhangi becomes invisible after wearing the gadget, Sachin convinces Shubhangi to remove it. Brahman Pari disguised as Dooba Dooba 1 comes and saves Baal Pari from an accident and asks for a gift. He asks for a gift that everyone is shocked upon hearing. What is this gift?

episodesList.title: Dooba Dooba Ek Demands Special Powers
episodesList.summary: Montu starts helping all the school children because of the fear of Bura Samay. Rani Pari tells everyone that the Darpan Diksha has to be performed with Baal Pari and Dooba Dooba 1. Will Brahman Pari succeed in acquiring all the powers of Baal Pari? Watch the episode to find out

episodesList.title: Montu Follows Bura Samay
episodesList.summary: Montu comes to know that Bura Samay is Sachin. Montu thinks that Saloni's hairband is the gadget so he wears it and believes he's invisible. Bhrahman Pari goes to Bhayankar Pari after acquiring all the powers of Baal Pari.

episodesList.title: Baalveer To Save Baal Pari
episodesList.summary: Montu gets hold of the invisible gadget and starts troubling Manav and Sachin. Baal Pari gets the sand disease and slowly starts turning into sand, Baalveer plans to cure Baal Pari by performing Darpan Diksha while Bhayankar Pari plans to acquire all the powers of Baalveer through the same process. Will Baalveer be able to cure Baal Pari or loose all his powers in the process?

episodesList.title: Montu's Explosive Plan
episodesList.summary: Montu becomes invisible and throws ink on sir and starts harsassing all the students. Manav calls Baalveer and tells him everything. Cookie hits a ball on Montu's face, he decides to make all the children's face black using black bomb.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Mesmerized
episodesList.summary: Montu exchanges the tennis balls, Cookie hits the ball towards Montu, Rohit and Keval. Baalveer takes Baal Pari and Dooba Dooba 1 to see Imagica and asks Rani Pari to take the children as well. Will Rani Pari allow him? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Imagica Competition In School
episodesList.summary: Baalveer thinks of an idea to take the children to Imagica, the children get free passes. Priya tells all the children to be present by 10 am at Imagica. Montu decides to stop all the children from reaching there before 10am.

episodesList.title: Montu Plans Again
episodesList.summary: All the children get ready to go to Imagica. Montu makes a plan to stop the children by puncturing the tyre of the bus. Bhayankar Pari shows Tauba Tauba a new instrument to get Baalveer's magical wand. What is this new intrument? Will the children reach Imagica on time?

episodesList.title: Manav And Gang In Imagica
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba disguised as Dooba Dooba 1 comes to Pari Lok to find Baalveer but he comes to know that Baalveer is in Imagica. Tauba Tauba tries to enter Imagica but is enable to do so because of Suraksha Kawach.

episodesList.title: Baalveer And Manav Trapped In Boat
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari makes a hole in the ground and enters Imagica. Bhayankar Pari takes Manav under her control and tries to hurt him. Bhayankar Pari traps Baalveer and all the children through Suraksha Kawach and plans to take them to Bhayanak Lok. Will she succeed in her intensions or Baalveer will find a way out? Watch this thrilling episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Vs Bhayankar Pari
episodesList.summary: An intense battle commences between Baalveer and Bhayankar Pari. There is a blast and Baalveer becomes unconscious and his magical wand disappears. How will Baalveer save the children and defeat Bhayankar Pari without his magical wand? Only one way to find out, watch the episode now!

episodesList.title: Retila Danav Returns
episodesList.summary: Manav and Bapuji's teeth start paining, Manav is frightened because of a bad dream. Bhayankar Pari decides to wake up the sand monster to destroy Pari Lok. Baalveer attacks Bhayankar Pari and Gaal Pari tries to capture her. Will they succeed in saving Pari Lok this time?

episodesList.title: Gaal Pari Spills The Truth
episodesList.summary: Manav fakes that he has fever to avoid going to the Dentist. Gaal Pari tells Baalveer about the truth of his life, Baalveer gets shocked to know his real identity, he decides to confront Baal Pari. What is Baalveer's real identity? Tune in to find out!

episodesList.title: Dant Pari's Magic
episodesList.summary: Montu tries to break Manav's teeth but Dant Pari punishes him. Montu takes an oath to break Manav's teeth. Bhayankar Pari decides to attack Baal Pari to hurt Baalveer. All the angels explain Baalveer why didn't they tell him the truth earlier.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari To Steal Jeevan Shakti Tara
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari decides to attack Baal Pari from Bhayanak Lok using Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara. Bhayankar Pari disguised as Baalveer goes to Pari Lok, she plays a game to deceive Baal Pari so that the first door can be opened.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari To Enter Tilismi Parvat
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari disguised as Baalveer gets Baal Pari's Jeevan Rekha and her hair required to open the gates of Tilasmi Mountain. Bhayankar Pari goes To Tilasmi Mountain to get Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara. Will Bhayankar Pari succeed in getting it?

episodesList.title: Montu Breaks Manav's Teeth
episodesList.summary: Montu makes a plan to trap Manav, Montu tries to break Manav's Teeth. Mahamayi decides To inform all the angels about Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara but Bhayankar Pari arrives and turns her into stone. Will Bhayankar Pari win this time?

episodesList.title: Tooth Fairy Punishes Montu
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari instructs Tauba Tauba to get Asatya Jal and she puts Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara inside it. Natkhat Pari shows all the angels her new invention of Magical Medicines, they decide to try the medicines on Dooba Dooba 1. What effect would the medicines have on him?

episodesList.title: Dant Pari Has A Task For Montu
episodesList.summary: Baal Pari strikes Dooba Dooba 1 and he falls down, all the angels are shocked to see Baal Pari's behaviour. Dant Pari And Dantu give Montu some special powers and ask him to convince Manav to believe in Tooth Fairy and get his teeth in two days.

episodesList.title: Montu's Plan In Dental Clinic
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari arrives at Pari Lok and takes Baal Pari under her control. Bapuji and Manav go to the Dentist, Montu comes there and takes Bapuji's teeth instead of Manav's. Bhayankar Pari orders Baal Pari to attack Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Baal Pari's Devilish Plan
episodesList.summary: Montu calls Dant Pari to give her Manav's teeth but they find out that it is Bapuji's teeth. Baal Pari catches Baalveer and she makes a valley of fire below Baalveer and drops him into it. Will Baalveer survive?

episodesList.title: Baal Pari's Satya Jal Pariksha
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari checks Baal Pari using Satya Jal and finds out that Baal Pari has become a Buri Pari and orders her to leave Pari Lok. Mahamayi informs all the angels and Baalveer that Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara is with Bhayankar Pari.

episodesList.title: Naraz Pari's Solution
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari informs Baalveer and all the angels that Baal Pari has to leave Pari Lok and tells Baalveer that the only way to save Baal Pari is to get Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara from Bhayankar Pari. Bhayankar Pari decides to go to Vinash Lok.

episodesList.title: Tooth Fairy Meets Manav
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari gives Jeevan Sitara to Baalveer which can be used only once in Vinash Lok. Baal Veer is on his way to Vinash Lok to acquire Baal Pari's Jeevan Shakti Tara.

episodesList.title: Baalveer In Vinash Lok
episodesList.summary: In the class, Manav sees Nitin who was very sad because he was removed for non-payment of fees from the school. Manav decides to help Nitin. Baalveer comes to Vinash Lok and sees a road ahead of the chessboard. Baalveer tries to go ahead, but he is attacked by Bhayankar Pari. Baalveer uses tree branches and crosses the road. Bhayankar Pari is angry and shocked.

episodesList.title: Pushtal Vishaili Challenges Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Baalveer meets Pushtal Vishaili in Vinash Lok who challenges him to fight. Manav decides not to reveal the truth about the school fees that is been given to him by his mother, Urmila.

episodesList.title: Bhayankar Pari's Vajra Danav
episodesList.summary: Cat woman becomes a hurdle in Baalveer's way but he requests her not to fight with him as he is on a very important mission. Bhayankar Pari has found her last and deadly warrior, Vajra Danav to kill Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Fights Vajra Danav
episodesList.summary: Vajra Danav and Baalveer fight and he tries to kill him. Bhayanak Pari still has an ace up her sleeve, as she instructs him to kill Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Manav's Chat Mission
episodesList.summary: Manav and his gang come up with an interesting plan to impress the public. Baalveer uses his special power in Vinash Lok and traps Bhayankar Pari. Manav's parents and teachers come to know about their secret plan.

episodesList.title: Panic On Planet Earth
episodesList.summary: Bhayankar Pari takes it to another level by coming up with even more dangerous plan to not only destroy Baalveer but also Planet Earth.

episodesList.title: Return Of Mahabhasma Pari
episodesList.summary: Mahabhasma Pari has returned to destroy Pari Lok. Rani Pari reveals to angels that rebirth of Mahabhasma Pari is next to impossible as she is dead.

episodesList.title: Manav's Secret Operation
episodesList.summary: Superheroes of Daggli family are on a secret mission. 2 big powers clash with each other in Bhayanak Lok. Mahabhasm Pari forces Bhayankar Pari to obey her orders and takes help of Manbadal Titli.

episodesList.title: Danav Lok
episodesList.summary: Mahabhasm Pari announces that she will open the doors to Danav lok and tells her evil plan to Tauba Tauba. Baalveer teaches an unforgettable lesson to Montu.

episodesList.title: Search For A Child
episodesList.summary: Teacher takes Montu's mobile as he was playing in the classroom with it. Montu goes to find his mobile inside the staff room, but Baalveer comes and punishes Montu, Rohit and Keval. Meanwhile, Mahabhasm Pari is searching for a Kid who is born on 8-08 at 8:08 am.

episodesList.title: Mahabhasm Pari Hijacks Plane
episodesList.summary: Mahabhasm Pari comes to know that the Child who was born on 8-08 at 8:08 am is travelling in the plane and so she decides to hijack the plane.

episodesList.title: Plane Imbalances
episodesList.summary: All the kids travelling with Meher in the plane are scared to see Mahabhasm Pari. Mahabhasam Pari finally finds the kid she was in search of, who would help her open the main doors of Danav Lok.

episodesList.title: Mahabhasm Pari Takes Plane To Bhasm Lok
episodesList.summary: Mahabhasm Pari takes the plane to Bhasm Lok and everybody on earth is shocked at the news of missing plane. There is hue and cry in Dagli family and families of other kids, Baalveer goes to Bhasm Lok and fights with Mahabhasm Pari.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Fight With Mahabhasm Pari

episodesList.title: World Of Ghosts

The specialized Paanch Tatviya Darpan Chakra is made up all the five essential matters of the earth. She has asked all the Paris to march ahead with the mission.

On the other hand, the fairies in the fairyland are bewildered to see a storm brewing up and doubt the some evil force has attacked with enough powers.

However, all the Paris of the Parilok are concerned about Baalveer's wellbeing.
