episodesList.summary: Baalveer tries to rescue Meher and Manav but Fitoori gets the best of him. Baalveer along with Meher and Manav is held captive in magic lantern. Mahavinashini is ready to launch an attack on Parilok.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Ally In Ginistan
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is trying to open the lid of the lantern so that he can free himself and save his friends. Meher and Manav are drowning as their lantern fell in the water.

episodesList.title: World Of Padaavon
episodesList.summary: Ruler of Ginistan has punished Fitoori for his deeds but apologizes to Baalveer as he cannot send him back to earth. Baalveer asks the Jinn king to guide him as he wants to go home with his friends. On this, Ruler of Ginistan told him a way out.

episodesList.title: The Last Level
episodesList.summary: Baalveer defeats the first Jinn and completes the quest and with this he has also crossed the first hurdle. Now, Baalveer only need Buland Chirag to get himself and his friends out of Ginistan.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Victory
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has defeated the Buland Jinn and now gets back to Earth. Before starting his life with mortals, Baalveer destroys the dangerous fire ball made by Mahavinashini to demolish Parilok.

episodesList.title: The Sound Of Evil
episodesList.summary: Baal Pari narrates Baalveer's childhood story which is about evil powers trying to capture little Baalveer. Mahavinashini, who heard everything, has now drafted a new plan to make Baalveer a slave of dark forces.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Turns Into Snake
episodesList.summary: Balveer gets drawn towards the sound of strange music which takes him to a magical forest. It was Mahavinashini's plan to bring him there and turn him into a poisonous snake. Can Balveer save himself? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Samay Vahak Yantra
episodesList.summary: All the fairies are looking for a cure to save Balveer, who is slowly turning into a snake. Meanwhile, Manav is upset about his 2nd rank in school and now Balveer also seems to be ignoring him. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Importance Of Satya Lok
episodesList.summary: The fairies transport the 'Samay Vahak Yantra' to Satya Lok in order to keep it safe from Mahavinashini. Meanwhile, Chittu gives a unique gadget to Montu so that he can keep up his mischief. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Super Hero Manav
episodesList.summary: Manav is getting all the love and attention because of the powers given to him by the evil Mahavinashini. But he is not aware of the trap that he is slowly falling into. Find out more by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Superhero M
episodesList.summary: With his new powers, Manav takes up the role of Superhero M who saves the school children from local goons. Baalveer is unsure what to make of this new hero and asks Rani Pari for her advice.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashini’s Plan
episodesList.summary: Bal Veer confronts Superhero M and asks him to reveal his identity. Manav is about to tell Bal Veer but Mahavinashini stops him and tells him to run away from there. Can Bal Veer find out who is behind the mask?

episodesList.title: Baalveer And Superhero M
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and the Paris have figured out that Manav is the person behind Superhero M and are concerned for his safety. Baalveer tries to convince Manav that Mahavinashini is evil but Manav is not ready to listen to him. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Maasi From Gujrat
episodesList.summary: Baalveer manages to trick Mahavinashini by giving her the fake 'Samay Vahak Yantra'. However, Mahavinashini is able to escape from there. At Dagli house, Maasi comes to visit all the way from Gujrat.

episodesList.title: Magical Mirror
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini creates a magical mirror which heightens feelings of anger inside anyone who looks at it. Her first target would be Balveer's best friends, Manav and Meher. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Montu Is Peaceful
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini plans to use Montu for her evil deeds. She orders Tauba Tauba to hand over the magical mirror to Montu so that he can use it with other kids. But Montu apparently has had a change of heart. Stay tuned for more.

episodesList.title: Angry Montu
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba manages to trick Montu and now he is very angry. But Mahavinashni is worried that Balveer will soil all her plans. Meanwhile, all the kids are having fun at the 'Ajayaab Ghar' but Ballu experiences a strange feeling from that place. What is going to happen now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: The Power Of Anger
episodesList.summary: Balveer overhears some kids crying in the distance and goes to investigate. Instead of finding the kids, Balveer finds himself surrounded by 5 goons. Meanwhile, Tauba Taub does his job of enraging Montu and sends him after the kid.

episodesList.title: Rani Pari Is Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Balveer is shocked to find the kids fighting with each other. He tries to stop Manav and Meher but they don't listen to him. He decides to get to the root of the problem inside the 'Ajayaab Ghar'. Can Bal Veer figure out Mahavinashini's trick?

episodesList.title: Magic Of The Mirror
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher's behaviour are getting worse by the minute. They are becoming very in-disciplined and have started telling lies at home. Meanwhile, the Paris have landed on Earth to confiscate the mirror from Tauba Tauba. Keep watching the episode to find out what will happen next.

episodesList.title: Secret Of Magic Mirror
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari and the other Paris have figured out how the magical mirror works. They imbibe Balveer with the power of earth, water, fire, sky and air so that he can battle Mahavinashni and take the mirror from her. Can Bal Veer accomplish his task? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: End Of The Anger Game
episodesList.summary: Balveer is successful in defeating Mahavinashini and bringing the magic mirror to Pari Lok. Meanwhile, Dooba Dooba 1 has landed on Vinash Lok. Keep watching to find out more.

episodesList.title: Shaatir Pari In Vinash Lok
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini has called upon a new evil to end Balveer. Meanwhile, Dooba Dooba 1 overhears her vile plans and informs Rani Pari about them. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: White Arrows
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari decides to draw the evil out of Mahavinashini and turn her into a good Pari. For her plan to be successful, Balveer will have to procure the 'White Arrows of Happiness'. He only has six hours to accomplish his mission. Can Balveer do it?

episodesList.title: Manav's Tale Of Intelligence
episodesList.summary: Balveer is in a race against time to get the white arrows and return to Pari Lok. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini and Shatir Pari are plotting to use the 'Charan Jakad Yantra' to trap Bal Veer. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Attack On Mahavinashni
episodesList.summary: The Paris and Balveer have launched a counterattack against Mahavinashini in order to set her on the right path. Meanwhile, Montu has been standing under a coconut tree, just waiting for a coconut to fall on his head after hearing Manav's story. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: White Bolt
episodesList.summary: The white arrows seemingly had no effect on Mahavinashini and she escaped. After getting hit by several coconuts, Montu has become a genius and is celebrating in school. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Changing Behavior
episodesList.summary: Balveer along with the Paris goes to Vinash Lok so that they can observe Mahavinashini's behaviour. Meanwhile in school, Montu's teacher decides to test his newfound intelligence. Can Mahavinashini turn over a new leaf? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Apology
episodesList.summary: In Pari Lok, Mahavinashini is being treated to extract all the evil out of her. Balveer has his doubts about her behaviour. Meanwhile, Montu has realized that Manav fooled him and now wants to pay him back. Is Bal Veer's suspicion true? Keep watching the show to find out.

episodesList.title: Satya Samarpan Pahad
episodesList.summary: To prove that Mahavinashini has turned good, Rani Pari has decided that she along with Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari will have to walk on the empty space between two mountains. If she is able to do that, then it will mean that she truly has had a change of heart. Will Mahavinashini pass this trial? Stay tuned and find out.

episodesList.title: Sachi And Achhi Pari
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari are being held in a cage after failing Rani Pari's test of truth. They feel that Mahavinashini has turned into a good Pari and has abandoned their quest of spreading evil. Meanwhile, Montu and Rohit are at Dagli house and are taking their revenge on Manav and Meher.

episodesList.title: Army Of Sachai And Achhai
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari takes all the Paris and Baalveer to Earth where she reveals a secret Laboratory. Meanwhile, Manav and Meher attempt to trick Montu again and temporarily save themselves from him.

episodesList.title: Protectors Of Goodness
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari explains the purpose of the army and the four chief generals to all the Paris and Baalveer. Meanwhile, Montu is trying to attain intelligence by standing upside down. Find out more by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Awakening Of Warriors
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari is going to breathe life into the army by reading a mantra from the 'Sena Sanjeevani' Book. However, Mahavinashini plans to use the army for her own evil deeds and is just putting on the act of being good. Keep watching to find out what will happen next.

episodesList.title: Four Warriors Of Truth
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini is trying her best to stop Rani Pari from bringing her army to life. However, the collective efforts of Bal Veer and the Paris are enough to prevent that from happening. What will Mahavinashini do now? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Trap For Warriors
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and the Paris have figured out how Mahavinashini deceived them and was able to pass the difficult test. Meanwhile, the four warriors of truth arrive at Vinash Lok to capture Mahavinashini. Keep watching to find out more.

episodesList.title: Slave Of Darkness
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini has trapped the four warriors of truth in Vinash Lok and is now going to turn them into servants of evil. Meanwhile, Montu has set up a trap for Manav and Meher in their own home. What does Mahavinashini plan to do with these four warriors? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Hidden Army Of Truth
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini tries to retain the army by threatening Rani Pari. However, Rani Pari has hidden the army in a place which cannot be accessed by anyone. How will Mahavinashini react now?

episodesList.title: Baalveer Fights Evil Generals
episodesList.summary: The four generals come to Pari Lok for Rani Pari but Bal Veer stands in their way. Meanwhile, Montu has set a trap for Manav so that he will lose in the challenge. What will happen now? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Immortal Generals
episodesList.summary: Baalveer tries to end the four generals but fails to do so as all of them are immortal and cannot be killed. At school, Montu plays a prank on his teacher to protect himself from punishment. His teacher finds out and now plans to teach Montu a lesson with Manav and Meher's help.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Army
episodesList.summary: Baalveer manages to escape from the grasp of the four generals. Rani Pari has the key that will free up the army of truth and she divides it into four parts. One part she keeps for herself and the other three she gives to three different Paris. Will Mahavinashini get her hands on these keys? Find out in this episode

episodesList.title: Generals Of Baalveer's Army
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is looking for kids who can become the new generals for the army of truth. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari inform Mahavinashini about the four keys. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: The Army Generals
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has found his three generals who will lead the army of truth at the school's Christmas carnival. But things are about to get problematic as Lohavaar and Vajrvaar arrive on Earth with the purpose of harming the kids. What is Bal Veer going to do now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Shaatir Pari Troubles Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Baalveer surrenders in front of Lohavaar and Vajrvaar and they take him to Pari Lok where Bal Pari is hiding. Shatir Pari threatens to end Baalveer's life if Bal Pari doesn't come out and hands over the last piece of the key. Will Bal Pari reveal herself? Watch the full episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Warriors
episodesList.summary: Baalveer convinces Manav, Meher and Montu to work together so that they can stop the four generals. Rani Pari comes to Earth and gives the three of them their powers. Baalver's army is now ready to take on the servants of evil.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Best Warrior
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari gives Manav, Meher and Montu their weapons which will aid them in their fight against the four generals. But the three of them are unable to pick up their weapons. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini comes to the school and calls out Rani Pari by threatening the lives of children. Can Baalveer's army be ready in time to face the imposing force of evil?

episodesList.title: Army Of The Devils
episodesList.summary: The lives of school kids are being threatened by Mahavinashini and her accomplices. Meanwhile, Manav, Meher and Montu are training hard to become fit for the role of a hero. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Challenge To Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: A situation of Panic has been created on Earth by Mahavinashini. She has captured children and is holding them for ransom in exchange for the 4th part of the key. Meanwhile, Manav, Meher and Montu are still preparing for their roles as heroes. Can they finish their preparations in time? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Fight Of Truth
episodesList.summary: Baalveer's team is finally ready to take on the four generals. However, the captured children have been surrounded by fire through Mahavinashini's magic. How wil our heroes save the kids now? Find out right here.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Army
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari and Baalveer have been successful in separating Mahavinashini from her generals. Meanwhile, Baalveer is planning an ambush on the four generals with Manav, Meher and Montu's help. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Last Potion Of Magical Key
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini has sent out fake soldiers to deceive Baalveer. At the same time, the captured kids have been locked inside a school bus and the soldiers are going to push that bus downhill. What will happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Children's Army
episodesList.summary: The fourth general is in hiding. Bal Veer and his team can't figure out a way to defeat the four generals as they keep reviving back. Rani Pari advises Baalveer and the kids to defeat all of them at once in order to end them for good. Will they find the fourth general? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Montu Is Scared
episodesList.summary: Montu abandons Baalveer's team and agrees to help the evil four generals to support and end the good guys. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini and her lackeys are off to find the hidden army with the help of the key. Find out more by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Donation For Noble Cause
episodesList.summary: It was Montu's plan all along, pretending to be on the side of evil just to smoke out the fourth general. However, Mahavianshini has successfully awakened the hidden army. Can Baalveer and his friends defeat the four generals and stop Mahavinashini's army?

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Oath
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini has assembled her army and has ordered them to destroy Baalveer and all the Paris of Pari Lok. Rani Pari still has faith, that Baalveer and his friends will be able to defeat the insurmountable odds posed by the forces of evil. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Gayabkar Yantra
episodesList.summary: Montu tries to cancel the school's New Year's part but Baalveer teaches him a lesson. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba comes to know that the Paris will lose their powers between 8 to 12 and plots to steal something important from them. Catch all the excitement on this episode of Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Magical Treasure
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari decides to trick Mahavinashini by sending Dooba Dooba 1, dressed as Tauba Tauba to Vinash Lok. In the meantime, Bhatkati Pari, Vijdhaar Pari and Dooba Doobas make their way towards Earth, so that they can help Baalveer with his new year's party.

episodesList.title: New Year Bash
episodesList.summary: The kids receive Baalveer's magical invitation for his new year's party. Montu and Rohit are trying to spoil the fun by creating hindrances in the preparation. Meanwhile, Mahavinashini and Shatir Pari are making their way towards Pari Lok. Have they figured out that Rani Pari has tricked them? Will Montu spoil the fun of the party? Keep watching to find answers to all your questions.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's New Year Party
episodesList.summary: The kids are amazed by the fantastic decoration as they enter the hall for the party. Baalveer and the Paris treat all of them with ice creams and chocolates. Elsewhere, Mahavinashini comes to know the truth which Rani was trying to hide. What will happen now? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Montu's Failed Plan
episodesList.summary: Montu tries to spoil Manav and Meher's performance but Baalveer stops him. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba and Shatir Pari are also at the party in a different get-up, looking for Baalveer. Watch the episode to find out more.

episodesList.title: Montu And Babli's Friendship
episodesList.summary: Shatir Pari arrives at the venue on her secret mission to look for the Paris. Meanwhile, Montu is giving Rohit a hard time for exposing all his plans. Stay tuned for more.

episodesList.title: Sand Watch
episodesList.summary: Baalveer gets the idea of adding more sand to the hourglass. But for this, he will need some help. Thankfully, Manav, Meher and Montu are more than willing to aid their favourite superhero. Can Baalveer save all the Paris by regaining his powers? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Plan For Baalveer's Birthday
episodesList.summary: It is Ballu and Meher's birthday and the Dagli household is very excited about it. Meanwhile, Pari Lok is also preparing for Baalveer's birthday but Rani Pari is worried that Mahavinashini might make things difficult.

episodesList.title: Rani Pari's Surprise Party
episodesList.summary: Meher has been strange for the past couple of days. Manav and Ballu are worried and decide to investigate the reason behind her strange behaviour. In Pari Lok, the Paris have planned a surprise party for Baalveer and they don't want Mahavinashini finding out about it. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Protective Sheild
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari has surrounded Pari Lok with a protective shield to protect it from evil forces. Meanwhile, Hasi and Khushi Pari invite all of Baalveer's friends to his surprise birthday party. Catch all the other exciting things that happened, on this episode of Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Montu's Dream
episodesList.summary: Hasi and Khushi Pari have accidentally invited Chittu to Baalveer's birthday party, not knowing that he actually is Tauba Tauba in disguise. Pari Lok is looking beautiful with all the decorations for Baalveer's birthday and they are ready to host their guests. Want to know more? Then continue watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Mahavinshni's War
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba informs Mahavinashini about the surprise birthday party for Baalveer. She decides to poison the grapes that will be used for Baalveer's birthday cake. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Fight With Mahavinashni
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini tries to break the protective barrier around Pari Lok but is unsuccessful in doing so. However, the Paris suspect that Mahavinashini knows about Baalveer's birthday party and decide to pass on the wrong information about the venue. Find out more in this episode.

episodesList.title: Invisible Site For Festival
episodesList.summary: All the kids have assembled on the ground to go to Pari Lok for Baalveer's birthday party. Meanwhile, Dooba Dooba 1 and 4 try to stop Baalveer from entering Pari Lok so that the surprise doesn't get spoiled. What will happen now? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Festive Island
episodesList.summary: All the invited kids are travelling to Pari Lok in a magical, flying bus! Baalveer has also reached Pari Lok but can't seem to find anyone around. Stay tuned to find out what will happen next.

episodesList.title: Magical Security Gate
episodesList.summary: The magical security gate installed at the entrance will not let anyone with bad intentions enter the party venue. Mahavinashini finds out about the real venue of the party through Tauba Tauba and she tries to enter with the help of a disguise.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Deadly Plan
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini has entered Baalveer's birthday party in the form of a small girl. All the kids seem to be having a lot of fun at the party but for how long? What will Mahavinashini do to spoil the party's fun?

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Poison
episodesList.summary: It is Baalveer's birthday party and all the children have arrived at Pari Lok to celebrate! To make the celebrations even grander, singer Preeti Bhalla is there to sing the kids their favourite songs. But, Mahavinashini also reaches the party in a disguise. What evil tricks has she planned this time? Will the Paris and Baalveer be successful in saving the kids?

episodesList.title: Poisonous Cake
episodesList.summary: After eating the cake at Baalveer's party, all the kids fall to sleep. Baalveer himself feels weakened. Mahavinashini returns to her original form and threatens to end all of them for good. Can Baalveer recover in time to spoil the evil Mahavinashini's plan? Watch the full episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Effect Of The Poisonous Cake
episodesList.summary: The three Paris and Baalveer leave to bring back various items from Pari Lok and Madhya Saagar. Mahavinashini has poisoned the water around the Pavitra Tree! Now it falls on Baalveer to bring the Pure Moti and save all the kids from Mahavinashini's poison. But a shark is in the Kund, protecting the Pure Moti. How will Baalveer get out of this?

episodesList.title: Magical Pearls
episodesList.summary: Baalveer finally managed to take the Pure Moti back. Mahavinashini was unsuccessful in her efforts to stop him from reaching Pari Lok. All the kids are back to normal and return home safely. It is a time for festivities! Meanwhile, Mhavinashini and Shatir Pari are contemplating on their loss.

episodesList.title: Pari Lok's Identity
episodesList.summary: Mahagajni establishes the pillar of truth in Pari Lok, as Rani Pari explains its importance to Baalveer and the Paris. Neil and Saloni are getting admitted into the school but are threatened by Montu on their very first day. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba is planning to blow away Pari Lok with a bomb from a mountain top. Will he be successful?

episodesList.title: Montu Learns A Lesson
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba fails to throw the bomb at Pari Lok and returns to Vinash Lok all burnt up. After hearing his story, Mahvinashini realizes that there is an active volcano in one of those five mountains. She learns of a monster that was trapped in there by the Paris and decides to free it.

episodesList.title: Burning Monster
episodesList.summary: In school, Neil sees the notice for a boxing tournament and decides to participate in it. He doesn't know that the school bully, Montu, will also be a part of it. Shatir Pari and Tauba Tauba are unable to wake Agnikal from his sleep. Tauba Tauba kicks Agnikal's leg in frustration and he opens his eye.

episodesList.title: Neil Participates Against Montu
episodesList.summary: Agnikal wakes up from his sleep and vows to attack Pari Lok for what they did to him. Neil is afraid and tense, after realizing that his boxing match is with Montu. Baalveer and all the Paris are shocked to see the Pavitra Nadi overflowing. What could be the reason?

episodesList.title: Neil Beats Montu Up
episodesList.summary: Neil goes to withdraw his name from the boxing match after learning that he has to face Montu. Rani Pari tells Baalveer about Agnikal and he decides to challenge him. At the same time, Agnikal and Mahavinashini have joined hands to destroy Pari Lok. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Agnikaal's Deceptive Powers
episodesList.summary: With no option other than to fight, Neil starts preparing for his boxing match. Baalveer's attacks have no effect on Agnikal. His body catches fire as Agnikall approaches him. The situation is looking dire for the great Baalveer. How will he overcome this obstacle?

episodesList.title: Agnikaal Defeats Baalveer
episodesList.summary: After his battle with Agnikal, Baalveer is badly injured. Mahavinashini decides to spare his life and sends his unconscious body to the Pari Lok as a statement. Manish, Neil's school friend, has an idea for defeating Montu in the boxing match. Agnikal reaches Pari Lok along with Mahavinashini and her accomplices. Watch the episode to find out what happens.

episodesList.title: Conspiracy To Ruin Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: Agnikal has activated the Volcano! He plans to burn the whole Pari Lok with the hot lava. Neil and Manish play pranks on Montu and make him believe that Neil got stronger than him by drinking that booster syrup. Watch the full episode to find out other exciting things that happened.

episodesList.title: Neil Challenges Montu
episodesList.summary: After witnessing Neil's strength, Montu feels extremely scared and wants to withdraw from the competition. Baalveer and the Paris are feeling helpless against the volcano's lava. They are unable to retrieve the water from Pavitra Nadi which is needed to stop the volcano. Suddenly, Baalveer gets an idea. Watch the episode to find out what is his idea to stop the crisis.

episodesList.title: Montu Follows Gandhi's Ideology
episodesList.summary: After witnessing Neil's strength, Montu feels extremely scared and wants to withdraw from the competition. Baalveer and the Paris are feeling helpless against the volcano's lava. They are unable to retrieve the water from Pavitra Nadi which is needed to stop the volcano. Suddenly, Baalveer gets an idea. Watch the episode to find out what is his idea to stop the crisis.

episodesList.title: Threat On Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: The volcano's lava is slowly moving towards Pari Lok, which has the Paris extremely worried. Montu did not take his name out of the boxing match which has shocked Manish and Neil. Baalveer is trying to dig a tunnel to get the water of Pavitra to Pari Lok but problems keep following him. Tune in to find out how he is going to solve them.

episodesList.title: The Boxing Match
episodesList.summary: Neil's parents are boosting his confidence and praying for his win as the much-awaited boxing match is finally here. Elsewhere, Baalveer is unable to bring the water of Pavitra Nadi to Pari Lok. He decides to unearth the Pillar of Truth which will help him get the water to Pari Lok. What is Baalveer's plan? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's Protective Sheild
episodesList.summary: The volcano which was activated by Agnikal has caused a lot of destruction in Pari Lok. He is trying to convince Mahavinashini to undo the security barrier so that he can himself enter Pari Lok. In the boxing match, Neil uses his agility to gain an advantage over Montu. Find out all that has happened by tuning in to this episode of Baalveer.

episodesList.title: The End Of Agnikaal
episodesList.summary: The boxing match has reached its final round. The audience is cheering for Neil but Montu tries to win by using unfair means. Baalveer has figured out a way to spread the water across Pari Lok. However, Agnikal is about to destroy the Pillar of Truth. Will Neil and Baalveer be able to figure out a way to come out on top?

episodesList.title: Go Green Movement
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is trying to raise awareness about the 'Go Green movement'u among the people. However, Montu tries to spoil the greenery and Baalveer is inclined to teach him a lesson. In Vinash Lok, Mahavinashini has awoken a dangerous monster which will prove to be extremely threatening for Baalveer and all of Pari Lok.

episodesList.title: Magical Seeds
episodesList.summary: A new and deadly threat has emerged! The Mahadanav has sown the magical seed which will help him eradicate all of Earth's greenery. In school, Baalveer warns Montu to not trouble the other kids, but he doesn't listen. Rohit has to tie him up against a pole in order to stop him from committing mischief. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Montu Is Excused
episodesList.summary: Upon seeing Baalveer in the garden, Mahadanav runs away but drops his bag of magical seeds. Montu is still not done with his mischief and starts scaring the kids by making Rohit wear a ghost mask. Meanwhile, the Minister informs Baalveer that all of Earth's greenery is getting depleted. What could be the cause? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Danger To Earth
episodesList.summary: Upon hearing about the Earth's greenery depleting, Baalveer and the other Paris of Pari Lok get worried. Montu is up to his usual mischief and tries to use Neil for target practice. Due to the depleting oxygen levels, people on Earth begin to faint. Pari Lok decides to send out oxygen in balloons in order to save them. Find out if they will be able to save the people, in this episode of Baalveer.

episodesList.title: Miracle Of The Seeds
episodesList.summary: Mahadanav finds Saloni on top of the tree that was created by the magical seed and captures her inside a cage. Rani Pari has found a temporary solution so that the people of Earth can breathe, but they need to quickly get to the root of the problem. Baalveer returns to Earth and finds the huge tree. Keep watching to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Mahadanav's Plan
episodesList.summary: After climbing up the tree, Baalveer has landed up in Danav Lok. His magical powers don't seem to work in this world. He hears Saloni calling out in the distance and goes to investigate. Will he be able to save Saloni in time? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Threat To Saloni
episodesList.summary: After some efforts, Baalveer is successful in rescuing Saloni from falling into the tiger pit. Saloni tells him about Mahadanav's master plan to eradicate Earth's greenery. What will be Baalveer's next move? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Mahadanav's Devotion
episodesList.summary: Earth's oxygen is depleting at a rapid pace and most of the greenery has dried up. Saloni and Baalveer manage to distract Mahadanav and steal the bottle of greenery. Meanwhile on Earth, Neil and Manish call all the kids together to take revenge on Montu. Will Montu learn the lesson? Will Saloni and Baalveer manage to escape from Danav Lok? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Encounter With Mahadanav
episodesList.summary: Saloni makes her way down the giant tree to escape from Danav Lok, but Mahdanav follows her footsteps to retrieve his bottle of greenery. Baalveer has also regained his consciousness and is now going to confront the Mahadanav on Earth.

episodesList.title: Maha Bed's Ethology
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini retrieves the 'Mahabed Shastra' from the 'Mayavi Agni' which can supposedly break through the protective shield around Ballu, Baalveer's alter-ego. She hands over the Mahabhed Shastra to Shatir Pari and sends her off to attack Ballu. Can Shatir Pari bring this evil plan to success? Continue watching to find.

episodesList.title: Conspiracy Against Baalveer
episodesList.summary: After failing in her first attempt of attacking Ballu, Shatir Pari lands on Pari Lok and takes on the disguise of Baal Pari. Her mission is to find out details about Baalveer's protective shield. Find out more about her evil plan by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Shatir Pari's New Conspiracy
episodesList.summary: Shatir Pari wants to learn the secret behind Baalveer's protective shield. Only Rani Pari knows how to remove it. Meanwhile, Neil and Saloni have challenged Montu to a fight. What is going to happen now? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Shatir Pari's Trap
episodesList.summary: After learning about the mantra to remove Ballu's protective shield, Shatir Pari has come to Ballu's school and has taken on the disguise of a teacher. In Pari Lok, Baal Pari is awake and Rani Pari has sent two Paris to protect Baalveer. Can they reach him in time?

episodesList.title: Shatir Pari's Plan For Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Shatir Par is disguised as a teacher in Ballu's school and makes him read the mantra that will remove his protective shield. She attacks Ballu and he falls to the ground, unconscious. She then brings Ballu to Mahavinashini. What do they plan to do with him?

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's New Trick
episodesList.summary: Shatir Pari and Mahavinashini reach Pari Lok to gloat over their victory. They announce to all the Paris that Baalveer is at Gilbill mountain, where all his powers will be extracted by Gilbill. What is going to happen now? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Is Trapped
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is being held captive at Gilbill mountain where all his powers are being stripped away. As it happens, the power of Pari Lok is also weakening along with Baalveer. What can the Paris do to save him from this situation?

episodesList.title: The Magic Mirror
episodesList.summary: The Paris cannot enter Gilbill mountain to save Baalveer. In this terrible situation, Rani Pari turns to Manav and Meher, to go and save Baalveer from Gilbill. Will the two kids be able to save their good friend? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Neil To Beat Montu Again
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher have successfully freed Baalveer from Gilbill's captivity and returned him to Pari Lok. But Mahavinashini has another evil trick up her sleeve left, and she plots an attack on Pari Lok. What is Mahavinashini's plan now? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Agnikaal's Powers
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashi has poisoned the air of Pari Lok, which has caused Aarpaar Pari to turn into sand. Rani Pari does know of a cure but the Paris will have to travel far for it. What is Mahavinashini's ultimate goal? Will Rani Pari be able to find a cure? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: The Deadly Poison
episodesList.summary: On Earth, Mahesh's mouth has been closed shut because of the glue. All his family members are looking for a way to open it up. Meanwhile, to cure the effects of the poison, Rani Pari wishes for an Amrit from the Vish Amrit mountain. Mahavinashini's plan is to wish for an elixir that will have an opposite effect. What will she do with such an elixir? Keep watching to find out

episodesList.title: Pari Lok In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari takes the Amrit back to Pari Lok, to cure the effects of the poison. Mahavinashini gave the elixir she got from the mountain to Tauba Tauba. His task is to poison Baalveer with it. What will happen to Baalveer now? Keep watching the show to find out.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba On Mission
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba did not succeed in his initial attempt to poison Baalveer. He asks Mahavinashini for a second chance. This time he plans to pose as Bagicha-cha and poison Baalveer as he is playing with him and the other kids. Can he be successful this time in poisoning Baalveer? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer To Know Tauba Tauba's Trick
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba was successful in shrinking Manav, Meher, and Baalveer down to size. Dooba Dooba comes back to consciousness and informs all the Paris about the incident. Rani Pari sends Dooba Dooba 1 and Bhatkati Pari to investigate. Find out what happens next in this episode.

episodesList.title: Shortened Height Of Kids
episodesList.summary: Bhatkati Pari and Dooba Dooba 1 reach the Dagli house but are unable to spot Baalveer and his friends. Mahavinashini is furious with Tauba Tauba and sends him back on earth to look for Baalveer. Who will find Baalveer first? Tune in to find out.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Looks For Kids
episodesList.summary: Tuaba Tauba is desperately searching for Baalveer and his friends. He decides to turn into Dagli house's servant so that he can easily look for them. Meanwhile, the other Paris have gone looking for a cure from the Vish Amrit Mountain. Will they be able to procure an antidote? Or will Tauba Tauba get to them first?

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba's Changed Look
episodesList.summary: Mahesh and Bapuji have decided to keep Tauba Tauba as their servant. The children are hiding under the dining table and suddenly, Ballu gets an idea to alert the Paris by pressing the Buzzer of the Chetavani Yantra! Meanwhile, Bhatakti Pari has an encounter with Shatir Pari on the school grounds.

episodesList.title: Kids Are Found
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tuaba finds the kids hiding in the shirt pocket. Bhatkati Pari is still looking for the Amrit bottle on Earth. The kids must find another way to get to the Yantra before Tauba Tauba catches them. How will Baalveer get himself out of this situation?

episodesList.title: The Chetavni Yantra
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba continues his search for the kids. Baalveer seems to have finally found his way into the bedroom where the Chetavni Yantra is kept. Meanwhile, Montu and Rohit aren't able to handle themselves after eating a humongous burger. Keep up with all the excitement by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Kids' Narrow Escape
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba finds the kids hiding inside the vacuum cleaner, but they manage to escape when Mahesh takes Tauba Tauba away from some work. Bhatakti Pari is finally able to retrieve the Amrit from Rohit and Montu. At the same time, The kids have found a way to Kick Tauba Tauba out of the house, for good.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: The kids were successful in their plan and Tauba Tauba got kicked out of the house. They safely reach the Cetavni Yantra and send out a message for help. Mahavinashini is angry when Tauba Tauba returns empty-handed. She has sent Shatir Pari to finish the job this time. Will she be able to bring Baalveer to Vinash Lok?

episodesList.title: Fancy Dress
episodesList.summary: A suspicious man with a weird costume and a magical merry-go-round has arrived at school. Montu is busy flaunting his new, remote control car in front of his schoolmates. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba has also arrived on Earth with a strange tool.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni To Kidnap Kids
episodesList.summary: It was Mahavinashini's plan to kidnap 21 kids in order to obtain the all-powerful Vajra. But she is disappointed when Riwana and Harun turn up with only 4. Now the Jhulewala has his eyes set on kidnapping Neil and Sonali. What is going to happen next? Stay tuned in to find out.

episodesList.title: Missing Kids
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is investigating the mystery of the missing children but is unable to place the Kidnapper even when he is right in front of him. Mahavinashini is disappointed in Harun and Riwana and wants them to speed up the process. Meanwhile, Bapuji has swallowed the magnetic pill which was earlier in Rohit's possession. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Baalveer On Mission
episodesList.summary: Baalveer is desperately searching for the missing kids and goes to Pari Lok for help. Mahesh goes to the police station to inform them about Bapuji's strange condition. Elsewhere, the missing children seem to be having fun in the strange world they have arrived in.

episodesList.title: Kid's Planning
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has purposefully gotten himself kidnapped to figure out Harun and Riwana's plan. They have been successful in procuring 21 kids and will be transporting them to Mahavinashini. What is Baalveer planning to do? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Baalveer To Save Kids
episodesList.summary: Mahavinashini is unable to get the All-powerful Vajra. Ballu transforms into Baalveer and has an idea for obtaining the Vajra for himself. Who will get Vajra first? Baalveer or Mahavinashini? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Super Hero Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and Mahavinashini are battling it out for the Vajra. Harun and Riwana have turned on Mahavinashini and are now going to help Baalveer in sending the kids home. What will happen next? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Dooba Dooba's Magical Broom
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari is not in Pari Lok and a huge meteor is headed towards Earth. Can the Paris and Baalveer find the cause behind the meteor and figure out a way to stop it before it collides with the Earth? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni's New Scheme
episodesList.summary: The looming threat of the meteorites moving towards the Earth is still there. But Bal Pari has seemingly got a solution from the magical history book. Meanwhile, Tauba Tauba has run out of the white magical rock and goes to Shatir Pari for more.

episodesList.title: Mahabalis' Threat To Fairies
episodesList.summary: On Mahavinashini's orders, Shatir Pari has called upon the Mahabali brothers to destroy Baalveer. The meteor is heading towards the Earth at a very quick pace. All the Paris have come together to give Baalveer their powers. Will Blaveer stop the meteor? How powerful are the Mahabali brothers? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Shakti Vitran Smaroh
episodesList.summary: During the Shakti Vitran Samaroh, all the Paris are transferring their powers to Baalveer, to help him save the Earth. The Mahabali brothers have also arrived on Pari Lok. What do they plan to do? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni Traps Baalveer
episodesList.summary: The Mahabali brothers are stealing all of Baalveer's powers! Meanwhile, the meteor is moving towards the Earth and Baalveer is the only one who can stop it. What will happen now? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Powers Are Back
episodesList.summary: The Paris bring all of Baalveer's powers back by chanting the Mool mantra. Now he plans on teaching them a lesson. On Earth, Manav finds out that the woman who goes by the title 'BBM', is a fraud. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Bhoot Bhagao Mission
episodesList.summary: Students get to know the truth about the ghost that has been tormenting them for so long. Baalveer has regained his powers from Mahabali and is now going to save the Earth from the oncoming meteorite.

episodesList.title: Natkhat Pari Returns
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari has returned to Pari Lok and all the Paris are reminiscing on their childhood memories. On Earth, Montu has given Neil, Saloni, and their friends a challenge. Watch the episode to catch up on all the excitement.

episodesList.title: The Magical Ring
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher have accidentally reached Pari Lok through the Magic ring which Natkhat Pari gave to Dooba Dooba 1. Meanwhile, Neil, Saloni, and their friends are still trying to beat Montu in his own challenge. Keep watching to find out what happens next.

episodesList.title: Montu's Viral Video
episodesList.summary: Montu has been troubling the school kids and Baalveer goes to teach him a lesson. At the same time, Manav, Meher, and their family members are taking a tour around Pari Lok. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Poisonous Shrubs
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari has become the Dagli Family's tour guide around Pari Lok. Shatir Pari is back at her evil deeds, as she plants a poisonous seed in Pari Lok. Meanwhile, on Earth, Montu and Rohit are planning to cheat during their exam. What is this seed gonna do? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Baalveer In Ghatak Lok
episodesList.summary: Natkhat Pari is showing the Dagli family around Pari Lok. Baalveer has entered Ghatak Lok to find a solution for the poisonous branches. In school, Saloni and Neil try to teach Montu so that he doesn't have to cheat on the exam. Find out more by watching the episode.

episodesList.title: Pari Lok In Danger
episodesList.summary: Shatir Pari has put the lives of everyone in Pari Lok in danger, by surrounding it with deadly, poisonous branches. The Dagli family who are enjoying their trip, are unaware of this danger. In Ghatak Lok, Baalveer has fallen into a pit but has Mahayoddha to help him out. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Saves Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: The poisonous branches have completely engulfed Pari Lok. Meanwhile, Baalveer is still stuck in Ghatak Lok with Mahayoddha. Who is going to save Pari Lok in this great time of need? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Montu's Burger Mela
episodesList.summary: The captain of the school cricket team is being selected and all the students have assembled in the playground. To ensure that Montu gets the position, he tries to bribe everyone with burgers to get the maximum vote. Meanwhile, strange events have begun in space.

episodesList.title: Khatal Posing A Threat To Earth
episodesList.summary: Aliens have offered the Earth as a gift to their King, Hansmatol on his birthday. He tries to play around with the globe which has serious repercussions on Earth. Find out what happens next in this episode.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Challenges Hansmatol
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has to save the Earth from King Hansmatol. He tries to reason with him by making him understand that the Earth is not a cricket ball. However, Hansmatol pays no heed to Baalveer's concerns. Now Baalveer has challenged him to a cricket match. Find out more by watching this episode.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Tip
episodesList.summary: Baalveer informs Rani Pari of the threat that Hansmatol has brought to the Earth. Now he begins practising with the kids for the cricket match that will save their world. Will the kids be successful in defeating Hansmatol? Stay tuned to find out.

episodesList.title: The Sports Competition
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and his team are practising hard for their cricket match against King Hansmatol and his team of aliens. While Hansmatol is adamant in winning the match, by hook or by crook.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Vs Hasmatol
episodesList.summary: The cricket match between Baalveer's team and Hansmatol's team has begun! The fate of the Earth hangs in the balance. Though, Hansmatol doesn't believe in playing fair and is utilizing all his magical powers to get the win. Can Baalveer's team find a way to overcome this situation? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Dharti Premiere League
episodesList.summary: The cricket match continues between Baalveer and Hansmatol's teams. The King of Shatir Lok has given his teammates full freedom to use magic for collecting as many runs as possible. At the same time, they are making it difficult for Baalveer's team to get ahead in the match. Can Baalveer and the kids pull out a victory? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's New Avtaar
episodesList.summary: Grand preparations are happening in Pari Lok but Natkhat Pari has no clue why. Meanwhile, All the kids go for a field trip with their teacher. Continue watching to find out what the preparations are for.

episodesList.title: Threat To Paris' Life
episodesList.summary: During the archaeological trip, the whole structure started rumbling and the Earth started. However, all the kids managed to escape from there safely. Although, from the depths of the cave a new threat has emerged who wishes to destroy all of Pari Lok and its Paris. Who exactly is he? Watch this episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Special Powers
episodesList.summary: The new threat that emerged from the cave is no one else but the Guru of all Paris of Pari Lok. But for some reason, he feels that they have betrayed him and he now wants to enact his revenge on them. Meanwhile, a new student has joined AVP Vidyamandir and all the boys seem pleasantly surprised to see her.

episodesList.title: Montu's Mission To Impress Monica
episodesList.summary: The battle between Guru Dev and Baalveer carries on! He believes that all Paris have turned evil, while Baalveer tries to reason with him. In school, all the boys are trying their best to impress Monica, the new girl.

episodesList.title: Gurudev Is Angry
episodesList.summary: Guru Dev is getting furious by the minute, while the Paris are observing his actions from Pari Lok. Montu has arranged a Yacht party to impress Monica. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Prithvilok In Danger
episodesList.summary: Montu's party is going on and all the kids are having a great time in the middle of the sea. Meanwhile, Gurudev has caused massive calamities across the earth which has put the kids in harm's way. Can Baalveer save the kids from Guru Dev's wrath?

episodesList.title: Manav and Meher's Life At Risk
episodesList.summary: Guru Dev calls upon one of his disciples to aid him in the war he is about to wage on Pari Lok. All the kids are stuck in a sinking yacht and are crying out for Baalveer to help them. What will happen now? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Manav And Meher's New Avtaar
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher appear in a new avatar as Rani Pari imbibes both of them with powers. Meher will now be known as Bal Sakhi and Manav will be called Bal Mitra. Meanwhile, Montu has come up with a new plan for impressing Monica but Manish and Neil want to stop him in his tracks.

episodesList.title: Meher And Manav's Magical Powers
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari hands over the Smriti Yantra to Bal Sakhi and Bal Mitra and instructs them to go and meet with Guru Dev. Baalveer is also going along with them. In school, Neil and Manish have managed to spoil Montu's plans and in doing so, have impressed Monica. What will happen now? Only one way to find out.

episodesList.title: Gurudev's New Plan
episodesList.summary: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi have gone to meet with Guru Dev and convince him that the Paris have not betrayed him. However, they are stopped by Vaayu, Guru Dev's disciple. Can the three of them somehow manage to defeat him?

episodesList.title: Hunt For Smriti Yantra
episodesList.summary: Guru Dev has created the 'Maha Sarvanashi Astra' and he gives it to Vaayu so that he can destroy the Paris. Meanwhile, the Paris are going to Pratham Griha to search for the Smriti Yantra. Will the Paris be able to convince Guru Dev of their innocence? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Rani Pari Finds Smriti Yantra
episodesList.summary: The Paris have found the Smriti Yantra which will help them prove their innocence to Guru Dev. While at school, Montu tries to tarnish Neil and Manish's reputation in front of Monica. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: King Of Vinash Lok
episodesList.summary: In the absence of Mahavinashni and Shatir Pari, Tauba-Tauba has proclaimed himself to be the King of Vinash Lok for two days! While in school, there is a surprise in store for all of the kids. What is this surprise? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Mahavinashni In Shakti Lok
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari gets to know that Mahavinashni has gone to Shakti Lok to get more magical powers. And, if she succeeds in her motives then she will become more powerful than Baalveer. Meanwhile in school, all the kids are excited to see the premiere of the latest film, Angry Birds!

episodesList.title: Angry Birds Protect Children
episodesList.summary: The children are eagerly waiting for the movie to begin but Tauba Tauba plans to trap them inside the theatre and terrorize them. But the children have someone else that will protect them from harm. Who is this secret protector? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Powers
episodesList.summary: Everyone in Pari Lok is rejoicing and eating Laddoos. Manav has a weird dream about a Mummy in a museum. The next day, the kids end up going to the same museum for their school trip. Is this just a coincidence or a sign of bad things to come? Keep watching and find out.

episodesList.title: Mummy Attacks Manav
episodesList.summary: The Mummy from the museum has come alive and is searching for its bracelet. It's Manav who has brought the bracelet home with him. The Mummy comes to the school, in search of Manav. Want to know more? Watch the episode and find out.

episodesList.title: Hunt For Pharaoh Rajkumar
episodesList.summary: The Mummy on Earth is searching for the bracelet and the Pharaoh prince. Shatir Pari makes a deal with the Mummy to help him search, in exchange for helping her end Bal Veer and his friends.

episodesList.title: Mummy Looks For Pharaoh Prince
episodesList.summary: The Mummy believes that the Pharaoh Prince has been reborn as Manav and is searching for him desperately at the school. Meanwhile, Bal Sakhi and Baalveer are concerned for Manav's safety. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Mummy Hypnotizes Baalsakhi
episodesList.summary: The Pharaoh warrior has hypnotized Bal Sakhi and has made her his loyal subject. Baalveer has hidden Manav in a safe place but the Pharaoh Warrior finds them with the help of Bal Sakhi. Can Baalveer and Bal Mitra fight with Bal Sakhi? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Duplicate
episodesList.summary: Shatir Pari feels that her plan to end Baalveer will finally be successful. Meanwhile, the Mummy takes Manav to the Pyramid in hopes of turning him into the Pharaoh Prince once again.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba's Plan
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tuaba is not in the mood for attacking Earth today and wants to relax. Shatir Pari sees him lazing around and teaches him a good lesson. While on Earth, Neil has gone for a school exchange program but Saloni seems upset about it.

episodesList.title: Kalpana Gami Yantra
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba overhears Montu and Rohit's discussion about impressing Monica. He decides to use the Kalpana Gami Yantra and sends Montu to the world of imaginations! Meanwhile, Bapu ji is preparing for an acting role.

episodesList.title: Tauba Tauba's Trap For Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Montu is living his best life in the imaginary world. Baalveer asks Tauba Tauba about the whereabouts of his friends but doesn't believe in his words. Can Baalveer save Montu and his other friends from the Imaginary World?

episodesList.title: Montu In Dreamland
episodesList.summary: Montu is living lavishly with Monica in the imaginary world and all the other kids are giving them a royal treatment. At the same time, Baalveer has also entered the Imaginary world but he puts on a disguise so no one can recognize him. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Montu To Ring The Bell
episodesList.summary: Baalveer has dressed up as a clown and tries to get Montu to ring the bell that will help in getting him out of the Imaginary world. Meanwhile, Baapu ji is upset as he was not selected for the ad film. Find out more in this episode.

episodesList.title: Ballu In Montu's Dreamland
episodesList.summary: Montu rings the bell and all the kids are able to get out of the Imaginary world. A strange earthquake occurs in Pari Lok and Bal Sakhi is left in a trance. What has happened to Bal Sakhi? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Faulty Chetavni Yantra
episodesList.summary: Rani Pari gets an intuition of an unknown evil on Earth. Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi go to investigate but find nothing. What could be this new threat that has Rani Pari so worried? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Baal Sakhi's Evil Powers
episodesList.summary: The Chetavani Yantra is now working properly, which means that Paris will now be able to identify the looming threat which they couldn't before. Bal Sakhi gets anxious after hearing this and decides to flee from Pari Lok after a strange aircraft attacks.

episodesList.title: Virus Plans To Destroy Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: A woman named 'Error' has disguised herself as Bal Sakhi, while the real one lies unconscious in a ship, somewhere in space. On Earth, Bapuji and Mahesh are finding it difficult to hide Khoonkhaar Don in their home. Stay tuned to find out more.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Rescues Friends
episodesList.summary: Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi, both have been kidnapped by Error and taken to her master, Virus, in the space ship. However, Baalveer has managed to follow Error back to the spaceship. Can Baalveer save his friends from Virus? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Virus Threatens Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: Virus has installed an explosive chip in Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi's palm and has activated the timer for the destructive device. The Paris have tried using their magic but nothing seems to work. Is this it for our three heroes? Keep watching to find out.

episodesList.title: Baalveer's Invisible Enemy
episodesList.summary: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi go to investigate the blast site. They are surprised to find nothing there. Meanwhile, a news broadcast shows the three heroes attacking a building. Rani Pari gets furious seeing this and warns that if this turns out to be true she will strip the three of them of their powers.

episodesList.title: New Enemy Of Pari Lok
episodesList.summary: Baalveer, Bal Mitra and Bal Sakhi are all desperate to find the true evil behind the attack and to prove to Rani Pari of their innocence. Meanwhile, Prachandika travels to space and sets her evil plan in motion. What is her plan? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Evil Powers' Intention
episodesList.summary: With Prachandika's power, she takes control of all the electronic equipment on Earth. Her first plan of action would be to crash a plane. Can Baalveer prevent that from happening? Find out in this episode.

episodesList.title: Buri Shakti Challenges Rani Pari
episodesList.summary: The Paris have activated the Chetavni Yantra in order to locate the evil force that is threatening the Earth. Prachandika has kidnapped a few children from Earth and has put them up in a rocket full of explosives. She has challenged Rani Pari to come and save them. What is going to happen now?

In the meantime, Baalveer has entered the Digital Lok and is going to derail Prachandika's evil plan. Can Baalveer stop her from destroying everything? Watch the episode to find out.

episodesList.title: Dhwani Yantra

episodesList.title: Baalveer Regains Memory
episodesList.summary: Baalmitra & Baalsakhi get hurt, Prachandika takes Baalveer with her, Paris come, Prachandika is in the sky with Baalveer, she's spreading a black cloud in the sky, this is the "garajbaraj cloud" that she has filled evil into it and she's going to make it burst on the earth.

episodesList.title: Aadibalak Comes To Baalveer's Rescue
episodesList.summary: Manav & Meher see an Aadibalak mask they get flashes of time they spend with Aadibalak, Heem danav attacks the Paris & Baalveer, they retaliate but no effect on Heem Danav, Rani Pari says she has to call aadi balak to complete Heem Danav, Rani Pari starts reading the mantra and we see that Aadibalak comes alive.

episodesList.title: Prachandika To Kidnap Aadibalak
episodesList.summary: Baalveer & Paris thank Aadi Balak for rescuing Heem Danav's Baalveer. Dd claims that they want Aadibalak to stay for some time in Parilok, but Paris are worried that it is not safe to keep Aadibalak in Parilok. Prachandika comes there to take an Aadibalak with her.

episodesList.title: Aadibalak In Dagli House
episodesList.summary: Prachandika places the magical band of Aadibalak on his hand so that anyone who touches it will look like Aadibalak and go to Aadiyug. Paris chooses to maintain Aadibalak at Prithvi lok and while going Aadibalak meets DoobaDooba & DD2 & he touches them. Baalveer brings Aadibalak to the Dagli house and he does mischief there. What does he do?

episodesList.title: Rocky Turns Into Apeman
episodesList.summary: Aadi balak is doing mischief in the house; Rocky becomes doubtful about the behavior of Manav & Meher. Paris following DD's chariot, Pari try to stop them, but silver particles are coming towards them and they are gone, Rani Pari and Paris are shocked and don't know what to do?? Prachandika, Shatir & TaubaTauba are happy as the first victim of their plan is Dooba Dooba.

episodesList.title: Manav Apeman
episodesList.summary: Baalveer tries to perform his magic, but there are silver particles on him & he disappears, Baalveer & family members are shocked. Baalveer chooses to take it back from Prachandika, Rani Pari & Paris Aadikalam Kitaab gets the information that silver particles are going toward Prachand Lok.

episodesList.title: Baalveer Brings Aadikalam Book
episodesList.summary: Shatir comes out, Prachandika turns into Bhatkati Pari. Shatir gets shocked and attacks her, but other Paris come out and all of them attack Shatir, she gets injured and TaubaTauba runs away. There is a fight between Baalveer & Prachnadika, Baalveer finally takes Aadi kalam book with him and Rani Pari reads the mantra.

episodesList.title: Prachandika's Firecrackers
episodesList.summary: Tauba Tauba comes with cracker to Prithvi Lok, but he sees Baalveer and tells kids to celebrate Diwali with eco-friendly cracker and he will give all the kids that cracker. Prachandika comes to Pari Lok to mix the "evil ash" but she's trapped in the Paris plan, Rani Pari catches her and puts her inside a box.

episodesList.title: Firecrackers Make Kids Invisible
episodesList.summary: Baalveer turns back and sees everything is in place. He's happy with Shatir. We see the kids disappearing in front of Baalveer, whoever lights a cracker is shocked. Baalveer comes in between; Baalveer tells them what happened on Prithvi lok.

episodesList.title: Doll Hypnotizes Meher
episodesList.summary: Prachandika & Baalveer are fighting, Baalveer almost finishes Prachandika, Baalveer is coming to Prachand lok, but she rises again. Baalveer is confused, Rani Pari comes & attacks on Mercury components.

episodesList.title: Prachandika's Mysterious Doll
episodesList.summary: Manav and Meher brings the doll close to a school tree. She brings one sandook, we see Prachandika come alive. Meher goes close to the tree.They all come to Prachand lok, Shatir & TaubaTauba, also shocked to see that Prachandika is alive, Prachandika tells the whole story to Shatir & TaubaTauba. Watch as action unfolds on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Doll Attacks Baalveer
episodesList.summary: Baalveer comes to school and sees many identical dolls but he doesn't find Manav and Meher. Manav and Meher are under the control of the evil doll & they obey the orders of the doll. Meanwhile, Baalveer is about to attack the main doll that's controlling all this. Watch now only on Sony LIV.

episodesList.title: Prachandika Apologizes To Baalveer
episodesList.summary: To get "kalishak tara," Ashavraj attacks Prachandika as she comes to Tantra Kund, she is badly injured, she meets Baalveer at the school library and asks him that now she wants to leave all evil behind and she wants to be a good pari, Baalveer brings her to Parilok.

episodesList.title: Mission Kanishk Tara
episodesList.summary: After some testing of Prachnadika Rani Pari, Baalveer & Praachndika are told to go and bring "Kalisak Tara". Initially, Ashavraj stops them, they enter Tantra Kund, but Baalveer tells him that they are sending them somewhere.

episodesList.title: The Kanishk Tara
episodesList.summary: Baalveer and Prachandika are about to leave but someone attacks Prachandika, Baalveer is shocked to see another Prachndika. She takes a "Kalishak Tara" and completes the duplicate of herself. Prachandika tells Baalveer her entire plan and shocks Baalveer.

cast.name: Dev Joshi
cast.role: as Baalveer / Ballu / Dev/ Debu/ Naqabposh: Baal Pari's adopted son; Vivaan's brother-figure; Jaikaas' biological son; Ray's estranged twin brother; Ananya's love interest; Saviour of the Earth.(2012–2016, 2019–2021) Baalveer / Veer Bhardwaj : Benaam and Bhasm’s biological-son; Adishi's adopted-son; Saviour of the Earth in another universe (2023, 2024, 2025) Happy Pandey, a happy-go-lucky guy from Kanpur, a lookalike of Baalveer who got 1/6th of his powers after his death. (2021) Kaal: an evil lookalike of Baalveer from Drak Lok who gets 1/6th portion of his powers and wants to kill the other lookalikes to obtain all the powers of Baalveer. (2021) Joshi also portrayed many lookalike of Baalveer including Prince Dorza (2016), four lookalike from different universes who were kidnapped by Kaal (2021) and Kaalveer, an evil shadow-lookalike of Baalveer created from the dark energy of the Manthan Kua. (2025)

cast.role: Baal Pari: Baalveer's adoptive mother; One of the Saptapari; Later, Rani Pari's successor; a fairy in Pari Lok who has the power of tresses and curls. She is the senior most fairy after Rani Pari and takes decisions in her absence. In the later season, she succeeds Rani Pari as Pari Lok's ruler. (2012-2016, 2019-2021) Benaam: Baalveer's biological-mother; Bhasm’s wife. She helps Veer in recollecting his true identity and proving his innocence. (2023, 2024, 2025)

title: Bhai Bhaiya Aur Brother
summary: Bhai Bhaiya Aur Brother is an Indian comedy television series, which aired on the SAB TV from 4 June 2012 to 10 August 2012.
plot: It's about a Gujarati family that unites after 15 years. Three brothers, who have been living separately with their own individual families, meet at middle brother's house in Mumbai. All are raised in three absolutely contrasting cultures. Younger brother's family has come from London and older brother's family is from a small village of Gujarat, called Pichurwadi. It's East meets West, in the centre situation, where from a 7-year-old child to 70-year-old grandmother, all of them, with various characteristics, standards of living and upbringing, live under one roof in a little humorous way with their discomforts and yet emotional bonding. The series progresses through the lighter situations mostly and warm and sensitive situations occasionally faced by all these peculiar characters, with their own individual quirks, likes and dislikes. How the families of the three brothers get into a relationship-how they need to be marginalized–how they need to learn something from one another-while embarking on a happy relationship is the main premise of the show.

title: Bhairavi Aavigalukku Priyamanaval
summary:
Bhairavi: Aavigalukku Priyamanaval (transl.  Bhairavi: The One beloved to spirits) is a 2012-2017 Indian Tamil-language supernatural horror mystery television series that aired on Sun TV from 29 January 2012 to 10 September 2017 for 1289 episodes.which airs only on Sunday at 10 PM.
The series follows the life of Nithya Das/Mahalakshmi (Bhairavi), who has the ability to see and communicate with ghosts. The show is produced by Saregama and director by P.S Dharan and S. Selvakumar. .
plot: The plot revolves around a young woman Bhairavi (Nitya Das/Sujitha/Radha), an antique shop owner who has had the ability since childhood to see ghosts. She uses her special abilities as a psychic medium to help the ghosts cross over to the Light (afterlife). Suddenly her life turns into some mysterious events where she is identified as goddess Madhura kaali, Kannagi reincarnation and is expected by demon to take revenge for destroyed him in the past. But however, she destroyed him again in the present and moves on her life again. Meanwhile, Madhura, a soft and a devotee of Madhura kaali and selliyamman started her journey to find goddess selliyamman's original statue. There, she faces a lot of struggle simultaneously, bhairavi is doing her work normally. At last, Bhairavi married Vijay, influential Zamindhar's heir but a sudden twist was happened in the story by Introducing character thamini, an evil soul who is Zamindhar's lover in the past and waits for marrying Zamindhar in the present who is actually in the same appearance of vijay at present. Amidst a lot of struggles bhairavi saved her husband.

title: Bodhu Kon Alo Laaglo Chokhe
summary: Bodhu Kon Alo Laaglo Chokhe (Bengali: বধূ কোন আলো লাগলো চোখে) is a Bengali television serial which used to air on GEC Star Jalsha. It was produced by Shree Venkatesh Films and starred Payel Dey and Sourav Chakraborty in the lead roles. After running for successful two and half years, it got replaced by Tumi Asbe Bole.
plot: The serial takes its name from a song from the dance drama Chitrangada, by Tagore. This is a story of a beautiful girl name Aalo and the various ups and downs she goes throughout her life. A failed marriage caused Aalo to attempt suicide but the twist of fate brought Sourav to her. Aalo accepts to nurture Sourav's daughter Icche, who suffers from an incurable disease. Though Aalo and Sourav care for each other they never represented themselves as ideal married couple as both of them are traumatized with their past experience of marriage.

title: Byaah Hamari Bahoo Ka
summary: Byaah Hamari Bahoo Ka (transl. Wedding of our daughter-in-law) is an Indian television series which aired on Sony Entertainment Television India from 28 May 2012 to 23 November 2012. It starred Shrenu Parikh and Gaurav Khanna .
plot:
The Vaishnav family in Baroda owns the Kanhaiya Dairy Farm. Yashoda, the female head of the family, encounters a poor couple and is impressed with their daughter Rajnibala "Rajni". Yashoda's son Krish falls in love with Rajni at first sight. Rajni and Krish are married in a grand Gujarati ceremony.
Things change as Rajni reveals that she has a son named Aryan born when she was 17 and became falsely involved in a surrogacy racket. Unable to abort the child, she gave him to her childless friend Archana and her husband Yash. However, Archana died shortly after. The family is shocked but accept Rajni anyway.
Aryan discovers that Rajni is his mother and insists on uniting with her. Krish decides to get Rajni married to Yash. In a sudden twist, Rajni quickly turns into an antagonist. She reveals that she plotted to marry Krish so she could take revenge from him. She accuses Krish of having made false promises of marriage to her sister Shikha. The betrayal left Shikha paralysed. Krish denies the allegations and is determined to uncover the real culprit. Meanwhile, Rajni takes control of the Vaishnav house and property and starts mistreating the family.
Yash learns that Krish is innocent but Krish tells him that they are being watched. An unknown man tries to kill Shikha many times and during one attack she gets scared and gets up from her wheelchair thus getting cured. The culprit kills Yash and Krish is revealed to be innocent. Rajni apologises and vows to uncover the truth. Rajni and Krish unite to find the truth and discover that the culprit is Krish's brother Rajan. He was the one who had an affair with Shikha and killed Yash. The family is shocked. Rajan is imprisoned.
Rajni and Krish go for their honeymoon to Mumbai. There they meet a man named Satya and his mother Tuljabai Dolkar. Krish finds her strangely familiar and on prodding she tells him that she worked as a maid at the Vaishnav house. When the Vaishnavs' son Krish and her own son Satya went out swimming, Satya went missing and was presumed drowned. In a fit of anger, Tuljabai kidnapped Krish and brought him to Mumbai and raised him poorly. Thus, Satya is revealed to be the real Krish.
Krish and Rajni return to Baroda with Satya and introduce him as the real Krish. The family immediately accept him. Yashoda reveals that Satya was brought back to the Vaishnavs in an unconscious state but failing to find Tuljabai and the real Krish, they decided to forget the incident and raise Satya as their own son.
Tuljabai arrives in Baroda and gives the Vaishnavs 20 days to spend time with Krish (the real Satya) before she takes him with her. However, after Yashoda saves her life in a minor fire, Tuljabai forgives the Vaishnavs and decides everyone should live together as a family. She celebrates Krish and Rajni's wedding with customs from her own Marathi culture and decides to return to Mumbai. Krish and Rajni enter the Vaishnav house with new hopes and dreams for a happy family life.

title: Bade Achhe Lagte Hain
summary:
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain (pronounced [bəˈɽeː ˈəttʃʰeː ləɡˈteː ɦɛ̃ː]; lit. They Look So Good) is an Indian soap opera that aired on Sony Entertainment Television from 30 May 2011 to 10 July 2014. Based on the Gujarati play Patrani by Imtiaz Patel, the soap opera was created and produced by Ekta Kapoor under the banner of Balaji Telefilms. The title of the show, along with the title-track, was derived from a song composed by R.D. Burman, from the soundtrack of the 1976 Bollywood film Balika Badhu.
The show explores the worlds of Priya Sharma (Sakshi Tanwar) and Ram Kapoor (Ram Kapoor), who accidentally discover love after getting married. After the storyline moved five years ahead in June 2012, many new actors and characters, including Samir Kochhar and Amrita Mukherjee who played the roles of Rajat Kapur and Peehu respectively, were introduced.
According to The Times of India, Bade Achhe Lagte Hain is the seventh most-watched television show of 2011 in India. The soap opera won the Kalakar Award for the Best Serial  and the People's Choice Award for Favourite TV Drama, both in 2012. The soap opera was voted the Most Inspiring Soap in 2013, receiving a vote count of 43.68%. It has been dubbed and rebroadcast in English, Tamil, and Telugu.
plot:
42 year old Ram Kapoor is an unmarried, wealthy, established, and well-reputed Mumbai-based Punjabi Hindu businessman. 33 year old Priya Sharma is a diligent working woman and comes from a middle-class Mumbai family. Ram's stepmother Niharika only uses him for money and is responsible for creating misunderstandings between his parents Amarnath Kapoor and Krishna Kapoor when he was 22, which led to Ram's mother Krishna leaving the house.
Ram's best friend Vikram is worried about Ram’s singleness and wants him to get married. Ram's spoilt half-sister, Natasha Kapoor, and Priya's brother, Kartik Sharma, fall in love and have to consider the taboo of younger siblings marrying before their elder siblings. Ram has yet to select a prospective spouse so the marriage of Kartik and Natasha must wait.
Thus, Ram and Priya agree to the practice of watta satta although Priya dislikes the economic disparity between their families. Ram and Priya consider each other arrogant and quarrelsome. However they grow respect for each other with time and get married. Niharika is unhappy as Ram and Priya's relationship is improving day by day.
Natasha always believed she was an unplanned child of Niharika due to her behaviour. She fears she won't be able to become a good mother so she aborts her baby and hides the fact from everyone that she was pregnant. She regrets it and becomes depressed. Priya's younger sister Ayesha starts blackmailing Natasha for showstopper position in Natasha's upcoming fashion show. Ram and Priya's trust in each other increases when Priya's ex Ashwin tries to cause misunderstanding but Ram exposes him without doubting Priya at all. Ram and Priya fall in love.
Natasha causes Ayesha’s wardrobe malfunction. Sid maliciously reveals this to Ayesha hence Ayesha and Natasha have a nasty catfight in public. Priya solves their problems and Natasha tries to change but after this incident, Priya's family become skeptical of Natasha. One day a nasty argument takes place due to Sudhir becoming ill. Kartik asks Natasha to leave the house. Niharika takes advantage of this and brutally beats up Natasha and manipulates her to frame Kartik. This causes a clash between Ram and Priya. Eventually Natasha feels guilty and apologies to Priya and Kartik.
Niharika tricks Natasha into staying in a room while she frames Kartik for her kidnapping. Priya confronts Niharika and Niharika says she needs to leave Ram to save Kartik's life. Priya teams up with Vikram and his wife Neha to defeat Niharika. Natasha apologies to Sharma family and shames Niharika. Priya tries to expose Niharika with the help of Natasha, Vikram and Neha but fails. Sid causes a terrible fraud and frames Ram for the same. Niharika reveals her true face and Ram is devastated. Priya takes the blame to save Ram and gets arrested leaving Ram shattered. Ram tries his best to save Priya but Ayesha gives a testimony in Sid's favour under Sid's manipulation and promise of true love. Priya gets imprisoned. Sid plans to kill Ram but Niharika realises the error of her ways and saves Ram and dies, leaving everyone heartbroken. Guilty and devastated Sid runs away. Priya is pregnant, has an accident that others believe has killed her. She moves to Dubai out of depression as she thinks she will never be proved innocent.
