articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The name of the soap opera, along with its title track, has been inspired by a song of the same name, composed by R. D. Burman, from the soundtrack of the 1976 Bollywood film Balika Badhu. Based on the Gujarati play Patrani by Imtiaz Patel, the soap opera is created by Ekta Kapoor and produced by her production company Balaji Telefilms. Ekta Kapoor had got the name, Bade Achhe Lagte Hain, registered about six years before the soap opera premiered.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain is reportedly one of the soap operas in India that broke the monotone of endless indoors-only sequences. Most of its shooting has been done in India. But many episodes of the soap opera have also been shot in foreign locales. Sixteen episodes of the soap opera (episodes 102–117) were shot in Australia over 14 days, in partnership with Tourism Australia, in late 2011, to portray the honeymoon of Ram (Kapoor) and Priya (Tanwar). Bade Achhe Lagte Hain also received support from Destination New South Wales, Sony Entertainment Television India and Balaji Telefilms.
During the summer of 2012, Ekta Kapoor introduced a five-year leap in the narrative. After this leap, 36 episodes of Bade Achhe Lagte Hain (episodes 235–270) had content which was shot in Dubai, UAE over a period of 10 days. These episodes portray Priya (Tanwar) living with her five-year-old daughter Peehu (Amrita Mukherjee) in the city until she has to return to Mumbai, in India. The production team failed to obtain the correct permits to shoot in Dubai and had to briefly stop shooting until the paperwork was processed.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text:
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain premiered on Sony Entertainment Television in India on 30 May 2011. It was initially intended to run for 150 episodes but it went on to telecast a total of 644 episodes, going off-air after completing a run of 3 years, 2 months and 41 days.
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain was dubbed in Telugu and broadcast on Gemini TV as Nuvvu Nachhavu, an afternoon soap opera, premiered on 9 April 2012. Bade Achhe Lagte Hain has also been dubbed in Tamil under the title Ullam Kollai Poguthada, and it premiered on Polimer TV, on 10 December 2012, with some of the characters' names changed.

articleSections.title: Integration episodes
articleSections.text: The show had two integration episodes with Kya Hua Tera Vaada on 4 and 5 December 2012 and one with Kehta Hai Dil...Jee Le Zara on 6 December 2013.

articleSections.title: Reboots
articleSections.text:
In July 2021, a sequel was announced, with the title Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 2. Nakuul Mehta was finalized as the male-lead of the sequel. Disha Parmar was approached and locked by the makers to play the female lead, doing her second project with Mehta after seven years. On 12 August 2021, the first teaser for the same was unveiled featuring leads, Mehta and Parmar, as Ram Kapoor and Priya Sood. The show premiered on 30 August 2021.
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 3 was announced after the previous season's TRP fell. The original leads of the previous season Mehta and Parmar were cast as the leads, marking their second collaboration with Ekta Kapoor.
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain 4 was announced on 25 March 2025. It stars Harshad Chopda and Shivangi Joshi as Rishabh "Rishu" Kapoor and Bhagyashree "Bhagya" Iyer.

articleSections.title: Response
articleSections.text:
Bade Achhe Lagte Hain had a television viewer rating of 1.3 in the debut week after its premiere, which increased ten weeks later to 3.7. It became the fifth most-watched Hindi television show in the thirty–fourth week (14–20 August) of 2011 in India, helping propel the broadcasting channel, Sony Entertainment Television India to number two in the rankings of the Hindi general entertainment television channels. The soap opera had a television viewer rating of 3.7 that week while Sony Entertainment Television India recorded a gross rating point of 245. and is the seventh most-watched of 2011.
Episode #166 which was directed by Anil V. Kumar The episode was backed by a teaser to draw hype and interest. Within minutes of its telecast the episode went viral on YouTube with nearly 150,630 hits and counting.efn-ua|group=note|See references: The episode worried certain viewers who did not want to watch the episode with their children. In early January 2013, the soap opera's TRP went down to 2.3.
In a 2014 poll conducted by Shaadi.com, Ram and Priya were voted the Favourite TV Couple by 42.3% of Indians. Fans even dub the on-screen couple Raya (also written as RaYa), which is a linguistic blend of the pair's names. Ram Kapoor was also called "the Indian husband we love" by a Sunday publication in 2012.

episodesList.title: Ram Is Lonely
episodesList.summary: A female pageant is organized in the city of dreams, Mumbai. Priya Sharma reaches on the registration desk to register her sister's name, Aisha. Priya Sharma is a lecturer. Business tycoon, Ram Kapoor, rushes for her sister Ipshikha's marriage. Priya explains the importance of love and marriage to her students.Ram gets extremely hurt as his mother didn't tell Ram to perform a small ritual in the marriage function. He feels lonely. Will Priya and Ram meet ? Will they fall in love? What has destiny planned for them?

episodesList.title: Aisha's Birthday Party
episodesList.summary: Priya reaches her residence to wish her sister, Aisha, but her mother had already organized a party without informing her. Vikram explains to Ram that he did so much for his family but his family doesn't value him. Priya's father urges her to find a life partner who can love her, support her, and think for her. Ram's mother discloses to Ipshikha that she never wanted Ram to get married. Vikram plans to make Ram meet a girl for marriage. Will Ram agree for marriage?

episodesList.title: Marriage Proposals
episodesList.summary: Priya's father again expresses his concern for her marriage. Priya's father urges her friend, Shruti, to talk to Priya about her marriage. Shruti introduces Priya to Vishal for her Marriage. Rehaan introduces a well-known model to Ram in regards to his marriage. Neha fights with Rehaan. Coincidently Ram and Priya are in the same restaurant. Will they meet? What has destiny planned for them?

episodesList.title: Ram Meets With A Small Accident
episodesList.summary: Ram Kapoor explains Vikram that he does not want to marry as he has crossed 40 and girls will marry him only because he is a rich tycoon. Priya too explains to her father that there is someone who is waiting for her. Priya discloses the unknown person's voice. Priya's mother releases her frustration on Priya. Priya's mother dashes her car with Ram's car. Will Ram and Priya meet this time? Will she recognize Ram's voice?

episodesList.title: The First Meeting
episodesList.summary: Priya's mother creates a scene as Ram's car accidentally dashes with Priya's car. Vikram apologizes for his mistake and urges Priya's mother to wind up the situation quickly. Ram misses his father's worship. Ram warns Priya's mother that he will destroy her. Priya and her father visit the police station instead of her mother.

episodesList.title: Karthik Slaps Natasha
episodesList.summary: Priya reaches Ram Kapoor's residence and Aisha Sharma reaches Ram's sister, Natasha Kapoor's studio, as she was selected for her fashion show. Natasha keeps her waiting for hours. A guest insults Natasha and Ram fumes in anger. Aisha's brother Karthik slaps Natasha Kapoor. Natasha likes Karthik. Karthik slaps Natasha as she made his sister wait for hours. She fumes in anger and accidentally her wrist gets cut by glass. Ram gets tensed. What will Ram do now?

episodesList.title: A Concerned Brother
episodesList.summary: Ram fumes in anger and urges Vikram to collect information about Karthik. Priya's mother Shipra can't believe that Natasha Kapoor likes Karthik. Priya's mother fumes in anger as she discloses to the police the incident that happened. Ram's mother forces Ram for Natasha and Karthik's marriage. Ram strictly denies. Priya calls Ram and discloses that there is no need to take this accident seriously. A huge misunderstanding is created between Ram and Priya, but who will clear it? Will Ram agree for Natasha and Karthik's marriage?

episodesList.title: Ram Decides To Meet Karthik's Family
episodesList.summary: Ram's mother orders Ram to talk to Karthik's parents as she wants Natasha to get married with Karthik, as she loves her. Ram fumes in anger. Priya gets upset, as her mother again shows her a photo of a guy who is much elder to her. Ram explains to Natasha to forget Karthik but she strictly denies it. Ram decides to meet Karthik's family. Will Ram and Priya meet this time?

episodesList.title: Shipra Plans To Call The Press
episodesList.summary: Ram and Priya converse for the first time. Priya identifies Ram's driver as he brings tablets for Ram. Ram and Priya both fumes in anger and fight with each other. The misunderstanding is still not cleared. Ram is talking about her sister Natasha and Priya is talking about his car. Shipra plans to call the press. Ram discloses Natasha that he has finalized her and Karthik's marriage. Karthik reveals that Ram Kapoor had visited Sharma residence to talk about Natasha's marriage. Shipra behaves crazy. Will Vikram clear his misunderstanding? Will Ram meet Priya again?

episodesList.title: Ram and Priya Decide To Meet
episodesList.summary: Karthik discloses about Natasha to Priya that he likes her. Priya calls Ram to talk about Natasha and Karthik's marriage but they again fight with each other, and she also calls Ram fat. Karthik finally accepts Natasha. Ram and Priya decide to meet. Vikram gives instructions to Ram and Shipra gives instructions to Priya as it's their first meeting. Will they again fight or talk politely with each other? What will be Priya's decision for Karthik's marriage?

episodesList.title: Priya Apologies To Ram
episodesList.summary: Priya apologizes Ram, as she insulted him by calling fat during their previous phone conversations. Priya invites Ram with his family members at her residence in regard to Natasha and Karthik's marriage. What will happen when Ram's family will meet Priya's mother, Shipra, who is extremely excited about Natasha and Karthik's marriage?

episodesList.title: Priya Is Angry At Karthik
episodesList.summary: Karthik denies to marry Natasha and discloses that until and unless his elder sister Priya does not marry he won't marry Natasha. Ram Kapoor appreciates Karthik's love for his family and his sister. He promises that Natasha will marry Karthik. Priya gets angry at Karthik. Natasha decides to go to London.

episodesList.title: Hunt For An Eligible Bachelor
episodesList.summary: Shipra calls a priest to find out a good looking boy for Priya. Priya gets angry as Aisha mentions her age wrong. Vikram and Ram discuss Priya. Aisha and Priya discuss Natasha's behaviour. Vikram urges Ram to ask Priya with regards to the selection of a boy. Ram meets Priya at her coaching classes to ask her which kind of boy she would like to marry? Will Priya select a boy for herself? What will be Priya's decision?

episodesList.title: Priya Gets A Proposal
episodesList.summary: Shipra gets angry with Ashwin. Ipshikha's mother-in-law brings a marriage proposal for Ram but Ram's mother avoids it. Ram's mother discloses her worry to her brother, Raghav, in regards to Ram's marriage. Ram gets tensed as he has to find a boy for Priya in 1 week. Priya's mother Shipra discloses that a boy has selected Priya in regards to the marriage and wants to meet her. Will Priya meet him?

episodesList.title: Will Priya Marry Vinit?
episodesList.summary: Natasha threatens Karthik to come along with her for a movie. Priya meets Vinit in regards to her marriage. Priya urges Vinit to give her some time for her final decision. All family members are quiet positive for Priya and Vinit's marriage. Will Priya agree to marry Vinit? What will be Priya's final decision?

episodesList.title: Priya's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Ram discloses his secret of life, that he lives for his family. Priya finds Ram's voice familiar. Niharika watches Natasha fighting with Karthik, thus, she instantly decides to fix their engagement function. Ram discloses to Vikram that there is no perfect match for Priya. Natasha warns Karthik that she will leave him and go back to her ex-boyfriend. Is Priya really happy with her engagement? What has destiny planned for Ram and Priya?

episodesList.title: Priya Is Heartbroken
episodesList.summary: Priya's father, Sudhir, gets extremely angry at Shipra as she was differentiating between Karthik and Priya. Ram discloses to Natasha that she has selected the best boy for herself. All family members are extremely happy and excited for Priya's engagement. Ram urges Priya not to get engaged. Vikram shares some important information with Ram in regards to the boy who is getting engaged with Priya. Priya's father blames Ram. Will Priya forgive Ram?

episodesList.title: Another Marriage Prospect For Priya
episodesList.summary: Priya promises Sharma and Kapoor family that Karthik and Natasha will definitely get married. Priya gets extremely upset. Raghav discloses to his sister Niharika about Ram and Priya's marriage. Niharika considers Priya as her biggest obstacle. Ram feels guilty about the incident. Raghav reveals to Niharika that Ram and Priya's marriage will be super beneficial. Will Ram agree to marry Priya? What will be Priya and her family's decision?

episodesList.title: Another Confusion
episodesList.summary: Ram Kapoor gets a shock as Niharika discloses to Ram about Priya for his marriage. Ram couldn't believe that his mother selected Priya for his marriage. On the other hand, a big confusion happens in Priya's house as all members are assuming that Ram's marriage proposal is for Aisha. Sharma family reaches Kapoors' residence with Aisha.

episodesList.title: Priya Rejects The Proposal
episodesList.summary: Niharika takes the initiative to clear the misunderstanding that happened between Sharma and Kapoor family. Sharma family gets shocked to hear that Ram's marriage was fixed with Priya and not with Aisha. Priya's intentions were not to insult the Kapoor family. Raghav urges Niharika to persuade Ram for marriage at any cost. Will Priya and Ram agree to marry each other? What will be Ram's decision?

episodesList.title: Ram And Priya Decide To Meet
episodesList.summary: The Sharma family completely agrees with Priya and Ram's marriage proposal but Priya does not take it seriously. Finally, Ayesha persuades Priya to meet Ram and Priya agrees too. Priya and Ram both prepare to meet each other. Ram and Priya both loose their cool and fight with each other. Natasha becomes a trouble for Karthik. The media people take snaps of Ram and Priya in the restaurant as they assume them as a future couple. What will Rama and Priya do now?

episodesList.title: Ram And Priya Make The Headlines
episodesList.summary: The media and news channel suddenly takes snaps and interviews of Ram and Priya during their conversation in the restaurant and spreads the news that Ram purposed Priya. Shipra again insults Priya. Priya gets shock to see her photograph in the newspaper. Ram gets upset. Priya's family and Ram's family are extremely happy with the news that has been aired on the T.V. Will Ram and Priya agree for marriage? What will be Ram and Priya's decision?

episodesList.title: A Compromise
episodesList.summary: Priya and Ram both disclose their engagement date and time to their respective families. Family members gets surprised to hear the time as Ram and Priya wants to get engaged in the night at 10.30 pm. Priya and Ram both select ring for each other. Vikram and Neha helps Ram to get ready for his engagement. All family members of Kapoor and Sharma are extremely happy in regards to Ram and Priya's engagement ceremony. Will Ram and Priya ever fall in love?

episodesList.title: Ram And Priya's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Kapoor family and Sharma family clicks photographs with Ram and Priya in regards to their engagement ceremony. Natasha forces Karthik to come along with her in the party but Karthik strictly denies. Neha and Vikram shows Ram's room to Priya. Natasha visits her friends party against Karthik's order. Ram and Priya discloses their likes and dislikes. Ram disagrees to share his cupboard space with Priya. Will they ever fall in love?

episodesList.title: Natasha Insults Priya
episodesList.summary: Vikram gets tensed as he gets a job opportunity from a multinational firm, but he will have to leave Ram Kapoor's firm which will affect his friendship. Natasha's friend informs Karthik about the fake accident of Natasha. She insults Priya and Karthik fumes in anger. Will Natasha break her engagement with Karthik? Will it affect Priya and Ram's marriage?

episodesList.title: Natasha And Karthik Break Up
episodesList.summary: Natasha gets bruises on her face as Karthik slapped her. Natasha discloses to Ram that she does not want to marry Karthik. Ram fumes in anger and heads towards Karthik's residence. Sudhir slaps Karthik. Karthik reveals the truth. What will be Ram and Priya's final decision in regards to their marriage? Will Natasha forgive Karthik?

episodesList.title: Karthik Apologizes To Natasha
episodesList.summary: Ram Kapoor informs her mother that he wants to break his engagement with Priya as Karthik and Natasha's engagement is broken. Shipra fumes in anger as society people insults Priya. Karthik puts the whole blame on himself. Natasha makes Karthik sit on his knees to accept his apology. Priya considers her engagement with Ram as an accident. Shipra's car again meets with an accident. Will Karthik's apology make a difference? Will Priya and Ram get married?

episodesList.title: Natasha Is Expecting
episodesList.summary: Natasha's heath gets disturbed in regards to frequent vomiting. Niharika doubts on Natasha and forces her to go through a test. Niharika fumes in anger as Natasha is expecting a child. Priya discloses Ram about breaking their relationship and also urges to exchange the ring. Niharika reveals a shocking truth to Natasha about Ram and forces her to marry Karthik. Will Natasha agree to marry Karthik? What will be Ram's decision?

episodesList.title: Ram Is In A Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Ram is frustrated with the whole situation as Natasha suddenly decides to marry Karthik without any terms and conditions. Ram finally agrees that he is engaged to Priya. Ashwin promises Priya that he will keep her happy. Priya declares Ram as his fiance in front of Ashwin. Will destiny bring Ram and Priya together? Will they agree for marriage?

episodesList.title: Priya Shows Ram Her Secret Room
episodesList.summary: Natasha decides to reveal the truth to Karthik about her child but Niharika stops her. Shipra discloses Priya that Niharika has confirmed Ram's marriage with Priya. Niharika orders priest to fix Ram and Priya's marriage date as fast as possible. A clash happens between the two priests in regards to marriage dates. Priya shows her secret room to Ram which has played a very significant role in her life. Which date will be fixed for Ram and Priya's marriage?

episodesList.title: Wedding Bells
episodesList.summary: Ram and Priya share their marriage happiness with all the family members. Ram gets extremely excited about his marriage preparations and urges Vikram to call Siddhanth. Ram discusses his marriage preparations with both the family members. Priya explicates Ram that her father Sudhir has lots of expectations in regards to her marriage which Sudhir is unable to perform. What will be Ram's decision?

episodesList.title: Ram Wins Sudhir's Heart
episodesList.summary: Ram Kapoor assures Priya's father Sudhir that he has all rights to organize his daughter's marriage in whichever way he wants and will support him. Ram discloses his family members that both the marriages will be conducted at different places. Is there a trouble waiting for Sharma family? What will be Niharika and her brother's planning?

episodesList.title: Ram Becomes A Laughing Stock
episodesList.summary: Ram calls Priya and urges her to book an AC hall, as he has, a breathing problem. Priya and her family members fail to control their laughter. Niharika forces Ram to go on a date with Priya as they are soon going to get married. Ram gets tensed. Niharika gets a call from Apeksha Malhotra. Is she related to Ram Kapoor and his family?

episodesList.title: Double Date
episodesList.summary: Ram picks Priya from her coaching classes. Natasha and Karthik are extremely excited as this is their first date and gets engaged in romance. Ram and Priya's conversations are pretty formal. Ram watches Cricket match whereas Priya reads the book. Apeksha's call disturbs Ram. Niharika gets tensed as her mother-in-law arrives. Will Ram and Priya enjoy their first date?

episodesList.title: Ram And Priya Spend Some Quality Time
episodesList.summary: Sudhir teases Shipra as his mother-in-law is arriving. Shipra guides Karthik to leave Ram and Priya alone in the car. Shipra and her mother get extremely excited as they watch Ram and Priya together. Priya describes Ram to her Naani and Ram describes Priya to his Daadi. Will Apeksha Malhotra be a hurdle in Ram and Priya's marriage? What will Ram do now?

episodesList.title: Clashing Views
episodesList.summary: Shipra and Sudhir receives their guest and relatives. Shipra breaks down in to tears as her mother informs her about a function in which there will be a small question answer session for Ram in regards to Priya's marriage at Ram's residence. Kapoor family strictly denies to perform the function. Shipra's mother fumes in anger. Will Ram succeed in convincing his Daadi?

episodesList.title: The Shobha Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Daadi gets emotional as Ram refreshes his Daadaji's memories and reveals how he respected every ceremony regards to the marriage. Ram notifies Priya about Sobha ceremony and Sharma family expresses their happiness. Niharika's brother informs her about the arrival of Apeksha Malhotra. Niharika gets tensed. Sharma family visits Ram's residence for Shobha ceremony.

episodesList.title: Family Get Together
episodesList.summary: Ram Kapoor introduces Sharma family to his relatives and Daadi. The Sobha Ceremony begins where Naani starts questioning Ram which becomes difficult for him to answer, but also assures Naani that he will keep Priya happy. Priya discloses few personal details about herself to Daadi. Apeksha Malhotra visits Ram Kapoor's residence. Will Ram meet Apeksha? Will Priya come to know about Ram's past?

episodesList.title: Ram Is Furious
episodesList.summary: Daadi and Naani try to affront each other with regards to the selection of costumes and jewellery. Priya smartly handles the situation by giving individual choices to Daadi and Naani. Apeksha Malhotra forces Ram to meet her and he fumes in anger. Ram thanks Priya for handling the situation. The marriage preparations in full swing. Will Ram reveal Priya about Apeksha?

episodesList.title: Wedding Shopping
episodesList.summary: Priya, Shruti and Ayesha decide to go for shopping. Ram tries his marriage outfit and finds it too fit. Vikram and Neha decide to organize strict dieting for Ram. Priya's friend Shruti conducts a small party. Priya tries several outfits and gets confused. Ram doubts that Apeksha Malhotra might spoil his marriage. Sudhir and Priya gets emotional. Will Niharika and her brother save Ram from Apeksha Malhotra?

episodesList.title: Ram Faints Due To Stress
episodesList.summary: Ram finds it difficult to control his diet. Niharika plans to organize marriage related functions in a hall inspite of the house. Niharika discloses her plan of organizing Sangeet and Mehndi ceremony of Ram, Priya, Karthik and Natasha on the same day and Sudhir agrees. Shipra worries about Priya. Apeksha Malhotra visits Ram Kapoor's office. Ram faints due to over stress. Employee informs Niharika that Ram is admitted in the hospital. Will Ram reveal Priya about Apeksha?

episodesList.title: Cops Arrest Apeksha Malhotra
episodesList.summary: The Doctor discloses Niharika to postpone all the functions as it will affect Ram's health. Ram urges Niharika not to reveal Priya or her family members about his illness as it might disturb their function. The cops arrest Apeksha Malhotra. All family members are extremely happy in regards with Priya's mehendi and sangeet ceremony. Members resides for sangeet function. What will happen when Priya will come to know that Ram is hospitalized? Will Apeksha become a hurdle in Ram and Priya's marriage?

episodesList.title: Mehendi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Kapoor and Sharma families are extremely busy in enjoying Sangeet and Mehndi. Priya calls Ram as he was missing from the function. Ram reveals to Priya that he is busy in a meeting and henceforth not to give a call. Vikram finally discloses the truth to Priya that due to low blood pressure, he is hospitalized. Priya gets a shock. What will Priya do now? Will Priya meet Ram?

episodesList.title: Thoughtful Priya
episodesList.summary: Priya discloses Ram that she left the Sangeet and Mehndi function when she came to know about his illness. Funny conversations take place between Ram and Priya. Nani fights with Daadi. Ram reveals his illness in front of all the family members. Daadi showers her blessings on Ram and Priya. What will be Apeksha Malhotra's next step?

episodesList.title: Rishabh Kapoor Surprises The Family
episodesList.summary: Ram's yonger brother, Rishabh Kapoor gives a huge surprise to Kapoor family. All members dance to the amazing tunes of Bollywood and gives a rocking dance performance. Students from blind school dedicates a devotional performance to Priya and Ram, supports her by donating a huge amount for their school. Is there a trouble waiting for Ram and Priya?

episodesList.title: Priya Is Emotional
episodesList.summary: Priya gets extremely emotional in regards with her family as she is soon going to be Mrs. Kapoor. Aisha expresses her feelings for Priya and also reveals how whole family is habitual to her. Journalist exposes the food menu which will be held during Natasha's marriage. Ram gets emotional in regards with her sister, Natasha. What kind of preparations has Priya done for Karthik's marriage?

episodesList.title: Karthik And Natasha Are Hitched
episodesList.summary: The groom Karthik Sharma and his family resides form his house and proceeds towards Ram Kapoor's residence for his marriage. News reporters attack Sharma family with their never-ending questions. Ram Kapoor and his family welcomes their guest and Sharma family in a unique way. Karthik finally ties the knot with Natasha. Ram gets emotional. Apeksha's lawyer informs her that after a hour she will be released from police station. What will Apeksha do now?

episodesList.title: Natasha's Stubbornness
episodesList.summary: Ram gets emotional as his dear sister, Natasha gets married to Karthik. Niharika doesn't call his son, Ram for Natasha's Kanyadaan, instead she searches for her son, Siddharth. Ram gets upset. Priya feels Ram's pain and assures him that her sister will be happy in Karthik's house. Karthik fumes in anger as Natasha forces him to go for honeymoon directly from the wedding venue. What will be Karthik's decision? Will he agree or disagree?

episodesList.title: Priya's Farewell

soundtrack.composer: The title track of the soap opera, inspired by the song Bade Achhe Lagte Hain is composed by R. D. Burman, from the 1976 Bollywood movie, Balika Badhu. The lyrics of the soap opera's title track have been penned up by Nawab Arzoo and the title track has been sung by Shreya Ghoshal and Trijayh Dey. Lalit Sen provided the music to the title track. The background music or the incidental music of the soap opera has been provided by Abhishek Singh and Mintu Jha. It also includes songs from soundtrack albums of few Bollywood movies. The Tamil version of the title track song was sung by Shweta Mohan, with hummings of Shreya Ghoshal reused.

plotHtml:
42 year old Ram Kapoor is an unmarried, wealthy, established, and well-reputed Mumbai-based Punjabi Hindu businessman. 33 year old Priya Sharma is a diligent working woman and comes from a middle-class Mumbai family. Ram's stepmother Niharika only uses him for money and is responsible for creating misunderstandings between his parents Amarnath Kapoor and Krishna Kapoor when he was 22, which led to Ram's mother Krishna leaving the house.
Ram's best friend Vikram is worried about Ram’s singleness and wants him to get married. Ram's spoilt half-sister, Natasha Kapoor, and Priya's brother, Kartik Sharma, fall in love and have to consider the taboo of younger siblings marrying before their elder siblings. Ram has yet to select a prospective spouse so the marriage of Kartik and Natasha must wait.
Thus, Ram and Priya agree to the practice of watta satta although Priya dislikes the economic disparity between their families. Ram and Priya consider each other arrogant and quarrelsome. However they grow respect for each other with time and get married. Niharika is unhappy as Ram and Priya's relationship is improving day by day.
Natasha always believed she was an unplanned child of Niharika due to her behaviour. She fears she won't be able to become a good mother so she aborts her baby and hides the fact from everyone that she was pregnant. She regrets it and becomes depressed. Priya's younger sister Ayesha starts blackmailing Natasha for showstopper position in Natasha's upcoming fashion show. Ram and Priya's trust in each other increases when Priya's ex Ashwin tries to cause misunderstanding but Ram exposes him without doubting Priya at all. Ram and Priya fall in love.
Natasha causes Ayesha’s wardrobe malfunction. Sid maliciously reveals this to Ayesha hence Ayesha and Natasha have a nasty catfight in public. Priya solves their problems and Natasha tries to change but after this incident, Priya's family become skeptical of Natasha. One day a nasty argument takes place due to Sudhir becoming ill. Kartik asks Natasha to leave the house. Niharika takes advantage of this and brutally beats up Natasha and manipulates her to frame Kartik. This causes a clash between Ram and Priya. Eventually Natasha feels guilty and apologies to Priya and Kartik.
Niharika tricks Natasha into staying in a room while she frames Kartik for her kidnapping. Priya confronts Niharika and Niharika says she needs to leave Ram to save Kartik's life. Priya teams up with Vikram and his wife Neha to defeat Niharika. Natasha apologies to Sharma family and shames Niharika. Priya tries to expose Niharika with the help of Natasha, Vikram and Neha but fails. Sid causes a terrible fraud and frames Ram for the same. Niharika reveals her true face and Ram is devastated. Priya takes the blame to save Ram and gets arrested leaving Ram shattered. Ram tries his best to save Priya but Ayesha gives a testimony in Sid's favour under Sid's manipulation and promise of true love. Priya gets imprisoned. Sid plans to kill Ram but Niharika realises the error of her ways and saves Ram and dies, leaving everyone heartbroken. Guilty and devastated Sid runs away. Priya is pregnant, has an accident that others believe has killed her. She moves to Dubai out of depression as she thinks she will never be proved innocent.
tagline: 42 year old Ram Kapoor is an unmarried, wealthy, established, and well-reputed Mumbai-based Punjabi Hindu businessman.

title: Banana News Network
summary: Banana News Network or BNN is a Pakistani TV show that was broadcast on GEO TV on Tuesdays at 11:05pm. It originally starred Murtaza Chaudhry and his team who were formerly part of 4 Man Show on Aaj TV.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text: BNN puts a comical spin on the happenings in Pakistan. It is a fictitious channel in which celebrities are mocked. The show has segments such as Sports Desk, News Room and Central Studio discussion. Celebrities mocked most often include Mirza Iqbal Baig, Ansar Abbasi and politicians. The main difference between BNN and other comedy Pakistani shows is that only four cast members are employed and they dress up as different celebrities on each show.

articleSections.title: Parting
articleSections.text: The show was restarted in autumn 2013 without Murtaza Chaudhry, Mustafa Chaudhry and Mohsin Abbas Haider. Haider left the show to join Mazaaq Raat on Dunya TV.
