However, Swayam is soon stabbed to death by Payal because he was getting in the way of her plans. Later on, when Payal was about to remarry Shubh, the kidnapper reveals everything and brings the real Aastha to Shubh. A fight ensues.
Eventually, it is revealed that the real culprit behind both Swayam and Shubh's murders is their own brother Saksham. Shubh's mother Sulochana wants to hand over Saksham to the police after he tries to kill a pregnant Aastha but Aastha pleads on his behalf. Saksham's wife Anoushka, who had so far hated Aastha and mistreated her, has a change of heart and apologises to Aastha. In a bid to do right by the family, she herself calls the police and Saksham is arrested. The story ends with Aastha and Sulochana embracing and waiting for Aastha and Shubh's child to fulfil the vacuum in their lives.

title: Bigg Boss
summary: Bigg Boss is an Indian Hindi-language reality television show of the Bigg Boss franchise in India that airs on Colors TV. It is based on the Dutch format of Big Brother, developed by Endemol. Since its premiere on November 3, 2006, the show has completed nineteen seasons and three OTT (Over-the-Top) seasons. Throughout its run, Bigg Boss has seen a variety of hosts. The first season was hosted by Arshad Warsi, followed by Shilpa Shetty in the second season and Amitabh Bachchan in the third. Farah Khan led the Halla Bol season, while Sanjay Dutt co-hosted the fifth season with Salman Khan. Since season 4, Salman Khan has taken the helm as the show's primary host. As of season 19, a total of 353 contestants has participated in Bigg Boss. Thirteen contestants have returned for other seasons, while two played as proxy contestants and 4 were not selected by the audience, preventing them from entering the house. As of season 19, Bigg Boss has aired a total of 2,076 episodes.

articleSections.title: Concept
articleSections.text:
Bigg Boss is a reality TV show inspired by the original Dutch Big Brother format created by John de Mol Jr. In this competition, a group of contestants, referred to as "housemates", live together in a specially designed house, cut off from the outside world. Each week, these housemates nominate each other for eviction, and those with the highest nominations face a public vote. Ultimately, one housemate is "evicted" each week.
There are some unique elements to the eviction process. Besides public voting, housemates with special privileges, like the captain, may have the power to evict someone directly. Additionally, Bigg Boss has the authority to modify the eviction process as needed, sometimes introducing exceptions or twists.
The final week of the show, with three to six housemates left. During this time, the public votes for their favorite contestant, leading to the crowning of a winner.
While most participants are celebrities in Indian version, seasons 10, 11 and 12 saw an influx of commoners as housemates, bringing a new dynamic to the show. Notably, Manveer Gurjar, a commoner, emerged as the winner of Season 10.
The housemates' actions and interactions are monitored by the voice of Bigg Boss, a mysterious figure who represents the show's authority and enforces rules.

articleSections.title: House
articleSections.text:
The Bigg Boss house is a unique and carefully designed space that serves as the central setting for the popular reality show which is built for each season. Over the seasons, its location has varied, with the initial seasons situated in tourist-magnate hill station of Lonavala, Pune district of Maharashtra and later moving to ND Studios in Karjat, in Maharashtra's Raigad district for Season 5. From Season 13 onwards, the house has been established in Film City, Goregaon, Mumbai.
The architecture of the house is contemporary and well-furnished, featuring a range of modern amenities to facilitate the daily lives of the housemates. Key areas include: Kitchen, Living Area, Bedroom (two in first three seasons while four in sixteenth season and three in seventeenth season), Bathrooms (two toilets, two bathrooms, two washrooms in bedroom, one washroom in jail, one washroom in garden area), Storeroom, Garden and Pool Area, Lounge Room, Activity Area, Medical Room, Smoking Room, Luggage Area, Dining Area, Jail, Gym and Balcony.
One notable aspect of the Bigg Boss house is the Confession Room, an essential feature where housemates can express their thoughts, feelings, strategy or any kind of conversation as Bigg Boss listens and talks with them. This is also where the nomination process occurs sometimes.
To ensure the housemates remain disconnected from the outside world, the house is devoid of televisions, telephones, internet access, clocks, books, pens, or paper.

articleSections.title: Rules
articleSections.text:
While not all the rules have been explicitly communicated to the audience, several key ones are clearly established. Inmates are required to speak only in Hindi. Tampering with any electronic equipment or other items in the house is strictly prohibited. They may not leave the premises at any time without permission. Physical violence is completely forbidden. Discussing the nomination process with anyone is also not allowed. Housemates must remain awake until the lights go off, and they can only converse outside of the designated smoking area. Additionally, singing is not permitted within the house, nor can they write anything while inside.
Occasionally, housemates may be nominated for various reasons, including being chosen by individuals with special privileges obtained through tasks, for breaking rules, or for other unspecified reasons. In serious cases, a contestant may face expulsion from the house.

articleSections.title: Airing
articleSections.text:
The main television coverage of the show consists of a daily highlights program and a weekly eviction show, typically aired on Saturday/Sunday and known as Weekend Ka Vaar or for Monday known as Somvaar Ka Vaar. In Seasons 16 and 17, the weekend episodes moved to Friday/Saturday (Shukravar Ka Vaar and Shanivar Ka Vaar), all broadcast on Colors TV, while the first season aired on Sony TV.
Each daily episode features key events from the previous day, while Saturday’s episodes focus primarily on the host's analysis of the housemates' performances and special tasks. Sunday’s episodes include a fun segment with guest appearances and the eviction of the housemates nominated that week. Notably, in Seasons 16 and 17, evictions took place on Saturdays instead of Sundays.
From Season 14 onward, Bigg Boss introduced a 24/7 Live Channel for Voot Select subscribers, and later for JioCinema Premium subscribers. This allowed viewers to enjoy direct engagement with the show’s happenings. Episodes were also aired 30 minutes earlier on Voot Select and JioCinema Premium until Season 17.
In Season 16, a new segment titled Bigg Bulletin with Shekhar Suman was introduced, airing on Sundays and hosted by Shekhar Suman. Season 17 saw the introduction of another segment, Just Chill with Arbaaz & Sohail, hosted by Arbaaz Khan and Sohail Khan, also on Sundays. In Season 18, episodes included Tandav Ka Overtime, extending the usual one-hour episode with additional content to cover the day's events. Season 18 also saw the launch of segment named Haye Daiyaa with Ravi Bhaiyya Garda Udaa Denge, hosted by Season 1 finalist Ravi Kishan, again on Sundays.
On Season 19 and Season 20, episodes will be aired 90 minutes before the television broadcast on JioHotstar.

articleSections.title: Spin-off
articleSections.text:
The series also has a digital version of the show called Bigg Boss OTT. Started in 2021, the first season was hosted by Karan Johar and broadcast by Voot for 24×7 coverage.
The second season aired on 2023 and was hosted by Salman Khan and broadcast by JioCinema for the 24x7 live feed.
The OTT series has rolled out its third season in 2024, hosted by Anil Kapoor and broadcast by JioCinema for the 24x7 live feed.

episodesList.title: Bigg Boss 9 Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan calls the contestants onto the stage for the grand finale. After a comedy session with Krishna and Bharti, Prince was declared as the winner of season 9.

episodesList.title: Season Premiere: Bigg Boss S11
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan kicks off the excitement with the cast of Judwaa 2, as Bigg Boss returns for its eleventh season. With 14 housemates more diverse than ever, this season raises the bar to epic proportions by introducing 4 Padosis, who will have total power over the housemates. Wait. there is more. Salman himself will be one of the Padosis. He will watch over their every move. So get ready for this journey of high-octane drama, surprises and fierce rivalry.

episodesList.title: Bigg Outbursts Gives Fiery Start
episodesList.summary: Day 1: Puneesh and Zubair are already at each other's throats and a small altercation almost gets physical between them. The Padosis are tasked with an outrageous challenge by Bigg Boss. How will the housemates react to such a fiery start to the season?

episodesList.title: The Nomination Begins!
episodesList.summary: Day 2: The members are given the opportunity to nominate two housemates for elimination. Some go for the obvious, based on previous spats and some try to eliminate a strong contender. Bigg Boss empowers the Padosis to make the final judgement allowing them to save one nominated person. Whose fortunes will be turned by the Padosis?

episodesList.title: The Drama King Of Bigg Boss
episodesList.summary: Day 3: Who's the drama king of Bigg Boss? Zubair Khan has made the cut for the title as he's leaving no stone unturned to get into fights with everybody in the house. What has he told Bandgi and Arshi now?

episodesList.title: Did Zubair Call Arshi A 2 Rupees Aurat?
episodesList.summary: Day 4: The tension inside the house reaches its peak when Shilpa and Arshi find themselves on the receiving end of some severe criticism. The duos' reluctance to cooperate with anyone initiates a very ugly spat, with Zubair coming down hard on Arshi. With all the melodrama being monitored by the padosis, will the four neighbours take advantage of this growing unrest?

episodesList.title: Who Will Be Put Behind Bars?
episodesList.summary: Day 5: With old rivalries reigniting and new ones erupting with every passing day, the housemates get ready to face the horror of the Kaal Kothri. Tempers flare as the Bigg Boss asks the housemates to nominate three people whom they wish to send to the Kaal Kothri. Who will be the first inmates of the Bigg Boss prison?

episodesList.title: Salman Kicks Priyank Out!
episodesList.summary: The first week, riddled with ugly spats and much foul-mouthed language has got on Salman's nerves. Zubair Khan is the first victim of Salman's fury. But what makes him throw Priyank Sharma out of the house? How will the other housemates react to this drastic step? Get ready to see Salman at his best and worst, when he is really angry.

episodesList.title: Bigg Fun With Golmaal Again!
episodesList.summary: Priyank Sharma's shocking eviction has the house divided, some are feeling guilty and a few celebrate Salman's decision. One more housemate is headed for a similar fate, as the angry host's justice is swift and decisive. Who will it be? But before the departures, watch the cast of Golmaal Again as they join Salman onstage to spread some cheer on Bigg Boss.

episodesList.title: The Padosis Make Their Entry
episodesList.summary: Day 7: The much anticipated moment is here. With their fake identities in place, the Padosis finally get the Bigg order to join the housemates. But with the unending conflicts and chaos in the house, they are surely going to have a tough time keeping their fake back story intact. Join the Padosis as they gear up for this wild ride.

episodesList.title: Choose Your Queen!
episodesList.summary: Day 8: What happens when two drama queens get to be real queens? Look no further than the new luxury budget task where Shilpa Shinde and Arshi Khan get to play the good and the evil queen respectively. But the king, Hiten Tejwani is put to the task of recognising the good queen out of the two. With newfound powers in place and the season's first captaincy on the line, watch out because things are starting to heat up.

episodesList.title: Padosis Almost Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Day 10: The new luxury budget advances to an exciting conclusion because King Hiten Tejwani believes he has recognised the good queen. Will he be able to turn his monarchy into a captaincy? But it seems Vikas Gupta is the real winner because he has cracked open the Padosis' fake backstory. Will he use this knowledge to his advantage?

episodesList.title: No Longer Besties?
episodesList.summary: Day 11: In this game of ever changing friendships, it's Shilpa Shinde and Arshi Khan's turn. With Shilpa Shinde dissing her in front of the whole house, Arshi Khan would not take it lightly. Watch the two divas battle it out, while their friendship crumbles.

episodesList.title: Sapna Sprays Insecticide On Arshi!
episodesList.summary: Day 12: The drama in the Bigg Boss house reaches next level when Sapna Choudhary sprays insecticide on Arshi Khan in the kaal kothri. Not one to take it sitting down, Arshi Khan too fires her shots. What does she do?

episodesList.title: Hina Faces The Heat
episodesList.summary: After a roller coaster of a second week, it is time for the witness box and some confessions. From Vikas Gupta's captaincy to Arshi Khan's foul language being put into question, the housemates have a lot of explaining to do. But no one has a worse time in the witness box than Hina Khan. Watch as she wades through a barrage of accusations and of course, Salman Khan's eagle eye scrutiny.

episodesList.title: Diwali Dhamaka With Bigg Boss
episodesList.summary: After two weeks of emotional fireworks, it is time for a grand Diwali sale in the house. What happens when the housemates play the roles of both the shopkeepers and the shopping items? Well, the guests, Rithvik Dhanjani and Ravi Dubey are here to put this hilarious sale into action. With another elimination around the corner, some fun seems like a good idea.

episodesList.title: Lucinda Pays A Heavy Price
episodesList.summary: Day 15: The Padosis pay a heavy price for not being able to perform their secret task. As a punishment, Lucinda Nicholas is evicted in a most shocking manner. The whole house is shaken. How do the others react?

episodesList.title: Vikas Faces A Bigg Punishment
episodesList.summary: Captain Vikas Gupta is about to pay the price for resorting to violence during the luxury budget task. Bigg Boss takes a swift decision to punish the captain. Team Vikas and Team Puneesh indulge in a chaotic display of frustration and fury in one hell of a task. Get ready for a double dose of chaos.

episodesList.title: Vikas Hatches A New Game Plan
episodesList.summary: The eve of Diwali turns special as some subtle fireworks light up inside the house. The mastermind behind all this is none other than Vikas Gupta. From inciting Luv Tyagi to turning Bandgi Kalra against Puneesh Sharma, the fallen captain plays the biggest game of all.

episodesList.title: Arshi Does The Unthinkable!
episodesList.summary: Day 17: The ugly spat between Arshi Khan and Hina Khan reaches the ultimate level with Arshi Khan doing the unthinkable. This incident created the biggest controversy ever in the history of Bigg Boss. Curious to know what happened?

episodesList.title: Maintain An Arms Distance, Roars Hina
episodesList.summary: The captaincy war is on and someone has just got on Hina Khan's nerves. Who do you think has crossed her this time?

episodesList.title: Hina And Arshi In Sultani Akhada!
episodesList.summary: The conflict between Arshi Khan and Hina Khan is at an all-time high. Salman Khan gives them a chance to bury the hatchet at the Sultani Akhada, but is forced to call it off when things get out of hand.

episodesList.title: Dhinchak Pooja's Bigg Entry
episodesList.summary: The Bigg Boss weekend just got bigger. Following an exciting visit by stars of the Colors family, the season's first Wild Card entry is announced and she is none other than internet singing sensation, Dhinchak Pooja. She joins the house but not before Salman Khan takes some hilarious jabs at her music. Watch out because the house is about to get a lot louder.

episodesList.title: Akash Nominated For Spitting?
episodesList.summary: Day 21: Get ready for the most bizarre nomination process ever. Bigg Boss directly nominates six housemates who can become safe at the expense of others. Hina Khan gets her sweet revenge by nominating Akash Dadlani for spitting on food. Did he really or is that a lame excuse?

episodesList.title: Survival Of The Fiercest
episodesList.summary: Day 22: Put into a primitive natural setting in the Khulja Sim Sim task, the housemates bare their own untamed wild side. From literal mudslinging to throwing cow dung, no one is as ferocious and unmerciful as Hina Khan.

episodesList.title: Dhinchak Pooja, The Pawn?
episodesList.summary: Day 24: As the Red team and Blue team fight it out in the luxury budget task, Dhinchak Pooja feels the pressure of politics from both sides. Being the newest housemate, taking a decision is never easy but with the task nearing its conclusion, she needs to take one. Will she stand up for herself or will she fall victim to the manipulative housemates?

episodesList.title: Hina In Sapna Ki Adaalat
episodesList.summary: Day 25: Bigg Boss puts Sapna Choudhary's impartial and outspoken nature to the test with a new task called Sapna Ki Adaalat. In the task, she is given the power to decide if Hina Khan deserves another term of captaincy. Watch the judge's eagle eye scrutinise the captain while accusations are slapped, in this one of a kind courtroom drama.

episodesList.title: Priyank: Kebab Mein Haddi?
episodesList.summary: Day 26: Dhinchak Pooja's music video is not the only thing setting fire in the house because Priyank Sharma is back and he is already making his mark. He starts off by jeopardising Puneesh and Bandgi's relationship with a shocking titbit. Priyank surely is back with a mission. So gear up for another wild ride.

episodesList.title: Golmaal Is Back Again!
episodesList.summary: The cast of Golmaal Again joins Salman Khan to celebrate the epic run of their movie. With the fourth installment of the Golmaal franchise turning into a blockbuster flick, it's time for Salman Khan to find the blockbuster contestant of the Bigg Boss house.

episodesList.title: Manu And Lopa Back At Bigg Boss!
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan has a couple of very special guests for the contestants to meet. Catch Manu Punjabi and Lopamudra Raut as they meet and greet the contestants at the house while giving them valuable insight and tips from their time in the Bigg Boss house.

episodesList.title: Priyank, The Serial Rule Breaker
episodesList.summary: Get ready for a heavy dose of diplomacy, disagreements and reconciliation as the housemates try to survive the emotionally draining nomination process. But it's not going to be a smooth ride because Priyank Sharma's constant tattletaling is getting on everyone's nerves. Despite stern warnings, it seems he can't keep his mouth shut. Catch up on the saga of Priyank, the rule breaker.

episodesList.title: Cushions And Captaincy For Sale
episodesList.summary: Day 30: The new luxury budget task has taken the house by a storm. Vikas Gupta and Shilpa Shinde are pitted against each other as rival business persons. Vikas Gupta has a secret advantage and he is only too keen to use it to the fullest, given his rival is none other than Shilpa Shinde.

episodesList.title: Vikas Bounces Back In The Game
episodesList.summary: Day 31: The Bigg Boss Cushion Factory task is poised for an exciting conclusion. With Shilpa Shinde's team hit by internal conflicts, Vikas Gupta can almost taste victory. With his eyes set on the captaincy, Vikas bounces back in the game with some new alliances. But will he have the last laugh in this game of negotiations?

episodesList.title: Emotional Vikas Decides To Quit
episodesList.summary: Vikas Gupta is the worst performer? The housemates think so despite his big victory in the luxury budget task and he faces the Kaal Kothri again. Shilpa Shinde is surely savouring the last laugh but she is not done yet. Watch as her relentless hazing and insults result in Vikas' emotional breakdown and he decides to quit.

episodesList.title: Vikas's Bigg Escape!
episodesList.summary: Vikas Gupta has lost it this time and is not being able to handle Shilpa Shinde's behaviour anymore. He tries to escape from the Bigg Boss house. What happens next?

episodesList.title: Salman Decodes The Shilpa-Vikas Saga
episodesList.summary: The Vikas Gupta and Shilpa Shinde conflict is the talk of the town. Even the housemates are afraid to choose sides on this one. But Salman Khan is here to decode this fiery situation and lay bare the truths and lies. Gear up for some awkwardness as well because Salman suspects some romantic tension behind this conflict.

episodesList.title: Confession Time At Bigg Boss!
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan is joined by some guests who listen to the contestants as they confess their biggest and most shocking secrets. They have to choose the contestant with the most sensational secret, who will receive special powers in the coming week's nominations.

episodesList.title: Priyank And Arshi's Nasty Fight
episodesList.summary: Day 36: If you wanted a fiery start to the week, this is it. From Arshi Khan's emotional breakdown after being incited by Priyank Sharma to Akash Dadlani getting on Benafsha Soonawalla's last nerve, the housemates are off to another chaotic start to a new week. Bandgi Kalra and Puneesh Sharma's hair-raising intimacy is on a show as well. With the crucial nominations ahead, it seems things are about to get much more personal this time.

episodesList.title: Big Accusation, Bigger Chaos
episodesList.summary: Day 37: Following the accusation that Akash Dadlani made dirty comments about the ladies in the house, there is a new spark in the Bigg Boss story. Brace yourself because this fire is showing no sign of decline. With Bandgi Kalra and Puneesh Sharma's relationship already igniting controversy, a new fire of accusations and lies is spreading. But this time, no housemate will be spared.

episodesList.title: Bigg Boss Prize Money Is Now Zero!
episodesList.summary: Day 38: The new luxury budget task titled Mission BB11 has the housemates play astronauts and spend time in a model rocket. But here is the kicker. If someone aborts the task, they get a chance to be the next captain but at the cost of a reduced prize money. But all thanks to the cheating housemates, Bigg Boss reduces the prize money to zero.

episodesList.title: The Blame Game Begins
episodesList.summary: Day 39: The luxury budget task was one big debacle. With the prize money reduced to zero, the housemates are feeling the pressure. The blame game has started as it is time for the worst performers to face the Kaal Kothri. Things escalate when Hina Khan blames Vikas Gupta for the blunder.

episodesList.title: Friend Turned Foe?
episodesList.summary: Day 40: Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta used to be thick as thieves. But, Vikas Gupta has done something which has left Priyank Sharma questioning his character. With Sabyasachi Satpathy becoming the new captain, cracks have started to appear in other friendships as well. What has driven Priyank Sharma to the edge of his patience?

episodesList.title: Bigg Laughs With Kapil Sharma
episodesList.summary: The comedy king and star of the upcoming film Firangi, Kapil Sharma is here to cheer everyone up. The housemates do need some cheering up after their gruelling session with Salman Khan. Gear up for some revelations, some laughter, Kapil's hilarious twist to the English language and lots of drama.

episodesList.title: Bindass Bol With Sulu
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan is joined by Vidya Balan, who promotes her latest film, Tumhari Sulu. She hosts a radio show with Vikas Gupta and Shilpa Shinde, who ask the housemates questions about their stay in the house so far and their relationship with others. Catch the housemates as they tackle sensational questions from Vidya Balan and her co-hosts.

episodesList.title: Priyank Sharma Goes Bald On National TV!
episodesList.summary: The nomination process for the week starts with an unexpected test of friendship. Some housemates have to make a sacrifice to save their nominated friends. Priyank goes bald on National TV. Who does he go bald for?

episodesList.title: Bigg Boss Nominates Hina Khan
episodesList.summary: Day 44: Despite Luv's bigg sacrifice, Hina Khan is nominated for this week's elimination. Vikas Gupta tops it off by not just destroying his favourite jacket to save Shilpa Shinde, but also offering her an apology and a chance to be a part of his professional career. Are they really ready to bury the hatchet?

episodesList.title: Love In The Bigg Boss House?
episodesList.summary: News about Priyank Sharma and Benafsha Soonawalla spending the night in the same bed has spread like wildfire. The whole house is now gossipping about it. Did they really get intimate? Have they found love in the Bigg Boss house? How will they react to this gossip?

episodesList.title: Vikas's Bigg Dhoka To Hiten!
episodesList.summary: Day 46: Vikas Gupta's closest ally, Hiten Tejwani is one of the powerful contenders for the captaincy. Now Vikas Gupta is regretting the promise he made to Puneesh Sharma regarding Bandgi Kalra's safety in the captaincy process. Did he just betray Hiten and kick him out of the captaincy race to save Bandgi Kalra?

episodesList.title: A Hot Pool Party!
episodesList.summary: Day 47: There's a hot pool party in the house. Temperature rises as the hot bikini babes take a dip in the pool. Puneesh Sharma can hardly take his eyes off Bandgi Kalra. But look out for Arshi Khan getting wet in a hot pink saree.

episodesList.title: Sizzling Saturday With Sunny Leone
episodesList.summary: Sunny Leone and Arbaaz Khan, stars of the upcoming film Tera Intezaar are here to spice up the weekend. Sunny brings with her a sizzling task for the unsuspecting housemates and you cannot miss this one. Akash Dadlani facing the music from Salman Khan is just the prefect bonus to this exciting weekend.

episodesList.title: Will Sultan Choose Maharani Padmavati?
episodesList.summary: Salman Khan and the housemates are visited by Queen Padmavati, Deepika Padukone from the upcoming film, Padmavati. She is on a mission to find the Padmavati, Ratan Singh and Alauddin Khilji of the house. That's not all. She wants to know who Salman would kill, marry and date- Katrina, Deepika or Jacqueline?

episodesList.title: When Titans Clash!
episodesList.summary: Day 50: It is common knowledge that Vikas Gupta and Hina Khan cannot stand each other. In the latest nomination process it is Team Vikas Gupta vs Team Hina Khan with both the masterminds trying to save their respective favourites. What follows is mind games and politics at its best. Who wins this game of minds?

episodesList.title: Arshi Is A Flirt! Alleges Priyank
episodesList.summary: Day 51: The Arshi Khan and Priyank Sharma rift just widened in BB Ki Adalat, as Arshi Khan is targeted for her flirty ways and accused of dore daalna and kapde phaadna. But Arshi is not someone to stay quiet.

episodesList.title: Arshi Rains Fury On Hina
episodesList.summary: Day 52: The Bigg Boss court is back in session in all its chaotic glory. Only this time, Hina Khan is under fire. Burdened by a mountain of accusations, Arshi Khan strikes back at Hina and accuses her of not standing up for the women in the house.

episodesList.title: Priyank Defaces Arshi's Poster
episodesList.summary: Day 53: With the wounds from the luxury budget task still fresh, the captaincy task is already announced. Among the five contenders is Arshi Khan. This time Priyank Sharma doesn't let anything come between him and his revenge. Watch a raging Priyank Sharma savoring every moment while he defaces Arshi Khan's poster, bit by bit. Curious to know his reason?

episodesList.title: Akash Explodes After Losing!
episodesList.summary: Day 54: Akash Dadlani goes through a complete meltdown after losing to Hiten Tejwani in the captaincy race. To make matters worse, he blames this loss on none other than his closest ally, Puneesh Sharma. Now with one of the strongest friendships of the season in disarray, what turn will the house take?

episodesList.title: Salman Khan Walks Off!
episodesList.summary: Sultani Akhada, where rivals get to vent out their anger and frustration, turns host to a shocking event. Akash Dadlani's insufferable attitude forces Salman Khan to leave the arena after the rapper simply refuses to compete against his newest enemy, Puneesh Sharma.

episodesList.title: Blockbuster Sunday With Race 3 Cast
episodesList.summary: Day 56: Blockbuster Sunday begins as Salman Khan welcomes the dazzling cast of the upcoming movie Race 3 and shakes a leg with Jacqueline and Daisy to a chartbuster 90s track.

episodesList.title: Pushed Over The Edge!
episodesList.summary: Day 57: The ongoing feud between the friends turned foes crosses all limits when Puneesh Sharma loses his temper and flings away Akash Dadlani's food. With eggs, slippers, and abuses being flung around, will Bigg Boss house witness the ugliest brawl of the season?

episodesList.title: The Red Chilli Attack!
episodesList.summary: Day 58: From putting chilli powder in eyes to waxing body hair, Hina Khan and friends go to extreme level of torture in the luxury budget task. Things go out of hand when Vikas Gupta decides to step in to help Bandgi Kalra. Is Hina Khan spear heading this attack only to win the luxury budget or is she using the task as an excuse of taking out her personal vendetta?

episodesList.title: Akash Faces Extreme Torture!
episodesList.summary: Day 59: In a frenzy to take revenge, did Team Shilpa just cross all boundaries? Watch as Akash Dadlani falls victim to Team Shilpa's vicious attacks and is left with a swollen face.

episodesList.title: Swami Om Hai Tu!
episodesList.summary: Day 60: The Bigg saga of rivalry and revenge continues as the housemates unanimously banish lovebirds Puneesh Sharma and Bandgi Kalra to the Kaal Kothri. Akash Dadlani adds fuel to the fire by unleashing Puneesh Sharma's wrath, comparing him to Swami Om.

episodesList.title: The Captaincy Battle: Priyank V/S Vikas
episodesList.summary: Contenders Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta turn DJs for the next captaincy task and the housemates have to literally dance to their tunes to make them win. Who will support whom?

episodesList.title: Tigress Meets The Tiger
episodesList.summary: Day 62: Usually, Salman Khan is the one putting the housemates on the hot seat every weekend. But this time, Salman is the one on the hot seat as he faces none other than his Tiger Zinda Hai co-star Katrina Kaif, in a hilarious lie detection test.

episodesList.title: Boys Turn Belly Dancers For Kat!
episodesList.summary: Day 63: Want to impress Katrina Kaif? The boys of the Bigg Boss house turn belly dancers to impress the diva. The fun doesn't end here. What Salman Khan made the guys do is beyond imagination.

episodesList.title: A Royal Role Play
episodesList.summary: Day 64: Doesn't matter who the reigning performer is, it is time for the ladies of the house to rule. In an outrageous role playing task, the ladies are now queens and the men become their subjects. From cooking, cleaning, massaging and cross dressing, the queens surely are making their commands heard.

episodesList.title: Not A Baby's Day Out This!
episodesList.summary: Day 65: Becoming a captain is not a child's play. The housemates have to take care of their respective babies in the captaincy task. With Akash Dadlani deciding to back down and the growing tension between some of the other contestants, the fun task quickly takes an interesting turn from the average baby's day out.

episodesList.title: Did Hiten Betray Hina?
episodesList.summary: Day 66: Hina Khan feels that Hiten Tejwani deliberately did not keep his promise of making her captain of the house. With the fight to become the next captain getting fierce, she accuses him of dancing to Vikas Gupta's tune. How will Mr. Cool of the house respond to this accusation?

episodesList.title: End Of The Priyank - Divya Story?
episodesList.summary: Day 67: The housemates are in for the sweetest luxury budget task of all, where they get to personally meet their loved ones. But for Priyank Sharma this sweet task turns sour when his ex-girlfriend, Divya Agarwal makes a surprise visit.

episodesList.title: Hina And Rocky's Romantic Reunion
episodesList.summary: Day 68: The emotional reunions continue in the luxury budget task. Hina Khan goes on a crying spree when her boyfriend, Rocky Jaiswal makes a visit.

episodesList.title: Salman Slams Arshi's Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Day 69: Captain Arshi Khan's foul behaviour hasn't gone unnoticed. But when Salman Khan comes to the defence of Arshi Khan's biggest victim, Shilpa Shinde, Arshi Khan fires back at him, accusing him of being too partial towards Shilpa Shinde.

episodesList.title: Fun With Fukrey Returns Cast
episodesList.summary: Day 70: Join Salman Khan on this blockbuster Sunday as he invites the talented cast of Fukrey Returns to the house. But the real fun begins when the guests fire quirky questions at the unsuspecting housemates.

episodesList.title: Captain Arshi, The Decider
episodesList.summary: Day 71: Captain Arshi Khan is at the helm of the new nomination process. With the housemates divided into two teams, the entire task comes down to the captain's decision. But this time the housemates will either survive or get nominated not as individuals, but as teams.

episodesList.title: Vikas Viciously Attacks Priyank
episodesList.summary: Day 72: The new luxury budget task is all about hiding your emotions. With one group acting as robots, the other group has to make them cry, laugh or angry. But in a house where emotional outbursts are everyday highlights, how will the robots fare? What does Vikas Gupta say to robot Priyank Sharma that makes him cry? Is this merely a task or a way to express personal vendetta?

episodesList.title: Priyank Strikes Back At Vikas!
episodesList.summary: Day 73: The tables have turned and it is Vikas Gupta now at the receiving end. Watch Priyank Sharma go head on hurling insults at Vikas Gupta without mincing a word.

episodesList.title: Secrets Are Exposed!
episodesList.summary: Day 74: Arshi Khan chooses Hina Khan and Vikas Gupta as the two other housemates who get to see the secret clips of the others talking about them. What Hina Khan sees shocks and hurts her.

episodesList.title: Negotiations Reach A Stalemate
episodesList.summary: Day 75: The nomination for the next captaincy candidates reaches a stalemate after the winners of the BB Lab task fail to reach an agreement over the candidacy. With all eyes set on the captain's powers and no one willing to compromise, will the house witness another fierce clash?

episodesList.title: Mouni Roy Sizzles With Salman
episodesList.summary: Day 76: The weekend is off to a sizzling start with Mouni Roy joining Salman Khan to rock the stage. Don't miss this entertaining episode as Salman faces a barrage of questions from his guest.

episodesList.title: Did Hiten Tejwani Get Evicted?
episodesList.summary: Day 77: For the first time in Bigg Boss history, the power of elimination is with the housemates. The result? Hiten Tejwani gets eliminated. Watch the drama unfold as we witness the most shocking elimination ever.

episodesList.title: Housemates's Blunder, Hina's Gain
episodesList.summary: Day 78: Could there be a more explosive start to the week? The housemates are in deep water with Bigg Boss for openly discussing the nominations. Even using secret codes did not help them. A furious Bigg Boss nominates everyone except Hina Khan. The reaction of the housemates? Epic.

episodesList.title: Arshi Lashes Out At Priyank
episodesList.summary: Day 79: The emergence of new alliances turn the tables in the captaincy task. Chaos takes over when Arshi Khan is thrown out of the captaincy race following a shrewd move by her rivals. Watch as she spews fiery accusations of betrayal at Luv Tyagi and Priyank Sharma.

episodesList.title: Sweet Revenge For Hina And Shilpa
episodesList.summary: Day 80: The race for the captaincy reaches an exciting peak when Akash Dadlani adds a new twist by throwing Vikas Gupta out of the race. This is a much awaited sweet revenge for none other than Hina Khan and Shilpa Shinde.

episodesList.title: You Have Lost A Friend, Says Priyank
episodesList.summary: Hina Khan's continuous mockery of Vikas Gupta's dressing sense and the argument that followed has left Priyank Sharma fuming. While Hina Khan denies being at fault, Priyank Sharma sides with Vikas Gupta and accuses her of crossing the line. Is this the end of Hina-Priyank-Luv friendship?

episodesList.title: Captaincy With A Luvly Twist
episodesList.summary: Day 83: In what can only be described as an abrupt finish, Arshi Khan's remarkable Bigg Boss journey comes to an end. But her friends, Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta's fate now rest on the public who have the power to propel one of them into the semi finals through live voting.

episodesList.title: Arshi's Bigg Journey Ends!
episodesList.summary: Day 83: In what can only be described as an abrupt finish, Arshi Khan's remarkable Bigg Boss journey comes to an end. But her friends, Priyank Sharma and Vikas Gupta's fate now rest on the public who have the power to propel one of them into the semi finals through live voting.

episodesList.title: Christmas Masti With Mika Singh
episodesList.summary: Day 84: There is nothing like a good Christmas spirit and the presence of Bollywood singing sensation Mika Singh, to bring together the housemates and spread some holiday cheer.

episodesList.title: Did Priyank Cross The Line?
episodesList.summary: Day 85: Did Priyank Sharma cross the line? An angry Luv Tyagi feels he did during the new nomination task. With the challenge of being trapped inside a dome and trying to spend precisely 42 minutes in there while enduring the constant distractions, this is one task not to be missed.

episodesList.title: Emotional Floodgates Open
episodesList.summary: Day 86: The housemates are left reeling with emotions when their loved ones take the role of the new Padosis. But this happy visit comes with a twist in the form of multiple competitions judged by none other than these new Padosis.

episodesList.title: Akash's Mother In Tears
episodesList.summary: Day 87: The contest for impressing the new Padosis heats up. As part of a deal, Akash Dadlani agrees to help the other housemates in the new task. But when his housemates refuse to keep up their end of the bargain, Akash's mother is left in tears.

episodesList.title: When Priyank Met His Mother
episodesList.summary: Day 88: The housemates are given the chance to bid farewell to the Padosis. This starts the emotional outpourings as the contestants get to actually see their loved ones. When Priyank Sharma's mother comes inside the house, both mother and son break down seeing each other.

episodesList.title: Vikas's Mission Impossible!
episodesList.summary: Day 89: Vikas Gupta is given a chance to win a New Year party for the housemates. But he has to complete some tasks given to him by Bigg Boss without letting the housemates know. With the housemates mocking him and misunderstanding his intentions, will the mastermind find a way to get the job done?

episodesList.title: Luv's Luck Strikes Again!
episodesList.summary: Day 90: It seems luck is sticking to Luv Tyagi like a shadow. In yet another surprising turn of events, Luv Tyagi survives the elimination, thus marking the end of Priyank Sharma's remarkable Bigg Boss journey.

episodesList.title: Balraj Syal's Bigg New Year Roast!
episodesList.summary: Day 91: It is time to welcome the new year and Bigg Boss has planned quite an exciting night. From Balraj Syal roasting the housemates to Salman Khan offering hilariously apt awards to them, the new year celebration is off to an epic start.

episodesList.title: Semi Finale Week Starts With A Shock!
episodesList.summary: Day 92: The first week of the new year starts with a shock. The unsuspecting housemates find themselves in a mire when Bigg Boss disguises this week's nomination process as a performance ranking contest. Which housemate strikes gold by surviving the nomination at the start of this crucial Semi Finale week?

episodesList.title: For A Ticket To The Finale!
episodesList.summary: Day 93: With every housemate eyeing a spot in the finals, a direct entry to the finale is up for grabs. The task titled Mount BB, assigns the housemates the burden of climbing up a mountain, but with their fates in each others hands. Watch as trust and friendships are thrown out of the window in this epic contest.

episodesList.title: Commoners V/S Celebrities
episodesList.summary: Day 94: The fight for the ticket to finale has become a commoner vs celebrity deal. This battle for survival between these two conflicting sides has created the fiery rivalry between Hina Khan and Luv Tyagi.

episodesList.title: Luv V/S Puneesh For Ticket To Finale!
episodesList.summary: Day 95: It has come down to two contestants as contenders for the ticket to Finale. Puneesh Sharma and Luv Tyagi go head on in the BB Museum task. Who do you think will get a spot in the finale

episodesList.title: When Housemates Met The Fans!
episodesList.summary: Day 96: The nominated Bigg Bogg housemates are taken to a mall, where the fans vote live. What ensued after the housemates reach the mall is nothing short of a mass frenzy. The people went crazy after meeting their favourite Bigg Boss contestants.

episodesList.title: Rani Mukherjee Schools Salman
episodesList.summary: Day 97: Salman Khan is joined by Rani Mukherjee who meets the housemates and promotes her upcoming film, Hichki. She turns the Bigg Boss set into a classroom and asks Salman Khan a very interesting question. It's not about his marriage. Curious to know what Rani asked?

episodesList.title: Salman Meets Chulbul Pandey!
episodesList.summary: Day 98: With the last Weekend Ka Vaar of the season underway, stars of the upcoming movie Aiyaary pay a visit to make it even more special. But what happens when Dabangg Salman Khan meets another Chulbul Pandey?

episodesList.title: Shilpa Grilled Before The Press
episodesList.summary: Day 99: The housemates face possibly the biggest challenge of all as they fall prey to severe and relentless questions of the press. But it is Shilpa Shinde who feels most of the attack. Witness her emotional breakdown as the housemates and journalists gang up against her with a bundle of accusations.

episodesList.title: Arshi, The Queen Of Mean
episodesList.summary: Day 100: Arshi Khan makes a surprise visit to spice up the finale week. She is here on a mission to judge the meanest housemate of all. Get ready because the finalists are all fired up to give each other hell, all to impress Arshi, the Queen of Mean.

episodesList.title: A Surprise Midnight Eviction
episodesList.summary: Day 101: With the final nomination process under way, Bigg Boss picks the four finalists of the season. This means bad news for one housemate and it turns out to be Akash Dadlani whose journey unfortunately comes to an end.

episodesList.title: The Reign Of The Mastermind
episodesList.summary: Day 102: The Bigg Boss house turns into Vikas city and everyone has to fulfil dictator Vikas' demands. What happens when Puneesh Sharma and Hina Khan disobey the dictator?

episodesList.title: Did Vikas Cross The Line?
episodesList.summary: Day 103: The Vikas city task ends on a sour note when Vikas Gupta orders Hina Khan to do the unthinkable - destroy his mother's photograph. This leaves Hina Khan in tears and even Puneesh Sharma thinks that Vikas Gupta has crossed the line this time.

episodesList.title: Emotional Recap Of The Bigg Journey
episodesList.summary: Day 104: As the contest nears its conclusion, the finalists get a beautiful reminder of the spectacular journey that they had this season. Watch them turn into emotional wrecks as Bigg Boss offers them a visual recap of their roller coaster journey.

episodesList.title: Bigg Boss 11 - Grand Finale
episodesList.summary: After surviving more than a 105 long and dramatic days in the Bigg Boss House, its time now for one of your favourite finalists to be declared the winner of BB11. Who is it?

While the housemates are still hungover by their entry into the house, Asim Riaz and Paras Chhabra seem to have already found a reason for the first argument of the season. What went wrong? Look out for the highly-anticipated, first episode of Bigg Boss,

As a show of admiration and affection quickly turns into their worst nightmare and, one revelation escalates into multiple altercations, accusations and tears. Watch all the drama.

And nothing is off-limits, from cringe-inducing use of Gobar and garbage to a harrowing personal attack that leaves Arti Singh in tears and broken. Catch all the emotional Atyachar on Sidharth Shukla and Arti in this entertainment-packed episode.

episodesList.title: Kaun banegi Queen?

Tasked with naming the first-ever Queen of the house, the team runs into a roadblock as they are unable to come to an agreement, all thanks to one person. Kaun banegi Queen? Watch the exciting episode.
